rows.original: When you step into the shop, you notice that for once, there’s actually someone in the Steele Tech outpost other than you and the playful ausar who runs the place. A red-haired girl with perky wolf-ears is leaning over the counter, a fluffy red tail swishing just under her black leather jacket. Anno’s sitting up beside the register, legs crossed and one hand running through the thick mane of her snowy hair as she laughs gaily. The redhead smirks, clearly pleased. Both sets of perky ausar ears twitch as you step into the shop, though, and the pair turn towards you.
rows.translation: 你走进商店，发现斯蒂尔科技前哨站里除了你和那位负责经营、性格顽皮的奥萨尔以外，居然破天荒地多了个人。一名红发姑娘俯身倚在柜台上，头顶一对活泼的狼耳，一条蓬松红尾正在黑色皮夹克下方摆动。安诺坐在收银台旁，双腿交叠，一只手梳过浓密雪白的长发，开心地大笑。红发姑娘显然十分愉悦，也跟着微笑起来。不过你一走进商店，两对挺立的奥萨尔耳朵便同时动了动，两人也一起转向你。
rows.raw: "When you step into the shop, you notice that for once, there’s actually someone in the Steele Tech outpost other than you and the playful ausar who runs the place. A red-haired girl with perky wolf-ears is leaning over the counter, a fluffy red tail swishing just under her black leather jacket. Anno’s sitting up beside the register, legs crossed and one hand running through the thick mane of her snowy hair as she laughs gaily. The redhead smirks, clearly pleased. Both sets of perky ausar ears twitch as you step into the shop, though, and the pair turn towards you. "

rows.original: “Oh, hey Boss!” Anno beams, hopping back behind the counter. “You haven’t met Kaede here, have you?”
rows.translation: “噢，老板你好！”安诺笑容满面地跳回柜台后。“你还没见过这位枫，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, hey Boss!” Anno beams, hopping back behind the counter. “You haven’t met Kaede here, have you?” "

rows.original: The red-headed girl turns and smiles shyly at you, giving a little wave. You note that her hands lack the familiar fur-coating of a full-blooded ausar - a halfbreed, maybe?
rows.translation: 红发姑娘转过身，羞怯地向你微笑并轻轻挥手。你注意到她的双手没有纯血奥萨尔常见的毛发覆盖——也许是个混血儿？
rows.raw: "\n\nThe red-headed girl turns and smiles shyly at you, giving a little wave. You note that her hands lack the familiar fur-coating of a full-blooded ausar - a halfbreed, maybe? "

rows.original: You say that you haven’t, and introduce yourself.
rows.translation: 你表示没有，随后介绍了自己。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou say that you haven’t, and introduce yourself. "

rows.original: “Kaede Entara,” the half-ausar says, extending a hand. “I’m Anno’s-”
rows.translation: “枫·恩塔拉，”半奥萨尔伸出一只手说道。“我是安诺的——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Kaede Entara,” the half-ausar says, extending a hand. “I’m Anno’s-”"

rows.original: “Girlfriend,” Anno finishes, reaching over the counter to wrap her arms around Kaede’s shoulders. “Her ship, Talon Rogue just stopped in on Tarkus for a big cargo run. But between you and me, I think she missed me.”
rows.translation: “女朋友，”安诺替她说完，从柜台另一边伸手搂住枫的肩膀。“她的飞船浪客之爪号刚刚停靠塔库斯，准备运送一大批货。不过只跟你说，我觉得她其实是想我了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Girlfriend,” Anno finishes, reaching over the counter to wrap her arms around Kaede’s shoulders. “Her ship, Talon Rogue just stopped in on Tarkus for a big cargo run. But between you and me, I think she missed me.”"

rows.original: “Always,” Kaede says with a little smile, leaning back to plant a kiss on Anno’s cheek.
rows.translation: “一直都想，”枫轻轻一笑，向后靠去亲了亲安诺的脸颊。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Always,” Kaede says with a little smile, leaning back to plant a kiss on Anno’s cheek. "

rows.original: Before you can get jealous, Anno flashes you a toothy grin. “Don’t worry, boss, Kaede and I are pretty... open... about other people. Sometimes with other people.”
rows.translation: 你还没来得及吃醋，安诺便露出满嘴利齿的笑容。“别担心，老板，我和枫对其他人相当...开放...有时也会跟其他人一起。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you can get jealous, Anno flashes you a toothy grin. “Don’t worry, boss, Kaede and I are pretty... open... about other people. Sometimes with other people.”"

rows.original: “Anno!” the redhead says, suddenly blushing.
rows.translation: “安诺！”红发姑娘突然涨红了脸。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anno!” the redhead says, suddenly blushing. "

rows.original: She grins. “C’mon, Red, don’t you remember how we first-”
rows.translation: 她咧嘴一笑。“来嘛，小红，你不记得我们第一次——”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe grins. “C’mon, Red, don’t you remember how we first-” "

rows.original: Kaede squirms in Anno’s grasp as the taller, full-blooded ausar teases her. Anno ruffles her lover’s hair and adds, “Don’t mind her, she’s just bashful. Anyway, boss, I’m gonna keep the shop closed down for a little bit. I’ve got a... break... to take. Unless you want to join us...?”
rows.translation: 高大纯血奥萨尔调戏着恋人，枫在她怀中不停扭动。安诺揉乱恋人的头发，又说道：“别在意，她只是害羞。总之，老板，我要把店再关一会儿。我得...休息...一下。除非你想加入我们...?”
rows.raw: "\n\nKaede squirms in Anno’s grasp as the taller, full-blooded ausar teases her. Anno ruffles her lover’s hair and adds, “Don’t mind her, she’s just bashful. Anyway, boss, I’m gonna keep the shop closed down for a little bit. I’ve got a... break... to take. Unless you want to join us...?”"

rows.original: Kaede’s eyes go wide at the forward invitation, but then again, she doesn’t protest...
rows.translation: 枫听见如此直白的邀请，顿时瞪大双眼，不过她也没有反对...
rows.raw: "\n\nKaede’s eyes go wide at the forward invitation, but then again, she doesn’t protest..."

rows.original: The inside of the shop is an absolute wreck. Piles of junk are scattered around in complete disarray, wall panels and lighting fixtures are hanging by threads of loose wire, and sparks occasionally fly from tears in the bulkhead. The shop clearly took a beating when the ship went orbital.
rows.translation: 商店内部完全是一片狼藉。堆积的垃圾凌乱地散落各处，墙板和照明设备仅靠几根松脱的电线悬挂，不时还有火花从舱壁裂口中飞出。飞船升入轨道时，这间店显然受到了重创。
rows.raw: "The inside of the shop is an absolute wreck. Piles of junk are scattered around in complete disarray, wall panels and lighting fixtures are hanging by threads of loose wire, and sparks occasionally fly from tears in the bulkhead. The shop clearly took a beating when the ship went orbital."

rows.original: The Steele Tech shop is a bigger wreck than ever; it’s more of a death trap than a storefront now. Piles of junk are scattered around in complete disarray, wall panels and lighting fixtures are hanging by threads of loose wire, and sparks occasionally fly from tears in the bulkhead. The shop clearly took a beating when the ship went orbital.
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔科技商店比以往更加残破；如今这里与其说是店面，不如说是死亡陷阱。堆积的垃圾凌乱地散落各处，墙板和照明设备仅靠几根松脱的电线悬挂，不时还有火花从舱壁裂口中飞出。飞船升入轨道时，这间店显然受到了重创。
rows.raw: "The Steele Tech shop is a bigger wreck than ever; it’s more of a death trap than a storefront now. Piles of junk are scattered around in complete disarray, wall panels and lighting fixtures are hanging by threads of loose wire, and sparks occasionally fly from tears in the bulkhead. The shop clearly took a beating when the ship went orbital."

rows.original: The inside of the Steele Tech outpost is a cluttered mess of rusty alien technology stacked ten feet high. Pillars of engine parts and disassembled devices you can’t identify reach to the ceiling, making the shop seem more like a storage room than a storefront.
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔科技前哨站内一片杂乱，生锈的外星科技产品堆起足足十英尺高。由引擎零件和你无法辨认的拆解设备组成的柱子直抵天花板，令这里看起来更像仓库，而非店面。
rows.raw: "The inside of the Steele Tech outpost is a cluttered mess of rusty alien technology stacked ten feet high. Pillars of engine parts and disassembled devices you can’t identify reach to the ceiling, making the shop seem more like a storage room than a storefront."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You step closer to the ausar woman, clearing your throat to get her attention. She looks up with a start, turning to face you. “Oh thank God! Pleeeaaassse tell me you’re the company rep coming in to tell me I can get off this bucket! Pleasepleaseplease!”
rows.translation: 你走近奥萨尔女子，清清嗓子吸引她的注意。她吃了一惊，抬头转身面对你。“噢，谢天谢地！ 求——你——了，快告诉我你是公司派来通知我终于能离开这艘破船的代表！ 求你了求你了求你了！”
rows.raw: "You step closer to the ausar woman, clearing your throat to get her attention. She looks up with a start, turning to face you. “Oh thank God! Pleeeaaassse tell me you’re the company rep coming in to tell me I can get off this bucket! Pleasepleaseplease!”"

rows.original: “Woah, slow down,” you start as the snowy-haired ausar goes all puppy-dog eyed at you.
rows.translation: “哇哦，慢点说，”雪发奥萨尔用小狗般水汪汪的眼睛望着你，你开口说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Woah, slow down,” you start as the snowy-haired ausar goes all puppy-dog eyed at you."

rows.original: “Wait, no, shit!” she says, leaning in and sniffing at you. “Holy shit! You’re... you’re not Victor’s kid, are you?”
rows.translation: “等等，不，操！”她说着贴近你嗅闻起来。“我靠！ 你...你该不会是维克托的孩子吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wait, no, shit!” she says, leaning in and sniffing at you. “Holy shit! You’re... you’re not Victor’s kid, are you?”"

rows.original: You nod.
rows.translation: 你点点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod."

rows.original: “I’M SAVED!” she cheers, rushing up and throwing her arms around your neck. “I thought you guys had forgot about me out here, but I get the CEO in person! And... and wait.”
rows.translation: “我得救啦！”她欢呼着冲上前，双臂环住你的脖子。“我还以为你们把我忘在这里了，结果首席执行官亲自来了！ 而且...等等。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’M SAVED!” she cheers, rushing up and throwing her arms around your neck. “I thought you guys had forgot about me out here, but I get the CEO in person! And... and wait.”"

rows.original: The ausar woman picks up her datapad and scrolls through it hurriedly. “Shit. That memo, right... You’re not here to get me out of here, are you?” she sighs, shoulders slumping. “Sorry about that, boss. Shouldn’t have gotten my hopes up. I’m the planetary manager for your dad’s company. Well, not PLANETARY anymore, huh? Uh, anyway.”
rows.translation: 奥萨尔女子拿起数据板，匆忙滚动查看。“该死。是那份通知，对了...你不是来接我离开的，对吧？”她双肩垮下，叹息起来。“抱歉，老板。我不该抱这么大希望。我是你父亲公司的行星经理。好吧，现在不算‘行星’经理了，对吧？ 呃，总之。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe ausar woman picks up her datapad and scrolls through it hurriedly. “Shit. That memo, right... You’re not here to get me out of here, are you?” she sighs, shoulders slumping. “Sorry about that, boss. Shouldn’t have gotten my hopes up. I’m the planetary manager for your dad’s company. Well, not PLANETARY anymore, huh? Uh, anyway.”"

rows.original: “By the way: we all got the memo after Victor passed on. I can give you a fair discount on our inventory, but otherwise we’re to treat you just like anyone else until otherwise notified.”
rows.translation: “对了：维克托去世以后，我们都收到了通知。我可以在库存商品上给你一个合理的折扣，但在另行通知之前，除此以外，我们必须像对待其他任何人一样对待你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“By the way: we all got the memo after Victor passed on. I can give you a fair discount on our inventory, but otherwise we’re to treat you just like anyone else until otherwise notified.”"

rows.original: She hesitates a moment before tucking the pad under her arm and putting a surprisingly familiar hand on your shoulder. “Sorry about your old man, by the way. The ‘verse is a lesser place without him. The name’s Anno, by the way,” she says, extending a fluffy hand to you. “Anno Dorna. Planetary manager for the company here.”
rows.translation: 她犹豫片刻，把数据板夹在腋下，又出乎意料地熟稔地把一只手放在你肩上。“还有，你父亲的事我很遗憾。这个宇宙少了他，也失色了不少。对了，我叫安诺，”她说着向你伸出覆满绒毛的手。“安诺·多娜。公司派驻这里的行星经理。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe hesitates a moment before tucking the pad under her arm and putting a surprisingly familiar hand on your shoulder. “Sorry about your old man, by the way. The ‘verse is a lesser place without him. The name’s Anno, by the way,” she says, extending a fluffy hand to you. “Anno Dorna. Planetary manager for the company here.”"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Keep your chin up, Anno,” you say, patting the miserable scientist between her big, fluffy ears. “You’ve got a job to do.”
rows.translation: “振作点，安诺，”你一边说，一边拍了拍这位沮丧科学家两只毛茸茸的大耳朵之间。“你还有工作要做。”
rows.raw: "“Keep your chin up, Anno,” you say, patting the miserable scientist between her big, fluffy ears. “You’ve got a job to do.”"

rows.original: “Ugh. I know,” Anno sighs, but still nuzzles her head up against your palm. “I’m just scared, boss. We lost some people when the boat went orbital.
rows.translation: “呃。我知道，”安诺叹息着，却依然抬头蹭了蹭你的手掌。“我只是有点害怕，老板。飞船升入轨道时，我们失去了一些人。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ugh. I know,” Anno sighs, but still nuzzles her head up against your palm. “I’m just scared, boss. We lost some people when the boat went orbital."

rows.original: Lost that little bat kid. A fuckin’ kid, [pc.name]. I swear to God I heard her getting sucked out when we lost atmosphere.
rows.translation: 那个蝙蝠小姑娘没了。她他妈还是个孩子，[pc.name]。失去大气压时，我发誓自己听见她被吸了出去。
rows.raw: " Lost that little bat kid. A fuckin’ kid, [pc.name]. I swear to God I heard her getting sucked out when we lost atmosphere."

rows.original: ” She shudders. “I don’t want to be next. This clanker is barely holding together. I mean, it crashed for a reason, right?”

rows.raw: "” She shudders. “I don’t want to be next. This clanker is barely holding together. I mean, it crashed for a reason, right?”"

rows.original: “Shit. Never mind me, boss. I’m a big girl, I’ll take care of myself. Anyway, you came here for something, or just to check on me?”
rows.translation: “该死。别管我了，老板。我是个大姑娘，能照顾好自己。总之，你来这里是想要什么，还是只想看看我？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shit. Never mind me, boss. I’m a big girl, I’ll take care of myself. Anyway, you came here for something, or just to check on me?”"

rows.original: You’ve barely made it through the door to the Steele Tech shop when you hear the tell-tale click of a gun leveling at you. Your eyes go wide when you see Anno behind the counter, a pistol aimed square at your chest.
rows.translation: 你才刚踏进斯蒂尔科技商店的门，便听见枪械瞄准自己时那标志性的咔嗒声。看到柜台后的安诺用一把手枪直指你的胸口，你顿时瞪大双眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve barely made it through the door to the Steele Tech shop when you hear the tell-tale click of a gun leveling at you. Your eyes go wide when you see Anno behind the counter, a pistol aimed square at your chest."

rows.original: A tense moment passes... before Anno lowers her weapon. “Shit, boss. I thought you were dead,” she sighs, holstering her sidearm on her hip and collapsing against the back wall. “I saw you go out, right before... fuck.”
rows.translation: 紧张的一刻过去...安诺终于放下武器。“该死，老板。我还以为你死了，”她叹息着，把随身武器插回髋部的枪套，随后瘫倒在后墙边。“我看见你出去了，就在那之前...操。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA tense moment passes... before Anno lowers her weapon. “Shit, boss. I thought you were dead,” she sighs, holstering her sidearm on her hip and collapsing against the back wall. “I saw you go out, right before... fuck.”"

rows.original: Anno shakes her head, looking out of the shop window to the debris-cluttered corridor. “Sorry. I’m just... I’m glad you’re alright, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: 安诺摇摇头，透过商店橱窗望向满是残骸的走廊。“抱歉。我只是...很高兴你没事，[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno shakes her head, looking out of the shop window to the debris-cluttered corridor. “Sorry. I’m just... I’m glad you’re alright, [pc.name].”"

rows.raw: "sweep Anno up into a tight hug. She goes rigid in your arms a moment, surprised, before relaxing into your embrace"

rows.raw: "\n\n“What makes you say that?”"

rows.translation: “不会吧，真的吗？”

rows.original: “What’s there to even come here for, now? I thought it was a shithole before, but now... the planet’s gone, and the raskvel don’t have shit to offer aside from cockshines for the galaxy. Damn it, I might as well pack up shop. Fuck your dad, and fuck this post. I want to go home!”
rows.translation: “现在还有什么可来这里找的？ 我以前就觉得这是个破地方，可现在...星球没了，拉斯克维尔除了给全银河的人舔鸡巴，也拿不出什么东西。该死，我干脆收拾东西关店算了。去你爸的，也去这个岗位的。我想回家！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’s there to even come here for, now? I thought it was a shithole before, but now... the planet’s gone, and the raskvel don’t have shit to offer aside from cockshines for the galaxy. Damn it, I might as well pack up shop. Fuck your dad, and fuck this post. I want to go home!”"

rows.original: After a moment of pouting, she groans, “I don’t suppose you need a warp-field expert on your crew, boss? Hell, I can do mechanical engineering, too. Just get me the fuck off the tub before it vents us all into space. I’m begging you!”
rows.translation: 撅嘴生了一会儿闷气后，她呻吟道：“我猜你的船员里不缺曲速场专家，对吧老板？ 见鬼，机械工程我也会。只要带我离开这条破船，别让它把我们全泄进太空就行。我求你了！”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a moment of pouting, she groans, “I don’t suppose you need a warp-field expert on your crew, boss? Hell, I can do mechanical engineering, too. Just get me the fuck off the tub before it vents us all into space. I’m begging you!”"

rows.translation: “现在这地方还有什么意义？ 我以前就觉得这是个破地方，可现在...星球没了。照目前的情况看，还是收拾东西关店最好。我连一分钟都不想继续待在这里！”

rows.original: The grappling gun CLANGs against the outer hull, and a moment later you and Anno are rocketing up the side of the ship towards the mysterious Deck 13. You come to a stop level with an old, rusty airlock. It’s at just such an angle that it would be invisible from the surface, and small enough to not be spotted at range.
rows.translation: 抓钩枪‘铛’地撞上外层船壳，片刻后，你和安诺便沿飞船侧面飞速升向神秘的13号甲板。你们在一扇古老生锈的气闸旁停下。它所处的角度恰好令其无法从地表看见，尺寸也小得不至于被人从远处发现。
rows.raw: "The grappling gun CLANGs against the outer hull, and a moment later you and Anno are rocketing up the side of the ship towards the mysterious Deck 13. You come to a stop level with an old, rusty airlock. It’s at just such an angle that it would be invisible from the surface, and small enough to not be spotted at range."

rows.original: “I knew it,” Anno says, pulling up her map of the ship on a wrist computer. “Here we are. Deck 13, and nowhere near any of those maintenance closets. Something’s on the other side of this hatch, boss. Something that doesn’t want to be found.”
rows.translation: “我就知道，”安诺一边说，一边在腕式电脑上调出飞船地图。“就在这里。13号甲板，而且离那些维修壁橱远得很。舱门另一边有东西，老板。有不想被人发现的东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I knew it,” Anno says, pulling up her map of the ship on a wrist computer. “Here we are. Deck 13, and nowhere near any of those maintenance closets. Something’s on the other side of this hatch, boss. Something that doesn’t want to be found.”"

rows.original: She pulls a small wire from her wrist and plugs it into a dim readout beside the airlock. A moment later, the display flickers to life, beeping weakly as Anno restores power to it. “Almost... got it!” she says, quickly followed by a pneumatic hiss as the hatch slides open.
rows.translation: 她从手腕上拉出一根细线，插进气闸旁一块昏暗的显示器。片刻后，安诺恢复供电，显示器随之闪烁亮起，发出微弱的哔哔声。“就快...好了！”她说道，紧接着气闸滑开，传来一阵气动嘶声。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pulls a small wire from her wrist and plugs it into a dim readout beside the airlock. A moment later, the display flickers to life, beeping weakly as Anno restores power to it. “Almost... got it!” she says, quickly followed by a pneumatic hiss as the hatch slides open. "

rows.original: “Alright, we’re in!” she cheers, leaping from the grappling gun’s rope and into the airlock. You follow close behind, soon finding yourself choking on centuries’ worth of kicked-up dust. You cover your mouth and wave your arms through the thick mist until it finally settles down.
rows.translation: “好了，我们进来了！”她欢呼着从抓钩枪的绳索跃入气闸。你紧随其后，很快便被扬起的数百年积尘呛得难以呼吸。你捂住嘴，在浓厚尘雾中挥舞双臂，直到它终于沉降下来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, we’re in!” she cheers, leaping from the grappling gun’s rope and into the airlock. You follow close behind, soon finding yourself choking on centuries’ worth of kicked-up dust. You cover your mouth and wave your arms through the thick mist until it finally settles down. "

rows.original: “Doesn’t look like anybody’s been this way for an age,” Anno says. Even as she speaks, though, she draws the holdout from her boot and racks the slide. “Come on. The power drain is coming from the north.”
rows.translation: “看起来已经有好几个世纪没人走过这里了，”安诺说道。不过她说话时依然从靴子里拔出袖珍手枪，拉动套筒。“走吧。电力流失来自北边。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Doesn’t look like anybody’s been this way for an age,” Anno says. Even as she speaks, though, she draws the holdout from her boot and racks the slide. “Come on. The power drain is coming from the north.”"

rows.original: Anno is poking around among the space suits, muttering to herself about the age of everything here.
rows.translation: 安诺正在宇航服之间四处翻看，嘴里喃喃念叨着这里所有东西的年代。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno is poking around among the space suits, muttering to herself about the age of everything here."

rows.original: Space Suits
rows.translation: 宇航服
rows.raw: "Space Suits"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You lean in close to examine the space suits sitting idle on the side of the airlock. There’s a dozen of them, all in pristine condition for their age. Each bears the Nova’s emblem proudly on its breast, as well as a smaller set of markings indicating that the spacers who would have worn these were citizens of the United States of America, sponsored by the Bell-Isle/Grunmann corporation.
rows.translation: 你凑近查看闲置在气闸一侧的宇航服。那里足有十二套，而且以它们的年代而言，保存状态全都完好无损。每套胸前都骄傲地印着诺瓦号的徽记，旁边还有一组较小的标识，表明本应穿上这些宇航服的航天员是美利坚合众国公民，由贝尔岛/格伦曼公司赞助。
rows.raw: "You lean in close to examine the space suits sitting idle on the side of the airlock. There’s a dozen of them, all in pristine condition for their age. Each bears the Nova’s emblem proudly on its breast, as well as a smaller set of markings indicating that the spacers who would have worn these were citizens of the United States of America, sponsored by the Bell-Isle/Grunmann corporation."

rows.original: “Either of those names sound familiar to you?” Anno asks, squinting at the I.D. plates. “I recognize the second one, at least: those gray-goo creatures outside. If you muck around in their programming, they insist they were made by Bell-Isle/Grunmann. Maybe... maybe they were part of the ship’s original cargo? But why the hell would anyone take gray-goo into space?”
rows.translation: “这两个名字你听说过吗？”安诺眯眼看着身份铭牌问道。“至少第二个我认识：就是外面那些灰色史莱姆生物。只要摆弄一下它们的程序，它们就会坚称自己由贝尔岛/格伦曼制造。也许...也许它们原本是这艘飞船的货物？ 可到底为什么会有人把灰色史莱姆带进太空？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Either of those names sound familiar to you?” Anno asks, squinting at the I.D. plates. “I recognize the second one, at least: those gray-goo creatures outside. If you muck around in their programming, they insist they were made by Bell-Isle/Grunmann. Maybe... maybe they were part of the ship’s original cargo? But why the hell would anyone take gray-goo into space?”"

rows.original: As you make your way out of the airlock, you’re suddenly blinded by a bright white light. You flinch, trying to regain your senses as a booming metallic voice shouts: “INTRUDERS DETECTED. PASSENGER REGISTRY: UNAVAILABLE. IDENTITIES UNCONFIRMED. LAY DOWN YOUR WEAPONS OR YOU WILL BE PURGED.”
rows.translation: 当你走出气闸时，一道刺眼白光突然令你失明。你畏缩着试图恢复感官，一个洪亮的金属声音随之大喊：“检测到入侵者。乘客名册：无法使用。身份尚未确认。放下武器，否则将予以清除。”
rows.raw: "As you make your way out of the airlock, you’re suddenly blinded by a bright white light. You flinch, trying to regain your senses as a booming metallic voice shouts: “INTRUDERS DETECTED. PASSENGER REGISTRY: UNAVAILABLE. IDENTITIES UNCONFIRMED. LAY DOWN YOUR WEAPONS OR YOU WILL BE PURGED.”"

rows.original: Your vision finally clears, revealing the unmistakable sight of security droids beneath an array of spotlights, each packing a laser pistol aimed right at you. “What the fuck?” Anno gasps, “How the... how the hell are a bunch of droids still functioning? Shit... looks like they’re not kidding!”
rows.translation: 你的视野终于恢复；聚光灯阵列下方赫然站着几台安保机器人，每一台都用激光手枪直指你。“搞什么鬼？”安诺倒吸一口气，“这怎么...一群机器人到底怎么还能运作？ 该死...看来它们不是在开玩笑！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour vision finally clears, revealing the unmistakable sight of security droids beneath an array of spotlights, each packing a laser pistol aimed right at you. “What the fuck?” Anno gasps, “How the... how the hell are a bunch of droids still functioning? Shit... looks like they’re not kidding!”"

rows.original: Before you can react, Anno squeezes the trigger of her sidearm. An almost silent crack echoes through the corridor, and one of the droids crumples to its knees. The others instantly start squeezing their triggers, hurling red bolts of energy downrange at you!
rows.translation: 你还没来得及反应，安诺便扣动随身武器的扳机。一声几乎无法听见的爆响回荡在走廊中，其中一台机器人应声跪倒。其余机器人立刻扣动扳机，将一道道红色能量束射向你们！
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you can react, Anno squeezes the trigger of her sidearm. An almost silent crack echoes through the corridor, and one of the droids crumples to its knees. The others instantly start squeezing their triggers, hurling red bolts of energy downrange at you! "

rows.original: You hear a horrible scream to your side. You pause in your fight just long enough to look, and see Anno crumpled on the ground, motionless. Oh, no.... You turn back, grabbing your [pc.weaponMain] to take the murderous drones down... only to see one of their gun barrels leveled at your forehead.
rows.translation: 你听见身旁传来一声凄厉尖叫。你在战斗中停顿片刻，转头便看见安诺瘫倒在地，一动不动。噢，不....你回过身，抓起[pc.weaponMain]准备击倒杀气腾腾的无人机...却发现其中一支枪管已经对准你的额头。
rows.raw: "You hear a horrible scream to your side. You pause in your fight just long enough to look, and see Anno crumpled on the ground, motionless. Oh, no.... You turn back, grabbing your [pc.weaponMain] to take the murderous drones down... only to see one of their gun barrels leveled at your forehead."

rows.original: Victory
rows.translation: 胜利
rows.raw: "Victory"

rows.original: “FuckyoufuckyouFUCKYOU!” Anno screams while firing her gun again and again into the last droid standing. It shudders and stumbles back under the impacts as her shots blow through its armored skeleton. She fires until the gun clicks empty, and still keeps pulling the trigger of the empty handgun until the robotic aggressor finally collapses, utterly destroyed.
rows.translation: “操你操你操你！”安诺一边尖叫，一边对最后一台仍站着的机器人连连开枪。子弹贯穿装甲骨架，令它在冲击下颤抖着向后踉跄。她一直开到弹匣打空，手枪发出咔咔声，却仍不断扣动空枪扳机，直到那名机器人袭击者终于倒下，彻底报废。
rows.raw: "“FuckyoufuckyouFUCKYOU!” Anno screams while firing her gun again and again into the last droid standing. It shudders and stumbles back under the impacts as her shots blow through its armored skeleton. She fires until the gun clicks empty, and still keeps pulling the trigger of the empty handgun until the robotic aggressor finally collapses, utterly destroyed."

rows.original: Hesitantly, you put a hand on Anno’s shoulder. She just about jumps out of her skin, and for a moment, you’re glad her gun’s run empty. Anno takes a deep breath and pulls you close, into a tight hug. “Fuck, [pc.name]. I didn’t... holy shit, they were going to KILL us.”
rows.translation: 你迟疑地把一只手搭上安诺肩头。她几乎吓得跳起来；有那么一刻，你很庆幸她的子弹已经打光。安诺深吸一口气，把你拉近，紧紧抱住。“操，[pc.name]。我没...我的天，它们刚才真想杀了我们。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHesitantly, you put a hand on Anno’s shoulder. She just about jumps out of her skin, and for a moment, you’re glad her gun’s run empty. Anno takes a deep breath and pulls you close, into a tight hug. “Fuck, [pc.name]. I didn’t... holy shit, they were going to KILL us.”"

rows.original: “We got ‘em first, though,” you answer, ruffling the hair between her perky ears.
rows.translation: “不过是我们先干掉了它们，”你一边回答，一边揉乱她两只挺立耳朵之间的头发。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We got ‘em first, though,” you answer, ruffling the hair between her perky ears. "

rows.original: “Yeah. We did,” she says, not quite smiling. Anno pulls a fresh magazine out and reloads her handgun before tucking it away again.
rows.translation: “是啊。我们干掉了它们，”她勉强笑着说道。安诺取出一个新弹匣，为手枪重新装弹，随后又将武器收起。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah. We did,” she says, not quite smiling. Anno pulls a fresh magazine out and reloads her handgun before tucking it away again."

rows.original: For such a little gun, it sure seemed to pack a punch... and was suppressed, too. Might be worth a look some time.
rows.translation: 这么小的一把枪，威力倒是大得惊人...而且还带消音。改天也许值得仔细看看。
rows.raw: " For such a little gun, it sure seemed to pack a punch... and was suppressed, too. Might be worth a look some time."

rows.original: Anno’s crouched just over an arm’s length away, her compact holdout held close at a low-ready as she waits for an opportunity to fire. Her bushy tail is tucked in tight, ears lowered against her head as she moves from cover to cover, ducking around incoming attacks.
rows.translation: 安诺蹲在仅一臂之遥的地方，将小巧的袖珍手枪贴近身体，保持低位待发姿势，等待开火机会。她浓密的尾巴紧紧夹住，耳朵压低贴在头上，一边从一处掩体移向另一处，一边躲避迎面袭来的攻击。
rows.raw: "Anno’s crouched just over an arm’s length away, her compact holdout held close at a low-ready as she waits for an opportunity to fire. Her bushy tail is tucked in tight, ears lowered against her head as she moves from cover to cover, ducking around incoming attacks."

rows.original: Anno quickly dodges out of the way and lands to safety.
rows.translation: 安诺迅速闪开，安全落地。
rows.raw: "Anno quickly dodges out of the way and lands to safety."

rows.original: Fight!
rows.translation: 战斗！
rows.raw: "Fight!"

rows.original: SEC. DROIDS
rows.raw: "SEC. DROIDS"

rows.original: <b>You’re fighting
rows.translation: <b>你正在与
rows.raw: "<b>You’re fighting "

rows.original: security droids: These security bots are old and outmoded, but that doesn’t make them any less dangerous. They fearlessly march forward through all the fire you and Anno can pour at them, lighting up the corridor with laser fire as they advance over the shattered remains of their fallen comrades.
rows.translation: 安保机器人战斗： 这些安保机器人既古老又过时，却丝毫不因此减少危险。你和安诺倾泻的所有火力都无法令它们畏缩；它们踩着倒下同伴的破碎残骸，无所畏惧地向前推进，激光火力照亮了整条走廊。
rows.raw: " security droids:\nThese security bots are old and outmoded, but that doesn’t make them any less dangerous. They fearlessly march forward through all the fire you and Anno can pour at them, lighting up the corridor with laser fire as they advance over the shattered remains of their fallen comrades."

rows.original: <b>You’re fighting
rows.translation: <b>你正在与
rows.raw: "<b>You’re fighting "

rows.original: security droids.
rows.translation: 安保机器人战斗。
rows.raw: " security droids."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Anno is scanning the destroyed droids, salvaging what remains of their onboard systems for Steele Tech.
rows.translation: 安诺正在扫描被摧毁的机器人，为斯蒂尔科技回收残余的机载系统。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno is scanning the destroyed droids, salvaging what remains of their onboard systems for Steele Tech."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “An armory? I guess that makes sense on a big ship like this,” Anno says as you approach the door. Unlike most doors on the ship - and across the galaxy - it doesn’t slide out of the way when you step up. You just about hit your face against it.
rows.translation: “军械库？ 这么大一艘船上有军械库也算合理，”走近舱门时，安诺说道。与船上乃至全银河的大多数舱门不同，它没有在你靠近时滑开。你差点一头撞上去。
rows.raw: "“An armory? I guess that makes sense on a big ship like this,” Anno says as you approach the door. Unlike most doors on the ship - and across the galaxy - it doesn’t slide out of the way when you step up. You just about hit your face against it."

rows.original: “Must be bolted from the inside. Mechanical lock, not digital,” she adds while poking at the console beside the door. It refuses to activate. “Sorry, boss, forgot to bring my lockpicks with me. Hmm... hey, check it out,” she says, pointing up.
rows.translation: “肯定从里面闩住了。是机械锁，不是电子锁，”她一边补充，一边摆弄舱门旁的控制台。控制台毫无反应。“抱歉，老板，我忘记带开锁器了。嗯...嘿，看看那里，”她说着指向上方。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Must be bolted from the inside. Mechanical lock, not digital,” she adds while poking at the console beside the door. It refuses to activate. “Sorry, boss, forgot to bring my lockpicks with me. Hmm... hey, check it out,” she says, pointing up."

rows.original: Your eyes follow her up to the ceiling. And an air vent.
rows.translation: 你的目光随她抬向天花板。那里有一条通风管。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour eyes follow her up to the ceiling. And an air vent."

rows.original: “Think you can get through there, boss? I’ll give you a boost.”
rows.translation: “老板，你觉得自己能从那里过去吗？ 我可以托你上去。”
rows.raw: " “Think you can get through there, boss? I’ll give you a boost.”"

rows.original: Get Boost
rows.translation: 借力上去
rows.raw: "Get Boost"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Alright, boost me,” you say. Anno laces her fingers together and does so as soon as you hop up into her hand, lifting you up over her shoulder to the vent. She passes you up a screwdriver from her kit, which you’re able to use to handily remove the grate. With that gone, you slip up into the air vent. Cramped as it is, your slight build enables you to easily squirm through the claustrophobic, dusty vent; a minute later, you come to another grate leading straight down past the door. You shift forward, kick the grate out, and plummet to the ground.
rows.translation: “好，托我上去，”你说道。安诺十指交扣；你一跳进她手中，她便将你举过肩头、托到通风口前。她把工具包里的螺丝刀递给你，你用它轻松卸下格栅。清除阻碍后，你钻进通风管。里面虽然狭窄，但你身形纤细，可以轻易扭动着穿过这条令人幽闭恐惧且满是灰尘的通风管；一分钟后，你来到另一面格栅前，正好可以越过舱门向下进入房间。你向前挪动，一脚踹开格栅，落向地面。
rows.raw: "“Alright, boost me,” you say. Anno laces her fingers together and does so as soon as you hop up into her hand, lifting you up over her shoulder to the vent. She passes you up a screwdriver from her kit, which you’re able to use to handily remove the grate. With that gone, you slip up into the air vent. Cramped as it is, your slight build enables you to easily squirm through the claustrophobic, dusty vent; a minute later, you come to another grate leading straight down past the door. You shift forward, kick the grate out, and plummet to the ground. "

rows.original: The door’s right there, and is indeed bolted from this side. You pull the lock, and are instantly greeted by a rush of light from the corridor. “Everything go alright, boss?” Anno asks, looking at your now-dust-covered visage.
rows.translation: 舱门就在旁边，而且确实从这一侧闩住了。你拉开门锁，走廊里的光芒顿时倾泻进来。“一切顺利吗，老板？”安诺看着如今满脸尘土的你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe door’s right there, and is indeed bolted from this side. You pull the lock, and are instantly greeted by a rush of light from the corridor. “Everything go alright, boss?” Anno asks, looking at your now-dust-covered visage."

rows.original: Get Boost
rows.translation: 借力上去
rows.raw: "Get Boost"

rows.original: Get a boost from Anno so you can squeeze through to the next room.
rows.translation: 让安诺托你一把，好挤进下一个房间。
rows.raw: "Get a boost from Anno so you can squeeze through to the next room."

rows.original: “Think you could give me a boost up there, boss? I’m small enough; might be able to crawl through and hop down inside.”
rows.translation: “老板，你能托我上去吗？ 我身材够小，也许可以爬过去，再跳到里面。”
rows.raw: " “Think you could give me a boost up there, boss? I’m small enough; might be able to crawl through and hop down inside.”"

rows.original: Boost Anno
rows.translation: 托起安诺
rows.raw: "Boost Anno"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Alright,” you say, locking your fingers just under the vent. “Up you go.”
rows.translation: “好，”你说着在通风口下方十指交扣。“上来吧。”
rows.raw: "“Alright,” you say, locking your fingers just under the vent. “Up you go.”"

rows.original: “Right. Glad I didn’t wear a skirt,” she jests with a grin, stepping up into your hand and scrambling up to the vent. She quickly pulls the grating off, tosses it aside, and crawls in. The last thing you see is Anno’s feet and tail wriggling as she squirms her way into the vent.
rows.translation: “好。幸亏我没穿裙子，”她咧嘴开着玩笑，踩进你的手中，爬向通风口。她迅速拆下格栅扔到一旁，随后钻了进去。你最后看到的是安诺的双脚与尾巴不断扭动，她一点点挤进通风管。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right. Glad I didn’t wear a skirt,” she jests with a grin, stepping up into your hand and scrambling up to the vent. She quickly pulls the grating off, tosses it aside, and crawls in. The last thing you see is Anno’s feet and tail wriggling as she squirms her way into the vent."

rows.original: A moment passes. A long moment.
rows.translation: 片刻过去了。无比漫长的一刻。
rows.raw: "\n\nA moment passes. A long moment. "

rows.original: Just as you’re starting to get worried, you hear a loud CLICK from the door, followed by a loud rusty squeal as the old door slides open. Behind it, Anno’s beaming. “Fuck yeah! Teamwork!” she cheers, following up her exclamation with a high five.
rows.translation: 就在你开始担心时，舱门传来响亮的‘咔嗒’声，紧接着老旧舱门伴随刺耳锈响滑开。门后，安诺笑容灿烂。“太他妈棒了！ 这就是团队合作！”她欢呼着，又与你击掌庆祝。
rows.raw: "\n\nJust as you’re starting to get worried, you hear a loud CLICK from the door, followed by a loud rusty squeal as the old door slides open. Behind it, Anno’s beaming. “Fuck yeah! Teamwork!” she cheers, following up her exclamation with a high five."

rows.raw: "Boost Anno"

rows.original: Give Anno a boost so she can squeeze into the next room.
rows.translation: 托安诺一把，好让她挤进下一个房间。
rows.raw: "Give Anno a boost so she can squeeze into the next room."

rows.raw: "Pick Locks"

rows.original: What kind of smuggler would you be if you didn’t pack lockpicks?
rows.translation: 出门竟然不带开锁器，那还算什么走私者？
rows.raw: "What kind of smuggler would you be if you didn’t pack lockpicks?"

rows.original: Pick Locks
rows.translation: 撬锁
rows.raw: "Pick Locks"

rows.original: Pick Locks
rows.translation: 撬锁
rows.raw: "Pick Locks"

rows.original: Smugglers probably carry the kind of tools around for this kinda job...
rows.translation: 走私者身上多半带着适合这种工作的工具...
rows.raw: "Smugglers probably carry the kind of tools around for this kinda job..."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Anno is poking around in the robotic guards, murmuring to herself about their manufacture.
rows.translation: 安诺正在机器人守卫身上翻找，低声猜测它们的制造工艺。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno is poking around in the robotic guards, murmuring to herself about their manufacture."

rows.original: Weapon Racks
rows.translation: 武器架
rows.raw: "Weapon Racks"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You step up to the weapon racks at the back of the room. There are several weapons bolted to the wall, but a few are lying out, just ripe for the taking...
rows.translation: 你走近房间后方的武器架。几件武器被固定在墙上，但也有几件随意摆放在那里，正适合顺手拿走...
rows.raw: "You step up to the weapon racks at the back of the room. There are several weapons bolted to the wall, but a few are lying out, just ripe for the taking...\n\n"

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: Robots
rows.translation: 机器人
rows.raw: "Robots"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You step up to the squads of robotic guards on standby, hanging from the ceiling by hooks in their backs. The ship is probably supplying them with a bit of power; they seem to be functional and in great condition for their age, but are just... inactive. If you had some serious tech, you could probably reactivate them under your control: you’d need a secure long-range wireless network, an A.I. taskmaster, and more. Well outside the scope of your work for now.
rows.translation: 你走向待命的机器人守卫小队。它们背后挂着钩子，悬吊在天花板下。飞船或许仍在给它们供应少量电力；它们似乎功能完好，以自身年代而言状态极佳，却只是...毫无动静。要是拥有足够强大的技术，你或许能重新启动它们、令其听你指挥：但这需要安全的远程无线网络、负责下令的人工智能，以及更多东西。这完全超出了你目前的工作范围。
rows.raw: "You step up to the squads of robotic guards on standby, hanging from the ceiling by hooks in their backs. The ship is probably supplying them with a bit of power; they seem to be functional and in great condition for their age, but are just... inactive. If you had some serious tech, you could probably reactivate them under your control: you’d need a secure long-range wireless network, an A.I. taskmaster, and more. Well outside the scope of your work for now."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “You might have forgotten,” you say, pulling out your lockpicks. “I don’t leave home without ‘em.”
rows.translation: “你大概忘了，”你一边说，一边拿出开锁器。“我出门从来不会忘记带它们。”
rows.raw: "“You might have forgotten,” you say, pulling out your lockpicks. “I don’t leave home without ‘em.”"

rows.original: “Oh. Well, uh, go ahead,” Anno says, waving you forward. You crouch down in front of the lock and slide your picks home, moving them with expert skill born out of years of training in the U.G.C.’s underbelly. And you thought Dad making you get a job was dumb...
rows.translation: “噢。好吧，呃，你来吧，”安诺说着挥手让你上前。你蹲到锁前，将开锁器探入锁孔，以多年混迹银河联合邦联地下世界练就的精湛技术操弄起来。你还觉得父亲让你找份工作很蠢来着...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh. Well, uh, go ahead,” Anno says, waving you forward. You crouch down in front of the lock and slide your picks home, moving them with expert skill born out of years of training in the U.G.C.’s underbelly. And you thought Dad making you get a job was dumb... "

rows.original: The lock clicks, and the door slides open. “There we go!” you announce, sliding your picks back into your pocket and stepping through.
rows.translation: 门锁咔嗒一响，舱门随之滑开。“搞定了！”你宣布道，将开锁器收回口袋，迈步走进门内。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe lock clicks, and the door slides open. “There we go!” you announce, sliding your picks back into your pocket and stepping through."

rows.original: Luckily you came prepared - a plucky rogue like yourself would never leave home without
rows.translation: 幸好你早有准备——像你这样机灵的浪客绝不会出门不带
rows.raw: "Luckily you came prepared - a plucky rogue like yourself would never leave home without "

rows.original: his
rows.translation: 他的
rows.raw: "his"

rows.original: her
rows.translation: 她的
rows.raw: "her"

rows.original: lockpicks.
rows.translation: 开锁器。
rows.raw: " lockpicks."

rows.original: You crouch down in front of the lock and slide your picks home. moving them with expert skill born out of years of training in the U.G.C.’s underbelly. And you thought Dad making you get a job was dumb...
rows.translation: 你蹲到锁前，将开锁器探入锁孔。你以多年混迹银河联合邦联地下世界练就的精湛技术操弄起来。你还觉得父亲让你找份工作很蠢来着...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou crouch down in front of the lock and slide your picks home. moving them with expert skill born out of years of training in the U.G.C.’s underbelly. And you thought Dad making you get a job was dumb..."

rows.original: The lock clicks, and the door slides open. You slide your picks back into your pocket and step through.
rows.translation: 门锁咔嗒一响，舱门随之滑开。你将开锁器收回口袋，迈步走进门内。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe lock clicks, and the door slides open. You slide your picks back into your pocket and step through."

rows.original: You put the pistol back where you found it.
rows.translation: 你把手枪放回原处。
rows.raw: "You put the pistol back where you found it."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You put the rifle back where you found it.
rows.translation: 你把步枪放回原处。
rows.raw: "You put the rifle back where you found it."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: With the door open, you turn your attention to what’s in the room as Anno flips the lights on. When they come on, you just about have a heart attack: there are a dozen robots in here, just like the ones from outside!
rows.translation: 舱门打开后，安诺打开灯光，你也将注意力转向房间内部。灯一亮起，你差点被吓得心脏骤停：这里有整整十二台机器人，和外面那些一模一样！
rows.raw: "\n\nWith the door open, you turn your attention to what’s in the room as Anno flips the lights on. When they come on, you just about have a heart attack: there are a dozen robots in here, just like the ones from outside! "

rows.original: But they’re not moving. When the initial oh shit moment passes, you realize that they’re just shells: empty, deactivated droids hanging from what amounts to meat hooks from the ceiling, waiting for orders. Probably waiting for centuries.
rows.translation: 不过它们并没有动。最初那阵糟了的恐慌过去后，你意识到它们只是空壳：这些已停用的机器人空空如也，被堪比肉钩的东西悬挂在天花板下，等待命令。很可能已经等了好几个世纪。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut they’re not moving. When the initial oh shit moment passes, you realize that they’re just shells: empty, deactivated droids hanging from what amounts to meat hooks from the ceiling, waiting for orders. Probably waiting for centuries. "

rows.original: “Hell of an armory,” Anno says, poking at one of the dusty chrome husks. “There are a few dozen of ‘em in here... don’t suppose you need a robot army, boss? Or, more accurately, I don’t suppose the Nova does? My guess is these shells are tied to the onboard computers. Basic white blood cells of a starship. Better keep them offline for now, unless you want another fight.”
rows.translation: “好家伙，真是一座军械库，”安诺一边说，一边戳了戳其中一具积满灰尘的镀铬躯壳。“这里足有几十台...我猜你不需要一支机器人军队吧，老板？ 或者更准确地说，诺瓦号应该不需要吧？ 我猜这些躯壳与船载电脑相连。算是星舰最基本的白细胞。我们现在最好让它们保持离线，除非你还想再打一场。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hell of an armory,” Anno says, poking at one of the dusty chrome husks. “There are a few dozen of ‘em in here... don’t suppose you need a robot army, boss? Or, more accurately, I don’t suppose the Nova does? My guess is these shells are tied to the onboard computers. Basic white blood cells of a starship. Better keep them offline for now, unless you want another fight.”"

rows.original: With the door open, you turn your attention to what’s in the room as you flip the lights on. When the fluorescent bulbs finish flickering their way to life, you just about have a heart attack: there are a dozen robots in here, just like the ones from outside!
rows.translation: 舱门打开后，你打开灯光，也将注意力转向房间内部。当荧光灯管闪烁着彻底亮起时，你差点被吓得心脏骤停：这里有整整十二台机器人，和外面那些一模一样！
rows.raw: "\n\nWith the door open, you turn your attention to what’s in the room as you flip the lights on. When the fluorescent bulbs finish flickering their way to life, you just about have a heart attack: there are a dozen robots in here, just like the ones from outside!"

rows.original: But they’re not moving. When the initial oh shit moment passes, you realize that they’re just shells: empty, deactivated droids hanging from what amounts to meat hooks from the ceiling, waiting for orders. Probably waiting for centuries.
rows.translation: 不过它们并没有动。最初那阵糟了的恐慌过去后，你意识到它们只是空壳：这些已停用的机器人空空如也，被堪比肉钩的东西悬挂在天花板下，等待命令。很可能已经等了好几个世纪。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut they’re not moving. When the initial oh shit moment passes, you realize that they’re just shells: empty, deactivated droids hanging from what amounts to meat hooks from the ceiling, waiting for orders. Probably waiting for centuries."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You step up to the elevator and press the call button. Immediately, the doors slide open, but no car comes.
rows.translation: 你走到电梯前，按下呼叫按钮。舱门立刻滑开，却没有轿厢出现。
rows.raw: "You step up to the elevator and press the call button. Immediately, the doors slide open, but no car comes. "

rows.original: “Someone must have done an override,” Anno says with a shrug, peering into the elevator shaft. “Keeps anybody from accidentally wandering through. I think this one goes right up to
rows.translation: “肯定有人启动了越控，”安诺耸耸肩，探头望进电梯井。“这样就不会有人意外闯进来。我想这部电梯会直接通往
rows.raw: "\n\n“Someone must have done an override,” Anno says with a shrug, peering into the elevator shaft. “Keeps anybody from accidentally wandering through. I think this one goes right up to"

rows.original: ... yeah, it goes right by the shop
rows.translation: ...没错，它正好经过商店
rows.raw: "... yeah, it goes right by the shop"

rows.original: . Maybe we can hitch a ride when we’re done here - I’m pretty good at getting around lockouts like this.”
rows.translation: 。也许我们在这里办完事后可以搭它离开——我很擅长绕过这种封锁。”
rows.raw: ". Maybe we can hitch a ride when we’re done here - I’m pretty good at getting around lockouts like this.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: DECK 13 SECURITY CHECKPOINT
rows.raw: "DECK 13 SECURITY CHECKPOINT"

rows.original: You’re in the central elevator shaft, looking out into the empty security checkpoint. This can take you back up to the main floor of the Nova.
rows.translation: 你身处中央电梯井，望向空荡荡的安检站。这里可以带你回到诺瓦号的主层。
rows.raw: "You’re in the central elevator shaft, looking out into the empty security checkpoint. This can take you back up to the main floor of the Nova."

rows.original: Not far past the security checkpoint is a long tunnel marked “Secondary Reactor Bay”. The way forward, however, is sealed: a huge blast door has slid down, blocking your passage.
rows.translation: 经过安检站不远，有一条标着“备用反应堆舱”的长隧道。然而前进道路已经封闭：一道巨型防爆门落下，挡住了你们的去路。
rows.raw: "Not far past the security checkpoint is a long tunnel marked “Secondary Reactor Bay”. The way forward, however, is sealed: a huge blast door has slid down, blocking your passage."

rows.original: “There’s a loose access panel over there,” Anno says, pointing it out. “Might be able to squeeze through there.”
rows.translation: “那边有块松动的检修板，”安诺指给你看。“也许能从那里挤过去。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“There’s a loose access panel over there,” Anno says, pointing it out. “Might be able to squeeze through there.”"

rows.original: This corridor runs between the elevator checkpoint and the reactor deck below. The door is now open, allowing easy access between the two points of interest.
rows.translation: 这条走廊连接电梯安检站与下方的反应堆甲板。舱门如今已经打开，两处要地之间可以轻松通行。
rows.raw: "This corridor runs between the elevator checkpoint and the reactor deck below. The door is now open, allowing easy access between the two points of interest. "

rows.original: “Alright, let’s see what we’ve got here,” Anno says, grabbing the loose panel hanging off of the hull. “Might be able to squeeze through all the wires. Heh, reminds me of working on the warp gates back at Akkadi. For such huge fucking things, you’d be amazed how cramped they are. Wires everywhere, have to bend over all the time when you’re working. Not that I mind bending over for work, if you know what I mean,” she says with a wink, yanking the panel off and tossing it up against the wall. It clangs and clatters as it drops, the sound echoing through the chamber.
rows.translation: “好吧，来看看这里有什么，”安诺一边说，一边抓住悬在船壳上的松动检修板。“或许能从电线之间挤过去。嘿，让我想起了以前在阿卡迪维修跃迁门的日子。那些东西他妈那么巨大，内部却狭窄得超乎想象。到处都是电线，工作时还得一直弯腰。不过我不介意为了工作弯腰，你懂我的意思吧，”她说着眨眨眼，猛地扯下检修板，将其扔向墙边。板子铿锵作响地掉落，声音在舱室中回荡。
rows.raw: "“Alright, let’s see what we’ve got here,” Anno says, grabbing the loose panel hanging off of the hull. “Might be able to squeeze through all the wires. Heh, reminds me of working on the warp gates back at Akkadi. For such huge fucking things, you’d be amazed how cramped they are. Wires everywhere, have to bend over all the time when you’re working. Not that I mind bending over for work, if you know what I mean,” she says with a wink, yanking the panel off and tossing it up against the wall. It clangs and clatters as it drops, the sound echoing through the chamber. "

rows.original: Anno winces at the commotion, covering her big ears. When it finally dies down, she peeks into the shaft. “Yeah, I think I can get through there. Let me just-” she starts to say, before the back of the access panel explodes. You stumble back, covering your eyes as shrapnel goes flying and... and a great big fucking gray hand reaches up through the hole, grabs Anno by the head, and sucks her through like a noodle. She doesn’t even have time to scream.
rows.translation: 巨响令安诺畏缩着捂住一双大耳朵。声音终于平息，她探头望进管道。“没错，我想自己能从这里过去。我只要——”她才刚开口，检修板后方便轰然炸开。弹片四处飞溅，你踉跄后退并遮住双眼，而...而一只他妈大得惊人的灰色手掌从洞里伸上来，一把抓住安诺的脑袋，像吸面条一样把她吸了进去。她甚至来不及尖叫。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno winces at the commotion, covering her big ears. When it finally dies down, she peeks into the shaft. “Yeah, I think I can get through there. Let me just-” she starts to say, before the back of the access panel explodes. You stumble back, covering your eyes as shrapnel goes flying and... and a great big fucking gray hand reaches up through the hole, grabs Anno by the head, and sucks her through like a noodle. She doesn’t even have time to scream."

rows.original: Holy fuck.
rows.translation: 我操。
rows.raw: "\n\nHoly fuck."

rows.original: Jump In
rows.translation: 跳下去
rows.raw: "Jump In"

rows.original: DECK 13 SHIELD CONTROL
rows.raw: "DECK 13 SHIELD CONTROL"

rows.original: Jump In
rows.translation: 跳下去
rows.raw: "Jump In"

rows.original: It looks like you’re going to have to juuuuuump!
rows.translation: 看来你只能往下——跳——啦！
rows.raw: "It looks like you’re going to have to juuuuuump!"

rows.original: Oh shit, oh shit, oh shit. “ANNO!” you scream, leaping through the hole in the bulkhead and into the darkness below...
rows.translation: 糟了，糟了，糟了。“安诺！”你大喊着跃过舱壁上的洞口，跳进下方的黑暗...
rows.raw: "Oh shit, oh shit, oh shit. “ANNO!” you scream, leaping through the hole in the bulkhead and into the darkness below..."

rows.original: You land with a splash. You feel like you fell forever, that you should have splattered all over the deck below... but instead, you scramble up amid a floor full of... shit, you can’t see! The room’s pitch-black, but you feel something gel-like squirming around your [pc.feet], as if you’d landed in a pool full of gelatin. It’s only a few inches deep, though, and you’re able to stand without too much trouble despite being a bit unsteady with this squirming goop all around you, below your [pc.feet].
rows.translation: 你扑通一声落地。你感觉自己仿佛坠落了无穷无尽的距离，本该摔得满地都是...可你反而在一片铺满地板的...该死，你什么都看不见！ 房间里漆黑一片，但你能感觉到某种凝胶般的东西在[pc.feet]周围蠕动，仿佛自己落进了一池果冻。不过它只有几英寸深，因此尽管这些蠕动黏液遍布周围、淹没[pc.feet]下方，让你有些站立不稳，你依然没有太大困难便站了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou land with a splash. You feel like you fell forever, that you should have splattered all over the deck below... but instead, you scramble up amid a floor full of... shit, you can’t see! The room’s pitch-black, but you feel something gel-like squirming around your [pc.feet], as if you’d landed in a pool full of gelatin. It’s only a few inches deep, though, and you’re able to stand without too much trouble despite being a bit unsteady with this squirming goop all around you, below your [pc.feet]. "

rows.original: “Anno!” you repeat, desperately flailing your hands around in the dark.
rows.translation: “安诺！”你再次呼喊，双手在黑暗中绝望地四处乱抓。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anno!” you repeat, desperately flailing your hands around in the dark."

rows.original: “Here!” the ausar answers from not that far away. The room echoes with your voices and the squelching sound of footsteps over the goop on the ground. “This gooey shit broke my fall.... I’m alright, boss.”
rows.translation: “在这里！”奥萨尔在不远处答道。你们的声音和脚步踩过地面黏液时发出的咕叽声在房间里回荡。“这些黏糊糊的鬼东西替我缓冲了坠落....我没事，老板。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Here!” the ausar answers from not that far away. The room echoes with your voices and the squelching sound of footsteps over the goop on the ground. “This gooey shit broke my fall.... I’m alright, boss.” "

rows.original: “Hey, who’re you calling shit?” an indignant third voice pouts.
rows.translation: “嘿，你们说谁是鬼东西？”第三个声音气愤地噘嘴问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, who’re you calling shit?” an indignant third voice pouts. "

rows.original: “Oh, shit,” Anno says.
rows.translation: “噢，糟了，”安诺说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, shit,” Anno says."

rows.original: Suddenly, the lights blast on full-force, nearly blinding you once again. As you squint and recoil, a silvery, goo-like girl drops down from the ceiling, plopping wetly onto the deck.
rows.translation: 灯光突然以全部功率亮起，几乎再度令你失明。你眯起眼畏缩后退，一名银色黏液般的姑娘从天花板落下，湿漉漉地啪嗒一声落在甲板上。
rows.raw: "\n\nSuddenly, the lights blast on full-force, nearly blinding you once again. As you squint and recoil, a silvery, goo-like girl drops down from the ceiling, plopping wetly onto the deck."

rows.original: You instantly recognize the familiar, silvery figure of a gray goo... but this one is different. More human. It stands on two long, well-formed legs that run from a pair of tall boots up into a knee-length skirt of goo it’s grown around itself, with a tight blouse tucked into it - also made of goo - that strains against a pair of perky, large breasts that aren’t nearly as comically over-stated as her sisters’ are. Her hair is almost real-looking, with fully textured individual strands running down her back in a tight ponytail. If it weren’t for the swirling, moving gray sheen that makes up her entire body, she could easily pass for a human woman, maybe twenty five years of age. Young, tall, athletic, almost grave.
rows.translation: 你立刻认出这道熟悉的银色身影是一只灰色史莱姆...但这个灰色史莱姆有所不同。更像人类。她双腿修长、轮廓分明，从一双高筒靴一路延伸到由黏液塑成的及膝裙；裙子里掖着同样由黏液构成的紧身上衣，被一对挺翘硕大的乳房撑得紧绷，不过并不像姐妹们那样夸张得可笑。她的头发几乎足以以假乱真，纹理分明的一根根发丝在背后扎成紧致马尾。若非她整个身体都由不断旋转流动的灰色光泽构成，她轻易便能冒充一名二十五岁左右的人类女子。年轻、高挑、矫健，甚至显得严肃。
rows.raw: " You instantly recognize the familiar, silvery figure of a gray goo... but this one is different. More human. It stands on two long, well-formed legs that run from a pair of tall boots up into a knee-length skirt of goo it’s grown around itself, with a tight blouse tucked into it - also made of goo - that strains against a pair of perky, large breasts that aren’t nearly as comically over-stated as her sisters’ are. Her hair is almost real-looking, with fully textured individual strands running down her back in a tight ponytail. If it weren’t for the swirling, moving gray sheen that makes up her entire body, she could easily pass for a human woman, maybe twenty five years of age. Young, tall, athletic, almost grave."

rows.original: “Gray goo!” Anno snaps, drawing down on the feminine figure before you. You cock an eyebrow, also drawing your [pc.rangedWeapon]. “They’re all over Tarkus, boss. Try and drain you dry of sex-juice. But they’re normally all big-titted bimbos. This one’s... different,” she says, looking the creature up and down.
rows.translation: “灰色史莱姆！”安诺厉声喊道，举枪瞄准你们面前的女性身影。你挑起眉毛，也拔出[pc.rangedWeapon]。“它们在塔库斯到处都是，老板。就想把你的性爱汁液榨得一滴不剩。不过正常情况下都是些大奶花瓶。这个...不太一样，”她说着上下打量那个生物。

Try and drain you dry of sex-juice. But they’re normally all big-titted bimbos. This one’s... different,” she says, looking the creature up and down. "

rows.original: It stands on two long, well-formed legs that run from a pair of tall boots up into a knee-length skirt of goo it’s grown around itself, with a tight blouse tucked into it - also made of goo - that strains against a pair of perky, large breasts that aren’t nearly as comically over-stated as her sisters’ are. Her hair is almost real looking, with fully textured individual strands running down her back in a tight ponytail. If it weren’t for the swirling, moving gray sheen that makes up her entire body, she could easily pass for a human woman, maybe twenty five years of age. Young, tall, athletic, almost grave.
rows.translation: 她双腿修长、轮廓分明，从一双高筒靴一路延伸到由黏液塑成的及膝裙；裙子里掖着同样由黏液构成的紧身上衣，被一对挺翘硕大的乳房撑得紧绷，不过并不像姐妹们那样夸张得可笑。她的头发几乎足以以假乱真，纹理分明的一根根发丝在背后扎成紧致马尾。若非她整个身体都由不断旋转流动的灰色光泽构成，她轻易便能冒充一名二十五岁左右的人类女子。年轻、高挑、矫健，甚至显得严肃。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt stands on two long, well-formed legs that run from a pair of tall boots up into a knee-length skirt of goo it’s grown around itself, with a tight blouse tucked into it - also made of goo - that strains against a pair of perky, large breasts that aren’t nearly as comically over-stated as her sisters’ are. Her hair is almost real looking, with fully textured individual strands running down her back in a tight ponytail. If it weren’t for the swirling, moving gray sheen that makes up her entire body, she could easily pass for a human woman, maybe twenty five years of age. Young, tall, athletic, almost grave."

rows.original: “It’s almost human,” Anno says, staring at the goo. Then, louder, “Sorry sweetheart, we’ve got work to do. Go molest somebody else.”
rows.translation: “她几乎像个人类，”安诺盯着灰色史莱姆说道。随后，她提高声音：“抱歉，甜心，我们还有工作要做。去骚扰别人吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s almost human,” Anno says, staring at the goo. Then, louder, “Sorry sweetheart, we’ve got work to do. Go molest somebody else.”"

rows.original: “Almost human? Jeez, what’d I ever do to you...” the goo scowls, crossing her arms under her rack; her whole body jiggles slightly as she takes a step forward. “Now who the fuck are you, exactly?”
rows.translation: “几乎像个人类？ 天啊，我到底哪里得罪你了...”灰色史莱姆皱起眉头，把双臂交叠在胸前；她向前迈出一步，整个身体随之微微摇晃。“现在告诉我，你们到底是什么人？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Almost human? Jeez, what’d I ever do to you...” the goo scowls, crossing her arms under her rack; her whole body jiggles slightly as she takes a step forward. “Now who the fuck are you, exactly?”"

rows.original: Anno blinks. “Anno Dorna. This is [pc.name] Steele. We’re looking into a power draw from this deck.”
rows.translation: 安诺眨眨眼。“安诺·多娜。这位是[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。我们正在调查这层甲板的电力流失。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno blinks. “Anno Dorna. This is [pc.name] Steele. We’re looking into a power draw from this deck.”"

rows.original: “Ah,” the goo says, her scowl softening into an almost-apologetic frown. “Honestly, I’m surprised nobody noticed before now. It’s been an age.”
rows.translation: “啊，”灰色史莱姆说道，怒容缓和成近乎歉意的蹙眉。“说实话，我很惊讶居然直到现在才有人发现。已经过了好几个世纪。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah,” the goo says, her scowl softening into an almost-apologetic frown. “Honestly, I’m surprised nobody noticed before now. It’s been an age.”"

rows.original: She sighs, reaching down into the sea of... of gray goo around your feet. So that’s what that was. From the gunk on the floor, the goo-girl draws a long, straight-edged saber as if from thin air, the goo around you forming into the weapon as she draws it. “I’m sorry about this. Really, I am.”
rows.translation: 她叹息着伸手探入你脚边那片...灰色史莱姆形成的海洋。原来刚才就是这个东西。灰色史莱姆姑娘从地面的黏液中抽出一把笔直锋利的长剑，仿佛凭空变出一般；她拔剑时，周围的灰色史莱姆随之凝聚成武器。“我很抱歉。真的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sighs, reaching down into the sea of... of gray goo around your feet. So that’s what that was. From the gunk on the floor, the goo-girl draws a long, straight-edged saber as if from thin air, the goo around you forming into the weapon as she draws it. “I’m sorry about this. Really, I am.”"

rows.original: Anno doesn’t hesitate for a second. She squeezes the trigger of her handgun, sending a bullet straight through the goo’s head. It splatters like a watermelon, smearing across the bulkhead behind her in a wet rain of gooey brain-matter. The rest of her body staggers forward, slumps to its knees, and flops to the ground. In the blink of an eye, it dissolves into the goo on the deck.
rows.translation: 安诺毫不犹豫地扣动手枪扳机，让一颗子弹径直贯穿灰色史莱姆头颅。她的脑袋如西瓜般爆裂，黏糊糊的脑组织如湿雨般溅满后方舱壁。其余身体踉跄着向前扑去，双膝一软跪倒在地，随后瘫落下来。转眼之间，她便溶入甲板上的黏液。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno doesn’t hesitate for a second. She squeezes the trigger of her handgun, sending a bullet straight through the goo’s head. It splatters like a watermelon, smearing across the bulkhead behind her in a wet rain of gooey brain-matter. The rest of her body staggers forward, slumps to its knees, and flops to the ground. In the blink of an eye, it dissolves into the goo on the deck. "

rows.original: “Bitch,” Anno spits, starting toward the consoles flickering around the room. “Fucking weird. I’ve never seen a goo act like that before. She was smart. Way smarter than the ones outside.”
rows.translation: “贱人，”安诺啐道，动身走向房间周围闪烁的控制台。“真他妈奇怪。我从没见过灰色史莱姆这样行动。她很聪明。比外面那些聪明得多。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bitch,” Anno spits, starting toward the consoles flickering around the room. “Fucking weird. I’ve never seen a goo act like that before. She was smart. Way smarter than the ones outside.”"

rows.original: “I’ll take that as a compliment,” the goo’s voice says, as if from all around you.
rows.translation: “我就把这当成夸奖了，”灰色史莱姆的声音仿佛从四面八方传来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ll take that as a compliment,” the goo’s voice says, as if from all around you. "

rows.original: You spin on a heel, coming face to face with the goo again as she rises from the sea of gray behind you, reforming with her head quite intact and a deadly look in her steel-gray eyes.
rows.translation: 你转身回头，正好与灰色史莱姆面对面。她从身后的灰色海洋中升起，重新形成完好无损的脑袋，一双钢灰色眼眸透出致命目光。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou spin on a heel, coming face to face with the goo again as she rises from the sea of gray behind you, reforming with her head quite intact and a deadly look in her steel-gray eyes. "

rows.original: Uh-oh.
rows.translation: 糟糕。
rows.raw: "\n\nUh-oh. "

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “No,” the goo groans, staggering back under your withering barrage of attacks and the hail of bullets from Anno’s gun. “No, I can’t... my work is too important. I’ve given everything for this... EVERYTHING. YOU WILL NOT STOP ME! YOU WILL NOT!” the goo screams, suddenly finding her second wind. Goo wriggles forward from the floor and walls, adding itself to her mass, repairing the damage you’ve done to her. She looks as good as new in the blink of an eye.
rows.translation: “不，”灰色史莱姆呻吟着，在你凶猛的连续攻击与安诺枪械的弹雨下踉跄后退。“不，我不能...我的工作太重要了。我已经为此付出了一切...一切。你们休想阻止我！ 你们休想!”灰色史莱姆尖声咆哮，突然恢复了力气。黏液从地面与墙壁向前蠕动，融入她的身体，修复你们造成的伤害。转眼之间，她便焕然一新。

Goo wriggles forward from the floor and walls, adding itself to her mass, repairing the damage you’ve done to her. She looks as good as new in the blink of an eye."

rows.original: “I will not fall here. Not to you!” the goo says, drawing her sword again.
rows.translation: “我不会倒在这里。更不会倒在你们手上！”灰色史莱姆说着再次拔出长剑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I will not fall here. Not to you!” the goo says, drawing her sword again."

rows.original: “You’ve got to be fucking kidding me!” Anno says, ramming a new magazine into her gun. “How do we kill this bitch!?”
rows.translation: “你他妈在开玩笑吧！”安诺一边说，一边把新弹匣猛塞进枪里。“我们到底要怎么杀掉这个贱人！?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’ve got to be fucking kidding me!” Anno says, ramming a new magazine into her gun. “How do we kill this bitch!?”"

rows.original: The goo sneers. “I am trillions upon trillions of machines... a thousand intelligences.... And you can’t kill what’s already dead.”
rows.translation: 灰色史莱姆冷笑一声。“我是数万亿台机器...也是上千个意识....而你们杀不死早已死去的东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe goo sneers. “I am trillions upon trillions of machines... a thousand intelligences.... And you can’t kill what’s already dead.”"

rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, shit.”"

rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “FUCKING DIE! DIE ALREADY!” Anno screams, firing her gun again and again and again into the retreating mass of gray goo, blowing fist-sized holes through its body with every shot. Still, it doesn’t fall - not for long.
rows.translation: “他妈的去死！ 赶紧去死！”安诺放声尖叫，一次又一次向后退的灰色史莱姆团块开枪，每一发都在她体内轰出拳头大小的洞。然而她始终没有倒下——即便倒下也只是一瞬。

rows.translation: “你们很厉害，”安诺重新装弹时，灰色史莱姆在这短暂喘息中说道。“可我...我不想死。明明已经如此接近...我不会...”

rows.original: Before Anno can try and kill her again, the goo all throughout the room surges, lifting up and swirling around. You grab your companion and hit the deck as a room full to bursting with nanomachines comes alive, swirling into the shape of a giant fist connected to the gray goo. With it, she punches down the door in the side of the room and leaps out, into the reactor chamber and away from you.
rows.translation: 安诺还没来得及再次尝试杀死她，房间各处的黏液便猛然涌动，向上升起并四处旋转。整间房内几乎满溢而出的纳米机器苏醒过来，凝聚成一只与灰色史莱姆相连的巨拳；你抓住同伴卧倒在地。灰色史莱姆用它一拳砸开房间侧面的舱门，纵身跃入反应堆舱，逃离你们。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore Anno can try and kill her again, the goo all throughout the room surges, lifting up and swirling around. You grab your companion and hit the deck as a room full to bursting with nanomachines comes alive, swirling into the shape of a giant fist connected to the gray goo. With it, she punches down the door in the side of the room and leaps out, into the reactor chamber and away from you."

rows.original: “What the...” Anno breathes, struggling to her feet. “What the hell was that thing?”

rows.raw: "\n\n“What the...” Anno breathes, struggling to her feet. “What the hell was that thing?”"

rows.translation: 你还没来得及完成任务，她便猛扑过来，用肩膀撞上你，把你砸向安诺。你们两人翻滚倒地；绝望的灰色史莱姆姑娘一把抓住反应堆舱入口，纵身跃入其中，逃离你们的性欲攻势。

rows.original: “What the hell!?” Anno shouts beside you, firing again and again into the seemingly unstoppable goo-girl. Every bullet blows chunks out of the jiggling gray mass of her body, enough to kill any living thing outright; this monster just shrugs it off as her body reforms into perfect shape a moment later, as if she’d never been hit at all. “She won’t go fucking down!”
rows.translation: “搞什么鬼！?”安诺在你身旁大喊，一次又一次向看似无法阻挡的灰色史莱姆姑娘开火。每颗子弹都会从她不断晃动的灰色身体上轰下一块，足以当场杀死任何生物；这个怪物却仿佛毫无感觉，片刻后身体便恢复完整，就像从未中枪一样。“她他妈根本倒不下去！”

rows.original: Just as Anno says that, though, one of her bullets blows the goo’s head off. The glistening gray body staggers forward, shudders, and collapses into the sea of goo at Anno’s feet. The ausar blinks, breathing hard. She stares at the locked-back slide of her empty gun. Behind her, the mass of gray goo squirms and rises, filling out into the shape of the unkillable goo.
rows.translation: 不过安诺话音刚落，其中一颗子弹便轰掉灰色史莱姆的脑袋。闪闪发光的灰色身体踉跄向前，浑身一颤，随后瘫入安诺脚边的黏液海洋。奥萨尔眨了眨眼，呼吸急促，盯着空枪后锁的套筒。在她背后，那团灰色史莱姆扭动着升起，重新塑成那个无法杀死的灰色史莱姆。

rows.original: Before you have a chance to warn her, Anno lets out a high scream as the gray goo surges around her to wrap around her with thick tentacles. Her arms and legs are grabbed first, splaying her out and lifting her off the ground. Another, more slender tentacle breaks off from the rest of the bunch so that it can slither up like a snake towards Anno’s face. She struggles, of course, and writhes in the tentacles’ grasp without finding purchase to escape. Her every movement is easily countermanded by the tentacles’ grasp.
rows.translation: 你还没来得及警告她，灰色史莱姆便涌向安诺，化作粗大触手将她缠住，令她发出一声高亢尖叫。触手先抓住她的四肢，把她大大展开并提离地面。另一根更加纤细的触手从其余触手中分离，像蛇一样蜿蜒爬向安诺面前。她当然奋力挣扎，在触手掌握中不断扭动，却找不到任何着力点脱身。她的每一个动作都被触手的钳制轻易抵消。

She struggles, of course, and writhes in the tentacles’ grasp without finding purchase to escape. Her every movement is easily countermanded by the tentacles’ grasp. "

rows.original: You move to help, grabbing your [pc.meleeWeapon] and lunging at the tentacle mass growing from the deck
rows.translation: 你拔出[pc.meleeWeapon]上前相助，扑向甲板上生长的触手团块
rows.raw: "\n\nYou move to help, grabbing your [pc.meleeWeapon] and lunging at the tentacle mass growing from the deck"

rows.translation: 你冲上前相助，扑向甲板上生长的触手团块
rows.raw: "\n\nYou move to help and lunge at the tentacle mass growing from the deck"

rows.original: - only for another gray vine to snap at you and throw you back against the far bulkhead. Your world spins, stars exploding in your vision as you slump down to the ground, barely conscious after the massive blow. Through the haze, though, you’re able - if not forced - to watch the tentacles drag Anno through the air, tearing at her catsuit until it’s nothing but shreds hanging from her writhing body. The slender one at her face presses against her lips, not waiting for her to relent but simply pouring through at the microscopic level and slowly forcing her mouth open from the inside.
rows.translation: ——却被另一条灰色藤蔓猛地抽中，砸向远处的舱壁。世界在你眼前旋转，星光在视野中炸开；遭受重击的你瘫落地面，几乎失去意识。然而透过朦胧视野，你仍能——甚至被迫——看着触手把安诺拖上半空，撕扯她的紧身衣，直到衣服只剩布条挂在扭动的身体上。她面前的纤细触手压上嘴唇，根本不给她屈服的机会，而是在微观层面直接灌入口中，慢慢从内部强行撑开她的嘴。

rows.original: The reactor room you enter is monolithic, easily taking up half the deck with thrumming power converters and a glowing fusion reactor dominating the center of the expansive room, surrounded by vats and tubes filled with gray goo. Several wires lead directly from the reactor to dozens of computer banks, servers, and hard drives scattered all throughout the room, like half the computers aboard the ship were all pulled and clustered around the reactor. Every device is beeping and blinking rhythmically, drawing power right from the secondary reactor itself. The heat in the room is oppressive, almost overwhelming, with so many devices running on max and clustered together. You break out in a sweat almost immediately as the heat hits you like a brick wall.
rows.translation: 你进入的反应堆室无比庞大，嗡鸣的电力转换器与一座发光聚变反应堆占据中央，轻易覆盖半层甲板；四周则环绕着装满灰色史莱姆的储罐与管道。几条电缆直接从反应堆连向散落在整间房里的数十组电脑、服务器与硬盘，仿佛把船上一半电脑都拆下来，集中堆在反应堆周围。每台设备都在有节奏地鸣响闪烁，直接从备用反应堆汲取电力。如此多设备以最大功率运作并聚集在一起，令房间里的热量令人窒息，几乎无法忍受。热浪如砖墙般撞上身体，你几乎立刻便冒出汗来。

rows.original: The gray goo waves her sword around the reactor bay. “This is... this is all that’s left of them. The Nova carried thousands. Ten thousand, four hundred and twenty eight souls borne into the void. Deep space exploration, maybe colonization if she’d found a good planet. Something better than Tarkus, at least. We would have settled a world, another beacon of humanity in the stars, ready to wait for the next wave centuries later.”
rows.translation: 灰色史莱姆挥动长剑，指向整个反应堆舱。“这些...这些就是他们仅存的一切。诺瓦号曾载着成千上万的人。总计一万零四百二十八个灵魂，被送入茫茫虚空。深入太空探索，如果找到一颗好星球，也许还会展开殖民。至少要找一个比塔库斯更好的地方。我们本应定居在某个世界，成为群星间另一座人类灯塔，准备好等待数百年后的下一波人。”

We would have settled a world, another beacon of humanity in the stars, ready to wait for the next wave centuries later.”"

rows.original: She gives a wry chuckle under her breath and locks eyes with you. “Did you ever notice that there were no bodies on the Nova? All those cryo beds, thousands and thousands of them... and not a single body.” She sighs. “There was a malfunction aboard the Nova, right out of the gate: a gas leak in the cryo system. We hadn’t even left Sol before the crew was dead. We were dust long before the old girl crashed here.”
rows.translation: 她低声苦笑，与你四目相对。“你有没有注意到，诺瓦号上根本没有尸体？ 那么多冷冻舱，成千上万个...却连一具尸体都没有。”她叹息道。“诺瓦号一启航便发生了故障：冷冻系统气体泄漏。我们甚至还没离开太阳系，船员便全都死了。早在这位老姑娘坠毁于此之前，我们就已经化作尘埃。”

There are dozens of them still floating, even now that the gates are up, still looking for a habitable world. It wasn’t that uncommon for something to just... go wrong.”
