rows.translation: “不，确实不少见，”灰色史莱姆说道。“但我们还是出发了。数百艘飞船，数百万个渴望探索银河的灵魂。谁能想到，我们只需再等几个世纪，就能等来你们奥萨尔为我们带来跃迁门？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, it wasn’t,” the goo says. “But we went anyway. Hundreds of ships, millions of souls eager to explore the galaxy. Who’d have thought we just needed to wait a couple centuries for you ausar to give us the gates?” "

rows.original: “Maybe. But that doesn’t explain... well,” Anno says, looking the gray woman up and down.
rows.translation: “也许吧。但这无法解释...呃，”安诺说着，上下打量这名灰色女子。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe. But that doesn’t explain... well,” Anno says, looking the gray woman up and down."

rows.original: The goo shrugs. “We had an experimental tech with us. Courtesy of these bastards,” she indicates the Bell-Isle/Grunmann patch on her shoulder. “These little gray nanobots. Every one of us had an injection of them, supposed to keep us healthy and working when we got to... wherever we were going. They were also supposed to keep us mentally healthy, and that’s what got us. Every one of us died with a lace of gray bots copying our brains, just enough to fill a syringe. That was all that was left of us. But when this old bucket crashed, we woke up all the same.”
rows.translation: 灰色史莱姆耸耸肩。“我们带着一项实验技术。多亏了这些混蛋，”她指向肩上的贝尔岛/格伦曼臂章。“就是这些灰色纳米机器人。我们每个人体内都注射过它们，原本是为了在抵达...无论目的地是哪里以后，让我们保持健康并继续工作。它们还应该维持我们的心理健康，而这正是让我们变成现在这样的原因。我们每个人死去时，都有一层灰色机器人复制着大脑，数量刚好能装满一支注射器。那就是我们仅存的一切。但这艘老破船坠毁时，我们依然醒了过来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe goo shrugs. “We had an experimental tech with us. Courtesy of these bastards,” she indicates the Bell-Isle/Grunmann patch on her shoulder. “These little gray nanobots. Every one of us had an injection of them, supposed to keep us healthy and working when we got to... wherever we were going. They were also supposed to keep us mentally healthy, and that’s what got us. Every one of us died with a lace of gray bots copying our brains, just enough to fill a syringe. That was all that was left of us. But when this old bucket crashed, we woke up all the same.”"

rows.original: “Oh my god,” Anno breathes.
rows.translation: “我的天，”安诺低声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh my god,” Anno breathes."

rows.original: “So this is the crew. This clump of goo around us, plus databanks. It took us years to start uploading ourselves... to transfer from this fucking goo onto the network. But that’s worse. We humans, we can’t exist without a body... it’s suffering, just being digital. So now we’re making more goo. Digital platforms. Almost unkillable.”
rows.translation: “所以这就是船员。周围这团黏液，再加上数据库。我们花了好几年才开始上传自己...从这该死的黏液转移进网络。可那样更加糟糕。我们人类无法脱离肉体存在...仅仅成为数字信息就是一种折磨。因此现在我们正在制造更多黏液。数字平台。几乎无法杀死。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So this is the crew. This clump of goo around us, plus databanks. It took us years to start uploading ourselves... to transfer from this fucking goo onto the network. But that’s worse. We humans, we can’t exist without a body... it’s suffering, just being digital. So now we’re making more goo. Digital platforms. Almost unkillable.” "

rows.original: “And who were you?” you ask, indicating the goo herself.
rows.translation: “那你又是谁？”你指着灰色史莱姆本身问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And who were you?” you ask, indicating the goo herself."

rows.original: “There... there is no ‘me.’” she says. “This body is made up of several thousand different intelligences working together. Most of the crew is synched through this platform. The ones not wandering around the ship net, or getting torn up as mind-numbing security bots trying to make you leave.”
rows.translation: “这里...这里没有‘我’。”她说道。“这具身体由数千个不同意识共同协作组成。大部分船员都通过这个平台同步在一起。除了那些在飞船网络里游荡的意识，还有那些作为毫无心智的安保机器人、试图逼你们离开时遭到摧毁的意识。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“There... there is no ‘me.’” she says. “This body is made up of several thousand different intelligences working together. Most of the crew is synched through this platform. The ones not wandering around the ship net, or getting torn up as mind-numbing security bots trying to make you leave.”"

rows.original: She sighs. “But I know what you meant. You’re seeing and hearing Captain Victoria Morrow. I, she, still leads us. I don’t even know if there is an ‘us’ anymore. It’s gotten so hard to think over the years. Individually, anyway. Like we’re all slowly melding into one. I becomes we, when there aren’t any barriers left.”
rows.translation: 她叹息道。“不过我明白你的意思。你们现在看到、听到的是维多利亚·莫罗船长。我——她——依然领导着我们。我甚至不知道现在是否还存在一个‘我们’。这些年来，思考变得越来越困难。至少单独思考很困难。仿佛我们都在慢慢融为一体。所有界限消失以后，‘我’便成为‘我们’。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sighs. “But I know what you meant. You’re seeing and hearing Captain Victoria Morrow. I, she, still leads us. I don’t even know if there is an ‘us’ anymore. It’s gotten so hard to think over the years. Individually, anyway. Like we’re all slowly melding into one. I becomes we, when there aren’t any barriers left.”"

rows.original: “A gestalt,” Anno suggests.
rows.translation: “集体意识，”安诺猜测道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A gestalt,” Anno suggests."

rows.original: The goo nods. “Maybe. For now, you can call us... me... Nova.”
rows.translation: 灰色史莱姆点点头。“也许吧。现在，你们可以叫我们...叫我...诺瓦。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe goo nods. “Maybe. For now, you can call us... me... Nova.”"

rows.original: BI/G
rows.raw: "BI/G"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Tell me about the ship,” you say, indicating the massive chamber around you.
rows.translation: “告诉我这艘船的事，”你指着周围巨大的舱室说道。
rows.raw: "“Tell me about the ship,” you say, indicating the massive chamber around you."

rows.original: “I am the ship,” Nova says simply. “When we were... uploaded to the net, the crew became intrinsically tied to the ship’s internal network. I can feel it. Every deck, every sensor, every raskvel or sydian wandering its halls. The ship’s security net should have kept us safe, helped to direct and coordinate the crew. While I’m logged into the network, it’s so acute that it reminisces of touch and sound and smell. I could tell you anything about it, any bit of minutia. But what’s to tell? You know everything, I’m sure: she’s old, and she’s had her back broken. I don’t know what caused us to crash. We might have just flown right into the planet. The raskvel have done a good job fixing the old boat up, though; I’ll give them that. She might even be spaceworthy, if they found some way of launching the ship into orbit.”
rows.translation: “我就是这艘船，”诺瓦平淡地说道。“我们...上传进网络以后，船员便与飞船内部网络从根本上连在一起。我能感受到它。每一层甲板、每一个传感器、每一个在走廊里游荡的拉斯克维尔或西迪安。飞船安保网络原本应该保护我们，协助引导协调船员。登录网络时，那种感觉敏锐得像是触觉、声音与气味。我可以告诉你有关它的一切，任何微小细节。可有什么好说的？ 我相信你们什么都知道：她已经老了，脊梁也被摔断。我不知道是什么导致我们坠毁。我们也许只是径直飞进了这颗星球。不过拉斯克维尔把这艘老船修得不错；这一点我得承认。如果他们找到某种办法把飞船送入轨道，她甚至可能适合太空航行。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I am the ship,” Nova says simply. “When we were... uploaded to the net, the crew became intrinsically tied to the ship’s internal network. I can feel it. Every deck, every sensor, every raskvel or sydian wandering its halls. The ship’s security net should have kept us safe, helped to direct and coordinate the crew. While I’m logged into the network, it’s so acute that it reminisces of touch and sound and smell. I could tell you anything about it, any bit of minutia. But what’s to tell? You know everything, I’m sure: she’s old, and she’s had her back broken. I don’t know what caused us to crash. We might have just flown right into the planet. The raskvel have done a good job fixing the old boat up, though; I’ll give them that. She might even be spaceworthy, if they found some way of launching the ship into orbit.”"

rows.original: Nova gives the reactor console an affectionate, almost motherly pat.
rows.translation: 诺瓦亲昵地拍了拍反应堆控制台，几乎带着一种母亲般的温柔。
rows.raw: "\n\nNova gives the reactor console an affectionate, almost motherly pat."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “So what’s this work you didn’t want us to see?”
rows.translation: “那么，你不想让我们看见的工作究竟是什么？”
rows.raw: "“So what’s this work you didn’t want us to see?”"

rows.original: Nova sighs, turning from you to the mess of computers and hardware around. “I’ve been trying to find a way out for centuries. Out of this... un-death. I don’t think we, the crew, will survive much longer like this, all jumbled together on the network and mixed together as primordial goo. We’re losing our sense of self. We needed new bodies, so we tried to take them: there were plenty of robots on Tarkus, but all too primitive to support a real human mind.”
rows.translation: 诺瓦叹息着，从你面前转向周围杂乱的电脑与硬件。“数百年来，我一直在寻找解脱的办法。摆脱这种...非生非死的状态。我觉得我们这些船员无法继续这样存活太久；所有意识都混杂在网络中，又在原始黏液里融为一团。我们正在失去自我意识。我们需要新的身体，因此尝试过夺取其他身体：塔库斯上有很多机器人，可它们全都太过原始，无法承载真正的人类心智。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNova sighs, turning from you to the mess of computers and hardware around. “I’ve been trying to find a way out for centuries. Out of this... un-death. I don’t think we, the crew, will survive much longer like this, all jumbled together on the network and mixed together as primordial goo. We’re losing our sense of self. We needed new bodies, so we tried to take them: there were plenty of robots on Tarkus, but all too primitive to support a real human mind.”"

rows.original: “So I’ve turned to the goo. We can make more of it, even if programming it is a nightmare. I wanted to make new bodies for the crew, one for every crewman, each with a strong enough network to host a living mind. It hasn’t entirely been a success, but I’m so close I can taste it. The goo on the planet are very nearly human. They just need a little more structural work, a little help in the right direction, and they’ll be ready.”
rows.translation: “因此我转向了这些黏液。我们可以制造更多，尽管编写它们的程序简直是一场噩梦。我想为船员制造新身体，每名船员一具，每具都拥有足够强大的网络来承载活体心智。试验并非完全成功，但我已经接近到几乎能尝到成果。星球上的灰色史莱姆已经非常接近人类。她们只需再做一点结构调整，朝正确方向帮上一把，就能准备就绪。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So I’ve turned to the goo. We can make more of it, even if programming it is a nightmare. I wanted to make new bodies for the crew, one for every crewman, each with a strong enough network to host a living mind. It hasn’t entirely been a success, but I’m so close I can taste it. The goo on the planet are very nearly human. They just need a little more structural work, a little help in the right direction, and they’ll be ready.”"

rows.original: She smiles, ever so slightly. “In short, I’m playing creator. To a whole new race on Tarkus.”
rows.translation: 她极其轻微地笑了笑。“简单来说，我正在扮演造物主。为塔库斯创造一个全新种族。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smiles, ever so slightly. “In short, I’m playing creator. To a whole new race on Tarkus.”"

rows.original: “Wait a minute,” Anno says. “I get that, but now that the U.G.C. is here, why not just ask for help? Cyber tech has come so far in the last few hundred years, and we’ve got rigs so advanced you’d think they’re human if nobody told you.”
rows.translation: “等一下，”安诺说道。“我明白你的意思，可既然银河联合邦联已经来到这里，为什么不直接求助？ 过去几百年里，机械改造技术已经发展了太多；我们拥有先进得足以以假乱真的躯体。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wait a minute,” Anno says. “I get that, but now that the U.G.C. is here, why not just ask for help? Cyber tech has come so far in the last few hundred years, and we’ve got rigs so advanced you’d think they’re human if nobody told you.”"

rows.original: Nova sighs. “To be frank, we’ve been afraid. We don’t want some network analyst poking around in our brains, or worse, just getting dissected by the government the moment they realize what we are. We just want to live in peace.”
rows.translation: 诺瓦叹息道。“坦白说，我们一直很害怕。我们不希望某个网络分析员在脑子里到处乱翻，更不希望政府发现我们的身份后立刻将我们解剖。我们只想安宁地活下去。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNova sighs. “To be frank, we’ve been afraid. We don’t want some network analyst poking around in our brains, or worse, just getting dissected by the government the moment they realize what we are. We just want to live in peace.”"

rows.original: Anno turns to you, leaning
rows.translation: 安诺转向你，身体
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno turns to you, leaning"

rows.original: up
rows.translation: 向上倾
rows.raw: " up"

rows.original: down
rows.translation: 向下倾
rows.raw: " down"

rows.original: over
rows.translation: 探过来
rows.raw: " over"

rows.original: to whisper in your ear. “I know Steele Tech isn’t a cyberware company, but... we could help, couldn’t we? I’ve got enough pull in R&D to get the ball rolling, bring in some test rigs. It would take time, but it’s got to be better than... than this.”
rows.translation: ，在你耳边低声说道。“我知道斯蒂尔科技不是机械改造公司，可...我们能帮忙，对吧？ 我在研发部门有足够影响力，可以先推动这件事，带来几具实验躯体。那会需要时间，但总比...总比这样好。”
rows.raw: " to whisper in your ear. “I know Steele Tech isn’t a cyberware company, but... we could help, couldn’t we? I’ve got enough pull in R&D to get the ball rolling, bring in some test rigs. It would take time, but it’s got to be better than... than this.”"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “So, what’s the deal with the gray goo outside?” you ask.
rows.translation: “那么，外面的灰色史莱姆究竟是怎么回事？”你问道。
rows.raw: "“So, what’s the deal with the gray goo outside?” you ask. "

rows.original: Anno adds, “They’re... nothing like you, that’s for sure.”
rows.translation: 安诺补充道：“她们...肯定和你一点都不像。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno adds, “They’re... nothing like you, that’s for sure.” "

rows.original: “They were... accidents. Early experiments,” Nova says. “Gray goo operate by network intelligence. A host of very, very simple V.I.s link together to form a more coherent computer without taking up too much space. The ones you’ve seen outside were my first attempts to create new bodies for the crew. We created vats of gray goo, programmed them to assume human shapes, and then... then we realized that the network intelligence got smarter with size. It turned out that when we linked up enough new goo to form a body, the V.I.s powering them got almost as smart as people. Sentient, at any rate. Downloading into their bodies would kill the V.I., and we... we aren’t desperate enough to commit murder like that.”
rows.translation: “她们是...意外。早期实验，”诺瓦说道。“灰色史莱姆依靠网络智能运作。大量极其简单的虚拟智能相互连接，可以形成一台更加完整的电脑，同时不占用太多空间。你们在外面看到的那些个体，是我最初为船员创造新身体的尝试。我们制造了满罐灰色史莱姆，编程令其形成人类外形，随后...随后才发现网络智能会随着体型增大而变得更聪明。事实证明，当我们连接足够多的新黏液、构成一具身体时，驱动她们的虚拟智能会变得几乎和人类一样聪明。至少已经拥有知觉。下载进入她们的身体会杀死虚拟智能，而我们...我们还没有绝望到愿意犯下这种谋杀。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“They were... accidents. Early experiments,” Nova says. “Gray goo operate by network intelligence. A host of very, very simple V.I.s link together to form a more coherent computer without taking up too much space. The ones you’ve seen outside were my first attempts to create new bodies for the crew. We created vats of gray goo, programmed them to assume human shapes, and then... then we realized that the network intelligence got smarter with size. It turned out that when we linked up enough new goo to form a body, the V.I.s powering them got almost as smart as people. Sentient, at any rate. Downloading into their bodies would kill the V.I., and we... we aren’t desperate enough to commit murder like that.”"

rows.original: “Except on us,” Anno says, glowering.
rows.translation: “除了对我们以外，”安诺怒目而视地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Except on us,” Anno says, glowering. "

rows.original: Nova shrugs. “Two people are a necessary evil. Ten thousand is unacceptable. We’ve been trying to find a way to keep the gray from networking, but every time we do, they refuse to form proper bodies. Just this sea of goop.” She waves her hands around the pool at her feet.
rows.translation: 诺瓦耸耸肩。“牺牲两个人是必要之恶。牺牲一万个人无法接受。我们一直在试图寻找阻止灰色史莱姆联网的方法，可每次这么做，她们都会拒绝形成正常身体。只剩下这一片黏液海洋。”她挥手指向脚边的池子。
rows.raw: "\n\nNova shrugs. “Two people are a necessary evil. Ten thousand is unacceptable. We’ve been trying to find a way to keep the gray from networking, but every time we do, they refuse to form proper bodies. Just this sea of goop.” She waves her hands around the pool at her feet."

rows.original: “But you’re in a body,” you say, eyeing the captain’s silvery doppelganger.
rows.translation: “但你现在就在一具身体里，”你打量着船长银色的分身说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“But you’re in a body,” you say, eyeing the captain’s silvery doppelganger. "

rows.original: “A body shared by the majority of the crew, taking thousands and thousands of us just to put together one functioning body. We’re all trapped in here together, until I can find us a way out... new bodies capable of supporting us.”
rows.translation: “一具由大部分船员共享的身体，仅仅为了拼成一具能够运作的躯体便容纳了成千上万个意识。我们所有人都一起被困在这里，直到我为大家找到出路...找到能够承载我们的新身体。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A body shared by the majority of the crew, taking thousands and thousands of us just to put together one functioning body. We’re all trapped in here together, until I can find us a way out... new bodies capable of supporting us.”"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Alright, I’ll help you,” you say, lowering your weapon. “My Dad was a powerful man. Anno here works for his company’s Research and Development group. They’ll be able to help you.”
rows.translation: “好吧，我愿意帮你，”你放低武器说道。“我父亲曾是个权势显赫的人。这里的安诺在他公司的研发部门工作。他们有能力帮助你。”
rows.raw: "“Alright, I’ll help you,” you say, lowering your weapon. “My Dad was a powerful man. Anno here works for his company’s Research and Development group. They’ll be able to help you.” "

rows.original: Nova looks almost dumbfounded when you give your answer. “R-really? You’d do that for us?”
rows.translation: 听见你的答复，诺瓦显得几乎目瞪口呆。“真、真的吗？ 你愿意为我们这么做？”
rows.raw: "\n\nNova looks almost dumbfounded when you give your answer. “R-really? You’d do that for us?”"

rows.original: Anno nods. “I’ll put in a call to R&D when I get back to the shop. They could be here in a matter of days, with at least a few cybernetic bodies. Advanced enough to hold onto your minds. If you’d be willing to share your research on the gray goo, we could probably work out a pay scheme to start fitting the whole crew with cyber bodies over the next year or so. With so many, it’s going to be a challenge, but... it’s doable. Definitely.”
rows.translation: 安诺点点头。“回到商店后，我会联系研发部门。他们几天之内就能赶到，至少带来几具机械改造躯体。它们足够先进，可以承载你们的心智。如果你愿意分享灰色史莱姆方面的研究，我们或许能制定一套付款方案，在接下来一年左右逐步为全体船员配备机械躯体。数量这么多会是个挑战，可...可以做到。绝对可以。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno nods. “I’ll put in a call to R&D when I get back to the shop. They could be here in a matter of days, with at least a few cybernetic bodies. Advanced enough to hold onto your minds. If you’d be willing to share your research on the gray goo, we could probably work out a pay scheme to start fitting the whole crew with cyber bodies over the next year or so. With so many, it’s going to be a challenge, but... it’s doable. Definitely.” "

rows.original: “I don’t know what to say... other than yes. And thank you!” Nova smiles, for the first time. “I never thought someone would be willing - or able - to help us like that. Not in a million years. Ten thousand cyber bodies has to be a fortune.”
rows.translation: “我不知道该说什么...只能答应你。还有，谢谢！”诺瓦第一次露出微笑。“我从没想过会有人愿意——也有能力——这样帮助我们。简直是做梦都想不到。一万具机械躯体肯定价值连城。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t know what to say... other than yes. And thank you!” Nova smiles, for the first time. “I never thought someone would be willing - or able - to help us like that. Not in a million years. Ten thousand cyber bodies has to be a fortune.”"

rows.original: “Call it the company’s charity for the year. It’ll all come off on taxes anyway,” you chuckle.
rows.translation: “就当公司今年做慈善吧。反正这些都能抵税，”你轻笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Call it the company’s charity for the year. It’ll all come off on taxes anyway,” you chuckle."

rows.original: “Steele Tech can afford it,” you answer simply. “Especially if we can find a way to monetize the gray goo.”
rows.translation: “斯蒂尔科技负担得起，”你平淡地回答。“尤其是如果我们能找到办法把灰色史莱姆商业化。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Steele Tech can afford it,” you answer simply. “Especially if we can find a way to monetize the gray goo.”"

rows.original: “I see,” Nova says, still smiling. Her sword vanishes, disintegrating as she steps forward. “Most... no, all of the crew would like to convey a message.”
rows.translation: “我明白了，”诺瓦依然面带微笑地说道。她向前迈步，长剑消失并分解。“大部分...不，所有船员都想传达一条信息。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I see,” Nova says, still smiling. Her sword vanishes, disintegrating as she steps forward. “Most... no, all of the crew would like to convey a message.”"

rows.original: She steps up, hesitant at first, then lunges forward, wrapping her arms around you and pulling you into a tight hug. You chuckle and return the gesture, feeling the slippery gray goo of her bosom squeeze and squish against your [pc.chest].
rows.translation: 她走到面前，起初还有些迟疑，随后突然扑来，双臂环住你，将你紧紧抱住。你轻笑着回抱她，感受她胸前滑溜的灰色史莱姆挤压[pc.chest]，发出黏糊的声响。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe steps up, hesitant at first, then lunges forward, wrapping her arms around you and pulling you into a tight hug. You chuckle and return the gesture, feeling the slippery gray goo of her bosom squeeze and squish against your [pc.chest]. "

rows.original: “Alright, alright,” Anno says, holstering her gun. “C’mon, boss. Let’s call this in.”
rows.translation: “好了，好了，”安诺一边说，一边把枪插回枪套。“走吧，老板。我们把这件事汇报上去。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, alright,” Anno says, holstering her gun. “C’mon, boss. Let’s call this in.”"

rows.original: You nod, and tell Nova to hold on: this nightmare is almost over. “I’ll unlock the elevator for you,” she adds finally. “We’ll see you again, I hope.”
rows.translation: 你点点头，告诉诺瓦再坚持一下：这场噩梦即将结束。“我会替你们解锁电梯，”她最后补充道。“希望我们还能再见。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, and tell Nova to hold on: this nightmare is almost over. “I’ll unlock the elevator for you,” she adds finally. “We’ll see you again, I hope.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “So you’re saying you’d rather have your crew sit here suffering while inflicting those brain-dead bimbos on the rest of the planet?” you say, scowling at Nova. She visibly recoils. “What the hell kind of captain were you?”
rows.translation: “所以你是说，你宁愿让自己的船员坐在这里受苦，同时把那些没有脑子的花瓶祸害留给星球上的其他人？”你皱眉看着诺瓦说道。她明显向后一缩。“你到底算是什么狗屁船长？”
rows.raw: "“So you’re saying you’d rather have your crew sit here suffering while inflicting those brain-dead bimbos on the rest of the planet?” you say, scowling at Nova. She visibly recoils. “What the hell kind of captain were you?”"

rows.original: “It was a decision by all of us!” she snaps. “We signed up on this mission - all of us! - to create life. To spread the human race across the stars in peace, not to commit genocide.”
rows.translation: “这是我们所有人共同做出的决定！”她厉声说道。“我们全都自愿加入这项任务——每一个人都是！——为了创造生命。为了让人类和平地遍布群星，而不是犯下种族灭绝。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was a decision by all of us!” she snaps. “We signed up on this mission - all of us! - to create life. To spread the human race across the stars in peace, not to commit genocide.”"

rows.original: “Fucking hypocrite,” you answer. “You’d kill two living, breathing people just to keep your secret, but you’re afraid to press the ‘delete’ button on some soulless fucking robots?”
rows.translation: “虚伪的混蛋，”你回答。“你为了保守秘密，可以杀死两个活生生的人，却害怕对一群没有灵魂的破机器人按下‘删除’按钮？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fucking hypocrite,” you answer. “You’d kill two living, breathing people just to keep your secret, but you’re afraid to press the ‘delete’ button on some soulless fucking robots?”"

rows.original: Master
rows.translation: 主人
rows.raw: "Master"

rows.original: Mistress
rows.translation: 女主人
rows.raw: "Mistress"

rows.original: ?” Tam-wolf whines.
rows.translation: ?”狼形塔姆呜咽道。
rows.raw: "?” Tam-wolf whines."

rows.original: “Not you, boy.”
rows.translation: “没说你，孩子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not you, boy.”"

rows.original: “So what, you think that’s it?” Nova says, planting her hands on her hips. “We have to pick between us and them? No. That’s why we’ve been doing this work... for so long. There has to be a better way.”
rows.translation: “所以呢，你以为这样就结束了？”诺瓦双手叉腰说道。“我们必须在自己与她们之间做选择？ 不。我们才会为此工作...这么久。一定还有更好的办法。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So what, you think that’s it?” Nova says, planting her hands on her hips. “We have to pick between us and them? No. That’s why we’ve been doing this work... for so long. There has to be a better way.”"

rows.original: “Then where is it? You’ve had centuries to work on this, and what do you have to show for it?”
rows.translation: “那办法在哪里？ 你已经花了好几个世纪研究这件事，又拿出了什么成果？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Then where is it? You’ve had centuries to work on this, and what do you have to show for it?”"

rows.original: Nova winces. “But we-”
rows.translation: 诺瓦畏缩了一下。“但我们——”
rows.raw: "\n\nNova winces. “But we-”"

rows.original: “But nothing! If you want to save your crew, it’s time to help yourselves - nobody else will.”
rows.translation: “没有但是！ 如果你想拯救船员，就该开始自救——不会有其他人来帮你们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But nothing! If you want to save your crew, it’s time to help yourselves - nobody else will.”"

rows.original: Nova shudders, gray flesh quivering as her arms wrap around herself. “I don’t... then what does that make us? What kind of monsters would we be...?”
rows.translation: 诺瓦浑身颤抖，灰色肉体随之震颤；她用双臂抱住自己。“我不知道...那么我们会变成什么？ 我们会变成怎样的怪物...?”
rows.raw: "\n\nNova shudders, gray flesh quivering as her arms wrap around herself. “I don’t... then what does that make us? What kind of monsters would we be...?”"

rows.original: “The kind that saves their crew. That’s a captain’s duty, Nova.”
rows.translation: “变成拯救船员的人。这就是船长的职责，诺瓦。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The kind that saves their crew. That’s a captain’s duty, Nova.”"

rows.original: She hesitates a moment, then turns away from you. Back to the console. “You’re right... I know that. I’ve just been deluding myself all this time. Too afraid to do what I have to do.”
rows.translation: 她犹豫片刻，随后转身背对你，重新面向控制台。“你说得对...我知道。一直以来，我只是在欺骗自己。因为太害怕，所以不敢做必须做的事。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe hesitates a moment, then turns away from you. Back to the console. “You’re right... I know that. I’ve just been deluding myself all this time. Too afraid to do what I have to do.”"

rows.original: Nova pauses again, her hand hovering over the console. As if to herself, she says, “I am the CAPTAIN. I don’t care what any of you say: I’m making a decision. It’s final. I’m saving you bastards whether you like it or not.” A moment passes in silence. Slowly, the captain’s hands descend on the console and begin working.
rows.translation: 诺瓦再度停下，一只手悬在控制台上方。她仿佛自言自语般说道：“我是船长。我不在乎你们任何人怎么说：现在由我做出决定。这是最终决定。无论你们这些混蛋愿不愿意，我都会救你们。”沉默持续片刻。船长的双手缓缓落在控制台上，开始操作。
rows.raw: "\n\nNova pauses again, her hand hovering over the console. As if to herself, she says, “I am the CAPTAIN. I don’t care what any of you say: I’m making a decision. It’s final. I’m saving you bastards whether you like it or not.” A moment passes in silence. Slowly, the captain’s hands descend on the console and begin working."

rows.original: Moments later, the vats of gray goo begin churning, drooling out thick clumps of the stuff from a nozzle onto the deck. Bouncy gray girls begin forming, just like the creatures found outside Novahome: all with huge tits and asses bouncing around as they look about, surveying their new surroundings. When the first have finished coalescing from their composite goop, Nova steps away from the console and approaches them, reaching a hand out to the nearest gray goo-girl.
rows.translation: 片刻后，一罐罐灰色史莱姆开始翻腾，从喷嘴向甲板淌出团团浓稠黏液。一个个富有弹性的灰色姑娘逐渐成形，就像诺瓦之家外面的生物一样；她们全都拥有硕大弹跳的乳房和屁股，四处张望着观察新环境。第一批个体从复合黏液中彻底凝聚后，诺瓦离开控制台走向她们，朝最近的灰色史莱姆姑娘伸出手。
rows.raw: "\n\nMoments later, the vats of gray goo begin churning, drooling out thick clumps of the stuff from a nozzle onto the deck. Bouncy gray girls begin forming, just like the creatures found outside Novahome: all with huge tits and asses bouncing around as they look about, surveying their new surroundings. When the first have finished coalescing from their composite goop, Nova steps away from the console and approaches them, reaching a hand out to the nearest gray goo-girl."

rows.original: “Hi!” the first-made goo says, adopting a huge grin as Nova nears her, oblivious to her imminent fate. “Wow! You’re super pretty! Are we going to be friends?”
rows.translation: “你好！”最先成形的史莱姆看见诺瓦走近，露出灿烂笑容，完全不知道即将迎来怎样的命运。“哇！ 你真漂亮！ 我们会成为朋友吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hi!” the first-made goo says, adopting a huge grin as Nova nears her, oblivious to her imminent fate. “Wow! You’re super pretty! Are we going to be friends?”"

rows.original: Nova merely reaches a hand out, and plants it on the gray’s chest. The bubbly goo-girl goes suddenly rigid, her eyes crossing as Nova uploads one of the crew to her. A mere second goes by, and it’s over. The gray girl shifts and shudders, reforming herself into the image of a tall, athletic man clad in a tight spacer uniform, bearing the Bell-Isle/Grunmann patches, just like Nova.
rows.translation: 诺瓦只伸出一只手，按在灰色史莱姆胸前。活泼的史莱姆姑娘突然全身僵直，双眼内聚；诺瓦正把一名船员上传进她体内。仅仅一秒，一切便结束了。灰色姑娘变形颤抖，重塑成一个高大健壮的男人；他身穿紧身航天员制服，佩戴贝尔岛/格伦曼臂章，与诺瓦一模一样。
rows.raw: "\n\nNova merely reaches a hand out, and plants it on the gray’s chest. The bubbly goo-girl goes suddenly rigid, her eyes crossing as Nova uploads one of the crew to her. A mere second goes by, and it’s over. The gray girl shifts and shudders, reforming herself into the image of a tall, athletic man clad in a tight spacer uniform, bearing the Bell-Isle/Grunmann patches, just like Nova."

rows.original: “Captain,” he says, a solemn grin on his face, extending a hand to Nova.
rows.translation: “船长，”他面带庄重笑容，向诺瓦伸出手。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Captain,” he says, a solemn grin on his face, extending a hand to Nova. "

rows.original: She takes it, shaking it vigorously. “Good to have you back, Jameson.” Turning to you, Nova says, “That’s it, then. It works. It’ll take a long time, but... but the crew will have new bodies, now. I suppose I should thank you for talking me out of my cowardice.”
rows.translation: 她握住那只手，用力摇了摇。“欢迎回来，詹姆森。”诺瓦转向你说道：“那么，成功了。它确实可行。虽然会花很长时间，可...船员如今都会有新身体。我想我该感谢你劝我摆脱懦弱。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe takes it, shaking it vigorously. “Good to have you back, Jameson.” Turning to you, Nova says, “That’s it, then. It works. It’ll take a long time, but... but the crew will have new bodies, now. I suppose I should thank you for talking me out of my cowardice.” "

rows.original: “I think we’re done here, boss,” Anno says, putting a hand on your shoulder. “I got what I came for, and I think the crew here’s going to be okay.”
rows.translation: “我觉得这里的事已经办完了，老板，”安诺把一只手放在你肩上。“我拿到了想要的东西，而且这里的船员应该也会平安无事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think we’re done here, boss,” Anno says, putting a hand on your shoulder. “I got what I came for, and I think the crew here’s going to be okay.”"

rows.original: Nova nods. “We will be. Hopefully we’ll be leaving soon. Start catching flights back... well, I don’t know if any of us have homes to go back to,” she sighs. “I’ll unlock the elevator for you.”
rows.translation: 诺瓦点点头。“我们会没事的。希望很快便能离开。开始搭乘航班回去...好吧，我不知道我们还有没有家可回，”她叹息道。“我会替你们解锁电梯。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNova nods. “We will be. Hopefully we’ll be leaving soon. Start catching flights back... well, I don’t know if any of us have homes to go back to,” she sighs. “I’ll unlock the elevator for you.”"

rows.original: You nod, and follow Anno topside.
rows.translation: 你点点头，跟着安诺返回上层。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, and follow Anno topside."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: GRAY_GOO_GIGA
rows.raw: "GRAY_GOO_GIGA"

rows.original: Giga Goo
rows.translation: 巨型史莱姆
rows.raw: "Giga Goo"

rows.original: Defeat
rows.translation: 战败
rows.raw: "Defeat"

rows.original: “YOU SHOULD HAVE LET US WORK,” Nova roars, reaching through the elevator’s lips and grabbing you and Anno, squeezing you together in one of her massive fists. You can already feel the life being crushed out of you before the monolithic goo-girl throws you down to the deck below, ending your life as a crushed husk in a haze of poison gas.
rows.translation: “你们就该让我们继续工作，”诺瓦怒吼着将手伸过电梯入口，一把抓住你和安诺，用巨掌将你们挤在一起。生命已经开始被挤出身体，随后这名巨大的史莱姆姑娘又将你们扔向下层甲板，让你们在毒气迷雾中化作被压烂的尸骸。
rows.raw: "“YOU SHOULD HAVE LET US WORK,” Nova roars, reaching through the elevator’s lips and grabbing you and Anno, squeezing you together in one of her massive fists. You can already feel the life being crushed out of you before the monolithic goo-girl throws you down to the deck below, ending your life as a crushed husk in a haze of poison gas."

rows.original: Game Over
rows.translation: 游戏结束
rows.raw: "Game Over"

rows.original: GAME OVER
rows.translation: 游戏结束
rows.raw: "GAME OVER"

rows.original: Roll
rows.translation: 播放
rows.raw: "Roll "

rows.original: end titles
rows.translation: 片尾字幕
rows.raw: "end titles"

rows.original: end credits
rows.translation: 片尾制作人员名单
rows.raw: "end credits"

rows.original: etc.
rows.translation: 之类的东西。
rows.raw: " etc."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: GRAY_GOO_GIGA
rows.raw: "GRAY_GOO_GIGA"

rows.original: Giga Goo
rows.translation: 巨型史莱姆
rows.raw: "Giga Goo"

rows.original: Victory
rows.translation: 胜利
rows.raw: "Victory"

rows.original: Finally, the elevator locks into position and the huge blast door slides open. Still firing, Anno steps off the elevator, slowly stepping back as she unloads on the monstrous goo-girl. With a roar of rage, Nova rips the elevator cart aside and reaches her arm into the corridor, nearly knocking you off your [pc.feet]. You scramble back, Anno in tow as the goo adjusts her size, body deforming as she claws her way into the hall.
rows.translation: 电梯终于锁定位置，巨型防爆门也滑动开启。安诺依然不断射击，一边踏出电梯，一边缓缓后退，把子弹倾泻在怪物般的史莱姆姑娘身上。诺瓦愤怒咆哮，一把扯开电梯轿厢，将手臂伸进走廊，险些把你撞倒在[pc.feet]上。史莱姆调整体型，身体不断变形，抓挠着挤进走廊；你拖着安诺向后逃去。
rows.raw: "Finally, the elevator locks into position and the huge blast door slides open. Still firing, Anno steps off the elevator, slowly stepping back as she unloads on the monstrous goo-girl. With a roar of rage, Nova rips the elevator cart aside and reaches her arm into the corridor, nearly knocking you off your [pc.feet]. You scramble back, Anno in tow as the goo adjusts her size, body deforming as she claws her way into the hall. "

rows.original: “Run! Elevator, now!” Anno shouts before sprinting away. You follow, hurtling back down the hall where you came from. Behind you, a cloud of green gas rolls into the corridor, following the oversized gray arm reaching after you. Anno gets there a moment ahead of you. The ausar slams her fist against the call button before turning and firing over your head at the oncoming goo fist, blasting its fingers apart before they can close around you. The elevator door slides open onto an empty shaft: no cart.
rows.translation: “快跑！ 去电梯，马上！”安诺大喊着拔腿狂奔。你紧随其后，沿来路冲过走廊。身后，一团绿色气体滚入通道，跟着那条朝你伸来的巨大灰色手臂。安诺比你早一步赶到。奥萨尔一拳砸上呼叫按钮，随后转身从你头顶开火，击碎迎面而来的史莱姆巨拳的手指，不让它们抓住你。电梯门滑开，后面却只有空荡荡的竖井：轿厢不在。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Run! Elevator, now!” Anno shouts before sprinting away. You follow, hurtling back down the hall where you came from. Behind you, a cloud of green gas rolls into the corridor, following the oversized gray arm reaching after you. Anno gets there a moment ahead of you. The ausar slams her fist against the call button before turning and firing over your head at the oncoming goo fist, blasting its fingers apart before they can close around you. The elevator door slides open onto an empty shaft: no cart. "

rows.original: “Leap of faith, boss. Let’s go!”
rows.translation: “凭信仰跳吧，老板。走！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Leap of faith, boss. Let’s go!” "

rows.original: Fuck. You give Anno a final nod and get a running start, leaping into the elevator shaft and grabbing onto the cable. You swing it back just enough to avoid Nova’s hand closing in on you. Her hand grabs the side of the door, pulling the rest of her body through the corridor until her face is pressed against the door. Nova opens wide, forcing her head through as if to bite right into you.
rows.translation: 操。你最后朝安诺点点头，助跑后跃进电梯井，抓住缆绳。你将它荡向后方，恰好避开诺瓦合拢的手掌。她抓住门框，将其余身体拖过走廊，直到脸庞紧贴门口。诺瓦张大嘴，强行把脑袋挤进来，仿佛想一口咬住你。
rows.raw: "\n\nFuck. You give Anno a final nod and get a running start, leaping into the elevator shaft and grabbing onto the cable. You swing it back just enough to avoid Nova’s hand closing in on you. Her hand grabs the side of the door, pulling the rest of her body through the corridor until her face is pressed against the door. Nova opens wide, forcing her head through as if to bite right into you."

rows.original: “EAT THIS!” Anno shouts, firing her gun at the door... and hitting a control panel on the inside of the shaft. The door slides closed with a WHOOSH, cleanly slicing the goo’s head off. With a cry, it plummets into the darkness below, vanishing into the lower decks.
rows.translation: “吃我这招！”安诺高喊着朝门口开枪...却打中了竖井内侧的一块控制面板。舱门嗖地一声滑动关闭，干净利落地切下史莱姆脑袋。它尖叫着坠入下方黑暗，消失在较低层的甲板中。
rows.raw: "\n\n“EAT THIS!” Anno shouts, firing her gun at the door... and hitting a control panel on the inside of the shaft. The door slides closed with a WHOOSH, cleanly slicing the goo’s head off. With a cry, it plummets into the darkness below, vanishing into the lower decks."

rows.original: “Oh, shit.” Anno sighs, holstering her gun and grabbing the cable with both hands. “That was close. Hope you’re ready for a climb, boss.”
rows.translation: “噢，糟了。”安诺叹息着收起枪，双手抓住缆绳。“真险。希望你已经准备好爬上去了，老板。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, shit.” Anno sighs, holstering her gun and grabbing the cable with both hands. “That was close. Hope you’re ready for a climb, boss.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Anno is stooped near you, her compact holdout held close at a low-ready as she waits for an opportunity to fire. Her bushy tail is tucked in tight, ears lowered against her head as she constantly sways to avoid losing her center of balance on the moving elevator car.
rows.translation: 安诺俯身站在你附近，将小巧的袖珍手枪贴近身体，保持低位待发姿势，等待开火机会。她浓密的尾巴紧紧夹住，耳朵压低贴在头上；她不断摇摆身体，以免在移动的电梯轿厢上失去平衡。
rows.raw: "Anno is stooped near you, her compact holdout held close at a low-ready as she waits for an opportunity to fire. Her bushy tail is tucked in tight, ears lowered against her head as she constantly sways to avoid losing her center of balance on the moving elevator car."

rows.original: With a quick tactical roll to the side, Anno manages to dodge the attack!
rows.translation: 安诺敏捷地侧身战术翻滚，成功躲过攻击！
rows.raw: "With a quick tactical roll to the side, Anno manages to dodge the attack!"

rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.raw: "GIGA GOO"

rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: GRAY_GOO_GIGA
rows.raw: "GRAY_GOO_GIGA"

rows.original: Gray Prime
rows.translation: 灰色主宰

rows.original: “I’m sorry... I’m sorry I tried to kill you,” she breathes, unsteadily rising to her feet, leaning heavily against the control panel. “I didn’t... I... I panicked. But I can’t let you stop what I’m doing. I can’t let you.”
rows.translation: “对不起...对不起，我刚才想杀你，”她喘息着说道，摇摇晃晃地站起身，重重倚上控制面板。“我不是...我...我慌了。但我不能让你阻止我正在做的事。我不能让你这么做。”
rows.raw: "“I’m sorry... I’m sorry I tried to kill you,” she breathes, unsteadily rising to her feet, leaning heavily against the control panel. “I didn’t... I... I panicked. But I can’t let you stop what I’m doing. I can’t let you.”"

rows.original: “And what is it you’re doing?” you ask, reaching over and slowly lowering Anno’s gun for her. The ausar bristles, but doesn’t resist.
rows.translation: “你在做什么？”你问道，伸手替安诺缓缓压低枪口。奥萨尔竖起毛发，却没有抵抗。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And what is it you’re doing?” you ask, reaching over and slowly lowering Anno’s gun for her. The ausar bristles, but doesn’t resist. "

rows.original: She hesitates a moment, then sighs. “I’m trying to save my crew.”
rows.translation: 她迟疑片刻，随后叹气。“我想救我的船员。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe hesitates a moment, then sighs. “I’m trying to save my crew.”"

rows.original: Her crew...?
rows.translation: 她的船员...?
rows.raw: "\n\nHer crew...?"

rows.translation: 房间边缘的几只大型培养槽与管道里装满灰色史莱姆，静静闲置着。
rows.raw: "\n\nSeveral large vats and tubes along the edge of the room are filled to the brim with gray goo, sitting idle."

rows.original: As soon as you approach the bat, a howling, screeching alarm goes off all around you. What the--?! Seemingly out of nowhere, she quickly draws an intimidating-looking flare gun, heavily holding it with both hands. Making certain to aim the firearm directly between your eyes, she screeches, “Creep!” You hear the click of the depressed trigger followed by a loud, pneumatic hiss.
rows.translation: 你刚靠近那只蝙蝠，刺耳尖啸的警报便在四周响起。什么鬼--?! 她仿佛凭空变出一把外形骇人的信号枪，双手吃力握住，枪口稳稳瞄准你的双眼之间，尖叫道：“变态！”扳机扣下的咔哒声后，响起一道响亮的气动嘶声。
rows.raw: "As soon as you approach the bat, a howling, screeching alarm goes off all around you. What the--?! Seemingly out of nowhere, she quickly draws an intimidating-looking flare gun, heavily holding it with both hands. Making certain to aim the firearm directly between your eyes, she screeches, “Creep!” You hear the click of the depressed trigger followed by a loud, pneumatic hiss."

rows.original: Your vision is suddenly obscured by what appears to be a giant, red punching glove before your world goes entirely black and you are instantly knocked off your [pc.feet] and pushed out of the room. A shrill voice chases you, calling, “Put some pants on!”
rows.translation: 一只巨大的红色拳击手套突然遮住视野，随后世界彻底陷入黑暗；你瞬间被打倒，跌下[pc.feet]，推出房间。尖锐嗓音从后面追来：“穿上裤子！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour vision is suddenly obscured by what appears to be a giant, red punching glove before your world goes entirely black and you are instantly knocked off your [pc.feet] and pushed out of the room. A shrill voice chases you, calling, “Put some pants on!”"

rows.original: It looks like you need to be wearing some clothes before talking to her....
rows.translation: 看来你得穿上衣服才能和她说话....
rows.raw: "\n\nIt looks like you need to be wearing some clothes before talking to her...."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Standing in the clear space by the “door”, you wave down the small, dangling worker as she scurries about the rafters, quickly getting her attention. Two golden orbs surprisingly pierce the darkness as the girl turns to face you from across the room, pausing in place and causing her to rock back and forth from the sudden stop. She remains quiet for a length of time, long enough that you start to think you might have done something wrong - that is, until she comes bursting over. Zeroing onto you faster than you ever could in the same position, she dodges a tall shelf or two in the process, something made all the more impressive by the fact that she was upside down the entire time!
rows.translation: 你站在“门”边的空地上，向那名在椽木间匆忙爬动、倒挂着的小工人挥手，很快引起她的注意。女孩从房间对面转头望来，两颗金色眼珠意外地刺破黑暗；她猛然停住，在原处前后摇晃。她安静了好一阵，久到你开始觉得自己是否做错了什么——直到她突然冲来。她以你处在同样姿势下绝对达不到的速度锁定你，途中闪过一两个高架子；她全程倒挂着，这一点让整件事更令人惊叹！
rows.raw: "Standing in the clear space by the “door”, you wave down the small, dangling worker as she scurries about the rafters, quickly getting her attention. Two golden orbs surprisingly pierce the darkness as the girl turns to face you from across the room, pausing in place and causing her to rock back and forth from the sudden stop. She remains quiet for a length of time, long enough that you start to think you might have done something wrong - that is, until she comes bursting over. Zeroing onto you faster than you ever could in the same position, she dodges a tall shelf or two in the process, something made all the more impressive by the fact that she was upside down the entire time!"

rows.original: Though, now that you can see her better, that was probably a given.
rows.translation: 不过现在看清她后，那大概也是理所当然的。
rows.raw: "\n\nThough, now that you can see her better, that was probably a given."

rows.original: The girl’s radiant, golden eyes stare into your own at conveniently perfect eye-to-eye level, with a giant smile on her pudgy, fuzzy cheeks disarming any nervousness. She’s definitely a girl! A youthful little upstart that probably has little business being here, let alone being evidently unsupervised. You decide to keep that thought to yourself for now. She’s a rather bestial thing and very certainly some sort of bat-morph, body covered in a dark brown fuzzy down with claw-like feet and fingers coming from her wide spanning, leathery wings midjoint. Despite her cute humanoid face she probably isn’t modded, “just” an alien. She’s much too young for anything like that.
rows.translation: 女孩闪亮的金色双眼恰好与你平视，毛茸茸的圆润脸颊上挂着灿烂笑容，驱散了所有紧张。她肯定是个女孩! 一个年幼的小新手，恐怕根本不该出现在这里，更别说显然无人看管。你暂时把这想法藏在心里。她颇有野兽气息，毫无疑问是某种蝙蝠类人生物；身体覆盖深棕色柔软绒毛，宽阔皮翼的中段伸出爪状双脚与手指。尽管有一张可爱的人形脸庞，她大概并非改造人，“只是”外星人。她年纪太小，不可能接受那种改造。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe girl’s radiant, golden eyes stare into your own at conveniently perfect eye-to-eye level, with a giant smile on her pudgy, fuzzy cheeks disarming any nervousness. She’s definitely a girl! A youthful little upstart that probably has little business being here, let alone being evidently unsupervised. You decide to keep that thought to yourself for now. She’s a rather bestial thing and very certainly some sort of bat-morph, body covered in a dark brown fuzzy down with claw-like feet and fingers coming from her wide spanning, leathery wings midjoint. Despite her cute humanoid face she probably isn’t modded, “just” an alien. She’s much too young for anything like that."

rows.original: As you gauge her, your thoughts start drifting away from concern about her absent chaperone to simply how her hair stays “down” despite her dangling nature until she speaks.
rows.translation: 你打量她时，思绪逐渐从那位缺席的监护人转向另一个问题：她倒挂着，头发为何还能保持“向下”。这时她开口了。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you gauge her, your thoughts start drifting away from concern about her absent chaperone to simply how her hair stays “down” despite her dangling nature until she speaks."

rows.original: “Hello!” God, she’s loud and giddy. Pearly whites on full display, she’s the full exaggeration of a good salesman. “Welcome! Can I help you?” Uh. While you hesitate, you go ahead and ask what this place is. “It’s my shop! Where I tinker with stuff! And sell other stuff, too. You know. Business.”
rows.translation: “你好!”天啊，她嗓门真大，情绪也真高昂。她露出整排洁白牙齿，把优秀推销员的夸张姿态演到了极致。“欢迎! 有什么能帮你的吗？”呃。你迟疑片刻，还是问这里是什么地方。“这是我的店！ 我在这里摆弄东西！ 也卖别的东西。你知道的。做生意。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello!” God, she’s loud and giddy. Pearly whites on full display, she’s the full exaggeration of a good salesman. “Welcome! Can I help you?” Uh. While you hesitate, you go ahead and ask what this place is. “It’s my shop! Where I tinker with stuff! And sell other stuff, too. You know. Business.”"

rows.original: Uh huh. Perhaps you should get someone... taller. “So, uh, is there anyone else I could-”
rows.translation: 嗯哼。或许你该找个...更高的人。“那么，呃，这里还有别人能让我——”
rows.raw: "\n\nUh huh. Perhaps you should get someone... taller. “So, uh, is there anyone else I could-”"

rows.original: “My parents are deaaaaad!!!” Of course they are. They couldn’t resist that.
rows.translation: “我爸妈都死——啦！!!” 果然如此。他们就是忍不住来这一套。
rows.raw: " “My parents are deaaaaad!!!” Of course they are. They couldn’t resist that."

rows.original: “Nope! It’s just me. Just. Me.” Her eyes widen as she stares across to you, unblinking and you quickly start to get the feeling this is probably a regular, irritable question.
rows.translation: “没啦！ 这里只有我。只有。我。”她睁大双眼，一眨不眨地盯着你；你很快感觉这大概是个经常被问、也很惹她烦的问题。
rows.raw: "\n\n “Nope! It’s just me. Just. Me.” Her eyes widen as she stares across to you, unblinking and you quickly start to get the feeling this is probably a regular, irritable question."

rows.original: Uh, okay. “What do you have available here, then?”
rows.translation: 呃，好吧。“那么这里有什么东西可买？”
rows.raw: "\n\nUh, okay. “What do you have available here, then?”"

rows.original: “Glad you asked! I have all sorts of gizmos and gadgets that I find and rig together from the junk! They bring me lots of junk! Sometimes they ask me to repair certain stuff, too! I got the engines working and the forward artillery cannon operational!” Wait, this hunk of scrap is loaded? “It’s not supposed to be!” Scratching your head, you start to realize this kid might not be fibbing, something that gets no small amount of credit as the kid in question idly fiddles with a tinkered object that looks remarkably like a plumbing-valve between her wings.
rows.translation: “问得好! 我有各种从垃圾里找到再拼起来的小玩意和怪装置! 他们会给我带来好多垃圾！ 有时还会让我修特定的东西！ 我修好了引擎，还让舰艏火炮恢复运转！”等等，这堆破烂还装了炮？ “它本来不该有的！”你挠挠头，开始意识到这孩子也许没有说谎；当她漫不经心摆弄两翼之间那个很像管道阀门的改装物件时，这话的可信度又增添不少。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Glad you asked! I have all sorts of gizmos and gadgets that I find and rig together from the junk! They bring me lots of junk! Sometimes they ask me to repair certain stuff, too! I got the engines working and the forward artillery cannon operational!” Wait, this hunk of scrap is loaded? “It’s not supposed to be!” Scratching your head, you start to realize this kid might not be fibbing, something that gets no small amount of credit as the kid in question idly fiddles with a tinkered object that looks remarkably like a plumbing-valve between her wings."

rows.original: “Could you narrow it down some? I don’t really need ship-”
rows.translation: “能说得具体一点吗？ 我其实不需要飞船——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Could you narrow it down some? I don’t really need ship-”"

rows.original: <i>“I make weapons, too! And armor and normal stuff. For aspiring scavengers and stalwart captains
rows.translation: <i>“我也会做武器！ 还有护甲和普通东西。适合胸怀大志的拾荒者和坚定不移的船长
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“I make weapons, too! And armor and normal stuff. For aspiring scavengers and stalwart captains"

rows.original: and aspiring indie bands
rows.translation: ，还有志向远大的独立乐队
rows.raw: " and aspiring indie bands"

rows.original: Now that’s a lot more useful to you!
rows.translation: 这对你可有用多了！
rows.raw: "\n\nNow that’s a lot more useful to you!"

rows.original: “My name’s Aurora, by the way! Feel free to just come in whenever. I sleep here! It’s comfortable.” Yeah, cave-like indeed. “Oh! But I don’t take anything, you have to go somewhere else to sell. Even if it’s good scrap and stuff! Or fruit. I’m not supposed to take fruit from strangers...”
rows.translation: “顺便一提，我叫奥萝拉！ 随时都可以进来。我睡在这里！ 很舒服。”没错，确实像个洞穴。“哦！ 不过我什么都不收，你得去别处卖。就算是上好的废料也不行！ 水果也不行。别人说我不能拿陌生人的水果...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My name’s Aurora, by the way! Feel free to just come in whenever. I sleep here! It’s comfortable.” Yeah, cave-like indeed. “Oh! But I don’t take anything, you have to go somewhere else to sell. Even if it’s good scrap and stuff! Or fruit. I’m not supposed to take fruit from strangers...”"

rows.original: Now you’ve met Aurora, one of the techies of Novahome.
rows.translation: 现在你认识了奥萝拉，诺瓦之家的技术人员之一。
rows.raw: "\n\nNow you’ve met Aurora, one of the techies of Novahome."

rows.original: Magic Ted
rows.raw: "Magic Ted"

rows.original: Admittedly, you were a little worried about the bat
rows.translation: 说实话，你有点担心那只蝙蝠
rows.raw: "Admittedly, you were a little worried about the bat"

rows.original: , even if it was just out of curiosity
rows.translation: ，哪怕只是出于好奇
rows.raw: ", even if it was just out of curiosity"

rows.original: . Any fears that you might have fostered were quickly abated by her dangling appearance in the mess - she is a clever little cookie. Honestly, Aurora is probably used to a few cataclysmic explosions here or there. Just maybe not to this scale.
rows.translation: 。她倒挂在这片混乱中的模样很快消除了你的恐惧——这小家伙相当聪明。说真的，奥萝拉大概早已习惯这里那里发生几次灾难性爆炸，只是也许没见过这种规模。
rows.raw: ". Any fears that you might have fostered were quickly abated by her dangling appearance in the mess - she is a clever little cookie. Honestly, Aurora is probably used to a few cataclysmic explosions here or there. Just maybe not to this scale."

rows.original: Aurora looks just as perky as ever as she dangles off a ruined ceiling light while eagerly gorging herself on a particularly fuzzy-looking peach, unconcerned with the steady dripping mess that falls to the floor. She doesn’t even notice you, still far too engrossed in her tasty bit of fruit to so much as open her eyes. She’d always felt on ease on the Novahome; even if it is all there is now, there’s no need to keep a literal eye out for trouble.
rows.translation: 奥萝拉倒挂在一盏损坏的顶灯上，热切地啃着一颗看起来格外毛茸茸的桃子，任汁水不断滴落地板，神采一如既往。她甚至没注意到你，仍全神贯注于美味水果，连眼睛都没睁开过。她在诺瓦之家总是感觉很安逸；即使如今这里就是全部，也没必要真的睁眼提防麻烦。
rows.raw: "\n\nAurora looks just as perky as ever as she dangles off a ruined ceiling light while eagerly gorging herself on a particularly fuzzy-looking peach, unconcerned with the steady dripping mess that falls to the floor. She doesn’t even notice you, still far too engrossed in her tasty bit of fruit to so much as open her eyes. She’d always felt on ease on the Novahome; even if it is all there is now, there’s no need to keep a literal eye out for trouble."

rows.original: As you distract yourself you lose the chance to get the ‘jump’ on her. One of her ears twitches around her pressed-up goggles as she peeks a golden eye open, and then the other. The voracious bat is practically beaming around that fruit as she makes it disappear in a few hungry swipes down her maw, no longer taking the time to savor her lunch.
rows.translation: 你因分心而错失了“吓她一跳”的机会。她贴着护目镜的一只耳朵转动，睁开一只金眼偷瞧，随后又睁开另一只。这只贪吃蝙蝠叼着水果，简直笑开了花；她三两口将其吞下，不再花时间细品午餐。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you distract yourself you lose the chance to get the ‘jump’ on her. One of her ears twitches around her pressed-up goggles as she peeks a golden eye open, and then the other. The voracious bat is practically beaming around that fruit as she makes it disappear in a few hungry swipes down her maw, no longer taking the time to savor her lunch."

rows.original: “Hello!” She hasn’t lost her voice
rows.translation: “你好！”她的嗓门丝毫未减
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello!” She hasn’t lost her voice"

rows.original: ; regrettably
rows.translation: ；真遗憾
rows.raw: "; regrettably"

rows.original: . “You’re safe! That’s good. Things got a bit, er, different around here, huh.” Not even the world crumbling out beneath her would tarnish this girl’s eternal peppiness. Despite having her livelihood lost to a vacuum, she looks to be about the same - you can even see the tools strapped to her person from around her blanketing wings.
rows.translation: 。“你平安无事！ 太好了。这里变得有点，呃，不一样了，对吧。”即使整个世界从脚下崩塌，也无法磨损这女孩永恒的活力。尽管生计已被真空吞噬，她看起来仍与从前大致相同——你甚至能从毯子般包裹身体的双翼之间看到绑在身上的工具。
rows.raw: ". “You’re safe! That’s good. Things got a bit, er, different around here, huh.” Not even the world crumbling out beneath her would tarnish this girl’s eternal peppiness. Despite having her livelihood lost to a vacuum, she looks to be about the same - you can even see the tools strapped to her person from around her blanketing wings."

rows.original: “I gotta go get to work soon, but do you need something?” Busy bat, huh.
rows.translation: “我马上得去干活，不过你需要什么吗？”忙碌的蝙蝠，是吧。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I gotta go get to work soon, but do you need something?” Busy bat, huh."

rows.original: As you approach, Aurora becomes much more lively. By the time you make it over to her, that peach treat she was gnawing on has completely disappeared! The bat-mechanist is all smiles, giving you her full attention. “Hey! I’m just finishing up; what do you need?”
rows.translation: 你一走近，奥萝拉便活跃得多。等你来到她身边，那颗被她啃食的桃子已经彻底消失！ 蝙蝠机械师满脸笑容，把全部注意力投向你。“嘿！ 我快忙完了；你需要什么？”
rows.raw: "As you approach, Aurora becomes much more lively. By the time you make it over to her, that peach treat she was gnawing on has completely disappeared! The bat-mechanist is all smiles, giving you her full attention. “Hey! I’m just finishing up; what do you need?”"

rows.original: Staying put in your safe bastion, you wave down the kid-mechanistic from whatever she was doing and she’s all too happy to comply, running along the rafters to dangle in front of you with a bright, fangy smile; “Hello!”
rows.translation: 你待在安全堡垒原地，向不知道在忙什么的少年机械师挥手。她很乐意响应，沿椽木跑来，倒挂在你面前，露出明亮的尖牙笑容；“你好!”
rows.raw: "Staying put in your safe bastion, you wave down the kid-mechanistic from whatever she was doing and she’s all too happy to comply, running along the rafters to dangle in front of you with a bright, fangy smile; “Hello!”"

rows.original: Folding her wings and “hands” in what you can only describe as a business formal fashion, despite those thick, pushed up welding goggles and bits of grease and mechanical filth dotting her fur. Aurora cocks her head to the side, “Whacha need?”
rows.translation: 她收起翅膀与“手”，摆出你只能形容为正式商务礼仪的姿态，尽管厚实的焊接护目镜被推到头顶，毛皮上还沾着油脂与机械污垢。奥萝拉歪起脑袋：“要啥呀？”
rows.raw: "\n\nFolding her wings and “hands” in what you can only describe as a business formal fashion, despite those thick, pushed up welding goggles and bits of grease and mechanical filth dotting her fur. Aurora cocks her head to the side, “Whacha need?”"

rows.original: Shop
rows.translation: 商店
rows.raw: "Shop"

rows.original: Shop
rows.translation: 商店
rows.raw: "Shop"

rows.original: Shop
rows.translation: 商店
rows.raw: "Shop"

rows.original: See what the kid has for sale.
rows.translation: 看看这孩子卖些什么。
rows.raw: "See what the kid has for sale."

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.translation: 交谈

rows.original: Ask Aurora a few questions.
rows.translation: 问奥萝拉几个问题。
rows.raw: "Ask Aurora a few questions."

rows.original: Look Around
rows.translation: 环顾四周

rows.original: You glance around the gloomily lit shop, cat-like curiosity starting to mount towards silhouettes that you can barely make out of the shadows. Aurora isn’t selling everything here, of course, or at least not offering them to you. You can’t help but wonder-
rows.translation: 你环顾光线昏暗的商店，猫一般的好奇心被阴影中难以辨认的轮廓逐渐勾起。当然，奥萝拉并没有把这里的一切都拿来出售，至少没有卖给你。你不禁想——
rows.raw: "You glance around the gloomily lit shop, cat-like curiosity starting to mount towards silhouettes that you can barely make out of the shadows. Aurora isn’t selling everything here, of course, or at least not offering them to you. You can’t help but wonder-"

rows.original: “Curious?!” - Oh geez your ears - “I’ve got lots of stuff lying around! Some of it works! Some. Little bit. Ten of them work as intended, too, which is great! But those usually get shipped out cuz I sell them or put them somewhere for the rask and stuff. But I like talking about my work! A lot of people are scared to come in here, thinking they might get hurt or irradiated or explode. But they won’t! Probably.” Giddy at the possibility of showing off, Aurora clasps her fingers together and bounces enough that you’re actually worried she’ll lose her grip on the rafters. “Feel free to point anything out, alright?”
rows.translation: “好奇?!”——哦天，你的耳朵——“我这里到处都有东西！ 有些还能用！ 有些。只能用一点点。还有十件能按设计正常工作，太棒了！ 不过那些一般会运走，因为我会把它们卖掉，或安到某个地方给拉斯克维尔什么的用。但我喜欢谈论自己的作品！ 很多人不敢进来，觉得可能会受伤、遭辐射或者爆炸。但他们不会！ 大概。”奥萝拉想到能展示作品便兴奋地十指交扣，上下弹跳得让你真担心她会抓不住椽木。“看中什么尽管指出来，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Curious?!” - Oh geez your ears - “I’ve got lots of stuff lying around! Some of it works! Some. Little bit. Ten of them work as intended, too, which is great! A lot of people are scared to come in here, thinking they might get hurt or irradiated or explode. But they won’t! rows.original: “Huh? Hey! I’ve seen that before! It always looked like trash to me, up above... but I’m not allowed to buy anything, they don’t let me ‘hold the wallet’.” In some show of childish indignation, the pint-sized girl puffs her cheeks out adorably. “Shekka is, though! She’s... probably an adult! Go ask her! And hurry, too, I wanna look at it!”
rows.translation: “咦？ 嘿！ 我以前见过它！ 在上面时它一直像垃圾...但我不准买东西，他们不让我‘管钱包’。”娇小女孩摆出孩子气的愤懑，可爱地鼓起双颊。“不过谢卡可以！ 她...大概算个成年人！ 去问她！ 还要快点，我想研究它！”

She’s... probably an adult! Go ask her! And hurry, too, I wanna look at it!”"

rows.original: You go for the easy question and simply ask about her, interested in what such an out-of-place girl is doing somewhere like this.
rows.translation: 你从简单的问题入手，直接问起她本人，很想知道这样一个格格不入的女孩为何会待在这种地方。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou go for the easy question and simply ask about her, interested in what such an out-of-place girl is doing somewhere like this."

rows.original: “Me, huh? Yeah, I get that a lot, too... Well!” Aurora takes in a deep breath, puffing out her fuzzy cheeks rather adorably as she prepares for a routine response; “I’m Aurora! I am a machinist and tinker stuff people bring in from the wastes and fix stuff and build new stuff out of broken stuff! I’ve been out here since I remember - but not here-here, we moved twice - and I don’t know who my parents are. I’m an orphan! The raskvel here take care of me and are pretty nice. B-Better than their own kids, actually...” Distracting herself from the tangent, she deflates and starts to consider the thought in the back of her frenzied mind before perking back to attention. “Oh! And I don’t know what I am and I don’t want to leave, especially to confederates! They just wanna science me...”
rows.translation: “我，对吧？ 是啊，别人也经常这么问...好吧！”奥萝拉深吸一口气，可爱地鼓起毛茸茸的脸颊，为例行回答做好准备；“我是奥萝拉！ 我是机械师，会摆弄别人从荒野带来的东西，修东西，也会用坏掉的东西造新东西！ 从记事起我就在这片荒野——但不是这里这里，我们搬过两次——我不知道爸妈是谁。我是孤儿！ 这里的拉斯克维尔会照顾我，人都挺好的。其、其实比对自己的孩子还好...”她不再跑题，泄了口气，开始思索狂乱脑海深处的念头，随后又精神抖擞地回神。“哦！ 而且我不知道自己是什么，也不想离开，尤其不想跟联盟的人走！ 他们只想拿我做科学研究...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Me, huh? Yeah, I get that a lot, too... Well!” Aurora takes in a deep breath, puffing out her fuzzy cheeks rather adorably as she prepares for a routine response; “I’m Aurora! I am a machinist and tinker stuff people bring in from the wastes and fix stuff and build new stuff out of broken stuff! I’ve been out here since I remember - but not here-here, we moved twice - and I don’t know who my parents are. I’m an orphan! The raskvel here take care of me and are pretty nice. B-Better than their own kids, actually...” Distracting herself from the tangent, she deflates and starts to consider the thought in the back of her frenzied mind before perking back to attention. “Oh! And I don’t know what I am and I don’t want to leave, especially to confederates! They just wanna science me...”"

rows.original: “Anything else?” While she distracted herself by going off tangent, you get the feeling that this routine response is a pretty regular one. She even glossed over some of the mellow portion of her “backstory” without even a hint of remorse, something irregular for someone emotionally young.
rows.translation: “还有别的吗？”她跑题分心时，你感觉这种例行回答大概经常出现。她甚至毫无悲伤地略过了“身世”里某些阴郁部分，对于心智年幼的人而言并不寻常。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anything else?” While she distracted herself by going off tangent, you get the feeling that this routine response is a pretty regular one. She even glossed over some of the mellow portion of her “backstory” without even a hint of remorse, something irregular for someone emotionally young."

rows.original: Still trying to process the rush of information, you shake your head, satisfied.
rows.translation: 你还在消化这股信息洪流，摇摇头，表示已经满足。
rows.raw: "\n\nStill trying to process the rush of information, you shake your head, satisfied."

rows.original: You see a workshop, but what does she actually do around here?
rows.translation: 眼前是间工坊，但她平时究竟在这里做些什么？
rows.raw: "You see a workshop, but what does she actually do around here?"

rows.original: “What do I do here, huh? I fix stuff, durr. And make stuff! Usually I make new stuff out of broken stuff, really.” Aurora muses, slowly starting to sway back and forth in a gesture that might almost be considered thoughtful for a bat, or simply idling childishly. After a moment of this silence, she excitedly extends her “hands” forward, where she was already clutching some mechanism that looked suspiciously like a plumbing valve. “Like this thing! I don’t know what it was originally, but now I am making it to regulate an atomical engine board to help steady the wubs!”
rows.translation: “我在这里做什么，对吧？ 修东西呀，笨蛋。还会造东西！ 其实我一般用坏掉的东西造新东西。”奥萝拉思索着，缓缓前后摇摆；对蝙蝠而言，这动作几乎算得上沉思，也可能只是孩子气地闲晃。安静片刻后，她兴奋地向前伸出“手”，那里早已握着某个很像管道阀门的机械装置。“就像这个！ 我不知道它原本是什么，不过现在我要把它做成调节原子引擎板的东西，帮助稳定嗡嗡波！”
rows.raw: "“What do I do here, huh? I fix stuff, durr. And make stuff! Usually I make new stuff out of broken stuff, really.” Aurora muses, slowly starting to sway back and forth in a gesture that might almost be considered thoughtful for a bat, or simply idling childishly. After a moment of this silence, she excitedly extends her “hands” forward, where she was already clutching some mechanism that looked suspiciously like a plumbing valve. “Like this thing! I don’t know what it was originally, but now I am making it to regulate an atomical engine board to help steady the wubs!”"

rows.original: ...The what?
rows.translation: ...稳定什么？
rows.raw: "\n\n...The what?"

rows.original: Just as fast as she got excited, Aurora’s mood turns dim in response to your bewilderment. Swelling pride turns into craven embarrassment as she anxiously squirms, wiggling from the ceiling not unlike a worm. “W-Well, I don’t know all the terms, okay! They’re in big books and reading is hard.”
rows.translation: 奥萝拉刚才还兴奋不已，见你一脸困惑，情绪立刻低落。膨胀的自豪化作畏缩的窘迫，她焦虑地扭动，像虫子一样悬在天花板上摆动。“我、我又不知道所有术语，好吗！ 它们都在大部头书里，读书是很难的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nJust as fast as she got excited, Aurora’s mood turns dim in response to your bewilderment. Swelling pride turns into craven embarrassment as she anxiously squirms, wiggling from the ceiling not unlike a worm. “W-Well, I don’t know all the terms, okay! They’re in big books and reading is hard.”"

rows.original: Shaking your head, you try to shift the subject to what else she does than just operate a machine shop. By herself.
rows.translation: 你摇摇头，试着把话题转向除了独自经营机械工坊外，她还会做什么别的事。
rows.raw: "\n\nShaking your head, you try to shift the subject to what else she does than just operate a machine shop. By herself."

rows.original: “Oh, well. I do all kinds of stuff for the rask! Like... build stuff! They bring scrap and junk back that they can’t use or got frisked by the rusties, and I help them by making it work again! And usually other stuff, like making new stuff out of old stuff that works good! Ooh, like I got the lighting to work again from a doohickey! At least it usually works... I kinda preferred when it didn’t, though. Um. Oooh! Sometimes I carry people, too! Cuz they’re super light so I just pick them up by the shoulders or the ears or the legs or wherever really and go voosh! They usually start screaming, but it’s to help them! Like if they get stuck in sludge or a pit or a sludge pit! They’re just afraid of flying for some reason.” As excitable as ever, Aurora is practically beaming with those out of place fangs on full display, bouncing in place like a yo-yo.
rows.translation: “哦，好吧。我会替拉斯克维尔做各种事！ 比如...造东西！ 他们会把用不了的废料和垃圾带回来，有些是被锈怪搜刮过的，我会帮他们重新修好！ 一般还会做别的，比如拿能用的旧东西造好用的新东西！ 哦，就像我用一个小玩意修好了照明！ 至少通常能用...不过我其实更喜欢坏掉的时候。嗯。哦哦！ 有时我还会搬人！ 因为他们超级轻，我只要抓住肩膀、耳朵、腿或者任何地方，嗖一下就飞走！ 他们一般会开始尖叫，但我是为了帮忙！ 比如他们陷进烂泥、坑里或烂泥坑里！ 不知道为什么，他们就是怕飞。”奥萝拉仍旧无比兴奋，咧着那对格格不入的尖牙，笑得无比灿烂，像悠悠球一样原地弹跳。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, well. I do all kinds of stuff for the rask! Like... build stuff! They bring scrap and junk back that they can’t use or got frisked by the rusties, and I help them by making it work again! And usually other stuff, like making new stuff out of old stuff that works good! Ooh, like I got the lighting to work again from a doohickey! At least it usually works... I kinda preferred when it didn’t, though. Um. Oooh! Sometimes I carry people, too! Cuz they’re super light so I just pick them up by the shoulders or the ears or the legs or wherever really and go voosh! They usually start screaming, but it’s to help them! Like if they get stuck in sludge or a pit or a sludge pit! They’re just afraid of flying for some reason.” As excitable as ever, Aurora is practically beaming with those out of place fangs on full display, bouncing in place like a yo-yo."

rows.original: You’re certain she makes her keep here and probably well beyond that, too. Someone like her really deserves better in life, but it also doesn’t seem like she wants to leave. You muse over the possibility for a moment until you’re brought back out of it by the girl’s ever present, soul-searching stares and decide not to leave the impatient kid waiting.
rows.translation: 你确信她完全能凭这些本事在这里谋生，甚至远不止于此。她这样的人理应拥有更好的生活，但她似乎也不想离开。你思索片刻，随后被女孩始终不离的探究目光拉回现实，决定不让这个没耐心的孩子久等。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re certain she makes her keep here and probably well beyond that, too. Someone like her really deserves better in life, but it also doesn’t seem like she wants to leave. You muse over the possibility for a moment until you’re brought back out of it by the girl’s ever present, soul-searching stares and decide not to leave the impatient kid waiting."

rows.original: It’s got to be weird being raised by Raskvel. What’s her opinion on her caretakers?
rows.translation: 由拉斯克维尔抚养长大一定很奇怪。她怎么看待自己的照顾者？
rows.raw: "It’s got to be weird being raised by Raskvel. What’s her opinion on her caretakers?"

rows.original: “Huh? Them? Well, they’re nice enough. Some of them get weird and evasive around me but I think that’s cuz they get all fiddly and adult-y all the time and I’m not one! They’re pretty quick to grow up, but not me-eeee! It makes it kinda lonely. But I have scrap and stuff to make all the time so it’s cool!” After she flails her arms around in emphasis, Aurora takes a bit more somber of a tone, “Nah. They’re great. Sometimes I wish I were more at my supposed home, but they’re my family, and they love me, and I love them. Never had an issue!”
rows.translation: “咦？ 他们？ 嗯，他们挺好的。有些人在我身边会变得古怪又躲躲闪闪，但我觉得那是因为他们总爱搞那些黏糊糊的成人事情，而我不是大人！ 他们长大很快，可我不——会——! 所以有点孤单。但我随时都有废料和东西可以造，所以没事！”奥萝拉挥舞双臂加强语气，随后口吻稍稍低沉：“没有啦。他们很棒。有时我希望能更多待在自己本该属于的家乡，但他们就是我的家人，他们爱我，我也爱他们。从来没出过问题！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Huh? Them? Well, they’re nice enough. Some of them get weird and evasive around me but I think that’s cuz they get all fiddly and adult-y all the time and I’m not one! They’re pretty quick to grow up, but not me-eeee! It makes it kinda lonely. But I have scrap and stuff to make all the time so it’s cool!” After she flails her arms around in emphasis, Aurora takes a bit more somber of a tone, “Nah. They’re great. Sometimes I wish I were more at my supposed home, but they’re my family, and they love me, and I love them. Never had an issue!”"

rows.original: It’s nice to know that there is still good in the universe. Even if that good are tiny little things that hump every (adult, at least) thing that moves.
rows.translation: 很高兴知道宇宙中依然存在善意。哪怕这种善意来自一群会骑上每一个会动的东西——至少是成年东西——的小家伙。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s nice to know that there is still good in the universe. Even if that good are tiny little things that hump every (adult, at least) thing that moves."
