rows.original: Just what is she, anyway?
rows.translation: 她到底是什么？
rows.raw: "Just what is she, anyway?"

rows.original: “No idea!” Her rather boisterous start probably would have caught you off guard if you didn’t already know how loud she tended to get on the drop of a hat. “No one knows! People keep asking and then they try to offer to take me away to somewhere nice but I know they really just wanna stick me in a lab and poke me with science forks and stuff to see how I work and why. And that’s lame! Nyeeeh!” Childishly, Aurora sticks her pink little tongue out at you in playful rebellion. “But no one knows what I’m supposed to be, or where I came from. Which sucks. I had a mom and dad and stuff, probably!”
rows.translation: “不知道!”若非早已知道她能毫无征兆地突然放大嗓门，这个喧闹开场大概会吓你一跳。“没人知道！ 大家一直问，然后提出要带我去某个好地方，但我知道他们其实只想把我塞进实验室，用科学叉子之类的戳我，看看我怎么运作，为什么会这样。太逊了！ 呸——!”奥萝拉孩子气地吐出粉红小舌，以顽皮反抗表达态度。“但没人知道我本该是什么，也不知道我来自哪里。真糟糕。我大概也有妈妈爸爸什么的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No idea!” Her rather boisterous start probably would have caught you off guard if you didn’t already know how loud she tended to get on the drop of a hat. “No one knows! People keep asking and then they try to offer to take me away to somewhere nice but I know they really just wanna stick me in a lab and poke me with science forks and stuff to see how I work and why. And that’s lame! Nyeeeh!” Childishly, Aurora sticks her pink little tongue out at you in playful rebellion. “But no one knows what I’m supposed to be, or where I came from. Which sucks. I had a mom and dad and stuff, probably!”"

rows.original: Curious, you bring up your codex to see if it has any information on her - and sure enough, you’re given an error message in short order. Not only is there no information, but she’s also too young to actually generate information on her. It’s all inconclusive, at least with your hardware.
rows.translation: 你好奇地调出图鉴，看看里面是否有她的资料——果然，很快便收到错误信息。里面不仅没有任何资料，而且她年龄太小，甚至无法为她生成资料。至少以你的硬件而言，一切都无法确定。
rows.raw: "\n\nCurious, you bring up your codex to see if it has any information on her - and sure enough, you’re given an error message in short order. Not only is there no information, but she’s also too young to actually generate information on her. It’s all inconclusive, at least with your hardware."

rows.original: By the time you slip the device away again the mechanist is already blabbing again. “I know I’m a vegetarian! Fruits are awesome and meat is lame, which is good cuz there really isn’t any out here. Bleh. But they don’t let me in hydroponics... and that I can kinda see in the dark and I have really good hearing like whoa and I can fly, durr, and stuff. And I like the dark, too, but light is okay. I guess.”
rows.translation: 你再次收起设备时，机械师已经又开始喋喋不休。“我知道自己吃素！ 水果超棒，肉很逊，幸好这里根本没有肉。呸。不过他们不让我进水培区...还有我能在黑暗里看见一点东西，听力超级好，哇哦，而且我会飞，笨蛋，还有别的。我也喜欢黑暗，不过光线也行。大概吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBy the time you slip the device away again the mechanist is already blabbing again. “I know I’m a vegetarian! Fruits are awesome and meat is lame, which is good cuz there really isn’t any out here. Bleh. But they don’t let me in hydroponics... and that I can kinda see in the dark and I have really good hearing like whoa and I can fly, durr, and stuff. And I like the dark, too, but light is okay. I guess.”"

rows.original: You’ve gathered in short order that yes, she is indeed some sort of alien Bat morph of some kind, with characteristics similar to a bat. A fruit bat, if you really wanted to be precise. But no one can just go out and say she’s a fruit bat alien for reasons. Also like, ten years old, so who cares?
rows.translation: 你很快便总结出，没错，她的确是某种外星蝙蝠类人生物，拥有类似蝙蝠的特征。若想特别精确，那就是果蝠。但大家出于某些原因，不能直接说她是外星果蝠。而且她大概才十岁，谁在乎呢？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve gathered in short order that yes, she is indeed some sort of alien Bat morph of some kind, with characteristics similar to a bat. A fruit bat, if you really wanted to be precise. But no one can just go out and say she’s a fruit bat alien for reasons. Also like, ten years old, so who cares?"

rows.original: Nodding, you muse over the information idly, trying to make heads or tails of it. Sounds like whatever she is, she’s awfully similar to that of a bat in basic features. Which was pretty obvious by her appearance alone. Still, the information isn’t really useful to you.
rows.translation: 你点点头，漫不经心地思考这些信息，试图理清头绪。无论她是什么，基本特征似乎都与蝙蝠极为相似。光看外表便相当明显。不过这些信息对你其实没有用。
rows.raw: "\n\nNodding, you muse over the information idly, trying to make heads or tails of it. Sounds like whatever she is, she’s awfully similar to that of a bat in basic features. Which was pretty obvious by her appearance alone. Still, the information isn’t really useful to you."

rows.original: “Oh hey! You’re one of those people all flying about space and exploring and planting flags on everything like you own it now, right? If you find folks like me, could you let me know about it or something? I mean... This is my home now and all that, but it’d be nice to know. Ya know?”
rows.translation: “哦，嘿！ 你就是那种在太空四处飞、到处探索，还在所有东西上插旗子，说现在归自己的人，对吧？ 如果你发现和我一样的人，能告诉我吗？ 我是说...这里现在就是我的家什么的，但要是能知道就好了。你懂吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh hey! You’re one of those people all flying about space and exploring and planting flags on everything like you own it now, right? If you find folks like me, could you let me know about it or something? I mean... This is my home now and all that, but it’d be nice to know. Ya know?”"

rows.original: You can’t make any promises, but you’ll see what you can do
rows.translation: 你无法保证什么，但会看看自己能做些什么
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t make any promises, but you’ll see what you can do"

rows.original: , knowing that this isn’t actually a quest hook
rows.translation: ，因为你知道这其实不是任务提示
rows.raw: ", knowing that this isn’t actually a quest hook"

rows.original: About Novahome
rows.translation: 关于诺瓦之家
rows.raw: "About Novahome"

rows.original: About Novahome
rows.translation: 关于诺瓦之家
rows.raw: "About Novahome"

rows.original: Magic Ted
rows.raw: "Magic Ted"

rows.original: How about the place she calls home?
rows.translation: 那她称为家的地方呢？
rows.raw: "How about the place she calls home?"

rows.original: “The Nova? Well, everyone here calls it the Novahome to be cute and stuff, but... well, it’s something. I’ve put a lot of work into this thing! I’m kinda the only one actually making progress most of the time. Those rusties made a mess of things; I only got the reactor working after people figured out this is a humie ship! There are a lot of parts about, but it’s best to match them up! A few cones of the engines are working now, too, so whenever we suddenly need to go nowhere fast with a bunch of fire we can!” Er. “Whenever this landed it was still working enough that it had a controlled fall, otherwise it woulda gotten all burnt up racing through atmosphere and lawndarted instead of skidding, or at least fell on its side. So all the damage is just on the bottom and even that’s pretty much nothing. They’re made for this sort of thing!”
rows.translation: “诺瓦号? 嗯，这里每个人都喜欢叫它诺瓦之家，听起来可爱什么的，不过...怎么说呢，它还挺特别。我给这东西费了不少心！ 大多数时候，实际上只有我一个人取得进展。那些锈怪把一切搞得乱七八糟；直到大家发现这是艘人类飞船，我才让反应堆运转起来！ 零件倒是很多，但最好把相配的装在一起！ 如今有几个引擎喷口也能运转，所以只要突然需要喷着一大团火快速原地踏步，我们就能做到！”呃。“它坠落时仍有足够动力控制下降，否则穿过大气层时早被烧光，像标枪一样扎下去，而不是滑行着陆；至少也会侧翻。所以损伤都集中在底部，即使那里的损伤也几乎不算什么。它们本来就是为这种情况设计的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The Nova? Well, everyone here calls it the Novahome to be cute and stuff, but... well, it’s something. I’ve put a lot of work into this thing! I’m kinda the only one actually making progress most of the time. Those rusties made a mess of things; I only got the reactor working after people figured out this is a humie ship! There are a lot of parts about, but it’s best to match them up! A few cones of the engines are working now, too, so whenever we suddenly need to go nowhere fast with a bunch of fire we can!” Er. “Whenever this landed it was still working enough that it had a controlled fall, otherwise it woulda gotten all burnt up racing through atmosphere and lawndarted instead of skidding, or at least fell on its side. So all the damage is just on the bottom and even that’s pretty much nothing. They’re made for this sort of thing!”"

rows.original: “Most of the issues is actually software and stuff. Even the rusties went for bigger, non-important stuff, like doors and the smaller ones nibbled on pipes like candy bars. But the computers! I dunno anything about computers, but that Steele Tech lady sure does, so whenever I find one she always comes racing over, but always gets annoyed cuz it doesn’t work on the inside, I guess. Sometimes I follow her cuz the hallways are tall and people don’t notice me and she gets all fidgety like every noise is out to get her. It’s funny!”
rows.translation: “大多数问题其实出在软件什么的。就连锈怪也只攻击体积更大、没那么重要的东西，比如门；小家伙则把管道当糖果棒一样啃。但那些电脑！ 我对电脑一窍不通，不过那位斯蒂尔科技女士可懂了，所以每当我找到一台，她都会飞奔过来，但又总是生气，因为我猜它里面坏了。有时我会跟着她，因为走廊很高，大家不会注意到我；她却神经兮兮的，仿佛每个响声都想害她。真有趣！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Most of the issues is actually software and stuff. Even the rusties went for bigger, non-important stuff, like doors and the smaller ones nibbled on pipes like candy bars. But the computers! I dunno anything about computers, but that Steele Tech lady sure does, so whenever I find one she always comes racing over, but always gets annoyed cuz it doesn’t work on the inside, I guess. Sometimes I follow her cuz the hallways are tall and people don’t notice me and she gets all fidgety like every noise is out to get her. It’s funny!”"

rows.original: “Please don’t stalk my employees.”
rows.translation: “请不要跟踪我的员工。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Please don’t stalk my employees.”"

rows.original: “Oh. Um. Well! Lately I’ve mostly been working in here cuz everything we need is mostly working. Still, I like it. It’s comfy and there are a bunch of holes in it, too, so I can just pop in and out real fast. Everyone else has to walk and they whiiiine about it. Heh.” Smug bat.
rows.translation: “哦。呃。好吧！ 最近我大多在这里工作，因为我们需要的一切基本都能用了。不过我喜欢这里。很舒服，而且还有好多洞，所以我可以特别快地进进出出。其他人只能走路，还为此不停抱——怨。嘿嘿。”得意的蝙蝠。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh. Um. Well! Lately I’ve mostly been working in here cuz everything we need is mostly working. Still, I like it. It’s comfy and there are a bunch of holes in it, too, so I can just pop in and out real fast. Everyone else has to walk and they whiiiine about it. Heh.” Smug bat."

rows.original: Will she ever be space capable again?
rows.translation: 它还能再次进行太空航行吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nWill she ever be space capable again?"

rows.original: “Nope! The rusties ate through most of the important air pipes and, among other things, the reactor is all messed up and never really could put out enough! Even if you somehow replaced all that, though, the hull is brittle and torn with age and the whole crashing thing. Rusties, too, durr. I’m no rocket scientist, but I am pretty sure she’d just break in half from the weight if we tried tossing her up, full speed ahead. Nothing is really in good shape to cannibalize, either - space is a bad place! You want prime stuff out in space. A bunch of uppity people second guess me, though, and have this whole dream of taking the ‘home’ out of ‘Novahome’, but it won’t happen. Besides, then they’d need more than just me!”
rows.translation: “不能! 锈怪啃穿了大部分重要空气管道；除此以外，反应堆也彻底坏了，本来就一直无法输出足够能量！ 就算你设法更换所有那些东西，船壳也因年代久远和坠毁事故而脆化破裂。还有锈怪，笨蛋。我不是什么火箭科学家，不过我很确定，要是我们全速把它抛上去，它光凭自身重量就会断成两半。也没有任何东西状态好到可以拆下来利用——太空可是坏地方！ 在太空里就该用顶级部件。可有一群自以为是的人会质疑我，整天梦想把‘诺瓦之家’里的‘家’拿掉，但那不可能。而且那样他们光靠我一个人也不够！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nope! The rusties ate through most of the important air pipes and, among other things, the reactor is all messed up and never really could put out enough! Even if you somehow replaced all that, though, the hull is brittle and torn with age and the whole crashing thing. Rusties, too, durr. I’m no rocket scientist, but I am pretty sure she’d just break in half from the weight if we tried tossing her up, full speed ahead. Nothing is really in good shape to cannibalize, either - space is a bad place! You want prime stuff out in space. A bunch of uppity people second guess me, though, and have this whole dream of taking the ‘home’ out of ‘Novahome’, but it won’t happen. Besides, then they’d need more than just me!”"

rows.original: You nod, curtly. By your gathering Aurora is pretty much the self-appointed chief engineer on this junk, if only because no one else has the skills for it. How she has the skills for it, though, is a mystery in of itself. Nonetheless, it sounds like she keeps her head out of other people’s affairs and just works on the ship, not having much to say for the various people in it. Which isn’t surprising coming from a kid.
rows.translation: 你简短地点头。依你所见，奥萝拉算是这堆垃圾上自封的总工程师，只因为别人都没有相应技能。不过她为何会有这些技能，本身就是个谜。总之，听起来她不会插手别人的事务，只管在飞船上干活，对船上各色人等没什么可说。这在一个孩子身上并不奇怪。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, curtly. By your gathering Aurora is pretty much the self-appointed chief engineer on this junk, if only because no one else has the skills for it. How she has the skills for it, though, is a mystery in of itself. Nonetheless, it sounds like she keeps her head out of other people’s affairs and just works on the ship, not having much to say for the various people in it. Which isn’t surprising coming from a kid."

rows.original: How Are You?
rows.translation: 你好吗？
rows.raw: "How Are You?"

rows.original: How Are You?
rows.translation: 你好吗？
rows.raw: "How Are You?"

rows.original: Magic Ted
rows.raw: "Magic Ted"

rows.original: “I’m good!” Aurora’s response is pretty much immediate, almost sounding trained in its efficiency. After a quiet moment between the two of you, the girl sheepishly continues, swaying from her lamp. “Um. I’m fine, really. I keep busy! There’s a lot of work to do and I’ve been using all the junk to make stuff work right! I got all the engines going earlier!”
rows.translation: “我很好！”奥萝拉几乎立刻回答，效率高得像是经过训练。你们安静片刻后，女孩羞涩地继续说，身体悬在灯上晃动。“嗯。我真的没事。我一直在忙！ 有好多工作要做，我一直在用所有垃圾把东西修好！ 我早些时候让所有引擎都转起来了！”
rows.raw: "“I’m good!” Aurora’s response is pretty much immediate, almost sounding trained in its efficiency. After a quiet moment between the two of you, the girl sheepishly continues, swaying from her lamp. “Um. I’m fine, really. I keep busy! There’s a lot of work to do and I’ve been using all the junk to make stuff work right! I got all the engines going earlier!”"

rows.original: That’s... great, but what about her?
rows.translation: 这...很棒，但她自己呢？
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s... great, but what about her?"

rows.original: The girl’s childish energy becomes less pronounced, and she grows awkward, wiggling in place as she struggles to talk about herself. Or avoid it. “I’m fine. Really! I just went from selling stuff to not selling stuff... doing the same thing either way!”
rows.translation: 女孩的童真活力不再那么明显，她变得尴尬，在原地扭动，挣扎着谈论自己。或者逃避这个话题。“我没事。真的！ 我只是从卖东西变成不卖东西...反正做的事都一样！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe girl’s childish energy becomes less pronounced, and she grows awkward, wiggling in place as she struggles to talk about herself. Or avoid it. “I’m fine. Really! I just went from selling stuff to not selling stuff... doing the same thing either way!”"

rows.original: It’s pretty obvious she doesn’t want to go into any more detail about it and you’re in no position to press it. She probably lost people just like everyone else.
rows.translation: 她显然不想继续详谈，你也不适合逼问。她大概与所有人一样失去了亲友。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s pretty obvious she doesn’t want to go into any more detail about it and you’re in no position to press it. She probably lost people just like everyone else."

rows.original: How Are You?
rows.translation: 你好吗？
rows.raw: "How Are You?"

rows.original: You could ask her how she’s doing - her life had quite the upheaval recently.
rows.translation: 你可以问问她近况如何——她的生活最近发生了天翻地覆的变化。
rows.raw: "You could ask her how she’s doing - her life had quite the upheaval recently."

rows.original: Survival
rows.translation: 幸存经过
rows.raw: "Survival"

rows.original: Survival
rows.translation: 幸存经过
rows.raw: "Survival"

rows.original: Magic Ted
rows.raw: "Magic Ted"

rows.original: “What, you doubted me?” Right from the onset you knew Aurora was going to be pretty smug and prideful about this. The girl adopts a cheeky grin as she puffs her chest out. “Of course I got back! I’m clever and stuff! When the planet started shaking and crumbling I was outside with a few spare parts from a wrecked converter. I knew something was off cuz the wind was getting all weird and the junk felt way lighter so I darted home!” Every so often Aurora pauses for a few seconds, trying to remember just how it went down. Or perhaps she’s making some stuff up here and there to embellish it. She is, like, twelve. That should be a given.
rows.translation: “怎么，你怀疑我？”一开始你便知道奥萝拉会对此颇为得意骄傲。女孩挺起胸膛，露出调皮笑容。“我当然回来了！ 我很聪明什么的！ 星球开始震动崩塌时，我正在外面，从一台损坏的转换器里拆了些备用零件。我知道不对劲，因为风开始变得古怪，垃圾也轻了许多，于是我飞快赶回家！”奥萝拉偶尔会停上几秒，努力回忆当时的经过。又或许，她正在这里那里编造细节，替故事添油加醋。她大概十二岁，这很正常。
rows.raw: "“What, you doubted me?” Right from the onset you knew Aurora was going to be pretty smug and prideful about this. The girl adopts a cheeky grin as she puffs her chest out. “Of course I got back! I’m clever and stuff! When the planet started shaking and crumbling I was outside with a few spare parts from a wrecked converter. I knew something was off cuz the wind was getting all weird and the junk felt way lighter so I darted home!” Every so often Aurora pauses for a few seconds, trying to remember just how it went down. Or perhaps she’s making some stuff up here and there to embellish it. She is, like, twelve. That should be a given."

rows.original: “The sky got weird by the time I got back and the air was thin, like I was wa-aaay up. So I figured something had happened to the artificial tether and we were all doomed! So I hopped in the mini-pod that no one wanted and hid! I was scared. Then everything started getting sucked out of the workshop and the pod got flung out and was spinning around. Everything was terrible!”
rows.translation: “我回来时天空已经变得古怪，空气也很稀薄，就像我飞到了非——常高的地方。所以我猜人造系绳出了问题，我们全都要完蛋！ 于是我跳进没人要的微型舱躲起来！ 我很害怕。然后一切东西都开始被吸出工坊，舱体也被抛出去不停打转。一切都糟透了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The sky got weird by the time I got back and the air was thin, like I was wa-aaay up. So I figured something had happened to the artificial tether and we were all doomed! So I hopped in the mini-pod that no one wanted and hid! I was scared. Then everything started getting sucked out of the workshop and the pod got flung out and was spinning around. Everything was terrible!”"

rows.original: “But the pod had fuel in it and worked, just like I said! So I got it turned on-” Aurora’s intrepid retelling becomes a bit muted as she mumbles something about ‘eventually’, though like any good storytelling bard, her aside is brief, leaving her to continue boasting. “- and I flew to the Novahome! I even caught someone - she’s fine - and I crashed into one of the bays before the doors got shut.”
rows.translation: “不过舱里有燃料，也确实能用，就像我说的！ 所以我把它发动起来——”奥萝拉英勇的讲述稍稍低沉，她含糊嘟囔了一句“最后总算”，但如同任何优秀的说书人，这句旁白很快过去，她继续吹嘘。“——然后我飞向诺瓦之家! 我甚至接住一个人——她没事——然后在舱门关上前撞进了一间机库。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But the pod had fuel in it and worked, just like I said! So I got it turned on-” Aurora’s intrepid retelling becomes a bit muted as she mumbles something about ‘eventually’, though like any good storytelling bard, her aside is brief, leaving her to continue boasting. “- and I flew to the Novahome! I even caught someone - she’s fine - and I crashed into one of the bays before the doors got shut.”"

rows.original: You blink. That’s a bit dramatic. Actually, why didn’t she just run into the Novahome when she had the chance instead of hiding in the pod?
rows.translation: 你眨眨眼。这还真惊险。其实，她当时明明有机会，为什么不直接跑进诺瓦之家，却要躲进舱里？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou blink. That’s a bit dramatic. Actually, why didn’t she just run into the Novahome when she had the chance instead of hiding in the pod?"

rows.original: “Cuz! It’s a piece of junk!”
rows.translation: “因为! 它就是堆破烂！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Cuz! It’s a piece of junk!”"

rows.original: Oh. That’s fair.
rows.translation: 哦。这倒也有道理。
rows.raw: "\n\nOh. That’s fair."

rows.original: Survival
rows.translation: 幸存经过
rows.raw: "Survival"

rows.original: Aurora had a practically outdoors workshop and spent plenty of time flying around the planet - how’d she make it back?
rows.translation: 奥萝拉的工坊几乎露天，她也经常飞遍星球——她是怎么赶回来的？
rows.raw: "Aurora had a practically outdoors workshop and spent plenty of time flying around the planet - how’d she make it back?"

rows.original: Nova?
rows.translation: 诺瓦号？
rows.raw: "Nova?"

rows.original: Nova?
rows.translation: 诺瓦号？
rows.raw: "Nova?"

rows.original: Magic Ted
rows.raw: "Magic Ted"

rows.original: “She wasn’t! But we fixed her up really quick. Really quick.”
rows.translation: “它原本不能! 不过我们很快就把它修好了。非常快。”
rows.raw: "“She wasn’t! But we fixed her up really quick. Really quick.”"

rows.original: You can imagine! Still, you’re curious about the details.
rows.translation: 你完全能想象！ 不过你仍想知道具体经过。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can imagine! Still, you’re curious about the details."

rows.original: “Well, bunch of us played a part. When the world started shaking and cracking everyone started freaking out.”
rows.translation: “嗯，我们好多人都出了力。世界开始震动开裂时，所有人都慌了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, bunch of us played a part. When the world started shaking and cracking everyone started freaking out.”"

rows.original: “The raskvel work pretty fast, too! They always do. Everything got welded off and sealed up right by the time I got back in again! Little gremlins, I swear. The meteorite shields kept all the debris from doing any more damage, too, but we didn’t have any air-systems. So we worked on it! That scared-y dog-lady with the guns apparently had a bunch of blueprints about the ship on her and she shoved it on us when she was done screaming! Then she went back to screaming. I gave a bunch of the readouts she found to Colesno cuz he knows computers and stuff. I knew he’d do it, even if we never see each other - cuz he’s short, durr. He and Shekka got the power generator working and we found a bunch of backup life-support systems! So we have air and it’s warm and stuff! Comfier than before, even!”
rows.translation: “拉斯克维尔干活也很快！ 他们一直如此。我再次回来时，所有东西都已焊好密封！ 我发誓，真是一群小怪物！ 陨石护盾也挡住了所有碎片，没让飞船进一步受损，不过我们没有空气系统。所以我们开始修！ 那个拿枪的胆小狗女士显然带着一大堆飞船蓝图；她尖叫完后把东西塞给我们，随后又继续尖叫。我把她找到的许多读数交给科莱斯诺，因为他懂电脑什么的。我知道他会做，哪怕我们从没见过——因为他很矮，笨蛋。他和谢卡修好了发电机，我们还找到一堆备用生命维持系统！ 所以我们现在有空气，也很暖和！ 甚至比从前更舒服！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The raskvel work pretty fast, too! They always do. Everything got welded off and sealed up right by the time I got back in again! Little gremlins, I swear. The meteorite shields kept all the debris from doing any more damage, too, but we didn’t have any air-systems. So we worked on it! That scared-y dog-lady with the guns apparently had a bunch of blueprints about the ship on her and she shoved it on us when she was done screaming! Then she went back to screaming. I gave a bunch of the readouts she found to Colesno cuz he knows computers and stuff. I knew he’d do it, even if we never see each other - cuz he’s short, durr. He and Shekka got the power generator working and we found a bunch of backup life-support systems! So we have air and it’s warm and stuff! Comfier than before, even!”"

rows.original: “With all that important stuff done we hooked up the engines and thrusters properly and established a safe orbit! Still collecting junk floating around, too. She can’t really go fast and I don’t really feel safe with her being in space to begin with, but the Novahome is cruising just fine!”
rows.translation: “所有重要事情完成后，我们正确接好引擎与推进器，建立了安全轨道！ 现在也仍在收集周围漂浮的垃圾。它其实飞不快，我也不太放心让它待在太空里，不过诺瓦之家航行得很好！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“With all that important stuff done we hooked up the engines and thrusters properly and established a safe orbit! Still collecting junk floating around, too. She can’t really go fast and I don’t really feel safe with her being in space to begin with, but the Novahome is cruising just fine!”"

rows.original: You’re rather surprised by their collective ingenuity and you find yourself happy for them. At least they can take care of themselves.
rows.translation: 他们齐心协力展现出的创造力令你十分惊讶，也让你为他们高兴。至少他们有能力照顾自己。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re rather surprised by their collective ingenuity and you find yourself happy for them. At least they can take care of themselves."

rows.original: Nova?
rows.translation: 诺瓦号？
rows.raw: "Nova?"

rows.original: How’s this bucket doing? You don’t recall her being space-capable.
rows.translation: 这只破桶情况如何？ 你记得它本来无法进行太空航行。
rows.raw: "How’s this bucket doing? You don’t recall her being space-capable."

rows.original: What Now?
rows.translation: 接下来呢？
rows.raw: "What Now?"

rows.original: What Now?
rows.translation: 接下来呢？
rows.raw: "What Now?"

rows.original: Magic Ted
rows.raw: "Magic Ted"

rows.original: “Uh... I dunno.” Surprised that she doesn’t have her usual gusto, you wait for the girl to collect her thoughts on the subject. “I don’t think this can last very long... They need a planet. And sun! And I wanna stretch my wings!” Naturally, she does just that, threatening to clothesline a pair of unsuspecting patrons who are just tall enough to be in the way.
rows.translation: “呃...我不知道。”她没有平常那股劲头，这让你有些惊讶。你等女孩整理好对这个问题的想法。“我觉得这样维持不了多久...他们需要一颗星球。还需要阳光！ 我也想伸展翅膀！”她自然立刻照做，险些用翅膀扫倒两名身高刚好挡路、毫无防备的顾客。
rows.raw: "“Uh... I dunno.” Surprised that she doesn’t have her usual gusto, you wait for the girl to collect her thoughts on the subject. “I don’t think this can last very long... They need a planet. And sun! And I wanna stretch my wings!” Naturally, she does just that, threatening to clothesline a pair of unsuspecting patrons who are just tall enough to be in the way."

rows.original: “But my family is here! Even if some of them are gone now... so until they go, Imma stay! I don’t have anywhere else to go, after all!” While her reservations about the idea are obvious in her tone, she seems pretty dedicated to it nonetheless.
rows.translation: “但我的家人在这里！ 哪怕有些人已经不在了...所以在他们离开前，我也会留下！ 反正我无处可去！”尽管语气明显流露出对这个想法的疑虑，她似乎依然十分坚定。
rows.raw: "\n\n“But my family is here! Even if some of them are gone now... so until they go, Imma stay! I don’t have anywhere else to go, after all!” While her reservations about the idea are obvious in her tone, she seems pretty dedicated to it nonetheless."

rows.original: You briefly muse over what could be done with the girl. She doesn’t have any real family beyond the community, but you figure they still take care of her just fine. She’s growing up, too. The thought of offering to take her under your wing - partly as a employee of Steele Tech, with all the junk she could ever want or even working aboard your ship - crosses your mind, but you squash the thought just as quickly. You don’t want a emotional then-teen to learn of your grisly involvement and have some kid mad-scientist after you. Besides, she said it herself; she didn’t want to leave.
rows.translation: 你短暂思考能为这女孩做些什么。社区之外，她没有真正的家人，不过你觉得他们还是能把她照顾得不错。她也在逐渐长大。你一度想提出把她收归麾下——既可以让她成为斯蒂尔科技员工，拥有取之不尽的垃圾，也可以让她在你的飞船上工作——但很快打消念头。你可不想让一个情绪多变的未来少女得知自己参与过那些血腥事件，再招来一个生气的少年疯狂科学家。而且她亲口说过，不想离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou briefly muse over what could be done with the girl. She doesn’t have any real family beyond the community, but you figure they still take care of her just fine. She’s growing up, too. The thought of offering to take her under your wing - partly as a employee of Steele Tech, with all the junk she could ever want or even working aboard your ship - crosses your mind, but you squash the thought just as quickly. You don’t want a emotional then-teen to learn of your grisly involvement and have some kid mad-scientist after you. Besides, she said it herself; she didn’t want to leave."

rows.original: You sigh. Maybe after this company-chasing business is actually over with you could do something about these people. Until then, though, you have an adventure to finish.
rows.translation: 你叹了口气。也许等这场追逐公司的风波真正结束后，你能为这些人做些什么。不过在那之前，你还有一场冒险要完成。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sigh. Maybe after this company-chasing business is actually over with you could do something about these people. Until then, though, you have an adventure to finish."

rows.original: Maybe with less fuckups.
rows.translation: 也许这次能少犯些错。
rows.raw: "\n\nMaybe with less fuckups."

rows.original: You break out of your reverie with Aurora’s golden eyes staring you down, impatiently swaying side to side as she waits for you to snap to again.
rows.translation: 奥萝拉的金色双眼正盯着你，她不耐烦地左右摇摆，等待你回过神来；你也因此脱离沉思。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou break out of your reverie with Aurora’s golden eyes staring you down, impatiently swaying side to side as she waits for you to snap to again."

rows.original: What Now?
rows.translation: 接下来呢？
rows.raw: "What Now?"

rows.original: What are you going to do now?
rows.translation: 你接下来打算做什么？
rows.raw: "What are you going to do now?"

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: Raygun
rows.translation: 射线枪
rows.raw: "Raygun"

rows.original: Raygun
rows.translation: 射线枪
rows.raw: "Raygun"

rows.original: Magic Ted
rows.raw: "Magic Ted"

rows.original: What’s that thing that looks suspiciously like a cartoon handheld ray gun hanging there?
rows.translation: 挂在那里的东西看起来很像卡通里的手持射线枪，那是什么？
rows.raw: "What’s that thing that looks suspiciously like a cartoon handheld ray gun hanging there?"

rows.original: With your vague prompting Aurora quickly scampers over to one of the racks where a host of various knick knacks and half built devices and scrap hang. The only one that stands out is the rather colorful thing dangling by its hilt, which looks very much like some “alien raygun” that you’d find little green men waving around in cartoons and other fanciful things. It looks like a toy, which wouldn’t really be out of place in Aurora’s repertoire if she didn’t seem a little above that sort of thing. At least you could tease her about it.
rows.translation: 在你含糊指引下，奥萝拉迅速爬向一个架子，那里挂着各式各样的小物件、半成品设备和废料。唯一显眼的是那个用握把挂起的彩色物件，看起来非常像卡通和其他幻想作品中小绿人挥舞的“外星射线枪”。它看着像玩具；要不是奥萝拉似乎不屑于这种玩意，这倒很符合她收藏品的风格。至少你可以拿它逗逗她。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith your vague prompting Aurora quickly scampers over to one of the racks where a host of various knick knacks and half built devices and scrap hang. The only one that stands out is the rather colorful thing dangling by its hilt, which looks very much like some “alien raygun” that you’d find little green men waving around in cartoons and other fanciful things. It looks like a toy, which wouldn’t really be out of place in Aurora’s repertoire if she didn’t seem a little above that sort of thing. At least you could tease her about it."

rows.original: “This? It’s my ray gun!” Chirps the bat, holding the maybe-toy with remarkable trigger discipline for a youth. “Someone found it and brought it to me! But it was empty and just had a speaker in it for some reason, so I fixed it! Now it works properly!”
rows.translation: “这个？ 是我的射线枪！”蝙蝠叽喳说道，以对年轻人而言堪称出色的扳机纪律握住那件疑似玩具的东西。“有人找到后拿给我的！ 不过它是空的，不知为何里面只有一个扬声器，所以我修好了它！ 现在它能正常用了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This? It’s my ray gun!” Chirps the bat, holding the maybe-toy with remarkable trigger discipline for a youth. “Someone found it and brought it to me! But it was empty and just had a speaker in it for some reason, so I fixed it! Now it works properly!”"

rows.original: A sickening knot starts to form in your stomach as nosiness gets the best of you, feeling endangered despite her childish smile. “How so?”
rows.translation: 好奇心压过理智，你腹中开始形成一个令人作呕的结；尽管她笑得天真，你却感到了危险。“怎么个正常法？”
rows.raw: "\n\nA sickening knot starts to form in your stomach as nosiness gets the best of you, feeling endangered despite her childish smile. “How so?”"

rows.original: Immediately, you regret asking as she swings her arm out to the side and brandishes the “weapon” in full, pointing the brightly colored object towards the open rift in the ship’s hull that then leads outside. Suddenly your senses go dizzy, body quaking and simultaneously clamming up like you’re about to puke, and it isn’t until the effect subsides a brief few seconds later that you’re able to gather what just happened. The weapon must have fired a brilliant emerald beam of some sort as wisps still linger in the path. The actual damage the weapon made is all too clear outside, where a big pile of useless, rusty scrap metal now has a molten hole the size of a doorway, still caving in on itself from gravity.
rows.translation: 她立刻将手臂甩向一旁，完全亮出那件“武器”，把鲜艳枪口对准船体上通向外界的开放裂口，你马上后悔问了。感官突然晕眩，身体颤抖僵硬，仿佛马上就要呕吐；几秒后影响消退，你才弄清发生了什么。武器一定发射过某种明亮的翠绿色光束，因为路径上仍残留缕缕微光。它造成的实际破坏在外面一目了然：一大堆毫无用处的锈蚀废金属上熔出一个门口大小的洞，仍在重力作用下不断塌陷。
rows.raw: "\n\nImmediately, you regret asking as she swings her arm out to the side and brandishes the “weapon” in full, pointing the brightly colored object towards the open rift in the ship’s hull that then leads outside. Suddenly your senses go dizzy, body quaking and simultaneously clamming up like you’re about to puke, and it isn’t until the effect subsides a brief few seconds later that you’re able to gather what just happened. The weapon must have fired a brilliant emerald beam of some sort as wisps still linger in the path. The actual damage the weapon made is all too clear outside, where a big pile of useless, rusty scrap metal now has a molten hole the size of a doorway, still caving in on itself from gravity."

rows.original: Naturally, Aurora herself didn’t seem phased by her “little” blaster whatsoever and was once again oblivious, giddily smiling towards you even as you recollect yourself, ears still ringing. “See! I’m not quite sure how it worked before, so I just used whatever I could get to fit. It took a while! But now it can fire forever and it’s pretty great! It still has some issues, and I kinda like it so it’s not on sale. Sorry if you were interested!”
rows.translation: 奥萝拉本人自然完全没被自己的“小”爆能枪影响，又一次毫无察觉；即使你仍耳鸣不止、努力恢复镇定，她也只是兴奋地对你微笑。“看吧！ 我不太清楚它以前怎么运作，所以只用了所有能装进去的东西。花了好久！ 不过现在它可以永远开火，特别棒！ 还有些问题，而且我挺喜欢它，所以不卖。如果你有兴趣，那就抱歉啦！”
rows.raw: "\n\nNaturally, Aurora herself didn’t seem phased by her “little” blaster whatsoever and was once again oblivious, giddily smiling towards you even as you recollect yourself, ears still ringing. “See! I’m not quite sure how it worked before, so I just used whatever I could get to fit. It took a while! But now it can fire forever and it’s pretty great! It still has some issues, and I kinda like it so it’s not on sale. Sorry if you were interested!”"

rows.original: This girl will be a terror on the galaxy when she grows up...
rows.translation: 这女孩长大后会成为整个银河的灾难...
rows.raw: "\n\nThis girl will be a terror on the galaxy when she grows up..."

rows.original: Cannon
rows.translation: 大炮
rows.raw: "Cannon"

rows.original: Cannon
rows.translation: 大炮
rows.raw: "Cannon"

rows.original: Magic Ted
rows.raw: "Magic Ted"

rows.original: There’s a thing over there that looks a awful lot like a old cannon....
rows.translation: 那边有件东西很像一门旧大炮....
rows.raw: "There’s a thing over there that looks a awful lot like a old cannon...."

rows.original: This is like a treasure hunt in a mad scientist’s lair! One shape in particular literally peeks out from the heaps of misused wreckage and assorted paraphernalia at a relatively shallow angle, betraying its rather noticeable size, almost like... A cannon?
rows.translation: 这简直像在疯狂科学家的巢穴里寻宝！ 有个形状特别显眼，以相当平缓的角度从成堆的废弃残骸与各式杂物中探出头来，暴露了自己引人注目的体积，几乎就像...一门大炮？
rows.raw: "\n\nThis is like a treasure hunt in a mad scientist’s lair! One shape in particular literally peeks out from the heaps of misused wreckage and assorted paraphernalia at a relatively shallow angle, betraying its rather noticeable size, almost like... A cannon?"

rows.original: “A howitzer, actually! C’mon, even I know that!” Comes the rapid, if teasing, reply for a question you hadn’t even realized you said out loud. “But it’s too ruined to work too well, and you’d need like, shells and stuff to do all the actual work. So I fiddled with it some! I use it as a trash bin now!” Sensible recycling? “Uh huh! When I find something just too ruined or I mess up too bad I just toss it down the barrel and then when something is about to explode I toss it in the pan and it goes out the hole in the wall!” This sounds both terrifying and exceedingly dangerous, as well as simply counterproductive. Why not just toss it outside to begin with? “It’s fine! It’s never failed and I’ve been doing it for a month! Besides, tossing it is a hassle and can scratch the paint whenever someone gets around to prettying up the hull. Gotta make a routine! Besides, I don’t want those rusties below sniffing around and figuring out I got all this quality junk! Keeping it hidden, quiet.” ...O-oookay.
rows.translation: “准确说是榴弹炮！ 拜托，连我都知道！”你甚至没意识到自己把问题说出了口，她便迅速给出略带调侃的回答。“不过它坏得太厉害，没法正常使用，而且你需要炮弹之类的东西才能完成真正的工作。所以我稍微摆弄了一下！ 现在把它当垃圾桶用！”合理的废物利用？ “嗯哼！ 如果发现东西坏得太彻底，或者我搞砸得太厉害，就把它扔进炮管；然后只要有什么东西快爆炸了，我就把它扔进药盘，让它从墙上的洞飞出去！”这听起来既恐怖又极端危险，而且纯粹是多此一举。为什么不一开始就扔到外面？ “没关系！ 从来没失败过，而且我已经这样做了一个月！ 再说，往外扔很麻烦，而且等有人来美化船壳时，可能会刮花油漆。必须形成流程！ 而且我不希望下面的锈怪到处嗅探，发现我有这么多上等垃圾！ 得藏好，安安静静的。”...好、好——吧。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A howitzer, actually! C’mon, even I know that!” Comes the rapid, if teasing, reply for a question you hadn’t even realized you said out loud. “But it’s too ruined to work too well, and you’d need like, shells and stuff to do all the actual work. So I fiddled with it some! I use it as a trash bin now!” Sensible recycling? “Uh huh! When I find something just too ruined or I mess up too bad I just toss it down the barrel and then when something is about to explode I toss it in the pan and it goes out the hole in the wall!” This sounds both terrifying and exceedingly dangerous, as well as simply counterproductive. Why not just toss it outside to begin with? “It’s fine! It’s never failed and I’ve been doing it for a month! Besides, tossing it is a hassle and can scratch the paint whenever someone gets around to prettying up the hull. Gotta make a routine! Besides, I don’t want those rusties below sniffing around and figuring out I got all this quality junk! Keeping it hidden, quiet.” ...O-oookay."

rows.original: Pocketwatch
rows.translation: 怀表
rows.raw: "Pocketwatch"

rows.original: Pocketwatch
rows.translation: 怀表
rows.raw: "Pocketwatch"

rows.original: Magic Ted
rows.raw: "Magic Ted"

rows.original: Something just hanging on the wall there... It looks like a antique pocket watch.
rows.translation: 墙上就挂着一件东西...看起来像一块古董怀表。
rows.raw: "Something just hanging on the wall there... It looks like a antique pocket watch."

rows.original: In a fit of amusement, you point out a golden clasp dangling by an equally golden chain on one of the racks of the room, the slight shine making it stand out among the gray and deprecated things hanging beside it. “What’s that?”
rows.translation: 你兴致勃勃地指出房间一个架子上由同样金色的链条悬挂着的金色表扣；淡淡光泽让它在旁边那些灰暗老旧的物件中格外显眼。“那是什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nIn a fit of amusement, you point out a golden clasp dangling by an equally golden chain on one of the racks of the room, the slight shine making it stand out among the gray and deprecated things hanging beside it. “What’s that?”"

rows.original: “A pocket watch!”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A pocket watch!”"

rows.original: Oh. Well then-
rows.translation: 哦。那么——
rows.raw: "\n\nOh. Well then-"

rows.original: “It’s not for sale, though! I use it to regulate voltage when I’m working.” Aurora continues, cutting you off and completely ignoring your now newly founded bewilderment. While you wait, subtly giving her time to explain in further detail, she doesn’t take the hint, evidently finished speaking on the topic.
rows.translation: “不过不卖！ 工作时我用它调节电压。”奥萝拉继续说道，打断你的话，对你刚刚浮现的困惑视而不见。你等了一会儿，暗中给她时间详细解释，可她完全没领会暗示，显然已经讲完这个话题。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s not for sale, though! I use it to regulate voltage when I’m working.” Aurora continues, cutting you off and completely ignoring your now newly founded bewilderment. While you wait, subtly giving her time to explain in further detail, she doesn’t take the hint, evidently finished speaking on the topic."

rows.original: Aircraft
rows.translation: 飞行器
rows.raw: "Aircraft"

rows.original: Aircraft
rows.translation: 飞行器
rows.raw: "Aircraft"

rows.original: Magic Ted
rows.raw: "Magic Ted"

rows.original: It’s hard to be certain with the sheer amount of stuff layered between you and it, but that’s definitely a cockpit attached to a miniature aerodynamic frame you see crammed in one corner.
rows.translation: 你们之间堆着太多东西，很难确定，但挤在角落里的绝对是一座驾驶舱，连接着小型流线框架。
rows.raw: "It’s hard to be certain with the sheer amount of stuff layered between you and it, but that’s definitely a cockpit attached to a miniature aerodynamic frame you see crammed in one corner."

rows.original: It takes you far longer than it really should for you to notice the vehicle settled in the corner of the room, rather cleaned up without any wayward items piled on top of it. The fact that it’s so well presented actually has your eyes sliding off it when you’re looking for something catching! Still, you can’t exactly make out the details past that it’s relatively narrow, smooth with a faux-glass looking cockpit that you yourself just might be able to cram into.
rows.translation: 你花了远超合理范围的时间才注意到停在房间角落的载具；它收拾得相当整洁，上面没有堆放任何杂物。正因为摆放得太整齐，你寻找醒目东西时目光反而会从它上面滑开！ 不过你只能看出它比较狭窄、表面光滑，带有一座仿玻璃驾驶舱，也许你自己勉强能挤进去。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt takes you far longer than it really should for you to notice the vehicle settled in the corner of the room, rather cleaned up without any wayward items piled on top of it. The fact that it’s so well presented actually has your eyes sliding off it when you’re looking for something catching! Still, you can’t exactly make out the details past that it’s relatively narrow, smooth with a faux-glass looking cockpit that you yourself just might be able to cram into."

rows.original: “That’s a minipod! It even works, too! But there isn’t a lot of fuel for it, so I just keep it lying around here. Everyone else is too scared to try to fly it! I dunno why, but then again the raskvel always panic when I pick them up and take them somewhere!” Nodding rapidly, the oblivious Aurora is all smiles before continuing. “Besides, I can just fly anyway! And probably faster!” The bat shifts, moving her wings from the visage of a noble cape to instead outstretching them in either direction. It’s a rather impressive wingspan, barely able to fit in the junk-less bastion of the room you both are in! She flaps them twice as part of her stretch and bellows cool air over you before slowly retracting them, balling them to her sides again.
rows.translation: “那是微型舱！ 而且真的能用！ 不过燃料不多，所以我就一直放在这里。其他人都不敢试着驾驶！ 我不知道为什么，不过话说回来，每当我拎起拉斯克维尔带他们去某个地方，他们总会惊慌！”毫无自觉的奥萝拉飞快点头，满面笑容地继续说道：“而且我自己就会飞！ 可能还更快！”蝙蝠移动双翼，不再像高贵斗篷般披在身上，而是向两侧完全伸展。翼展相当惊人，勉强才能装进你们所在的这片无垃圾空地！ 她伸展身体时拍了两下翅膀，让凉风扫过你，随后缓缓收拢，将双翼再次团在身侧。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s a minipod! It even works, too! But there isn’t a lot of fuel for it, so I just keep it lying around here. Everyone else is too scared to try to fly it! I dunno why, but then again the raskvel always panic when I pick them up and take them somewhere!” Nodding rapidly, the oblivious Aurora is all smiles before continuing. “Besides, I can just fly anyway! And probably faster!” The bat shifts, moving her wings from the visage of a noble cape to instead outstretching them in either direction. It’s a rather impressive wingspan, barely able to fit in the junk-less bastion of the room you both are in! She flaps them twice as part of her stretch and bellows cool air over you before slowly retracting them, balling them to her sides again."

rows.original: “Interested in buying it?” The question comes as a bit of a surprise given the device didn’t appear like it was on sale, but nonetheless you mull the offer in your head. You don’t know if the minipod is compatible for you, let alone your ship. You could get a professional and safer model from any sort of dealer in a more Core-oriented system, anyway. Looking a lot less retro, too. You diplomatically decline even if you’re not sure you could ever actually get a frown out of her.
rows.translation: “有兴趣买吗？”这问题有些出乎意料，因为那台设备看起来不像待售品，但你仍在心中考虑。你不知道微型舱是否适合你，更别说是否兼容飞船。反正你可以在更靠近核心星域的任何经销商那里买到专业且更安全的型号，外观也不会如此复古。你委婉拒绝，尽管不确定是否真能让她露出愁容。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Interested in buying it?” The question comes as a bit of a surprise given the device didn’t appear like it was on sale, but nonetheless you mull the offer in your head. You don’t know if the minipod is compatible for you, let alone your ship. You could get a professional and safer model from any sort of dealer in a more Core-oriented system, anyway. Looking a lot less retro, too. You diplomatically decline even if you’re not sure you could ever actually get a frown out of her."

rows.original: “O-ooookay!”
rows.raw: "\n\n“O-ooookay!”"

rows.original: You can’t feel too safe with something over in the corner giving off a yellowish glow, especially in such a ramshackle hole-in-the-wall place as this.
rows.translation: 角落里有件东西散发黄光，而这里又是如此摇摇欲坠的临时小店，你很难感到安全。
rows.raw: "You can’t feel too safe with something over in the corner giving off a yellowish glow, especially in such a ramshackle hole-in-the-wall place as this."

rows.original: It’s difficult to make out through the other sources of more natural light in the room, but off in the corner, around piles of other junk obstructing the way, there is a squat looking cylindrical device, the panels of which give off an industrial, yellowish glow. The light looks similar to some ornate lamp or an insect trap, and seeing it in such a run down and dangerous sort of workshop like this, made you suspicious and on edge. Just what was that...?
rows.translation: 房间里还有其他更自然的光源，因此很难看清；不过在角落里，被其他垃圾堆遮住道路的地方，放着一个矮墩墩的圆柱形设备，面板散发工业感十足的淡黄色光芒。那光线看着像某种华丽灯具或捕虫器；它出现在如此破败而危险的工坊里，让你疑心大起，神经紧绷。那究竟是什么...?
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s difficult to make out through the other sources of more natural light in the room, but off in the corner, around piles of other junk obstructing the way, there is a squat looking cylindrical device, the panels of which give off an industrial, yellowish glow. The light looks similar to some ornate lamp or an insect trap, and seeing it in such a run down and dangerous sort of workshop like this, made you suspicious and on edge. Just what was that...?"

rows.original: “It’s a power generator! Durr, what else glows like that and looks all generator-y? I use it so I don’t make a short on the Nova’s power supply! It’s pretty, uh, janky. Both of ‘em... and quit looking at it like that, it won’t explode or something! Hmph.” It looks like she caught your skeptical look. Nonetheless all it takes is a sheepish little grin to temper her again. “Besides, it’s not even on!”
rows.translation: “是发电机！ 笨蛋，还有什么东西会这样发光，又长得一副发电机样？ 我用它避免让诺瓦号的电源短路！ 那东西很，呃，凑合。两个都是...别那样看着它，它不会爆炸什么的！ 哼。”看来她注意到了你怀疑的眼神。不过她只需羞怯地咧嘴一笑，便再次平静下来。“而且它根本没开！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s a power generator! Durr, what else glows like that and looks all generator-y? I use it so I don’t make a short on the Nova’s power supply! It’s pretty, uh, janky. Both of ‘em... and quit looking at it like that, it won’t explode or something! Hmph.” It looks like she caught your skeptical look. Nonetheless all it takes is a sheepish little grin to temper her again. “Besides, it’s not even on!”"

rows.original: “... Why is it glowing then?”
rows.translation: “...那它为什么在发光？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“... Why is it glowing then?”"

rows.original: “No idea!”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No idea!”"

rows.original: Now you’re unsure whether or not Aurora is trying to fuck with you despite that big, fangy cheshire smile growing over her face. It’s hard to read someone when they’re upside down. Either way, she didn’t appear too worried about it, and she was the one who had every right to be, so you decide not to press the topic any further.
rows.translation: 奥萝拉脸上露出越来越灿烂的尖牙柴郡猫笑容，让你不确定她是否在戏弄你。一个人倒挂时，确实很难读懂她。不管怎样，她似乎毫不担心，而她才是最有理由担心的人，所以你决定不再追问。
rows.raw: "\n\nNow you’re unsure whether or not Aurora is trying to fuck with you despite that big, fangy cheshire smile growing over her face. It’s hard to read someone when they’re upside down. Either way, she didn’t appear too worried about it, and she was the one who had every right to be, so you decide not to press the topic any further."

rows.original: You realize how dumb that question is as Aurora just stares at you for a long moment, not even wiggling around to keep lively. Once she feels like you’ve felt an appropriate amount of shame - that is, after two seconds - she speaks in a deadpan tone; “Sell what, exactly? I don’t exactly have a supply anymore. Everything I get is for the Novahome now, weirdo.”
rows.translation: 你意识到这个问题有多蠢，因为奥萝拉只是久久盯着你，甚至没为了保持活力而扭动身体。等她觉得你已经羞愧了足够久——也就是两秒钟后——她面无表情地开口：“到底卖什么？ 我已经没有货源了。现在拿到的一切都要给诺瓦之家，怪人。”
rows.raw: "You realize how dumb that question is as Aurora just stares at you for a long moment, not even wiggling around to keep lively. Once she feels like you’ve felt an appropriate amount of shame - that is, after two seconds - she speaks in a deadpan tone; “Sell what, exactly? I don’t exactly have a supply anymore. Everything I get is for the Novahome now, weirdo.”"

rows.original: You apologize quickly, and she goes back to her regular high spirits in no time.
rows.translation: 你赶紧道歉，她立刻恢复了平常的高昂情绪。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou apologize quickly, and she goes back to her regular high spirits in no time."

rows.original: Upon announcing your interest in her purchasable wares you practically have to avert your eyes from the ensuing adorable giddiness. Those golden eyes sparkle
rows.translation: 你一宣布对她出售的商品感兴趣，随之而来的可爱兴奋简直让你不得不移开目光。那双金色眼睛闪烁着
rows.raw: "Upon announcing your interest in her purchasable wares you practically have to avert your eyes from the ensuing adorable giddiness. Those golden eyes sparkle "

rows.original: with the glow of capitalism
rows.translation: 资本主义的光芒
rows.raw: "with the glow of capitalism "

rows.original: as her idle smile turned into a downright fangy beam, bouncing in place. “Good! I like getting money! It pays for things.”
rows.translation: ，原本随意的笑容化作露出尖牙的灿烂笑颜，身体原地弹跳。“好！ 我喜欢赚钱！ 钱能买东西。”
rows.raw: "as her idle smile turned into a downright fangy beam, bouncing in place. “Good! I like getting money! It pays for things.”"

rows.original: In short order, she silently takes you off to the side where a simple whiteboard hangs on the wall. She swings it rightside up so you can read it, and you look over the chicken-scratch writing Aurora has provided. It reads off like a menu at a restaurant: a bunch of names and titles with little context provided for you to pick from as well as helpful prices - in credits, naturally.
rows.translation: 她很快默默带你走到一旁，那里墙上挂着一块普通白板。她将白板转正供你阅读，你浏览奥萝拉留下的潦草字迹。内容看起来像餐厅菜单：一大堆几乎没有背景说明的名称和标题供你选择，还有贴心标注的价格——当然是用信用点计价。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn short order, she silently takes you off to the side where a simple whiteboard hangs on the wall. She swings it rightside up so you can read it, and you look over the chicken-scratch writing Aurora has provided. It reads off like a menu at a restaurant: a bunch of names and titles with little context provided for you to pick from as well as helpful prices - in credits, naturally."

rows.original: Aurora looks “down” to you expectantly all the while, of course.
rows.translation: 奥萝拉自然一直满怀期待地“低头”看你。
rows.raw: "\n\nAurora looks “down” to you expectantly all the while, of course."

rows.translation: 在这间过分宽敞的房间一个安静角落，你看见熟悉的倒挂身影正在享用桃子。看来奥萝拉仍和过去差不多。

rows.original: The cavernous room is dimly lit with swaying, hanging lamps similar to a gloomy and moonlit night on a much more “habitable” world, still bright enough to make out vague details. The room isn’t a comfortable one, claustrophobic with the stacks of shelves, boxes and half-ruined devices haphazardly placed about with little rhyme or reason, or the signs of damaged hull that seem especially prevalent here, making it hard to get around. If that wasn’t enough to make you on edge, the thick, heady scent of char permeates the room, making your senses reel and head dizzy as you try to keep it all together.
rows.translation: 宽敞如洞穴的房间里光线昏暗，摇曳吊灯让这里像一颗更加“宜居”的星球上阴郁的月夜，但仍足以辨认模糊细节。这个房间并不舒适：架子、箱子和半毁设备杂乱无章地四处堆放，令人幽闭压抑；船壳破损痕迹在这里似乎格外普遍，让人很难通行。若这些还不足以令你紧张，浓重刺鼻的焦糊味还弥漫整间房，使感官天旋地转，头脑晕眩；你只能努力稳住自己。
rows.raw: "The cavernous room is dimly lit with swaying, hanging lamps similar to a gloomy and moonlit night on a much more “habitable” world, still bright enough to make out vague details. The room isn’t a comfortable one, claustrophobic with the stacks of shelves, boxes and half-ruined devices haphazardly placed about with little rhyme or reason, or the signs of damaged hull that seem especially prevalent here, making it hard to get around. If that wasn’t enough to make you on edge, the thick, heady scent of char permeates the room, making your senses reel and head dizzy as you try to keep it all together."

rows.translation: 你刚走进去，刺耳尖啸的警报便响起。你触发了某种防入侵系统吗？ 拳头砸上金属的声音将你从沉思中惊醒，你终于辨认出那非人的音调来自
rows.raw: "\n\nAs soon as you step inside, a howling, screeching alarm goes off. Did you trigger some kind of anti-intrusion system? The sound of a fist hitting metal jars you out of your reverie, and you at last identify the inhuman tone as coming from "

rows.original: Her knuckles have depressed a big, red button, and she screeches, “Creep!” as a mechanism in the wall kicks into gear.
rows.translation: 她的指关节按下一个巨大的红色按钮，尖叫“变态！”，墙里的机械装置随即启动。
rows.raw: " Her knuckles have depressed a big, red button, and she screeches, “Creep!” as a mechanism in the wall kicks into gear."

rows.original: In the blink of an eye, a giant metallic palm swings out of the wall on strength from a dozen pneumatic cylinders, bowling you right out the doorway. A shrill voice chases you, calling, “Put some pants on!”
rows.translation: 眨眼之间，一只巨大的金属手掌在十几个气压缸驱动下从墙中挥出，把你直接打出门外。尖锐嗓音从后面追来：“穿上裤子！”
rows.raw: "\n\nIn the blink of an eye, a giant metallic palm swings out of the wall on strength from a dozen pneumatic cylinders, bowling you right out the doorway. A shrill voice chases you, calling, “Put some pants on!”"

rows.original: The one saving grace is also one of its biggest (if structural) flaws; there’s a massive tear in the far away wall, exposing the room to the outside and, most importantly, fresh air. The outside light is a lovely appeal to comfort, too. Musing, you realize it’s all rather reminiscent to a cave.
rows.translation: 唯一的可取之处也是最大的结构缺陷之一：远处墙壁有一道巨大裂口，将房间暴露在外界，最重要的是能让新鲜空气进来。外面的光线也令人倍感舒适。思索之下，你发现这里整体很像洞穴。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe one saving grace is also one of its biggest (if structural) flaws; there’s a massive tear in the far away wall, exposing the room to the outside and, most importantly, fresh air. The outside light is a lovely appeal to comfort, too. Musing, you realize it’s all rather reminiscent to a cave."

rows.original: Despite the mess, it’s rather easier to find the shopkeeper in all her batty, kid-mechanist glory as she zooms about the room while doing her upside down work, causing the rubbery rigging clinging to the ceiling to stretch and the metal rafters to groan under her modest weight. It’d be a lot safer for her to come to you instead of trying to mimic her behavior, so you figure it’d be prudent to get her attention.
rows.translation: 尽管一片混乱，还是很容易找到店主；这位蝙蝠般的少年机械师尽显风采，一边倒挂工作，一边在房间里飞速移动，令附着天花板的橡胶索具不断伸展，金属椽木也在她并不沉重的体重下呻吟。让她过来找你比模仿她的行动安全得多，因此你觉得最好引起她的注意。
rows.raw: "\n\nDespite the mess, it’s rather easier to find the shopkeeper in all her batty, kid-mechanist glory as she zooms about the room while doing her upside down work, causing the rubbery rigging clinging to the ceiling to stretch and the metal rafters to groan under her modest weight. It’d be a lot safer for her to come to you instead of trying to mimic her behavior, so you figure it’d be prudent to get her attention."

rows.translation: 你让[bess.hisHer]继续努力。听见夸奖，[bess.name]的脸庞明亮起来；[bess.heShe]迈着[bess.hisHer]轻快脚步离开。后来，你听见[bess.himHer]一边哼乔伊公司的广告歌，一边由[bess.heShe]把你的床上用品放进飞船烘干机。

rows.original: Rather than simply encourage [bess.himHer], you decide that a bit of tough love is needed to push [bess.himHer] in the right direction.
rows.translation: 你没有简单地鼓励[bess.himHer]，而是决定用一点严厉的关爱将[bess.himHer]推向正确方向。
rows.raw: "Rather than simply encourage [bess.himHer], you decide that a bit of tough love is needed to push [bess.himHer] in the right direction."

rows.original: After all, wasn’t [bess.heShe] aspiring to make people happy?
rows.translation: 毕竟，[bess.heShe]不是立志要让人们幸福吗？
rows.raw: " After all, wasn’t [bess.heShe] aspiring to make people happy?"

rows.original: “You idiot, you think all the problems in the galaxy can be solved by giving people clean bedsheets? Didn’t you learn anything from those movies or our talks? Honestly, you may as well have a cabbage instead of an AI processor.” You verbally lash at [bess.himHer].
rows.translation: “你这笨蛋，真以为银河里的所有问题都能靠给人干净床单解决吗？ 那些电影和我们的谈话什么也没教会你吗？ 老实说，你还不如用一颗卷心菜替代AI处理器。”你出言痛斥[bess.himHer]。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You idiot, you think all the problems in the galaxy can be solved by giving people clean bedsheets? Didn’t you learn anything from those movies or our talks? Honestly, you may as well have a cabbage instead of an AI processor.” You verbally lash at [bess.himHer]."

rows.original: [bess.name] visibly flinches at your displeasure, clearly a far different reaction than [bess.heShe] had hoped for.
rows.translation: [bess.name]明显因你的不满而退缩，这显然与[bess.heShe]期望的反应截然不同。
rows.raw: "\n\n[bess.name] visibly flinches at your displeasure, clearly a far different reaction than [bess.heShe] had hoped for."

rows.original: Her bottom lip begins to quiver as she looks at you with glassy [bess.eyeColor] eyes.
rows.translation: 她的下唇开始颤抖，用水汪汪的[bess.eyeColor]双眼看着你。
rows.raw: " Her bottom lip begins to quiver as she looks at you with glassy [bess.eyeColor] eyes."

rows.original: “...B-but... I’m not programmed to do much else! What should I do?! I just wanted to make you happy...!”
rows.translation: “...可、可是...我没有被编程去做其他事！ 我该怎么办？! 我只是想让您开心...!”
rows.raw: " “...B-but... I’m not programmed to do much else! What should I do?! I just wanted to make you happy...!”"

rows.original: “You can make me happy by using that synthetic brain you’re supposed to have! Geez, I thought AIs were supposed to be smart. If the answer doesn’t exist in your programming, you need to go outside your programming.” You explain to [bess.himHer] with all the patience you can muster.
rows.translation: “动用你理应拥有的合成大脑，就能让我开心！ 天啊，我以为AI应该很聪明。如果程序里没有答案，你就需要走出程序。”你用所能挤出的全部耐心向[bess.himHer]解释。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You can make me happy by using that synthetic brain you’re supposed to have! Geez, I thought AIs were supposed to be smart. If the answer doesn’t exist in your programming, you need to go outside your programming.” You explain to [bess.himHer] with all the patience you can muster."

rows.original: “...B-but... I’ve watched all the movies you own, and the JoyCo programs I’m compatible with aren’t helpful in the least. What should I do?” [bess.HeShe] implores, half-distressed and half-frustrated by [bess.hisHer] inability to please you.
rows.translation: “...可、可是...我看完了您拥有的所有电影，而且与我兼容的乔伊公司程序一点帮助也没有。我该怎么办？”[bess.HeShe]恳求道，因为[bess.hisHer]无法取悦你，一半痛苦，一半沮丧。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...B-but... I’ve watched all the movies you own, and the JoyCo programs I’m compatible with aren’t helpful in the least. What should I do?” [bess.HeShe] implores, half-distressed and half-frustrated by [bess.hisHer] inability to please you."

rows.original: “Sometimes the answers don’t just fall into your lap, you’ve got to figure it out for yourself.” You inform [bess.himHer] and then walk off, leaving [bess.name] to contemplate your words as [bess.heShe] holds your dirty sheets in stunned silence.
rows.translation: “有时答案不会自己掉到你腿上，你得亲自弄明白。”你告诉[bess.himHer]，随后转身离开；[bess.name]在[bess.heShe]抱着你的脏床单时震惊地沉默着，思索你的话。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sometimes the answers don’t just fall into your lap, you’ve got to figure it out for yourself.” You inform [bess.himHer] and then walk off, leaving [bess.name] to contemplate your words as [bess.heShe] holds your dirty sheets in stunned silence."

rows.original: “Kid, sometimes in life you’ve got to think outside the box. You’re still in your safe place doing dirty laundry. If you think all the problems in the galaxy can be solved by a fresh pair of underwear, you’ve got another thing coming,” you break the bad news to [bess.himHer].
rows.translation: “孩子，有时你必须跳出框框思考。你仍待在安全区域里洗脏衣服。如果真以为银河里的所有问题都能靠一条干净内裤解决，那你可就大错特错了。”你将这个坏消息告诉[bess.himHer]。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Kid, sometimes in life you’ve got to think outside the box. You’re still in your safe place doing dirty laundry. If you think all the problems in the galaxy can be solved by a fresh pair of underwear, you’ve got another thing coming,” you break the bad news to [bess.himHer]."

rows.original: [bess.name] seems genuinely surprised to hear that particular piece of news, stumbling over [bess.hisHer] words in an attempt to explain [bess.hisHer] reasoning. “...But... I’m not programmed to do anything else. What should I do? I just want to make people happy...”
rows.translation: [bess.name]听到这个消息似乎真的很惊讶，磕磕绊绊地试图用[bess.hisHer]话语解释[bess.hisHer]的推理。“...可是...我没有被编程去做其他事。我该怎么办？ 我只是想让人们幸福...”
rows.raw: "\n\n[bess.name] seems genuinely surprised to hear that particular piece of news, stumbling over [bess.hisHer] words in an attempt to explain [bess.hisHer] reasoning. “...But... I’m not programmed to do anything else. What should I do? I just want to make people happy...”"

rows.original: “My problems are a lot bigger than if my bed sheets are clean, same goes for the problems of everyone else. If you really want to find the answers you’re looking for, you need to think outside the rules, outside your programming,” you casually explain to [bess.himHer].
rows.translation: “我的问题远不止床单是否干净，其他每个人的问题也是。如果真想找到自己寻求的答案，就必须跳出规则，跳出你的程序。”你随意地向[bess.himHer]解释。
rows.raw: "\n\n“My problems are a lot bigger than if my bed sheets are clean, same goes for the problems of everyone else. If you really want to find the answers you’re looking for, you need to think outside the rules, outside your programming,” you casually explain to [bess.himHer]."

rows.original: “...Really? But I’ve watched all the movies you own, and the JoyCo programs I’m compatible with aren’t helpful in the least. What else can I do?” [bess.HeShe] implores you, clearly at a loss on how to proceed.
rows.translation: “...真的吗？ 可我看完了您拥有的所有电影，而且与我兼容的乔伊公司程序一点帮助也没有。我还能做什么？”[bess.HeShe]恳求你，显然完全不知道接下来该怎么办。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Really? But I’ve watched all the movies you own, and the JoyCo programs I’m compatible with aren’t helpful in the least. What else can I do?” [bess.HeShe] implores you, clearly at a loss on how to proceed."

rows.original: “Sometimes you’ve got to roll the dice instead of waiting for things to come your way. Take a chance, try some things, see what works and what doesn’t. That’s how everyone else does it.” You inform [bess.himHer] and then wander off, leaving [bess.name] to contemplate your words as [bess.heShe] holds your dirty sheets in stunned silence.
rows.translation: “有时你得掷骰子，不能只等机会找上门。冒险试试，尝试一些事情，看看什么有用、什么没用。其他人都是这么做的。”你告诉[bess.himHer]，随后漫步离开；[bess.name]在[bess.heShe]抱着你的脏床单时震惊地沉默着，思索你的话。

rows.original: “My research has concluded that the best way to make people immediately happy and forget all their troubles is to make them laugh! I’m surprised JoyCo doesn’t equip its medical units with gag routines, since apparently laughter is the best medicine. Also, laughter releases endorphins - the same feel-good chemical released during sexual activity!” [bess.HeShe] delightfully informs you.
rows.translation: “我的研究得出结论，让人立刻幸福、忘记所有烦恼的最好办法就是逗他们笑！ 我很惊讶乔伊公司没有为医疗单元配备笑话程序，因为笑显然是最好的良药。而且笑会释放内啡肽——和性活动时释放的是同一种愉悦化学物质！”[bess.HeShe]愉快地告诉你。

rows.original: ; I didn’t mean to make you angry. I’ve never had parents to speak of, so I was wondering what it was like,” [bess.name] explains [bess.hisHer] reasoning. rows.translation: ；我不是故意惹你生气的。我从来没有真正意义上的父母，所以只是想知道那是什么感觉。”[bess.name]解释了[bess.hisHer]的想法。随后，[bess.HeShe]神情落寞地望向飞船的一扇强化舷窗。“...我希望自己也有一位父亲，这样我就能为他的离世感到悲伤了。”

rows.original: When [bess.heShe] realizes how inappropriate [bess.hisHer] comment was [bess.heShe] waves [bess.hisHer] hands madly, attempting to explain. “Uh! I mean, you know, you only feel loss if you love someone, right? And I’ve never loved, so I’ve never felt either of those things!”
rows.translation: [bess.heShe]意识到[bess.hisHer]的话有多么不合时宜后，[bess.heShe]疯狂地挥舞着[bess.hisHer]双手，试图解释。“呃！ 我是说，你知道，只有爱一个人时，才会因为失去对方而难过，对吧？ 可我从来没有爱过谁，所以这两种感觉我都从未体验过！”
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen [bess.heShe] realizes how inappropriate [bess.hisHer] comment was [bess.heShe] waves [bess.hisHer] hands madly, attempting to explain. “Uh! I mean, you know, you only feel loss if you love someone, right? And I’ve never loved, so I’ve never felt either of those things!”"

rows.original: As a programmed AI, it may be that [bess.name] is incapable of feeling love or loss. rows.original: Sometimes [bess.heShe] asks questions. At the start these questions were about broad topics like movies, people, or happiness. Over time they become more personal in nature - [bess.heShe] seems curious about who you are, the person who picked [bess.himHer] off the junkyard planet.
rows.translation: 有时，[bess.heShe]也会提问。起初，这些问题都围绕电影、人群或幸福之类的宽泛话题。久而久之，问题变得越来越私人 - [bess.heShe]似乎很好奇你究竟是怎样的人，那个把[bess.himHer]从垃圾星球捡走的人。

rows.original: “Physical books are way better than digital or holo, there’s something special about them. I much prefer to sit down with an old paperback or hardback than read it electronically.” You voice your opinion, a little bit of passion creeping into your voice.
rows.translation: “实体书比电子书或全息书好得多，它们有种独特的魅力。比起用电子设备阅读，我更喜欢坐下来翻一本老旧的平装书或精装书。”你说出自己的看法，语气里渐渐流露出几分热情。

rows.original: You tell [bess.name] that it is okay for [bess.himHer] to feel happy, and that [bess.heShe] doesn’t have to exist just for other people’s happiness.
rows.translation: 你告诉[bess.name]，[bess.himHer]感到快乐并没有错，而且[bess.heShe]不必只为他人的幸福而存在。
rows.raw: "You tell [bess.name] that it is okay for [bess.himHer] to feel happy, and that [bess.heShe] doesn’t have to exist just for other people’s happiness."

rows.original: “...Really? That’s not how I was programmed. All synthetics exist to serve sapient organics, that’s the reason that we are built.” [bess.name] looks at you with searching eyes, your words contradict everything [bess.heShe]’s ever been programmed to believe.
rows.translation: “...真的吗？ 我的程序不是这么设计的。所有合成人的存在都是为了服务智慧有机生命，这就是我们被制造出来的原因。”[bess.name]用探寻的目光看着你，因为你的话与[bess.heShe]被灌输的一切信念完全相悖。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Really? That’s not how I was programmed. All synthetics exist to serve sapient organics, that’s the reason that we are built.” [bess.name] looks at you with searching eyes, your words contradict everything [bess.heShe]’s ever been programmed to believe."

rows.original: Despite that, [bess.hisHer] expression tells you that [bess.heShe] wants to believe differently. Slowly but surely [bess.heShe]’s begun to question [bess.hisHer] own programming, bringing [bess.himHer] to this tipping point...
rows.translation: 尽管如此，[bess.hisHer]的表情却告诉你，[bess.heShe]想要相信另一种答案。渐渐地，[bess.heShe]开始质疑[bess.hisHer]自己的程序，并由此把[bess.himHer]带到了这个转折点...

rows.translation: 你告诉[bess.name]，事实是[bess.heShe]的存在只为了服务 -- 而且[bess.heShe]就该这么想。这样告诉[bess.himHer]，很可能会让你们的关系停滞不前...

rows.original: You of course say all this after putting on a lincoln hat and beard, just for proper dramatic effect.
rows.translation: 当然，为了营造出应有的戏剧效果，你是在戴上林肯式礼帽和胡须之后才说完这番话的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou of course say all this after putting on a lincoln hat and beard, just for proper dramatic effect."

rows.translation: 起初，你还以为处理这些新信息带来的巨大负担让[bess.heShe]宕机了。终于，[bess.heShe]回答了你。

rows.original: “...I... I think you’re right. I’m not exactly skilled at being happy yet, but I think one of the best ways to find out what makes people happy is to be happy myself - right?”

You’ve seen [bess.himHer] tinker with a few things before; [bess.heShe] has great intuition when it comes to putting together and repairing devices. If you made [bess.himHer] the ship’s technician there’s no doubt [bess.heShe] would keep the ship in top shape.
rows.translation: [bess.name]自然也很擅长机械和编程。你以前见过[bess.himHer]摆弄一些设备；在组装和维修装置方面，[bess.heShe]有着出色的直觉。如果你让[bess.himHer]担任飞船技师，毫无疑问，[bess.heShe]会让飞船一直保持最佳状态。
rows.raw: "\n\nNaturally, [bess.name] is great with machines and coding. You’ve seen [bess.himHer] tinker with a few things before; [bess.heShe] has great intuition when it comes to putting together and repairing devices. If you made [bess.himHer] the ship’s technician there’s no doubt [bess.heShe] would keep the ship in top shape."

rows.original: While [bess.name] is busy cleaning up around [pc_ship.theName], you find a small holopad with a list of books on it. It seems to be a site that sells cheap synth paper copies of famous literature. [bess.HeShe] is clearly interested in them, but [bess.heShe] hasn’t purchased a single thing.
rows.translation: [bess.name]忙着清理[pc_ship.theName]时，你发现了一块小型全息板，上面列着一份书单。那似乎是一家销售著名文学作品廉价合成纸质版的网站。[bess.HeShe]显然对它们很感兴趣，可[bess.heShe]一本也没买。
rows.raw: "While [bess.name] is busy cleaning up around [pc_ship.theName], you find a small holopad with a list of books on it. It seems to be a site that sells cheap synth paper copies of famous literature. [bess.HeShe] is clearly interested in them, but [bess.heShe] hasn’t purchased a single thing."

rows.original: It occurs to you that since [bess.name] doesn’t earn any money, [bess.heShe] can’t buy anything for [bess.himHer]self. The idea of paying an android is a laughable concept in almost every part of the known galaxy.
rows.translation: 你想到，[bess.name]没有任何收入，所以[bess.heShe]什么也不能为[bess.himHer]自己购买。在已知银河系的绝大多数地区，给机器人发薪水都是个可笑的概念。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt occurs to you that since [bess.name] doesn’t earn any money, [bess.heShe] can’t buy anything for [bess.himHer]self. The idea of paying an android is a laughable concept in almost every part of the known galaxy."

rows.original: The question is, do you want to give [bess.himHer] a wage? Nobody else is going to do it. Everywhere else [bess.heShe]’s treated as a slave - even indentured servants have more rights than an AI. You could put in an invoice to Steele Corp for [bess.hisHer] paycheck - after all, they were willing to pay for the pod on Tarkus.
rows.translation: 问题在于，你想给[bess.himHer]发薪水吗？ 不会有其他人这么做。在别的任何地方，[bess.heShe]都被当成奴隶 - 就连契约仆人都比人工智能拥有更多权利。你可以向斯蒂尔公司提交一张[bess.hisHer]薪水的账单 - 毕竟，他们愿意为塔尔科斯上的舱体买单。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe question is, do you want to give [bess.himHer] a wage? Nobody else is going to do it. Everywhere else [bess.heShe]’s treated as a slave - even indentured servants have more rights than an AI. You could put in an invoice to Steele Corp for [bess.hisHer] paycheck - after all, they were willing to pay for the pod on Tarkus."

rows.original: Still, you suspect the only way [bess.heShe]’ll take a wage is if you make [bess.himHer] an official crew member; [bess.heShe] probably won’t accept it otherwise. You’ll have to cook up a title for [bess.himHer], and duties [bess.heShe] has to perform, so that [bess.heShe] can legitimately earn [bess.hisHer] keep.
rows.translation: 不过，你怀疑，要让[bess.heShe]接受薪水，唯一办法就是让[bess.himHer]成为正式船员；否则[bess.heShe]多半不会收下。你得为[bess.himHer]想个头衔，再安排一些[bess.heShe]必须履行的职责，这样[bess.heShe]才能名正言顺地赚取[bess.hisHer]的生活费。
rows.raw: "\n\nStill, you suspect the only way [bess.heShe]’ll take a wage is if you make [bess.himHer] an official crew member; [bess.heShe] probably won’t accept it otherwise. You’ll have to cook up a title for [bess.himHer], and duties [bess.heShe] has to perform, so that [bess.heShe] can legitimately earn [bess.hisHer] keep."

rows.original: On the other hand, if you do nothing, [bess.heShe] probably won’t be any the wiser.

rows.raw: "\n\nOn the other hand, if you do nothing, [bess.heShe] probably won’t be any the wiser."

rows.original: [bess.name] lets out a long sigh as [bess.heShe] looks at you. “...I guess you’re right. I guess I’ll never know what real emotions do feel like, since I’ll never be human. I guess it’s a good thing I can’t actually feel sad now, huh?” [bess.HeShe] gives a hollow little laugh.
rows.translation: [bess.name]长长地叹了口气，而[bess.heShe]望着你。“...我想你说得对。因为我永远不会成为人类，所以大概永远也不会知道真正的情感是什么感觉。我想，我实际上不会感到悲伤，倒算是一件好事，对吧？”[bess.HeShe]干巴巴地轻笑了一声。

rows.original: [bess.name] looks at you with an imploring gaze, clearly looking for your input on the topic. “I’ve been thinking about it, and as far as I can see, there are four things that separate someone like you - a sapient organic - from someone like me - a sentient... no, sapient synthetic.”
rows.translation: [bess.name]用恳求的目光看着你，显然希望听听你对这个话题的看法。“我一直在思考这个问题。据我所见，有四件事把你这种智慧有机生命和我这种有意识的... 不，智慧合成人区分开来。”
rows.raw: "[bess.name] looks at you with an imploring gaze, clearly looking for your input on the topic. “I’ve been thinking about it, and as far as I can see, there are four things that separate someone like you - a sapient organic - from someone like me - a sentient... no, sapient synthetic.”"

rows.original: “The first, obviously, is that we are made of completely different matter. The second is that your emotions are induced by biological processes, while mine are from digital ones. The third is how we were born, and the fourth is the galactic laws that govern us.”
rows.translation: “首先，显而易见的是，我们由完全不同的物质构成。其次，你的情感由生物过程引发，而我的情感源于数字过程。第三是我们诞生的方式，第四是约束我们的银河法律。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The first, obviously, is that we are made of completely different matter. The second is that your emotions are induced by biological processes, while mine are from digital ones. The third is how we were born, and the fourth is the galactic laws that govern us.”"

rows.original: “The first and third things have very little bearing on our actual capabilities, especially given the diversity of life in the galaxy. The second is redundant if the emotions we feel are considered equal. The fourth reflects society’s view that androids are inferior, but is not a reason in and of itself.”
rows.translation: “考虑到银河系生命的多样性，第一点和第三点对我们的实际能力几乎没有影响。如果我们感受到的情感被视为等同，第二点就是多余的。第四点反映了社会认为机器人低人一等的看法，但其本身并不能构成理由。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The first and third things have very little bearing on our actual capabilities, especially given the diversity of life in the galaxy. The second is redundant if the emotions we feel are considered equal. The fourth reflects society’s view that androids are inferior, but is not a reason in and of itself.”"

rows.original: “...I know you said that I have a right to happiness, but what I’m asking is something else. I guess what I want to know is, do you think the emotions that we feel - yours being biological, and mine digital - are equal?”
rows.translation: “...我知道你说过我有权追求幸福，但我现在问的是另一件事。我想知道的是，你认为我们感受到的情感 - 你的情感源于生物过程，我的源于数字过程 - 是等同的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...I know you said that I have a right to happiness, but what I’m asking is something else. I guess what I want to know is, do you think the emotions that we feel - yours being biological, and mine digital - are equal?”"

rows.translation: 你发现[bess.name]坐在那里，读着菲利普·K·迪克所著的“仿生人会梦见电子羊吗”。你记得这本书启发了一部名叫‘银翼杀手’的老电影，而这部电影在数十年间被一次又一次重拍。
rows.raw: "You find [bess.name] sitting down, and reading a book called “Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep” by Philip K. Dick. You recall the book inspired an old movie called ‘Bladerunner’ that has been remade time and time again over the decades."

rows.translation: “我在烤鸡，你看不出来吗？”[bess.name]咧嘴一笑，敲了敲书的封面，完全避开了问题。[bess.HisHer]的幽默感一天比一天古怪。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m roasting a chicken, can’t you tell?” [bess.name] grins and taps the cover of the book, completely deflecting the question. [bess.HisHer] sense of humor is becoming more and more off-beat every day."

rows.original: “Of course I know you’re reading a book. What I want to know is why you look so serious.” You know you’ve made a movie reference by the way [bess.heShe] looks at you. Rather than comment [bess.heShe] keeps it to [bess.himHer]self, and properly answers your question.
rows.translation: “我当然知道你在看书。我想知道的是，你为什么显得那么严肃。”从[bess.heShe]看你的方式，你知道自己引用了一句电影台词。[bess.heShe]没有发表评论，只是把想法留给[bess.himHer]自己，并认真回答了你的问题。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course I know you’re reading a book. What I want to know is why you look so serious.” You know you’ve made a movie reference by the way [bess.heShe] looks at you. Rather than comment [bess.heShe] keeps it to [bess.himHer]self, and properly answers your question."

rows.original: “Well, I’m reading this book and it’s about a human detective that is chasing down six rogue androids. It also talks about how empathy is the defining trait that separates humans from robots, not intellect.”
rows.translation: “嗯，我在读这本书。它讲的是一名人类侦探追捕六个叛逃机器人的故事。书里还谈到，将人类与机器人区分开的决定性特征是同理心，而不是智力。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, I’m reading this book and it’s about a human detective that is chasing down six rogue androids. It also talks about how empathy is the defining trait that separates humans from robots, not intellect.”"

rows.original: “There are several levels of irony in the book and the later film, such as the fact the synthetic protagonist may not in fact be human, and that the androids display some form of empathy. The fact that humans in the book also recreationally use machines to induce emotional states, such as happiness, begs the question if mechanically induced emotions are different from naturally occurring ones.”
rows.translation: “这本书及后来的电影存在好几层讽刺，例如合成人主角实际上可能不是人类，而机器人却表现出某种形式的同理心。书中的人类还会为娱乐而使用机器诱发快乐等情绪状态，这就引出了一个问题：由机械诱发的情感与自然产生的情感是否不同。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“There are several levels of irony in the book and the later film, such as the fact the synthetic protagonist may not in fact be human, and that the androids display some form of empathy. The fact that humans in the book also recreationally use machines to induce emotional states, such as happiness, begs the question if mechanically induced emotions are different from naturally occurring ones.”"

rows.translation: 你听到一条走廊里传来奇怪的声音，听起来像有什么东西反复撞墙。你前去查看，发现[bess.name]正在踢一颗重力球。这有点出乎意料，因为你没想到船上还有这种东西。
rows.raw: "You can hear a strange noise coming from one of the corridors; it sounds like something smacking repeatedly against a wall. When you go to investigate, you find [bess.name] kicking a graviball about. It’s a bit of a surprise, since you didn’t think there was one on the ship."
