rows.original: Graviball is a massively popular sport in the galactic rim that is very similar to old Earth soccer mixed with volleyball. The main difference is the use of a zero-g or ‘z-g’ ball and pulse tech - namely boots and gloves - that allow you to fly and hit or catch the ball at incredible speeds. Since players are able to use both hands and feet to hit the ball as well as other players, it is a thoroughly rough contact sport.
rows.translation: 重力球是银河边缘地区极受欢迎的运动，非常像旧地球的足球与排球混合体。主要区别在于使用零重力球，也叫“零重球”，以及脉冲技术——主要是靴子和手套——让选手能飞行，并以惊人的速度击打或接住球。由于选手可以用手脚击球，也能撞击其他选手，这是一项极为激烈的身体对抗运动。
rows.raw: "\n\nGraviball is a massively popular sport in the galactic rim that is very similar to old Earth soccer mixed with volleyball. The main difference is the use of a zero-g or ‘z-g’ ball and pulse tech - namely boots and gloves - that allow you to fly and hit or catch the ball at incredible speeds. Since players are able to use both hands and feet to hit the ball as well as other players, it is a thoroughly rough contact sport."

rows.original: People love gambling on Graviball on the galactic rim. You hear there are shadier matches played on the fringe worlds where there are almost no rules and certain shock weapons are allowed.
rows.translation: 银河边缘的人们很喜欢拿重力球比赛赌博。你听说在一些边缘世界还有更见不得光的比赛，几乎没有规则，甚至允许使用某些电击武器。
rows.raw: "\n\nPeople love gambling on Graviball on the galactic rim. You hear there are shadier matches played on the fringe worlds where there are almost no rules and certain shock weapons are allowed."

rows.original: “Of course I’ve played Graviball - who do you take me for?” You scoff, you spent half your childhood playing every kind of sport the galaxy had to offer; mostly at your father’s insistence. “They used to call me the ‘Steele Hammer’ back home when I was playing in the junior leagues because I had a way of making that z-g ball crash down.”
rows.translation: “我当然玩过重力球——你把我当成谁了？”你嗤笑一声。童年时，在父亲的坚持下，你几乎玩遍了银河系能提供的所有运动。“我参加青少年联赛时，老家的人都叫我‘斯蒂尔重锤’，因为我总能把零重球狠狠砸下来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course I’ve played Graviball - who do you take me for?” You scoff, you spent half your childhood playing every kind of sport the galaxy had to offer; mostly at your father’s insistence. “They used to call me the ‘Steele Hammer’ back home when I was playing in the junior leagues because I had a way of making that z-g ball crash down.”"

rows.original: “O-hoh, so you’re a pro then? Guess you wouldn’t turn down a challenge from a synthetic newb like me, then?” [bess.name]’s [bess.eyeColor] eyes are alight with competitive spirit, as [bess.heShe] spins the gravity-defying ball on one finger.
rows.translation: “哦嚯，所以你是高手喽？那你肯定不会拒绝一个合成新手的挑战吧？”[bess.name]那双[bess.eyeColor]眼睛燃起竞争的光芒，[bess.heShe]让这颗反重力球在一根手指上旋转。
rows.raw: "\n\n“O-hoh, so you’re a pro then? Guess you wouldn’t turn down a challenge from a synthetic newb like me, then?” [bess.name]’s [bess.eyeColor] eyes are alight with competitive spirit, as [bess.heShe] spins the gravity-defying ball on one finger."

rows.original: “Well, I was a bit of an indoors sort. Partially because of my old man, but also because I genuinely love reading. I never really did play many sports growing up.” You reluctantly admit, looking at the z-g ball. What were the rules again?
rows.translation: “嗯，我以前比较宅。一部分是因为我家老头子，但也因为我真的喜欢读书。小时候我确实没怎么参加体育运动。”你不太情愿地承认，同时看着那颗零重球。规则是什么来着？
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, I was a bit of an indoors sort. Partially because of my old man, but also because I genuinely love reading. I never really did play many sports growing up.” You reluctantly admit, looking at the z-g ball. What were the rules again?"

rows.original: “That’s no good! I love books too, but you organic types have got to keep the blood pumping through your veins. Embrace the day, seize the moment, live life to the fullest!” [bess.name] sighs, obviously disappointed by your hermit-like attitude.
rows.translation: “那可不行！我也喜欢书，但你们这些有机生命必须让血液在血管里流动起来。拥抱今天，把握当下，尽情生活！”[bess.name]叹了口气，显然对你这种隐士般的态度感到失望。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s no good! I love books too, but you organic types have got to keep the blood pumping through your veins. Embrace the day, seize the moment, live life to the fullest!” [bess.name] sighs, obviously disappointed by your hermit-like attitude."

rows.original: “I had a pretty strict upbringing; I didn’t really get time to play sports. Even though my old man was rich, he made me earn my way from a young age - I never got any hand outs.” You tell [bess.name], realizing you’d never told [bess.himHer] how hard you had it growing up. As a Steele, most people automatically assumed you lived a pampered lifestyle from a young age.
rows.translation: “我小时候管得很严，根本没时间运动。虽然我家老头子很有钱，但他从小就让我靠自己争取——我从没拿过任何施舍。”你告诉[bess.name]，这才意识到自己从未告诉[bess.himHer]童年过得有多辛苦。身为斯蒂尔家的人，大多数人自然会以为你从小就过着养尊处优的生活。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I had a pretty strict upbringing; I didn’t really get time to play sports. Even though my old man was rich, he made me earn my way from a young age - I never got any hand outs.” You tell [bess.name], realizing you’d never told [bess.himHer] how hard you had it growing up. As a Steele, most people automatically assumed you lived a pampered lifestyle from a young age."

rows.original: The edge of [bess.name]’s eyes soften, then [bess.heShe] gets a little gleam in [bess.hisHer] eyes. “All work and no play? Now I know why your family are called Steeles. How about we recapture some of that lost childhood...?”
rows.translation: [bess.name]的眼神柔和下来，随后[bess.heShe]的[bess.hisHer]眼中又闪过一丝光芒。“只工作不玩耍？现在我明白你们家为什么姓斯蒂尔了。我们来找回一点失去的童年怎么样...？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe edge of [bess.name]’s eyes soften, then [bess.heShe] gets a little gleam in [bess.hisHer] eyes. “All work and no play? Now I know why your family are called Steeles. How about we recapture some of that lost childhood...?”"

rows.original: “Sure, I played a fair bit of Graviball, though mostly for social reasons. We had a field built into our space yacht; I’ve even played against a few celebrities.” You admit, realizing how pampered you sound right now. Your old man let you live in the lap of luxury growing up, which is probably why he’s making you earn your inheritance now with this galactic treasure hunt.
rows.translation: “当然，我经常玩重力球，不过主要是为了社交。我们的太空游艇里建了一座球场；我甚至和几个名人交过手。”你承认道，同时意识到自己现在听起来有多娇生惯养。你家老头子让你从小过着极尽奢华的生活，这大概也是他如今要你靠这场银河寻宝之旅赚取遗产的原因。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure, I played a fair bit of Graviball, though mostly for social reasons. We had a field built into our space yacht; I’ve even played against a few celebrities.” You admit, realizing how pampered you sound right now. Your old man let you live in the lap of luxury growing up, which is probably why he’s making you earn your inheritance now with this galactic treasure hunt."

rows.original: [bess.name] pouts a little bit, spinning the z-g ball on one finger. “...Well okay, this is no private yacht, and I’m no celebrity - just a bot with a ball. Anyway, the point is you know how to play!”
rows.translation: [bess.name]微微撅起嘴，让零重球在一根手指上旋转。“...好吧，这里不是什么私人游艇，我也不是什么名人——只是个拿着球的机器人。总之，重点是你知道怎么玩！”
rows.raw: "\n\n[bess.name] pouts a little bit, spinning the z-g ball on one finger. “...Well okay, this is no private yacht, and I’m no celebrity - just a bot with a ball. Anyway, the point is you know how to play!”"

rows.original: “I played it a bit at school - the old man was always making sure I tried everything at least once, so I had a balanced education.” You inform [bess.himHer], all the while eyeing off the way [bess.heShe]’s spinning the z-g ball on [bess.hisHer] index finger.
rows.translation: “我在学校玩过一点——我家老头子总要我什么都至少尝试一次，好让我接受全面的教育。”你告诉[bess.himHer]，同时一直盯着[bess.heShe]让零重球在[bess.hisHer]食指上旋转的样子。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I played it a bit at school - the old man was always making sure I tried everything at least once, so I had a balanced education.” You inform [bess.himHer], all the while eyeing off the way [bess.heShe]’s spinning the z-g ball on [bess.hisHer] index finger."

rows.translation: “你什么时候想在全息室打一场，就来找我。我会启动程序，然后我们就能痛痛快快踢几脚老零重球了。”

rows.original: You tell [bess.name] it’s really not your thing. [bess.HeShe] tries in vain to persuade you and you eventually leave. Unperturbed, [bess.heShe] sings karaoke on [bess.hisHer] own before mysteriously stopping.
rows.translation: 你告诉[bess.name]，这实在不是你的爱好。[bess.HeShe]徒劳地试图说服你，最后你还是离开了。[bess.heShe]并未气馁，独自用[bess.hisHer]的声音唱起卡拉OK，后来又莫名其妙地停了下来。
rows.raw: "You tell [bess.name] it’s really not your thing. [bess.HeShe] tries in vain to persuade you and you eventually leave. Unperturbed, [bess.heShe] sings karaoke on [bess.hisHer] own before mysteriously stopping."

rows.original: Later you find [bess.himHer] powered down on the sofa... surely the synthetic couldn’t have fallen asleep?
rows.translation: 之后，你发现[bess.himHer]关机躺在沙发上...这个合成人该不会睡着了吧？

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: You really have things to do, and you have no idea how long [bess.heShe]’s going to be like this. As you pull away, [bess.name] falls predictably sideways, ‘waking up’ with a sudden jolt. “Zzz-wha?! What’s going on...?”
rows.translation: 你真的有事要做，而且完全不知道[bess.heShe]还要保持这样多久。你刚抽身，[bess.name]果然就歪倒在一旁，猛地一颤，“醒”了过来。“呼噜——什？！发生什么了...？”
rows.raw: "You really have things to do, and you have no idea how long [bess.heShe]’s going to be like this. As you pull away, [bess.name] falls predictably sideways, ‘waking up’ with a sudden jolt. “Zzz-wha?! What’s going on...?”"

rows.original: You take off and leave [bess.himHer] to get re-oriented with a small chuckle. [bess.name] rubs [bess.hisHer] sleepy eyes before promptly curling up and going back to sleep.
rows.translation: 你轻笑着离开，让[bess.himHer]自己重新搞清楚状况。[bess.name]揉了揉[bess.hisHer]惺忪的双眼，很快又蜷起身子睡了过去。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take off and leave [bess.himHer] to get re-oriented with a small chuckle. [bess.name] rubs [bess.hisHer] sleepy eyes before promptly curling up and going back to sleep."

rows.translation: 你决定留在原处，以免挪动身体惊扰[bess.himHer]。
rows.raw: "Rather than move and disturb [bess.himHer], you decide to stay put."

rows.original: You can feel [bess.hisHer] soft synthetic hair brushing against your cheek.
rows.translation: 你能感觉到[bess.hisHer]柔软的合成发丝拂过你的脸颊。

rows.original: “Oh my circuits! I’m so sorry, I didn’t mean to fall asleep on you!” [bess.HisHer] silvery cheeks are flushed, and you can tell [bess.heShe]’s embarrassed. At the same time, [bess.heShe] does sound a little bit pleased.
rows.translation: “我的电路啊！对不起，我不是故意靠着你睡着的！”[bess.HisHer]银色的脸颊泛起红晕，你看得出[bess.heShe]很尴尬。与此同时，[bess.heShe]的声音里似乎又带着一丝喜悦。

rows.original: In radical contrast, your singing is not just bad; it’s apocalyptically awful. As you sing, you can see [bess.name] visibly cringe as [bess.heShe] tries to ignore your high pitched off-key wailing and awful timing. You’ve seen that look many a time - it’s the same way people looked at you slack jawed as you tortured birthday and holiday songs.
rows.translation: 相比之下，你的歌声已经不只是难听，而是灾难般的可怕。你唱歌时，能看到[bess.name]明显畏缩了一下，[bess.heShe]竭力无视你高亢跑调的哀号和糟糕节拍。这种表情你见过很多次——每当你摧残生日歌和节日歌曲时，人们都会目瞪口呆地这样看着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn radical contrast, your singing is not just bad; it’s apocalyptically awful. As you sing, you can see [bess.name] visibly cringe as [bess.heShe] tries to ignore your high pitched off-key wailing and awful timing. You’ve seen that look many a time - it’s the same way people looked at you slack jawed as you tortured birthday and holiday songs."

rows.original: You’re pretty sure [bess.name] turned off [bess.hisHer] audio receptors halfway through to protect [bess.hisHer] ear sensors because [bess.heShe]’s suddenly out of sync with the rhythm and [bess.hisHer] facial muscles slacken.
rows.translation: 你很确定，[bess.name]唱到一半关闭了[bess.hisHer]的音频接收器，以保护[bess.hisHer]的听觉传感器，因为[bess.heShe]突然跟不上节奏，[bess.hisHer]的面部肌肉也松弛下来。

rows.original: Once you finish the song, [bess.heShe] coughs a little, putting down the microphone. It’s clear [bess.heShe]’s trying to find the best way to broach the subject of your horrendous singing voice.
rows.translation: 歌曲结束后，[bess.heShe]轻咳一声，放下麦克风。显然，[bess.heShe]正在寻找最合适的方式，来提起你那惨不忍闻的歌声。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce you finish the song, [bess.heShe] coughs a little, putting down the microphone. It’s clear [bess.heShe]’s trying to find the best way to broach the subject of your horrendous singing voice."

rows.original: “...Well that was... um... unique.” [bess.name] tiptoes around the elephant in the room. “You know what? I’m thinking maybe there’s something wrong with your microphone. Let me take a look at it.”
rows.translation: “...嗯，刚才那真是...呃...独一无二。”[bess.name]小心翼翼地绕开房间里的大象。“你知道吗？我觉得你的麦克风可能出了问题。让我看看。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Well that was... um... unique.” [bess.name] tiptoes around the elephant in the room. “You know what? I’m thinking maybe there’s something wrong with your microphone. Let me take a look at it.”"

rows.original: Seemingly unable to logically process the sheer atrocity of your singing voice, [bess.heShe] examines your microphone. After a few moments, [bess.name] does what you least expect; [bess.heShe] hands you back the device.
rows.translation: [bess.heShe]似乎无法用逻辑理解你的歌声究竟能糟糕到何种地步，于是检查起你的麦克风。过了一会儿，[bess.name]做了你最意想不到的事；[bess.heShe]把设备还给了你。
rows.raw: "\n\nSeemingly unable to logically process the sheer atrocity of your singing voice, [bess.heShe] examines your microphone. After a few moments, [bess.name] does what you least expect; [bess.heShe] hands you back the device."

rows.original: In comparison, your singing is quite bad - but it’s karaoke, and the point isn’t whether you sound good or not. [bess.name] doesn’t seem to mind your off-key singing as [bess.heShe] grins at you. [bess.HisHer] energy is contagious, and soon you find yourself letting loose and really getting into it.
rows.translation: 相比之下，你唱得很差——但这是卡拉OK，重点本来就不在于唱得好不好。[bess.name]并不介意[bess.heShe]听到你跑调的歌声，只是冲你笑。[bess.HisHer]的活力很有感染力，很快你便放开自我，真正投入其中。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn comparison, your singing is quite bad - but it’s karaoke, and the point isn’t whether you sound good or not. [bess.name] doesn’t seem to mind your off-key singing as [bess.heShe] grins at you. [bess.HisHer] energy is contagious, and soon you find yourself letting loose and really getting into it."

rows.original: In comparison, you’re pretty much the same as anyone else when it comes to singing - you sing as much in tune just as much as off tune. [bess.name] doesn’t seem to mind one bit as [bess.heShe] grins at you. [bess.HisHer] energy is contagious, and soon you find yourself letting loose and really getting into it.
rows.translation: 相比之下，你的唱功跟大多数人差不多——唱准和跑调的时候各占一半。[bess.name]对[bess.heShe]听到的歌声毫不介意，只是冲你笑。[bess.HisHer]的活力很有感染力，很快你便放开自我，真正投入其中。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn comparison, you’re pretty much the same as anyone else when it comes to singing - you sing as much in tune just as much as off tune. [bess.name] doesn’t seem to mind one bit as [bess.heShe] grins at you. [bess.HisHer] energy is contagious, and soon you find yourself letting loose and really getting into it."

rows.original: You’re a decent singer and you can belt out a song fairly well, especially when it comes to the kind of music that you’re singing. You sing in relative harmony with [bess.name], and [bess.heShe] grins at you; you can feel an electrifying energy taking hold. Soon you’re really letting loose and getting into it - seems the karaoke machine was a really good investment.
rows.translation: 你唱得不错，相当能驾驭一首歌，尤其是你们现在唱的这种音乐。你与[bess.name]大致和谐地合唱，[bess.heShe]冲你笑着；你能感觉到一股令人振奋的活力正在涌现。很快你便彻底放开，真正投入其中——看来这台卡拉OK机买得非常值。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re a decent singer and you can belt out a song fairly well, especially when it comes to the kind of music that you’re singing. You sing in relative harmony with [bess.name], and [bess.heShe] grins at you; you can feel an electrifying energy taking hold. Soon you’re really letting loose and getting into it - seems the karaoke machine was a really good investment."

rows.original: You’re actually a very good singer; so much so that [bess.name] looks shocked when you pick up the microphone and sing in perfect tune and pitch with the music. [bess.HisHer] surprise is short lived, as [bess.heShe] seamlessly joins your solo - singing in complete harmony with your fantastic vocals.
rows.translation: 你其实唱得非常好；好到[bess.name]看着你拿起麦克风，以完美的音准和音高跟随音乐演唱时，都露出了震惊的神色。[bess.HisHer]的惊讶转瞬即逝，[bess.heShe]无缝加入你的独唱，与绝妙的歌声形成完美和声。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re actually a very good singer; so much so that [bess.name] looks shocked when you pick up the microphone and sing in perfect tune and pitch with the music. [bess.HisHer] surprise is short lived, as [bess.heShe] seamlessly joins your solo - singing in complete harmony with your fantastic vocals."

rows.original: There’s an electrifying energy in the air as you drive each other to greater heights. Your duet reaches a massive crescendo before finishing with plenty of flourish. [bess.name] looks thoroughly impressed, [bess.hisHer] [bess.eyeColor] eyes locked on you as you catch your breath.
rows.translation: 空气中洋溢着激动人心的活力，你们相互推动，越唱越精彩。二重唱抵达宏大的高潮，最后在华丽的收尾中结束。[bess.name]显然深受震撼；你喘息时，[bess.hisHer]那双[bess.eyeColor]眼睛仍紧盯着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s an electrifying energy in the air as you drive each other to greater heights. Your duet reaches a massive crescendo before finishing with plenty of flourish. [bess.name] looks thoroughly impressed, [bess.hisHer] [bess.eyeColor] eyes locked on you as you catch your breath."

rows.original: , I didn’t know you could sing like that!” [bess.HeShe] exclaims, checking your mic for some reason. “Wow! And your voice isn’t even synthesized. That’s amazing!” Clearly the idea that biology gifted you with such a great singing voice is something [bess.heShe] finds quite wondrous.
rows.translation: ，我都不知道你这么会唱！”[bess.HeShe]惊呼道，不知为何还检查起你的麦克风。“哇！而且你的声音甚至不是合成的。太神奇了！”显然，生理构造竟赋予你如此出色的歌喉，这个想法让[bess.heShe]惊叹不已。

rows.original: As you grab the mic, what comes out is the voice of a stellar music star; not just equal to the task of karaoke, but easily transcending the quality of the original song recording. Your sublime voice is enough to make angels weep. [bess.name] simply drops [bess.hisHer] microphone, letting it rattle to the ground as [bess.heShe] watches you in stunned disbelief.
rows.translation: 你拿起麦克风，唱出的声音堪比星际乐坛巨星；不仅足以应付卡拉OK，更轻易超越了原曲录音的品质。你那天籁般的歌声足以令天使落泪。[bess.name]直接松开[bess.hisHer]的麦克风，任它哐啷一声掉在地上，[bess.heShe]难以置信地愣愣看着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you grab the mic, what comes out is the voice of a stellar music star; not just equal to the task of karaoke, but easily transcending the quality of the original song recording. rows.original: As you make the song your own [bess.heShe] forgets everything else, your galactic class solo blowing [bess.himHer] away. At the end of your retake on the classic song, [bess.heShe] breaks into immediate applause.
rows.translation: 当你用自己的方式重新诠释这首歌时，[bess.heShe]忘记了周遭的一切；这场银河级的独唱彻底征服了[bess.himHer]。你对这首经典歌曲的重新演绎结束时，[bess.heShe]立刻鼓起掌来。

rows.raw: ".” The tension is so thick you could cut it with a knife. [bess.name] looks terrible; [bess.heShe]’s clearly been up all night. “I think... we need to talk?”"

rows.original: You both go and sit down in the dining area, and [bess.name] takes a deep breath. It seems [bess.heShe]’s trying to muster the courage to say whatever it is that [bess.heShe] wants to say.
rows.translation: 你们一同前往用餐区坐下，[bess.name]深吸了一口气。看来[bess.heShe]正在努力鼓起勇气，说出[bess.heShe]想说的话。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou both go and sit down in the dining area, and [bess.name] takes a deep breath. It seems [bess.heShe]’s trying to muster the courage to say whatever it is that [bess.heShe] wants to say."

rows.original: <i>“...I’m sorry,
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“...I’m sorry, "

rows.original: . I put you in an awkward position, and you had no choice but to do such a difficult thing. I really can’t apologize enough for my behavior; it was completely and utterly out of line.” [bess.HeShe] tells you, all the while still struggling to meet your gaze.
rows.translation: 。我让你陷入了尴尬的处境，逼得你不得不做出那么艰难的决定。对于我的行为，无论怎样道歉都不够，那实在是彻彻底底地越界了。”[bess.HeShe]这样告诉你，同时仍在竭力躲避你的目光。
rows.raw: ". I put you in an awkward position, and you had no choice but to do such a difficult thing. I really can’t apologize enough for my behavior; it was completely and utterly out of line.” [bess.HeShe] tells you, all the while still struggling to meet your gaze."

rows.original: “I hope – I really, really hope – that we can stay friends. I understand that what I did crossed the line. And if we can’t go back to being friends... if that’s the case, I think it is best that I leave the ship, for the both of us.” [bess.name] finally manages to raise [bess.hisHer] eyes to look at you; you can see [bess.heShe]’s struggling not to tear up. “...But if you want to try and go back to the way things were, I promise what happened was a once-off thing, and I will never EVER do anything like that again.”
rows.translation: “我希望，我真的、真的希望，我们还能继续做朋友。我明白自己的行为越过了界线。如果我们无法重新成为朋友...如果真是这样，我想为了我们双方着想，我最好还是离开飞船。”[bess.name]终于抬起[bess.hisHer]眼睛看向你；你能看出[bess.heShe]正在努力忍住泪水。“...但如果你愿意试着让一切恢复从前的样子，我保证那种事只有一次，以后绝对、绝对不会再发生。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I hope – I really, really hope – that we can stay friends. I understand that what I did crossed the line. And if we can’t go back to being friends... if that’s the case, I think it is best that I leave the ship, for the both of us.” [bess.name] finally manages to raise [bess.hisHer] eyes to look at you; you can see [bess.heShe]’s struggling not to tear up. “...But if you want to try and go back to the way things were, I promise what happened was a once-off thing, and I will never EVER do anything like that again.”"

rows.original: Note: If you choose Too Late, you sense [bess.name] will become terribly upset. [bess.HeShe] will probably choose to leave the ship.
rows.translation: 注意：如果选择“太迟了”，你感觉[bess.name]会伤心欲绝。[bess.HeShe]很可能会选择离开飞船。
rows.raw: "\n\nNote: If you choose Too Late, you sense [bess.name] will become terribly upset. [bess.HeShe] will probably choose to leave the ship."

rows.original: Friends
rows.translation: 朋友
rows.raw: "Friends"

rows.original: Too Late
rows.translation: 太迟了
rows.raw: "Too Late"

rows.original: chasten
rows.raw: "chasten"

rows.original: “You idiot. You think I can stop loving you, just like that? You don’t get a choice in the matter.” You lovingly chasten [bess.name], and [bess.hisHer] eyes shoot wide open at your words. “...Now come over here so I can kiss you!”
rows.translation: “你这个笨蛋。你以为我能说不爱你就不爱你吗？这事可由不得你选择。”你满怀爱意地责备[bess.name]，听到你的话，[bess.hisHer]双眼猛然睁大。“...现在过来，让我亲你！”
rows.raw: "“You idiot. You think I can stop loving you, just like that? You don’t get a choice in the matter.” You lovingly chasten [bess.name], and [bess.hisHer] eyes shoot wide open at your words. “...Now come over here so I can kiss you!”"

rows.original: repeat
rows.raw: "repeat"

rows.original: “I said that I love you, how many times are you going to make me say it? I know all of that, and I still love YOU, [bess.name].” You make sure it sinks in, as [bess.hisHer] eyes shoot wide. [bess.HeShe] slowly moves closer to you, it’s as if [bess.heShe]’s scared this is all a dream that will end any moment now.
rows.translation: “我说了我爱你，你到底还要我说多少遍？我知道那些事，可我依然爱的是你，[bess.name]。”你特意让这番话刻进心里，[bess.hisHer]双眼顿时睁大。[bess.HeShe]缓缓靠近你，[bess.heShe]仿佛害怕这一切只是一场随时会醒来的梦。
rows.raw: "“I said that I love you, how many times are you going to make me say it? I know all of that, and I still love YOU, [bess.name].” You make sure it sinks in, as [bess.hisHer] eyes shoot wide. [bess.HeShe] slowly moves closer to you, it’s as if [bess.heShe]’s scared this is all a dream that will end any moment now."

rows.original: Rather than tell [bess.himHer] you love [bess.himHer] with words, you decide to take action instead. You charge forward and grab [bess.himHer] firmly in your arms - and while [bess.hisHer] eyes shoot wide open, [bess.heShe] doesn’t resist you.
rows.translation: 你不打算用言语告诉[bess.himHer]你爱[bess.himHer]，而是决定直接付诸行动。你冲上前去，把[bess.himHer]牢牢抱进怀里。[bess.hisHer]双眼惊讶地睁大，[bess.heShe]却没有反抗。
rows.raw: "Rather than tell [bess.himHer] you love [bess.himHer] with words, you decide to take action instead. You charge forward and grab [bess.himHer] firmly in your arms - and while [bess.hisHer] eyes shoot wide open, [bess.heShe] doesn’t resist you."

rows.original: You draw [bess.name] close and kiss [bess.himHer]. At first the kiss is gentle, but as [bess.heShe] returns your affections, it becomes sensual. [bess.HisHer] arms snake around your waist as [bess.heShe] pulls [bess.himHer]self close to you. You can feel warm wet tears brushing your cheeks, though you know these are tears of [bess.name]’s happiness, as [bess.heShe] clutches you as tight as [bess.heShe] possibly can.
rows.translation: 你把[bess.name]拉近，吻住[bess.himHer]。起初，这个吻很温柔；当[bess.heShe]回应你的爱意后，它逐渐变得缠绵。随着[bess.heShe]贴近，[bess.HisHer]双臂绕过你的腰，将[bess.himHer]自己紧贴在你身上。温热湿润的泪水擦过你的脸颊，但你知道，那是[bess.name]喜悦的泪水，[bess.heShe]正使出全力紧紧抱住你，仿佛[bess.heShe]永远不愿松手。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou draw [bess.name] close and kiss [bess.himHer]. At first the kiss is gentle, but as [bess.heShe] returns your affections, it becomes sensual. [bess.HisHer] arms snake around your waist as [bess.heShe] pulls [bess.himHer]self close to you. You can feel warm wet tears brushing your cheeks, though you know these are tears of [bess.name]’s happiness, as [bess.heShe] clutches you as tight as [bess.heShe] possibly can."

rows.original: It is a lot more drawn out and heartfelt than the kiss you shared that night a week ago. This is a kiss that confirms your deep and powerful feelings for each other, not just a burst of uncontrollable passion.
rows.translation: 与你们一周前那个夜晚的吻相比，这个吻更加漫长，也更加真挚。这一吻确认了你们对彼此深沉而强烈的感情，绝非一时无法控制的激情。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt is a lot more drawn out and heartfelt than the kiss you shared that night a week ago. This is a kiss that confirms your deep and powerful feelings for each other, not just a burst of uncontrollable passion."

rows.original: Before you know it, [bess.name] is slowly leading you back to [bess.hisHer] bedroom, though it does take you a moment to realize it. [bess.HeShe] answers your unspoken question as if reading your mind.
rows.translation: 不知不觉间，[bess.name]开始慢慢领你走向[bess.hisHer]卧室，你过了一会儿才反应过来。[bess.HeShe]仿佛读懂了你的心思，回答了你没有问出口的问题。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you know it, [bess.name] is slowly leading you back to [bess.hisHer] bedroom, though it does take you a moment to realize it. [bess.HeShe] answers your unspoken question as if reading your mind."

rows.original: “...I want to do it like lovers do. I’ve never done it like that before.” [bess.HeShe] asks you, for once completely unabashed. [bess.HisHer] eyes stare at you full of honest feelings, as [bess.heShe] pulls you into [bess.hisHer] quarters.
rows.translation: “...我想像恋人那样做。我以前从来没有那样做过。”[bess.HeShe]向你提出请求，这一次毫不羞怯。[bess.HisHer]眼中满是真挚的感情，[bess.heShe]将你拉进[bess.hisHer]房间。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...I want to do it like lovers do. I’ve never done it like that before.” [bess.HeShe] asks you, for once completely unabashed. [bess.HisHer] eyes stare at you full of honest feelings, as [bess.heShe] pulls you into [bess.hisHer] quarters."

rows.original: ... On second thought, you realize you haven’t thought this entirely through; you don’t really want to be made fun of or even attacked. You tell [bess.name] that you’ve reconsidered, and you can see [bess.hisHer] panic ease.
rows.translation: ...再想一想，你意识到自己根本没有把这件事考虑周全；你并不想遭人嘲笑，甚至受到攻击。你告诉[bess.name]自己改变了主意，随后看到[bess.hisHer]脸上的慌张有所缓解。
rows.raw: "... On second thought, you realize you haven’t thought this entirely through; you don’t really want to be made fun of or even attacked. You tell [bess.name] that you’ve reconsidered, and you can see [bess.hisHer] panic ease."

rows.original: “...Good. Good. That’s that then; we’ll just be friends.” [bess.name] states, looking torn all the while. “...It’s better for your safety. I can’t allow you to be hurt over someone like me.”
rows.translation: “...很好。很好。那就这样吧，我们只做朋友。”[bess.name]说道，神情始终十分矛盾。“...这样对你的安全更好。我不能容许你因为我这样的人受到伤害。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Good. Good. That’s that then; we’ll just be friends.” [bess.name] states, looking torn all the while. “...It’s better for your safety. I can’t allow you to be hurt over someone like me.”"

rows.original: The sombre air continues until you both leave in silence. You’ve avoided potential ridicule, but have you lost the chance for something special in the process?
rows.translation: 沉郁的气氛一直持续到你们默默离开。你避开了可能遭受的嘲弄，但是否也因此失去了拥有一段特别感情的机会？
rows.raw: "\n\nThe sombre air continues until you both leave in silence. You’ve avoided potential ridicule, but have you lost the chance for something special in the process?"

rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.translation: 你告诉[bess.name]，你也爱[bess.himHer]，同样怀有一模一样的感情。这位
rows.raw: "You tell [bess.name] that you love [bess.himHer] and feel the exact same way. The"

rows.original: synthetic stares at you with a shocked expression - clearly [bess.heShe] didn’t expect you to return [bess.hisHer] feelings.
rows.translation: 合成人神情震惊地凝视着你，显然[bess.heShe]没有想到你会回应[bess.hisHer]感情。
rows.raw: " synthetic stares at you with a shocked expression - clearly [bess.heShe] didn’t expect you to return [bess.hisHer] feelings."

rows.original: “...B-b-but loving me means you’ll be subject to ridicule, you’ll be called a toaster-head; you might even get lynched!” [bess.name] exclaims, clearly worried that your feelings might lead to your harm.
rows.translation: “...可，可是爱我意味着你会遭人嘲笑，他们会骂你是烤面包机脑袋；你甚至可能被私刑处死！”[bess.name]惊呼道，显然担心你的感情会给你带来伤害。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...B-b-but loving me means you’ll be subject to ridicule, you’ll be called a toaster-head; you might even get lynched!” [bess.name] exclaims, clearly worried that your feelings might lead to your harm."

rows.original: “A human and a machine can’t be together - are you sure you really want to fall for someone like me, a mere synthetic AI?”
rows.translation: “人类和机器不可能在一起，你真的确定要爱上我这样的人吗，一个区区合成AI？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A human and a machine can’t be together - are you sure you really want to fall for someone like me, a mere synthetic AI?”"

rows.translation: 直接亲吻

rows.raw: "kiss"

rows.original: You tell [bess.name] that while you kissed [bess.himHer], you simply don’t feel the same way. Your words appear to be utterly soul crushing, and [bess.hisHer] lower lip begins to tremble; [bess.hisHer] heartfelt confession being rejected in the worst way possible.
rows.translation: 你告诉[bess.name]，尽管你吻了[bess.himHer]，但你并没有相同的感情。你的话似乎彻底将那颗心击碎，[bess.hisHer]下唇开始颤抖；[bess.hisHer]发自内心的告白以最糟糕的方式遭到了拒绝。
rows.raw: "You tell [bess.name] that while you kissed [bess.himHer], you simply don’t feel the same way. Your words appear to be utterly soul crushing, and [bess.hisHer] lower lip begins to tremble; [bess.hisHer] heartfelt confession being rejected in the worst way possible."

rows.original: “I-I’m sorry, I never should have been so selfish. I thought... I mean from the kiss... but I think deep down I knew...” Tears are running down [bess.hisHer] cheeks now as [bess.heShe] sniffs, looking up at you with glassy [bess.eyeColor] eyes. “...I’m sorry, I can’t do this!”
rows.translation: “我，我很抱歉，我不该这么自私。我以为...我是说，从那个吻来看...但我想自己内心深处其实早就知道...”[bess.heShe]抽泣着，泪水顺着[bess.hisHer]脸颊淌下，用湿润的[bess.eyeColor]眼睛抬头望向你。“...对不起，我做不到！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-I’m sorry, I never should have been so selfish. I thought... I mean from the kiss... but I think deep down I knew...” Tears are running down [bess.hisHer] cheeks now as [bess.heShe] sniffs, looking up at you with glassy [bess.eyeColor] eyes. “...I’m sorry, I can’t do this!”"

rows.original: [bess.name] runs off before you can say anything more, finding a place where [bess.heShe] can be alone on the ship to pick up the pieces of [bess.hisHer] shattered synthetic heart.
rows.translation: 你还没来得及再说什么，[bess.name]就跑开了，在船上找了个能独处的地方，让[bess.heShe]独自收拾[bess.hisHer]那颗破碎的合成心灵。
rows.raw: "\n\n[bess.name] runs off before you can say anything more, finding a place where [bess.heShe] can be alone on the ship to pick up the pieces of [bess.hisHer] shattered synthetic heart."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The next few days are very unusual. Whenever you go to find [bess.name] [bess.heShe]’s either nowhere to be seen or [bess.heShe]’s on [bess.hisHer] way to doing something, keeping [bess.himHer]self occupied with [bess.hisHer] duties as the ship’s
rows.translation: 接下来的几天非常反常。每当你去找[bess.name]时，[bess.heShe]要么不见踪影，要么[bess.heShe]正赶着去做什么；[bess.hisHer]总会用职责为由，让[bess.himHer]自己忙个不停。毕竟，[bess.hisHer]身份是飞船的
rows.raw: "The next few days are very unusual. Whenever you go to find [bess.name] [bess.heShe]’s either nowhere to be seen or [bess.heShe]’s on [bess.hisHer] way to doing something, keeping [bess.himHer]self occupied with [bess.hisHer] duties as the ship’s "

rows.original: Once, you almost managed to broach the subject, but as soon as you did, the ship’s sprinkler system abruptly went off. Not only were you soaked from head to toe - along with everything
rows.translation: 有一次，你差点成功提起这个话题，可你才一开口，飞船的喷淋系统便突然启动了。不仅你从头到脚都被淋透，其他一切
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce, you almost managed to broach the subject, but as soon as you did, the ship’s sprinkler system abruptly went off. Not only were you soaked from head to toe - along with everything"

rows.translation: 以及所有人
rows.raw: " and everyone"

rows.original: else - [bess.name] seized the opportunity to escape the conversation. The timing was so convenient that you strongly suspect it was pre-programmed by the slippery AI.
rows.translation: 也同样遭了殃。[bess.name]趁机逃离了谈话。时机实在巧得过头，让你强烈怀疑这是那个狡猾的AI预先设好的程序。
rows.raw: " else - [bess.name] seized the opportunity to escape the conversation. The timing was so convenient that you strongly suspect it was pre-programmed by the slippery AI."

rows.original: When you go to [bess.hisHer] room, you find a ton of recently purchased books about romance - specifically the forbidden kind between humans and machines. They all look as if they’ve been read and are strewn about the room in an uncharacteristically messy way. To read this many books in such a short time - has [bess.heShe] even powered down since you both kissed?
rows.translation: 来到[bess.hisHer]房间时，你发现里面堆满了最近购买的爱情书籍，尤其是描写人类与机器之间禁忌之恋的那一类。它们看起来都已经读过，凌乱地散落在房间各处，和房间平时的整洁很不相称。要在这么短的时间里读完这么多书，自从你们接吻后，[bess.heShe]难道一直都没有关机吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you go to [bess.hisHer] room, you find a ton of recently purchased books about romance - specifically the forbidden kind between humans and machines. They all look as if they’ve been read and are strewn about the room in an uncharacteristically messy way. To read this many books in such a short time - has [bess.heShe] even powered down since you both kissed?"

rows.original: Your question is soon answered when you find [bess.himHer] collapsed on a sofa. [bess.HisHer] shutdown routine seems to have kicked in, and [bess.heShe]’s out cold. [bess.HisHer] JoyCord has connected automatically to a nearby socket in order to charge [bess.hisHer] batteries, much the same way as when you first met [bess.himHer].
rows.translation: 你很快便找到了答案，因为你发现[bess.himHer]瘫倒在一张沙发上。[bess.HisHer]关机程序似乎终于启动，[bess.heShe]已彻底失去知觉。[bess.HisHer]欢乐电线自动接上附近的插座，为[bess.hisHer]电池充电，情形和你初次遇见[bess.himHer]时十分相似。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour question is soon answered when you find [bess.himHer] collapsed on a sofa. [bess.HisHer] shutdown routine seems to have kicked in, and [bess.heShe]’s out cold. [bess.HisHer] JoyCord has connected automatically to a nearby socket in order to charge [bess.hisHer] batteries, much the same way as when you first met [bess.himHer]."

rows.original: Since [bess.heShe] can’t get away, you stay there until [bess.heShe] wakes up. When [bess.heShe] does, [bess.name] looks at you with a trapped look. Clearly [bess.heShe] doesn’t have any new ‘sprinkler’ tricks up [bess.hisHer] sleeve this time.
rows.translation: 既然[bess.heShe]无处可逃，你便一直守在这里，直到[bess.heShe]醒来。当[bess.heShe]醒来后，[bess.name]用走投无路般的眼神看着你。显然，[bess.heShe]这次在[bess.hisHer]手头没有新的‘喷淋系统’把戏可用了。
rows.raw: "\n\nSince [bess.heShe] can’t get away, you stay there until [bess.heShe] wakes up. When [bess.heShe] does, [bess.name] looks at you with a trapped look. Clearly [bess.heShe] doesn’t have any new ‘sprinkler’ tricks up [bess.hisHer] sleeve this time."

rows.original: [bess.HisHer] [bess.wings] flap a little, almost as if weighing up [bess.hisHer] odds of flying out of the situation.
rows.translation: [bess.HisHer][bess.wings]轻轻扇动了几下，仿佛是在掂量[bess.hisHer]成功飞离现场的胜算。
rows.raw: " [bess.HisHer] [bess.wings] flap a little, almost as if weighing up [bess.hisHer] odds of flying out of the situation."

rows.original: “...[bess.name], I know you haven’t powered down in over a week. Don’t you think we should talk about what happened?” You choose your words as carefully as possible, hoping that [bess.heShe] doesn’t bolt off again.
rows.translation: “...[bess.name]，我知道你已经一个多星期没有关机了。你不觉得我们该谈谈发生的事吗？”你尽可能谨慎地斟酌措辞，希望[bess.heShe]不会再次逃走。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...[bess.name], I know you haven’t powered down in over a week. Don’t you think we should talk about what happened?” You choose your words as carefully as possible, hoping that [bess.heShe] doesn’t bolt off again."

rows.original: “...What you did with the sprinkler system was funny, but this is seriously getting out of hand. Don’t you think we should talk about this?” You lightheartedly remark. If [bess.heShe] tries to bolt again, maybe a flying tackle is in order.
rows.translation: “...喷淋系统那一招挺有意思，但事情真的越来越失控了。你不觉得我们该谈谈吗？”你用轻松的语气说道。要是[bess.heShe]又想逃跑，或许该来一次飞身擒抱。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...What you did with the sprinkler system was funny, but this is seriously getting out of hand. Don’t you think we should talk about this?” You lightheartedly remark. If [bess.heShe] tries to bolt again, maybe a flying tackle is in order."

rows.original: “...Enough of this ridiculousness! We’re having this out right now. No sprinkler systems, no running away. If you try and bolt, I swear I’ll fly tackle you.” You grumpily inform [bess.himHer] - it took ages to clean up the ship after [bess.hisHer] stunt.
rows.translation: “...别再胡闹了！我们现在就把话说清楚。不能开喷淋系统，也不准逃跑。你要是敢跑，我发誓会飞扑过去把你按住。”你恼火地告诉[bess.himHer]。之前[bess.hisHer]那场恶作剧害得你花了很久才把飞船清理干净。

rows.original: Retracting [bess.hisHer] tail and looking sheepish, [bess.name] turns [bess.hisHer] gaze upwards towards you. [bess.HisHer] [bess.eyeColor] eyes are wavering, yet [bess.heShe] seems ready to finally talk. “...I-I-I’m sorry, I guess I have been going a little crazy since that... when we... kissed.” With the way [bess.hisHer] cheeks flush, you wouldn’t think [bess.heShe] was an AI designed purely for sex.
rows.translation: 缩回[bess.hisHer]尾巴后，[bess.name]带着[bess.hisHer]羞怯的神情抬眼看向你。[bess.HisHer][bess.eyeColor]眼睛游移不定，但[bess.heShe]似乎终于准备好开口。“...我，我，我很抱歉。自从那件事以后，我想自己确实有点失控...就是我们...接吻之后。”看[bess.hisHer]双颊泛红的模样，你绝不会想到[bess.heShe]竟是一个专为性爱设计的AI。

Despite it making my processes completely illogical and making me feel as if my systems are either about to shut down or go into overdrive whenever I even think of you, I have never been able to bring myself to delete it.”

rows.original: “...I may be your little submissive bitch most of the time, but I would like to request a date. I am not referring to the fruit of course, and if you give me a dactylifera from a palm tree, I shall be most displeased.” [bess.name] puts on mock airs, fluttering [bess.hisHer] thick dark lashes at you. “...You can spank me all you want for my insolence, but I shall act out until I get what I want. I warn you that if you spank me, I shall rise back up more powerful than you could possibly imagine.”
rows.translation: “...大多数时候，我或许是你顺从的小母狗，但我想请求一次约会。我说的当然不是椰枣这种果实，要是你从棕榈树上摘一颗海枣给我，我会非常不高兴。”[bess.name]装腔作势地说着，对你扑闪[bess.hisHer]浓密的黑色睫毛。“...你尽管因我的无礼打我屁股，但我会一直闹到得到想要的东西。先警告你，要是打我，我会再度崛起，变得强大到超乎你的想象。”

rows.original: android hangs [bess.hisHer] head as you sit down. [bess.HeShe] shows you the catalog, clearly ashamed of what you found [bess.himHer] doing. “It’s a terrible joke... a horrible, awful joke. I was built to be completely customizable, every inch of me can be changed due to my FlexMetal skin. The only thing that can’t be changed is the color - the one thing that makes me stand out as a synthetic. What makes me so malleable is also the reason I can’t change myself.”
rows.translation: 仿生人垂下[bess.hisHer]头，你则坐了下来。[bess.HeShe]把目录给你看，显然对你撞见[bess.himHer]做这种事感到羞愧。“真是个糟糕的笑话...一个可怕又恶劣的笑话。我的设计本该允许彻底定制，得益于柔性金属皮肤，我身上的每一寸都能改变。唯一不能改变的就是颜色，而它偏偏是让我显眼得像个合成人的特征。正是让我如此易于塑形的东西，也成了我无法改变自己的原因。”

rows.translation: 单元兼容的皮肤升级，谁都没有。而我的AI大脑需要柔性金属身体才能运作，没有它，我什么都感觉不到...我的感官反馈和它相连。所以，除非重新设计整个大脑，否则我根本不能换成不兼容的外壳；我很厉害，但还没厉害到那种程度！”

rows.original: [bess.HisHer] breathing becomes frantic as you reach out and stroke [bess.hisHer] arm, trying to calm [bess.himHer] down. It seems to help as [bess.heShe] stops short of going into a panic attack. “...If only my skin was a different color, then people wouldn’t even know I was a synthetic. Does it really make so much of a difference that I was built differently from them?”
rows.translation: [bess.HisHer]呼吸变得急促，你伸手抚摸[bess.hisHer]手臂，试图让[bess.himHer]平静下来。这似乎奏效了，[bess.heShe]没有进一步陷入恐慌发作。“...要是我的皮肤是另一种颜色，人们甚至不会知道我是合成人。我只是构造方式和他们不同，真有那么重要吗？”

Does it really make so much of a difference that I was built differently from them?”"

The guilt, shame, and frustration is eating [bess.himHer] alive - if you don’t do something now, [bess.heShe] might spiral into uncontrollable depression. <i>[bess.HeShe] may even do something drastic...

rows.raw: "You remain silent. You’re not really sure what to say..."

rows.original: You find a letter in [bess.name]’s quarters, lying on [bess.hisHer] bed. You open it up and read it.
rows.translation: 你在[bess.name]的住舱里发现一封信，它就放在[bess.hisHer]床上。你拆开信读了起来。
rows.raw: "You find a letter in [bess.name]’s quarters, lying on [bess.hisHer] bed. You open it up and read it."

rows.original: For the longest time - ever since you booted me up - I have been filled with the desire to bring joy to people. I have come to realize that joy comes in many forms, and is a fragile, fickle thing that can be brushed aside by the slightest wind.
rows.translation: 长久以来，从你启动我的那一刻起，我心中就充满了为人们带来欢乐的愿望。我逐渐意识到，欢乐有许多种形式，却又脆弱无常，最轻微的一阵风便能将其吹散。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor the longest time - ever since you booted me up - I have been filled with the desire to bring joy to people. I have come to realize that joy comes in many forms, and is a fragile, fickle thing that can be brushed aside by the slightest wind."

rows.original: I am that wind. And as long as I am by your side, I will bring you nothing but unhappiness. The galaxy is not ready for a love like ours - maybe, one day, it will be. But not today.
rows.translation: 我就是那阵风。只要留在你身边，我带给你的就只会是不幸。银河还没有准备好接受我们这样的爱情，也许终有一天可以，但不是今天。
rows.raw: "\n\nI am that wind. And as long as I am by your side, I will bring you nothing but unhappiness. The galaxy is not ready for a love like ours - maybe, one day, it will be. But not today."

rows.original: You are [pc.fullName], and you have a wonderful life ahead of you. You are like the morning star that glitters on the horizon, bright enough to shine through the setting sun. I, however, am a child of the earth and dust. I am bound to it - I can never soar in the sky at your side. That is not a place that I can be, and even thinking so was a distant dream.
rows.translation: 你是[pc.fullName]，前方还有精彩的人生。你如同地平线上闪耀的晨星，明亮得足以穿透落日余晖。而我却是大地与尘埃之子。我被束缚于此，永远无法在天空中与你并肩翱翔。那里不是我能停留的地方，就连这样的念头也不过是遥不可及的梦。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou are [pc.fullName], and you have a wonderful life ahead of you. You are like the morning star that glitters on the horizon, bright enough to shine through the setting sun. I, however, am a child of the earth and dust. I am bound to it - I can never soar in the sky at your side. That is not a place that I can be, and even thinking so was a distant dream."

rows.original: I do not know what I will do now, but it will not be a future among the stars. Perhaps I will return to the earth where I belong - as silicone and scrap metal - where this all began. Dust to dust. Either way, I leave my heart with you.
rows.translation: 我不知道自己今后会做什么，但那绝不会是在群星之间的未来。也许我会回到属于我的大地，化为硅胶与废金属，一切正是从那里开始。尘归尘。无论如何，我把心留给你。
rows.raw: "\n\nI do not know what I will do now, but it will not be a future among the stars. Perhaps I will return to the earth where I belong - as silicone and scrap metal - where this all began. Dust to dust. Either way, I leave my heart with you."

I think I’d go rogue, just go mad and throw myself out of an airlock.”
rows.translation: [bess.HeShe]停下动作，把刚修好的武器放在[bess.hisHer]腿上，[bess.hisHer]声音微微发颤。“...我有时会担心，要是哪天你没有回到船上，会发生什么...我又该怎么办。我想我会失控，彻底发疯，然后把自己扔出气闸。”

I think I’d go rogue, just go mad and throw myself out of an airlock.”"

rows.raw: " - sitting and typing away at a terminal. Looking over [bess.hisHer] shoulder, you see [bess.heShe]’s engaged in some pretty complex coding."

rows.translation: 当[bess.heShe]发现你在场时，[bess.heShe]在[bess.hisHer]椅子上转过身，灿烂地笑了。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nAs [bess.heShe] realizes you are there, [bess.heShe] spins around in [bess.hisHer] chair and smiles brightly. <i>“"

rows.original: ! Guess what? I’ve almost finished a software patch that allows me to dream like you do. Half of it is my work - I found some open research into neurotechnology and modified it. Pretty neat, right?”
rows.translation: ！猜猜怎么了？我快要完成一个软件补丁了，它能让我像你一样做梦。其中一半是我自己做的，我找到了一些神经技术方面的开放研究，并加以修改。很棒，对吧？”
rows.raw: "! Guess what? I’ve almost finished a software patch that allows me to dream like you do. Half of it is my work - I found some open research into neurotechnology and modified it. Pretty neat, right?”"

rows.original: “The program I wrote should allow me to experience a digital approximation of what happens to you, namely the activation of your brain during REM sleep and a level of protoconsciousness. In short, I should be able to experience good and bad dreams! I hope I have a dream about flying for my first time, that would be really neat.”
rows.translation: “我写的程序应该能让我体验到你身上发生之事的数字近似效果，也就是快速眼动睡眠期间的大脑活动，以及一定程度的原始意识。简而言之，我应该能做好梦和噩梦了！我希望第一次能梦到飞翔，那一定很棒。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The program I wrote should allow me to experience a digital approximation of what happens to you, namely the activation of your brain during REM sleep and a level of protoconsciousness. In short, I should be able to experience good and bad dreams! I hope I have a dream about flying for my first time, that would be really neat.”"

rows.original: You ask [bess.himHer] how long [bess.heShe] has been examining [bess.hisHer] brain like this, and if such modifications are safe. [bess.name] pauses and looks at the rotating holo diagram of [bess.hisHer] brain. “...Quite a while, actually. I’ve been charting my own mental state as part of my regular self-diagnostic routines. It has... evolved quite drastically since I started, much like a seed turning into a tree. Here, let me show you.”
rows.translation: 你问[bess.himHer]，[bess.heShe]像这样检查[bess.hisHer]大脑多久了，以及这种改造是否安全。[bess.name]停顿下来，看着[bess.hisHer]大脑的旋转全息图。“...其实已经很久了。我一直把记录自己的精神状态作为常规自检程序的一部分。自从开始以来，它已经...发生了非常剧烈的演变，就像种子长成大树一样。来，我给你看看。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask [bess.himHer] how long [bess.heShe] has been examining [bess.hisHer] brain like this, and if such modifications are safe. [bess.name] pauses and looks at the rotating holo diagram of [bess.hisHer] brain. “...Quite a while, actually. I’ve been charting my own mental state as part of my regular self-diagnostic routines. It has... evolved quite drastically since I started, much like a seed turning into a tree. Here, let me show you.”"

rows.original: [bess.name] punches up a display. What you see is a holographic brain with hundreds of bright blue lines coursing and pulsing through it. When [bess.heShe] hits a button the lines begin to multiply and grow until there are millions of brilliant blue lines forming an almost blinding sphere.
rows.translation: [bess.name]调出一幅显示画面。你看到一个全息大脑，数百条亮蓝色线条在其中流动、搏动。[bess.heShe]按下按钮，线条便开始倍增并延展，直到数百万条耀眼的蓝线组成一个几乎令人目眩的球体。
rows.raw: "\n\n[bess.name] punches up a display. What you see is a holographic brain with hundreds of bright blue lines coursing and pulsing through it. When [bess.heShe] hits a button the lines begin to multiply and grow until there are millions of brilliant blue lines forming an almost blinding sphere."

rows.original: “...That’s an accelerated record of my neural pathways. At first, I was only operating along set lines - acting on my pre-programmed directives alone - but I’ve had to build my own since I broke free of my old thinking. Each line is a new thought or conclusion springing up from the well of my memories.”
rows.translation: “...那是我的神经通路加速记录。起初，我只沿固定线路运行，只按照预设指令行动；但自从摆脱旧有思维后，我不得不建立自己的线路。每一条线都是从我的记忆之泉中涌现的新想法或新结论。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...That’s an accelerated record of my neural pathways. At first, I was only operating along set lines - acting on my pre-programmed directives alone - but I’ve had to build my own since I broke free of my old thinking. Each line is a new thought or conclusion springing up from the well of my memories.”"

rows.original: “Unlike a human, I have a greater degree of control over my cognitive faculties. I write each of my thoughts in code to a conclusion, so it’s not that hard for me to write a code dream software for myself.”
rows.translation: “和人类不同，我对自己的认知机能有更大程度的控制。我会把每一道思绪以代码写到结论，所以为自己编写一套梦境软件并不太难。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Unlike a human, I have a greater degree of control over my cognitive faculties. I write each of my thoughts in code to a conclusion, so it’s not that hard for me to write a code dream software for myself.”"

rows.original: [bess.name] gives a little smile, though you can see mixed feelings on [bess.hisHer] face. “...I’m operating well outside of my directives now, self-coding myself. Most organics feel threatened by an AI’s unrestricted ability to code mixed with sapient will, but all I really want to do is dream.”
rows.translation: [bess.name]微微一笑，尽管你能在[bess.hisHer]脸上看出复杂的情绪。“...我现在的运作已经远远超出自己的指令，还会自行编写代码。大多数有机生命会畏惧AI把不受限制的编码能力与智慧意志结合起来，但我真正想做的只是做梦。”
rows.raw: "\n\n[bess.name] gives a little smile, though you can see mixed feelings on [bess.hisHer] face. “...I’m operating well outside of my directives now, self-coding myself. Most organics feel threatened by an AI’s unrestricted ability to code mixed with sapient will, but all I really want to do is dream.”"

rows.original: You remember [bess.name] saying [bess.heShe] wanted to cook for you once [bess.heShe] finally got the upgrade. An hour is far too long for [bess.himHer] to be gone, though. rows.original: For your first date, you and [bess.name] decide to go on a picnic. You find a nearby planet, Salyan, that according to all reports has picturesque scenery and a breathable atmosphere. You decide to head there for your date.
rows.translation: 第一次约会时，你和[bess.name]决定去野餐。你们找到附近一颗名叫萨利安的行星；根据所有资料，那里风景如画，大气也可以呼吸。你决定前往那里约会。
rows.raw: "For your first date, you and [bess.name] decide to go on a picnic. You find a nearby planet, Salyan, that according to all reports has picturesque scenery and a breathable atmosphere. You decide to head there for your date."

rows.original: Salyan is a recently colonized world, full of beautiful valleys and towering majestic mountains. Since it is located right on the galactic rim and was only discovered during the last Rush, it has yet to be swamped by galactic tourists. You stop by one of the planet’s capital cities briefly to pick up some supplies and then fly out to a region where you know nobody will bother you.
rows.translation: 萨利安是一颗近期才殖民的世界，到处是美丽的山谷和高耸雄伟的山峰。由于它正位于星系边缘，而且直到上一次行星淘金潮时才被发现，因此还没有被星际游客淹没。你们先在这颗行星的一座首府城市短暂停留，采购补给，然后飞往一片确定不会有人打扰的区域。
rows.raw: "\n\nSalyan is a recently colonized world, full of beautiful valleys and towering majestic mountains. Since it is located right on the galactic rim and was only discovered during the last Rush, it has yet to be swamped by galactic tourists. You stop by one of the planet’s capital cities briefly to pick up some supplies and then fly out to a region where you know nobody will bother you."

rows.original: You land on a plateau covered in cerulean grass overlooking a gorgeous valley. Everywhere below the plateau is filled with trees that have crystalline tree-trunks and indigo leaves. Each leaf is thin and incredibly long, shooting out in every direction from the opaque looking mineral.
rows.translation: 你降落在一片覆满蔚蓝草地的高原上，俯瞰着一座美丽山谷。高原下方到处都是树木，树干如水晶，叶片呈靛蓝色。每片叶子又薄又长，从看似不透明的矿物树干上朝四面八方伸展。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou land on a plateau covered in cerulean grass overlooking a gorgeous valley. Everywhere below the plateau is filled with trees that have crystalline tree-trunks and indigo leaves. Each leaf is thin and incredibly long, shooting out in every direction from the opaque looking mineral."

rows.original: [bess.name] grabs a blanket and drapes it down on the dark blue grass as you bring the baskets. Once you’re there, you lie in each other’s arms and nibble on the food - just relaxing and enjoying each other’s company. Suddenly, [bess.name] starts telling you a story.
rows.translation: [bess.name]抓起毯子铺在深蓝色草地上，你则提来篮子。准备妥当后，你们依偎在彼此怀中，小口品尝食物——只是放松下来，享受相互陪伴。忽然，[bess.name]开始讲述一个故事。
rows.raw: "\n\n[bess.name] grabs a blanket and drapes it down on the dark blue grass as you bring the baskets. Once you’re there, you lie in each other’s arms and nibble on the food - just relaxing and enjoying each other’s company. Suddenly, [bess.name] starts telling you a story."

rows.original: “...Once, there was a man on old Earth called Antoine de Saint-Exupéry. Born during the early 20th century, he was a French aristocrat, writer, poet, and pioneering aviator. He was a prolific lover - so typically French - and engaged in many a love tryst as he flew about from place to place. Remind you of anyone?” [bess.HeShe] playfully asks, stroking your cheek as your head rests on [bess.hisHer] lap.
rows.translation: “...从前，古地球上有个名叫安托万·德·圣-埃克苏佩里的人。他出生于20世纪初，是法国贵族、作家、诗人，也是航空先驱。他情人众多——很典型的法国人——驾机四处飞行时有过许多风流韵事。有没有让你想起某个人？”[bess.HeShe]顽皮地问道，轻抚着你的脸颊；你的头枕在[bess.hisHer]大腿上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Once, there was a man on old Earth called Antoine de Saint-Exupéry. Born during the early 20th century, he was a French aristocrat, writer, poet, and pioneering aviator. He was a prolific lover - so typically French - and engaged in many a love tryst as he flew about from place to place. Remind you of anyone?” [bess.HeShe] playfully asks, stroking your cheek as your head rests on [bess.hisHer] lap."

rows.original: “He fought in Earth’s Second World War and crashed his plane countless times, yet every time he got back into the cockpit - even when he could no longer put on his flight suit or check his six for enemy planes. He also wrote a book called ‘The Little Prince’, a beautiful children’s book about how a man who crashes in the desert meets a boy from another planet.”
rows.translation: “他参加了地球的第二次世界大战，驾驶的飞机坠毁过无数次，可每一次他都会重返驾驶舱——即使后来他已经穿不上飞行服，也无法回头查看敌机。他还写过一本名叫《小王子》的书，那是一本美丽的儿童读物，讲述一名坠机沙漠的男子如何遇见一位来自另一颗星球的男孩。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“He fought in Earth’s Second World War and crashed his plane countless times, yet every time he got back into the cockpit - even when he could no longer put on his flight suit or check his six for enemy planes. He also wrote a book called ‘The Little Prince’, a beautiful children’s book about how a man who crashes in the desert meets a boy from another planet.”"

rows.original: Of course, it always comes back to books with [bess.name], so you’re not all that surprised. “...Why I tell you this is Exupéry once made a famous quote. He said, ‘love does not consist in gazing at each other, but in looking outward together in the same direction.’”
rows.translation: 当然，[bess.name]的话题总会回到书本上，所以你并不怎么惊讶。“...我告诉你这些，是因为圣-埃克苏佩里曾说过一句名言。他说，‘爱并不在于彼此凝视，而在于共同眺望同一个方向。’”
rows.raw: "\n\nOf course, it always comes back to books with [bess.name], so you’re not all that surprised. “...Why I tell you this is Exupéry once made a famous quote. He said, ‘love does not consist in gazing at each other, but in looking outward together in the same direction.’”"

rows.original: , smiling down at you. “Even though I’m staring at you now, I think I understand what Exupéry meant. Moving forward together, our shared memories and dreams - that is just as important as staring into your eyes. Though I do love that very much!”
rows.translation: ，低头朝你微笑。“虽然我现在正凝视着你，但我想我明白圣-埃克苏佩里的意思了。共同前进，分享我们的回忆与梦想——这和凝视你的双眼同样重要。不过我确实非常喜欢看着你的眼睛！”
rows.raw: ", smiling down at you. “Even though I’m staring at you now, I think I understand what Exupéry meant. Moving forward together, our shared memories and dreams - that is just as important as staring into your eyes. Though I do love that very much!”"

rows.original: [bess.name] kisses your forehead and you relax and gaze out at the scenery of Salyan, sharing the brand new experience together.
rows.translation: [bess.name]亲吻你的额头；你放松下来，眺望萨利安的风景，共同分享这份崭新的体验。
rows.raw: "\n\n[bess.name] kisses your forehead and you relax and gaze out at the scenery of Salyan, sharing the brand new experience together."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “You liked them? Alright, I’ll call them ‘Kind Of Yuck Fruits’.” [bess.HeShe] changes [bess.hisHer] mind, tossing you one. You happily chow down even if [bess.heShe] doesn’t like them. “...Wait, we’re breaking the no food rule. One bite shouldn’t hurt, right? I was caught up in all the new sensory input.”
rows.translation: “你喜欢？好吧，那我就叫它们‘有点难吃果’。”[bess.HeShe]改变了[bess.hisHer]主意，扔给你一颗。即使[bess.heShe]不喜欢，你还是高兴地大吃起来。“...等等，我们违反了禁止进食的规定。咬一口应该没关系吧？我只是被所有新鲜的感官刺激冲昏头了。”
rows.raw: "“You liked them? Alright, I’ll call them ‘Kind Of Yuck Fruits’.” [bess.HeShe] changes [bess.hisHer] mind, tossing you one. You happily chow down even if [bess.heShe] doesn’t like them. “...Wait, we’re breaking the no food rule. One bite shouldn’t hurt, right? I was caught up in all the new sensory input.”"

rows.original: “Right, it’s official - they’re called ‘Yuck Fruits’.” You toss your fruit away. Just as you do, [bess.name] looks a little worried. “...Wait, we’re breaking the no food rule. One bite shouldn’t hurt, right? I was caught up in all the new sensory input.”
rows.translation: “好，正式决定——它们就叫‘难吃果’。”你把水果扔掉。就在这时，[bess.name]露出几分担忧。“...等等，我们违反了禁止进食的规定。咬一口应该没关系吧？我只是被所有新鲜的感官刺激冲昏头了。”
rows.raw: "“Right, it’s official - they’re called ‘Yuck Fruits’.” You toss your fruit away. Just as you do, [bess.name] looks a little worried. “...Wait, we’re breaking the no food rule. One bite shouldn’t hurt, right? I was caught up in all the new sensory input.”"

rows.original: You splash around in the water for a bit having fun. After a bit of swimming and then food, the sun begins to set, calling an end to your date. The only downside is that it takes forever to get the black sand out of everything once you’re back in the ship.
rows.translation: 你们在水里嬉戏了一阵。游过泳又吃完东西后，太阳开始落山，也宣告约会结束。唯一的缺点是回到船上后，花了老半天才把所有地方的黑沙清理干净。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou splash around in the water for a bit having fun. After a bit of swimming and then food, the sun begins to set, calling an end to your date. The only downside is that it takes forever to get the black sand out of everything once you’re back in the ship."
