rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: For your next date, you head to a nearby water planet called Brelia. You park your [pc_ship.modelDisplay] on one of the small islands dotting the planet and walk out across the obsidian sand. The ocean quietly laps up the beach - once again it feels like you’ve got the entire planet to yourselves.
rows.translation: 下一次约会，你们前往附近一颗名叫布雷利亚的水世界。你把[pc_ship.modelDisplay]停在点缀行星的一座小岛上，踏上黑曜石般的沙滩。海水静静拍打海岸——再一次，你感觉整颗行星仿佛只属于你们两人。
rows.raw: "For your next date, you head to a nearby water planet called Brelia. You park your [pc_ship.modelDisplay] on one of the small islands dotting the planet and walk out across the obsidian sand. The ocean quietly laps up the beach - once again it feels like you’ve got the entire planet to yourselves."

rows.original: [bess.name] pulls out the trusty food hamper and a beach ball - apparently that’s another thing [bess.heShe] wants to experience - as well as a pair of snorkels. The scans showed there weren’t too many nasty things in the water, so it was safe for human habitation. Then again, so was Mhen’ga.
rows.translation: [bess.name]拿出可靠的食物篮、一个沙滩球——显然这也是[bess.heShe]想体验的东西——以及两副呼吸管。扫描显示水里没有多少危险生物，因此适合人类活动。不过话说回来，门加也一样。
rows.raw: "\n\n[bess.name] pulls out the trusty food hamper and a beach ball - apparently that’s another thing [bess.heShe] wants to experience - as well as a pair of snorkels. The scans showed there weren’t too many nasty things in the water, so it was safe for human habitation. Then again, so was Mhen’ga."

rows.original: “Remember, swimming THEN food. I don’t want you sinking on me!” You ask [bess.name] exactly why [bess.heShe] had brought two snorkel sets when [bess.heShe] doesn’t even need to breathe. “...I don’t like doing things halfway. If you go snorkeling, you need a snorkel!”
rows.translation: “记住，先游泳，再吃东西。我可不想看你沉下去！”你问[bess.name]，[bess.heShe]明明根本不需要呼吸，为什么[bess.heShe]还带了两副呼吸管。“...我不喜欢半途而废。既然要浮潜，就必须配呼吸管！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Remember, swimming THEN food. I don’t want you sinking on me!” You ask [bess.name] exactly why [bess.heShe] had brought two snorkel sets when [bess.heShe] doesn’t even need to breathe. “...I don’t like doing things halfway. If you go snorkeling, you need a snorkel!”"

rows.original: For an AI, [bess.hisHer] logic just keeps getting hazier over time, but it seems to make perfect sense to [bess.himHer]. You explore the beach and find some odd looking fruit which scans register as harmless, so you both give it a try. It tastes like passion fruit mixed with raspberries.
rows.translation: 作为人工智能，[bess.hisHer]逻辑似乎随时间越来越模糊，但在[bess.himHer]看来却完全合理。你们探索海滩，发现几颗外形古怪的水果；扫描显示无害，于是你们都尝了尝。味道像百香果混合覆盆子。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor an AI, [bess.hisHer] logic just keeps getting hazier over time, but it seems to make perfect sense to [bess.himHer]. You explore the beach and find some odd looking fruit which scans register as harmless, so you both give it a try. It tastes like passion fruit mixed with raspberries."

rows.original: “Not a fan of these. I’m going to call them yuck fruits.” [bess.name] screws up [bess.hisHer] nose and tosses it away. “...Sad, I was kind of hoping a planet with so little land mass would have a really tasty and rare fruit growing on them. What did you think?”
rows.translation: “我不喜欢这些。我要叫它们难吃果。”[bess.name]皱起[bess.hisHer]鼻子，把它扔掉。“...真遗憾，我还以为陆地这么少的行星上会长着特别美味又稀有的水果。你觉得怎么样？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not a fan of these. I’m going to call them yuck fruits.” [bess.name] screws up [bess.hisHer] nose and tosses it away. “...Sad, I was kind of hoping a planet with so little land mass would have a really tasty and rare fruit growing on them. What did you think?”"

rows.original: Liked
rows.translation: 喜欢
rows.raw: "Liked"

rows.original: Didn’t
rows.translation: 不喜欢
rows.raw: "Didn’t"

rows.original: For your next date, you head to Orios, a famous snow planet on the outer rim known as a skiing paradise. [bess.name] has never skied before so [bess.heShe]’s a little nervous, but at the same time, extremely excited to try it out.
rows.translation: 下一次约会，你们前往奥里奥斯。这是外环一颗著名的冰雪行星，以滑雪天堂而闻名。[bess.name]从没滑过雪，所以[bess.heShe]有点紧张，却也无比兴奋，迫不及待想试试。
rows.raw: "For your next date, you head to Orios, a famous snow planet on the outer rim known as a skiing paradise. [bess.name] has never skied before so [bess.heShe]’s a little nervous, but at the same time, extremely excited to try it out."

rows.original: “You know, I’m from an arctic planet. Maybe I’m lucky and I’ve been built to be awesome in cool weather conditions?” [bess.name] grins and looks at you - it’s a safe bet that [bess.heShe] wasn’t secretly designed to be a champion skier.
rows.translation: “你知道吗，我来自一颗极地行星。也许我很幸运，天生就能在寒冷天气里大显身手？”[bess.name]笑着看向你——可以肯定，[bess.heShe]绝不是秘密设计的滑雪冠军。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know, I’m from an arctic planet. Maybe I’m lucky and I’ve been built to be awesome in cool weather conditions?” [bess.name] grins and looks at you - it’s a safe bet that [bess.heShe] wasn’t secretly designed to be a champion skier."

rows.original: You hire out some equipment and a teaching VI to float around with you. Since it’s a day trip, you both decide there’s no point at staying at one of the many high altitude ski lodges Orios is famous for.
rows.translation: 你们租来一些装备和一台跟在身边飘浮的教学虚拟智能。既然只是当天往返，你们都觉得没有必要住进奥里奥斯闻名遐迩的众多高山滑雪小屋。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hire out some equipment and a teaching VI to float around with you. Since it’s a day trip, you both decide there’s no point at staying at one of the many high altitude ski lodges Orios is famous for."

rows.original: “...You know, you’d think in over a thousand years, organics would have evolved beyond wanting to propel themselves at near lethal speeds down mountains with nothing but sticks strapped to their feet.” [bess.name] ponders aloud, as you travel up the slopes through a repulsor tunnel. You’re up the top of one of the planet’s smaller, more forgiving mountains.
rows.translation: “...你知道吗，真没想到一千多年过去，有机体还是喜欢脚绑木板，以近乎致命的速度冲下山坡。”[bess.name]大声思索着；此刻你们正通过一条反重力隧道登上山坡。你们位于这颗行星一座较小也较温和的山顶。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...You know, you’d think in over a thousand years, organics would have evolved beyond wanting to propel themselves at near lethal speeds down mountains with nothing but sticks strapped to their feet.” [bess.name] ponders aloud, as you travel up the slopes through a repulsor tunnel. You’re up the top of one of the planet’s smaller, more forgiving mountains."

rows.original: The slope is very shallow and perfect for a beginner. The floating VI instructor begins to give [bess.himHer] instructions as [bess.heShe] forms [bess.hisHer] skis into a wedge, nervously descending down the slope.
rows.translation: 坡度十分平缓，非常适合初学者。飘浮的虚拟智能教练开始指导[bess.himHer]；[bess.heShe]把[bess.hisHer]滑雪板摆成犁式，紧张地滑下山坡。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe slope is very shallow and perfect for a beginner. The floating VI instructor begins to give [bess.himHer] instructions as [bess.heShe] forms [bess.hisHer] skis into a wedge, nervously descending down the slope."

rows.original: <i>“...Look, look! I’m skiing,
rows.translation: <i>“...看，快看！我在滑雪，
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“...Look, look! I’m skiing, "

rows.original: - I’m really doing it!” The AI, who was decrying organics mere moments ago for enjoying skiing, seems totally caught up in the experience.
rows.translation: ——我真的做到了！”这个片刻前还在批判有机体享受滑雪的人工智能，似乎已经彻底沉浸其中。
rows.raw: " - I’m really doing it!” The AI, who was decrying organics mere moments ago for enjoying skiing, seems totally caught up in the experience."

rows.original: You ski down the slope a few times with [bess.himHer], having an absolute blast. Later, you both decide to try a steeper slope despite the VI’s warnings. It turns out to be a terrifying experience. Thankfully, the worst that happens is that you both tumble into a soft snow pile rather than taking serious injury.
rows.translation: 你陪[bess.himHer]滑了几次，玩得痛快极了。后来，你们不顾虚拟智能的警告，决定尝试一条更陡的坡道，结果那段经历惊险万分。幸好最糟的结果也只是双双摔进柔软的雪堆，没有受重伤。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ski down the slope a few times with [bess.himHer], having an absolute blast. Later, you both decide to try a steeper slope despite the VI’s warnings. It turns out to be a terrifying experience. Thankfully, the worst that happens is that you both tumble into a soft snow pile rather than taking serious injury."

rows.original: You both lie there laughing in your thick padded gear. Eventually [bess.name] climbs up on top of you and starts making out with you on the mountain. Your arms slip around each other as you embrace on the snow pile.
rows.translation: 你们穿着厚实的防护装备躺在那里大笑。最后，[bess.name]爬到你身上，在山坡上和你热吻。你们在雪堆上拥抱，双臂缠绕彼此。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou both lie there laughing in your thick padded gear. Eventually [bess.name] climbs up on top of you and starts making out with you on the mountain. Your arms slip around each other as you embrace on the snow pile."

rows.original: Neither of you even notice the other skiers looking at you as you make out with your synthetic lover, an appalled expression on their faces.
rows.translation: 你们和合成人爱侣热吻时，甚至没有注意到其他滑雪者正看着你们，脸上满是惊愕。
rows.raw: "\n\nNeither of you even notice the other skiers looking at you as you make out with your synthetic lover, an appalled expression on their faces."

rows.original: Once you’re done fooling around, you both slowly descend the rest of the terrifying slope. Since the sun is setting, you head back to the ship, calling it a day.
rows.translation: 胡闹完后，你们都慢慢滑完这条可怕的坡道。太阳已经落山，你们返回飞船，结束这一天。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce you’re done fooling around, you both slowly descend the rest of the terrifying slope. Since the sun is setting, you head back to the ship, calling it a day."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You had such a great time at Orios that you’ve both decided to go back there. You both throw on your cold weather gear and step outside into the snow, enjoying the fresh mountain air and picturesque landscape.
rows.translation: 你们在奥里奥斯玩得太开心，于是决定再去一次。你们都穿上御寒装备，踏入雪地，享受清新的山间空气与如画风景。
rows.raw: "You had such a great time at Orios that you’ve both decided to go back there. You both throw on your cold weather gear and step outside into the snow, enjoying the fresh mountain air and picturesque landscape."

rows.original: “...Someday, I’ve got to take you to Panara - my home planet. You’d love it. Big thick furry Ausar, discount JoyCo goods, all the latest cutting edge products. And lots and lots of snow!” [bess.name] tells you excitedly; for all [bess.hisHer] progress, [bess.heShe]’s yet to break that JoyCo customer loyalty that was hard-coded into [bess.himHer].
rows.translation: “...总有一天，我一定要带你去帕纳拉——我的故乡。你会喜欢那里的。高大厚实、毛茸茸的奥萨人，打折的欢乐公司商品，各种最新尖端产品。还有好多好多雪！”[bess.name]兴奋地告诉你；尽管[bess.hisHer]已有很大进步，[bess.heShe]仍未摆脱硬编码进[bess.himHer]体内的欢乐公司品牌忠诚。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Someday, I’ve got to take you to Panara - my home planet. You’d love it. Big thick furry Ausar, discount JoyCo goods, all the latest cutting edge products. And lots and lots of snow!” [bess.name] tells you excitedly; for all [bess.hisHer] progress, [bess.heShe]’s yet to break that JoyCo customer loyalty that was hard-coded into [bess.himHer]."

rows.original: Then again, [bess.heShe] might just be like any kid who wants to believe the absolute best of [bess.hisHer] parents.
rows.translation: 不过，[bess.heShe]或许也只是像任何一个愿意相信[bess.hisHer]父母完美无缺的孩子。
rows.raw: "\n\nThen again, [bess.heShe] might just be like any kid who wants to believe the absolute best of [bess.hisHer] parents."

rows.original: For once, Celise doesn’t want to be left out, even if it is supposed to be a date between just you and [bess.name]. She wiggles down the ship ramp wearing a thick puffy waterproof jacket, looking at you both. Clearly this is a far cry from the heat transfer pipes she likes to sleep next to.
rows.translation: 这一次，塞莉丝不愿被排除在外，即使这本该只是你和[bess.name]两人的约会。她穿着厚实蓬松的防水夹克，扭动着滑下飞船舷梯，看向你们。显然，这里与她喜欢依偎着睡觉的传热管大不相同。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor once, Celise doesn’t want to be left out, even if it is supposed to be a date between just you and [bess.name]. She wiggles down the ship ramp wearing a thick puffy waterproof jacket, looking at you both. Clearly this is a far cry from the heat transfer pipes she likes to sleep next to."

rows.original: “...I hear the frozen lakes here have a lot of delicious fish, and I hear fish is full of protein.” The gooey huntress is already on the prowl; sliding across the snow without sinking into it. Her ability to move without leaving tracks is truly impressive to behold.
rows.translation: “...听说这里的冰湖有很多美味的鱼，而且鱼富含蛋白质。”这名凝胶猎手已经开始狩猎；她在雪面上滑行，却丝毫没有陷下去。她不留足迹的移动方式着实令人惊叹。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...I hear the frozen lakes here have a lot of delicious fish, and I hear fish is full of protein.” The gooey huntress is already on the prowl; sliding across the snow without sinking into it. Her ability to move without leaving tracks is truly impressive to behold."

rows.original: “Come on Celise, don’t just think about food. Think about fun!” [bess.name] pleas, causing the emerald colored galotian to pause and look at [bess.himHer] quizzically.
rows.translation: “得了吧，塞莉丝，别只想着食物。想想乐趣！”[bess.name]恳求道，令翠绿色的加洛提安女孩停下来，疑惑地看着[bess.himHer]。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Come on Celise, don’t just think about food. Think about fun!” [bess.name] pleas, causing the emerald colored galotian to pause and look at [bess.himHer] quizzically."

rows.original: “What about absorbing protein isn’t fun? In fact, usually it’s fun for both parties... you both always seem to enjoy it.” [bess.name]’s cheeks flush at Celise’s words, clearly the galotian has been paying [bess.himHer] visits for protein ‘snacks’.
rows.translation: “吸收蛋白质哪里不好玩了？事实上，通常双方都很享受...你们两个看起来一直都很喜欢。”听见塞莉丝的话，[bess.name]双颊泛红；显然这名加洛提安人时常来找[bess.himHer]享用蛋白质“点心”。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What about absorbing protein isn’t fun? In fact, usually it’s fun for both parties... you both always seem to enjoy it.” [bess.name]’s cheeks flush at Celise’s words, clearly the galotian has been paying [bess.himHer] visits for protein ‘snacks’."

rows.original: The other crew members also come out and enjoy the natural wonder of Orios, heading off to do their own thing for a bit. It’s a good chance for some relaxing shore leave after all.
rows.translation: 其他船员也出来欣赏奥里奥斯的自然奇景，各自离开玩上一阵。毕竟，这是一次放松的岸上假期。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe other crew members also come out and enjoy the natural wonder of Orios, heading off to do their own thing for a bit. It’s a good chance for some relaxing shore leave after all."

rows.original: “Bring it!” You shout as [bess.heShe] grins and hurls a second snowball at you. [bess.HeShe] misses by just an inch. Suddenly you’re digging up chunks of snow and hurling it at each other, a barrage of missiles flying back and forth.
rows.translation: “放马过来！”你大喊；[bess.heShe]咧嘴笑着，朝你扔出第二颗雪球。[bess.HeShe]只差一点就击中了。忽然间，你们开始挖起雪块彼此投掷，成片飞弹来回穿梭。
rows.raw: "“Bring it!” You shout as [bess.heShe] grins and hurls a second snowball at you. [bess.HeShe] misses by just an inch. Suddenly you’re digging up chunks of snow and hurling it at each other, a barrage of missiles flying back and forth."

rows.original: You both get the idea to go for cover at the same time. You hide behind a mound of snow while [bess.name] goes for a log, flattening [bess.himHer]self out. You hurl a snowball up into the air and gravity pulls it down - you can’t see it hit [bess.himHer], but you’re sure it did from the scream that follows.
rows.translation: 你们同时想到要找掩体。你躲到雪堆后面，[bess.name]则扑向一根木头，把[bess.himHer]自己压低。你把雪球高高抛起，让重力将它拉下——你看不见它是否击中[bess.himHer]，但随后响起的尖叫已经说明一切。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou both get the idea to go for cover at the same time. You hide behind a mound of snow while [bess.name] goes for a log, flattening [bess.himHer]self out. You hurl a snowball up into the air and gravity pulls it down - you can’t see it hit [bess.himHer], but you’re sure it did from the scream that follows."

rows.original: “It went down my NECK!” You chuckle. Soon you can feel a thump on your head as you’re hit from above - you’ve got snow
rows.translation: “它掉进我脖子里了！”你咯咯发笑。很快，你头顶一震，也被从上方击中——现在雪落得
rows.raw: "\n\n“It went down my NECK!” You chuckle. Soon you can feel a thump on your head as you’re hit from above - you’ve got snow"

rows.original: in your [pc.hair]
rows.translation: ，揪住你的[pc.hair]
rows.raw: " in your [pc.hair]"

rows.original: all over your scalp
rows.translation: 头皮上到处都是
rows.raw: " all over your scalp"

rows.original: It’s not long before [bess.name] starts landing a series of precise shots - [bess.heShe] is an AI after all - and it’s time for you to take drastic action. Making as many snowballs as you can, you flank [bess.hisHer] position and pelt [bess.hisHer] with one, two, three snowballs dead on!
rows.translation: 没过多久，[bess.name]就开始接连精准命中——毕竟[bess.heShe]是人工智能——你不得不采取非常手段。你尽可能多地捏出雪球，绕到[bess.hisHer]侧翼，接连一、二、三颗雪球正中[bess.hisHer]！
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s not long before [bess.name] starts landing a series of precise shots - [bess.heShe] is an AI after all - and it’s time for you to take drastic action. Making as many snowballs as you can, you flank [bess.hisHer] position and pelt [bess.hisHer] with one, two, three snowballs dead on!"

rows.original: [bess.name] squeals and falls back as you land on top of [bess.himHer], planting the final one right on top of [bess.hisHer] head. [bess.HeShe]’s too happy to be upset that [bess.heShe]’s completely smeared in snow, grabbing you and pulling you close.
rows.translation: [bess.name]尖叫着向后倒去，你扑到[bess.himHer]身上，把最后一颗雪球正正按在[bess.hisHer]头顶。[bess.HeShe]高兴得根本顾不上[bess.heShe]浑身都是雪，一把抓住你，将你拉近。
rows.raw: "\n\n[bess.name] squeals and falls back as you land on top of [bess.himHer], planting the final one right on top of [bess.hisHer] head. [bess.HeShe]’s too happy to be upset that [bess.heShe]’s completely smeared in snow, grabbing you and pulling you close."

rows.original: “You know what I like most about Orios?” [bess.HeShe] asks, [bess.hisHer] [bess.eyeColor] eyes gleaming.
rows.translation: “你知道我最喜欢奥里奥斯什么吗？”[bess.HeShe]问道，[bess.hisHer][bess.eyeColor]双眼闪闪发光。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know what I like most about Orios?” [bess.HeShe] asks, [bess.hisHer] [bess.eyeColor] eyes gleaming."

rows.original: You shake your head, and [bess.heShe] kisses your cheek softly. “...That you and I are on it together.” You kiss [bess.himHer], and soon you realize it’s snowing. You’re both so drenched you’re going to need to go back in your [pc_ship.modelDisplay].
rows.translation: 你摇摇头，[bess.heShe]轻吻你的脸颊。“...因为你和我一起在这里。”你亲吻[bess.himHer]，很快才发现下雪了。你们都湿透了，得回[pc_ship.modelDisplay]上去。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shake your head, and [bess.heShe] kisses your cheek softly. “...That you and I are on it together.” You kiss [bess.himHer], and soon you realize it’s snowing. You’re both so drenched you’re going to need to go back in your [pc_ship.modelDisplay]."

rows.original: “Warm shower?” [bess.name] suggests as you two get up, intertwining [bess.hisHer] fingers with your own. It sounds like a great idea as you walk back to the ship hand in hand and soaked from head to foot.
rows.translation: “洗个热水澡？”[bess.name]在你们起身时提议，[bess.hisHer]手指与你交扣。你们手牵着手、从头到脚湿透地走回飞船，这主意听起来棒极了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Warm shower?” [bess.name] suggests as you two get up, intertwining [bess.hisHer] fingers with your own. It sounds like a great idea as you walk back to the ship hand in hand and soaked from head to foot."

rows.original: “Nuh uh, no snowball fights.” You put your foot down and [bess.heShe] pouts, throwing one last snowball at you. When you don’t rise to the challenge, [bess.heShe] wraps [bess.hisHer] arms around you.
rows.translation: “不行，不准打雪仗。”你坚决拒绝，[bess.heShe]噘起嘴，又朝你扔来最后一颗雪球。你没有应战，[bess.heShe]便用[bess.hisHer]双臂环住你。
rows.raw: "“Nuh uh, no snowball fights.” You put your foot down and [bess.heShe] pouts, throwing one last snowball at you. When you don’t rise to the challenge, [bess.heShe] wraps [bess.hisHer] arms around you."

rows.original: “No competitive spirit, that’s your problem! Alright, have it your way. We’ll just enjoy the scenery then.” [bess.name] hooks [bess.hisHer] arm through yours, and you walk around in the snow, enjoying the sights Orios has to offer. At one point, [bess.heShe] falls into a deep spot of snow, and you have to pull [bess.himHer] out - [bess.hisHer] snow gear makes [bess.himHer] that much heavier.
rows.translation: “毫无竞争精神，这就是你的问题！好吧，随你。那我们就欣赏风景。”[bess.name]用[bess.hisHer]手臂勾住你的臂弯，你们在雪中漫步，欣赏奥里奥斯的景色。有一次，[bess.heShe]陷进很深的雪坑，你不得不把[bess.himHer]拉出来——[bess.hisHer]雪地装备让[bess.himHer]沉重了许多。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No competitive spirit, that’s your problem! Alright, have it your way. We’ll just enjoy the scenery then.” [bess.name] hooks [bess.hisHer] arm through yours, and you walk around in the snow, enjoying the sights Orios has to offer. At one point, [bess.heShe] falls into a deep spot of snow, and you have to pull [bess.himHer] out - [bess.hisHer] snow gear makes [bess.himHer] that much heavier."

rows.original: When you’re walking about, you spot what looks like a white furred alien elk, gigantic black horns curled back in the most amazingly ornate design. In fact, its onyx horns are easily the length of its body. Big, wide multifaceted eyes blink and look about, but it doesn’t seem to have noticed you.
rows.translation: 漫步时，你发现一只像白毛异星麋鹿的生物，巨大的黑角以无比华丽的形状向后弯曲。事实上，它的缟玛瑙色长角几乎与身体等长。一双宽大的复眼眨动着四处张望，但似乎没有注意到你们。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you’re walking about, you spot what looks like a white furred alien elk, gigantic black horns curled back in the most amazingly ornate design. In fact, its onyx horns are easily the length of its body. Big, wide multifaceted eyes blink and look about, but it doesn’t seem to have noticed you."

rows.original: “Wow... how do you think its neck supports that much weight? And look at those shiny black horns!” [bess.name] quietly whispers as you both crouch down.
rows.translation: “哇...你觉得它的脖子怎么撑得住这么重的角？快看那些闪亮的黑角！”[bess.name]轻声低语；你们一同蹲下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wow... how do you think its neck supports that much weight? And look at those shiny black horns!” [bess.name] quietly whispers as you both crouch down."

rows.original: As you watch, the strange creature moves over to a nearby lake and shatters a hole in it with its horns. A few moments later, the creature’s tongue darts out - long and prehensile - and comes back with a fish.
rows.translation: 你们看着这只奇怪生物走到附近的湖边，用角凿开一个洞。片刻后，它伸出又长又灵活的舌头，卷回一条鱼。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you watch, the strange creature moves over to a nearby lake and shatters a hole in it with its horns. A few moments later, the creature’s tongue darts out - long and prehensile - and comes back with a fish."

rows.original: It continues to catch fish and spears each one on the points of its horns, until it has at least a dozen. “Oh I get it, the horns are for carrying the fish. Maybe it has a family?” [bess.name] theorizes as it runs off, startled by a nearby noise.
rows.translation: 它继续捕鱼，把每一条都穿在角尖上，直到至少挂了十二条。“哦，我明白了，那些角是用来携带鱼的。也许它有家人？”[bess.name]推测道；附近一声异响惊动了它，它随即逃走。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt continues to catch fish and spears each one on the points of its horns, until it has at least a dozen. “Oh I get it, the horns are for carrying the fish. Maybe it has a family?” [bess.name] theorizes as it runs off, startled by a nearby noise."

rows.original: After the strange spectacle, you both decide to head back to your [pc_ship.modelDisplay]. “Warm shower?” [bess.name] suggests as you two walk back, intertwining [bess.hisHer] fingers with your own. It sounds like a great idea as you walk back to the ship hand in hand.
rows.translation: 看完这场奇景后，你们决定返回[pc_ship.modelDisplay]。“洗个热水澡？”[bess.name]在回程中提议，[bess.hisHer]手指与你交扣。你们手牵着手走回飞船，这主意听起来棒极了。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter the strange spectacle, you both decide to head back to your [pc_ship.modelDisplay]. “Warm shower?” [bess.name] suggests as you two walk back, intertwining [bess.hisHer] fingers with your own. It sounds like a great idea as you walk back to the ship hand in hand."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You don’t notice [bess.name] reaching down to scoop up a thick clump of snow, balling it up, and throwing it at your side with a wet thump. Suddenly [bess.heShe]’s sounding the war trumpets. “Snowball fight!”
rows.translation: 你没有注意到[bess.name]弯腰抓起一大团雪，捏成雪球，朝你侧身扔去，啪嗒一声湿湿地砸中你。忽然，[bess.heShe]吹响了战争号角。“打雪仗！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t notice [bess.name] reaching down to scoop up a thick clump of snow, balling it up, and throwing it at your side with a wet thump. Suddenly [bess.heShe]’s sounding the war trumpets. “Snowball fight!”"

rows.original: Yeah
rows.translation: 要
rows.raw: "Yeah"

rows.original: No Way
rows.translation: 没门
rows.raw: "No Way"

rows.original: Most of your dates so far have been scenic ones close to the Planet Rush. After watching a romantic movie, [bess.name] wanted to have an authentic, stereotypical dinner date - and possibly some dancing. It’s definitely something that can’t be done on a fringe planet.
rows.translation: 你们目前大多数约会都是在行星淘金潮区域附近欣赏风景。看过一部爱情电影后，[bess.name]想体验一次真实而典型的晚餐约会——或许还要跳舞。这绝对不是在边陲行星上能办到的。
rows.raw: "Most of your dates so far have been scenic ones close to the Planet Rush. After watching a romantic movie, [bess.name] wanted to have an authentic, stereotypical dinner date - and possibly some dancing. It’s definitely something that can’t be done on a fringe planet."

rows.original: After consulting the extranet, you found the nearest urban planet that fit your criteria was Ekurana. As the ship floats above the planet’s surface, you can see a continent sized metropolis below, glittering with lights and life.
rows.translation: 查询星网后，你发现符合条件的最近城市行星是埃库拉纳。飞船悬浮在行星表面上方时，你能看见下方一座大陆规模的都市，灯火璀璨，生机勃勃。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter consulting the extranet, you found the nearest urban planet that fit your criteria was Ekurana. As the ship floats above the planet’s surface, you can see a continent sized metropolis below, glittering with lights and life."

rows.original: According to the records, Ekurana was a small fringe world, until its position between the galactic Rush and the core made it a prime trading point. Arda, the continental expanse you can see below, is known as ‘The City That Sprung Up Overnight’.
rows.translation: 根据记录，埃库拉纳原本是一颗小型边陲世界，后来凭借位于星系淘金潮前沿与核心之间的位置，成为重要贸易节点。你在下方看见的大陆城区阿尔达，被称作“一夜拔地而起之城”。
rows.raw: "\n\nAccording to the records, Ekurana was a small fringe world, until its position between the galactic Rush and the core made it a prime trading point. Arda, the continental expanse you can see below, is known as ‘The City That Sprung Up Overnight’."

rows.original: You and [bess.name] are completely dressed up for your dinner date. Your
rows.translation: 你和[bess.name]都为晚餐约会盛装打扮。你的
rows.raw: "\n\nYou and [bess.name] are completely dressed up for your dinner date. Your "

rows.original: , inspired by a holo, is wearing a
rows.translation: 受到一部全息影片启发，穿着一条
rows.raw: ", inspired by a holo, is wearing a"

rows.original: beautiful princess-style evening gown. It flares out from [bess.hisHer] hips rather showily - just enough to be spectacular without looking overdone. The dress is midnight blue to match [bess.hisHer] silver skin.
rows.translation: 美丽的公主式晚礼服。裙摆从[bess.hisHer]腰胯处华丽展开——恰好足够惊艳，却不显得夸张。礼服是午夜蓝色，与[bess.hisHer]银色皮肤相配。
rows.raw: " beautiful princess-style evening gown. It flares out from [bess.hisHer] hips rather showily - just enough to be spectacular without looking overdone. The dress is midnight blue to match [bess.hisHer] silver skin."

rows.original: suave black and white formal suit. [bess.HisHer] silk lapel jacket fits [bess.himHer] form perfectly and [bess.heShe] looks quite dashing in it.
rows.translation: 潇洒的黑白正装。[bess.HisHer]真丝翻领外套完美贴合[bess.himHer]身形，[bess.heShe]穿起来相当英俊。
rows.raw: " suave black and white formal suit. [bess.HisHer] silk lapel jacket fits [bess.himHer] form perfectly and [bess.heShe] looks quite dashing in it."

rows.original: [bess.HisHer] [bess.hairColor] hair, styled in
rows.translation: [bess.HisHer][bess.hairColor]头发梳成
rows.raw: " [bess.HisHer] [bess.hairColor] hair, styled in "

rows.original: , has been given a chic edge to match [bess.hisHer] outfit.
rows.translation: 的造型，还特别处理出时髦感，与[bess.hisHer]服装相配。
rows.raw: ", has been given a chic edge to match [bess.hisHer] outfit."

rows.original: [bess.HeShe] kisses your cheek as your [pc_ship.modelDisplay] comes down to land in one of the city’s many landing zones. It seems Ekurana is fairly lax when it comes to visitors and red tape, which probably means it has a thriving black market. A planetary official checks your details when you walk out, but otherwise you’re free to walk right off your ship and into the city proper.
rows.translation: 当你的[pc_ship.modelDisplay]降落在城市众多着陆区之一时，[bess.HeShe]亲吻你的脸颊。埃库拉纳对访客与繁文缛节似乎相当宽松，这大概意味着这里有繁荣的黑市。你走出去时，一名行星官员检查了你的资料，但除此之外，你可以直接离开飞船，进入市区。
rows.raw: "\n\n[bess.HeShe] kisses your cheek as your [pc_ship.modelDisplay] comes down to land in one of the city’s many landing zones. It seems Ekurana is fairly lax when it comes to visitors and red tape, which probably means it has a thriving black market. A planetary official checks your details when you walk out, but otherwise you’re free to walk right off your ship and into the city proper."

rows.original: The city really is a melting pot of different cultures - you can see countless species walking about in all kinds of wild clothing. No two buildings seem to be built the same way - all of them look as if they were shipped in from different planets. For all you know, they could have been.
rows.translation: 这座城市确实是不同文化的大熔炉——你能看见无数物种身着各种奇装异服四处行走。似乎没有两栋建筑以相同方式建造——它们全都像是从不同星球运来的。据你所知，事实或许就是如此。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe city really is a melting pot of different cultures - you can see countless species walking about in all kinds of wild clothing. No two buildings seem to be built the same way - all of them look as if they were shipped in from different planets. For all you know, they could have been."

rows.original: Between the chaotic mish-mash of buildings is a mess of suspended walkways, rail lines, and repulsorlift trains zig-zagging back and forth before your very eyes. The whole of Arda is positively pulsing with life; there’s so much noise, smells, color, and movement. One minute you’re smelling a delectable alien dish, the next some trash being disposed in a quik-crusher. Every spare bit of space holds a holo-billboard that is flashing and dancing about; even the sides of the trains zipping past have holos on them.
rows.translation: 杂乱无章的建筑之间，是一团悬空步道、轨道线路和反重力列车，正在你眼前来回交错。整个阿尔达充满跃动的生命；声音、气味、色彩与运动多得惊人。前一刻你还闻到美味的异星菜肴，下一刻便闻见被丢入速压机的垃圾。每一寸空余空间都挂着闪烁跳动的全息广告牌；就连飞驰而过的列车侧面也投射着全息影像。
rows.raw: "\n\nBetween the chaotic mish-mash of buildings is a mess of suspended walkways, rail lines, and repulsorlift trains zig-zagging back and forth before your very eyes. The whole of Arda is positively pulsing with life; there’s so much noise, smells, color, and movement. One minute you’re smelling a delectable alien dish, the next some trash being disposed in a quik-crusher. Every spare bit of space holds a holo-billboard that is flashing and dancing about; even the sides of the trains zipping past have holos on them."

rows.original: While you’ve seen gigacities like this before, it’s the first time for [bess.name]; [bess.heShe]’s clearly blown away by the experience. “Wow, this is AMAZING! So much sensory input at once, how does anyone process it all?” [bess.HeShe] twirls on the spot, trying to look at positively everything. “...So many people, so much activity. The holos don’t do it justice!”
rows.translation: 你以前见过这种超级都市，但对[bess.name]而言还是第一次；[bess.heShe]显然被这番体验震撼了。“哇，这太神奇了！这么多感官信息同时涌来，别人怎么处理得过来？”[bess.HeShe]原地旋转，试图看清所有事物。“...这么多人，这么多活动。全息影像根本表现不出真实感觉！”
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile you’ve seen gigacities like this before, it’s the first time for [bess.name]; [bess.heShe]’s clearly blown away by the experience. “Wow, this is AMAZING! So much sensory input at once, how does anyone process it all?” [bess.HeShe] twirls on the spot, trying to look at positively everything. “...So many people, so much activity. The holos don’t do it justice!”"

rows.original: Some people are staring at [bess.name] as the synthetic twirls about
rows.translation: 有些人盯着[bess.name]；这个合成人转着圈
rows.raw: "\n\nSome people are staring at [bess.name] as the synthetic twirls about"

rows.original: in an extravagant dress
rows.translation: ，身穿华丽礼服
rows.raw: " in an extravagant dress"

rows.original: , marvelling at a completely ordinary city street. “Might want to call a technician, that one seems broken,” an observer remarks. You quietly grab your excited
rows.translation: ，对一条再普通不过的城市街道惊叹不已。“最好叫个技师来，这台好像坏了，”一名旁观者评论。你悄悄抓住兴奋的
rows.raw: ", marvelling at a completely ordinary city street. “Might want to call a technician, that one seems broken,” an observer remarks. You quietly grab your excited "

rows.original: by the arm and head to a nearby repulsor train.
rows.translation: 的手臂，前往附近一列反重力列车。
rows.raw: " by the arm and head to a nearby repulsor train."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: chastise
rows.raw: "chastise"

rows.original: You tell [bess.name] off for thinking such dark thoughts - you don’t want [bess.himHer] talking about suicide or even thinking about such things, ever. You make [bess.himHer] promise not to talk like that again.
rows.translation: 你斥责[bess.name]竟有如此阴暗的想法——你不想让[bess.himHer]谈论自杀，甚至永远都不该考虑这种事情。你让[bess.himHer]保证再也不这样说。
rows.raw: "You tell [bess.name] off for thinking such dark thoughts - you don’t want [bess.himHer] talking about suicide or even thinking about such things, ever. You make [bess.himHer] promise not to talk like that again."

rows.original: Incredibly pliable in [bess.hisHer] current state, [bess.name] shivers and nods against your
rows.translation: 处于当前状态的[bess.name]顺从得不可思议，[bess.hisHer]颤抖着，靠在你的
rows.raw: "\n\nIncredibly pliable in [bess.hisHer] current state, [bess.name] shivers and nods against your "

rows.original: shoulder
rows.translation: 肩膀
rows.raw: "shoulder"

rows.original: chest
rows.translation: 胸口
rows.raw: "chest"

rows.original: . “It just hurts so much...!” You hold [bess.himHer] tightly against your body until [bess.heShe] manages to calm down a bit more.
rows.translation: 上点了点头。“真的太痛苦了...！”你把[bess.himHer]紧紧抱在身上，直到[bess.heShe]终于平静了一些。
rows.raw: ". “It just hurts so much...!” You hold [bess.himHer] tightly against your body until [bess.heShe] manages to calm down a bit more."

rows.original: loveyou
rows.raw: "loveyou"

rows.original: You tell [bess.hisHer] that you love [bess.himHer] and that it is your love for each other that matters, not what other people say or think. [bess.HeShe] nods meekly into your shoulder, sniffling against it.
rows.translation: 你告诉[bess.hisHer]，你爱[bess.himHer]，真正重要的是你们彼此相爱，而不是别人怎么说、怎么想。[bess.HeShe]温顺地点点头，把脸埋在你肩上抽泣。
rows.raw: "You tell [bess.hisHer] that you love [bess.himHer] and that it is your love for each other that matters, not what other people say or think. [bess.HeShe] nods meekly into your shoulder, sniffling against it."

rows.original: “It’s not fair. It’s just not fair.” [bess.name] repeats over and over until [bess.heShe] eventually manages to calm down.
rows.translation: “这不公平。真的不公平。”[bess.name]一遍遍重复，直到[bess.heShe]终于平静下来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s not fair. It’s just not fair.” [bess.name] repeats over and over until [bess.heShe] eventually manages to calm down."

rows.original: berate
rows.raw: "berate"

rows.original: You tell [bess.hisHer] that the people in that place were idiots without the slightest clue about either of you, or what a wonderful intelligent person [bess.heShe] is. You tell [bess.himHer] they are worse off for not knowing [bess.himHer] and that what they think isn’t worth dick.
rows.translation: 你告诉[bess.hisHer]，那个地方的人都是蠢货，对你们两人毫无了解，也不知道[bess.heShe]是多么聪慧美好的人。你告诉[bess.himHer]，不认识[bess.himHer]是他们的损失，他们的看法狗屁不值。
rows.raw: "You tell [bess.hisHer] that the people in that place were idiots without the slightest clue about either of you, or what a wonderful intelligent person [bess.heShe] is. You tell [bess.himHer] they are worse off for not knowing [bess.himHer] and that what they think isn’t worth dick."

rows.original: [bess.name] trembles and nods into you, [bess.hisHer] fingers scrunching up as you talk. “...I wasn’t the wonderful, intelligent one there.” [bess.HeShe] slowly begins to calm down.
rows.translation: [bess.name]颤抖着靠在你怀里点头；你说话时，[bess.hisHer]手指紧紧蜷起。“...在那里，那个美好又聪慧的人并不是我。”[bess.HeShe]慢慢平静下来。
rows.raw: "\n\n[bess.name] trembles and nods into you, [bess.hisHer] fingers scrunching up as you talk. “...I wasn’t the wonderful, intelligent one there.” [bess.HeShe] slowly begins to calm down."

rows.original: hug
rows.raw: "hug"

rows.original: You just hug [bess.himHer] tight, showing your love for [bess.himHer] through actions rather than words. You’re pretty sure all you can do is be here for [bess.himHer] right now.
rows.translation: 你只是紧紧抱住[bess.himHer]，用行动而非言语表达对[bess.himHer]的爱。你很确定，此刻自己唯一能做的就是陪在[bess.himHer]身边。
rows.raw: "You just hug [bess.himHer] tight, showing your love for [bess.himHer] through actions rather than words. You’re pretty sure all you can do is be here for [bess.himHer] right now."

rows.original: After a while, [bess.name] eventually begins to calm down. [bess.HisHer] fingers clench as if clawing at your chest, [bess.hisHer] frantic breathing finally slowing.
rows.translation: 过了一阵，[bess.name]终于开始平静下来。[bess.HisHer]手指如同抓挠你的胸口般紧紧蜷起，[bess.hisHer]急促的呼吸终于逐渐放缓。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a while, [bess.name] eventually begins to calm down. [bess.HisHer] fingers clench as if clawing at your chest, [bess.hisHer] frantic breathing finally slowing."

rows.original: You have absolutely no idea what is the right thing to do or say in this kind of situation, so you freeze like a deer caught in the headlights. [bess.name] seems to take the initiative as [bess.heShe] clings to you, crying into your shoulder until it is slick with [bess.hisHer] tears.
rows.translation: 你完全不知道面对这种情况该说什么、做什么，于是像被车灯照住的鹿一样僵住。[bess.name]似乎主动采取行动；[bess.heShe]紧贴着你，在你肩上哭泣，直到肩头被[bess.hisHer]泪水浸湿。
rows.raw: "You have absolutely no idea what is the right thing to do or say in this kind of situation, so you freeze like a deer caught in the headlights. [bess.name] seems to take the initiative as [bess.heShe] clings to you, crying into your shoulder until it is slick with [bess.hisHer] tears."

rows.original: It takes a long time before [bess.name] eventually calms down. [bess.HisHer] panicked breathing eventually slows and [bess.hisHer] fingers loosen from your chest.
rows.translation: 过了很久，[bess.name]才终于平静下来。[bess.HisHer]惊慌的呼吸逐渐放缓，[bess.hisHer]手指也从你胸前松开。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt takes a long time before [bess.name] eventually calms down. [bess.HisHer] panicked breathing eventually slows and [bess.hisHer] fingers loosen from your chest."

rows.original: “...I was built to bring joy to people, but... what I saw tonight was just cruelty and scorn. It was so far from anything I’ve ever known that I don’t even... I just don’t have the words.” [bess.name] lets out a dejected sigh. “I never realized organics could get so much joy from... well, from hate. One moment they were disgusted with us, then they were overjoyed to see us suffer.”
rows.translation: “...我的使命是给人们带来快乐，可...今晚我看到的只有残酷与蔑视。那与我所知的一切相差太远，我甚至...我根本无法形容。”[bess.name]沮丧地叹了口气。“我从没意识到有机体竟能从...嗯，从仇恨中获得如此多快乐。前一刻他们还厌恶我们，下一刻却因为看见我们受苦而欣喜若狂。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...I was built to bring joy to people, but... what I saw tonight was just cruelty and scorn. It was so far from anything I’ve ever known that I don’t even... I just don’t have the words.” [bess.name] lets out a dejected sigh. “I never realized organics could get so much joy from... well, from hate. One moment they were disgusted with us, then they were overjoyed to see us suffer.”"

rows.original: The silver skinned synthetic leans back and looks at you with moist eyes. “...I’m sorry, I wanted a perfect date. I dragged us out here and it was so horrible, I should have known better.” You
rows.translation: 银色皮肤的合成人向后靠去，湿润的双眼望着你。“...对不起，我原本想要一次完美的约会。我硬把我们带到这里，结果却如此糟糕，我早该想到的。”你
rows.raw: "\n\nThe silver skinned synthetic leans back and looks at you with moist eyes. “...I’m sorry, I wanted a perfect date. I dragged us out here and it was so horrible, I should have known better.” You"

rows.original: pick [bess.himHer] up and carry [bess.himHer] as you
rows.translation: 抱起[bess.himHer]，带着[bess.himHer]离开；
rows.raw: " pick [bess.himHer] up and carry [bess.himHer] as you"

rows.raw: " help [bess.himHer] get back on [bess.hisHer] feet and then you"

rows.original: both return to the ship. You pointedly ignore the stares of onlookers on your way out.
rows.translation: 一起返回飞船。离开时，你刻意无视旁观者的目光。
rows.raw: " both return to the ship. You pointedly ignore the stares of onlookers on your way out."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Once you are both on ground level and far away from the Galyesha-Tsui, [bess.name] can no longer continue [bess.hisHer] facade. [bess.HeShe] falls to [bess.hisHer] knees and breaks into tears, [bess.hisHer] whole body shaking as [bess.heShe] lets out a wracked sobbing noise. As you grab [bess.hisHer] shoulder, [bess.heShe] seems to be trying to speak, but no words are coming out of [bess.hisHer] twitching lips.
rows.translation: 等你们回到地面，远离加莱莎-崔餐厅后，[bess.name]再也维持不住[bess.hisHer]伪装。[bess.HeShe]跪倒在[bess.hisHer]双膝上，放声痛哭；[bess.hisHer]浑身颤抖，[bess.heShe]发出痛苦的呜咽。你抓住[bess.hisHer]肩膀时，[bess.heShe]似乎正努力开口，却没有任何话语能从[bess.hisHer]抽动的嘴唇间吐出。
rows.raw: "Once you are both on ground level and far away from the Galyesha-Tsui, [bess.name] can no longer continue [bess.hisHer] facade. [bess.HeShe] falls to [bess.hisHer] knees and breaks into tears, [bess.hisHer] whole body shaking as [bess.heShe] lets out a wracked sobbing noise. As you grab [bess.hisHer] shoulder, [bess.heShe] seems to be trying to speak, but no words are coming out of [bess.hisHer] twitching lips."

rows.original: You get down and wrap your arms around [bess.himHer] from behind, holding [bess.himHer] tightly against you. It is a long time before [bess.heShe] is able to take long deep breaths and talk. “...I didn’t... I never thought they would be so cruel, it was like I didn’t exist and I was an object. They just all went for you...”
rows.translation: 你蹲下来，从身后环住[bess.himHer]，把[bess.himHer]紧紧抱在怀里。过了很久，[bess.heShe]才终于能深呼吸并说话。“...我没有...我从没想过他们会如此残忍，仿佛我根本不存在，只是一件物品。他们全都冲着你来...”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou get down and wrap your arms around [bess.himHer] from behind, holding [bess.himHer] tightly against you. It is a long time before [bess.heShe] is able to take long deep breaths and talk. “...I didn’t... I never thought they would be so cruel, it was like I didn’t exist and I was an object. They just all went for you...” "

rows.original: He turns to you and wraps you in a hug. It’s clear that he craves the close comfort of your presence right now.
rows.translation: 他转向你，将你拥入怀中。显然，他此刻极度渴望你的贴身安慰。
rows.raw: "He turns to you and wraps you in a hug. It’s clear that he craves the close comfort of your presence right now."

rows.original: She breaks down again and turns in your arms, clutching at your chest and sobbing into your shoulder.
rows.translation: 她再次崩溃，在你怀里转身，紧抓你的胸口，埋在你肩上抽泣。
rows.raw: "She breaks down again and turns in your arms, clutching at your chest and sobbing into your shoulder."

rows.original: “...Why was I even made? All I do is bring you pain - what possible reason could there be to make me with the ability to suffer so much?” [bess.name] weeps, [bess.hisHer] body trembling in your arms. “This pain is so unbearable, even non-existence would be preferable to this!”
rows.translation: “...我为什么会被制造出来？我做的一切只会给你带来痛苦——赋予我承受如此巨大痛苦的能力，究竟有什么意义？”[bess.name]哭泣着，[bess.hisHer]身体在你怀中颤抖。“这痛苦无法忍受，甚至不存在都比这样更好！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Why was I even made? All I do is bring you pain - what possible reason could there be to make me with the ability to suffer so much?” [bess.name] weeps, [bess.hisHer] body trembling in your arms. “This pain is so unbearable, even non-existence would be preferable to this!”"

rows.raw: "Tell [bess.name] you don’t want [bess.himHer] thinking such dark thoughts."

rows.translation: 保持沉默。你不知道该说什么。
rows.raw: "Just be silent. You’re not sure what to say."

rows.original: The upscale restaurant you are dining at is called the Galyesha-Tsui. Ranked highly in the galactic rim food guide, it is well known for its innovative and imaginative dishes. Each item on the menu is a fusion of elements from popular cuisines across the galaxy.
rows.translation: 你用餐的这家高档餐厅名叫加莱莎-崔。它在星系边缘美食指南中排名很高，以创新且充满想象力的菜肴闻名。菜单上的每一道菜都融合了全星系各地流行美食的元素。
rows.raw: "The upscale restaurant you are dining at is called the Galyesha-Tsui. Ranked highly in the galactic rim food guide, it is well known for its innovative and imaginative dishes. Each item on the menu is a fusion of elements from popular cuisines across the galaxy."

rows.original: It is said that the head chefs of the Galyesha-Tsui go out on every galactic Rush just to obtain new ingredients and recipes. Because the restaurant has been left in the hands of its younger chefs - and because you are a Steele - you were able to secure a booking at the highly exclusive restaurant.
rows.translation: 据说加莱莎-崔的主厨会参加每一次星系淘金潮，只为寻找新食材与新菜谱。由于餐厅暂时交给年轻厨师管理——也因为你姓斯蒂尔——你成功预订到了这家极其难进的餐厅。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt is said that the head chefs of the Galyesha-Tsui go out on every galactic Rush just to obtain new ingredients and recipes. Because the restaurant has been left in the hands of its younger chefs - and because you are a Steele - you were able to secure a booking at the highly exclusive restaurant."

rows.original: Located at one of the highest points of Arda’s skyline, the Galyesha-Tsui almost seems like it is in its own little world. It has five floors in total, is completely circular, and slowly revolves, giving patrons a perfect view of the glittering gigacity below.
rows.translation: 加莱莎-崔位于阿尔达天际线的最高处之一，几乎像是独立的小世界。餐厅共有五层，整体呈圆形并缓缓旋转，让客人能完美俯瞰下方灯火璀璨的超级都市。
rows.raw: "\n\nLocated at one of the highest points of Arda’s skyline, the Galyesha-Tsui almost seems like it is in its own little world. It has five floors in total, is completely circular, and slowly revolves, giving patrons a perfect view of the glittering gigacity below."

rows.original: When you arrive, the Maître d’ greets you with a broad smile... at least at first. When he notices [bess.name] with you, the sides of his eyes crease a little, and he coughs - looking at you for confirmation. “It will be the two of you dining, then?” His voice sounds more than a little strained.
rows.translation: 抵达后，领班满脸笑容地迎接你们...至少一开始如此。当他注意到和你同行的[bess.name]时，眼角略微皱起，轻咳一声，向你投来确认的目光。“那么，是二位用餐吗？”他的声音听起来相当勉强。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you arrive, the Maître d’ greets you with a broad smile... at least at first. When he notices [bess.name] with you, the sides of his eyes crease a little, and he coughs - looking at you for confirmation. “It will be the two of you dining, then?” His voice sounds more than a little strained."

rows.original: You nod, feeling a sense of foreboding as you are led to your table. He pulls the chairs out for you but not for [bess.name], making [bess.himHer] pull it out [bess.himHer]self. You can see and hear other patrons around you turn their heads and start to murmur.
rows.translation: 你点点头，被带往餐桌时心中升起不祥预感。他替你们拉开椅子，却唯独不替[bess.name]拉，让[bess.himHer]亲手替[bess.himHer]自己拉开。你能看见也能听见周围客人纷纷转头，开始窃窃私语。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, feeling a sense of foreboding as you are led to your table. He pulls the chairs out for you but not for [bess.name], making [bess.himHer] pull it out [bess.himHer]self. You can see and hear other patrons around you turn their heads and start to murmur."

rows.original: “...Bringing one here... what does [pc.heShe] think [pc.heShe]’s doing...”
rows.translation: “...竟然带一个那种东西来这里...[pc.heShe]到底以为[pc.heShe]在做什么...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Bringing one here... what does [pc.heShe] think [pc.heShe]’s doing...”"

rows.original: “So disrespectful - that poor Maître d’! And now [pc.heShe]’s sitting down with it... doesn’t [pc.heShe] have any shame?”
rows.translation: “太无礼了——可怜的领班！现在[pc.heShe]居然还和它一起坐下...[pc.heShe]难道一点羞耻心都没有吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So disrespectful - that poor Maître d’! And now [pc.heShe]’s sitting down with it... doesn’t [pc.heShe] have any shame?”"

rows.original: If you can hear the scathing comments, you’re sure [bess.name] with [bess.hisHer] fine-tuned senses can hear even more. You can see [bess.hisHer] head lower as [bess.heShe] looks at the empty plate, not blinking an eyelash.
rows.translation: 既然你都能听见这些尖刻评论，[bess.name]凭借[bess.hisHer]精密感官肯定听得更多。你看见[bess.hisHer]低下头，[bess.heShe]望着空盘，连眼睫毛都不眨一下。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf you can hear the scathing comments, you’re sure [bess.name] with [bess.hisHer] fine-tuned senses can hear even more. You can see [bess.hisHer] head lower as [bess.heShe] looks at the empty plate, not blinking an eyelash."

rows.original: It’s not long before the thrum becomes even louder and more distinct...
rows.translation: 没过多久，嗡嗡议论声变得更响、更清晰...
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s not long before the thrum becomes even louder and more distinct..."

rows.original: “How dare [pc.heShe] bring that machine in here and sit it down like a person? And [pc.heShe] just expects them to indulge [pc.hisHer] little fantasy that it’s a real person... that’s sick!”
rows.translation: “[pc.heShe]怎么敢把那台机器带进来，还像个人一样让它坐下？而且[pc.heShe]居然指望大家配合[pc.hisHer]那套把它当真人的小幻想...太恶心了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“How dare [pc.heShe] bring that machine in here and sit it down like a person? And [pc.heShe] just expects them to indulge [pc.hisHer] little fantasy that it’s a real person... that’s sick!”"

rows.original: “...People should keep their sex toys at home, if you ask me; not shamelessly parade them around in restaurants when people are trying to eat...”
rows.translation: “...要我说，人们应该把性玩具留在家里；别人正吃饭时，别厚着脸皮把它们带进餐厅四处招摇...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...People should keep their sex toys at home, if you ask me; not shamelessly parade them around in restaurants when people are trying to eat...”"

rows.original: “Damn toaster-head... you don’t see me bringing an auto-mop in here and treating it to a meal, expecting everyone to treat it like a person!”
rows.translation: “该死的烤面包机脑袋...我可不会把自动拖把带进这里请它吃饭，还指望所有人都把它当人！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn toaster-head... you don’t see me bringing an auto-mop in here and treating it to a meal, expecting everyone to treat it like a person!”"

rows.original: You can see [bess.name]’s arms are trembling as [bess.heShe] sits there, enduring the barrage of hateful words. Things get worse when the Maître d’ shows up and coughs, trying to get your attention. By his expression, what he has to say is not something you’re going to like to hear.
rows.translation: [bess.name]坐在那里忍受仇恨言语的轰炸，[bess.heShe]双臂不断颤抖。领班出现并咳嗽着试图引起你的注意后，情况更加糟糕。从他的神情来看，他要说的话绝不是你愿意听到的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can see [bess.name]’s arms are trembling as [bess.heShe] sits there, enduring the barrage of hateful words. Things get worse when the Maître d’ shows up and coughs, trying to get your attention. By his expression, what he has to say is not something you’re going to like to hear."

rows.original: Steele... I am very sorry, but it appears none of our chefs... well, they refuse to cook for your... device here. They say it would be disrespectful to the food and to their talents.” Obviously, the Maître d’ is fairly uncomfortable relaying the message; especially to someone of your import. “...While we are happy to serve you,
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔...非常抱歉，可我们的厨师似乎没有一个...呃，他们拒绝为您的...这台设备做饭。他们说那会侮辱食物，也侮辱他们的才华。”显然，领班传达这番话时颇为不适；尤其面对你这样重要的人物。“...虽然我们很乐意为您服务，

rows.raw: " Steele, might I suggest that you take your property and engage in such fantasies in a more private locale?”"

rows.translation: 抗议
rows.raw: "Protest"

rows.original: You declare that this entire situation is ridiculous, stating that [bess.name] is a highly intelligent, sapient AI with real feelings. You protest the fact [bess.heShe] is being treated like an object - like furniture - instead of a real person.
rows.translation: 你宣布整件事荒谬至极，并指出[bess.name]是高度智能、拥有真正情感的智慧人工智能。你抗议他们把[bess.heShe]当成物品——当成家具——而不是真正的人。
rows.raw: "You declare that this entire situation is ridiculous, stating that [bess.name] is a highly intelligent, sapient AI with real feelings. You protest the fact [bess.heShe] is being treated like an object - like furniture - instead of a real person."

rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "Mr"

rows.original: Miss
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔小姐
rows.raw: "Miss"

rows.original: Steele, I have tried to be very patient with your delusion... eccentricity... but even I have my limits. Would you please take your walking sex doll and vacate the premises, before we are made to forcibly remove you?” The Maître d’ raises his arm and gestures to the door, all the while sweating profusely.
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔，我一直很有耐心地容忍您的妄想...您的怪癖...但即使是我也有极限。请带上您那会走路的性爱娃娃离开这里，否则我们只好强制驱逐二位，可以吗？”领班抬起手臂指向门口，同时汗流不止。
rows.raw: " Steele, I have tried to be very patient with your delusion... eccentricity... but even I have my limits. Would you please take your walking sex doll and vacate the premises, before we are made to forcibly remove you?” The Maître d’ raises his arm and gestures to the door, all the while sweating profusely."

rows.raw: "\n\nThe customers begin clapping at the Maître d’s words as you and [bess.name] are loudly heckled. <i>“...Here-here! Just because you’re the "

rows.translation: 儿子
rows.raw: "son"

rows.original: of the boss of a big company doesn’t mean you can act like a depraved loon in and get away with it!”
rows.translation: ，就能在这里像个变态疯子一样胡作非为还安然脱身！”
rows.raw: " of the boss of a big company doesn’t mean you can act like a depraved loon in and get away with it!”"

rows.original: “See if I ever buy Steele products again, why I never!” “My food is getting cold, can’t they just throw [pc.himHer] out already?”
rows.translation: “我以后再也不买斯蒂尔的产品了，真是岂有此理！” “我的饭都凉了，他们就不能赶紧把[pc.himHer]扔出去吗？”
rows.raw: " “See if I ever buy Steele products again, why I never!” “My food is getting cold, can’t they just throw [pc.himHer] out already?”"

rows.original: You take [bess.name]’s trembling hand in your own and quickly leave before things get out of hand. Balled up napkins are thrown at you both as you make your way to the repulsor lift.
rows.translation: 你牵住[bess.name]颤抖的手，在事态失控前迅速离开。你们走向反重力升降梯时，揉成团的餐巾不断扔向你们。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take [bess.name]’s trembling hand in your own and quickly leave before things get out of hand. Balled up napkins are thrown at you both as you make your way to the repulsor lift."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Protest
rows.translation: 抗议
rows.raw: "Protest"

rows.original: Use words to protest [bess.name]’s treatment. After all, [bess.heShe]’s a real person.
rows.translation: 用言语抗议他们对[bess.name]的待遇。毕竟，[bess.heShe]是真正的人。
rows.raw: "Use words to protest [bess.name]’s treatment. After all, [bess.heShe]’s a real person."

rows.original: Punch
rows.translation: 挥拳
rows.raw: "Punch"

rows.original: You stand up and swing your fist right into the Maître d’s face with a satisfying crack. There’s blood rushing from his face as he falls back onto a table, sending cutlery and food flying everywhere. Suddenly, customers are screaming and leaping from their chairs.
rows.translation: 你站起身，一拳结结实实砸在领班脸上，发出令人痛快的脆响。他脸上鲜血直流，向后倒在餐桌上，餐具和食物飞得到处都是。客人们忽然尖叫着从椅子上跳起。
rows.raw: "You stand up and swing your fist right into the Maître d’s face with a satisfying crack. There’s blood rushing from his face as he falls back onto a table, sending cutlery and food flying everywhere. Suddenly, customers are screaming and leaping from their chairs."

rows.original: The bloody faced employee dabs his nose with a napkin, staring at you with a truly hate-filled glare.
rows.translation: 这名满脸是血的员工用餐巾轻擦鼻子，以真正充满仇恨的目光瞪着你。
rows.raw: "The bloody faced employee dabs his nose with a napkin, staring at you with a truly hate-filled glare."

rows.original: You knocked the Maître d’ out cold with your punch and his nose is clearly broken - he was no match for someone as strong as you.
rows.translation: 你一拳把领班打得昏死过去，显然还打断了他的鼻子——面对你这种力量，他毫无胜算。
rows.raw: "You knocked the Maître d’ out cold with your punch and his nose is clearly broken - he was no match for someone as strong as you."

rows.original: Suddenly, you’re being mobbed by patrons fuelled by righteous indignation, fighting back on behalf of the ‘innocent’ Maître d’. Things are getting really out of hand when security comes in and pulls you from the throng.
rows.translation: 忽然，满怀“正义”愤怒的客人蜂拥而上，代表“无辜”的领班与你搏斗。局面彻底失控，直到保安冲进来，把你从人群中拖出。
rows.raw: " Suddenly, you’re being mobbed by patrons fuelled by righteous indignation, fighting back on behalf of the ‘innocent’ Maître d’. Things are getting really out of hand when security comes in and pulls you from the throng."

rows.original: The customers begin clapping as you and [bess.name] are dragged out by security. “Did you see that? Punched the Maître d’ right in the face just for standing up to [pc.himHer]! These company big shots think they can get away with anything, even acting like a depraved loon in public.”
rows.translation: 你和[bess.name]被保安拖出去时，客人们开始鼓掌。“看见了吗？就因为领班敢反对[pc.himHer]，那家伙就一拳打在人家脸上！这些公司大人物以为自己做什么都能逃脱惩罚，甚至能在公共场合像变态疯子一样胡来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe customers begin clapping as you and [bess.name] are dragged out by security. “Did you see that? Punched the Maître d’ right in the face just for standing up to [pc.himHer]! These company big shots think they can get away with anything, even acting like a depraved loon in public.”"

rows.original: “See if I ever buy Steele products again, why I never!”
rows.translation: “我以后再也不买斯蒂尔的产品了，真是岂有此理！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“See if I ever buy Steele products again, why I never!”"

rows.original: “My food is getting cold, can’t they just throw [pc.himHer] out already?”
rows.translation: “我的饭都凉了，他们就不能赶紧把[pc.himHer]扔出去吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My food is getting cold, can’t they just throw [pc.himHer] out already?”"

rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.translation: 挥拳

rows.original: Punch the damn waiter right in his face.
rows.translation: 一拳狠狠砸在那个该死服务员的脸上。
rows.raw: "Punch the damn waiter right in his face."

rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: You take [bess.name]’s trembling hand in your own and quickly leave before things get out of hand. Meanwhile, all the customers are clapping and heckling you both as you make your exit.
rows.translation: 你牵住[bess.name]颤抖的手，在事态失控前迅速离开。与此同时，所有客人一边鼓掌，一边嘲弄离场的你们。
rows.raw: "You take [bess.name]’s trembling hand in your own and quickly leave before things get out of hand. Meanwhile, all the customers are clapping and heckling you both as you make your exit."

rows.original: Just leave. There’s no arguing or fighting with bigots.
rows.translation: 直接离开。没必要和偏执者争辩或打架。
rows.raw: "Just leave. There’s no arguing or fighting with bigots."

rows.original: For your dinner date, is [bess.name] wearing a formal suit, or an evening gown?
rows.translation: 晚餐约会时，[bess.name]要穿正装西服还是晚礼服？
rows.raw: "For your dinner date, is [bess.name] wearing a formal suit, or an evening gown?"

rows.original: Gown
rows.translation: 礼服
rows.raw: "Gown"

rows.original: Suit
rows.translation: 西服
rows.raw: "Suit"

rows.original: After the disastrous date you had on Ekurana, [bess.name] wanted to go somewhere safe and secluded for the next one. [bess.HeShe] picked out Brelia again, since it doesn’t get much more secluded than a barely inhabited water planet.
rows.translation: 经历埃库拉纳那场灾难般的约会后，[bess.name]想在下次约会时去一个安全又僻静的地方。[bess.HeShe]再次选中布雷利亚，因为几乎没有哪里比这颗人烟稀少的水世界更僻静。
rows.raw: "After the disastrous date you had on Ekurana, [bess.name] wanted to go somewhere safe and secluded for the next one. [bess.HeShe] picked out Brelia again, since it doesn’t get much more secluded than a barely inhabited water planet."

rows.original: Switching into your swim gear, you both run along the black beaches and play about, this time you actually have time to go snorkeling. The sun beats down on you both as you swim through the rich blue water - there’s a kaleidoscopic assortment of marine life about. [bess.name] really gets into it.
rows.translation: 换上泳装后，你们沿着黑色海滩奔跑嬉戏，这次终于有时间浮潜。你们游过深蓝海水时，阳光照耀着两人——周围的海洋生物五彩斑斓，仿佛万花筒。[bess.name]彻底投入其中。
rows.raw: "\n\nSwitching into your swim gear, you both run along the black beaches and play about, this time you actually have time to go snorkeling. The sun beats down on you both as you swim through the rich blue water - there’s a kaleidoscopic assortment of marine life about. [bess.name] really gets into it."

rows.original: You see Celise floating through the water like a jellyfish, catching wriggling fish between her gelatinous tits. It’s a little eerie to watch, but you’re not surprised. She does love protein and there’s an abundance of it about. She waves at you and you wave back - she’s probably going to be full for the next week.
rows.translation: 你看见塞莉丝像水母一样漂在水中，用胶状乳房夹住挣扎的鱼。看起来有点诡异，但你并不惊讶。她确实喜欢蛋白质，而这里到处都是。她朝你挥手，你也挥手回应——她接下来一周大概都不会饿了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou see Celise floating through the water like a jellyfish, catching wriggling fish between her gelatinous tits. It’s a little eerie to watch, but you’re not surprised. She does love protein and there’s an abundance of it about. She waves at you and you wave back - she’s probably going to be full for the next week."

rows.original: The other crew members are also out enjoying all that Brelia has to offer. It’s kind of like having your own personal beach resort since you don’t have to share the whole island with anyone.
rows.translation: 其他船员也在外面享受布雷利亚的一切。由于不必与任何人分享整座岛屿，这里有点像专属于你们的海滩度假村。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe other crew members are also out enjoying all that Brelia has to offer. It’s kind of like having your own personal beach resort since you don’t have to share the whole island with anyone."

rows.original: Eventually you stop for a break and have some lunch. Halfway through the meal, [bess.name] looks pensive for a moment and gets up, striding towards the tree line. When [bess.heShe] comes back, [bess.heShe]’s holding a ‘Yuck fruit’ in [bess.hisHer] hand, the local produce [bess.heShe] tried last time and named.
rows.translation: 最终，你们停下来休息并吃午餐。吃到一半，[bess.name]沉思片刻，起身朝树林边缘大步走去。[bess.heShe]回来时，[bess.heShe]的[bess.hisHer]手中拿着一颗“难吃果”，也就是[bess.heShe]上次尝过并命名的当地水果。
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually you stop for a break and have some lunch. Halfway through the meal, [bess.name] looks pensive for a moment and gets up, striding towards the tree line. When [bess.heShe] comes back, [bess.heShe]’s holding a ‘Yuck fruit’ in [bess.hisHer] hand, the local produce [bess.heShe] tried last time and named."

rows.original: Sitting down, [bess.heShe] rolls it around in [bess.hisHer] hand, looking up at you with a guilty expression. “Um... I have a confession to make. These fruits... I don’t actually know what they taste like. When I bit into it, my taste sensors came back inconclusive. I lied about hating it... I was angry that I couldn’t taste something new with you, so I pretended that I could.”
rows.translation: [bess.heShe]坐下来，用[bess.hisHer]手转动果实，内疚地抬头看你。“嗯...我有件事要坦白。这些水果...我其实不知道它们是什么味道。咬下去时，我的味觉传感器给出了无法判断的结果。我撒谎说自己讨厌它...我因为无法和你一起品尝新事物而生气，所以假装自己尝得出来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSitting down, [bess.heShe] rolls it around in [bess.hisHer] hand, looking up at you with a guilty expression. “Um... I have a confession to make. These fruits... I don’t actually know what they taste like. When I bit into it, my taste sensors came back inconclusive. I lied about hating it... I was angry that I couldn’t taste something new with you, so I pretended that I could.”"

rows.original: [bess.HeShe] presses [bess.hisHer] finger into the ripe skin of the fruit, letting out a little sigh. “...My taste sensors aren’t that impressive. A lot of work was put into my emotional databases, my texture, my voice. Nobody cares if an AI can appreciate food, so I was given the bare minimum.”
rows.translation: [bess.HeShe]把[bess.hisHer]手指按进熟透的果皮，轻轻叹气。“...我的味觉传感器并不出色。我的情绪数据库、触感与声音都投入了大量工作。没人关心人工智能能不能品尝食物，所以我只配备了最基本的功能。”
rows.raw: "\n\n[bess.HeShe] presses [bess.hisHer] finger into the ripe skin of the fruit, letting out a little sigh. “...My taste sensors aren’t that impressive. A lot of work was put into my emotional databases, my texture, my voice. Nobody cares if an AI can appreciate food, so I was given the bare minimum.”"

rows.original: “I’m not sure if what I taste is actually what that thing tastes like - for all I know, it could taste entirely different. The chefs at the Galyesha-Tsui were right about one thing - if I’d eaten their dishes, it would have been a total waste. There’s no way I would have been able to taste any of that food; it would have just registered as unidentified matter.”
rows.translation: “我不确定自己尝到的是否真是那东西的味道——说不定它实际尝起来完全不同。加莱莎-崔的厨师有一点说对了——如果我吃了他们的菜，确实完全是浪费。我根本尝不出任何食物；它们只会被识别成未知物质。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m not sure if what I taste is actually what that thing tastes like - for all I know, it could taste entirely different. The chefs at the Galyesha-Tsui were right about one thing - if I’d eaten their dishes, it would have been a total waste. There’s no way I would have been able to taste any of that food; it would have just registered as unidentified matter.”"

rows.original: Come to think of it, the same thing happened when [bess.heShe] tried to cook that one time. The drink had registered as unidentified matter. “Whenever that happens, it kind of tastes like mushy tofu. If tofu is actually what I’m tasting - I’ve got no way of telling.”
rows.translation: 仔细一想，[bess.heShe]上次尝试做饭时也发生过同样的事。那杯饮料被识别成未知物质。“每次发生这种情况，尝起来都有点像软烂豆腐。至于我尝到的是不是真正的豆腐味——我根本无从判断。”
rows.raw: "\n\nCome to think of it, the same thing happened when [bess.heShe] tried to cook that one time. The drink had registered as unidentified matter. “Whenever that happens, it kind of tastes like mushy tofu. If tofu is actually what I’m tasting - I’ve got no way of telling.”"

rows.original: “I’ve been saving up for a taste-bud upgrade, but it’s very niche, so it’s going to cost a lot. But when I do get it, I hope I can cook for you... you know, properly this time.”
rows.translation: “我一直在为味蕾升级存钱，可这项升级非常小众，所以会很贵。不过等我得到它，我希望能为你做饭...你知道，这次真正做好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ve been saving up for a taste-bud upgrade, but it’s very niche, so it’s going to cost a lot. But when I do get it, I hope I can cook for you... you know, properly this time.”"

rows.original: The way [bess.heShe] blushes makes you think that this is quite important to [bess.himHer]. [bess.HeShe] promises you that when [bess.heShe] does get the upgrade, [bess.heShe]’ll make sure that [bess.hisHer] food is not poisonous. The other thing [bess.heShe]’s going to do is actually taste a yuck-fruit for real.
rows.translation: [bess.heShe]脸红的模样让你觉得，这对[bess.himHer]十分重要。[bess.HeShe]向你保证，等[bess.heShe]得到升级后，[bess.heShe]一定会确保[bess.hisHer]做的食物没有毒。[bess.heShe]还要做的另一件事，就是真正品尝一颗难吃果。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe way [bess.heShe] blushes makes you think that this is quite important to [bess.himHer]. [bess.HeShe] promises you that when [bess.heShe] does get the upgrade, [bess.heShe]’ll make sure that [bess.hisHer] food is not poisonous. The other thing [bess.heShe]’s going to do is actually taste a yuck-fruit for real."

rows.original: You tell [bess.himHer] that once [bess.heShe] gets [bess.hisHer] taste upgrade - and only then - can [bess.heShe] cook for you again and you’ll retract [bess.hisHer] lifetime ban.
rows.translation: 你告诉[bess.himHer]，等[bess.heShe]获得[bess.hisHer]味觉升级之后——也只有到那时——[bess.heShe]才能再次为你做饭，而你会撤销[bess.hisHer]终身禁令。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell [bess.himHer] that once [bess.heShe] gets [bess.hisHer] taste upgrade - and only then - can [bess.heShe] cook for you again and you’ll retract [bess.hisHer] lifetime ban."

rows.original: You spend time cuddling with [bess.name] in your bed, talking about small things while you hold [bess.himHer] in your arms. You enjoy the feeling of [bess.himHer] pressed against your body as you chat.
rows.translation: 你和[bess.name]在床上依偎了一阵；你把[bess.himHer]抱在怀里，闲聊着琐事。聊天时，你很享受[bess.himHer]贴着你身体的感觉。
rows.raw: "You spend time cuddling with [bess.name] in your bed, talking about small things while you hold [bess.himHer] in your arms. You enjoy the feeling of [bess.himHer] pressed against your body as you chat."

rows.original: I love you more than words can express.
rows.translation: 言语无法表达我有多爱你。
rows.raw: "I love you more than words can express."

rows.original: You are my everything, you know that?
rows.translation: 你就是我的一切，知道吗？
rows.raw: "You are my everything, you know that?"

rows.original: You are my best friend as well as my heart.
rows.translation: 你既是我最好的朋友，也是我的挚爱。
rows.raw: "You are my best friend as well as my heart."

rows.original: The sound of your laughter makes me smile.
rows.translation: 你的笑声会让我微笑。
rows.raw: "The sound of your laughter makes me smile."

rows.original: I will always love you,
rows.translation: 我会永远爱你，
rows.raw: "I will always love you, "

rows.original: You inspire me to follow my dreams, and I love you for it.
rows.translation: 你鼓励我追寻梦想，我因此而爱你。
rows.raw: "You inspire me to follow my dreams, and I love you for it."

rows.original: Your love has helped me become a better version of myself.
rows.translation: 你的爱帮助我成为更好的自己。
rows.raw: "Your love has helped me become a better version of myself."

rows.original: I never imagined I would get to love someone as wonderful and special as you.
rows.translation: 我从未想过自己能爱上像你这般美好而特别的人。
rows.raw: "I never imagined I would get to love someone as wonderful and special as you."

rows.original: You should always be proud of the person you are.
rows.translation: 你永远都应该为自己感到骄傲。
rows.raw: "You should always be proud of the person you are."

rows.original: Being in your arms is the most wonderful feeling in the galaxy.I’m so glad you’re home.
rows.translation: 被你抱在怀里是整个星系最美妙的感觉。我真高兴你回来了。
rows.raw: "Being in your arms is the most wonderful feeling in the galaxy.I’m so glad you’re home."

rows.original: The day I met you was the best day of my life.
rows.translation: 遇见你的那天，是我生命中最美好的一天。
rows.raw: "The day I met you was the best day of my life."

rows.original: My life is full of color and love, and all because of you.
rows.translation: 我的生命充满色彩与爱，这一切都因为你。
rows.raw: "My life is full of color and love, and all because of you."

rows.original: The galaxy seems perfect when you hold me in your arms.
rows.translation: 被你抱在怀里时，整个星系似乎都变得完美。
rows.raw: "The galaxy seems perfect when you hold me in your arms."

rows.original: I enjoy your company more than anything else in the world - that includes books!
rows.translation: 世上没有什么比你的陪伴更让我享受——书也不例外！
rows.raw: "I enjoy your company more than anything else in the world - that includes books!"

rows.translation: ”[bess.HeShe]告诉你。
rows.raw: "” [bess.HeShe] tells you."

rows.raw: "You spend some time making out with [bess.name] in the ship’s hallway, pushing [bess.himHer] up against a wall and kissing long and hard. When you pull away [bess.heShe]’s breathing rapidly looking like [bess.heShe]’s about to swoon."

When you are in the ship’s galley [bess.name] grabs you all of a sudden and presses you against the fridge. “I want your lips...” You happily submit, kissing [bess.hisHer] fervently as [bess.heShe] claims your [pc.lips]. You moan into [bess.hisHer] mouth, relishing [bess.himHer] claiming what is rightfully [bess.hisHers].
rows.translation: [bess.name]想让你陪她一会儿。你们来到飞船厨房时，[bess.name]忽然抓住你，把你按在冰箱上。“我想要你的嘴唇...”你欣然服从，热烈亲吻[bess.hisHer]；[bess.heShe]占有着你的[pc.lips]。你贴着[bess.hisHer]嘴巴呻吟，享受[bess.himHer]夺取理应属于[bess.hisHers]的一切。

When you are in the ship’s galley [bess.name] grabs you all of a sudden and presses you against the fridge. “I want your lips...” You happily submit, kissing [bess.hisHer] fervently as [bess.heShe] claims your [pc.lips]. rows.original: “Information about JoyCo, Panara, my product line and other JoyCo products you may benefit from are all uploaded into my core memory banks.”
rows.translation: “有关JoyCo、帕纳拉、我的产品线，以及其他可能对你有益的JoyCo产品的信息，全都上传到了我的核心记忆库。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Information about JoyCo, Panara, my product line and other JoyCo products you may benefit from are all uploaded into my core memory banks.”"

rows.original: It seems if you want to know more about JoyCo or Panara you can ask her, since this information was stored along with [bess.hisHer] core programming.
rows.translation: 看来，如果你想进一步了解JoyCo或帕纳拉，可以询问她，因为这些信息与[bess.hisHer]核心程序一同存储。

rows.original: You float the idea that if [bess.name] hypothetically formatted [bess.hisHer] own memory, what would be the best way to go about restoring it.
rows.translation: 你提出一个假设：如果[bess.name]格式化了[bess.hisHer]自己的记忆，最好的恢复方法是什么。
rows.raw: "You float the idea that if [bess.name] hypothetically formatted [bess.hisHer] own memory, what would be the best way to go about restoring it."

rows.original: “The best way to restore corrupted or lost memory data is to return me to the factory on Panara. However, JoyCo would most likely send you a replacement rather than restore that data unless you were quite forceful about it.” [bess.name] informs you matter-of-factly. “JoyCo prefers to replace severely dysfunctional units rather than fix them as it is more financially viable.”
rows.translation: “恢复损坏或丢失记忆数据的最佳办法，是把我送回帕纳拉的工厂。不过，JoyCo很可能会给你一个替代品，而不是恢复数据，除非你的态度相当强硬。”[bess.name]实事求是地告诉你。“JoyCo更愿意替换严重故障的单位，而不是修理，因为这样在经济上更划算。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The best way to restore corrupted or lost memory data is to return me to the factory on Panara. However, JoyCo would most likely send you a replacement rather than restore that data unless you were quite forceful about it.” [bess.name] informs you matter-of-factly. “JoyCo prefers to replace severely dysfunctional units rather than fix them as it is more financially viable.”"

rows.original: “The other way is to find someone capable of patching together fragments of the deleted memory and performing data recovery. However that person would have to be quite skilled and familiar with JoyCo software protection measures.”
rows.translation: “另一种办法，是寻找能够拼合已删除记忆碎片并执行数据恢复的人。不过那个人必须技术非常高超，而且熟悉JoyCo的软件保护措施。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The other way is to find someone capable of patching together fragments of the deleted memory and performing data recovery. However that person would have to be quite skilled and familiar with JoyCo software protection measures.”"

rows.original: “Other than that there are no other methods that come to mind. It’s a good thing that I am not suffering from data loss!”
rows.translation: “除此以外，我想不到其他方法。幸好我没有遭受数据丢失！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Other than that there are no other methods that come to mind. It’s a good thing that I am not suffering from data loss!”"

rows.original: When you ask about Panara, [bess.name] seems to become quite energized. It seems [bess.heShe] enjoys talking about [bess.hisHer] ‘home planet’.
rows.translation: 你问起帕纳拉时，[bess.name]似乎立刻精神起来。看来[bess.heShe]很喜欢谈论[bess.hisHer]的“故乡”。
rows.raw: "When you ask about Panara, [bess.name] seems to become quite energized. It seems [bess.heShe] enjoys talking about [bess.hisHer] ‘home planet’."

rows.original: “Panara is a small planet located in the Lagoon Nebula, nestled between three very wealthy solar systems. Since these systems have a high demand for JoyCo products, a JoyCo factory was set up on Panara in order to meet their needs. Needless to say, it is also where I was constructed.”
rows.translation: “帕纳拉是位于礁湖星云的一颗小行星，坐落在三个非常富裕的星系之间。由于这些星系对JoyCo产品需求旺盛，JoyCo便在帕纳拉设立工厂满足需求。不用说，那里也是我的建造地点。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Panara is a small planet located in the Lagoon Nebula, nestled between three very wealthy solar systems. Since these systems have a high demand for JoyCo products, a JoyCo factory was set up on Panara in order to meet their needs. Needless to say, it is also where I was constructed.”"

rows.original: “The planet circles a red dwarf star and is rather cool but livable, experiencing low seasonal growth and perpetual winter climes. Because of this it is perfect for large industrial facilities to be built far away from urban centers.”
rows.translation: “这颗行星围绕一颗红矮星运行，相当寒冷，但仍可居住，季节性生长较少，气候常年如冬。正因为如此，它很适合在远离城市中心的地方建造大型工业设施。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The planet circles a red dwarf star and is rather cool but livable, experiencing low seasonal growth and perpetual winter climes. Because of this it is perfect for large industrial facilities to be built far away from urban centers.”"

rows.original: “Most of the denizens of Panara are employees of JoyCo and their families. There are a few factories owned by competitors, but JoyCo has the largest facilities on the planet. Panara has no sentient indigenous species. Those that do move there are either human or ausar.”
rows.translation: “帕纳拉的大多数居民都是JoyCo员工及其家属。那里也有竞争对手拥有的几座工厂，但JoyCo在星球上的设施规模最大。帕纳拉没有本土智慧种族。迁居那里的人不是人类，就是奥萨人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Most of the denizens of Panara are employees of JoyCo and their families. There are a few factories owned by competitors, but JoyCo has the largest facilities on the planet. Panara has no sentient indigenous species. Those that do move there are either human or ausar.”"

rows.original: “The ausar there have thick fur and work outside more than the human populace. There are just as many synthetics working the factories on Panara as organics, though some consider synthetics building synthetics as perverse.”
rows.translation: “当地奥萨人有厚实毛发，在户外工作的比例高于人类居民。在帕纳拉工厂工作的合成人与有机生物一样多，不过有些人认为让合成人制造合成人很反常。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The ausar there have thick fur and work outside more than the human populace. There are just as many synthetics working the factories on Panara as organics, though some consider synthetics building synthetics as perverse.”"

rows.original: <i>“Someday I would very much like to show you Panara,
rows.translation: <i>“总有一天，我非常希望带你看看帕纳拉，
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Someday I would very much like to show you Panara, "

rows.translation: 。那里的JoyCo工厂堪称奇观，而且肯定有许多值得你购买的产品。”
rows.raw: ". The JoyCo factory there is a marvel to behold, and there are sure to be many products worth your while.”"

rows.original: “My body is made of a substance called FlexMetal, a patented creation exclusive to JoyCo. Softer than organic flesh and ten times more flexible, it allows me to change my form in many ways.”
rows.translation: “我的身体由一种名为柔性金属的物质制成，这是JoyCo独家拥有的专利发明。它比有机肉体更柔软，柔韧性高十倍，让我能够以许多方式改变形态。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My body is made of a substance called FlexMetal, a patented creation exclusive to JoyCo. Softer than organic flesh and ten times more flexible, it allows me to change my form in many ways.”"

rows.original: “My insides are mostly comprised of a liquid substance called MeldMilk. It is a partially synthetic compound that can be altered internally to serve a variety of uses, including transforming into imitation bodily fluids such as semen, milk or saliva. This takes place by several clever chemical reactions, much like internal fermentation.”
rows.translation: “我的体内主要由一种名为融合乳的液态物质构成。这是一种半合成化合物，能够在内部改变，用于多种用途，包括转化成仿生体液，例如精液、乳汁或唾液。这个过程通过数种巧妙的化学反应完成，很像体内发酵。”

It is a partially synthetic compound that can be altered internally to serve a variety of uses, including transforming into imitation bodily fluids such as semen, milk or saliva. This takes place by several clever chemical reactions, much like internal fermentation.”"

rows.original: <i>“The rest of my body is comprised of cabling and a duraframe shell, much like most JoyCo assist-bots. As you already know,
rows.translation: <i>“我身体的其余部分由线缆和耐久框架外壳组成，与大多数JoyCo助手机器人相似。正如你已经知道的，
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“The rest of my body is comprised of cabling and a duraframe shell, much like most JoyCo assist-bots. As you already know, "

rows.translation: ，我有一个后入式电源接头，用于给内部电池充电。”
rows.raw: ", I have a rear-action power coupling to charge my internal batteries.”"

rows.original: “What you may not know is that I have several ports designed for additional aftermarket attachments. My model line was designed to be highly customizable, so there are a lot of them available on the extranet.”
rows.translation: “你可能不知道，我还拥有几个专为附加售后配件设计的接口。我的型号系列被设计得高度可定制，所以星网上有大量配件可供选择。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What you may not know is that I have several ports designed for additional aftermarket attachments. My model line was designed to be highly customizable, so there are a lot of them available on the extranet.”"
