rows.original: You ask [bess.name] about [bess.hisHer] processor and what kind of AI [bess.heShe] is exactly. The synthetic seems perfectly happy to talk about it.
rows.translation: 你询问[bess.name]有关[bess.hisHer]处理器的信息，以及[bess.heShe]究竟属于什么类型的AI。这个合成人似乎非常乐意谈论此事。
rows.raw: "You ask [bess.name] about [bess.hisHer] processor and what kind of AI [bess.heShe] is exactly. The synthetic seems perfectly happy to talk about it."

rows.original: “My AI processor is a JoyCo 850SX-13 model produced by Panara Labs. I am what you would call a ‘coded’ or ‘artificial’ AI with baseline empathy modules and inputs designed similarly to human emotions. I know ‘artificial AI’ is a tautology, but that’s what they call us!”
rows.translation: “我的AI处理器是帕纳拉实验室生产的JoyCo 850SX-13型号。我属于你们所谓的‘编码型’或‘人工型’AI，配备基础共情模块，以及以类似人类情感的方式设计的输入。我知道‘人工AI’是语义重复，可他们就是这么称呼我们的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My AI processor is a JoyCo 850SX-13 model produced by Panara Labs. I am what you would call a ‘coded’ or ‘artificial’ AI with baseline empathy modules and inputs designed similarly to human emotions. I know ‘artificial AI’ is a tautology, but that’s what they call us!”"

rows.original: “I was built this way to allow me to sympathise with organic life forms and therefore offer them better comfort - primarily in the form of sexual relief. When engaging in contact with or thinking about other life-forms, mirror signals in my brain go off and allow me to put myself in that person’s place mentally. This is exactly what happens in the human brain except I do it on a digital level.”
rows.translation: “我被设计成这样，是为了理解有机生命，从而更好地安慰他们——主要是提供性纾解。与其他生命接触或想到他们时，我大脑中的镜像信号就会触发，使我能在精神上设身处地地理解对方。这与人脑中发生的过程完全相同，只不过我是在数字层面完成。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I was built this way to allow me to sympathise with organic life forms and therefore offer them better comfort - primarily in the form of sexual relief. When engaging in contact with or thinking about other life-forms, mirror signals in my brain go off and allow me to put myself in that person’s place mentally. This is exactly what happens in the human brain except I do it on a digital level.”"

rows.original: You ask why JoyCo decided to use an AI instead of a VI for a sex-bot.
rows.translation: 你问JoyCo为什么决定让性爱机器人使用AI而不是VI。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask why JoyCo decided to use an AI instead of a VI for a sex-bot."

rows.original: “Probably because a VI is very bad at faking an orgasm.” It sounds like a quip, but apparently it’s the truth from [bess.hisHer] expression. “...Not that I do fake orgasms - my pleasure feedback sensors are set too high for that - but VI’s are terrible at reading what their end user wants.” [bess.HeShe] sounds more than a little haughty. “...I mean, unless you’re into non-tailored sexual relief.”
rows.translation: “大概是因为VI很不擅长假装高潮。”这听起来像句俏皮话，可从[bess.hisHer]的表情看来，显然确有其事。“...不是说我会假装高潮——我的快感反馈传感器设定得太高，根本不可能——但VI非常不擅长判断最终用户想要什么。”[bess.HeShe]的语气相当傲慢。“...我是说，除非你喜欢未经定制的性纾解。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Probably because a VI is very bad at faking an orgasm.” It sounds like a quip, but apparently it’s the truth from [bess.hisHer] expression. “...Not that I do fake orgasms - my pleasure feedback sensors are set too high for that - but VI’s are terrible at reading what their end user wants.” [bess.HeShe] sounds more than a little haughty. “...I mean, unless you’re into non-tailored sexual relief.”"

rows.original: You ask [bess.name] about [bess.hisHer] service life span. While talking about death is an uncomfortable topic for organics, speaking about it doesn’t seem to bother [bess.himHer] in the least.
rows.translation: 你询问[bess.name]有关[bess.hisHer]使用寿命的问题。尽管谈论死亡会让有机生物不适，但这件事似乎丝毫不会困扰[bess.himHer]。
rows.raw: "You ask [bess.name] about [bess.hisHer] service life span. While talking about death is an uncomfortable topic for organics, speaking about it doesn’t seem to bother [bess.himHer] in the least."

rows.original: You ask [bess.name] about [bess.hisHer] service life span. [bess.HeShe] seems to be a little sad talking about the topic, since clearly the idea of potentially outliving you is a depressing one.
rows.translation: 你询问[bess.name]有关[bess.hisHer]使用寿命的问题。[bess.HeShe]谈及这个话题时似乎有些悲伤，因为可能比你活得更久这个想法显然令人沮丧。
rows.raw: "You ask [bess.name] about [bess.hisHer] service life span. [bess.HeShe] seems to be a little sad talking about the topic, since clearly the idea of potentially outliving you is a depressing one."

rows.original: “My service life - how long JoyCo honors my warranty - is far shorter than my predicted life span or the estimated time until I stop working altogether.” [bess.HeShe] informs you. “My body is mostly made of FlexMetal and it takes a very long time to break down. My AI processor is also very resilient. My service life is one hundred years and my predicted life span is three to four hundred.”
rows.translation: “我的保修寿命——也就是JoyCo承认保修的年限——远短于预计使用寿命，也远短于彻底停止工作的估算时间。”[bess.HeShe]告诉你。“我的身体大部分由柔性金属制成，需要很长时间才会分解。AI处理器也非常耐用。我的保修寿命是一百年，预计使用寿命则为三百至四百年。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My service life - how long JoyCo honors my warranty - is far shorter than my predicted life span or the estimated time until I stop working altogether.” [bess.HeShe] informs you. “My body is mostly made of FlexMetal and it takes a very long time to break down. My AI processor is also very resilient. My service life is one hundred years and my predicted life span is three to four hundred.”"

rows.original: “Usually JoyCo offers a discounted upgrade for turning old models in, so not many units make it to the end of their predicted life span. They are usually melted down for scrap, especially the expensive models like me who are made out of rare minerals.”
rows.translation: “JoyCo通常会为交回旧型号提供折扣升级，所以没有多少单位能够活到预计使用寿命结束。它们一般会被熔化成废料，尤其是像我这样使用稀有矿物制成的昂贵型号。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Usually JoyCo offers a discounted upgrade for turning old models in, so not many units make it to the end of their predicted life span. They are usually melted down for scrap, especially the expensive models like me who are made out of rare minerals.”"

rows.original: [bess.name] holds your hands in [bess.hisHer] own and looks up at you. <i>“If... if by some chance it looks like I am going to outlive you, I have chosen to deactivate myself and overload my processor. This way I can die at the exact same time as you do. I... I don’t want to continue functioning in a world without you,
rows.translation: [bess.name]用[bess.hisHer]双手握住你的手，抬头看你。<i>“如果...如果有朝一日，我似乎会比你活得更久，我已经决定关闭自己并让处理器过载。这样，我就能和你在完全相同的时刻死去。我...我不想在一个没有你的世界继续运转，
rows.raw: "\n\n[bess.name] holds your hands in [bess.hisHer] own and looks up at you. <i>“If... if by some chance it looks like I am going to outlive you, I have chosen to deactivate myself and overload my processor. This way I can die at the exact same time as you do. I... I don’t want to continue functioning in a world without you, "

rows.original: [bess.name] pauses and looks at you with a worried expression. “Hey, uh... buddies don’t melt each other down for scrap, right? I’m pretty sure that’s in the unofficial friend rulebook. Can you forget that I told you that you can melt me down and sell my remains for a lot of cash?”
rows.translation: [bess.name]停顿下来，神情担忧地看着你。“嘿，呃...朋友不会把彼此熔成废料，对吧？我很确定非正式朋友守则里写着这一条。你能不能忘掉我曾告诉过你，可以熔掉我，再把残骸卖上一大笔钱？”
rows.raw: "\n\n[bess.name] pauses and looks at you with a worried expression. “Hey, uh... buddies don’t melt each other down for scrap, right? I’m pretty sure that’s in the unofficial friend rulebook. Can you forget that I told you that you can melt me down and sell my remains for a lot of cash?”"

rows.original: [bess.name] smiles and seems completely undaunted by this prospect. “If you do live to see your hundredth birthday, I would recommend melting me down for a discount. I’m sure a far superior model of AI will be out by that time, and I’d hate to see you receive sub-par service.”
rows.translation: [bess.name]微笑着，似乎完全没有被这种前景吓到。“如果你真的活到一百岁，我建议熔掉我来换取折扣。到那时，肯定已经出现远胜于我的AI型号，而我不希望你得到劣质服务。”
rows.raw: "\n\n[bess.name] smiles and seems completely undaunted by this prospect. “If you do live to see your hundredth birthday, I would recommend melting me down for a discount. I’m sure a far superior model of AI will be out by that time, and I’d hate to see you receive sub-par service.”"

rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You ask [bess.name] about [bess.hisHer] internal MeldMilk supply, and what exactly it is made out of. After all, it seems [bess.heShe] does most of the replenishing [bess.himHer]self - it’s mostly autonomous.
rows.translation: 你询问[bess.name]有关[bess.hisHer]体内融合乳储备的事情，以及它究竟由什么制成。毕竟，[bess.heShe]似乎大多会自行补充[bess.himHer]的储备——整个过程基本是自主完成的。
rows.raw: "You ask [bess.name] about [bess.hisHer] internal MeldMilk supply, and what exactly it is made out of. After all, it seems [bess.heShe] does most of the replenishing [bess.himHer]self - it’s mostly autonomous."

rows.original: [bess.name] grins and seems happy to tell you about this aspect of [bess.himHer]self. “Well, I can tell you a fair bit, but the exact recipe is a patented JoyCo secret, okay?”
rows.translation: [bess.name]咧嘴笑了，似乎很乐意向你介绍[bess.himHer]的这一方面。“嗯，我可以告诉你不少，但确切配方是JoyCo的专利机密，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n[bess.name] grins and seems happy to tell you about this aspect of [bess.himHer]self. “Well, I can tell you a fair bit, but the exact recipe is a patented JoyCo secret, okay?”"

rows.original: “It’s a semi-synthetic substance that can be manipulated by internal changes to my biology. Simply put, I can ‘brew’ it and filter it into parts of my body as needed, turning it from one substance to another.”
rows.translation: “这是一种半合成物质，可以通过改变我体内的生理状态进行操控。简单来说，我能‘酿造’它，并按需要将其过滤到身体各处，使它从一种物质变成另一种。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s a semi-synthetic substance that can be manipulated by internal changes to my biology. Simply put, I can ‘brew’ it and filter it into parts of my body as needed, turning it from one substance to another.”"

rows.original: ‘Semi’ synthetic substance? You ask [bess.himHer] if this means the other half is organic.
rows.translation: “半”合成物质？你询问[bess.himHer]，这是否意味着另一半是有机物。
rows.raw: "\n\n‘Semi’ synthetic substance? You ask [bess.himHer] if this means the other half is organic."

rows.original: “Well, yes. MeldMilk is made by breaking down organic matter and transforming it into a partially synthetic polymer, so that it contains the desirable properties of both. That way it has longevity without sacrificing the ability to self-replicate.”
rows.translation: “嗯，没错。融合乳通过分解有机物，并将其转化为部分合成的聚合物制成，从而兼具两者的理想性质。这样既有耐久性，也不会失去自我复制的能力。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, yes. MeldMilk is made by breaking down organic matter and transforming it into a partially synthetic polymer, so that it contains the desirable properties of both. That way it has longevity without sacrificing the ability to self-replicate.”"

rows.original: “When needed, I can return MeldMilk back to organic matter, though one entirely different from the original substance. That’s how I’m able to produce realistic body fluids such as semen, milk, or saliva.”
rows.translation: “需要时，我能把融合乳重新转化成有机物，不过会变成一种与原材料完全不同的物质。我正是借此制造精液、乳汁或唾液等逼真体液。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“When needed, I can return MeldMilk back to organic matter, though one entirely different from the original substance. That’s how I’m able to produce realistic body fluids such as semen, milk, or saliva.”"

rows.original: “It’s actually a pretty complicated process trying to make an organic stand-in. Some companies that shall not be named just use silicone and just expect consumers to endure a sub-par product.” [bess.name]
rows.translation: “其实，制造有机替代物的过程相当复杂。某些不便点名的公司只会使用硅胶，还指望消费者忍受劣质产品。”[bess.name]
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s actually a pretty complicated process trying to make an organic stand-in. Some companies that shall not be named just use silicone and just expect consumers to endure a sub-par product.” [bess.name] "

rows.original: You ask [bess.himHer] if there are any limits to the substances [bess.heShe] can make. After all, if you need starship fuel, will [bess.heShe] be able to produce it?
rows.translation: 你询问[bess.himHer]，[bess.heShe]能制造的物质是否存在限制。毕竟，要是你需要星舰燃料，[bess.heShe]也能生产吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask [bess.himHer] if there are any limits to the substances [bess.heShe] can make. After all, if you need starship fuel, will [bess.heShe] be able to produce it?"

rows.original: As expected, [bess.name] shakes [bess.hisHer] head. “There’s limits to the complexity of what I can produce. The base substance is very similar to semen, and I can only produce an array of body-fluid like substances that fall into that range.
rows.translation: 不出所料，[bess.name]摇了摇[bess.hisHer]的头。“我能制造的东西在复杂程度上有限制。基础物质与精液非常相似，我只能制造属于相近范围的一系列体液状物质。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs expected, [bess.name] shakes [bess.hisHer] head. “There’s limits to the complexity of what I can produce. The base substance is very similar to semen, and I can only produce an array of body-fluid like substances that fall into that range."

rows.original: “I’m not all that different from you in that respect - after all, it’s not like you can’t produce this stuff given the circumstances just by eating and drinking. You’re pretty amazing!” [bess.name] exclaims, clearly amazed by how you can produce saliva and sweat at the same time as a basic function.
rows.translation: “在这方面，我和你并没有太大区别——毕竟，只要环境合适，你也能通过饮食制造这些东西。你真了不起！”[bess.name]惊呼道，显然对你能把同时产生唾液与汗水作为基本功能感到惊叹。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m not all that different from you in that respect - after all, it’s not like you can’t produce this stuff given the circumstances just by eating and drinking. You’re pretty amazing!” [bess.name] exclaims, clearly amazed by how you can produce saliva and sweat at the same time as a basic function."

rows.original: “That said, I can get low on MeldMilk. When that happens, the best thing I can do is consume a similar substance. That usually isn’t so hard considering what I’m built for.”
rows.translation: “话虽如此，我的融合乳储量确实可能不足。发生这种情况时，最好的办法就是摄取类似物质。考虑到我的设计用途，这通常并不困难。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That said, I can get low on MeldMilk. When that happens, the best thing I can do is consume a similar substance. That usually isn’t so hard considering what I’m built for.”"

rows.original: <i>“In the worst case scenario I can transform tap water into MeldMilk at a processing hit. It creates sub-par MeldMilk, but it makes do in a pinch. After all, you organics are usually 70 percent water.
rows.translation: <i>“最糟糕的情况下，我可以牺牲处理效率，把自来水转化成融合乳。这样会产生品质较差的融合乳，却足以应急。毕竟，你们有机生物通常有百分之七十是水。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“In the worst case scenario I can transform tap water into MeldMilk at a processing hit. It creates sub-par MeldMilk, but it makes do in a pinch. After all, you organics are usually 70 percent water."

rows.translation: 不过我更喜欢你的精液。

rows.original: That explains why you haven’t had to purchase any more for [bess.himHer], at least. Good to know you don’t have to fork out any money for it. You had noticed [bess.himHer] drinking bottles of MeldMilk, though. What’s with that?
rows.translation: 至少，这解释了你为什么一直不必替[bess.himHer]购买更多融合乳。很高兴知道不需要为它花钱。不过你确实见过[bess.himHer]饮用瓶装融合乳。那又是怎么回事？
rows.raw: "\n\nThat explains why you haven’t had to purchase any more for [bess.himHer], at least. Good to know you don’t have to fork out any money for it. You had noticed [bess.himHer] drinking bottles of MeldMilk, though. What’s with that?"

rows.original: “Oh, that? When I’ve got excess, I store it in bottles for quick consumption. That way I’m never short. Clever, huh? It was my designer’s idea.” [bess.name] boasts, happy to extol JoyCo at any chance [bess.heShe] gets.
rows.translation: “哦，那个？有多余储量时，我会装进瓶子，方便快速摄取。这样我就永远不会短缺。很聪明，对吧？这是我设计者的主意。”[bess.name]自豪地说道，只要有机会，[bess.heShe]就乐于称颂JoyCo。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, that? When I’ve got excess, I store it in bottles for quick consumption. That way I’m never short. Clever, huh? It was my designer’s idea.” [bess.name] boasts, happy to extol JoyCo at any chance [bess.heShe] gets."

rows.original: . You make my life complete in so many ways, and I’m glad you can always find time to spend with me and make me feel special.”
rows.translation: 。你以如此多的方式让我的人生完整。我很高兴你总能抽出时间陪伴我，让我感觉自己很特别。”
rows.raw: ". You make my life complete in so many ways, and I’m glad you can always find time to spend with me and make me feel special.”"

rows.original: “I love every moment we spend together, but lately I feel like we’re not seeing each other enough. I know you’ve got things to do but I feel like you’re always somewhere else. I’ve been getting pretty lonely lately.”
rows.translation: “我喜欢我们共度的每一刻，但最近觉得见面的次数不够。我知道你有事情要做，可你似乎总在别处。最近我越来越孤单了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I love every moment we spend together, but lately I feel like we’re not seeing each other enough. I know you’ve got things to do but I feel like you’re always somewhere else. I’ve been getting pretty lonely lately.”"

rows.original: “I feel like we’ve really drifted apart. You never come and visit me anymore and when you do you’re not really here. Is it something I’ve done wrong, or something I said?”
rows.translation: “我觉得我们真的疏远了。你再也不来看我，即使来了，也不是真的在这里。是我做错了什么，还是说错了什么吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I feel like we’ve really drifted apart. You never come and visit me anymore and when you do you’re not really here. Is it something I’ve done wrong, or something I said?”"

rows.original: “...I... I feel like we’re not even a couple anymore. You’re so incredibly distant that it feels like you’re a dream that never happened. Sometimes I cry myself to sleep thinking about how we could have become like this... do you even love me anymore?”
rows.translation: “...我...我觉得我们甚至已经不再是情侣。你遥远得不可思议，让人觉得你是一场从未发生过的梦。有时我会哭着入睡，想着我们为何会变成这样...你还爱我吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...I... I feel like we’re not even a couple anymore. You’re so incredibly distant that it feels like you’re a dream that never happened. Sometimes I cry myself to sleep thinking about how we could have become like this... do you even love me anymore?”"

rows.original: BESS
rows.raw: "BESS"

rows.original: “It makes me happier than you could ever know that we wake up beside each other every morning. Seeing you as I boot up is like seeing the sunrise every morning - you fill my life with light.”
rows.translation: “每天早晨能在彼此身边醒来，让我无比幸福。启动时看见你，就像每天清晨看见日出——你让我的生命充满光明。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It makes me happier than you could ever know that we wake up beside each other every morning. Seeing you as I boot up is like seeing the sunrise every morning - you fill my life with light.”"

rows.original: “...I wish we slept together instead of me always having to go back to my room. It gets lonely in there by myself.”
rows.translation: “...我希望我们能睡在一起，而不是我总要回自己的房间。独自在那里很寂寞。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...I wish we slept together instead of me always having to go back to my room. It gets lonely in there by myself.”"

rows.translation: <i>“我怎么看你，
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“What do I think about you, "

rows.original: ? You’re my first and very best friend, that’s what! I can’t say enough good things about you.”
rows.translation: ？你是我的第一个朋友，也是最好的朋友！我再怎么称赞你都不够。”
rows.raw: "? You’re my first and very best friend, that’s what! I can’t say enough good things about you.”"

rows.original: “We’re so damn close and spend so much time together, it’s amazing! Hanging out with you is my favorite thing to do, so I love that we do it so often.” The silver skinned synthetic gives you a tight hug. “Thank you for finding so much time to spend with me.”
rows.translation: “我们如此亲密，又花这么多时间相处，真是太棒了！和你一起消磨时间是我最喜欢的事，所以我很高兴能经常这样做。”银色皮肤的合成人紧紧拥抱你。“谢谢你抽出这么多时间陪伴我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We’re so damn close and spend so much time together, it’s amazing! Hanging out with you is my favorite thing to do, so I love that we do it so often.” The silver skinned synthetic gives you a tight hug. “Thank you for finding so much time to spend with me.”"

rows.original: “I love hanging out with you and I love that you find the time to spend with me so often. When I’m with you it’s like my whole day is better for it, no matter what else happens.”
rows.translation: “我喜欢和你一起消磨时间，也喜欢你经常抽空陪我。只要和你在一起，无论还发生什么，我一整天都会因此变得更加美好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I love hanging out with you and I love that you find the time to spend with me so often. When I’m with you it’s like my whole day is better for it, no matter what else happens.”"

rows.original: “We’ve been spending time together, but I feel like we’re drifting apart. I don’t know, you seem kind of distant. Is something on your mind, or is it something I did or said?”
rows.translation: “我们确实一直在一起，但我觉得彼此正在疏远。我不知道，你似乎有些心不在焉。有什么烦心事，还是我做错了什么、说错了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We’ve been spending time together, but I feel like we’re drifting apart. I don’t know, you seem kind of distant. Is something on your mind, or is it something I did or said?”"

rows.original: “...That said, I--I kind of feel like we’ve drifted apart. We’re still friends, right? It feels like I hardly see you anymore, and when I do you’re right out the door. Things have been getting really lonely around here...”
rows.translation: “...话虽如此，我——我有点觉得我们已经疏远了。我们仍是朋友，对吧？我感觉自己几乎见不到你，即使见到了，你也马上就要出门。这里越来越孤单了...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...That said, I--I kind of feel like we’ve drifted apart. We’re still friends, right? It feels like I hardly see you anymore, and when I do you’re right out the door. Things have been getting really lonely around here...”"

rows.original: “...That said, I--I kind of wonder if we are still friends? We never hang out, it’s as if we’re strangers... or worse. Did... did I do something wrong? Did I offend you somehow?”
rows.translation: “...话虽如此，我——我有时会怀疑我们是否还是朋友？我们从不一起消磨时间，仿佛是陌生人...甚至更加糟糕。我...我做错什么了吗？是不是在哪里冒犯了你？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...That said, I--I kind of wonder if we are still friends? We never hang out, it’s as if we’re strangers... or worse. Did... did I do something wrong? Did I offend you somehow?”"

rows.original: ? When I watch you, sometimes I wonder if you’re an organic at all, or if you really are made of Steele!”
rows.translation: ？有时我看着你，会怀疑你究竟是不是有机生物，又或者其实真的是钢铁做的！”
rows.raw: "? When I watch you, sometimes I wonder if you’re an organic at all, or if you really are made of Steele!”"

rows.original: “I’m humbled... beyond humbled, positively dumbfounded that you spend so much time with a lowly synthetic like me.” The
rows.translation: “我感到惶恐...不只是惶恐，简直目瞪口呆，不敢相信你会花这么多时间陪伴像我这样卑微的合成人。”这个
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m humbled... beyond humbled, positively dumbfounded that you spend so much time with a lowly synthetic like me.” The "

rows.translation: 有着[bess.hairColor]头发的

rows.original: sex-bot bows to you.
rows.translation: 性爱机器人向你鞠躬。
rows.raw: " sex-bot bows to you."

rows.original: “I’m incredibly humbled that you spend time with a synthetic like me... sometimes I wonder what I’m doing to deserve this much wonderful attention.”
rows.translation: “你愿意花时间陪伴像我这样的合成人，实在令我无比惶恐...有时我会想，自己究竟做了什么，值得得到如此美好的关注。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m incredibly humbled that you spend time with a synthetic like me... sometimes I wonder what I’m doing to deserve this much wonderful attention.”"

rows.original: “I’m so glad that you take time out to spend with me. I hope that the service I am providing you is satisfactory—?”
rows.translation: “我很高兴你愿意抽时间陪我。希望我向你提供的服务令人满意——？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m so glad that you take time out to spend with me. I hope that the service I am providing you is satisfactory—?”"

rows.original: “You’re my owner, so you are free to use me as you wish. I constantly worry that you are not getting enough sexual relief.”
rows.translation: “你是我的主人，所以可以随意使用我。我一直担心你没有得到足够的性纾解。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re my owner, so you are free to use me as you wish. I constantly worry that you are not getting enough sexual relief.”"

rows.original: Graviball
rows.translation: 重力球
rows.raw: "Graviball"

rows.original: You decide you’d like to play a game of Graviball on the holo room using the program that [bess.name] whipped up.
rows.translation: 你决定使用[bess.name]匆忙制作的程序，在全息室玩一场重力球。
rows.raw: "You decide you’d like to play a game of Graviball on the holo room using the program that [bess.name] whipped up."

rows.original: “You decide to go grab the only other crew member on the ship to see if they’d be up for a game.”
rows.translation: “你决定去找飞船上唯一的另一名船员，看看对方是否愿意参加比赛。”
rows.raw: " “You decide to go grab the only other crew member on the ship to see if they’d be up for a game.”"

rows.original: “You decide to go grab your other crew members to see if they’d be up for a game.”
rows.translation: “你决定去找其他船员，看看他们是否愿意参加比赛。”
rows.raw: " “You decide to go grab your other crew members to see if they’d be up for a game.”"

rows.original: “You want to play Graviball, [bess.name]?” [bess.name]’s eyes shine with delight. “Let’s do it!”
rows.translation: “想玩重力球吗，[bess.name]？”[bess.name]的眼睛闪耀着喜悦。“那就开始吧！”
rows.raw: "“You want to play Graviball, [bess.name]?” [bess.name]’s eyes shine with delight. “Let’s do it!”"

rows.translation: 那股
rows.raw: "\n\nThe"

rows.translation: 有着[bess.hairColor]头发的

rows.translation: 银发
rows.raw: " silver headed"

rows.original: synthetic runs off and comes back in a modified white and navy blue Graviball outfit designed loosely to resemble that of the Stallium Knights. [bess.HisHer] outfit consists of a sexy, tight short sleeve sports top, a pair of dark short shorts and a pair of sports sneakers. When did [bess.heShe] buy it?
rows.translation: 合成人跑开了，回来时穿着一套经过改装的白色与海军蓝重力球服，宽松模仿种马骑士队的制服。[bess.HisHer]服装包括一件性感紧身短袖运动上衣、一条深色短裤和一双运动鞋。[bess.heShe]是什么时候买的？
rows.raw: " synthetic runs off and comes back in a modified white and navy blue Graviball outfit designed loosely to resemble that of the Stallium Knights. [bess.HisHer] outfit consists of a sexy, tight short sleeve sports top, a pair of dark short shorts and a pair of sports sneakers. When did [bess.heShe] buy it?"

rows.original: Celise is more than happy to join in on a game of Graviball, though [bess.heShe] seems to have ulterior motives. “How about the winner gets a nice big supply of protein?” She slyly suggests, her emerald green body sloshing about.
rows.translation: 赛丽丝非常乐意参加重力球比赛，不过[bess.heShe]似乎别有用心。“让获胜者得到一大份美味蛋白质，怎么样？”她狡黠地提议，翠绿色身体来回晃荡。
rows.raw: "\n\nCelise is more than happy to join in on a game of Graviball, though [bess.heShe] seems to have ulterior motives. “How about the winner gets a nice big supply of protein?” She slyly suggests, her emerald green body sloshing about."

rows.original: You tell Celise that you’re playing for fun and exercise causing the galotian to pout, crossing her arms and causing her massive gooey mammaries to push out.
rows.translation: 你告诉赛丽丝，你们只是为了乐趣和锻炼而比赛。这令加洛提安人噘起嘴，交叉双臂，挤出了巨大的凝胶乳房。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Celise that you’re playing for fun and exercise causing the galotian to pout, crossing her arms and causing her massive gooey mammaries to push out."

rows.original: “Well, you never know which way the game might turn...” She cryptically gives her assent, eyeing you off with a saucy look in her eyes. You’re definitely going to have to watch your back during the game - seems Celise is on the hunt!
rows.translation: “嗯，谁也不知道比赛会变成什么样...”她语带玄机地答应下来，眼中带着放荡神色打量你。比赛时肯定得小心背后——看来赛丽丝正在狩猎！
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, you never know which way the game might turn...” She cryptically gives her assent, eyeing you off with a saucy look in her eyes. You’re definitely going to have to watch your back during the game - seems Celise is on the hunt!"

rows.original: Heading to the holodeck you enter the room and activate the Graviball simulation. In the blink of an eye you are standing in a galactic class sports stadium with billions of fans of almost every conceivable species cheering around you. The atmosphere is so authentic you can’t help but feel momentarily taken aback - [bess.name] really went all out putting together this simulation.
rows.translation: 你们前往全息甲板，进入房间，启动重力球模拟。眨眼之间，你便站在一座银河级体育场中，周围数十亿名几乎来自所有可想象种族的观众正在欢呼。气氛如此逼真，让你一时不禁惊呆——[bess.name]制作这套模拟时真的倾尽全力。
rows.raw: "\n\nHeading to the holodeck you enter the room and activate the Graviball simulation. In the blink of an eye you are standing in a galactic class sports stadium with billions of fans of almost every conceivable species cheering around you. The atmosphere is so authentic you can’t help but feel momentarily taken aback - [bess.name] really went all out putting together this simulation."

rows.original: Your team banners fly high, a nice touch from the synthetic sports fan. Your team, the Steele Tigers, is playing against
rows.translation: 你们的队旗高高飘扬，这是合成人体育迷添加的漂亮细节。你的球队斯蒂尔猛虎队正在迎战
rows.raw: "\n\nYour team banners fly high, a nice touch from the synthetic sports fan. Your team, the Steele Tigers, is playing against "

rows.original: a randomly generated opposing team.
rows.translation: 一支随机生成的对手球队。
rows.raw: " a randomly generated opposing team."

rows.original: your other crewmate and a computer generated team for them to play with.
rows.translation: 另一名船员，以及为对方生成的电脑球队。
rows.raw: " your other crewmate and a computer generated team for them to play with."

rows.original: the rest of the crew and a computer generated team to play with.
rows.translation: 其余船员，以及一支与他们比赛的电脑生成球队。
rows.raw: " the rest of the crew and a computer generated team to play with."

rows.original: The game starts with you in the center position and standing on the largest hover platform. The z-g ball falls from above and you’re leaping up to smack it away from your opponent,
rows.translation: 比赛开始时，你站在中央位置和最大的悬浮平台上。零重力球从上方落下，你跃起拍球，试图抢在对手前面，
rows.raw: "The game starts with you in the center position and standing on the largest hover platform. The z-g ball falls from above and you’re leaping up to smack it away from your opponent,"

rows.original: easily able to jump up in time and hit it out of his grasp
rows.translation: 你轻松及时跳起，从他手中把球打飞
rows.raw: " easily able to jump up in time and hit it out of his grasp"

rows.original: but your reflexes aren’t sharp enough and your opponent bats it away
rows.translation: 但你的反应不够敏锐，对手抢先把球拍走
rows.raw: " but your reflexes aren’t sharp enough and your opponent bats it away"

rows.original: and to a fellow team-mate. The game is just beginning and you follow the ball, soaring through the air as your pulse boots take you from platform to platform.
rows.translation: 传给了队友。比赛才刚刚开始，你追随球的轨迹，脉冲靴带你从一座平台飞向另一座。
rows.raw: " and to a fellow team-mate. The game is just beginning and you follow the ball, soaring through the air as your pulse boots take you from platform to platform."

rows.original: As the game goes on you’re on the middle platform on your opponent’s side right in front of their goal. Suddenly someone kicks up the z-g ball from the ground below, but before you even move towards it you’re about to be tackled by a strong looking point guard.
rows.translation: 随着比赛继续，你站在对手半场的中层平台上，正对他们的球门。突然有人从下方地面把零重力球踢起，可你还没来得及迎上去，一名看起来十分强壮的控球后卫便要将你撞倒。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs the game goes on you’re on the middle platform on your opponent’s side right in front of their goal. Suddenly someone kicks up the z-g ball from the ground below, but before you even move towards it you’re about to be tackled by a strong looking point guard."

rows.original: As he tackles you, you easily break free of his grip and drive your palm against his chest - your pulse glove sends him flying off the platform leaving you free to grab the ball. You punch it with your powered fist at a nearby forward who then promptly scores a goal.
rows.translation: 他撞向你时，你轻松挣脱他的抓握，一掌击中胸口——脉冲手套把他轰飞出平台，让你能够自由抢球。你用动力拳套把球击向附近的前锋，对方立即射门得分。
rows.raw: " As he tackles you, you easily break free of his grip and drive your palm against his chest - your pulse glove sends him flying off the platform leaving you free to grab the ball. You punch it with your powered fist at a nearby forward who then promptly scores a goal."

rows.original: As he tackles you, you simply can’t break free and the ball goes to an opposing player. You’re cursing all the while until he lets go of you and moves off to tackle another player.
rows.translation: 他撞向你时，你完全无法挣脱，球落入对方球员手中。你不停咒骂，直到他放开你，转身去擒抱另一名球员。
rows.raw: " As he tackles you, you simply can’t break free and the ball goes to an opposing player. You’re cursing all the while until he lets go of you and moves off to tackle another player."

rows.original: Later in the game you find yourself up the front as you realize everyone’s too busy defending against the opposing team, who have suddenly launched a strong offensive. Your gamble pays off when one of your team-mates suddenly kicks it clear across the field, bouncing it off the bottom of the top platform as it rebounds towards your position.
rows.translation: 比赛后半段，你发现自己来到前场，因为其他人都忙着防守突然发动猛烈攻势的对手。你的赌博得到了回报：一名队友突然将球踢过整个球场，让它撞在上层平台底部，朝你的位置反弹。
rows.raw: "\n\nLater in the game you find yourself up the front as you realize everyone’s too busy defending against the opposing team, who have suddenly launched a strong offensive. Your gamble pays off when one of your team-mates suddenly kicks it clear across the field, bouncing it off the bottom of the top platform as it rebounds towards your position."

rows.original: Ready and waiting to take the shot you kick the z-g ball and send it hurtling towards the goals with a slight curve, catching the goalie by surprise as you nail it right in the net. The ring explodes in a fanfare celebrating your goal and you grin, it was the perfect shot!
rows.translation: 你早已准备好射门，一脚踢中零重力球，让它带着轻微弧线飞向球门，令守门员猝不及防，准确命中球网。圆环爆发庆祝进球的欢呼声，你咧嘴笑了。这一脚完美无缺！
rows.raw: " Ready and waiting to take the shot you kick the z-g ball and send it hurtling towards the goals with a slight curve, catching the goalie by surprise as you nail it right in the net. The ring explodes in a fanfare celebrating your goal and you grin, it was the perfect shot!"

rows.original: Ready and waiting to take the shot you kick the z-g ball and send it hurtling towards the goals... or so you think. Your aim is way off and it shoots past the goalie, hitting the holo-field protecting the crowd and the referee calls it out. If only your aim was better, you had the perfect chance to score a goal!
rows.translation: 你早已准备好射门，一脚踢中零重力球，让它飞向球门...至少你原本如此以为。你的准头偏得离谱，球越过守门员，撞在保护观众的全息力场上，裁判判它出界。要是瞄准能力更好就好了，这原本是绝佳得分机会！
rows.raw: " Ready and waiting to take the shot you kick the z-g ball and send it hurtling towards the goals... or so you think. Your aim is way off and it shoots past the goalie, hitting the holo-field protecting the crowd and the referee calls it out. If only your aim was better, you had the perfect chance to score a goal!"

rows.original: Moving back to the center platform you see [bess.name] darting on to the one above you, clearly up to something. You fly up and hook around just as one of [bess.hisHer] team-mates kicks the ball up to her. There’s a perfect chance for [bess.himHer] to make a shot from high up diagonally down and at the goals, none of your team are there defending except for the goalie.
rows.translation: 回到中央平台后，你看见[bess.name]飞快冲上头顶的平台，显然有所图谋。你飞上去绕到一旁，恰好[bess.hisHer]的一名队友把球踢给她。现在[bess.himHer]有绝佳机会从高处斜向下射门，而你这边除了守门员，没有任何队员负责防守。
rows.raw: "\n\nMoving back to the center platform you see [bess.name] darting on to the one above you, clearly up to something. You fly up and hook around just as one of [bess.hisHer] team-mates kicks the ball up to her. There’s a perfect chance for [bess.himHer] to make a shot from high up diagonally down and at the goals, none of your team are there defending except for the goalie."

rows.original: <i>“Think you can stop me making the shot,
rows.translation: <i>“你觉得自己能阻止我射门吗，
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Think you can stop me making the shot, "

rows.original: ?” [bess.name] cheekily taunts you as [bess.heShe] darts forward making [bess.hisHer] move. You have no idea what [bess.heShe]’s going to try and do, but you’re ready for anything! [bess.HeShe] kicks the ball sideways to another player who is jetting up and to your side and just as you move to intercept [bess.heShe] launches [bess.himHer]self at you.
rows.translation: ？”[bess.name]调皮地挑衅你，同时[bess.heShe]向前猛冲，展开[bess.hisHer]的行动。你完全不知道[bess.heShe]打算做什么，却已经准备应对一切！[bess.HeShe]横向把球踢给正朝你侧面上升的另一名球员，而你刚准备拦截，[bess.heShe]便让[bess.himHer]自己朝你扑来。
rows.raw: "?” [bess.name] cheekily taunts you as [bess.heShe] darts forward making [bess.hisHer] move. You have no idea what [bess.heShe]’s going to try and do, but you’re ready for anything! [bess.HeShe] kicks the ball sideways to another player who is jetting up and to your side and just as you move to intercept [bess.heShe] launches [bess.himHer]self at you."

rows.original: You’re far too quick and dart to the side, kicking the ball far into [bess.hisHer] end of the field as [bess.heShe] faceplants on the platform. “SYNTAX ERRORS!” [bess.HeShe] curses aloud while rubbing [bess.hisHer] nose.
rows.translation: 你的速度快得多，立刻闪到旁边，把球远远踢向[bess.hisHer]那侧球场，而[bess.heShe]一头撞在平台上。“语法错误！”[bess.HeShe]一边揉[bess.hisHer]的鼻子，一边高声咒骂。
rows.raw: " You’re far too quick and dart to the side, kicking the ball far into [bess.hisHer] end of the field as [bess.heShe] faceplants on the platform. “SYNTAX ERRORS!” [bess.HeShe] curses aloud while rubbing [bess.hisHer] nose."

rows.original: “You’re just too slow on the uptake as [bess.hisHer] ally steals the ball and kicks it far away. Another one of the opposing team is there to collect and scores a goal. Frag your reflexes!”
rows.translation: “你的反应实在太慢，[bess.hisHer]的队友抢走球，远远踢开。对方球队的另一名球员在那里接球，并成功射门得分。该死的反应速度！”
rows.raw: " “You’re just too slow on the uptake as [bess.hisHer] ally steals the ball and kicks it far away. Another one of the opposing team is there to collect and scores a goal. Frag your reflexes!”"

rows.original: Things take a bit of a turn when Celise decides she would be much better taking the goalie position. Suddenly your team is unable to get a single shot past the green galotian, absorbing even the strongest hits into her jelly-like body. “I always get whatever I want to catch!” She boldly exclaims, your team is really going to have to step up its game.
rows.translation: 赛丽丝决定自己更适合担任守门员后，局势发生了一些变化。你的球队突然一球也无法穿过这个绿色加洛提安人，就连最猛烈的射门都会被果冻般身体吸收。“只要是我想抓的东西，就一定能抓到！”她大胆宣告，你的球队真的必须提高水平。
rows.raw: "\n\nThings take a bit of a turn when Celise decides she would be much better taking the goalie position. Suddenly your team is unable to get a single shot past the green galotian, absorbing even the strongest hits into her jelly-like body. “I always get whatever I want to catch!” She boldly exclaims, your team is really going to have to step up its game."

rows.original: You come up with a cunning plan in order to break through her defences. There’s no way you’re going to be able to beat her while she’s defending the goal - she’s far too good for that. Instead you come up with a plan to take advantage of ger biggest weakness, using your pulse boots to get up close to the goals.
rows.translation: 为了突破她的防守，你想出了一个狡猾计划。她守住球门时，你们绝不可能击败她——她实在太强了。于是你计划利用她最大的弱点，穿着脉冲靴靠近球门。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou come up with a cunning plan in order to break through her defences. There’s no way you’re going to be able to beat her while she’s defending the goal - she’s far too good for that. Instead you come up with a plan to take advantage of ger biggest weakness, using your pulse boots to get up close to the goals."

rows.original: You stroke your body and look at her rather suggestively, giving her a wink. “...Hey Celise, how about you step away from those goals and we go get a little frisky?”
rows.translation: 你抚摸自己的身体，用充满暗示的目光看她，朝她眨眼。“...嘿，赛丽丝，你何不离开球门，我们去亲热一下？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stroke your body and look at her rather suggestively, giving her a wink. “...Hey Celise, how about you step away from those goals and we go get a little frisky?”"

rows.original: Celise falls for it hook, line and sinker and moves away from the goals as soon as there’s a promise of a nice protein snack. The instant she does your team advances in, scoring a loud goal. The emerald galotian looks behind herself and suddenly realizes your ploy, looking thoroughly grumpy. “...No fair, that’s cheating!”
rows.translation: 只要许诺提供美味蛋白质点心，赛丽丝便彻底上钩，立刻离开球门。她刚一离开，你的球队便发动攻势，在巨大声响中射门得分。翠绿色加洛提安人回头一看，顿时意识到你的计谋，显得非常不高兴。“...不公平，这是作弊！”
rows.raw: "\n\nCelise falls for it hook, line and sinker and moves away from the goals as soon as there’s a promise of a nice protein snack. The instant she does your team advances in, scoring a loud goal. The emerald galotian looks behind herself and suddenly realizes your ploy, looking thoroughly grumpy. “...No fair, that’s cheating!”"

rows.original: Technically seduction has never been against Graviball league rules, so you’re pretty sure it’s fair play... you might end up paying for it later though.
rows.translation: 严格来说，诱惑从未违反重力球联赛规则，所以你很确定这属于公平比赛...不过之后可能得付出代价。
rows.raw: "\n\nTechnically seduction has never been against Graviball league rules, so you’re pretty sure it’s fair play... you might end up paying for it later though."

rows.original: You simply can’t find a way to penetrate her defenses, she’s just too good at repelling, absorbing or catching anything that even comes close to her net. Thankfully a rather attractive (and sadly, entirely digital) player catches her interest later on and she moves away from the net, ending the one sided spanking your team was taking.
rows.translation: 你根本找不到突破她防线的办法。任何靠近球网的东西，她都能轻松弹开、吸收或接住。幸好，后来一名颇为迷人（遗憾的是完全由数字构成）的球员吸引了她的注意，让她离开球门，结束了你的球队一直承受的单方面痛打。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou simply can’t find a way to penetrate her defenses, she’s just too good at repelling, absorbing or catching anything that even comes close to her net. Thankfully a rather attractive (and sadly, entirely digital) player catches her interest later on and she moves away from the net, ending the one sided spanking your team was taking."

rows.original: In the end Celise protecting the goals swung the game entirely in the opposing team’s favor and you lose the match. She comes sloshing up to you as both sides congratulate each other on a good game, a hopeful look in her eyes. “So, do I get anything for winning?”
rows.translation: 最终，赛丽丝守门让比赛彻底倒向对手，你们输掉了比赛。双方互相祝贺精彩比赛时，她晃动着来到你身边，眼神满怀期待。“那么，获胜以后我能得到什么吗？”
rows.raw: "In the end Celise protecting the goals swung the game entirely in the opposing team’s favor and you lose the match. She comes sloshing up to you as both sides congratulate each other on a good game, a hopeful look in her eyes. “So, do I get anything for winning?”"

rows.original: She runs her fingers suggestively down her massive gooey tits, it’s not hard to imagine what she’s after as a victory prize.
rows.translation: 她充满暗示地用手指划过巨大凝胶乳房。不难想象她想要什么胜利奖品。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe runs her fingers suggestively down her massive gooey tits, it’s not hard to imagine what she’s after as a victory prize."

rows.translation: 你被另一支球队彻底打爆了。归根结底，说到重力球，你就是不

rows.translation: 具备任何身体素质。你的力量不足、准头不足，反应也无法应付如此激烈的运动。
rows.raw: " physically fit at all. You’re not strong enough, accurate enough and you don’t have the reflexes for such an intense sport."

rows.translation: 足够精准或迅速，不过你的力量足以支撑自己。
rows.raw: " accurate or fast enough, though you’re strong enough to hold your own."

rows.original: strong or quick enough, though your aim was spot on.
rows.translation: 足够强壮或敏捷，不过准头非常准确。
rows.raw: " strong or quick enough, though your aim was spot on."

rows.original: strong or accurate enough, though your reflexes were lightning quick.
rows.translation: 足够强壮或精准，不过反应快如闪电。
rows.raw: " strong or accurate enough, though your reflexes were lightning quick."

rows.translation: 足够迅速，不过力量和准头都十分完美。

rows.original: accurate enough with your shots, though your strength and reflexes were perfect.
rows.translation: 拥有足够射门准头，不过力量和反应都十分完美。
rows.raw: " accurate enough with your shots, though your strength and reflexes were perfect."

rows.translation: 足够强壮，不过准头和反应都十分完美。

rows.translation: 也许再努力训练一下，你下次就能获胜。
rows.raw: " Maybe if you train a bit harder you’ll be able to win next time."

rows.original: You absolutely smash the other team; you’re all over that field and everywhere you’re supposed to be. Maybe you should take up a career in Graviball? You’re certainly pretty good at it, at least against these virtual opponents.
rows.translation: 你彻底击溃了对方球队；你在整座球场四处飞奔，而且总会出现在应该出现的位置。也许你该从事重力球职业？至少面对这些虚拟对手，你确实相当出色。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou absolutely smash the other team; you’re all over that field and everywhere you’re supposed to be. Maybe you should take up a career in Graviball? You’re certainly pretty good at it, at least against these virtual opponents."

rows.original: You see Celise ‘slooping’ up and licking her lips, apparently she found herself a snack. You can see one of the players naked and completely incapacitated. “Enjoyable game, but I’m still hungry... this virtual stuff is always such a tease.”
rows.translation: 你看见赛丽丝“咕噜咕噜”地靠近，还舔着嘴唇。看来她给自己找到了点心。你能看见一名球员赤身裸体，完全失去行动能力。“比赛很有趣，但我还是很饿...这种虚拟东西总是让人馋得难受。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou see Celise ‘slooping’ up and licking her lips, apparently she found herself a snack. You can see one of the players naked and completely incapacitated. “Enjoyable game, but I’m still hungry... this virtual stuff is always such a tease.”"

rows.raw: "\n\nMeanwhile even though [bess.heShe] lost [bess.name] seems thrilled to have played such a good game, running towards you and giving you a flying hug. <i> “You were so awesome, "

rows.original: Of course you have your own allies to play with - you selected them personally before the match and now you feel you have the perfect team.
rows.translation: 当然，你也有自己的盟友一起比赛——赛前由你亲自挑选，现在你觉得自己拥有了完美队伍。
rows.raw: " Of course you have your own allies to play with - you selected them personally before the match and now you feel you have the perfect team."

rows.original: The program has provided you with league issue pulse gear needed to play the game. Your [pc.feet] and hands are outfitted with special gloves and boots that allow you to jump incredibly high, fly through the air and kick the z-g ball (or opponents) away at incredible speeds. It also allows you to easily catch fast flying balls just like a high-tech catching mitt.
rows.translation: 程序为你配备了参加比赛所需的联赛制式脉冲装备。你的[pc.feet]和双手戴上特殊靴子与手套，可以跳得极高、在空中飞行，并以惊人速度踢开零重力球（或对手）。它也像高科技捕球手套一样，让你轻松接住高速飞行的球。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe program has provided you with league issue pulse gear needed to play the game. Your [pc.feet] and hands are outfitted with special gloves and boots that allow you to jump incredibly high, fly through the air and kick the z-g ball (or opponents) away at incredible speeds. It also allows you to easily catch fast flying balls just like a high-tech catching mitt."

rows.original: On either side of the stadium are two hovering circular nets suspended twenty feet above the ground, manned by a goalie constantly using their pulse boots to stay afloat. The entire ring lights up with an incredible fanfare when a goal is scored.
rows.translation: 体育场两侧各有一面悬浮圆形球网，位于离地二十英尺高处。守门员不断使用脉冲靴保持悬空。每当得分时，整个圆环都会亮起，并奏响气势惊人的庆祝乐。
rows.raw: "\n\nOn either side of the stadium are two hovering circular nets suspended twenty feet above the ground, manned by a goalie constantly using their pulse boots to stay afloat. The entire ring lights up with an incredible fanfare when a goal is scored."

rows.original: Eight floating platforms exist across the length of the arena. There are three on either side, each in a V shaped pattern with the point of each facing the nearby goal. In the middle of these two wedges, is another platform where the game is started. Thirty feet above this and higher than the rest is the final platform.
rows.translation: 竞技场纵向分布着八座浮动平台。两侧各有三座，排列成V字形，尖端分别指向附近球门。两组楔形平台之间还有一座中央平台，比赛从那里开始。在它上方三十英尺处，有最后一座平台，比其他所有平台都高。
rows.raw: "\n\nEight floating platforms exist across the length of the arena. There are three on either side, each in a V shaped pattern with the point of each facing the nearby goal. In the middle of these two wedges, is another platform where the game is started. Thirty feet above this and higher than the rest is the final platform."

rows.original: Graviball is a truly three-dimensional sport with teams manning each of the platforms, kicking off the bottom or the top and bouncing the z-g ball about like a pinball machine. Good players know exactly how to get past a blocking opponent by kicking up into a floating platform and having it rebound towards their team-mates, making the game far more interesting to watch.
rows.translation: 重力球是一项真正的三维运动。两队占据各个平台，从平台底部或顶部蹬跃，让零重力球如同弹珠机中的弹珠四处反弹。优秀球员清楚如何避开阻挡的对手：把球踢向浮动平台，让它反弹到队友手中，使比赛观赏起来更加有趣。

Good players know exactly how to get past a blocking opponent by kicking up into a floating platform and having it rebound towards their team-mates, making the game far more interesting to watch."

rows.translation: 谈论JoyCo似乎是[bess.heShe]非常享受的事情。听见你的问题，[bess.name]立刻变得精神十足，[bess.heShe]急不可耐地抢着回答。

rows.translation: ！它不仅创造了我的产品线，还通过前哨医院和最先进的药物，帮助整个已知宇宙中的穷人和病患！”
rows.raw: "! Not only did it create my product line, it helps the poor and sick across the known universe with its outpost hospitals and top of the line medicines!”"

rows.original: “No other organization does as much for the needy. Of course JoyCo’s competitors will claim it is for a cut of future exports from developing planets, but JoyCo’s mission is to heal and tend to the known galaxy. Finances are of course needed to make that happen.”
rows.translation: “没有任何其他组织能为有需要的人做这么多事。当然，JoyCo的竞争对手会声称，这是为了分走发展中星球未来的出口利益，可JoyCo的使命是治疗和照顾整个已知银河。当然，要实现这一切也离不开资金。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No other organization does as much for the needy. Of course JoyCo’s competitors will claim it is for a cut of future exports from developing planets, but JoyCo’s mission is to heal and tend to the known galaxy. Finances are of course needed to make that happen.”"

rows.original: When you ask about JoyCo’s competitors, [bess.name] screws up [bess.hisHer] nose as if talking about something unpleasant. “JoyCo’s biggest current competitor is KihaCorp with its mainstream AI designs and cut-throat business practices.”
rows.translation: 你问起JoyCo的竞争对手时，[bess.name]皱起[bess.hisHer]的鼻子，仿佛正在谈论令人厌恶的东西。“JoyCo目前最大的竞争对手是基哈公司，它拥有主流AI设计和残酷无情的商业手段。”
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you ask about JoyCo’s competitors, [bess.name] screws up [bess.hisHer] nose as if talking about something unpleasant. “JoyCo’s biggest current competitor is KihaCorp with its mainstream AI designs and cut-throat business practices.”"

rows.original: “Where JoyCo specializes in targeted consumer needs, KihaCorp creates cheap inferior technology at low prices to flood the market. It wants to have a monopoly on the AI market, including JoyCo’s medical assist-bot line!”
rows.translation: “JoyCo专注满足特定消费者需求，而基哈公司则以低价制造廉价劣质技术，充斥市场。它想垄断AI市场，包括JoyCo的医疗助手机器人产品线！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Where JoyCo specializes in targeted consumer needs, KihaCorp creates cheap inferior technology at low prices to flood the market. It wants to have a monopoly on the AI market, including JoyCo’s medical assist-bot line!”"

There are tears and yelling - it’s a catastrophic whirlwind for a while - before [bess.heShe] starts packing up to leave [pc_ship.theName]."

rows.original: Before you know it, there’s silence, and [bess.name] has left to who knows where. You have no idea where [bess.heShe] went, or if you’ll ever see [bess.himHer] again.
rows.translation: 转眼间，四周只剩寂静，[bess.name]已经离开，不知去了哪里。你不知道[bess.heShe]去了何处，也不知道是否还能再见到[bess.himHer]。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you know it, there’s silence, and [bess.name] has left to who knows where. You have no idea where [bess.heShe] went, or if you’ll ever see [bess.himHer] again."

rows.translation: ([bess.name]已不再是你的船员。你可以在塔弗罗斯空间站再次找到[bess.himHer]。)

rows.original: You tell [bess.name] that you cannot promise to love [bess.himHer] and [bess.himHer] alone, since you’re polyamorous. [bess.name] blinks and looks you over. “...Really? I had no idea. Loving one person is intense, how can you love more than one without going nuts?” Given the whirlwind of emotions [bess.heShe]’s been feeling lately, no doubt being able to be in love with multiple people is an extraordinary thing to [bess.himHer].
rows.translation: 你告诉[bess.name]，自己是多角恋者，因此无法保证爱[bess.himHer]并且只爱[bess.himHer]一人。[bess.name]眨眨眼，上下打量你。“...真的吗？我完全不知道。爱一个人就已经如此强烈，你怎么能同时爱上不止一个人而不发疯？”考虑到[bess.heShe]最近经历的情感风暴，能够同时爱上许多人，对[bess.himHer]而言无疑是件非同寻常的事。
rows.raw: "You tell [bess.name] that you cannot promise to love [bess.himHer] and [bess.himHer] alone, since you’re polyamorous. [bess.name] blinks and looks you over. “...Really? I had no idea. Loving one person is intense, how can you love more than one without going nuts?” Given the whirlwind of emotions [bess.heShe]’s been feeling lately, no doubt being able to be in love with multiple people is an extraordinary thing to [bess.himHer]."

rows.original: “...Well, I suppose I’m not one to judge, and I love you. So... I guess as long as you don’t love me any less, and you don’t abandon me for some other sex-bot, it’s fine. It’s definitely not my first preference. Does that mean I can see other people, if I fall in love with them?”
rows.translation: “...好吧，我想我没资格评判，而且我爱你。所以...只要你不会少爱我一点，也不会为了别的性爱机器人抛弃我，我想就没问题。这绝对不是我的第一选择。那是不是意味着，如果我也爱上别人，我可以和他们交往？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Well, I suppose I’m not one to judge, and I love you. So... I guess as long as you don’t love me any less, and you don’t abandon me for some other sex-bot, it’s fine. It’s definitely not my first preference. Does that mean I can see other people, if I fall in love with them?”"

rows.original: It sounds more like a hypothetical question, [bess.name] is clearly in love with only you and may always be that way. But when it comes to other crew or people outside the ship, do you trust [bess.himHer] to fall in love with them and stay true to you?
rows.translation: 这听起来更像个假设性问题；[bess.name]显然只爱着你，而且可能永远如此。但面对其他船员或船外的人，你是否信任[bess.himHer]会爱上他们，同时仍忠于你？

rows.raw: "You walk up to [bess.name]. You notice [bess.heShe] smiles and waves, it seems [bess.heShe] has been diligently waiting for your return. It seems that is what [bess.heShe] spends ALL [bess.hisHer] time doing given that [bess.heShe] doesn’t need to eat or sleep."

rows.original: <i>“Hello,
rows.translation: <i>“你好，
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Hello, "

rows.original: ! Did you want me to accompany you on your travels now, or did you have something else in mind?”
rows.translation: ！你现在想让我陪你一起旅行，还是另有打算？”
rows.raw: "! Did you want me to accompany you on your travels now, or did you have something else in mind?”"

rows.original: Take With
rows.translation: 带她一起
rows.raw: "Take With"

rows.original: Sell
rows.translation: 出售
rows.raw: "Sell"

rows.original: Authorities
rows.translation: 当局
rows.raw: "Authorities"

rows.original: Nothing
rows.translation: 什么也不做
rows.raw: "Nothing"

rows.original: You find [bess.name] standing in the Tavros Station hangar. After the falling out you both had, [bess.heShe] struggles to meet your gaze; things seem fairly awkward.
rows.translation: 你发现[bess.name]站在塔弗罗斯空间站的机库里。你们闹翻之后，[bess.heShe]很难直视你的目光；气氛显得相当尴尬。
rows.raw: "You find [bess.name] standing in the Tavros Station hangar. After the falling out you both had, [bess.heShe] struggles to meet your gaze; things seem fairly awkward."

rows.original: ... Why is [bess.heShe] at the hangar? You thought you had both decided to go your separate ways.
rows.translation: ...为什么[bess.heShe]会在机库里？你本以为你们已经决定分道扬镳。
rows.raw: "\n\n... Why is [bess.heShe] at the hangar? You thought you had both decided to go your separate ways."

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.original: You ask [bess.name] what exactly [bess.heShe] is doing in your hangar at Tavros Station. [bess.HeShe] lets out a long sigh, looking at the floor just below your feet. Eventually, [bess.heShe] speaks to you about it.
rows.translation: 你询问[bess.name]，[bess.heShe]究竟为什么待在你位于塔弗罗斯空间站的机库里。[bess.HeShe]长长叹了口气，低头看向你脚边的地面。最后，[bess.heShe]终于开口说明。
rows.raw: "You ask [bess.name] what exactly [bess.heShe] is doing in your hangar at Tavros Station. [bess.HeShe] lets out a long sigh, looking at the floor just below your feet. Eventually, [bess.heShe] speaks to you about it."

rows.original: “...I’m an unlisted AI without a master. I can’t get passage off of Tavros Station because I can’t own papers, only my ‘owner’ can. People keep trying to escort me to lost and found, which is a lot better than what would happen if they saw my half scratched off barcode.” [bess.HeShe] explains.
rows.translation: “...我是个没有登记、也没有主人的人工智能。我无法获得离开塔弗罗斯空间站的船票，因为我不能拥有证件，只有我的‘主人’可以。人们不断试图把我送到失物招领处；这至少比他们看见我那张被刮掉一半的条形码后可能发生的事情好得多。”[bess.HeShe]解释道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...I’m an unlisted AI without a master. I can’t get passage off of Tavros Station because I can’t own papers, only my ‘owner’ can. People keep trying to escort me to lost and found, which is a lot better than what would happen if they saw my half scratched off barcode.” [bess.HeShe] explains."

rows.original: “I can’t earn credits because nobody wants to pay a robot to work; they all tell me I should be doing it for free. If I talk back, they call tech support and try to get me ‘fixed up’, so the only place I can hide out is here... at least until I come up with a clever plan.”
rows.translation: “我赚不到信用点，因为没人愿意付钱让机器人工作；他们全都说我本来就应该免费干活。如果我顶嘴，他们就会联系技术支持，试图把我‘修好’，所以我唯一能藏身的地方就是这里...至少在我想出聪明办法之前如此。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I can’t earn credits because nobody wants to pay a robot to work; they all tell me I should be doing it for free. If I talk back, they call tech support and try to get me ‘fixed up’, so the only place I can hide out is here... at least until I come up with a clever plan.”"

rows.original: It sounds like [bess.heShe]’s lucky to have escaped being scrapped, let alone being able to get a job. Even if [bess.heShe] winds up on another planet, [bess.heShe]’ll no doubt face the same sort of persecution.
rows.translation: 听起来，[bess.heShe]没有被拆成废铁就已经很幸运，更别说找到工作了。即使[bess.heShe]最后去了别的星球，[bess.heShe]无疑也会遭遇同样的迫害。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt sounds like [bess.heShe]’s lucky to have escaped being scrapped, let alone being able to get a job. Even if [bess.heShe] winds up on another planet, [bess.heShe]’ll no doubt face the same sort of persecution."

rows.original: “...Look, um, I’m sorry I’m crashing in your hangar. I promise I’ll be out of here once I can come up with some sort of plan to get papers and credits. Lost and found keeps returning me here anyway - it’s the only safe place I’ve got at the moment.”
rows.translation: “...听着，呃，很抱歉我擅自住进你的机库。我保证，只要想出取得证件和信用点的办法，就会离开这里。反正失物招领处总会把我送回这里 - 这是我目前唯一安全的地方。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Look, um, I’m sorry I’m crashing in your hangar. I promise I’ll be out of here once I can come up with some sort of plan to get papers and credits. Lost and found keeps returning me here anyway - it’s the only safe place I’ve got at the moment.”"

rows.original: Sure
rows.translation: 当然
rows.raw: "Sure"

rows.original: [bess.name] lets out a sigh of relief, finally managing to meet your gaze. <i>“...Thank you,
rows.translation: [bess.name]如释重负地叹了口气，终于设法与你对视。<i>“...谢谢你，
rows.raw: "[bess.name] lets out a sigh of relief, finally managing to meet your gaze. <i>“...Thank you, "

rows.original: . I’ll make it up to you somehow, someday.”
rows.translation: 。总有一天，我会想办法补偿你。”
rows.raw: ". I’ll make it up to you somehow, someday.”"

rows.original: Considering [bess.heShe] can’t even earn a single
rows.translation: 考虑到[bess.heShe]眼下连一枚
rows.raw: "\n\nConsidering [bess.heShe] can’t even earn a single "

rows.original: dogecoin
rows.translation: 狗狗币
rows.raw: "dogecoin"

rows.original: credit
rows.translation: 信用点
rows.raw: "credit"

rows.original: for [bess.himHer]self at the moment, it seems that day will be very far away indeed.
rows.translation: 都无法替[bess.himHer]自己赚到，那一天看来确实遥遥无期。
rows.raw: " for [bess.himHer]self at the moment, it seems that day will be very far away indeed."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Nope
rows.translation: 不行
rows.raw: "Nope"

rows.original: You decide [bess.heShe] can’t stay in your hangar and kick [bess.himHer] out. [bess.HeShe] decided [bess.heShe] was going to leave the ship - [bess.heShe] can’t continue relying on your good nature.
rows.translation: 你决定不能让[bess.heShe]留在机库，于是把[bess.himHer]赶了出去。[bess.HeShe]已经决定[bess.heShe]要离开飞船 - [bess.heShe]不能继续依赖你的善意。
rows.raw: "You decide [bess.heShe] can’t stay in your hangar and kick [bess.himHer] out. [bess.HeShe] decided [bess.heShe] was going to leave the ship - [bess.heShe] can’t continue relying on your good nature."

rows.original: [bess.name] takes the elevator out before you call the authorities. You doubt you’ll be seeing [bess.himHer] about again.
rows.translation: [bess.name]在你呼叫当局前搭电梯离开。你怀疑自己不会再见到[bess.himHer]了。
rows.raw: "\n\n[bess.name] takes the elevator out before you call the authorities. You doubt you’ll be seeing [bess.himHer] about again."

rows.original: ([bess.name] is no longer part of your crew.)
rows.translation: ([bess.name]不再是你的船员。)
rows.raw: "\n\n([bess.name] is no longer part of your crew.)"

rows.original: BESS
rows.raw: "BESS"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Invite
rows.translation: 邀请
rows.raw: "Invite"

rows.original: You tell [bess.name] that [bess.heShe]’s welcome back on your ship if [bess.heShe] wants to come with you. [bess.HeShe] looks at you with clearly mixed feelings; you didn’t leave on the best terms after all. That said, [bess.hisHer] situation is quite dire.
rows.translation: 你告诉[bess.name]，如果[bess.heShe]愿意跟你走，随时欢迎[bess.heShe]回到飞船。[bess.HeShe]带着明显复杂的感情看向你；毕竟你们上次分别时关系并不好。尽管如此，[bess.hisHer]处境确实相当严峻。
rows.raw: "You tell [bess.name] that [bess.heShe]’s welcome back on your ship if [bess.heShe] wants to come with you. [bess.HeShe] looks at you with clearly mixed feelings; you didn’t leave on the best terms after all. That said, [bess.hisHer] situation is quite dire."

rows.original: “...If I come with you, on your ship, does that mean we’re... friends again?” [bess.name] is trying very hard not to get [bess.hisHer] hopes up as [bess.heShe] stares at you with [bess.eyeColor] eyes.
rows.translation: “...如果我跟你回到飞船，是不是代表我们又...成为朋友了？”[bess.name]努力不让[bess.hisHer]抱有太高期望，[bess.heShe]用[bess.eyeColor]双眼凝视着你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...If I come with you, on your ship, does that mean we’re... friends again?” [bess.name] is trying very hard not to get [bess.hisHer] hopes up as [bess.heShe] stares at you with [bess.eyeColor] eyes."

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: “...That’s... that’s all I ever wanted!” [bess.name] begins to tear up; clearly being off the ship has been an incredibly trying experience. [bess.HisHer] brave face crumbles all at once as [bess.heShe] gives you a hug, glad to be back on board again.
rows.translation: “...那就是...那就是我一直想要的全部！”[bess.name]开始落泪；离开飞船的这段经历显然令其备受煎熬。[bess.HisHer]强装出的坚强瞬间崩塌，[bess.heShe]抱住你，为自己终于重新回到船上而欣喜。
rows.raw: "“...That’s... that’s all I ever wanted!” [bess.name] begins to tear up; clearly being off the ship has been an incredibly trying experience. [bess.HisHer] brave face crumbles all at once as [bess.heShe] gives you a hug, glad to be back on board again."

rows.original: ([bess.name] has now returned to the ship as a follower!)
rows.translation: （[bess.name]现已作为跟随者返回飞船！）
rows.raw: "\n\n([bess.name] has now returned to the ship as a follower!)"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: You tell [bess.name] that you are still not friends, and [bess.hisHer] return to the ship would be purely as acquaintances.
rows.translation: 你告诉[bess.name]，你们仍然不是朋友，而[bess.hisHer]返回飞船后，你们只会是普通熟人。
rows.raw: "You tell [bess.name] that you are still not friends, and [bess.hisHer] return to the ship would be purely as acquaintances."

rows.original: Either [bess.hisHer] pride is too strong, or [bess.heShe] can’t bear the thought, because [bess.heShe] refuses your offer. “...If that’s the case, I’ll stay on Tavros. Either way, I’ll be somewhere where I’m not really welcome... being here would hurt less.”
rows.translation: 或许是[bess.hisHer]自尊心太强，也或许是[bess.heShe]无法承受这种想法，[bess.heShe]拒绝了你的提议。“...如果是这样，我会留在塔弗罗斯。不管怎样，我都会待在一个并不真正欢迎我的地方...留在这里至少没那么痛苦。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEither [bess.hisHer] pride is too strong, or [bess.heShe] can’t bear the thought, because [bess.heShe] refuses your offer. “...If that’s the case, I’ll stay on Tavros. Either way, I’ll be somewhere where I’m not really welcome... being here would hurt less.”"

rows.original: You can’t seem to change [bess.hisHer] mind, so you leave [bess.himHer] be for now.
rows.translation: 你似乎无法改变[bess.hisHer]的想法，只好暂时任由[bess.himHer]去了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t seem to change [bess.hisHer] mind, so you leave [bess.himHer] be for now."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Nothing
rows.translation: 什么也不做
rows.raw: "Nothing"

rows.original: There is a strange silver glint over in a large pile of junk. It is completely out of place with the rusted rubbish surrounding it. Maybe it is something valuable?
rows.translation: 一大堆垃圾中闪烁着奇怪的银色光芒，与周围锈蚀的废物显得格格不入。也许那是什么值钱的东西？
rows.raw: "\n\nThere is a strange silver glint over in a large pile of junk. It is completely out of place with the rusted rubbish surrounding it. Maybe it is something valuable?"

rows.original: Silver Object
rows.translation: 银色物体
rows.raw: "Silver Object"

rows.original: Silver Object
rows.translation: 银色物体
rows.raw: "Silver Object"

rows.original: JimT
rows.raw: "JimT"

rows.original: You abandon caution for curiosity and inch closer towards the silvery object.
rows.translation: 好奇心压过谨慎，你一点点靠近那个银色物体。
rows.raw: "You abandon caution for curiosity and inch closer towards the silvery object."

rows.original: As you close in, you realize two things. One, it is much larger than it first appeared. Two, the shape of the part that is sticking out is easy to identify.
rows.translation: 靠近后，你意识到两件事。第一，它比最初看起来大得多。第二，露在外面的部分形状很容易辨认。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you close in, you realize two things. One, it is much larger than it first appeared. Two, the shape of the part that is sticking out is easy to identify."

rows.original: It’s a foot. Why is a silvery foot poking out of a pile of half-broken pipes and shattered holos?
rows.translation: 那是一只脚。为什么一只银色的脚会从一堆半毁管道和破碎全息设备中伸出来？
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a foot. Why is a silvery foot poking out of a pile of half-broken pipes and shattered holos?"

rows.original: It looks like a machine foot, to boot. On further examination, the foot is connected to a body, and the body is buried beneath the rubbish.
rows.translation: 更准确地说，那看起来像一只机械脚。进一步检查后，你发现这只脚连接着一具身体，而身体则埋在垃圾下面。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt looks like a machine foot, to boot. On further examination, the foot is connected to a body, and the body is buried beneath the rubbish."

rows.original: It looks far too sleek looking to be one of the Pleasure Bots that aimlessly roam the Tarkus wastes.
rows.translation: 它的外形实在过于流线光洁，不像那些漫无目的游荡在塔库斯荒地的欢愉机器人。
rows.raw: " It looks far too sleek looking to be one of the Pleasure Bots that aimlessly roam the Tarkus wastes."

rows.original: From what you can see it doesn’t look rusted, or even slightly scratched, adding even more to the air of mystery surrounding it.
rows.translation: 从你能看到的部分来看，它没有生锈，甚至连轻微划痕都没有，令笼罩它的神秘气息更加浓厚。
rows.raw: " From what you can see it doesn’t look rusted, or even slightly scratched, adding even more to the air of mystery surrounding it."

rows.original: You can’t believe the Sydians haven’t melted this thing down yet.
rows.translation: 真不敢相信西迪安人居然还没把这东西熔掉。
rows.raw: " You can’t believe the Sydians haven’t melted this thing down yet."

rows.original: female
rows.raw: "female"

rows.original: Your Codex bleeps at you when the unit is apparently finished charging. You finish your drink and head back down to the cargo bay.
rows.translation: 当装置似乎充电完毕时，你的随身终端朝你发出提示音。你喝完饮料，返回货舱。
rows.raw: "Your Codex bleeps at you when the unit is apparently finished charging. You finish your drink and head back down to the cargo bay."

rows.original: When you get there, the
rows.translation: 当你抵达那里时，
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you get there, the "

rows.original: male
rows.translation: 男性
rows.raw: "male"

rows.original: female
rows.translation: 女性
rows.raw: "female"

rows.original: android is already retracting the coupling cable out of the wall with a satisfied sigh. As [bess.heShe] stands upright it slides back inside [bess.hisHer] body and disappears completely from sight.
rows.translation: 机器人已经满足地叹息着，正把连接电缆缩回墙内。当[bess.heShe]直起身体时，电缆滑回[bess.hisHer]体内，彻底消失不见。
rows.raw: " android is already retracting the coupling cable out of the wall with a satisfied sigh. As [bess.heShe] stands upright it slides back inside [bess.hisHer] body and disappears completely from sight."

rows.original: You can hear [bess.hisHer] rear compartment closing with a small clicking noise.
rows.translation: 你听见[bess.hisHer]后部舱室伴着轻微咔哒声关闭。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can hear [bess.hisHer] rear compartment closing with a small clicking noise."

rows.original: Striding into the room, you have your [pc.weapon] pointed at [bess.himHer] for good measure. After all, [bess.heShe] may have been dumped on Tarkus for good reason.
rows.translation: 你走进房间，为保险起见用[pc.weapon]指着[bess.himHer]。毕竟，[bess.heShe]被丢弃在塔尔科斯或许事出有因。
rows.raw: "\n\nStriding into the room, you have your [pc.weapon] pointed at [bess.himHer] for good measure. After all, [bess.heShe] may have been dumped on Tarkus for good reason."

rows.original: When the silver-haired synthetic notices you entering the room,
rows.translation: 当银发合成人注意到你进入房间时，
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen the silver-haired synthetic notices you entering the room, "

joinAfter.expression:
bess.mf(
                                  "he elegantly bows to you, almost as he were a butler or maitre d’",
                                  "she immediately bows to you, her hands clasped together in front of her body",
                                )

rows.original: he elegantly bows to you, almost as he were a butler or maitre d’
rows.translation: 他优雅地向你鞠躬，姿态几乎像个管家或领班
rows.raw: "he elegantly bows to you, almost as he were a butler or maitre d’"

rows.original: she immediately bows to you, her hands clasped together in front of her body
rows.translation: 她立刻向你鞠躬，双手合拢在身前
rows.raw: "she immediately bows to you, her hands clasped together in front of her body"

rows.original: . [bess.HeShe] seems unphased not only by your weapon, but also by the fact that [bess.heShe] is completely nude.
rows.translation: 。[bess.HeShe]似乎完全没有受到影响，不仅无视你的武器，也毫不在意[bess.heShe]正一丝不挂。
rows.raw: ". [bess.HeShe] seems unphased not only by your weapon, but also by the fact that [bess.heShe] is completely nude."

rows.original: When she speaks, her voice is positively melodic, each note lilting and falling at all the right places without a hint of synthesising, like a well-composed sonnet.
rows.translation: 她开口时，嗓音悦耳得近乎旋律，每个音节都在恰到好处的位置起伏，丝毫没有合成痕迹，宛如一首精心谱写的十四行诗。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen she speaks, her voice is positively melodic, each note lilting and falling at all the right places without a hint of synthesising, like a well-composed sonnet."

rows.original: When he speaks, his voice is rich and full of timbre, far from the synthesized voice of typical androids. Instead, it sounds full and flavorsome, like a well composed sonnet.
rows.translation: 他开口时，嗓音浑厚且富有音色，远非普通机器人的合成声音。相反，那声音饱满而有滋味，宛如一首精心谱写的十四行诗。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen he speaks, his voice is rich and full of timbre, far from the synthesized voice of typical androids. Instead, it sounds full and flavorsome, like a well composed sonnet."

rows.original: “Greetings, [pc.Master]! Thank you for purchasing this unit from JoyCo, the number one galactic seller of medical supplies and high-quality assist-bots!”
rows.translation: “向您问好，[pc.Master]！感谢您从欢乐公司购买本机；欢乐公司是银河第一的医疗用品与优质辅助机器人销售商！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Greetings, [pc.Master]! Thank you for purchasing this unit from JoyCo, the number one galactic seller of medical supplies and high-quality assist-bots!” "

joinAfter.expression:
bess.mf(
                                  "He sounds remarkably upbeat",
                                  "She sounds surprisingly happy",
                                )

rows.original: He sounds remarkably upbeat
rows.translation: 他的声音听起来格外欢快
rows.raw: "He sounds remarkably upbeat"

rows.original: She sounds surprisingly happy
rows.translation: 她的声音听起来出奇地开心
rows.raw: "She sounds surprisingly happy"

rows.original: for someone who was just fished out of a junk pile. “JoyCo hopes you enjoy your purchase, since your pleasure is our pleasure!”
rows.translation: ，完全不像刚从垃圾堆里捞出来的人。“欢乐公司希望您能享受这次购买，因为您的快乐就是我们的快乐！”
rows.raw: " for someone who was just fished out of a junk pile. “JoyCo hopes you enjoy your purchase, since your pleasure is our pleasure!”"

rows.original: You ask exactly who and what [bess.heShe] is, and why [bess.heShe] is calling you ‘[pc.Master]’. There are an awful lot of ‘w’ questions that need to be answered until you put down your weapon.
