rows.raw: "Well two can play at this game, you figure, and return his stony expression with one of your own."

rows.original: You lean back with a sigh. Though you’re curious, you have better things to do than have your inquiries answered grudgingly.
rows.translation: 你叹了口气，向后靠去。虽然心中好奇，但你还有更重要的事情可做，没必要让自己的问题只得到不情不愿的回答。
rows.raw: "You lean back with a sigh. Though you’re curious, you have better things to do than have your inquiries answered grudgingly."

rows.original: “You’re not familiar with saurmorians, are you?” As you indicate that you’re apparently not, he nods with a grunt, “Thought so. Saurmorians are, what do ya call it... Cold blooded? Well, kinda cold blooded. But we’re made for intense heat. On other worlds, our scales tighten to trap in warmth. This ends up a problem for us guys, since we’re more dense than the women,” the brute growls, though you’re not sure if that last bit was a joke. “Something about the men being underground more, where the more volcanic temps were, and needing less ventilation and more prevention of hot air,” he rumbles as his azure peepers bore into your own eyes.
rows.translation: “你不熟悉索莫里安，对吧？”你表示自己确实不了解，他便咕哝着点头：“我就知道。索莫里安算是，你们怎么说来着...冷血动物？嗯，算是冷血吧。但我们的身体适应了酷热环境。在其他星球，我们的鳞片会收紧，把热量锁在体内。这对男性来说会成为问题，因为我们比女性更致密，”这名壮汉低吼道，不过你不确定最后一句是不是玩笑。“大概是因为男性以前更多待在地下，那里的温度更接近火山环境；我们需要的不是更多通风，而是更好地阻止热空气进入，”他隆隆说着，一双蔚蓝眼睛直直钻进你的目光。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re not familiar with saurmorians, are you?” As you indicate that you’re apparently not, he nods with a grunt, “Thought so. Saurmorians are, what do ya call it... Cold blooded? Well, kinda cold blooded. But we’re made for intense heat. On other worlds, our scales tighten to trap in warmth. This ends up a problem for us guys, since we’re more dense than the women,” the brute growls, though you’re not sure if that last bit was a joke. “Something about the men being underground more, where the more volcanic temps were, and needing less ventilation and more prevention of hot air,” he rumbles as his azure peepers bore into your own eyes."

rows.original: Glad that he’s actually talking openly, you note that he said saurmorians weren’t completely cold blooded. What did he mean?
rows.translation: 你很高兴他终于愿意坦率交谈，同时注意到他曾说索莫里安并不完全属于冷血动物。他是什么意思？
rows.raw: "\n\nGlad that he’s actually talking openly, you note that he said saurmorians weren’t completely cold blooded. What did he mean?"

rows.original: “Yeah, we kinda generate body heat like you warm bloods, but can’t cool off like one. That’s the problem with being on an alien world, I guess; we travel and fight and shit like we would back in the day, except our scales don’t open to help with releasing the heat. It’s why you’ll see most males as very apathetic, or callous, when out in the galaxy. Gotta keep our heads cool so we don’t get too hot headed,” he finishes casually, again leaving you wondering if that last bit was intentional.
rows.translation: “对，我们的确会像你们温血动物那样产生一些体温，但没办法像你们那样降温。我想，这就是身处异星世界的问题；我们像过去一样旅行、战斗和干其他破事，可鳞片却不会张开帮助散热。所以你在银河里见到的大多数男性都会显得十分冷漠，甚至无情。必须保持头脑冷静，免得真的热血上头，”他随意地说完，再次让你怀疑最后那句话是不是故意的。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, we kinda generate body heat like you warm bloods, but can’t cool off like one. That’s the problem with being on an alien world, I guess; we travel and fight and shit like we would back in the day, except our scales don’t open to help with releasing the heat. It’s why you’ll see most males as very apathetic, or callous, when out in the galaxy. Gotta keep our heads cool so we don’t get too hot headed,” he finishes casually, again leaving you wondering if that last bit was intentional."

rows.original: Well, you weren’t really expecting a xenobiology lesson. Anyways, that sounds like it could get difficult. Why would he or any other saurmorians be offworld then?
rows.translation: 好吧，你原本并没期待听上一堂异星生物学课。不管怎样，这听起来可能会相当麻烦。那他和其他索莫里安为什么还要离开母星？
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, you weren’t really expecting a xenobiology lesson. Anyways, that sounds like it could get difficult. Why would he or any other saurmorians be offworld then?"

rows.original: “Other than being contracted off world for whatever reason, I can’t really say. I’m out here playing space cowboy because I decided to do what I wanted to do. Which, it turns out, is the same thing every other spacer sets off to do,” Chaurmine grunts, idly picking at the table with a claw.
rows.translation: “除了因为什么原因被签约派往外星，我也说不准。我会在这里扮演太空牛仔，是因为我决定去做自己想做的事。结果发现，这和每个踏上旅途的太空人想做的事都一样，”乔敏咕哝着，用一根爪子漫不经心地抠着桌面。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Other than being contracted off world for whatever reason, I can’t really say. I’m out here playing space cowboy because I decided to do what I wanted to do. Which, it turns out, is the same thing every other spacer sets off to do,” Chaurmine grunts, idly picking at the table with a claw."

rows.original: You nod sympathetically. Not much different from what you’re doing, you figure. Though you have something more specific you’re looking for.
rows.translation: 你同情地点头，心想这与你正在做的事情没什么不同。不过，你确实在寻找某个更加明确的目标。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod sympathetically. Not much different from what you’re doing, you figure. Though you have something more specific you’re looking for."

rows.original: This seems to pique a sliver of his interest, “And what is that, then?” You proceed to talk about your dad, and the quest he set you on in order to inherit the seat of CEO of Steele Tech. Chaurmine snorts in mild mirth, perhaps the first real indication of emotion since you sat down. “Must have been quite a guy,” he says, and you habitually nod in response.
rows.translation: 这似乎稍稍勾起了他的兴趣。“那是什么？”你接着讲起父亲，以及他为了让你继承斯蒂尔科技首席执行官席位而交给你的任务。乔敏略带愉快地哼了一声；这或许是你坐下以来，他第一次真正流露情绪。“他一定是个了不起的人，”他说，而你习惯性地点头回应。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis seems to pique a sliver of his interest, “And what is that, then?” You proceed to talk about your dad, and the quest he set you on in order to inherit the seat of CEO of Steele Tech. Chaurmine snorts in mild mirth, perhaps the first real indication of emotion since you sat down. “Must have been quite a guy,” he says, and you habitually nod in response."

rows.original: Turning the topic back to him, you ask if he has a ship. Running off into space would be hard enough without one, let alone doing so as a huge lizard covered in metal.
rows.translation: 你把话题拉回他身上，询问他是否拥有飞船。没有飞船就闯入太空已经够困难了，更别说还是一只浑身覆盖金属的巨型蜥蜴。
rows.raw: "\n\nTurning the topic back to him, you ask if he has a ship. Running off into space would be hard enough without one, let alone doing so as a huge lizard covered in metal."

rows.original: Chaurmine seems to spend a moment thinking over your inquiry, then lets out a sigh. “Back then, if I was in a position where I had a ship, I’d either be well off enough to the point where I wouldn’t want to leave, or be forced to stay by military law,” he growls, his tone stained with a touch of scorn, “Nah, I started my fun in space hitchhiking. Though I did manage to get my own ship a few years ago...”
rows.translation: 乔敏似乎花了片刻思考你的问题，随后叹了口气。“以前，如果我处在能拥有飞船的地位，要么已经富裕到根本不想离开，要么会因军事法律被迫留下，”他低吼道，语气中染着一丝轻蔑。“不，我最初在太空里的乐趣是搭便船。不过几年前，我确实设法弄到了自己的船...”
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine seems to spend a moment thinking over your inquiry, then lets out a sigh. “Back then, if I was in a position where I had a ship, I’d either be well off enough to the point where I wouldn’t want to leave, or be forced to stay by military law,” he growls, his tone stained with a touch of scorn, “Nah, I started my fun in space hitchhiking. Though I did manage to get my own ship a few years ago...”"

rows.original: Figuring you’ll humor him, and a little curious yourself, you ask him about his hard earned space vessel. It’s something he obviously takes some measure of pride in.
rows.translation: 你决定顺着他的话说，自己也有些好奇，于是询问那艘由他辛苦挣来的太空船。显然，他对此颇为自豪。
rows.raw: "\n\nFiguring you’ll humor him, and a little curious yourself, you ask him about his hard earned space vessel. It’s something he obviously takes some measure of pride in."

rows.original: “Damn right,” he rumbles, “Going from dirt-broke to owning a heavy Saurmorian Bulwark Command corvette is a very good feeling.” He lets out a sigh as he leans back in his seat, though it almost sounds more like a growl to you. “And I mean heavy by saurmorian standards. Yeah, it’s slow and isn’t the easiest to handle, but it’s easily the most durable ship in its class,” he explains.
rows.translation: “那当然，”他隆隆说道，“从穷得叮当响，到拥有一艘索莫里安壁垒司令部重型护卫舰，感觉非常好。”他靠回座位，发出一声叹息，不过听在你耳中更像低吼。“而且我说的重型，是按索莫里安标准衡量。没错，它很慢，也不算容易操纵，但绝对是同级别中最坚固耐用的飞船，”他解释道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn right,” he rumbles, “Going from dirt-broke to owning a heavy Saurmorian Bulwark Command corvette is a very good feeling.” He lets out a sigh as he leans back in his seat, though it almost sounds more like a growl to you. “And I mean heavy by saurmorian standards. Yeah, it’s slow and isn’t the easiest to handle, but it’s easily the most durable ship in its class,” he explains."

rows.original: Sounding like a vessel from the saurmorians’ military, you imagine this would have been outrageously expensive, let alone how it could be legal. How many years has he been wandering the galaxy?
rows.translation: 听起来像索莫里安军方的舰船；你猜这东西一定贵得离谱，更别提它怎么可能是合法的。他在银河中游荡多少年了？
rows.raw: "\n\nSounding like a vessel from the saurmorians’ military, you imagine this would have been outrageously expensive, let alone how it could be legal. How many years has he been wandering the galaxy?"

rows.original: The brute growls and shakes his bulky head with a scrape of his scales, “I think you, of all people, know the kind of money that can end up in your pocket in the more rough edges of society. Perfectly legal, too. The SBC decommissions aging ships, after stripping off their weapons of course, and eventually sells them to the public. Cash being worth more than scrap metal to my kind, you see.”
rows.translation: 壮汉低吼一声，鳞片刮擦着摇动粗壮脑袋。“我想，所有人里偏偏是你，应该最清楚社会边缘地带能让多少钱落进口袋。而且完全合法。索莫里安壁垒司令部会把老化飞船除役，当然会先拆掉武器，随后最终卖给公众。你看，对我的族人而言，现金比废金属更有价值。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe brute growls and shakes his bulky head with a scrape of his scales, “I think you, of all people, know the kind of money that can end up in your pocket in the more rough edges of society. Perfectly legal, too. The SBC decommissions aging ships, after stripping off their weapons of course, and eventually sells them to the public. Cash being worth more than scrap metal to my kind, you see.”"

rows.original: You nod, noticing he didn’t seem to care to count the years he’s been out here.
rows.translation: 你点点头，注意到他似乎根本懒得计算自己已经在外漂泊多少年。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, noticing he didn’t seem to care to count the years he’s been out here."

rows.original: “What about you,” he growls, “I doubt someone of your worth started a quest like this without a ride.”
rows.translation: “你呢？”他低吼道，“我不相信像你这样身价的人，会连代步工具都没有就开始这种任务。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What about you,” he growls, “I doubt someone of your worth started a quest like this without a ride.”"

rows.original: You
rows.translation: 你
rows.raw: "\n\nYou "

rows.original: grin
rows.translation: 咧嘴笑着
rows.raw: "grin"

rows.original: laugh nervously
rows.translation: 紧张地笑起来
rows.raw: "laugh nervously"

rows.original: as you picture your old, inherited ship next to what his must be like.
rows.translation: ；你想象着自己继承来的老旧飞船停在他那艘船旁边的样子。
rows.raw: " as you picture your old, inherited ship next to what his must be like. "

rows.original: “Well, it’s not a corvette, but my old man left me his clunky Casstech Z14. It’s in good shape for its age, and I’m proud to be its captain,” you say with confidence.
rows.translation: “好吧，它不是护卫舰，但我父亲给我留下了那艘笨重的卡斯泰克Z14。以它的年纪而言，船况很好，而我也以担任它的船长为荣，”你自信地说道。
rows.raw: "“Well, it’s not a corvette, but my old man left me his clunky Casstech Z14. It’s in good shape for its age, and I’m proud to be its captain,” you say with confidence."

rows.original: “Well, uh, it was my dad’s before giving it to me. Many of his adventures in the old thing... I guess he wanted me to make my own with it too,” you finish with a shrug.
rows.translation: “那个，呃，它以前属于我父亲，后来才交给我。他曾驾驶那艘老家伙经历过许多冒险...我想，他也希望我用它创造自己的冒险，”你耸肩说完。
rows.raw: "“Well, uh, it was my dad’s before giving it to me. Many of his adventures in the old thing... I guess he wanted me to make my own with it too,” you finish with a shrug."

rows.original: Chaurmine nods and leans forward. “Must be some ship, huh?” he rumbles.
rows.translation: 乔敏点点头，身体前倾。“一定是艘不得了的船，对吧？”他隆隆说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine nods and leans forward. “Must be some ship, huh?” he rumbles."

rows.original: Aullama
rows.raw: "Aullama"

rows.original: So why is he on Tarkus specifically? Hardly seems like a place that would have anything of worth to him.
rows.translation: 那么，他为什么偏偏来到塔尔科斯？这里怎么看都不像有什么对他有价值的东西。
rows.raw: "So why is he on Tarkus specifically? Hardly seems like a place that would have anything of worth to him."

rows.original: “Not here for the locals, either,” he grunts, “I was hoping to find some outdated weapons that may have been thrown out. Every once in a rare while, old tech can still be useful. Though I haven’t found jack shit yet, and now I regret coming to this heap of junk. The air irritates my scales...” He shivers, making his scales clank and clatter against each other.
rows.translation: “我也不是为了本地人而来，”他咕哝道，“我是希望找到一些可能被丢弃的过时武器。极少数情况下，老技术仍可能派上用场。不过我到现在连根毛都没找到，已经后悔来这堆破烂了。这里的空气会刺激我的鳞片...”他打了个寒颤，令鳞片彼此碰撞，叮当作响。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not here for the locals, either,” he grunts, “I was hoping to find some outdated weapons that may have been thrown out. Every once in a rare while, old tech can still be useful. Though I haven’t found jack shit yet, and now I regret coming to this heap of junk. The air irritates my scales...” He shivers, making his scales clank and clatter against each other."

rows.original: That brings up an interesting question: how have his scales not corroded? Not just from the environment, but the natives too.
rows.translation: 这引出了一个有趣的问题：他的鳞片为什么没有腐蚀？不仅要考虑环境，还有本地居民。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat brings up an interesting question: how have his scales not corroded? Not just from the environment, but the natives too."

rows.original: Chaurmine responds with a shrug as he growls, “Hmph, fuck if I know. What I do know is that any of those bugs or fat-eared skinks that come near me are getting a fistful of these scales they covet so much!” He curls an armored hand into a tight fist, his silvery scales reflecting the surrounding area like polished platemail. “No, seriously, tell me if you see any bugs.”
rows.translation: 乔敏耸肩回应，低吼道：“哼，我他妈怎么知道。我确实知道的是，任何胆敢靠近我的虫子或肥耳石龙子，都会吃上一记满是它们如此垂涎鳞片的拳头！”他把一只装甲手掌紧紧攥成拳头，银色鳞片像抛光板甲一样映照着周围。“不，认真说，如果看到虫子就告诉我。”
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine responds with a shrug as he growls, “Hmph, fuck if I know. What I do know is that any of those bugs or fat-eared skinks that come near me are getting a fistful of these scales they covet so much!” He curls an armored hand into a tight fist, his silvery scales reflecting the surrounding area like polished platemail. “No, seriously, tell me if you see any bugs.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Aullama
rows.raw: "Aullama"

rows.original: Considering your connections, and his apparent success, you bring up the possibility of the two of you assisting each other. You’d likely be an effective duo.
rows.translation: 考虑到你的人脉以及他显然取得的成功，你提出两人互相协助的可能性。你们很可能会成为一对高效组合。
rows.raw: "Considering your connections, and his apparent success, you bring up the possibility of the two of you assisting each other. You’d likely be an effective duo."

rows.original: This causes the tin lizard to shake his head, then rumble, “Let me stop you there [pc.name]. I’m not gonna do the whole lone wolf spiel, but I do work alone. Besides, I’m pretty sure that would be a one sided deal.”
rows.translation: 这让铁皮蜥蜴摇了摇头，随后隆隆说道：“先打住，[pc.name]。我不打算讲什么独行狼的陈词滥调，但我的确独自工作。再说，我很确定那会是一笔单方面受益的交易。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThis causes the tin lizard to shake his head, then rumble, “Let me stop you there [pc.name]. I’m not gonna do the whole lone wolf spiel, but I do work alone. Besides, I’m pretty sure that would be a one sided deal.”"

rows.original: Well, fuck.
rows.translation: 好吧，操。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, fuck."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Tarkus
rows.translation: 塔库斯
rows.raw: "Tarkus"

rows.original: Tarkus
rows.translation: 塔库斯
rows.raw: "Tarkus"

rows.original: What brought him to Tarkus?
rows.translation: 是什么把他带到塔尔科斯的？
rows.raw: "What brought him to Tarkus?"

rows.original: Help
rows.translation: 协助
rows.raw: "Help"

rows.original: Help
rows.translation: 协助
rows.raw: "Help"

rows.original: Maybe you could assist one another.
rows.translation: 也许你们可以互相帮助。
rows.raw: "Maybe you could assist one another."

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: About Him
rows.translation: 关于他
rows.raw: "About Him"

rows.original: Get to know the big guy.
rows.translation: 了解这个大块头。
rows.raw: "Get to know the big guy."

rows.original: His Home
rows.translation: 他的家乡
rows.raw: "His Home"

rows.original: Aullama
rows.raw: "Aullama"

rows.original: You ask Chaurmine if he could, perhaps, tell you more about his species’ home planet. Molis, you believe it was called. You wonder what kind of world could create something like a saurmorian naturally.
rows.translation: 你询问乔敏，能否多讲一些他种族的母星。你记得那里似乎叫作摩利斯。你很好奇，怎样的世界才能自然孕育出索莫里安这样的生物。
rows.raw: "You ask Chaurmine if he could, perhaps, tell you more about his species’ home planet. Molis, you believe it was called. You wonder what kind of world could create something like a saurmorian naturally."

rows.original: “Yeah, sure,” he says with a slow nod, adding, “Not much to say about it other than ‘it’s a massive rock’, really. Hell, your UGC dubbed it Molis. A massive, hot rock covered in volcanoes.”
rows.translation: “嗯，当然，”他缓缓点头说道，随后补充，“其实没什么可讲的，只能说‘那是一块巨大的岩石’。该死，是你们银河联合邦联把它命名为摩利斯。一块巨大、炽热、遍布火山的岩石。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, sure,” he says with a slow nod, adding, “Not much to say about it other than ‘it’s a massive rock’, really. Hell, your UGC dubbed it Molis. A massive, hot rock covered in volcanoes.”"

rows.original: Well, you were hoping to get more details than that,
rows.translation: 好吧，你原本希望听到比这更详细的描述，
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, you were hoping to get more details than that, "

rows.original: human
rows.raw: "human"

rows.original: but it sounds similar to Venus.
rows.translation: 但听起来与金星很相似。
rows.raw: "but it sounds similar to Venus."

rows.original: but it sounds kinda like a planet from terran space; Venus, to be exact.
rows.translation: 但听起来有点像地球空间的一颗行星，准确说就是金星。
rows.raw: "but it sounds kinda like a planet from terran space; Venus, to be exact."

rows.original: Chaurmine pauses and reaches for a big, outdated codex. After the better half of a minute, he snorts and turns his attention to you again. “I guess, yeah. Though Molis is many times bigger...And not quite as hot or toxic on its surface...Otherwise, I guess I can see the resemblance,” he says, putting his codex away before continuing, “Not sure if your ‘Venus’ has any water or life on it, but Molis has rare bodies of water on it. The scarcity of water on the surface wasn’t a major concern in the past, what with moisture also being underground, but ever since the UGC found us, and our populations grew, water has become the biggest import of saurmorians.”
rows.translation: 乔敏停顿下来，伸手拿起一台又大又过时的随身终端。大半分钟后，他哼了一声，重新把注意力转向你。“我想，是吧。不过摩利斯要大上许多倍...而且地表没那么炎热或有毒...除此之外，我想确实能看出相似之处，”他说着收起随身终端，随后继续道，“我不确定你们的‘金星’上有没有水或生命，但摩利斯的确有少量水体。过去，地表缺水不算重大问题，毕竟地下也有水分；但自从银河联合邦联发现我们、人口开始增长后，水便成了索莫里安最大的进口商品。”
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine pauses and reaches for a big, outdated codex. After the better half of a minute, he snorts and turns his attention to you again. “I guess, yeah. Though Molis is many times bigger...And not quite as hot or toxic on its surface...Otherwise, I guess I can see the resemblance,” he says, putting his codex away before continuing, “Not sure if your ‘Venus’ has any water or life on it, but Molis has rare bodies of water on it. The scarcity of water on the surface wasn’t a major concern in the past, what with moisture also being underground, but ever since the UGC found us, and our populations grew, water has become the biggest import of saurmorians.”"

rows.original: Nodding thoughtfully, you note that importing water must have put much less strain on the natural reservoirs.
rows.translation: 你若有所思地点头，指出进口水源一定大大减轻了天然蓄水区的压力。
rows.raw: "\n\nNodding thoughtfully, you note that importing water must have put much less strain on the natural reservoirs."

rows.original: The tin brute gives an amused grunt, “Of course, granted this was only a millennium or so ago,” he says dryly. “The planet is a surface of jagged black stone, just larger lakes and stuff.”
rows.translation: 铁皮壮汉愉快地哼了一声。“当然，只不过这都是大约一千年前的事了，”他冷淡地说道。“这颗星球的地表确实满是锯齿状黑岩，只是如今多了更大的湖泊之类。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe tin brute gives an amused grunt, “Of course, granted this was only a millennium or so ago,” he says dryly. “The planet is a surface of jagged black stone, just larger lakes and stuff.”"

rows.original: Agriculture must be near impossible, you imagine. Stone surfaces are usually not a good source of nourishment for produce.
rows.translation: 你猜，农业在那里肯定近乎不可能。石质地表通常无法为农作物提供良好养分。
rows.raw: "\n\nAgriculture must be near impossible, you imagine. Stone surfaces are usually not a good source of nourishment for produce."

rows.original: Chaurmine stares blankly at you for a moment, “Pro-doos?” He blinks as understanding hits, “Oh, you mean plants and shit, right? Never heard of a saurmorian family ever growing anything. Most-... well, everything on our world relies on meat and minerals.” He taps a metallic scale on his nose for emphasis. “That includes the few plantlife on Molis. I doubt any saurmorian has ever really thought about consuming those weeds,” he grumbles.
rows.translation: 乔敏茫然看了你片刻。“农-作物？”他眨眨眼，终于理解。“哦，你是说植物之类的破玩意儿，对吧？我从没听说哪个索莫里安家庭种过东西。大多数...不，我们世界上的一切都依赖肉类和矿物质。”他敲了敲鼻梁上的金属鳞片，以此强调。“这也包括摩利斯上为数不多的植物。我怀疑是否有索莫里安真正考虑过食用那些杂草，”他咕哝道。
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine stares blankly at you for a moment, “Pro-doos?” He blinks as understanding hits, “Oh, you mean plants and shit, right? Never heard of a saurmorian family ever growing anything. Most-... well, everything on our world relies on meat and minerals.” He taps a metallic scale on his nose for emphasis. “That includes the few plantlife on Molis. I doubt any saurmorian has ever really thought about consuming those weeds,” he grumbles."

rows.original: You stroke your chin thoughtfully. You think you have a better idea of what Molis is like.
rows.translation: 你若有所思地摸着下巴，觉得自己更加了解摩利斯的模样了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stroke your chin thoughtfully. You think you have a better idea of what Molis is like."

rows.original: Aullama
rows.raw: "Aullama"

rows.original: You mention that if they import resources, they have to export as well.
rows.translation: 你提到，既然他们进口资源，必然也要出口。
rows.raw: "You mention that if they import resources, they have to export as well."

rows.original: Chaurmine nods, “Yeah, of course. I don’t know everything that’s exported, but obviously there’s plenty of meat, and metals. Molis still has minerals in its veins.”
rows.translation: 乔敏点点头。“对，当然。我不知道出口的全部商品，但显然有大量肉类和金属。摩利斯的矿脉中依然蕴藏着矿物。”
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine nods, “Yeah, of course. I don’t know everything that’s exported, but obviously there’s plenty of meat, and metals. Molis still has minerals in its veins.”"

rows.original: You figured, with what he said the planet was like. Though you’re surprised they export their metal, given their scales. Do they take more potent supplements?
rows.translation: 结合他对这颗星球的描述，你早就猜到了。不过考虑到他们的鳞片，你很惊讶他们竟然会出口金属。他们会服用效力更强的补充剂吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou figured, with what he said the planet was like. Though you’re surprised they export their metal, given their scales. Do they take more potent supplements?"

rows.original: “Mhmm. Well, we used to. Most of what we need these days is found in food. Well... Our food,” the large lizard rumbles, absently scratching his jaw. Before you can comment, he grunts, “Though most saurmorians still keep emergency pills of minerals on hand. Just in case, you know.”
rows.translation: “嗯哼。好吧，我们以前会服用。如今需要的大部分物质都能从食物中获得。嗯...我们的食物，”这只巨蜥漫不经心地挠着下巴，隆隆说道。你还没来得及评论，他便哼了一声。“不过，大多数索莫里安仍会随身准备应急矿物质药片。你知道，以防万一。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mhmm. Well, we used to. Most of what we need these days is found in food. Well... Our food,” the large lizard rumbles, absently scratching his jaw. Before you can comment, he grunts, “Though most saurmorians still keep emergency pills of minerals on hand. Just in case, you know.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Aullama
rows.raw: "Aullama"

rows.original: When you ask about the actual place Chaurmine grew up, and what it was like, his response is a detached sigh.
rows.translation: 当你询问乔敏真正成长的地方以及那里的生活时，他以一声疏离的叹息回应。
rows.raw: "When you ask about the actual place Chaurmine grew up, and what it was like, his response is a detached sigh."

rows.original: “Yeah... Okay,” he grumbles. Seeing the look on your face, the brute gestures dismissively, “Nah, not a sob story really. Just a boring, common one. Grew up in one of the slums outside the capital, Aegidis. The streets were narrow and packed, but most buildings were open and airy on the inside. Traditional saurmorian architecture, you see. Food and comfort usually weren’t a problem in the slums... usually.”
rows.translation: “好吧...行，”他咕哝道。看到你的表情，这名壮汉不以为意地挥了挥手。“不，其实不是什么悲惨故事，只是个无聊又常见的故事。我在首都埃吉迪斯外围的一处贫民窟长大。街道狭窄拥挤，但大多数建筑内部开放而通风。你看，那是索莫里安的传统建筑。贫民窟里通常不缺食物和舒适条件...通常如此。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah... Okay,” he grumbles. Seeing the look on your face, the brute gestures dismissively, “Nah, not a sob story really. Just a boring, common one. Grew up in one of the slums outside the capital, Aegidis. The streets were narrow and packed, but most buildings were open and airy on the inside. Traditional saurmorian architecture, you see. Food and comfort usually weren’t a problem in the slums... usually.”"

rows.original: So he lived a simple, but comfortable life, you note as you nod for him to continue.
rows.translation: 所以，他过着简单却舒适的生活；你一边指出这点，一边点头示意他继续。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo he lived a simple, but comfortable life, you note as you nod for him to continue."

rows.original: Chaurmine actually snorts in minor amusement, “I guess... Though there were some less than pleasant moments. A common thing to do for fun, and money, in the otherwise quiet alleys was to hold black markets of sorts and sell off the local stray dogs as exotic pets. Even forming fights for those interested in attack or guard dogs, to show off the merchandise,” he spits out in distaste.
rows.translation: 乔敏竟然略带愉快地哼了一声。“大概吧...不过，也有些不那么愉快的时刻。在那些除此之外十分安静的小巷里，人们常为娱乐和赚钱举办某种黑市，把当地流浪狗当作异宠出售。甚至还会为对攻击犬或护卫犬感兴趣的人组织斗狗，以此展示商品，”他厌恶地吐出这些话。
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine actually snorts in minor amusement, “I guess... Though there were some less than pleasant moments. A common thing to do for fun, and money, in the otherwise quiet alleys was to hold black markets of sorts and sell off the local stray dogs as exotic pets. Even forming fights for those interested in attack or guard dogs, to show off the merchandise,” he spits out in distaste."

rows.original: Given his deepening frown, and his tone, you can assume how he feels about these activities. You are curious though; what do saurmorian dogs look like?
rows.translation: 从他越皱越紧的眉头和语气来看，你已经能猜到他对这些活动有何看法。不过你确实很好奇：索莫里安犬长什么模样？
rows.raw: "\n\nGiven his deepening frown, and his tone, you can assume how he feels about these activities. You are curious though; what do saurmorian dogs look like?"

rows.original: Chaurmine looks confused for a moment, but recovers, “Oh, right. You probably haven’t actually seen one. They’re armored, like us,” he points to his scales. “They walk on four pawed feet, and for size they uh,” he looks around the bar, and back out to the cafeteria of the Mess, before shrugging and looking back to you, “Uhh they’re roughly two raskvel tall, maybe one and a half wide, and three raskvel long. When full grown, that is. Offworlders tend to call them things like ‘metal mutts’ and ‘plate pups’, and probably others these days I haven’t heard.”
rows.translation: 乔敏一时露出困惑神情，很快又恢复过来。“哦，对。你大概确实从没见过。它们和我们一样覆盖装甲，”他指了指自己的鳞片。“它们用四只带爪的脚行走，体型嘛，呃，”他环顾酒吧，又望向食堂区域，随后耸肩重新看向你。“呃，它们大约有两个拉斯克维尔那么高，也许一个半那么宽，三个那么长。我说的是完全长大以后。外星人往往会称它们为‘金属杂种’、‘板甲幼犬’之类，也许如今还有其他我没听过的叫法。”
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine looks confused for a moment, but recovers, “Oh, right. You probably haven’t actually seen one. They’re armored, like us,” he points to his scales. “They walk on four pawed feet, and for size they uh,” he looks around the bar, and back out to the cafeteria of the Mess, before shrugging and looking back to you, “Uhh they’re roughly two raskvel tall, maybe one and a half wide, and three raskvel long. When full grown, that is. Offworlders tend to call them things like ‘metal mutts’ and ‘plate pups’, and probably others these days I haven’t heard.”"

rows.original: You’ll have to look into one of these ‘dogs’ someday, you note to yourself. Other than the alley markets, it sounds like his life tended to be more quiet, if not boring.
rows.translation: 你暗自记下，今后得去了解一下这种‘狗’。除了巷子里的市场，他的生活听起来往往十分平静，即使不算无聊。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ll have to look into one of these ‘dogs’ someday, you note to yourself. Other than the alley markets, it sounds like his life tended to be more quiet, if not boring."

rows.original: The metal lizard makes to speak, but pauses, then hesitantly nods, “Yeah, pretty much...Though that was mostly during my younger years. As I grew older I took as many heavy labor jobs as I could.”
rows.translation: 金属蜥蜴正要开口，却又停下，随后犹豫地点头。“对，差不多...不过那主要是在我更年轻的时候。长大一些后，我尽可能接下所有重体力工作。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe metal lizard makes to speak, but pauses, then hesitantly nods, “Yeah, pretty much...Though that was mostly during my younger years. As I grew older I took as many heavy labor jobs as I could.”"

rows.original: Makes sense, even menial labor would give him something to do back then. Though how could he start penniless as a spacer if he had so many jobs?
rows.translation: 这很合理；即使是粗活，当时也能让他有事可做。不过，既然他干过那么多工作，又怎会身无分文地开始太空生活？
rows.raw: "\n\nMakes sense, even menial labor would give him something to do back then. Though how could he start penniless as a spacer if he had so many jobs?"

rows.original: Chaurmine actually shifts uncomfortably, almost looking a little flustered, “Well, many young males reaching maturity took whatever work they could. Work that was often rewarded with, uh... grateful affection by the desperate females that hired them. Given our society or whatever, that’s almost always who had jobs available.”
rows.translation: 乔敏的身体明显不安地动了动，看起来甚至有点慌乱。“好吧，许多刚刚成年的年轻男性会接下所有能找到的工作。而雇用他们的绝望女性，往往会用，呃...感激的爱抚来支付报酬。考虑到我们的社会之类的情况，有工作可提供的几乎总是女性。”
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine actually shifts uncomfortably, almost looking a little flustered, “Well, many young males reaching maturity took whatever work they could. Work that was often rewarded with, uh... grateful affection by the desperate females that hired them. Given our society or whatever, that’s almost always who had jobs available.”"

rows.original: Well fuck, almost sounds like a phallus’ paradise. Though the lack of actual monetary pay would need to change... How could he leave such an opportunity?
rows.translation: 好家伙，听起来简直像阳具的天堂。不过，没有真正金钱报酬这点确实需要改变...他怎么舍得离开这样的机会？
rows.raw: "\n\nWell fuck, almost sounds like a phallus’ paradise. Though the lack of actual monetary pay would need to change... How could he leave such an opportunity?"

rows.original: You stifle a laugh, picturing all the young men lining up for ‘work’. How you haven’t seen this porn-turned-reality on the extranet, you don’t know. Though it’s no wonder he took as many jobs as he could, is it?
rows.translation: 你忍住笑意，想象着所有年轻男性排队等候‘工作’的景象。你不知道自己怎么会没在外联网上看过这种色情片化为现实的场面。不过，他会尽可能多接工作也就不足为奇了，对吧？
rows.raw: "You stifle a laugh, picturing all the young men lining up for ‘work’. How you haven’t seen this porn-turned-reality on the extranet, you don’t know. Though it’s no wonder he took as many jobs as he could, is it?"

rows.original: You nod with a slight flush. It would seem a topic he’s not entirely proud of. At the time though, it must have been worth it at least, right?
rows.translation: 你微微脸红着点头。看来这并不是一个令他完全自豪的话题。不过在当时，那至少应该值得吧？
rows.raw: "You nod with a slight flush. It would seem a topic he’s not entirely proud of. At the time though, it must have been worth it at least, right?"

rows.original: “No, it wasn’t,” Chaurmine scowls, the air that surrounds you and the booth heating up. “Ever since I was young, it was made clear what I was. Even the pleasures those barren females showed to a naive, young Chaurmine were just reminders of what was expected of me
rows.translation: “不，一点也不值得，”乔敏皱眉说道，你们与卡座周围的空气逐渐升温。“从小开始，我就被明确告知自己究竟是什么。就连那些不育女性向天真的年轻乔敏展示的欢愉，也只是提醒我，别人对我抱着怎样的期待
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, it wasn’t,” Chaurmine scowls, the air that surrounds you and the booth heating up. “Ever since I was young, it was made clear what I was. Even the pleasures those barren females showed to a naive, young Chaurmine were just reminders of what was expected of me"

rows.original: Chaurmine’s lips pull back in a snarl, baring his teeth, and you feel the air around you heating up. “Fuck off, [pc.name]. Being seen as a dildo that also fixes shit for you gets REALLY old, really fast
rows.translation: 乔敏双唇后缩，龇牙咆哮；你感觉周围空气逐渐升温。“滚开，[pc.name]。被当成一根顺便替人修东西的假阳具，会让人非常快地厌烦透顶
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine’s lips pull back in a snarl, baring his teeth, and you feel the air around you heating up. “Fuck off, [pc.name]. Being seen as a dildo that also fixes shit for you gets REALLY old, really fast"

rows.original: ,” the lizard barks.
rows.translation: ，”蜥蜴厉声喝道。
rows.raw: ",” the lizard barks."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Exports
rows.translation: 出口商品
rows.raw: "Exports"

rows.original: Exports
rows.translation: 出口商品
rows.raw: "Exports"

rows.original: What kind of things do saurmorians export?
rows.translation: 索莫里安会出口哪些商品？
rows.raw: "What kind of things do saurmorians export?"

rows.original: Growing Up
rows.translation: 成长经历
rows.raw: "Growing Up"

rows.original: Growing Up
rows.translation: 成长经历
rows.raw: "Growing Up"

rows.original: He told you about Molis, but what about where he grew up?
rows.translation: 他向你讲过摩利斯，但他成长的地方呢？
rows.raw: "He told you about Molis, but what about where he grew up?"

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: His Home
rows.translation: 他的家乡
rows.raw: "His Home"

rows.original: Ask about where he came from.
rows.translation: 询问他的出身之地。
rows.raw: "Ask about where he came from."

rows.original: His Home
rows.translation: 他的家乡
rows.raw: "His Home"

rows.original: His Home
rows.translation: 他的家
rows.raw: "His Home"

rows.original: You don’t know him well enough for this.
rows.translation: 你还不够了解他，无法询问这个。
rows.raw: "You don’t know him well enough for this."

rows.original: Family
rows.translation: 家庭
rows.raw: "Family"

rows.original: Aullama
rows.raw: "Aullama"

rows.original: Knowing that you risk setting off his temper, you ask about his family. He’s barely said even a word about them.
rows.translation: 尽管知道可能会惹他发火，你还是问起他的家人。他几乎从未提过他们。
rows.raw: "Knowing that you risk setting off his temper, you ask about his family. He’s barely said even a word about them."

rows.original: Chaurmine’s nostrils flare, but the rest of his primal visage remains passive, “Yeah, how ‘bout that.”
rows.translation: 乔尔曼鼻孔张开，但原始野性的脸庞其余部分依然平静，“是啊，可真巧。”
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine’s nostrils flare, but the rest of his primal visage remains passive, “Yeah, how ‘bout that.”"

rows.original: You comment that he said his past really wasn’t a ‘sob story’, so you imagine-
rows.translation: 你评论说，他曾讲过自己的过去并不是什么‘悲惨故事’，所以你猜-
rows.raw: "\n\nYou comment that he said his past really wasn’t a ‘sob story’, so you imagine-"

rows.original: “Tell me, [pc.name],” he growls low, and you feel his voice as much as hear it, “Are you aware what it’s like having your future, your purpose, chosen for you when you’ve just hatched? As if your life were for someone else...”
rows.translation: “告诉我，[pc.name]，”他低声咆哮；那声音不只传入耳中，更让你切身感受到。“你知道刚孵化时，未来、你的使命就被别人选定是什么滋味吗？仿佛你的人生是为别人而活...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Tell me, [pc.name],” he growls low, and you feel his voice as much as hear it, “Are you aware what it’s like having your future, your purpose, chosen for you when you’ve just hatched? As if your life were for someone else...”"

rows.original: You nod solemnly, mentioning how familiar you are to being born in such a way.
rows.translation: 你神情严肃地点头，提到自己对以这种方式出生有多么熟悉。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod solemnly, mentioning how familiar you are to being born in such a way."

rows.original: You chuckle, shaking your head as you remark that he has no idea.
rows.translation: 你轻笑着摇摇头，指出他根本不知道。
rows.raw: "You chuckle, shaking your head as you remark that he has no idea."

rows.original: His lips pull back into a snarl, and he opens his maw, but pauses a moment before calming himself. His irritation deflated into a somber demeanor, he looks at you with sympathetic eyes, “Yeah... I suppose you’re right.”
rows.translation: 他龇起嘴唇咆哮，张开巨口，却停顿片刻，让自己冷静下来。他的烦躁消退成阴沉神情，带着同情望向你，“是啊...我想你说得对。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHis lips pull back into a snarl, and he opens his maw, but pauses a moment before calming himself. His irritation deflated into a somber demeanor, he looks at you with sympathetic eyes, “Yeah... I suppose you’re right.”"

rows.original: Nodding, you ask him to explain what he meant, how his path was set for him.
rows.translation: 你点点头，请他解释自己的意思，以及人生道路是如何被预先决定的。
rows.raw: "\n\nNodding, you ask him to explain what he meant, how his path was set for him."

rows.original: Though he remains still, his bulky tail shifts in its position under the table irritably. “I hatched with six siblings; a clutch of seven, unusually small for a woman of my kind to lay. On top of that, my matron- err, mother, seemed to lose all fertility; she never had a clutch after mine,” he grunts dejectedly, then lets out a small snort, “Heh, a dark joke while I was around was that I stole my matron’s potency. I was born with the signs of virility and strong blood, you see.” Upon your confusion, he points first to his amber hide, hidden under his metal scales, and then his eyes; a blazing and fiery azure.
rows.translation: 尽管他身体不动，桌下粗壮的尾巴却烦躁地变换位置。“我和六个兄弟姐妹一起孵化；一窝七个，对我们种族的女性而言异常少。更糟的是，我的女家长——呃，母亲——似乎彻底失去了生育能力；在我这窝之后，她再没有产过卵，”他沮丧地哼道，随后轻轻嗤笑，“呵，我在场时流传过一个阴暗笑话，说我偷走了女家长的生育力。你看，我出生时就带着精力旺盛、血统强健的征兆。”见你困惑，他先指向藏在金属鳞片下的琥珀色皮肤，又指向双眼；那是一片炽烈如火的蔚蓝。
rows.raw: "\n\nThough he remains still, his bulky tail shifts in its position under the table irritably. “I hatched with six siblings; a clutch of seven, unusually small for a woman of my kind to lay. On top of that, my matron- err, mother, seemed to lose all fertility; she never had a clutch after mine,” he grunts dejectedly, then lets out a small snort, “Heh, a dark joke while I was around was that I stole my matron’s potency. I was born with the signs of virility and strong blood, you see.” Upon your confusion, he points first to his amber hide, hidden under his metal scales, and then his eyes; a blazing and fiery azure."

rows.original: Saurmorians
rows.raw: "Saurmorians"

rows.original: You remember reading something similar from the saurmorian codex entry. Virile male offspring usually being groomed as they are raised by their families to be offered to more well off and politically powerful females. As a result, virile males tend to be treated as little more than prizes to be shuffled around, and seen as meal tickets to the families in the lower class. Little wonder that Chaurmine looks back to his past bitterly; he’d find that kind of life unfulfilling, no doubt.
rows.translation: 你记得在索莫里安人的百科条目中读过类似内容。精力旺盛的男性后代在成长过程中通常会由家族精心培养，随后献给更加富裕、政治势力强大的女性。因此，这类男性往往只被视作可供调配的奖品，也被下层家庭当成改善生活的门票。难怪乔尔曼会苦涩地回望过去；毫无疑问，他会觉得那种人生空虚乏味。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou remember reading something similar from the saurmorian codex entry. Virile male offspring usually being groomed as they are raised by their families to be offered to more well off and politically powerful females. As a result, virile males tend to be treated as little more than prizes to be shuffled around, and seen as meal tickets to the families in the lower class. Little wonder that Chaurmine looks back to his past bitterly; he’d find that kind of life unfulfilling, no doubt."

rows.original: Chaurmine smirks, “Looks like someone did their homework. While a comfortable life, enviable to many, I personally want to be more than just another brightly colored cum pump...”
rows.translation: 乔尔曼坏笑道：“看来有人认真做了功课。那样的生活很舒适，也令许多人羡慕，但我自己想成为的可不只是又一根色彩鲜艳的精液泵...”
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine smirks, “Looks like someone did their homework. While a comfortable life, enviable to many, I personally want to be more than just another brightly colored cum pump...”"

rows.original: Confused, you question what this has to do with his predetermined future.
rows.translation: 你困惑地追问，这与他被预先决定的未来有什么关系。
rows.raw: "\n\nConfused, you question what this has to do with his predetermined future."

rows.original: This earns an amused grunt from the lizard, “Look, saurmorians almost always have their most fertile females in charge of their families and societies. The much higher class matrons, usually those at the embassy in Aegidis, tend to favor virile males. Whether out of some kink or something, I don’t know. But they pick from even the lowest family; as long as the seed is potent, the male and his family are taken in and cared for by his new matron.”
rows.translation: 蜥蜴被逗得哼笑一声。“听着，索莫里安人几乎总会让生育力最强的女性掌管家族和社会。那些阶级高得多的女家长，通常就是埃吉迪斯大使馆里的那群人，往往偏爱精力旺盛的男性。我不知道这是某种癖好还是别的什么。但她们甚至会从最低等的家庭中挑选；只要精种够强，那个男性和他的家人就会被新女家长接纳、照顾。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThis earns an amused grunt from the lizard, “Look, saurmorians almost always have their most fertile females in charge of their families and societies. The much higher class matrons, usually those at the embassy in Aegidis, tend to favor virile males. Whether out of some kink or something, I don’t know. But they pick from even the lowest family; as long as the seed is potent, the male and his family are taken in and cared for by his new matron.”"

rows.original: You nod thoughtfully, piecing it together.
rows.translation: 你若有所思地点头，把线索拼到了一起。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod thoughtfully, piecing it together."

rows.original: “So if I’m the last male from my lower class matron, and a virile one at that, what do you think they’re going to use me as?” he questions somewhat bitterly.
rows.translation: “所以，如果我是出身下层的女家长最后一个男性孩子，而且偏偏还精力旺盛，你觉得他们打算拿我做什么？”他语气颇为苦涩地问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So if I’m the last male from my lower class matron, and a virile one at that, what do you think they’re going to use me as?” he questions somewhat bitterly."

rows.original: Well when he puts it like that... Though you still question what would be so bad about that kind of life.
rows.translation: 听他这么一说...不过你依然追问，那种生活究竟有什么不好。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell when he puts it like that... Though you still question what would be so bad about that kind of life."

rows.original: Chaurmine only shakes his head, “Some prefer not being an object...”
rows.translation: 乔尔曼只是摇头。“有些人不愿意当一件物品...”
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine only shakes his head, “Some prefer not being an object...”"

rows.original: Taking it all in, you inquire about his actual family once more. He said he had six siblings. You’re curious about them, as well as his mother. Or ‘matron’, as he called her.
rows.translation: 消化完这些信息后，你再次问起他真正的家人。他说自己有六个兄弟姐妹。你对他们以及他的母亲都很好奇；或者按他的称呼，是‘女家长’。
rows.raw: "\n\nTaking it all in, you inquire about his actual family once more. He said he had six siblings. You’re curious about them, as well as his mother. Or ‘matron’, as he called her."

rows.original: Chaurmine sighs tiredly and shakes his head, “I’ve been an open book for you, [pc.name]. This time I’m gonna stay closed...”
rows.translation: 乔尔曼疲惫地叹息、摇头。“我已经对你知无不言了，[pc.name]。这一次，我要把书合上...”
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine sighs tiredly and shakes his head, “I’ve been an open book for you, [pc.name]. This time I’m gonna stay closed...”"

rows.original: Feeling the hot air from Chaurmine’s lingering irritation and frustration, you’re reminded of encountering him out in the wastes; he cooled off when calming down, which swiftly happened after an orgasm.
rows.translation: 乔尔曼残留的烦躁与挫败化作热气扑面而来，让你想起在荒原与他相遇时的情形；他冷静后体温便会下降，而高潮很快就让他平静了下来。
rows.raw: "Feeling the hot air from Chaurmine’s lingering irritation and frustration, you’re reminded of encountering him out in the wastes; he cooled off when calming down, which swiftly happened after an orgasm."

rows.original: You delicately bring up his rising body heat, wondering how dangerous being in such a state for long can be. You imagine that could get unhealthy if he doesn’t release the stress heating him up.
rows.translation: 你委婉提起他不断升高的体温，想知道长时间保持这种状态会有多危险。你猜如果他不释放令身体升温的压力，恐怕会影响健康。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou delicately bring up his rising body heat, wondering how dangerous being in such a state for long can be. You imagine that could get unhealthy if he doesn’t release the stress heating him up."

rows.original: Chaurmine raises a brow, glancing down at an empty, sweating glass; the ice having melted a while ago and now sits as a shot of water, tinted with traces of the drink it held. “I’m fine... Out in the wastes there, that was the hottest I’ve been, I think. And that was with the pink slime those bugs smeared on me; must have been some aphrodisiac or something,” he states as he looks back to you, an odd look on his armored visage, “So right now there’s nothing to worry about. Are you suggesting that we...?”
rows.translation: 乔尔曼挑起眉毛，低头看向一只冒着水汽的空杯；冰块早已融化，只剩一小口被原先饮料残迹染色的水。“我没事...在荒原那次大概是我经历过最热的时候。而且当时还有那些虫子抹在我身上的粉色黏液；肯定是什么催情剂之类的东西，”他一边说一边重新看向你，装甲脸庞露出怪异神色。“所以现在没什么可担心的。你是在暗示我们...？”
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine raises a brow, glancing down at an empty, sweating glass; the ice having melted a while ago and now sits as a shot of water, tinted with traces of the drink it held. “I’m fine... Out in the wastes there, that was the hottest I’ve been, I think. And that was with the pink slime those bugs smeared on me; must have been some aphrodisiac or something,” he states as he looks back to you, an odd look on his armored visage, “So right now there’s nothing to worry about. Are you suggesting that we...?”"

rows.original: You nod and, with a nonchalant shrug, add how distraught he seemed out in the wastes. You’d rather not seem him in such a state again, if you can help it.
rows.translation: 你点头，若无其事地耸耸肩，又补充说他在荒原上显得多么痛苦。如果能帮上忙，你不愿再看见他陷入那种状态。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod and, with a nonchalant shrug, add how distraught he seemed out in the wastes. You’d rather not seem him in such a state again, if you can help it."

rows.original: Chaurmine leans back in his seat, his features softening, before breaking into a lecherous grin. “Well, uh, thanks for the concern. Though a better place to cool off after heating up would be my ship,” he growls, trying to sound seductive.
rows.translation: 乔尔曼向后靠在座位上，神情逐渐柔和，随后咧出淫荡笑容。“这个，呃，多谢关心。不过身体热起来以后，想去更适合降温的地方，还是我的飞船，”他低声咆哮，试图让语气听起来充满诱惑。
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine leans back in his seat, his features softening, before breaking into a lecherous grin. “Well, uh, thanks for the concern. Though a better place to cool off after heating up would be my ship,” he growls, trying to sound seductive."

rows.original: With an impish smile, you ask Chaurmine if he’s feeling alright, mentioning that he looks a little hot. More than usual, that is.
rows.translation: 你带着顽皮笑容问乔尔曼感觉是否还好，并指出他看起来有点热；比平常更热。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith an impish smile, you ask Chaurmine if he’s feeling alright, mentioning that he looks a little hot. More than usual, that is."

rows.original: He remains bitter for a moment, until your words hit home. The brute responds with a grin of his own etched on his armored face, “Nah, I’m fine. The heat’s not getting to you, is it?” His heavy tail twitches with a thump, betraying his excitement.
rows.translation: 他仍苦着脸，直到真正听懂你的话。壮汉自己的装甲脸庞也咧出笑容。“没，我很好。热气没有影响到你吧？”他沉重的尾巴怦地抽动一下，暴露了内心的兴奋。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe remains bitter for a moment, until your words hit home. The brute responds with a grin of his own etched on his armored face, “Nah, I’m fine. The heat’s not getting to you, is it?” His heavy tail twitches with a thump, betraying his excitement."

rows.original: Nonchalantly, you coil your tail around his, though the brute’s is powerless against your more agile appendage. Playfully wrangling his tail with yours, you reply that you are feeling a little feverish.
rows.translation: 你若无其事地用尾巴缠住他的尾巴；不过面对你更加灵活的附肢，这壮汉的尾巴毫无还手之力。你顽皮地用尾巴擒住他的尾巴，回答自己确实有点发烧。
rows.raw: "Nonchalantly, you coil your tail around his, though the brute’s is powerless against your more agile appendage. Playfully wrangling his tail with yours, you reply that you are feeling a little feverish."

rows.original: You playfully lay a [pc.foot] on the heavy appendage, pinning it to the floor. As he twitches his thick tail, mirth written on his face, you reply that you are feeling a little feverish.
rows.translation: 你调皮地把一只[pc.foot]踩在那条沉重附肢上，将其压在地板。他粗壮的尾巴抽动，脸上满是笑意；你回答自己确实有点发烧。
rows.raw: "You playfully lay a [pc.foot] on the heavy appendage, pinning it to the floor. As he twitches his thick tail, mirth written on his face, you reply that you are feeling a little feverish."

rows.original: “I feel ya,” he rumbles, flexing his tail for emphasis, “This bar’s a stuffy place, but I dunno what else there is on this planet.”
rows.translation: “我懂，”他低沉地说道，同时特意屈伸尾巴。“这酒吧闷得要命，但我也不知道这颗星球还有什么别的去处。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I feel ya,” he rumbles, flexing his tail for emphasis, “This bar’s a stuffy place, but I dunno what else there is on this planet.”"

rows.original: Well, he has a ship, doesn’t he?
rows.translation: 嗯，他不是有一艘飞船吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, he has a ship, doesn’t he?"

rows.original: Reaching over the table, you grab one of Chaurmine’s horns in a tight grip, giving the surprisingly pliant titan an appraising look as you turn him this way and that.
rows.translation: 你越过桌面，一把攥住乔尔曼的一根角；这位意外温顺的巨汉被你转来转去，而你用审视目光打量着他。
rows.raw: "\n\nReaching over the table, you grab one of Chaurmine’s horns in a tight grip, giving the surprisingly pliant titan an appraising look as you turn him this way and that."

rows.original: “The fuck are you doing?” he asks, brushing your hand off of him.
rows.translation: “你他妈在干什么？”他问道，同时拨开你的手。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The fuck are you doing?” he asks, brushing your hand off of him."

rows.original: You shrug, remarking that you were just wanting to know his best angle before you fuck. You look him in the eyes as you say this.
rows.translation: 你耸耸肩，说只是想在开操前弄清楚他哪个角度最棒。说话时，你直视他的双眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shrug, remarking that you were just wanting to know his best angle before you fuck. You look him in the eyes as you say this."

rows.original: This earns a small chuckle from the brute. “Right to the point, I like that,” he states in approval.
rows.translation: 这让壮汉轻笑一声。“直奔主题，我喜欢，”他赞许道。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis earns a small chuckle from the brute. “Right to the point, I like that,” he states in approval."

rows.original: Chaurmine moves out of the booth, stretching as he and his empty seat groan in relief, and motions towards the exit, “C’mon, we have better places to be.”
rows.translation: 乔尔曼挪出卡座，伸展身体；他和那张空座椅都如释重负地呻吟起来。随后他朝出口示意。“走吧，我们有更好的地方可去。”
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine moves out of the booth, stretching as he and his empty seat groan in relief, and motions towards the exit, “C’mon, we have better places to be.”"

rows.original: You slither out from your seat in the booth, stiffly uncoiling yourself before following Chaurmine out of the bar
rows.translation: 你从卡座上蜿蜒滑出，僵硬地舒展开盘绕的身体，随后跟着乔尔曼离开酒吧
rows.raw: "\n\nYou slither out from your seat in the booth, stiffly uncoiling yourself before following Chaurmine out of the bar"

rows.original: You do much the same, stiffly stretching once you’re standing out of the booth. Once that’s done, you follow Chaurmine out of the bar
rows.translation: 你也基本照做；从卡座站起来后，僵硬地伸展身体。完成之后，你跟着乔尔曼离开酒吧
rows.raw: "\n\nYou do much the same, stiffly stretching once you’re standing out of the booth. Once that’s done, you follow Chaurmine out of the bar"

rows.original: . After several long minutes walking along the landing bay, still quite far from your own ship, you note that you’re passing by larger and larger vessels.
rows.translation: 。沿着停机坪步行了漫长的几分钟后，你离自己的飞船仍相当遥远，并注意到经过的舰船体型越来越大。
rows.raw: ". After several long minutes walking along the landing bay, still quite far from your own ship, you note that you’re passing by larger and larger vessels."

rows.original: “You’ve never seen a saurmorian ship before, right?” he grunts, snapping your attention back to him, “Well if not, let me warn you, our spacecrafts are known for two things; they’re durable as fuck, and they’re big.” He punctuates this with a jerk of his snout towards the ship you’re now standing before.
rows.translation: “你以前从没见过索莫里安人的飞船，对吧？”他哼道，把你的注意力重新拉回身上。“如果真没见过，我先提醒你：我们的航天器以两件事闻名；结实得要命，而且巨大。”他说着用口鼻朝你们面前的飞船猛地一指，为这句话作结。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’ve never seen a saurmorian ship before, right?” he grunts, snapping your attention back to him, “Well if not, let me warn you, our spacecrafts are known for two things; they’re durable as fuck, and they’re big.” He punctuates this with a jerk of his snout towards the ship you’re now standing before."

rows.original: Well, it is big. With its thick, blocky hull girding its triangular shape, you wonder how the mammoth thing can even fly, let alone be piloted by a single person. Though faded and scratched, you can still clearly make out its matte black finish trimmed with chrome. Two massive cannons hang from the bottom of the ship near the middle. rows.translation: 嗯，这也算是一种排出方式。该继续前进了，你想。希望下次别再忘记寄生虫的卵。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, that was one way to get them out. Time to move on, you guess. Hopefully you don’t forget about the parasite’s eggs next time."

rows.original: Tapping thrice into the sand with your [pc.foot] seems to attract one of the worms to you. It digs into your direction and slows once at your feet. One more tap causes it to lift its frontal body out of the sand. Still relatively small since available space limits their maximum size, the worm’s frontal length is similar to that of a medium-sized dog. In a strange way, the worm even acts like a dog too. Nudging its still sand-covered tip into your hand, it gives you the impression that it wants some attention, and who are you to say no to such a cute gesture?
rows.translation: 你用[pc.foot]在沙地上轻敲三下，似乎吸引了一条沙虫。它朝你的方向钻来，到达脚边后减速。你再敲一下，它便把前半身从沙中抬起。由于可用空间限制了最大体型，它仍相对幼小，探出地面的前段长度与中型犬相仿。奇怪的是，沙虫甚至表现得像狗。它把仍沾满沙子的尖端蹭进你手里，让你觉得它想得到关注；面对这么可爱的举动，谁又忍心拒绝？
rows.raw: "Tapping thrice into the sand with your [pc.foot] seems to attract one of the worms to you. It digs into your direction and slows once at your feet. One more tap causes it to lift its frontal body out of the sand. Still relatively small since available space limits their maximum size, the worm’s frontal length is similar to that of a medium-sized dog. In a strange way, the worm even acts like a dog too. Nudging its still sand-covered tip into your hand, it gives you the impression that it wants some attention, and who are you to say no to such a cute gesture?"

rows.original: You brush your palm across its sides and swipe the sand off from the top of its head as it leans into each one of your rubs, sometimes directing the attention where it is needed. Out of nowhere it suddenly goes back underground. It burrows of in some unknown direction, but comes back just as fast, springing out of the sifting grains with a rock in its mandibles. Slightly covered with greenish saliva it is placed at your feet. It seems like your worm wants you to take the rock and do something with it.
rows.translation: 你用掌心沿它身体两侧抚过，又扫掉头顶沙粒；它靠向每一次抚摸，有时还会引导你的手去往需要关注的位置。它忽然毫无征兆地重新钻入地下，朝未知方向挖去，却又同样迅速地返回，从流动沙粒中跃出，颚间叼着一块石头。石头上略微沾有绿色唾液，被放到你脚边。看来你的沙虫希望你拿起石头，用它做些什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou brush your palm across its sides and swipe the sand off from the top of its head as it leans into each one of your rubs, sometimes directing the attention where it is needed. Out of nowhere it suddenly goes back underground. It burrows of in some unknown direction, but comes back just as fast, springing out of the sifting grains with a rock in its mandibles. Slightly covered with greenish saliva it is placed at your feet. It seems like your worm wants you to take the rock and do something with it."

rows.translation: 你要陪它玩吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nDo you play with it?"

rows.original: You pick up the rock and suddenly all the worm’s attention is diverted away from you, and straight to the rock. It sways this way and that with focus as you move the rock about with your hands, and the sandworm almost goes straight when you ready for a throw. The baseball sized rock flies
rows.translation: 你捡起石头，沙虫的全部注意力顿时从你身上转移，完全集中到了石头上。你用手左右移动石头，它便专注地来回摇摆；当你准备投掷时，沙虫几乎立刻绷直身体。棒球大小的石块飞出
rows.raw: "You pick up the rock and suddenly all the worm’s attention is diverted away from you, and straight to the rock. It sways this way and that with focus as you move the rock about with your hands, and the sandworm almost goes straight when you ready for a throw. The baseball sized rock flies"

rows.original: a mere 10 or so meters proving little challenge for the worm to fetch. After only a few repeated throws, your shoulder is already starting to cramp up. Maybe you need to work on your throwing arm.
rows.translation: 大约区区10米，对沙虫的取回能力几乎毫无挑战。重复投掷几次后，你的肩膀已经开始抽筋。也许该锻炼一下投掷手臂。
rows.raw: " a mere 10 or so meters proving little challenge for the worm to fetch. After only a few repeated throws, your shoulder is already starting to cramp up. Maybe you need to work on your throwing arm."

rows.original: an appreciable distance away. The worm finds it easily sometimes, but just as often takes a while to find it. It’s not too bad for someone with your strength, but the constant throwing is tiring you out a bit. The worm is also showing some signs of slowing down.
rows.translation: 相当可观的距离。沙虫有时能轻易找到，有时又要花上一阵。以你的力量而言还不算太糟，但不断投掷已让你有些疲惫，沙虫也逐渐显出放慢速度的迹象。
rows.raw: " an appreciable distance away. The worm finds it easily sometimes, but just as often takes a while to find it. It’s not too bad for someone with your strength, but the constant throwing is tiring you out a bit. The worm is also showing some signs of slowing down."

rows.original: a sizable distance away. You almost lose sight of it on a few consecutive throws. It always takes a while for the worm to find it, and only brings the rock back a few times before slowing down in it’s efforts. Maybe throwing a rock that distance away in a room like this isn’t a very good idea. You might break something.
rows.translation: 一段很远的距离。连续几次投掷时，你几乎看不见石头去了哪里。沙虫每次都要花上一阵才能找到，只把石头带回来几次便开始放慢动作。也许在这样的房间里把石头扔那么远并不是好主意；你可能会打坏东西。
rows.raw: " a sizable distance away. You almost lose sight of it on a few consecutive throws. It always takes a while for the worm to find it, and only brings the rock back a few times before slowing down in it’s efforts. Maybe throwing a rock that distance away in a room like this isn’t a very good idea. You might break something."

rows.original: After a few more lobs of the rock, you decide to end the play time. Your fetcher is looking a bit winded as well. This time you set the stone in front of it and give a few more soft caresses before stepping back a little. Understanding your message, the worm picks up the rock once more, and disappears with it into the sand. Well that was fun.
rows.translation: 又把石头扔了几次后，你决定结束玩耍。负责取回的家伙看起来也有些气喘。这次你把石头放在它面前，又温柔抚摸几下，随后稍稍后退。沙虫理解了你的意思，再次叼起石头，带着它消失在沙中。嗯，还挺好玩的。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a few more lobs of the rock, you decide to end the play time. Your fetcher is looking a bit winded as well. This time you set the stone in front of it and give a few more soft caresses before stepping back a little. Understanding your message, the worm picks up the rock once more, and disappears with it into the sand. Well that was fun."

rows.original: You roll the rock back towards it, but the worm just rolls it back. A couple more bouts of this rolling tennis match go by before you give it a clearer message. With a hand rubbing its head once more you pick up the Stone and put it into the worm’s mouth this time,you step back from your hoping to be playpal. Sagging a little from the realization you don’t want to play, its attentions are drawn elsewhere, burrowing into the sand and bolting off to what seems to be a nursedroid. The nursedroid plays with the worm a bit at least, so you know it won’t be left sad.
rows.translation: 你把石头滚向它，沙虫却又把石头滚回来。这场滚石网球又来回几个回合，你才给出更清楚的信号。你再次揉着它的头，捡起石头，这次直接放进沙虫嘴里，随后从这位原本希望成为玩伴的家伙面前退开。意识到你不想玩后，它略微垂下身体，注意力随即转向别处；它钻入沙中，飞快冲向一台看似护理机器人的设备。至少护理机器人陪沙虫玩了一阵，所以你知道它不会一直伤心。
rows.raw: "You roll the rock back towards it, but the worm just rolls it back. A couple more bouts of this rolling tennis match go by before you give it a clearer message. With a hand rubbing its head once more you pick up the Stone and put it into the worm’s mouth this time,you step back from your hoping to be playpal. Sagging a little from the realization you don’t want to play, its attentions are drawn elsewhere, burrowing into the sand and bolting off to what seems to be a nursedroid. The nursedroid plays with the worm a bit at least, so you know it won’t be left sad."

rows.original: You whistle into the fake desert, calling out to a hybrid in the distance and prompting them to turn their head in your direction. By the looks of it, they are happy to see you.
rows.translation: 你朝人造沙漠吹了声口哨，呼唤远处的一名混血体，令对方转头望向你。从模样来看，对方很高兴见到你。
rows.raw: "You whistle into the fake desert, calling out to a hybrid in the distance and prompting them to turn their head in your direction. By the looks of it, they are happy to see you."

rows.original: Membranous insectile wings deploy from their back as they fly in your direction, wings barely visible from their fast movement. Some sand is also kicked up by the path of their flight. As they get closer, a low vibrsatory sound can be heard from their wings, slowing in frequency as they get close.
rows.translation: 膜状昆虫翅膀从背后展开，对方朝你飞来；翅膀运动太快，几乎看不清楚。飞行路径还卷起了一些沙尘。距离逐渐拉近时，你能听见翅膀发出的低沉振动声；随着接近，振动频率也逐渐放缓。
rows.raw: " Membranous insectile wings deploy from their back as they fly in your direction, wings barely visible from their fast movement. Some sand is also kicked up by the path of their flight. As they get closer, a low vibrsatory sound can be heard from their wings, slowing in frequency as they get close."

rows.original: A multi-legged insectoid underbody is what their humanoid half sits upon, skittering across the sand they quickly make their way towards you. The sounds of sand being shifted about by their six legs fills your auditory field in short time, slowing down as they near you.
rows.translation: 对方的人形上半身坐在多足昆虫下身上，六条腿在沙地上疾走，很快便来到你面前。六足拨动沙粒的声音转眼充斥你的听觉，接近时逐渐减缓。
rows.raw: " A multi-legged insectoid underbody is what their humanoid half sits upon, skittering across the sand they quickly make their way towards you. The sounds of sand being shifted about by their six legs fills your auditory field in short time, slowing down as they near you."

rows.original: Running as a humanoid biped would, their legs kick up some sand while they make their way towards you. It takes a bit, but at least they don’t seem tired.
rows.translation: 对方像双足人形生物般奔跑，双腿一路踢起沙尘。虽然花了点时间，但至少看起来并不疲惫。
rows.raw: " Running as a humanoid biped would, their legs kick up some sand while they make their way towards you. It takes a bit, but at least they don’t seem tired."

rows.original: As near as they are now you can easily make out their more subtle features. Though still manufactured with modern fabrics their attire looks somewhat tribal, consisting of a patterned kilt, sandals and a poncho to cover their upper body. Must be the best for this climate you guess.
rows.translation: 如今距离足够接近，你能轻易看清对方更加细微的特征。服装虽仍由现代织物制造，外观却颇具部落风格，由带图案的褶裙、凉鞋以及遮盖上身的斗篷组成。你猜这大概最适合这里的气候。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs near as they are now you can easily make out their more subtle features. Though still manufactured with modern fabrics their attire looks somewhat tribal, consisting of a patterned kilt, sandals and a poncho to cover their upper body. Must be the best for this climate you guess."

rows.original: With a pretty face and curvy body you estimate they must be female. Her small but noticeable breasts would also help to tell anyone that she was a woman.
rows.translation: 对方长着漂亮脸蛋与曲线玲珑的身体，你估计应该是女性。小巧却清晰可见的乳房也足以告诉任何人她是女人。
rows.raw: " With a pretty face and curvy body you estimate they must be female. Her small but noticeable breasts would also help to tell anyone that she was a woman."

rows.original: A rugged but overall handsome face and a reasonably muscular looking body has you guessing that this one must be male, with the flat chest and occasional kilt bulge also being a dead giveaway.
rows.translation: 粗犷却总体英俊的脸庞与颇为强健的身体，让你猜测这位应该是男性；平坦胸膛和褶裙下偶尔显出的隆起更是明显证据。
rows.raw: " A rugged but overall handsome face and a reasonably muscular looking body has you guessing that this one must be male, with the flat chest and occasional kilt bulge also being a dead giveaway."

rows.original: A bit androgynous to your eyes, your guesswork is thrown into a bit of a loop, forcing you to resort to other indicators in order to determine their sex. Some reasonably well developed breasts and slight bulge in their kilt has you guessing they must be a hermaphrodite. Then again, you don’t really know and it would be weird and awkward to ask for a look. Why would you even? There’s nothing you’re interested in under there.
rows.translation: 在你看来，对方有些中性，这让你的判断陷入混乱，只能借助其他迹象确定性别。发育得相当不错的乳房与褶裙下轻微隆起，让你猜测对方应该是双性人。话说回来，你其实并不确定，而要求看一眼未免怪异又尴尬。你为什么要那么做？下面又没有任何令你感兴趣的东西。
rows.raw: " A bit androgynous to your eyes, your guesswork is thrown into a bit of a loop, forcing you to resort to other indicators in order to determine their sex. Some reasonably well developed breasts and slight bulge in their kilt has you guessing they must be a hermaphrodite. Then again, you don’t really know and it would be weird and awkward to ask for a look. Why would you even? There’s nothing you’re interested in under there."

rows.original: Without warning they dive straight at you, embracing you in a hug that would make a bear proud. Untangling from you they look you in the eyes and say, “It is good to see you’re healthy, my carrier. I hope to see many more brothers and sisters from you.” A bit taken aback by their directness, you blush a little while you entertain the thought. Putting a hand on their cheek, you tell them that maybe you will give them more. A smile appears on their segmented humanoid face as they ask, “So... anything specific you want to talk about?”
rows.translation: 对方毫无预兆地直接扑向你，给了你一个足以令熊自豪的拥抱。从你身上解开后，对方望进你的双眼，说道：“很高兴看到你身体健康，我的孕育者。希望今后还能从你那里见到更多兄弟姐妹。”这份直接令你有些措手不及；想象着这种可能，你微微脸红。你把手放在对方脸颊上，告诉对方，也许会给他们更多。对方分节的人形脸庞绽开笑容，问道：“所以...有什么特定话题想聊吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nWithout warning they dive straight at you, embracing you in a hug that would make a bear proud. Untangling from you they look you in the eyes and say, “It is good to see you’re healthy, my carrier. I hope to see many more brothers and sisters from you.” A bit taken aback by their directness, you blush a little while you entertain the thought. Putting a hand on their cheek, you tell them that maybe you will give them more. A smile appears on their segmented humanoid face as they ask, “So... anything specific you want to talk about?”"

rows.translation: 随处可见的双足
