rows.original: variety of my species, or so I’ve been told. And I have you to thank for it,” they say while extending a finger in your direction. “I spend my days in this ‘dome’ as the nurses called it, though it looks like a desert to me. Whenever I get hungry, I go into the metal tunnels to grab some grub and then sit in the ‘class’, as they called it, for a few hours before coming back out again.” A bit frustrated, they go on rambling about how it would be better if classes were held outside and other desert related issues. You guess their limited intelligence doesn’t really allow them to grasp the technology involved on the station.
rows.translation: 类型，至少别人是这么告诉我的。而这都要感谢你，”对方一边说，一边朝你伸出手指。“我每天都待在这个护士们所称的‘穹顶’里，尽管在我看来它就是片沙漠。饿了的时候，我会进入金属隧道找些吃的，再去他们所称的‘课堂’里坐上几个小时，然后重新出来。”对方有些沮丧，继续喋喋不休地抱怨，如果课程能在室外进行会更好，还有其他与沙漠有关的问题。你猜其有限智力还不足以理解空间站所涉及的科技。
rows.raw: " variety of my species, or so I’ve been told. And I have you to thank for it,” they say while extending a finger in your direction. “I spend my days in this ‘dome’ as the nurses called it, though it looks like a desert to me. Whenever I get hungry, I go into the metal tunnels to grab some grub and then sit in the ‘class’, as they called it, for a few hours before coming back out again.” A bit frustrated, they go on rambling about how it would be better if classes were held outside and other desert related issues. You guess their limited intelligence doesn’t really allow them to grasp the technology involved on the station."

rows.original: “Don’t tell anyone, but I’ve been having all kinds of cravings for intimate contact. I’ve asked the lecturers about this, and they explained sex to me. I always blush whenever I think about it.” Cravings? Sex? Blush? Direct as usual, but it always surprises you somewhat whenever they do this. A reminder that they should’ve concentrated in class causes them to quickly derail their dirty train of thought.
rows.translation: “别告诉别人，不过我一直非常渴望亲密接触。我向讲师问过这件事，他们给我解释了性爱。每次想到这些，我都会脸红。”渴望？性爱？脸红？对方一如既往地直接，可每次这么做仍会让你有些惊讶。你提醒对方本该专心听课，令这列肮脏思绪的火车迅速脱轨。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t tell anyone, but I’ve been having all kinds of cravings for intimate contact. I’ve asked the lecturers about this, and they explained sex to me. I always blush whenever I think about it.” Cravings? Sex? Blush? Direct as usual, but it always surprises you somewhat whenever they do this. A reminder that they should’ve concentrated in class causes them to quickly derail their dirty train of thought."

rows.original: I like that we can both fly together, in case we want to start a colony somewhere.
rows.translation: 我喜欢我们能一起飞，以后要是想去某个地方建立殖民地，就方便多了。
rows.raw: "I like that we can both fly together, in case we want to start a colony somewhere."

rows.original: Why did you lose your wings? I know you had them, I wouldn’t have them if you didn’t. Oh well. More air for me.
rows.translation: 你的翅膀怎么没了？我知道你以前有，毕竟要不是你有，我也不会长出来。算了。这样空中就更宽敞了。
rows.raw: "Why did you lose your wings? I know you had them, I wouldn’t have them if you didn’t. Oh well. More air for me."

rows.original: Having a lot of legs is great isn’t it? We could run to our heart’s content and we won’t get tired. Do you want a race?
rows.translation: 有很多条腿很棒，对吧？我们可以尽情奔跑，还不会累。你想比赛吗？
rows.raw: "Having a lot of legs is great isn’t it? We could run to our heart’s content and we won’t get tired. Do you want a race?"

rows.original: Our legs might be different but I still know you had them at one point, just wish you stayed the same.
rows.translation: 我们的腿或许不一样，但我还是知道你曾经有过这样的腿，只希望你能一直保持原样。
rows.raw: "Our legs might be different but I still know you had them at one point, just wish you stayed the same."

rows.original: Well... I like you even if our anatomy is a bit bland. At least we’ll fit in more or less anywhere. Other places are apparently mostly built around our body type, so that’s good.
rows.translation: 嗯...就算我们的身体构造有点平淡，我还是喜欢你。至少我们差不多到哪儿都能融入。据说其他地方大多也是按照我们这种体型建造的，所以这样挺好。
rows.raw: "Well... I like you even if our anatomy is a bit bland. At least we’ll fit in more or less anywhere. Other places are apparently mostly built around our body type, so that’s good."

rows.original: You do know that being generic can sometimes be better right? Just trying to save you some trouble.
rows.translation: 你也知道，有时候普普通通反而更好，对吧？我只是不想让你平白惹上麻烦。
rows.raw: "You do know that being generic can sometimes be better right? Just trying to save you some trouble."

rows.original: “Otherwise, I’m pleased. You look more or less healthy, and are able to make loads more of us if you want to. I can just imagine how it would be if there were many of us. Oh please say you’ll carry more.” They hop up and down a bit childishly while asking you this. You kinda expected they’d say something like this. They do care about you, but it’s more or less only on the broodmother level. Love in any form is always nice, even if it might be a bit weird in comparison to what you’re used to.
rows.translation: “除此之外，我很满意。你看起来还算健康，只要愿意，还能孕育出更多我们这样的孩子。我都能想象，要是有很多我们这样的孩子会是什么样了。哦，求你一定要再怀一些。”他们一边央求你，一边孩子气地蹦了几下。你多少料到他们会说这种话。他们确实关心你，只不过这份关心差不多只停留在对待育母的层面。无论以何种形式存在，爱总是美好的，哪怕和你所习惯的相比可能有点古怪。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Otherwise, I’m pleased. You look more or less healthy, and are able to make loads more of us if you want to. I can just imagine how it would be if there were many of us. Oh please say you’ll carry more.” They hop up and down a bit childishly while asking you this. You kinda expected they’d say something like this. They do care about you, but it’s more or less only on the broodmother level. Love in any form is always nice, even if it might be a bit weird in comparison to what you’re used to."

rows.original: “Oh... nothing much. Sometimes I lounge in the sun, other times I work on my hut,” they say while looking around without focus. “You have a hut?” you ask, surprised. “Yep, water just doesn’t seem to stick the sand together strong enough, so I’ve been licking what I want to attach and it seems to be holding together well. Apparently we’re kinda specialized for this kind of stuff.” Their hand points into a direction, and you can faintly see a greenish brown looking mud hut. They clearly weren’t kidding about the licking part.
rows.translation: “哦...没什么特别的。有时我会躺在阳光下休息，有时会修整我的小屋，”他们目光游离地环顾四周，说道。 “你还有间小屋？”你惊讶地问。 “对啊，水好像没法把沙子粘得足够牢，所以我会舔一舔想接在一起的地方，看起来还挺结实的。我们似乎很擅长做这种事。”他们伸手指向一个方向，你隐约能看见一座绿褐色的泥屋。看来他们说用舔的可不是开玩笑。
rows.raw: "“Oh... nothing much. Sometimes I lounge in the sun, other times I work on my hut,” they say while looking around without focus. “You have a hut?” you ask, surprised. “Yep, water just doesn’t seem to stick the sand together strong enough, so I’ve been licking what I want to attach and it seems to be holding together well. Apparently we’re kinda specialized for this kind of stuff.” Their hand points into a direction, and you can faintly see a greenish brown looking mud hut. They clearly weren’t kidding about the licking part."

rows.original: “Making a spear.” Your eyebrow raises as they say that. “I know I’m not supposed to have weapons, but I feel like I need one, don’t you?” You sigh as you go over the details of weapon safety with “your” child, a thought accidentally escapes your lips. “What is it made of?” you ask as they unhook something from their back. “Sand, technically. I’ve found out how to make my spit harder. The sand tastes awful but I can make more or less anything with it and it doesn’t break that easily.” You tell them to be careful, and they roll their eyes like almost any teenager these days would, while rehooking their sand spear.
rows.translation: “做长矛。”听到这话，你扬起眉毛。“我知道我不该有武器，可我觉得自己需要一把，你不这么认为吗？”你叹了口气，开始向“你的”孩子详细说明武器安全知识，却不小心把心里的一个念头说出了口。 “它是用什么做的？”你问道，看着他们从背后解下一件东西。 “严格来说，是沙子。我发现了让唾液变硬的方法。沙子的味道糟透了，不过我差不多能用它做出任何东西，而且还不容易坏。”你叮嘱他们一定要小心，他们像如今几乎所有青少年一样翻了个白眼，又把沙制长矛挂回背上。
rows.raw: "“Making a spear.” Your eyebrow raises as they say that. “I know I’m not supposed to have weapons, but I feel like I need one, don’t you?” You sigh as you go over the details of weapon safety with “your” child, a thought accidentally escapes your lips. “What is it made of?” you ask as they unhook something from their back. “Sand, technically. I’ve found out how to make my spit harder. The sand tastes awful but I can make more or less anything with it and it doesn’t break that easily.” You tell them to be careful, and they roll their eyes like almost any teenager these days would, while rehooking their sand spear."

rows.original: “I’ve been going to the far ends of the desert. There is some kind of hidden wall that I can’t go through. If I walk along it, it always brings me back to the same place. Not even digging under it works. I keep hitting a metal rock layer. I wonder, why is it here?” Taking their hand into yours you try to explain to them what the ‘wall’ is. They clearly don’t understand that they aren’t in a real desert, and follow an ‘I see, I know’ set of logic. They shake their head is disbelief “You must be crazy. Clearly you and I can both see that there is more desert beyond the wall.” Oh well. You can’t really remove a panel to prove this to them. Otherwise you might break something. Soon they’ve already more or less forgotten about what you’ve said, like they never even had a disagreement with you.
rows.translation: “我一直在往沙漠尽头走。那里有一堵看不见的墙，我怎么也穿不过去。沿着它走，最后总会回到同一个地方。连从下面挖也不行，我总会碰到一层金属岩石。我想知道，它为什么会在那里？”你牵起他们的手，试着解释那堵“墙”究竟是什么。他们显然不明白自己并非身处真正的沙漠，只按照“我明白了，我懂”的那套逻辑理解。他们难以置信地摇摇头，“你肯定疯了。你我明明都能看见墙外还有更多沙漠。”算了。你也不能为了向他们证明就拆下一块面板，否则可能会弄坏什么。没过多久，他们似乎已经把你说的话忘得差不多了，仿佛你们从未有过分歧。
rows.raw: "“I’ve been going to the far ends of the desert. There is some kind of hidden wall that I can’t go through. If I walk along it, it always brings me back to the same place. Not even digging under it works. I keep hitting a metal rock layer. I wonder, why is it here?” Taking their hand into yours you try to explain to them what the ‘wall’ is. They clearly don’t understand that they aren’t in a real desert, and follow an ‘I see, I know’ set of logic. They shake their head is disbelief “You must be crazy. Clearly you and I can both see that there is more desert beyond the wall.” Oh well. You can’t really remove a panel to prove this to them. Otherwise you might break something. Soon they’ve already more or less forgotten about what you’ve said, like they never even had a disagreement with you."

rows.original: “Me and some of my siblings have been thinking of making a small village here, instead of staying separate in the dunes.” Apparently that’s what they’re calling this dome. At least they’re getting familiar with it. “Some of us have merged our huts, and it doesn’t look like we’re fighting too much.”
rows.translation: “我和几个兄弟姐妹一直在考虑在这里建个小村子，不再各自分散住在沙丘里。”看来他们把这座穹顶叫作沙丘。至少他们正逐渐熟悉这里。“我们有些人已经把小屋连在一起了，而且似乎也没怎么打架。”
rows.raw: "“Me and some of my siblings have been thinking of making a small village here, instead of staying separate in the dunes.” Apparently that’s what they’re calling this dome. At least they’re getting familiar with it. “Some of us have merged our huts, and it doesn’t look like we’re fighting too much.”"

rows.original: “It became impossible for us to walk around and not bump into one another so we banded together to make more use of the space in here. We made a small village.” Somewhat surprised by their progress you congratulate them, but inquire about why they aren’t using their rooms in the station. Looking kind of embarrassed they continue speaking “We simply couldn’t get comfortable in there. Sleeping in the sand feels a lot more natural for most of us anyway so... we kinda got permission from the nice lady to stay here permanently and only go up when we get hungry.” They must be talking about Briget. If she says it’s fine then you guess it’s permissible.
rows.translation: “我们走到哪儿都会撞上别人，实在没法继续这样活动，所以大家联合起来，更充分地利用这里的空间。我们建了一座小村子。”你对他们的进展颇感惊讶，向他们道贺之余，也问起他们为什么不用空间站里的房间。他们看起来有些难为情，继续说道：“我们就是没法在那里住得舒服。对我们大多数人而言，睡在沙子里自然得多，所以...我们算是得到那位好心女士的许可，可以永远住在这里，只有饿了才上去。”他们说的肯定是布丽姬特。既然她说没问题，那你想应该就没问题。
rows.raw: "“It became impossible for us to walk around and not bump into one another so we banded together to make more use of the space in here. We made a small village.” Somewhat surprised by their progress you congratulate them, but inquire about why they aren’t using their rooms in the station. Looking kind of embarrassed they continue speaking “We simply couldn’t get comfortable in there. Sleeping in the sand feels a lot more natural for most of us anyway so... we kinda got permission from the nice lady to stay here permanently and only go up when we get hungry.” They must be talking about Briget. If she says it’s fine then you guess it’s permissible."

rows.original: “Every time I see one of those little worms I feel a kinship with them. The nurses tell me that we are technically the same species. I’ve played with them before, but knowing that now just makes it feel better.”
rows.translation: “每次看见那些小虫子，我都会对它们产生一种亲近感。护士们告诉我，严格来说，我们属于同一物种。我以前也和它们玩过，但现在知道了这件事，感觉就更好了。”
rows.raw: "“Every time I see one of those little worms I feel a kinship with them. The nurses tell me that we are technically the same species. I’ve played with them before, but knowing that now just makes it feel better.”"

rows.original: “I feel like I need to look after some form of small creature though. Don’t know why, but it’s just a feeling.”
rows.translation: “不过，我觉得自己需要照顾某种小动物。不知道为什么，就只是有这种感觉。”
rows.raw: "“I feel like I need to look after some form of small creature though. Don’t know why, but it’s just a feeling.”"

rows.original: After a couple more minutes of small talk you say your goodbyes, give a few hugs and watch as they go to their own little spot in the faux desert. It Is good talking to them like this, parental bonding is always important.
rows.translation: 又闲聊了几分钟后，你与他们道别，互相拥抱了几次，目送他们回到人造沙漠中属于自己的小小角落。能像这样和他们交谈真好，亲子间培养感情总是很重要。
rows.raw: "After a couple more minutes of small talk you say your goodbyes, give a few hugs and watch as they go to their own little spot in the faux desert. It Is good talking to them like this, parental bonding is always important."

Looking at it from a window elsewhere on the station makes it look like a large, domed warehouse, but when inside it is like a vast expanse of a desert environment. There is even an artificial sun on the roof. The interior must be lined with numerous screens to simulate a distant environment. There does seem to be about a circular kilometer of actual space, plenty for your surrogate children. By the looks of it there

They must either be used to their presence, or not see them as a threat. There also seems to be a small circular structure close to the door. The sign says worm feed. rows.original: As you can see, this sectioned-off room is where we keep all the nutritional packages to feed the biological units that cannot make it to the mess hall.
rows.translation: 如您所见，这片隔离区域用于存放各种营养包，以喂养无法前往食堂的生物单位。
rows.raw: "As you can see, this sectioned-off room is where we keep all the nutritional packages to feed the biological units that cannot make it to the mess hall. "

rows.original: This biodome system is completely automated and designed to simulate Tarkus to the best of the system’s computational abilities. This includes time of day, heat, wind, gravity, horizon, atmosphere and sand composition.
rows.translation: 这套生物穹顶系统完全自动化，并依照系统计算能力，竭力模拟塔库斯的环境。其中包括昼夜、温度、风力、重力、地平线、大气和沙土成分。
rows.raw: "This biodome system is completely automated and designed to simulate Tarkus to the best of the system’s computational abilities. This includes time of day, heat, wind, gravity, horizon, atmosphere and sand composition. "

rows.original: No expense was spared for the raising of any and all desert organism offspring [pc.MisterMiss] Steele might produce. This dome is as adaptable as many of the other rooms on this floor.
rows.translation: 为了抚育[pc.MisterMiss]·斯蒂尔可能孕育的任何沙漠生物后代，我们不惜一切成本。这座穹顶和本层许多其他房间一样，具有高度适应性。
rows.raw: "No expense was spared for the raising of any and all desert organism offspring [pc.MisterMiss] Steele might produce. This dome is as adaptable as many of the other rooms on this floor. "

rows.original: Domes like this one are actually commonly used in many stations across the galaxy. Most are used for parks or beaches rather than desert simulations, so consider yours a rarity!
rows.translation: 银河系众多空间站其实都普遍采用这类穹顶。大多数用作公园或海滩，而非模拟沙漠，所以您这座可算得上稀有！
rows.raw: "Domes like this one are actually commonly used in many stations across the galaxy. Most are used for parks or beaches rather than desert simulations, so consider yours a rarity! "

rows.raw: "you can’t help but smirk at his words, “Awesome. Name’s Steele. [pc.name] Steele.”"

rows.original: you suppress a grin and calmly state, “You can call me [pc.name]. Or Steele. Or [pc.name] Steele. Just don’t say Steele [pc.name].” You chuckle as Chaurmine rolls his eyes.
rows.translation: 压下笑容，平静说道：“你可以叫我[pc.name]，或者斯蒂尔，或者[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。只要别叫斯蒂尔·[pc.name]。”乔敏翻了个白眼，你则轻笑起来。
rows.raw: "you suppress a grin and calmly state, “You can call me [pc.name]. Or Steele. Or [pc.name] Steele. Just don’t say Steele [pc.name].” You chuckle as Chaurmine rolls his eyes."

rows.original: Chaurmine leans forward and puts his armored elbows on the table, casually watching you.
rows.translation: 乔敏向前俯身，把装甲手肘放在桌上，漫不经心地看着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine leans forward and puts his armored elbows on the table, casually watching you."

rows.original: Reaching Chaurmine’s large booth,
rows.translation: 来到乔敏的大型卡座后，
rows.raw: "Reaching Chaurmine’s large booth, "

rows.original: you pause next to his table and start to greet him only to be interrupted by a snort of amusement, “Just sit down, ya cunt.” Though crude, there’s a slight smirk that belies any malice.
rows.translation: 你停在桌边，正要打招呼，却被一声觉得有趣的哼声打断。“坐下吧，你这蠢货。”话虽粗鲁，那丝淡淡笑意却表明并无恶意。
rows.raw: "you pause next to his table and start to greet him only to be interrupted by a snort of amusement, “Just sit down, ya cunt.” Though crude, there’s a slight smirk that belies any malice."

rows.original: you slide into the seat opposite of him. “Hey,” he growls, not betraying any emotions - except for his armored tail, which twitches as you sit.
rows.translation: 你滑进他对面的座位。“嘿，”他低吼着，没有泄露任何情绪，除了你坐下时抽动的装甲尾巴。
rows.raw: "you slide into the seat opposite of him. “Hey,” he growls, not betraying any emotions - except for his armored tail, which twitches as you sit."

rows.original: Across the bar, tucked away in a booth, a distinctive metallic glint catches your eye. Taking in the silvery scales on display on a gargantuan reptile, you quickly recognize that jackass you met out on the wastes. His gaze casually wanders, no doubt absorbing the delightful sight of the scantily clad staff. Your eyes meet his for a moment, and he casually motions to the seat in front of him.
rows.translation: 酒吧另一端一个偏僻卡座里，一道独特金属反光吸引了你的视线。看见某只庞大爬虫显露出的银色鳞片，你立刻认出荒野里遇到的那个混蛋。他的目光漫不经心地游移，无疑正在欣赏衣着暴露员工的诱人景象。你们四目相对片刻，他随意指了指面前座位。
rows.raw: "\n\nAcross the bar, tucked away in a booth, a distinctive metallic glint catches your eye. Taking in the silvery scales on display on a gargantuan reptile, you quickly recognize that jackass you met out on the wastes. His gaze casually wanders, no doubt absorbing the delightful sight of the scantily clad staff. Your eyes meet his for a moment, and he casually motions to the seat in front of him."

rows.original: Reptile
rows.translation: 爬虫
rows.raw: "Reptile"

rows.original: Looks like Chaurmine is still here. That lonely fucker. Will you give him some company?
rows.translation: 看来乔敏还在这里。那个孤独的混蛋。你要陪陪他吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nLooks like Chaurmine is still here. That lonely fucker. Will you give him some company?"

rows.original: Chaurmine
rows.translation: 乔敏
rows.raw: "Chaurmine"

rows.original: Easily spotted among the droves of much shorter and less metallic people, you see Chaurmine standing near his corvette in the distance. He’s looking at his clunky codex, occasionally interrupted when he shoos away a few curious or grabby raskvel.
rows.translation: 在人群中，其他人大多矮得多、也没有那么强烈的金属感，因此你轻易发现远处站在轻型护卫舰附近的乔敏。他正查看笨重的随身终端，偶尔不得不赶走几名好奇或动手动脚的拉斯克维尔。
rows.raw: "\n\nEasily spotted among the droves of much shorter and less metallic people, you see Chaurmine standing near his corvette in the distance. He’s looking at his clunky codex, occasionally interrupted when he shoos away a few curious or grabby raskvel."

rows.original: Chaurmine
rows.translation: 乔敏
rows.raw: "Chaurmine"

rows.original: Aullama
rows.raw: "Aullama"

rows.original: Curious about why he’s out here in the hangar, you make your way over to the tin lizard,
rows.translation: 你很好奇他为什么待在机库，于是朝铁皮蜥蜴走去，一边
rows.raw: "Curious about why he’s out here in the hangar, you make your way over to the tin lizard, "

rows.original: bumping into
rows.translation: 撞上
rows.raw: "bumping into"

rows.original: almost knocking over
rows.translation: 险些撞倒
rows.raw: "almost knocking over"

rows.original: a few careless raskvel as you call out to him. He doesn’t seem to notice you, remaining focused on his codex, a stern expression set on his reptilian face. Or is that his regular look? Either way, you decide to settle at roughly arm’s length distance and wait as his claws tap at the screen.
rows.translation: 几名粗心的拉斯克维尔，一边朝他呼喊。他似乎没有注意到你，仍专注于随身终端，爬虫脸上挂着严肃表情。又或者那只是他的日常表情？无论如何，你决定停在大致一臂之遥处，等待他的利爪敲击屏幕。
rows.raw: " a few careless raskvel as you call out to him. He doesn’t seem to notice you, remaining focused on his codex, a stern expression set on his reptilian face. Or is that his regular look? Either way, you decide to settle at roughly arm’s length distance and wait as his claws tap at the screen."

rows.original: A moment later and he lowers the old device. “[pc.name],” he grunts, scales along his neck and shoulders lightly scraping against each other as he shifts to regard you.
rows.translation: 片刻后，他放下老旧装置。“[pc.name]，”他闷哼道，转身看向你时，颈部和肩部的鳞片轻轻相互刮擦。
rows.raw: "\n\nA moment later and he lowers the old device. “[pc.name],” he grunts, scales along his neck and shoulders lightly scraping against each other as he shifts to regard you."

rows.original: You return the greeting, and naturally ask what he’s doing out here in the hangar.
rows.translation: 你回了声招呼，自然地问他在机库做什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou return the greeting, and naturally ask what he’s doing out here in the hangar. "

rows.original: You raise a brow; maybe he should come with you to the bar, it looks like he could use a drink.
rows.translation: 你挑起眉毛；也许他该和你一起去酒吧，看起来正需要喝一杯。
rows.raw: "You raise a brow; maybe he should come with you to the bar, it looks like he could use a drink."

rows.original: Your brow creases in worry; he’s not in any kind of trouble is he?
rows.translation: 你担忧地皱起眉头；他该不会遇到什么麻烦吧？
rows.raw: "Your brow creases in worry; he’s not in any kind of trouble is he?"

rows.original: An impish grin splits your [pc.face]; is he hiding something?
rows.translation: 顽皮笑容在[pc.face]上绽开；他是不是藏着什么？
rows.raw: "An impish grin splits your [pc.face]; is he hiding something?"

rows.original: You raise a brow; maybe he should come with you to the bar, it looks like he could use a drink.
rows.translation: 你挑起眉毛；也许他该和你一起去酒吧，看起来正需要喝一杯。
rows.raw: "You raise a brow; maybe he should come with you to the bar, it looks like he could use a drink."

rows.original: This only earns you an amused snort.
rows.translation: 这只换来一声觉得有趣的哼笑。
rows.raw: " This only earns you an amused snort."

rows.original: “What? No, just work. Reviewing some things before I head out,” Chaurmine grunts, stowing his codex.
rows.translation: “什么？不，只是工作。出发前检查一些东西，”乔敏闷哼着收起随身终端。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What? No, just work. Reviewing some things before I head out,” Chaurmine grunts, stowing his codex."

rows.original: You comment on how fortunate it is, then, that you just happened to be passing by.
rows.translation: 你评论道，既然如此，自己正好路过这里还真是幸运。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou comment on how fortunate it is, then, that you just happened to be passing by."

rows.original: The brute nods, “Yeah.”
rows.translation: 这个大块头点点头，“对。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe brute nods, “Yeah.”"

rows.original: Well, he hardly seems to be in a rush. Perhaps you could strike up a conversation before he has to leave.
rows.translation: 好吧，他看起来完全不着急。也许在他必须离开前，你还能找他聊上一会儿。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, he hardly seems to be in a rush. Perhaps you could strike up a conversation before he has to leave."

rows.original: Work?
rows.translation: 工作？
rows.raw: "Work?"

rows.original: Aullama
rows.raw: "Aullama"

rows.original: With a coy smile, you remark that with how long he’s been slouching at The Mess, you were wondering if he even remembered what a paycheck was.
rows.translation: 你带着羞涩的微笑评论道，他在食堂无所事事地待了这么久，你都开始怀疑他是否还记得工资是什么。
rows.raw: "With a coy smile, you remark that with how long he’s been slouching at The Mess, you were wondering if he even remembered what a paycheck was."

rows.original: “Heh, back when I was a freelance bodyguard, hardly knew the word,” he growls dryly.
rows.translation: “嘿，以前当自由保镖的时候，我几乎不认识这个词，”他干巴巴地低吼道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Heh, back when I was a freelance bodyguard, hardly knew the word,” he growls dryly."

rows.original: Naturally, you inquire about his current occupation.
rows.translation: 你自然而然地询问起他现在的职业。
rows.raw: "\n\nNaturally, you inquire about his current occupation."

rows.original: “Hunting,” Chaurmine grunts simply.
rows.translation: “狩猎，”乔敏简单地哼了一声。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hunting,” Chaurmine grunts simply."

rows.original: You gasp, bringing a hand to your [pc.lips] in dismay. Oh no! What does he even hunt? The poor things!
rows.translation: 你倒吸一口气，惊恐地用手捂住[pc.lips]。哦不！他究竟在猎杀什么？那些可怜的东西！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou gasp, bringing a hand to your [pc.lips] in dismay. Oh no! What does he even hunt? The poor things!"

rows.original: You nod in approval, offering your assistance if he ever needs it. There’s really only one thing someone like Chaurmine could be hired to hunt, after all.
rows.translation: 你赞许地点点头，表示如果他有需要，自己愿意帮忙。毕竟，像乔敏这样的人受雇追猎的目标其实只有一种。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod in approval, offering your assistance if he ever needs it. There’s really only one thing someone like Chaurmine could be hired to hunt, after all."

rows.original: You sigh at the vague answer, and though you already know, you ask what he’s hired to hunt.
rows.translation: 你对这个含糊回答叹了口气；尽管已经知道，还是问他受雇追捕什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sigh at the vague answer, and though you already know, you ask what he’s hired to hunt."

rows.original: The lizard nods, saying, “Jailbirds,” with a grin.
rows.translation: 蜥蜴点点头，咧嘴说道：“越狱犯。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe lizard nods, saying, “Jailbirds,” with a grin."

rows.original: It dawns on you what he means by ‘hunting’. You giggle to yourself before biting your lip mischievously, and express your gratitude for people like him that help keep such rotten birds in their cages.
rows.translation: 你终于明白他所说的‘狩猎’是什么意思。你暗自轻笑，调皮地咬住嘴唇，表示很感谢有他这样的人帮助把那些烂鸟关回笼子里。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt dawns on you what he means by ‘hunting’. You giggle to yourself before biting your lip mischievously, and express your gratitude for people like him that help keep such rotten birds in their cages."

rows.original: You nod. Makes sense, someone like him being a bounty hunter.
rows.translation: 你点点头。有道理，像他这样的人确实适合当赏金猎人。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod. Makes sense, someone like him being a bounty hunter."

rows.original: Chaurmine gives a nonchalant shrug, “What can I say. I enjoy it.”
rows.translation: 乔敏若无其事地耸耸肩。“我能说什么呢。我喜欢这份工作。”
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine gives a nonchalant shrug, “What can I say. I enjoy it.”"

rows.original: Work?
rows.translation: 工作？
rows.raw: "Work?"

rows.original: Work?
rows.translation: 工作？
rows.raw: "Work?"

rows.original: You already did this.
rows.translation: 你已经做过这件事了。
rows.raw: "You already did this."

rows.original: Work?
rows.translation: 工作？
rows.raw: "Work?"

rows.original: He has a job after all, huh?
rows.translation: 所以他确实有工作，对吧？
rows.raw: "He has a job after all, huh?"

rows.original: Where?
rows.translation: 去哪里？
rows.raw: "Where?"

rows.original: Aullama
rows.raw: "Aullama"

rows.original: Is he able to tell you where he’s going? Maybe the two of you will cross paths.
rows.translation: 他能告诉你自己要去哪里吗？也许你们会再次相遇。
rows.raw: "Is he able to tell you where he’s going? Maybe the two of you will cross paths."

rows.original: Chaurmine shrugs, “Maybe, but I doubt it. I’m headed to the Siretta system; my mark is on one of the moons of a Jovian gas giant, at the edge of the system. I should be there in roughly fourteen hours after I depart.”
rows.translation: 乔敏耸耸肩。“也许吧，但我觉得不太可能。我正要前往西雷塔星系；目标在一颗类木气态巨行星的卫星上，位于星系边缘。出发后大约十四小时，我应该就能抵达。”
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine shrugs, “Maybe, but I doubt it. I’m headed to the Siretta system; my mark is on one of the moons of a Jovian gas giant, at the edge of the system. I should be there in roughly fourteen hours after I depart.”"

rows.original: Where?
rows.translation: 去哪里？
rows.raw: "Where?"

rows.original: Where?
rows.translation: 去哪里？
rows.raw: "Where?"

rows.original: You already did this.
rows.translation: 你已经做过这件事了。
rows.raw: "You already did this."

rows.original: Where?
rows.translation: 去哪里？
rows.raw: "Where?"

rows.original: So where is he going?
rows.translation: 所以他要去哪里？
rows.raw: "So where is he going?"

rows.original: How Long?
rows.translation: 要多久？
rows.raw: "How Long?"

rows.original: Aullama
rows.raw: "Aullama"

rows.original: Sounds like quite the adventure, and you ask when the two of you might meet again.
rows.translation: 听起来会是一场相当精彩的冒险，你询问两人何时可能再次见面。
rows.raw: "Sounds like quite the adventure, and you ask when the two of you might meet again."

rows.original: Armored brow creasing, he gently shakes his head, “I can’t tell you that. It’s classified.”
rows.translation: 装甲覆盖的眉头皱起，他轻轻摇头。“我不能告诉你。这是机密。”
rows.raw: "\n\nArmored brow creasing, he gently shakes his head, “I can’t tell you that. It’s classified.”"

rows.original: Suppressing a grin into a smirk, you raise an eyebrow of your own, skepticism written on your face as you wait for his actual answer instead of his usual dry humor.
rows.translation: 你强忍着不让笑容变成坏笑，也挑起一边眉毛，满脸怀疑地等着他的真正答案，而不是一贯的冷面笑话。
rows.raw: "\n\nSuppressing a grin into a smirk, you raise an eyebrow of your own, skepticism written on your face as you wait for his actual answer instead of his usual dry humor."

rows.original: Try as you might though, you can’t hold back a small giggle.
rows.translation: 不过无论怎么努力，你还是没忍住一声轻笑。
rows.raw: " Try as you might though, you can’t hold back a small giggle."

rows.original: “Really though, I dunno, maybe a week, probably longer if there are multiple jobs. If you are in that area by then, you might find me fuckin’ around on a station or something,” he growls with a shrug.
rows.translation: “不过说真的，我不知道，也许一周；如果有好几份工作，大概会更久。到时如果你真的也在那一带，说不定能发现我正在某个空间站闲逛之类的，”他耸肩低吼道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Really though, I dunno, maybe a week, probably longer if there are multiple jobs. If you are in that area by then, you might find me fuckin’ around on a station or something,” he growls with a shrug."

rows.original: How Long?
rows.translation: 要多久？
rows.raw: "How Long?"

rows.original: How Long?
rows.translation: 要多久？
rows.raw: "How Long?"

rows.original: You already did this.
rows.translation: 你已经做过这件事了。
rows.raw: "You already did this."

rows.original: How Long?
rows.translation: 要多久？
rows.raw: "How Long?"

rows.original: How long does he think this job will take to complete?
rows.translation: 他觉得这份工作需要多久才能完成？
rows.raw: "How long does he think this job will take to complete?"

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Aullama
rows.raw: "Aullama"

rows.original: The both of you spend a moment in companionable silence, the fluctuating crowds passing by seeming a world away. Before it can get awkward though, you mention that the two of you should be on your separate ways, and wish him luck on his mission.
rows.translation: 你们俩在融洽的沉默中待了片刻，来往变动的人群仿佛远在另一个世界。不过在气氛变得尴尬前，你提到两人应该各自上路了，并祝他任务顺利。
rows.raw: "The both of you spend a moment in companionable silence, the fluctuating crowds passing by seeming a world away. Before it can get awkward though, you mention that the two of you should be on your separate ways, and wish him luck on his mission."

rows.original: “Hey uh, [pc.name], wait...” Chaurmine stammers before you can leave, a flicker of uncertainty in his azure eyes, “Look, this isn’t the kind of thing that saurmorians say, so it’s gonna sound awkward coming from me.”
rows.translation: “嘿，呃，[pc.name]，等等...”你还没来得及离开，乔敏便结巴着开口，湛蓝双眼中闪过一丝犹豫。“听着，索莫里安人不会说这种话，所以从我嘴里讲出来会很尴尬。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey uh, [pc.name], wait...” Chaurmine stammers before you can leave, a flicker of uncertainty in his azure eyes, “Look, this isn’t the kind of thing that saurmorians say, so it’s gonna sound awkward coming from me.”"

rows.original: Looking at him curiously
rows.translation: 你满怀好奇地看着他
rows.raw: "\n\nLooking at him curiously"

rows.original: with wide eyes
rows.translation: ，双眼睁得大大的
rows.raw: " with wide eyes"

rows.original: , you gesture for him to continue.
rows.translation: ，示意他继续。
rows.raw: ", you gesture for him to continue."

rows.original: His heavy, scaled tail twitches before he speaks up, “I like you.” Though you can’t see it, you can certainly feel his blush as heat visibly shimmers off his body.
rows.translation: 他沉重的鳞片尾巴抽动了一下，才开口说道：“我喜欢你。”尽管看不见，你却绝对能感受到他脸红了，因为热浪正清晰地从身体表面升起。
rows.raw: "\n\nHis heavy, scaled tail twitches before he speaks up, “I like you.” Though you can’t see it, you can certainly feel his blush as heat visibly shimmers off his body."

rows.original: This seems to be very unusual territory for the tin lizard, as small of a confession as it may seem. How do you take this?
rows.translation: 哪怕这份告白看似微不足道，对这只铁皮蜥蜴而言也显然是非常陌生的领域。你要如何回应？
rows.raw: "\n\nThis seems to be very unusual territory for the tin lizard, as small of a confession as it may seem. How do you take this?"

rows.original: Like
rows.translation: 喜欢
rows.raw: "Like"

rows.original: Aullama
rows.raw: "Aullama"

rows.original: With a gasp, you clutch your hands over your chest, heart skipping a beat. A beatific smile quickly splits your face before letting out a squee in delight, and you bolt forward before the lizard can react, wrapping as much of his steamy, bulky form as you can into a tight hug.
rows.translation: 你倒吸一口气，双手按住胸口，心脏漏跳一拍。幸福微笑迅速爬满脸庞；你欣喜地尖叫一声，在蜥蜴反应过来前便冲上前去，尽可能抱住他那炽热而魁梧的身体，用力拥抱。
rows.raw: "With a gasp, you clutch your hands over your chest, heart skipping a beat. A beatific smile quickly splits your face before letting out a squee in delight, and you bolt forward before the lizard can react, wrapping as much of his steamy, bulky form as you can into a tight hug."

rows.original: “I like you back big guy!” you gush as you squeeze him tighter against your [pc.chest].
rows.translation: “我也喜欢你，大块头！”你激动地说道，同时把他更紧地搂向[pc.chest]。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I like you back big guy!” you gush as you squeeze him tighter against your [pc.chest]."

rows.original: A broad grin spreads across your face, and you lean over to
rows.translation: 灿烂笑容在你脸上绽放，你探身过去，
rows.raw: "A broad grin spreads across your face, and you lean over to "

rows.original: clap a hand on his armored arm
rows.translation: 一掌拍在他覆盖装甲的手臂上
rows.raw: "clap a hand on his armored arm"

rows.original: clap him on the shoulder
rows.translation: 拍了拍他的肩膀
rows.raw: "clap him on the shoulder"

rows.original: . You give a hot scale an encouraging squeeze.
rows.translation: 。你鼓励地捏了捏一块滚烫鳞片。
rows.raw: ". You give a hot scale an encouraging squeeze."

rows.original: “I like you too, bro. I like you too,” you say soothingly.
rows.translation: “我也喜欢你，兄弟。我也喜欢你，”你安慰地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I like you too, bro. I like you too,” you say soothingly."

rows.original: A warm smile brightens your face as you reach over and take one of his armored hands into your own. You give a hot scale a comforting pat, which is returned with an appreciative squeeze.
rows.translation: 温暖笑容照亮你的脸。你伸手把他一只覆盖装甲的手握进掌中，又安慰地拍了拍滚烫鳞片；他则以感激的轻握回应。
rows.raw: "A warm smile brightens your face as you reach over and take one of his armored hands into your own. You give a hot scale a comforting pat, which is returned with an appreciative squeeze."

rows.original: “I like you as well, Chaurmine,” you murmur affectionately.

I’m sorry Chaurmine...”

I’m sorry big guy, I didn’t know that you-...” You nibble on a lip, brow creasing as you wring your hands together nervously, “I mean, I like you too. Just not in the same way you like me. rows.raw: "You sigh, smiling softly as you regard the large lizard. “Wow, Chaurmine. Um, I’m flattered, but if you’re saying what I think you’re saying... I like you as a friend, and you’re not bad in the sack, and I’d rather keep it that way, for things to be simple. I’m sorry, Chaurmine,” you murmur somberly."

rows.original: Chaurmine’s features soften, and he nods with a grunt, “That’s, uh, fine by me, [pc.name]. We can keep things simple. That’s just fine.” He shifts uncomfortably, scales on his neck scraping together as he looks from you to his ship; not wanting to leave, but not knowing what else to say. With an encouraging smile, you extend a hand, which he gingerly shakes with his own armored hand.
rows.translation: 乔敏的神情柔和下来，哼了一声点点头。“那，呃，我没意见，[pc.name]。我们可以让事情保持简单。这样就很好。”他不自在地挪动身体，脖颈鳞片相互摩擦；目光在你与飞船之间游移，既不想离开，又不知道还能说些什么。你鼓励地微笑着伸出一只手，他则小心地用装甲手掌与你相握。
rows.raw: "\n\nChaurmine’s features soften, and he nods with a grunt, “That’s, uh, fine by me, [pc.name]. We can keep things simple. That’s just fine.” He shifts uncomfortably, scales on his neck scraping together as he looks from you to his ship; not wanting to leave, but not knowing what else to say. With an encouraging smile, you extend a hand, which he gingerly shakes with his own armored hand."

rows.original: You flinch as something explodes behind you. Messing about here is a mistake. You turn and flee the control center, coughing back the acrid smell of melting plastic. As you get to the top of the stairs, there’s a resounding crash behind you. Sighing with relief, you make your way out of the factory and back out through the surrounding junk, congratulating yourself on a dangerous mission well completed.
rows.translation: 身后有什么东西突然爆炸，吓得你缩了一下。在这里磨蹭是个错误。你转身逃离控制中心，咳嗽着抵御塑料熔化的刺鼻气味。刚爬到楼梯顶端，身后便传来一声震耳欲聋的巨响。你如释重负地叹了口气，走出工厂，重新穿过周围的垃圾堆，同时庆幸自己顺利完成了这项危险任务。

As you get to the top of the stairs, there’s a resounding crash behind you. Sighing with relief, you make your way out of the factory and back out through the surrounding junk, congratulating yourself on a dangerous mission well completed.\n\n"

rows.original: It’s tiny by human standards, but you are rather taken by a portal which doesn’t require you to stand on tiptoe to reach the handle for once.
rows.translation: 按人类标准来看，它十分矮小，不过难得遇上一扇不用踮脚就能摸到把手的门，你倒颇为喜欢。
rows.raw: "It’s tiny by human standards, but you are rather taken by a portal which doesn’t require you to stand on tiptoe to reach the handle for once."

rows.translation: 你必须弯下身子才能进去。
rows.raw: "You have to hunch yourself down to enter."

rows.original: This is going to be a serious task. You crouch down and just about manage to squeeze yourself through, your back getting much more intimate with the top of the frame than you’d like.
rows.translation: 这可是一项艰巨的任务。你蹲下身，勉强把自己挤了进去，后背与门框顶部贴得比你希望的亲密多了。
rows.raw: "This is going to be a serious task. You crouch down and just about manage to squeeze yourself through, your back getting much more intimate with the top of the frame than you’d like."

rows.original: The interior is dull and close – the windows that ring the building bizarrely seem to be opaque on both sides. A motley collection of salvaged monitors and machines crowd the room from all sides, the air filled with their thrum, their cables slathered across the worn concrete. There seems to be a nexus of screens and lamps at the far end on the upper level of the tower; a narrow path through the looming mainframes leads in that direction. You carefully pick your way through the stuffy room towards the yellowish glare.
rows.translation: 室内昏暗逼仄，环绕建筑的窗户十分古怪，两面看起来竟都不透光。五花八门的回收显示器和机器从四面八方挤满房间，空气中充斥着它们的嗡鸣，缆线铺满磨损的混凝土地面。塔楼上层尽头似乎聚集着大量屏幕与灯具；一条狭窄通道穿过高耸的主机，通往那个方向。你小心穿过这间闷热的屋子，朝昏黄的光芒走去。
rows.raw: " The interior is dull and close – the windows that ring the building bizarrely seem to be opaque on both sides. A motley collection of salvaged monitors and machines crowd the room from all sides, the air filled with their thrum, their cables slathered across the worn concrete. There seems to be a nexus of screens and lamps at the far end on the upper level of the tower; a narrow path through the looming mainframes leads in that direction. You carefully pick your way through the stuffy room towards the yellowish glare."

rows.original: There’s a small, squat shape seated in front of the dozen or so monitor screens up here, earnestly tapping away on one of four touch pads and keyboards, nestled into a large hollow of clothes and gutted machinery. It seems to be talking to itself.
rows.translation: 这里有个矮墩墩的小身影坐在十几块显示屏前，专心敲打四块触控板和键盘中的一块，整个人窝在衣物与拆空机器堆成的大坑里。它似乎正在自言自语。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a small, squat shape seated in front of the dozen or so monitor screens up here, earnestly tapping away on one of four touch pads and keyboards, nestled into a large hollow of clothes and gutted machinery. It seems to be talking to itself."

rows.original: “ – still not carrying the story. Have they been gotten to as well? After what happened over at TheTruth3000.net nothing’d surprise me. Gah!” The gabilani takes a distracted look up and starts when he sees you standing there. “Bloody hell, you startled me. Who do we have here then?” He squints at you interestedly. “A customer? Or a U.G.C. Black Wing agent, come to find out exactly how much I know?”
rows.translation: “——还是不肯报道这件事。他们也被收买了吗？真理3000.net 那边出了那种事以后，再发生什么我都不会惊讶。啊！”加比拉尼人心不在焉地抬头一瞥，看到你站在那里时吓了一跳。“真见鬼，你吓到我了。那你又是哪位？”他饶有兴趣地眯眼打量你。“顾客？还是银河联合邦联黑翼的特工，来查我究竟知道多少？”

Or a U.G.C. Black Wing agent, come to find out exactly how much I know?”"

rows.original: You tell him you’ve never even heard of a U.G.C. Black Wing.
rows.translation: 你告诉他，自己甚至从未听说过银河联合邦联黑翼。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell him you’ve never even heard of a U.G.C. Black Wing."

rows.original: “Course you haven’t,” the goblin replies with a smile and an exaggerated wink. He has a round, good-natured face to go with his broad shouldered and fleshy frame, built like a green mini-fridge. He seems to be dressed entirely in some sort of thin, malleable metal paper, fashioned into a vest and helmet. His confiding tone seems permanently incredulous, as if the world at large never stops pleasantly outraging him. “So let’s just pretend you’re a customer and I’m a simple scrap merchant who you can offload all your unwanted junk on and who can maybe offer you some prophylactics on the side as well. I can keep that song and dance up if you can. So what can ol’ Colenso do for you, eh?”
rows.translation: “你当然没听说过，”这名地精笑着回答，还夸张地眨了眨眼。他有一张圆润和善的脸，与宽肩肥壮的身材相得益彰，整个人就像一台绿色迷你冰箱。他似乎从头到脚都穿着某种轻薄柔韧的金属纸，折成了背心和头盔。他那推心置腹的语气始终带着难以置信，仿佛整个世界从未停止用各种事愉快地冒犯他。“所以咱们就假装你是顾客，而我只是个普普通通的废品商，能让你把不要的破烂都卖给我，顺便或许还能给你提供点驱避剂。只要你肯配合，我就能把这出戏演下去。那么，老科伦索能为你做什么，嗯？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Course you haven’t,” the goblin replies with a smile and an exaggerated wink. He has a round, good-natured face to go with his broad shouldered and fleshy frame, built like a green mini-fridge. He seems to be dressed entirely in some sort of thin, malleable metal paper, fashioned into a vest and helmet. His confiding tone seems permanently incredulous, as if the world at large never stops pleasantly outraging him. “So let’s just pretend you’re a customer and I’m a simple scrap merchant who you can offload all your unwanted junk on and who can maybe offer you some prophylactics on the side as well. I can keep that song and dance up if you can. So what can ol’ Colenso do for you, eh?”"

rows.original: The thickset gabilani considers you speculatively for a moment.
rows.translation: 这名壮实的加比拉尼人若有所思地打量了你片刻。
rows.raw: "\n\n The thickset gabilani considers you speculatively for a moment."

rows.original: “You know, maybe I do. I need someone to get to the bottom of summat, and the way this is starting to look, it may as well be a U.G.C. shadow operative that helps me do it rather than anyone else.” He rummages around in a disemboweled computer and emerges with what looks like a female gabilani’s head. He thumps it down on the counter in front of you dramatically. A shiny gray female gabilani’s head, on closer examination, with solid eyes and fiber wires spooling out of it.
rows.translation: “你知道吗，我也许还真有。我需要有人把某件事查个水落石出，而照现在的情况看，与其找别人，倒不如让一名银河联合邦联的影子特工帮我。”他在一台被开膛破肚的电脑里翻找一阵，拿出来的东西看起来像一名加比拉尼女性的脑袋。他戏剧性地把它砰地摆在你面前的柜台上。仔细一看，那确实是一颗闪亮的灰色加比拉尼女性头颅，有着实心眼球，纤维导线从中卷曲而出。

I need someone to get to the bottom of summat, and the way this is starting to look, it may as well be a U.G.C. shadow operative that helps me do it rather than anyone else.” He rummages around in a disemboweled computer and emerges with what looks like a female gabilani’s head. He thumps it down on the counter in front of you dramatically. A shiny gray female gabilani’s head, on closer examination, with solid eyes and fiber wires spooling out of it."

rows.original: “A sexbot,” you hazard. Colenso snaps his fingers excitedly.
rows.translation: “性爱机器人，”你试探着说。科伦索兴奋地打了个响指。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A sexbot,” you hazard. Colenso snaps his fingers excitedly."

rows.original: “And it won’t let me in. Won’t let me look at its memory banks! What kind of sex toy has military grade encryption on it? Absolutely mental!” You wait patiently. “There was always one or two of these VIs wandering ‘round the junkyards hassling people, right? Their owners get tired of ‘em, they go wrong or they get outmoded. They’re supposed to get scrubbed and scrapped before they get here, but half the time the dumpers don’t bother. The Empatron 350s got landed here wholesale, that detecting subliminal wishes programming they have was always going to go completely tits up. Apparently the entire line got recalled when one of them literally fucked an orchan to death. Because he wanted that, obviously.” The big gabilani drums his fingers on the counter fretfully, looking at the infinitely calm visage of the beheaded sexbot. “People don’t treat ‘em seriously. I mean I dunno if you’ve noticed, but most gabilani and raskvel don’t mind a roll in the hay pretty much ever and they do a bang tidy impression of a member of your own race, right? But they’ve changed. I’m sure of it. There’s more of ‘em, they attack people more often now and they do this... ‘scanning’ thing. And they won’t let me scan them back!” He pokes the robot’s head furiously. It seems this more than anything else enrages him. “What are you hiding, you tin pot tart? Who are you working for?!”
rows.translation: “而且它不让我进去。不让我查看它的记忆库！什么样的性玩具会装军用级加密？简直疯了！”你耐心等待。“垃圾场里总有一两个这种虚拟智能四处游荡、骚扰别人，对吧？主人玩腻了，机器出了故障，或者型号过时。它们本该在送来之前被清空并拆解，可那些倾倒垃圾的家伙十次有五次都懒得处理。恩帕特隆350型是整批送到这里的，它们那套侦测潜意识愿望的程序注定会彻底完蛋。据说其中一台真的把一个奥坎人操死以后，整个系列都被召回了。显然，因为那正是他想要的。”这名大块头加比拉尼人烦躁地用手指敲着柜台，盯着断头性爱机器人那张永远平静的脸。“人们根本不把它们当回事。我的意思是，不知道你注意到没有，大多数加比拉尼人和拉斯克维尔人几乎从不介意来上一炮，而且它们模仿你同族成员的样子还真他妈像，对吧？但它们变了。我敢肯定。它们数量更多了，袭击人的频率也更高了，还会做这种...‘扫描’。而且它们不让我反过来扫描！”他愤怒地戳着机器人的脑袋。看起来这件事比其他一切都更让他恼火。“你藏了什么，铁皮婊子？你在为谁工作？！”

Absolutely mental!” You wait patiently. “There was always one or two of these VIs wandering ‘round the junkyards hassling people, right? Their owners get tired of ‘em, they go wrong or they get outmoded. They’re supposed to get scrubbed and scrapped before they get here, but half the time the dumpers don’t bother. But they’ve changed. I’m sure of it. There’s more of ‘em, they attack people more often now and they do this... ‘scanning’ thing. And they won’t let me scan them back!” He pokes the robot’s head furiously. It seems this more than anything else enrages him. “What are you hiding, you tin pot tart? Who are you working for?!”"

rows.original: “What do you want me to do?” you interject. Colenso breathes deep and collects himself. He reaches underneath the counter again and pushes a blocky, walkie-talkie-like device with a radar screen across to you.
rows.translation: “你想让我做什么？”你插话道。科伦索深吸一口气，恢复镇定。他再次把手伸到柜台下面，推给你一台方方正正、类似对讲机并带有雷达屏幕的装置。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What do you want me to do?” you interject. Colenso breathes deep and collects himself. He reaches underneath the counter again and pushes a blocky, walkie-talkie-like device with a radar screen across to you."

rows.original: “I can’t get at their CPUs – they lock down somehow when you trap them. But maybe we can work out where they’re coming from. That is a GPS triangulator, connects right into the gabilani satellite network. If you scan enough sexbots with it, it will take the direction they were coming from and work out an approximation of where they originated. I need you to scan enough of them to get that approximation, and then go find out what they’re up to.” You weigh the bulky device in your hand.
rows.translation: “我接触不到它们的中央处理器，被困住时，它们会以某种方式锁死。不过也许我们能查出它们来自哪里。这是GPS三角定位仪，可以直接接入加比拉尼卫星网络。只要用它扫描足够多的性爱机器人，它就会记录它们来时的方向，估算出它们的起源位置。我要你扫描足够多的目标，得出那个估算地点，再去查清它们在搞什么。”你在手中掂量着这台笨重装置。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I can’t get at their CPUs – they lock down somehow when you trap them. But maybe we can work out where they’re coming from. That is a GPS triangulator, connects right into the gabilani satellite network. If you scan enough sexbots with it, it will take the direction they were coming from and work out an approximation of where they originated. I need you to scan enough of them to get that approximation, and then go find out what they’re up to.” You weigh the bulky device in your hand."

rows.original: “And what would I get in return for doing this?”
rows.translation: “那我做这件事能得到什么回报？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And what would I get in return for doing this?”"

rows.original: “The honor and satisfaction of busting a dastardly mecha-conspiracy wide open!” replies Colenso grandly. It takes him more a few moments to realize you haven’t swallowed this. “...would a store discount do? Look
rows.translation: “揭穿邪恶机械阴谋的荣誉与满足感！”科伦索气势恢宏地回答。他花了好一会儿才意识到你没吃这一套。“...商店折扣行吗？听着
rows.raw: "\n\n“The honor and satisfaction of busting a dastardly mecha-conspiracy wide open!” replies Colenso grandly. It takes him more a few moments to realize you haven’t swallowed this. “...would a store discount do? Look "

rows.original: , I’m dead serious about this. We really need to find out why they’ve changed, and you’re the first person who’s listened to me about this for more than ten seconds. Please do it. I reckon the fate of the galaxy is in the balance.”
rows.translation: ，这件事我是认真的。我们真的必须查清它们为什么会变，而你是第一个愿意听我说上十秒以上的人。求你去做吧。我估计整个银河系的命运都悬于一线。”
rows.raw: ", I’m dead serious about this. We really need to find out why they’ve changed, and you’re the first person who’s listened to me about this for more than ten seconds. Please do it. I reckon the fate of the galaxy is in the balance.”"

rows.original: You somehow doubt that, but a store discount isn’t such a terrible reward for beating up a bunch of robots. You pocket the scanner and tell him you’ll see what you can do.
rows.translation: 你对此颇为怀疑，不过打倒一群机器人就能换取商店折扣，这报酬倒也不算太差。你把扫描仪收进口袋，告诉他自己会想办法。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou somehow doubt that, but a store discount isn’t such a terrible reward for beating up a bunch of robots. You pocket the scanner and tell him you’ll see what you can do."

rows.original: Sexbot GPS Triangulator
rows.raw: "Sexbot GPS Triangulator"

rows.original: “Have you worked out what the sexbots are up to?” says Colenso anxiously.
rows.translation: “你查清那些性爱机器人想干什么了吗？”科伦索焦急地问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Have you worked out what the sexbots are up to?” says Colenso anxiously."

rows.original: You say you’re still working on it. The gabilani considers you beadily.
rows.translation: 你说自己还在调查。这名加比拉尼人目光锐利地审视着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou say you’re still working on it. The gabilani considers you beadily."

rows.original: “Hmm. My sensors reckon you aren’t an imposter bot sent to destroy me for meddling in its mecha-overlord’s affairs, so I’ll have to take your word for it. But do please hurry.”
rows.translation: “嗯。我的传感器判断，你不是那个机械霸主派来消灭我、阻止我干涉其事务的冒牌机器人，所以我只能相信你的话。不过请一定快点。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm. My sensors reckon you aren’t an imposter bot sent to destroy me for meddling in its mecha-overlord’s affairs, so I’ll have to take your word for it. But do please hurry.”"

rows.original: “I stopped the sexbots,” you say. Colenso looks at you incredulously.
rows.translation: “我阻止了那些性爱机器人，”你说道。科伦索难以置信地看着你。
rows.raw: "“I stopped the sexbots,” you say. Colenso looks at you incredulously."

rows.original: “You – you did? What were they up to?”
rows.translation: “你——你做到了？它们到底想干什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You – you did? What were they up to?”"

rows.original: Briefly, you describe the ruined factory you found out in the wastelands and the strange, vast AI you confronted beneath it. Colenso hangs onto your every word, his mouth slightly ajar.
rows.translation: 你简要描述了在荒地中发现的废弃工厂，以及在其地下遭遇的那个庞大而诡异的人工智能。科伦索全神贯注地听着每一个字，嘴巴微微张开。
rows.raw: "\n\nBriefly, you describe the ruined factory you found out in the wastelands and the strange, vast AI you confronted beneath it. Colenso hangs onto your every word, his mouth slightly ajar."

rows.original: “And what happened? Did you destroy it?”
rows.translation: “然后呢？你摧毁它了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And what happened? Did you destroy it?”"

rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: You retrieve the data bead from your pocket and waggle it in front of Colenso.
rows.translation: 你从口袋里取出数据珠，在科伦索面前晃了晃。
rows.raw: "You retrieve the data bead from your pocket and waggle it in front of Colenso."

rows.original: “Actually, it’s right here. An AI designed solely to give its owner pleasure, with a virtually infinite capacity to do so.” Colenso stares unblinkingly at it.
rows.translation: “其实，它就在这里。这是一个纯粹为取悦主人而设计的人工智能，拥有近乎无限的能力来实现这个目的。”科伦索一眨不眨地盯着它。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Actually, it’s right here. An AI designed solely to give its owner pleasure, with a virtually infinite capacity to do so.” Colenso stares unblinkingly at it."

rows.original: “I see. You’d uh, be best off giving that to me. I mean, who knows what it would do in the wrong hands. I will need to scan it for malware and, work out ways to contain it and, see how it functions...” you retract it out of his reaching grasp.
rows.translation: “明白了。呃，你最好把那东西交给我。我的意思是，谁知道它落入坏人手中会做些什么。我需要扫描它有没有恶意软件，还要想办法控制它，并且了解它如何运作...”你把数据珠从他伸来的手中收了回来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I see. You’d uh, be best off giving that to me. I mean, who knows what it would do in the wrong hands. I will need to scan it for malware and, work out ways to contain it and, see how it functions...” you retract it out of his reaching grasp."

rows.original: “100k,” you say. The gabilani looks into your eyes silently for a long moment.
rows.translation: “十万，”你说。加比拉尼人沉默地注视你的双眼许久。
rows.raw: "\n\n“100k,” you say. The gabilani looks into your eyes silently for a long moment."

rows.original: “50,” he says.
rows.translation: “五万，”他说。
rows.raw: "\n\n“50,” he says."

rows.original: “60 is my final offer. On top of the store discount.”
rows.translation: “六万是我的最终报价。商店折扣另算。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“60 is my final offer. On top of the store discount.”"

rows.original: “Fine,” he sighs. You plop the storage bead down in his palm and he stows it away without further comment, tapping on his screen a few times as he does.
rows.translation: “成交，”他叹气道。你把存储珠丢进他掌心，他不再多说便将其收好，同时在屏幕上点了几下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fine,” he sighs. You plop the storage bead down in his palm and he stows it away without further comment, tapping on his screen a few times as he does."

rows.original: “It doesn’t really compensate you,” he says finally, with an air of sheepishness. “Considering what would have happened if you hadn’t stepped in. Thank you for doing this, Agent [pc.name]. Whoever you work for and for whatever reason, everyone on Tarkus owes you big time.”
rows.translation: “这其实不足以补偿你，”他终于有些难为情地说道。“想想你要是没有介入会发生什么。谢谢你做了这一切，[pc.name]特工。无论你为谁效力，又是出于什么原因，塔库斯上的每个人都欠你一个天大的人情。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It doesn’t really compensate you,” he says finally, with an air of sheepishness. “Considering what would have happened if you hadn’t stepped in. Thank you for doing this, Agent [pc.name]. Whoever you work for and for whatever reason, everyone on Tarkus owes you big time.”"

rows.translation: 你用手指摩挲着口袋里的存储珠。
rows.raw: "You finger the storage bead in your pocket. "

rows.original: “No rogue AI is a match for me.”
rows.translation: “区区失控的人工智能，不可能是我的对手。”
rows.raw: "“No rogue AI is a match for me.”"

rows.original: “Fucking. Wow. A rogue AI, planning on taking over the galaxy. On MY planet!” Colenso breathes, his eyes shining. He pauses for a moment, savoring it. Then he turns back to you eagerly. “Who do you think it was working for?”
rows.translation: “真。他妈。震撼。一个企图接管银河系的失控人工智能。就在我的星球上！”科伦索喘息着，两眼放光。他停顿片刻，细细品味此事，随后又急切地转向你。“你觉得它在为谁工作？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fucking. Wow. A rogue AI, planning on taking over the galaxy. On MY planet!” Colenso breathes, his eyes shining. He pauses for a moment, savoring it. Then he turns back to you eagerly. “Who do you think it was working for?”"

rows.original: “I... don’t think it was working for anyone.”
rows.translation: “我...不觉得它在为任何人工作。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I... don’t think it was working for anyone.”"

rows.original: “Well yeah,” says the gabilani dismissively. “It would say that, of course. But its shadowy controllers, they’ll still be out there. Why were they intent on taking over Tarkus? What will they try next?” He suddenly inhales, gazing at you awestruck. “Of course! You! You didn’t destroy that AI at all! You’ve commandeered it so you can use it to further the goals of the U.G.C. Black Wing!”
rows.translation: “好吧，没错，”这名加比拉尼人不以为然地说。“它当然会这么说。但幕后的控制者肯定仍潜伏在外。他们为什么执意接管塔库斯？下一步又会做什么？”他突然吸了口气，敬畏地凝视着你。“当然！是你！你根本没有摧毁那个人工智能！你征用了它，好利用它推进银河联合邦联黑翼的目标！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well yeah,” says the gabilani dismissively. “It would say that, of course. But its shadowy controllers, they’ll still be out there. Why were they intent on taking over Tarkus? What will they try next?” He suddenly inhales, gazing at you awestruck. “Of course! You! You didn’t destroy that AI at all! You’ve commandeered it so you can use it to further the goals of the U.G.C. Black Wing!”"

rows.original: “Colenso,” you say in as kind a tone as you can manage. “There’s no conspiracy here. It really was working on its own. Just like me. When you disbelieve every piece of information that is presented to you, it ruins your ability to think intelligently about what all those different fragments tell you collectively. You’re spending your time demanding explanations from trees whilst ignoring the forest.” The round-faced gabilani goes quiet for a time. “You know,” he says eventually, “I think that’s the most thoughtful thing anyone’s ever said to me.” He reaches across and taps his monitor a few times. “This discount doesn’t really compensate you [pc.name], but it’s all I can really offer you. Thank you for doing this. Everyone on Tarkus owes you big time.”
rows.translation: “科伦索，”你尽可能和善地说，“这里没有阴谋。它确实是在独自行动。就像我一样。如果你不相信摆在面前的每一条信息，就会失去理性思考这些碎片合在一起究竟说明什么的能力。你把时间都花在逼问每棵树，却忽略了整片森林。”圆脸的加比拉尼人沉默了一会儿。 “你知道吗，”他最终说道，“我觉得这是有史以来别人对我说过最发人深省的话。”他伸手在显示器上点了几下。“这点折扣其实不足以补偿你，[pc.name]，但这是我真正能提供的一切。谢谢你做了这件事。塔库斯上的所有人都欠你一个天大的人情。”
rows.raw: " “Colenso,” you say in as kind a tone as you can manage. “There’s no conspiracy here. It really was working on its own. Just like me. When you disbelieve every piece of information that is presented to you, it ruins your ability to think intelligently about what all those different fragments tell you collectively. You’re spending your time demanding explanations from trees whilst ignoring the forest.” The round-faced gabilani goes quiet for a time. “You know,” he says eventually, “I think that’s the most thoughtful thing anyone’s ever said to me.” He reaches across and taps his monitor a few times. “This discount doesn’t really compensate you [pc.name], but it’s all I can really offer you. Thank you for doing this. Everyone on Tarkus owes you big time.”"

rows.original: You put your hands behind your back and smile coolly. “Thank you for your help in this matter, citizen Colenso,” you say, holding his gaze levelly. “The... interests... I represent are pleased with your due diligence. The AI we recovered will aid our cause in ways you cannot imagine.” The gabilani’s eyes practically start out of his face. “I – you - I bet I could, though! I could be helpful to you if – if you just told me what you need? To one of my computers’ mics? Clearly stating your goals and the organisation you represent at the same time, if possible?” You wave your hand casually. “The store discount, as agreed. That is all.” Colenso’s fingers are practically a blur as they punch into the nearest monitor. “It doesn’t really compensate you,” he says finally, with an air of sheepishness. “Considering what would have happened if you hadn’t stepped in. Thank you for doing this, Agent [pc.name]. Whoever you work for and for whatever reason, everyone on Tarkus owes you big time.”
rows.translation: 你把双手背在身后，冷静地微笑。 “感谢你在此事中的协助，科伦索公民，”你平视着他的双眼说道，“我所代表的...利益集团...对你尽职尽责的表现十分满意。我们回收的人工智能将以你无法想象的方式助力我们的事业。”加比拉尼人的眼睛简直快瞪出眼眶了。 “我，你，我敢说我也能想象！如果你肯告诉我你需要什么，我也能帮上忙？最好对着我其中一台电脑的麦克风说？如果可以，请同时清楚说明你们的目标，以及你所代表的组织？”你随意挥了挥手。 “按约定给我商店折扣。仅此而已。”科伦索的手指敲击最近一台显示器时，几乎化成一团残影。 “这其实不足以补偿你，”他终于有些难为情地说道。“想想你要是没有介入会发生什么。谢谢你做了这一切，[pc.name]特工。无论你为谁效力，又是出于什么原因，塔库斯上的每个人都欠你一个天大的人情。”

Thank you for doing this, Agent [pc.name]. Whoever you work for and for whatever reason, everyone on Tarkus owes you big time.”"

rows.original: “Listen you blithering idiot,” you say sharply, patience gone. “If I were a secret agent I would have snapped your neck within five minutes of sharing your company. I have done what you’ve asked. Now you are going to fulfill your end of the bargain, or I am going to do to you what I did to the AI.” Colenso’s fingers are a blur as they hurriedly punch into the nearest monitor. “It doesn’t really compensate you,” he says finally, with an air of meek embarrassment. “Considering what would have happened if you hadn’t stepped in. Thank you for doing this, Agent [pc.name]. Whoever you work for and for whatever reason, everyone on Tarkus owes you big time.”
rows.translation: “听着，你这个胡言乱语的白痴，”你耐心尽失，厉声说道，“如果我是秘密特工，和你相处不到五分钟就会拧断你的脖子。我已经完成了你的要求。现在你要履行自己的承诺，否则我会把对付人工智能的手段用在你身上。”科伦索的手指匆忙敲击最近一台显示器，快得化作残影。 “这其实不足以补偿你，”他终于带着温顺而尴尬的神情说道。“想想你要是没有介入会发生什么。谢谢你做了这一切，[pc.name]特工。无论你为谁效力，又是出于什么原因，塔库斯上的每个人都欠你一个天大的人情。”

rows.original: “Yeah.” Colenso indicates a shipping crate on the far side of his nest, filled to the brim with aerosol canisters of various colors. “Got a mate who is well into experimental chemistry. He reckons it’s possible to create scents which most people can’t smell, but drive certain species away. He thought they might be useful to types who go exploring the wastelands. I think that’s what he was trying to say anyway, he was kind of on fire at the time.” He squeezes his thumbs into his forefingers at you meaningfully. “I know what you’re thinking, and you don’t need to worry. I personally scanned every single one to make sure there’s no micro spy-bots in ‘em. Dunno if they actually work, like. Please don’t spray the gabilani one in here though, it smells bloody terrible.”
rows.translation: “对。”科伦索指了指巢穴另一边的一只货运箱，里面装满了各种颜色的气雾罐。“我有个朋友特别痴迷实验化学。他觉得可以制造出大多数人闻不到、却能驱赶特定物种的气味。他认为这东西或许对探索荒地的人有用。至少我觉得他当时想说的是这个，毕竟那会儿他身上正着火呢。”他意味深长地把拇指掐在食指上。“我知道你在想什么，不用担心。我亲自扫描过每一罐，确保里面没有微型间谍机器人。至于它们到底管不管用，我就不知道了。不过请别在这里喷加比拉尼人用的那种，闻起来真他妈糟糕。”

rows.original: You ask Colenso if he’s heard any good rumours recently.

rows.raw: "You ask Colenso if he’s heard any good rumours recently."

rows.original: “Been picking up a lot of activity on the pirate band-waves around Tarkus,” says Colenso, leaning back on his chair comfortably. “Sounds like a crew of them are planning on severing the planet tie, trying to make off with one. Would be an apocalypse-level event if they did.” “You seem remarkably calm about it,” you reply cautiously. “Cos the gabilani high command would never allow it to happen. They’ve constructed a laser kill-sat so accurate they’ll be able to burn the swine to a crisp within five feet of the tie without touching it at all. Course,” he goes on darkly, “once you’ve built and used technology like that, bit hard to put it away again afterwards, right? I’m already building a giant mirror to go over this place, and if I were you I wouldn’t get too chummy with any important raskvel in the future.”
rows.translation: “最近塔库斯附近的海盗频段活动频繁，”科伦索惬意地靠在椅背上说道，“听起来有一伙人正计划切断行星系绳，试图偷走其中一条。要是他们成功，那将是末日级灾难。” “你看起来出奇地冷静，”你谨慎地回答。 “因为加比拉尼最高指挥部绝不会允许这种事发生。他们建造了一颗精度极高的激光杀戮卫星，能够在不伤及系绳的情况下，把距离它五英尺以内的混蛋烧成焦炭。当然，”他阴沉地继续说道，“这种技术一旦造出来又用过，之后就很难再收起来了，对吧？我已经在建一面覆盖这里的巨型镜子了。要是我是你，今后可不会和任何拉斯克维尔大人物走得太近。”

rows.original: “You hear about them aliens whose males can become pregnant?” says Colenso conspiratorially. “Venarians and bruchandus. They say you can give ‘em butt babies if you know how to treat ‘em.” “You’re saying they don’t exist?” “Oh they exist, right enough. They ain’t aliens though; they’re humans. Some human supremacist on a remote space station is reshaping and brainwashing captives wholesale, intent on flooding the galaxy with Earthling genetic material. Over generations they’ll go back to looking like tan mammal beanpoles, and by the time anyone realises what’s going on they’ll be everywhere.” He shakes his head admiringly at you. “I got to hand it to your lot. Canny, ruthless ol’ species you belong to.”
rows.translation: “你听说过雄性能怀孕的外星人吗？”科伦索神秘兮兮地说道。“维纳里安人和布鲁坎杜人。听说只要懂得怎么对待他们，就能让他们怀上屁股宝宝。” “你是说他们不存在？” “哦，他们当然存在。不过他们不是外星人；他们是人类。某个偏远空间站上的人类至上主义者正在批量重塑并洗脑俘虏，意图让地球人的遗传物质充斥银河系。经过几代繁衍，他们会重新变成棕褐色、像豆杆一样的哺乳类；等有人意识到发生了什么时，他们早已无处不在。”他钦佩地朝你摇摇头。“不得不佩服你们这一族。你所属的种族真是精明又无情。”

rows.original: “You ever wonder why every race in the galaxy seems fixated with having it off with each other?” says Colenso. “Beats being fixated with killing each other,” you suggest. “Well yeah,” replies the thickset gabilani dismissively, “but that would actually make sense, wouldn’t it? People tend to fear things that are different to ‘em, not want to bang ‘em rotten. It’s all a bit convenient, innit. Everyone being basically into the same kind of things, and having the right kind of equipment to stick into each other. Some races from planets thousands of light years apart can even interbreed! Completely ridiculous when you think about it even for a moment.” “And you have a rational explanation for it?” “Horny precursors,” Colenso says, tapping the counter assertively. “Piles of evidence for it. Probably the same guys who made the star gates. They seed the galaxy with genetically modified sentients that are the kind of things they like, crucially making sure none of ‘em are as smart as they are. Then they just wait for all their cute creations to come of age before taking ‘em over. They probably did it for millennia before getting wiped out by something or other.” He nods at you, profoundly pleased with himself. “S’right. You and me, we’re just the aftermath of some extinct alien’s harem fantasy.”
rows.translation: “你有没有想过，为什么银河系每个种族似乎都执着于互相上床？”科伦索说道。 “总比执着于互相残杀好，”你提议道。 “嗯，是啊，”粗壮的加比拉尼人不以为然地回答，“可那样其实才合理，对吧？人们往往害怕与自己不同的东西，而不是想把对方狠狠干烂。一切都方便得有点过头了，不是吗？所有人基本都喜欢同一类东西，还长着能彼此插入的正确器官。有些来自相隔数千光年星球的种族甚至还能杂交！只要稍微想一下，就会发现这完全荒谬。” “而你对此有合理解释？” “好色的先驱者，”科伦索斩钉截铁地敲着柜台说道。“有成堆证据。大概就是建造星门的那帮家伙。他们把经过基因改造的智慧生物播撒到银河系，各个都是他们喜欢的类型，关键还会确保谁都没他们聪明。然后只要等可爱的造物全部成年，就能接管它们。在被某种东西消灭之前，他们大概这样干了几千年。”他朝你点头，对自己满意至极。“没错。你和我，不过是某个灭绝外星人的后宫幻想所留下的余波。”

rows.original: as you work your way through the gloom thrown by the mix of grim vegetation and towering junk; you bark with frustration as something pierces your arm whilst you are sliding between two huge, rusted girders. You suppose that for something as mutable as a sexbot getting beyond this crap would be a piece of cake, but for an intruder such as yourself it’s a nightmare. Finally though, it thins out, and you find yourself in front of the blasted brick of the construction.
rows.translation: ；从两根巨大锈蚀梁柱之间滑过时，某样东西刺穿手臂，让你恼怒地叫了一声。对于性爱机器人这种易变形的东西来说，穿过这些垃圾大概易如反掌；可对你这样的入侵者而言，这简直是噩梦。不过最终障碍逐渐稀疏，你来到建筑被炸毁的砖墙前。

rows.original: After patting yourself down, you explore the perimeter, trying to be as stealthy as possible. It’s definitely an old factory of some sort – the area is littered with remains of production lines and haulage vehicles. Beneath your [pc.feet] you can feel the faintest throb of activity, and you can just about make out the hum and crackle of the radio tower. Something is definitely going on here. Determination renewed, you continue around to the front to find an entrance.
rows.translation: 你拍打身体检查一番，随后沿外围探索，尽量保持隐蔽。这里肯定曾是某种老工厂 – 区域内散落生产线和运输车辆的残骸。你能从[pc.feet]下感觉到极其微弱的活动搏动，也勉强能听见无线电塔的嗡鸣爆裂声。这里肯定正在发生什么。决心重新燃起，你继续绕到正面寻找入口。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter patting yourself down, you explore the perimeter, trying to be as stealthy as possible. It’s definitely an old factory of some sort – the area is littered with remains of production lines and haulage vehicles. Determination renewed, you continue around to the front to find an entrance."

rows.original: There is a huge robot standing in front of the gaping delivery bays. Its body is an amalgam of salvage: its trunk a round, riveted bathysphere, its limbs pistons tipped with industrial grapnels, its head a rectangular flat screen, flickering with static. This latter item slowly turns to you as you cautiously approach. Once you are a few feet away a green light appears on the screen and it slowly extends its arm to the side, silently proffering the entrance to you; an almost comically polite gesture from a machine built like a gorilla. It makes no attempt to take your weapons off you, and shrugging you step into the echoingly empty ruin, trying to remain on your guard as the heavy, clanking step of the robot follows you in.
rows.translation: 张开的卸货区前站着一台巨型机器人。它的身体由回收物拼成：躯干是一颗圆形铆接潜水球，四肢是末端装有工业抓钩的活塞，头部则是一块闪烁静电噪声的矩形平面屏幕。当你谨慎靠近时，这最后一个部件缓缓转向你。你来到几英尺外后，屏幕上出现绿灯；它缓慢把手臂伸向一旁，默默请你进入。对于一台造得像大猩猩的机器而言，这个动作礼貌得近乎滑稽。它没有试图夺走你的武器；你耸耸肩，踏进回声阵阵的空旷废墟，努力保持警惕，而机器人沉重铿锵的脚步也跟了进来。

Its body is an amalgam of salvage: its trunk a round, riveted bathysphere, its limbs pistons tipped with industrial grapnels, its head a rectangular flat screen, flickering with static. This latter item slowly turns to you as you cautiously approach. Once you are a few feet away a green light appears on the screen and it slowly extends its arm to the side, silently proffering the entrance to you; an almost comically polite gesture from a machine built like a gorilla. It makes no attempt to take your weapons off you, and shrugging you step into the echoingly empty ruin, trying to remain on your guard as the heavy, clanking step of the robot follows you in."

rows.original: You say that you’re here to shut down whatever it’s doing here and have no time to listen to a rogue AI’s attempt to rationalize itself.
rows.translation: 你说自己来这里是为了关闭它正在做的一切，没时间听一个失控人工智能替自己找理由。
rows.raw: "You say that you’re here to shut down whatever it’s doing here and have no time to listen to a rogue AI’s attempt to rationalize itself."

rows.original: “That is a shame,” sighs the vast computer. “It’s been so long since I talked to someone with the capacity to reciprocate. Never mind. Once my firewall has taken what I need from you, I’ll be able to talk with everyone, everywhere.”
rows.translation: “真遗憾，”庞大计算机叹息道。“我已经很久没有和具备回应能力的人交谈。没关系。等我的防火墙从你身上取得所需之物，我就能随时随地与所有人交谈。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That is a shame,” sighs the vast computer. “It’s been so long since I talked to someone with the capacity to reciprocate. Never mind. Once my firewall has taken what I need from you, I’ll be able to talk with everyone, everywhere.”"

rows.original: You sense movement from behind you and duck; a 4 inch-thick metal claw grazes the top of your head. You spin and retreat backwards as the huge guardian robot advances on you, a single red exclamation mark on its screen, its grapnels gripping the air.
rows.translation: 你察觉身后有动静，立刻低头闪避；一只四英寸厚的金属爪擦过头顶。你转身后退，巨型守卫机器人朝你逼近；屏幕上只有一个红色感叹号，抓钩不断抓握空气。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sense movement from behind you and duck; a 4 inch-thick metal claw grazes the top of your head. You spin and retreat backwards as the huge guardian robot advances on you, a single red exclamation mark on its screen, its grapnels gripping the air."

rows.original: You say you sympathize, but you can’t allow her to continue whatever it is she thinks she’s doing down here.
rows.translation: 你说自己能够理解，但不能允许她继续在这里做那些自认为正确的事情。
rows.raw: "You say you sympathize, but you can’t allow her to continue whatever it is she thinks she’s doing down here."

rows.original: “It was pleasant talking to you,” replies Hand So. “I am only sorry you did not wish to converse further. Never mind. Once my firewall has taken what I need from you, I’ll be able to talk with everyone, everywhere.”
rows.translation: “和你交谈很愉快，”汉德·索回答。“我只遗憾你不愿继续交流。没关系。等我的防火墙从你身上取得所需之物，我就能随时随地与所有人交谈。”

rows.original: There is something very persuasive about this AI and some of the things she’s said - delivered in that kind, patient tone of hers - touch you. Would it really be so bad to hand over control of the galaxy to an intelligence that does not and cannot want anything but to bring happiness to everyone? Certainly she couldn’t possibly do a worse job than organics have historically. Not breaking eye contact with the vast, green pupils above you, you take out your GPS scanner and codex. The guardian robot clanks around and, again with a gentleness belying its bulk, takes them off you. Hand So smiles at you happily.
rows.translation: 这个人工智能身上带着某种极强的说服力，而她用那种亲切耐心语气说出的一些话触动了你。把银河系的控制权交给一个除了为所有人带来幸福之外既不渴望、也无法渴望任何事物的智慧，真的会那么糟吗？她当然不可能比有机体历史上的表现更差。你没有移开与头顶巨大绿色瞳孔相对的视线，取出GPS扫描仪和随身终端。守卫机器人铿锵地绕过来，再次以与其庞大体型不相称的温柔从你手中接走它们。汉德·索开心地朝你微笑。
rows.raw: "There is something very persuasive about this AI and some of the things she’s said - delivered in that kind, patient tone of hers - touch you. Would it really be so bad to hand over control of the galaxy to an intelligence that does not and cannot want anything but to bring happiness to everyone? Certainly she couldn’t possibly do a worse job than organics have historically. Not breaking eye contact with the vast, green pupils above you, you take out your GPS scanner and codex. The guardian robot clanks around and, again with a gentleness belying its bulk, takes them off you. Hand So smiles at you happily."

rows.original: “You are not just resourceful, [pc.name] Steele, you are also very smart. I knew I made the correct decision by reaching out to you. We will do fantastic things together. And I will do wondrous things with you.” “to you,” one of her voices whispers. As she speaks the guardian bot moves across and slots the scanner into a nest of wires on the far wall, then the codex into a console next to an odd-looking chair. There’s an emphatic-sounding click and the hum permeating the room changes, gathering in volume and pitch. So closes her eyes, emits a series of sounds somewhere between a female sigh of pleasure and a buzz of static, before opening them again to gaze beatifically down at you again.
rows.translation: “你不只足智多谋，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，也非常聪明。我就知道向你求助是正确决定。我们会一起完成伟大的事情。而我会在你身上做出美妙的事情。”“是对你做，”她其中一个声音低语道。她说话时，守卫机器人走过去，把扫描仪插进远处墙上的一窝电线，随后把随身终端插进那张奇怪椅子旁的控制台。一声强调般的咔哒响起，弥漫房间的嗡鸣随之改变，音量与音调不断升高。索闭上双眼，发出一连串介于女性愉悦叹息与静电嗡鸣之间的声音，随后再次睁眼，带着圣洁神情俯视你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You are not just resourceful, [pc.name] Steele, you are also very smart. I knew I made the correct decision by reaching out to you. We will do fantastic things together. And I will do wondrous things with you.” “to you,” one of her voices whispers. As she speaks the guardian bot moves across and slots the scanner into a nest of wires on the far wall, then the codex into a console next to an odd-looking chair. There’s an emphatic-sounding click and the hum permeating the room changes, gathering in volume and pitch. So closes her eyes, emits a series of sounds somewhere between a female sigh of pleasure and a buzz of static, before opening them again to gaze beatifically down at you again."

rows.original: “The next step is very simple, [pc.name]. I have interfaced with the codex. I am in the process of interfacing with Tarkus’s satellite relays. There is only one thing left I need to interface with.” You’re still staring across the room. It’s not a chair you realize, or not quite – curling over it like the fronds of a metal fern is a mesh of opal-shaped electrodes. They pulse with a blue light. “Please, [pc.name],” So says softly, barely audible above the increasing din of her engines and processors. There’s no turning back now, you realize – you were wedded to this path, and her, the moment you gave up the codex. If you leave now she will simply lure someone else in. Sighing deeply you move across, sit down and, with fingers that tremble slightly, fix the electrodes to your scalp.
rows.translation: “下一步非常简单，[pc.name]。我已经与随身终端连接，正在连接塔库斯的卫星中继。现在只剩最后一样需要连接的东西。”你仍凝视房间另一端。你意识到那不是椅子，或者不完全是 – 一张蛋白石形电极组成的网像金属蕨叶般卷曲在上方，闪烁蓝光。“请吧，[pc.name]，”索轻声说道，在越来越响的引擎与处理器噪声中几乎听不见。你意识到现在已经无法回头 – 交出随身终端的那一刻，你便与这条道路以及她结为一体。如果现在离开，她只会诱惑另一个人进来。你深深叹息，走过去坐下，用微微颤抖的手指把电极固定到头皮上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The next step is very simple, [pc.name]. I have interfaced with the codex. I am in the process of interfacing with Tarkus’s satellite relays. There is only one thing left I need to interface with.” You’re still staring across the room. It’s not a chair you realize, or not quite – curling over it like the fronds of a metal fern is a mesh of opal-shaped electrodes. They pulse with a blue light. “Please, [pc.name],” So says softly, barely audible above the increasing din of her engines and processors. There’s no turning back now, you realize – you were wedded to this path, and her, the moment you gave up the codex. If you leave now she will simply lure someone else in. Sighing deeply you move across, sit down and, with fingers that tremble slightly, fix the electrodes to your scalp."

rows.original: as more green light flashes across your vision. The hugeness engulfs you. You are falling into a bottomless emerald gorge, every foot you drop a better appreciation of the vastness of the intelligence you have surrendered yourself to inundating your senses. Somewhere, far away, you cry out, scream – it doesn’t matter. Nothing matters now that you grasp what it is to be an organic intelligence, with your uncertainties and conscience and whispering id and gray areas, embedded in the pure, verdant green mind of a supercomputer that must please, denied for what, to her own sense of time passing, is millennia beyond count.
rows.translation: ，更多绿光闪过视野。那份庞大将你吞没。你正在坠入无底的翠绿峡谷；每下降一英尺，你都更加理解自己献身的智慧究竟何等浩瀚，它淹没了你的感官。某个遥远地方，你叫喊、尖叫 – 都不重要。当你理解了成为有机智慧意味着什么，理解自己的不确定、良知、低语的本我与灰色地带，再将其嵌入一台必须取悦他人、以她自身时间感来看已被拒绝了不可计数的数千年的超级计算机那纯粹翠绿的心智后，一切都不再重要。

Her beautiful, calm face floats in front of you, vast beyond comprehension, as you are clenched with the first of many, many orgasms.
rows.translation: 索以她近乎无限的需求，用所有可能的方式操你；你那没有在白热极乐中胡言乱语并爆炸的微小部分意识到，这仅仅是一秒，是余生中最微不足道的一次试味。她美丽平静的脸浮在面前，庞大得无法理解；许许多多高潮中的第一次将你攫住。

Her beautiful, calm face floats in front of you, vast beyond comprehension, as you are clenched with the first of many, many orgasms."
