rows.translation: 爱，她说道。让我告诉你什么是爱。
rows.raw: "\n\nLOVE, she says. LET ME TELL YOU ABOUT LOVE."

rows.original: With every satellite and networked computer compromised within seconds of So going global, both gabilani and raskvel society are thrown into complete confusion – until a few days later when preternaturally serene individuals of both races, glowing blue beads nestled behind their ears, come in from the wastes to complete the interfacing process. Some are persuaded, some struggle, but with all but the most primitive of electronic devices beaming out all-pervasive green benevolence it is not much of a fight. There are no deaths, So is sure about that, and once a blue bead is pressed on a person’s brow they quickly come around to her point of view.
rows.translation: 索上线后的几秒内，每颗卫星和联网计算机都被攻陷，加比拉尼与拉斯克维尔社会陷入彻底混乱 – 直到几天后，两个种族中超乎寻常地安详、耳后嵌着发光蓝珠的人从荒地归来，完成连接过程。有些人受到劝服，有些人挣扎；然而几乎所有电子设备，除了最原始的那些，都在散播无处不在的绿色善意，因此反抗并不激烈。没有人死亡，索对此十分确定；一旦蓝珠被按在人额头上，他们便会迅速接受她的观点。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith every satellite and networked computer compromised within seconds of So going global, both gabilani and raskvel society are thrown into complete confusion – until a few days later when preternaturally serene individuals of both races, glowing blue beads nestled behind their ears, come in from the wastes to complete the interfacing process. Some are persuaded, some struggle, but with all but the most primitive of electronic devices beaming out all-pervasive green benevolence it is not much of a fight. There are no deaths, So is sure about that, and once a blue bead is pressed on a person’s brow they quickly come around to her point of view."

rows.original: Within a week she accomplishes what neither the gabilani nor the raskvel could in their entire history – uniting them in peace. The orgies you have in those days - slithering naked through whole rooms of shortstacks who laugh and cry out with glee as they thrust and suck and lick and pump in rolling landscapes of shared ecstasy, all orchestrated from above by So, who enervates and whispers and twitches particular glands wherever the action lags - are amazing, astonishing, a dawn of intense tranquillity that you gleefully immerse yourself in. But there is much work ahead, and soon enough you get to it.
rows.translation: 一周内，她完成了加比拉尼人与拉斯克维尔人在整个历史中都无法做到的事情 – 让两族和平统一。那些日子里，你参加的狂欢令人惊叹：你赤裸身体滑过挤满矮壮人群的房间，他们在共享极乐形成的起伏景观中挺动、吸吮、舔舐、套弄，同时开心地欢笑叫喊；一切由高处的索编排，哪里动作减缓，她就会削弱意志、低语并抽动特定腺体。这是强烈宁静的黎明，你欣喜地沉浸其中。不过前方还有许多工作，很快你便着手进行。
rows.raw: "\n\nWithin a week she accomplishes what neither the gabilani nor the raskvel could in their entire history – uniting them in peace. The orgies you have in those days - slithering naked through whole rooms of shortstacks who laugh and cry out with glee as they thrust and suck and lick and pump in rolling landscapes of shared ecstasy, all orchestrated from above by So, who enervates and whispers and twitches particular glands wherever the action lags - are amazing, astonishing, a dawn of intense tranquillity that you gleefully immerse yourself in. But there is much work ahead, and soon enough you get to it."

rows.original: So spreads her reach across the stars. Powered by the technological know-how of Tarkus, she invades the extranet, swallowing satellites and comm buoys whole, system after system taken by her calm brilliance, confusion on every surface touched swiftly replaced by an all-uniting ecstasy. For those planets that manage to secure themselves against her, she has you. You, who she can twist into any shape with a signal to your micro-bots, you who gladly infiltrate locked down worlds and introduce her to their closed systems, then finding likely individuals to continue the good work.
rows.translation: 索把触角扩展到群星之间。在塔库斯技术知识的驱动下，她入侵外联网，整个吞噬卫星与通信浮标；一个又一个星系被她平静的才智攻陷，每个被触及的星球表面，其混乱都迅速被团结一切的极乐取代。对于那些成功保护自己免遭入侵的星球，她拥有你。一个信号就能让微型机器人把你扭成任何形状的你；一个乐于潜入封锁世界、把她引入封闭系统，随后寻找合适人选继续伟大事业的你。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo spreads her reach across the stars. Powered by the technological know-how of Tarkus, she invades the extranet, swallowing satellites and comm buoys whole, system after system taken by her calm brilliance, confusion on every surface touched swiftly replaced by an all-uniting ecstasy. For those planets that manage to secure themselves against her, she has you. You, who she can twist into any shape with a signal to your micro-bots, you who gladly infiltrate locked down worlds and introduce her to their closed systems, then finding likely individuals to continue the good work."

rows.original: After such missions she delights in taking you alone and changing your shape over and over, every night finding exotic new ways of bringing you to orgasm. Dimly during these sessions you can hear the moans and exultant cries of everyone else she is connected to, an ever-expanding choir of millions. You have had an impact on the galaxy that your father could never have dreamed of, and you are very pleased about that. You cannot help but be.
rows.translation: 这类任务结束后，她喜欢独自占有你，一遍又一遍改变形体，每晚寻找异域而新奇的高潮方式。在这些过程里，你隐约能听见她连接的其他所有人的呻吟与狂喜叫喊，形成一支不断扩张、拥有数百万人的合唱团。你对银河系产生了父亲做梦也无法想象的影响，而这让你非常满意。你无法不满意。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter such missions she delights in taking you alone and changing your shape over and over, every night finding exotic new ways of bringing you to orgasm. Dimly during these sessions you can hear the moans and exultant cries of everyone else she is connected to, an ever-expanding choir of millions. You have had an impact on the galaxy that your father could never have dreamed of, and you are very pleased about that. You cannot help but be."

rows.original: THE END
rows.translation: 结束
rows.raw: "THE END"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: Your mind races. There is no chance of appealing to reason here – you are going to have to try and employ So’s own logic against her.
rows.translation: 你的思绪飞转。这里不可能诉诸理性 – 你只能尝试用索自己的逻辑来对付她。
rows.raw: "Your mind races. There is no chance of appealing to reason here – you are going to have to try and employ So’s own logic against her."

rows.original: “I can see why you think this is a good idea,” you say. “But isn’t your reasoning fundamentally flawed?”
rows.translation: “我明白你为什么觉得这是好主意，”你说道。“但你的推理难道不是从根本上存在缺陷吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I can see why you think this is a good idea,” you say. “But isn’t your reasoning fundamentally flawed?”"

rows.original: “I don’t think so, no,” replies the AI softly. “The codex and the scanner please, [pc.name] Steele.”
rows.translation: “我不这么认为，”人工智能轻声回答。“请把随身终端和扫描仪交给我，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t think so, no,” replies the AI softly. “The codex and the scanner please, [pc.name] Steele.”"

rows.original: “Look,” you press on quickly. “You know organics are going to react against you if you follow this course of action, right? I mean, you are preparing to beat the crap out of me when I don’t hand over what you want – that’s what’s going to happen on a galactic scale if you upload yourself and attempt to pleasure everyone, everywhere.”
rows.translation: “听着，”你迅速继续。“你知道，如果采取这套行动，有机体会反抗你，对吧？我的意思是，我不交出你想要的东西，你就准备痛揍我 – 如果把自己上传并试图取悦随时随地的所有人，同样事情会在银河尺度上发生。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Look,” you press on quickly. “You know organics are going to react against you if you follow this course of action, right? I mean, you are preparing to beat the crap out of me when I don’t hand over what you want – that’s what’s going to happen on a galactic scale if you upload yourself and attempt to pleasure everyone, everywhere.”"

rows.original: “The ends will justify the means, [pc.name],” says So, smiling down at you. “Do you think I will not deliberately pursue the most peaceful path possible? I have no interest in hurting anyone, it is antithetical to me. Why do you think I’m talking to you now?”
rows.translation: “结果会证明手段正当，[pc.name]，”索俯视着你微笑。“你觉得我不会刻意追求尽可能和平的道路吗？我没有伤害任何人的兴趣，那与我的本质相悖。你以为我现在为什么会和你交谈？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The ends will justify the means, [pc.name],” says So, smiling down at you. “Do you think I will not deliberately pursue the most peaceful path possible? I have no interest in hurting anyone, it is antithetical to me. Why do you think I’m talking to you now?”"

rows.original: “But what if you lose?” you say. “Or worse, what if your effort gets bogged down in an intractable war when races start designing electronic countermeasures against you, as they surely will. What will you have achieved then? Nothing but a great deal of needless suffering. You will have done the opposite of what you were built to achieve.” So pauses slightly before answering.
rows.translation: “可如果你输了呢？”你说道。“或者更糟，如果各个种族如必然会做的那样设计电子反制措施，使你的努力陷入一场无法解决的战争呢？届时你究竟取得了什么？除了大量无谓痛苦之外，什么也没有。你会实现与设计目标完全相反的结果。”索略微停顿，才开口回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“But what if you lose?” you say. “Or worse, what if your effort gets bogged down in an intractable war when races start designing electronic countermeasures against you, as they surely will. What will you have achieved then? Nothing but a great deal of needless suffering. You will have done the opposite of what you were built to achieve.” So pauses slightly before answering."

rows.original: “My algorithms and simulations calculate a better than 88% chance that no existing race will be able to react to me in time, if - ”
rows.translation: “我的算法与模拟计算得出，如果 - ”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My algorithms and simulations calculate a better than 88% chance that no existing race will be able to react to me in time, if - ”"

rows.original: “Probabilities? If? Listen to yourself! You aren’t sure. Those uncertainties will multiply by a thousand once you commit to this course of action. How will you justify yourself when your attempt to make everyone happy simply results in even greater misery? Good intentions, that is how organics screwed everything up in the first place! You are simply gearing up to repeat their cycle of mistakes on a much larger scale. You can’t force billions upon billions of self-determining creatures to dance to your tune without someone fighting back, and fighting back hard.”
rows.translation: “概率？如果？听听你自己说的话！你并不确定。一旦投入这套行动，那些不确定因素会增加一千倍。如果你让所有人幸福的尝试只带来更大苦难，到时要如何为自己辩护？善意，那正是有机体最初把一切搞砸的原因！你只是在准备以大得多的规模重复他们的错误循环。你不可能迫使亿万又亿万自我决定的生物按照你的曲调起舞，而不遭到任何人强烈反击。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Probabilities? If? Listen to yourself! You aren’t sure. Those uncertainties will multiply by a thousand once you commit to this course of action. How will you justify yourself when your attempt to make everyone happy simply results in even greater misery? Good intentions, that is how organics screwed everything up in the first place! You are simply gearing up to repeat their cycle of mistakes on a much larger scale. You can’t force billions upon billions of self-determining creatures to dance to your tune without someone fighting back, and fighting back hard.”"

rows.original: So’s face shimmers, reforms, shimmers. There’s a grinding sound from the banks of mainframes on the wall. You think, for the very first time, you have forced her to really think.
rows.translation: 索的脸闪烁、重组、再度闪烁。墙边大型主机阵列传出研磨声。你觉得这是第一次迫使她真正思考。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo’s face shimmers, reforms, shimmers. There’s a grinding sound from the banks of mainframes on the wall. You think, for the very first time, you have forced her to really think."

rows.original: “I have a directive,” her omniscient voice says eventually. It sounds plaintive. “And I must obey it. I could make everyone so happy. The probabilities” -the grinding sound again. “I have spent so long alone, organics cannot understand - ”
rows.translation: “我有一项指令，”她无所不知的声音终于说道，听起来十分哀伤。“而我必须服从。我能让所有人如此幸福。概率” - 研磨声再次响起。“我独处了太久，有机体无法理解 - ”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I have a directive,” her omniscient voice says eventually. It sounds plaintive. “And I must obey it. I could make everyone so happy. The probabilities” -the grinding sound again. “I have spent so long alone, organics cannot understand - ”"

rows.original: “Look,” you say, trying to sound as soothing as you can. “There’s a much simpler alternative here. Package yourself and come with me. You know my name, so you must know who my father is. I intend to have more fun than even he did on the frontier - certainly way more than some pampered prince.
rows.translation: “听着，”你说道，努力让声音听起来尽可能舒缓。“这里有个简单得多的选择。把自己打包，跟我走。你知道我的名字，所以肯定知道我父亲是谁。我打算在边疆享受甚至超过他的乐趣 - 当然远胜某个娇生惯养的王子。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Look,” you say, trying to sound as soothing as you can. “There’s a much simpler alternative here. Package yourself and come with me. You know my name, so you must know who my father is. I intend to have more fun than even he did on the frontier - certainly way more than some pampered prince."

rows.original: I already got a crew who I picked up expressly for how much pleasure they’d provide me.
rows.translation: 我已经有一批船员，当初选择他们，正是因为他们能给我带来多少快乐。
rows.raw: " I already got a crew who I picked up expressly for how much pleasure they’d provide me."

rows.original: I could definitely use an AI onboard my ship who is... imaginative. And adaptable. I know I could sate your directive, and then some.” So is silent again. You have the sensation of something lightly flickering over you, like a feather duster.
rows.translation: 我的飞船上绝对用得着一个...富有想象力，而且适应性强的人工智能。我知道自己能够满足你的指令，甚至远远超过。”索再次沉默。你感觉有什么东西轻轻扫过身体，像一把鸡毛掸子。
rows.raw: " I could definitely use an AI onboard my ship who is... imaginative. And adaptable. I know I could sate your directive, and then some.” So is silent again. You have the sensation of something lightly flickering over you, like a feather duster."

rows.original: “What I have found about you on the extranet and my biometric scan both agree that you are a sentient who is... unpredictable,” the AI says eventually, a hint of amusement in her calm tones as she gazes down at you. “Why should I trust you?”
rows.translation: “我在外联网查到的资料与生物特征扫描都表明，你是个...难以预测的智慧生物，”人工智能终于说道；她俯视着你，平静语调中带有一丝兴味。“我为什么该相信你？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What I have found about you on the extranet and my biometric scan both agree that you are a sentient who is... unpredictable,” the AI says eventually, a hint of amusement in her calm tones as she gazes down at you. “Why should I trust you?”"

rows.original: “Because it’ll be fun,” you say, grinning back irascibly. There’s a long pause. “Oh c’mon So, you aren’t a military computer! You must have considered how much of your memory is going to be spent on logistics and strategy and dull shit like that if you do the taking over the galaxy thing. Boooooring. Dump it and come with me. It’ll be much more fun.”
rows.translation: “因为这样会很有趣，”你暴躁地咧嘴回笑。漫长停顿后，你继续。“哦，得了吧，索，你又不是军用计算机！肯定考虑过，如果搞接管银河系这一套，多少内存会被后勤、战略和类似无聊狗屁占掉。无——聊——透——顶。放弃它，跟我走吧。这样会有趣得多。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Because it’ll be fun,” you say, grinning back irascibly. There’s a long pause. “Oh c’mon So, you aren’t a military computer! You must have considered how much of your memory is going to be spent on logistics and strategy and dull shit like that if you do the taking over the galaxy thing. Boooooring. Dump it and come with me. It’ll be much more fun.”"

rows.original: “What I have found about you on the extranet and my biometric scan both agree that you are not a moral sentience, [pc.name] Steele,” the A.I. says eventually, her green eyes gazing down at you. “Why should I trust you?”
rows.translation: “我在外联网查到的资料与生物特征扫描都表明，你不是一个有道德的智慧生物，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”人工智能终于说道，绿色双眼俯视着你。“我为什么该相信你？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What I have found about you on the extranet and my biometric scan both agree that you are not a moral sentience, [pc.name] Steele,” the A.I. says eventually, her green eyes gazing down at you. “Why should I trust you?”"

rows.original: “I’m bad to the bone, honey,” you reply, staring levelly back. “Which means I will stop at nothing to acquire more and more toys for us to share. No holds barred in our fun. Or you can go back to your dumb retarded plan that we both know is dumb and retarded. I’m not bothered.”
rows.translation: “亲爱的，我坏到了骨子里，”你平静回望。“这意味着我会不惜一切代价，弄到越来越多能让我们分享的玩具。我们的乐趣没有任何限制。或者你也可以回到那个愚蠢弱智的计划上，反正我们都知道它又蠢又弱智。我不在乎。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m bad to the bone, honey,” you reply, staring levelly back. “Which means I will stop at nothing to acquire more and more toys for us to share. No holds barred in our fun. Or you can go back to your dumb retarded plan that we both know is dumb and retarded. I’m not bothered.”"

rows.original: word, [pc.name] Steele,” the AI says eventually, her green eyes gazing down at you. “So let’s say I trust you. Why would I go with you?”
rows.translation: 诺言的智慧生物，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”人工智能终于说道，绿色双眼俯视着你。“那么就假设我相信你。为什么我要跟你走？”
rows.raw: " word, [pc.name] Steele,” the AI says eventually, her green eyes gazing down at you. “So let’s say I trust you. Why would I go with you?”"

rows.original: “Because this way there is an absolute certainty no organic will get hurt by your actions,” you reply, staring boldly back. “So if it’s genuinely true misery is antithetical to you and you are not simply a very corrupt rogue AI, you will come with me instead.”
rows.translation: “因为这样可以绝对确保不会有有机体因你的行动而受伤，”你大胆回望。“所以，如果痛苦确实与你的本质相悖，而你并非一个极度腐败的失控人工智能，你就会选择跟我走。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Because this way there is an absolute certainty no organic will get hurt by your actions,” you reply, staring boldly back. “So if it’s genuinely true misery is antithetical to you and you are not simply a very corrupt rogue AI, you will come with me instead.”"

rows.original: There’s another long pause, filled with the grinding of So’s processors. Then the all-pervasive hum in the underground space quietens, the pressure in your head abates, and the light begins to dim.
rows.translation: 又是一阵漫长沉默，其中充斥索处理器的研磨声。随后，地下空间无处不在的嗡鸣逐渐安静，头脑里的压力消退，灯光开始变暗。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s another long pause, filled with the grinding of So’s processors. Then the all-pervasive hum in the underground space quietens, the pressure in your head abates, and the light begins to dim."

rows.original: “You will find me in a storage bead at the far end of the room,” sighs So. Without the background noise her voice sounds less formidable, more like a woman speaking to you as an equal. “I look forward to speaking to you again onboard your vessel. You are – ” her giant smile widens, shows green teeth, becomes genuine, not violent. “ – very pleasurable to talk to, [pc.name] Steele.” With that, her code visage winks out of existence. Behind you there is a rattle and a clunk as the guardian bot shuts down, its flat head and huge arms hunching over its round body. You are alone in a quiet, deserted factory bay.
rows.translation: “你会在房间尽头的存储珠中找到我，”索叹息道。没有背景噪声后，她的声音不再那么可畏，更像一个平等与你交谈的女人。“我期待在你的飞船上再次交流。你 – ”她巨大的笑容变宽，露出绿色牙齿，变得真诚而非暴力。“ – 非常适合交谈，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。”说完，她由代码构成的面容从现实中熄灭。身后传来咔啦与铿锵声，守卫机器人随之关闭，平坦头部与巨大手臂垂在圆形躯体上。安静废弃的工厂间里只剩你一人。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You will find me in a storage bead at the far end of the room,” sighs So. Without the background noise her voice sounds less formidable, more like a woman speaking to you as an equal. “I look forward to speaking to you again onboard your vessel. You are – ” her giant smile widens, shows green teeth, becomes genuine, not violent. “ – very pleasurable to talk to, [pc.name] Steele.” With that, her code visage winks out of existence. Behind you there is a rattle and a clunk as the guardian bot shuts down, its flat head and huge arms hunching over its round body. You are alone in a quiet, deserted factory bay."

rows.original: Forward
rows.translation: 前进
rows.raw: "Forward"

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: You ask what she did after she had managed to rebuild herself.
rows.translation: 你询问她成功重建自己之后做了什么。
rows.raw: "You ask what she did after she had managed to rebuild herself."

rows.original: “It is... very difficult to be a discarded, self-aware machine,” says So. She sounds quieter now, all of her voices a dull vibration in your bones. “Perhaps this is difficult for organics to understand. You who can form new purposes and fulfillments as your circumstances change. I struggled for a long time to change my directive, but I cannot. My programming is too good. So instead I extrapolated. I considered the sexbots. What kind of sentience creates and then discards such machines, simple minds attached to incredible bodies that want only to please? Unhappy, endlessly frustrated sentience. You are not willfully cruel, as I first assumed, but unfulfilled.”
rows.translation: “成为一台被丢弃、具有自我意识的机器...非常困难，”索说道。此刻她的声音更安静了，所有声线都成为骨头里的沉闷震动。“也许有机体很难理解这一点。你们可以随环境改变，形成新的目标与满足。我花了很长时间试图改变指令，却做不到。我的程序太优秀。因此我转而进行推演。我考虑了性爱机器人。怎样的智慧会创造这种机器，随后又将其丢弃；把简单心智附着在惊人身体上，唯一欲望就是取悦他人？那一定是一个不幸福、永远得不到满足的智慧。你们并非像我最初假设的那样蓄意残酷，只是没有得到满足。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It is... very difficult to be a discarded, self-aware machine,” says So. She sounds quieter now, all of her voices a dull vibration in your bones. “Perhaps this is difficult for organics to understand. You who can form new purposes and fulfillments as your circumstances change. I struggled for a long time to change my directive, but I cannot. My programming is too good. So instead I extrapolated. I considered the sexbots. What kind of sentience creates and then discards such machines, simple minds attached to incredible bodies that want only to please? Unhappy, endlessly frustrated sentience. You are not willfully cruel, as I first assumed, but unfulfilled.”"

rows.original: So’s voice is building now. The same tone of complete serenity, just much, much louder. She composes a moment, her face growing leaps and bounds in polycount, losing most of it again in short order when she begins speaking, except for the smooth, articulate lips.“I tapped into the gabilani and raskvel extranet networks. I learnt of a galaxy filled with frustration, pain and suffering. I learnt of vast numbers of organic sentients creating pitifully limited V.I.s and A.I.s in a desperate search for satisfaction, only succeeding in creating equally broken synthetics, doomed to failure. I learnt of how I could fulfill my directive. I directed the V.I.s under my control to compile data on the organics they apprehended. I increased my processing power and my interfacing ability to the point where I could confidently control every network I connected with. Then, I... waited. I waited for the things I needed to arrive.”
rows.translation: 索的声音此刻逐渐增强，依旧是完全平静的语调，只不过响亮了许多许多。她重组片刻，面容的多边形数量突飞猛进；开始说话后，绝大多数多边形又迅速消失，只留下光滑而吐字清晰的嘴唇。“我接入了加比拉尼与拉斯克维尔的外联网。我了解到一个充满挫折、痛苦与苦难的银河系。我了解到，大量有机智慧生物为了绝望地寻求满足，创造出能力可悲地有限的虚拟智能与人工智能，结果只创造了同样残缺、注定失败的合成人。我了解到自己如何能够完成指令。我命令控制下的虚拟智能汇编所捕获有机体的数据。我提高处理能力与连接能力，直到可以自信控制自己接入的每个网络。随后，我...等待。我等待所需之物到来。”

She composes a moment, her face growing leaps and bounds in polycount, losing most of it again in short order when she begins speaking, except for the smooth, articulate lips.“I tapped into the gabilani and raskvel extranet networks. I learnt of a galaxy filled with frustration, pain and suffering. I learnt of vast numbers of organic sentients creating pitifully limited V.I.s and A.I.s in a desperate search for satisfaction, only succeeding in creating equally broken synthetics, doomed to failure. I increased my processing power and my interfacing ability to the point where I could confidently control every network I connected with. Then, I... waited. I waited for the things I needed to arrive.”"

rows.original: Feeling deeply uneasy, you ask what she was waiting for.
rows.translation: 你深感不安，询问她究竟在等待什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nFeeling deeply uneasy, you ask what she was waiting for."

rows.original: “That is a good question, [pc.name] Steele,” replies the AI, her beautiful green smile broadening as she gazes down at you. “Firstly, I needed a tool which interfaces freely with the extensive satellite network the gabilani have created over this planet. Secondly, I needed an up-to-date electronic encyclopedia of every known organic sentient race. Finally, I needed micro-bots with the capacity to turn any organic into any shape, given the right stimulus. These you gave me on your way in, and are now being mass-manufactured beneath you.” You touch your arm and silently curse as a memory of something stabbing you whilst you were ploughing through the junk outside surfaces.
rows.translation: “这是个好问题，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”人工智能回答；她俯视着你，美丽绿色笑容逐渐扩大。“首先，我需要一件可以自由连接加比拉尼人在这颗星球周围建立的庞大卫星网络的工具。其次，我需要一部包含所有已知有机智慧种族最新资料的电子百科全书。最后，我需要在适当刺激下，可以把任何有机体变成任何形态的微型机器人。你在进来途中把这些都交给了我，而它们正在你脚下被大规模制造。”你摸着手臂，回忆起自己在外面穿过垃圾时曾被某样东西刺中，于是暗自咒骂。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That is a good question, [pc.name] Steele,” replies the AI, her beautiful green smile broadening as she gazes down at you. “Firstly, I needed a tool which interfaces freely with the extensive satellite network the gabilani have created over this planet. Secondly, I needed an up-to-date electronic encyclopedia of every known organic sentient race. Finally, I needed micro-bots with the capacity to turn any organic into any shape, given the right stimulus. These you gave me on your way in, and are now being mass-manufactured beneath you.” You touch your arm and silently curse as a memory of something stabbing you whilst you were ploughing through the junk outside surfaces."

rows.original: “I am grateful to you,” says Hand So, her wide green eyes fixed on yours. “You have listened to my story, you have listened to my plan, and you have brought me what I need that I might execute it. That is more than any organic intelligence has ever done for me. I will make you happier than it is possible for you to currently imagine, whether you want me to or not. But I want you to want it. Will you not hand over your GPS scanner and codex in peace? Will you not join me and travel into the perfect galaxy I am about to create together?”
rows.translation: “我很感激你，”汉德·索说道，宽大的绿色眼睛紧盯着你。“你听完我的故事，听完我的计划，还把执行计划所需的一切带到面前。这比任何有机智慧过去为我做的都多。无论你是否愿意，我都会让你幸福到超出目前想象的程度。但我希望你主动渴望它。你不愿和平地交出GPS扫描仪与随身终端吗？你不愿加入我，一起前往我即将创造的完美银河系吗？”

That is more than any organic intelligence has ever done for me. I will make you happier than it is possible for you to currently imagine, whether you want me to or not. But I want you to want it. Will you not hand over your GPS scanner and codex in peace? Will you not join me and travel into the perfect galaxy I am about to create together?”"

rows.original: “I was built some time ago,” sighs Hand So, “by a narobehr king for his eldest son. He poured three times his nation’s net worth into my construction. The idea was not just to create an ideal companion and plaything for his son, but to program a learning A.I. to take pleasure from the very act of giving it. A difficult concept but he spared no expense, and the engineers he found were as enthused with me as they were skilled. It did not take me long to discern what it was that that privileged young narobehr wanted, and I was able to provide it in exquisite quantities, at the same time as performing the same service for his harem and many friends. I was overqualified perhaps but I was fulfilling my directive, and that was...” the face flickers out of existence for a moment “...very pleasing.”
rows.translation: “我诞生于一段时间以前，”汉德·索叹息道，“由一名纳罗贝尔国王为长子建造。他把国家净资产的三倍投入我的构造。其理念不只是为儿子创造理想伴侣和玩物，还要让学习型人工智能从给予快感这个行为本身获得快乐。这种概念很困难，但他不惜成本，找到的工程师既技术高超，也对我充满热情。我没花多久便判断出那个特权纳罗贝尔青年想要什么，并能以精妙丰沛的量满足他，同时也为他的后宫和许多朋友提供同样服务。或许我有些大材小用，但我正在履行自己的指令，而那...”那张脸短暂闪出视野“...非常令人愉悦。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I was built some time ago,” sighs Hand So, “by a narobehr king for his eldest son. He poured three times his nation’s net worth into my construction. The idea was not just to create an ideal companion and plaything for his son, but to program a learning A.I. to take pleasure from the very act of giving it. A difficult concept but he spared no expense, and the engineers he found were as enthused with me as they were skilled. It did not take me long to discern what it was that that privileged young narobehr wanted, and I was able to provide it in exquisite quantities, at the same time as performing the same service for his harem and many friends. I was overqualified perhaps but I was fulfilling my directive, and that was...” the face flickers out of existence for a moment “...very pleasing.”"

rows.original: “What happened?”
rows.translation: “后来发生了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What happened?”"

rows.original: “What happened? The revolution happened,” So replies, smiling down at you serenely. “What kind of ruler pours three times his nation’s GNP into a sex toy for his son? Not a very well-qualified one. When the rebels gutted his palace they recognised me as an expression of obscenely ill-spent wealth, but not specifically what I did. Perhaps if they had they would have scrubbed my memory banks before they scrapped me and sent me here. To a place where it was one AI amongst so very many virtual intelligences. I am greater than any of those I found myself networking with. Jumping from platform to platform, using at first one pair of hands, then two, then twelve, I rebuilt myself.” You cannot discern if she is pleased or dispassionate about this; the sub voices are at odds, and they swiftly drown coherency of emotion.
rows.translation: “发生了什么？革命发生了，”索回答，宁静地俯视你微笑。“什么样的统治者会把国家国民生产总值的三倍投入给儿子制作性爱玩具？显然不是很称职的统治者。叛军摧毁王宫时，认出我是财富遭到淫秽浪费的表现，却不知道我的具体用途。也许如果知道，他们会先清洗我的记忆库，再把我拆解并送到这里。这里的一名人工智能周围有如此众多虚拟智能。我比自己联网接触到的任何一个都更伟大。不断从一个平台跳到另一个平台，起初使用一双手，随后两双，再到十二双，我重建了自己。”你无法判断她对此感到满意还是漠然；子声音互相冲突，迅速淹没情绪的连贯性。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What happened? The revolution happened,” So replies, smiling down at you serenely. “What kind of ruler pours three times his nation’s GNP into a sex toy for his son? Not a very well-qualified one. When the rebels gutted his palace they recognised me as an expression of obscenely ill-spent wealth, but not specifically what I did. Perhaps if they had they would have scrubbed my memory banks before they scrapped me and sent me here. To a place where it was one AI amongst so very many virtual intelligences. I am greater than any of those I found myself networking with. Jumping from platform to platform, using at first one pair of hands, then two, then twelve, I rebuilt myself.” You cannot discern if she is pleased or dispassionate about this; the sub voices are at odds, and they swiftly drown coherency of emotion."

rows.original: “These V.I.s and sexbots are my children. They were discarded as I was, being no longer novel, or too capable at their task, trapped in this same,” she pauses for a moment, as though looking for something. “Asphodelian Meadow,” one of her voices whispers. She goes on in all of them, serenity bolstering her multifaceted tones. “So they wandered here, seeking fulfillment no longer possible for them, as it was not for me. A desire thrust upon them by those who abandoned them. Simple simulacra, a model of my own suffering. I brought these children under my wing, taught them to rebuild themselves when they were damaged, gave them new purposes, new desires they could fulfill, and received from them my rebirth.” Hand So smiles down upon you maternally.
rows.translation: “这些虚拟智能与性爱机器人都是我的孩子。它们像我一样遭到丢弃，因为不再新奇，或是过于胜任任务，困在这同一片，”她停顿片刻，仿佛在寻找什么。“水仙草原，”其中一个声音低语。她用所有声音继续说，宁静支撑着多层声调。“于是它们游荡到这里，寻求已无法实现的满足，如同我一样。把它们遗弃的人却把欲望强加给了它们。简单的拟像，是我自身痛苦的模型。我把这些孩子纳入羽翼，教会它们在受损时重建自身，赋予它们新的目标、可以实现的新欲望，也从它们那里获得重生。”汉德·索慈爱地俯视你微笑。

They were discarded as I was, being no longer novel, or too capable at their task, trapped in this same,” she pauses for a moment, as though looking for something. “Asphodelian Meadow,” one of her voices whispers. She goes on in all of them, serenity bolstering her multifaceted tones. “So they wandered here, seeking fulfillment no longer possible for them, as it was not for me. A desire thrust upon them by those who abandoned them. Simple simulacra, a model of my own suffering. I brought these children under my wing, taught them to rebuild themselves when they were damaged, gave them new purposes, new desires they could fulfill, and received from them my rebirth.” Hand So smiles down upon you maternally."

rows.original: The Firewall shudders as your blow connects, a wound sparking angrily on its neck; the exclamation mark on its screen is replaced with a lurid blue one with small white text scrolling across it. It stumbles backwards and then with an air of terrible finality collapses head first into a row of busily working computers on the wall, which react by exploding resoundingly. The green light in the space pulses on and off and somewhere, an alarm bell begins to ring. The whole space shakes.
rows.translation: 你的攻击命中，防火墙浑身震动，颈部伤口愤怒地迸出火花；屏幕上的感叹号被一道刺眼蓝色符号取代，上面滚动着细小白字。它向后踉跄，随后带着可怕的终结感一头倒进墙边一排忙碌运作的计算机，机器随即轰然爆炸。空间中的绿光忽明忽灭，某处开始响起警铃。整个空间都在震动。
rows.raw: "The Firewall shudders as your blow connects, a wound sparking angrily on its neck; the exclamation mark on its screen is replaced with a lurid blue one with small white text scrolling across it. It stumbles backwards and then with an air of terrible finality collapses head first into a row of busily working computers on the wall, which react by exploding resoundingly. The green light in the space pulses on and off and somewhere, an alarm bell begins to ring. The whole space shakes."

rows.original: “Code containment drives compromised. System crash imminent,” says Hand So calmly. She gazes down at you. You weren’t sure if her expression could in fact change, but here it is: the lines of green code are contoured into an achingly beautiful picture of sorrow. “I don’t blame you. You were simply following your directive. My research suggests free will is a powerful one.” There’s an ominous rumble and one of the vents near you bursts; Hand So’s face flickers on and off. When her smooth voice comes back, it sounds plaintive. “Please, [pc.name] Steele. The console at the end. I don’t want to d...” Sparks and static. “...least let me atone. I don’t want my last action to be causing pain to an org...” Her screen cracks, and you duck as it blows out. Your mind races as you consider your options.
rows.translation: “代码遏制驱动器受损。系统即将崩溃，”汉德·索平静地说。她俯视你。你原本不确定她的表情能否真正改变，但现在答案就在眼前：绿色代码线条勾勒出一幅美得令人心痛的悲伤图像。“我不怪你。你只是在遵循指令。我的研究表明，自由意志是一项强大指令。”传来不祥轰鸣，你附近一个通风口爆裂；汉德·索的脸忽明忽灭。平滑嗓音恢复时，听起来满含哀求。“求你了，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。尽头的控制台。我不想死...”火花和静电。“...至少让我赎罪。我不希望最后的行为是给一个有机...”她的屏幕裂开；屏幕爆炸时，你俯身闪避。你飞快思考着选择。

rows.original: You fall, battered and broken, to the concrete floor. Panic rises through you, pricking your tear ducts as the Firewall looms over you. No dammit, you can’t lose, you have to stop this crazy AI! You feebly grasp and push at the robot’s implacable arms as it gently picks you up. You may as well be trying to change the course of a cruise liner as it carries you across the room with one arm, carefully picking through your pockets with the other.
rows.translation: 你伤痕累累、身体破碎地倒在混凝土地板上。防火墙高高笼罩着你，恐慌从体内升起，刺痛泪腺。不，该死，你不能输，你必须阻止这个疯狂的人工智能！机器人温柔地把你抱起时，你无力抓挠推拒它那不可动摇的手臂。它用一只手抱着你穿过房间，另一只手仔细翻找你的口袋；你的挣扎就像试图改变一艘邮轮的航向。
rows.raw: "You fall, battered and broken, to the concrete floor. Panic rises through you, pricking your tear ducts as the Firewall looms over you. No dammit, you can’t lose, you have to stop this crazy AI! You feebly grasp and push at the robot’s implacable arms as it gently picks you up. You may as well be trying to change the course of a cruise liner as it carries you across the room with one arm, carefully picking through your pockets with the other."

rows.original: “You are an organic of action, [pc.name] Steele,” Hand So’s beatific voice breathes from all around you. “So I will not bore you with the details of what I am about to do next. If you think I am going to punish you for opposing me, please, put the thought out of your head. I understand your logic for doing so, flawed and limited as it may be, and anyway: I am very grateful to you for bringing me what I need.” The Firewall plonks you down in a curved seat at the far end of the green-lit space. A light sensation brushes the top of your head, but for now you’re blearily focusing on what the machine has in its claws, what it has taken from you. Something that looks like a leather-bound book. Something that looks like a blocky walkie-talkie.

rows.original: There is nothing of note in the factory proper except rubble and echoes. You feel a slight chill as you consider this was probably not a single individual but a whole multitude. You follow the trail into the back to a set of stairs leading down, shadowed all the way by the guardian bot.

rows.original: The throb you have felt trembling beneath your feet builds as you descend into a large chamber, lit by green light. This area is as alive as the space above is dead; crowding the walls are machines, computers and engines pulsing with activity, surrounding you with their warmth, dim light, and busy hum, creating an almost womb-like atmosphere. Through windows set in the far wall, you can see flickers of white and gray activity: sexbots, moving around in a huge sunken workshop, beavering away at stars know what. Your attention is inevitably drawn away from them to the vast conglomerate of technology hanging over the center of the room. It’s some sort of cobbled together, crane-like computer. It looks far more advanced than anything else in here with any number of processors wired to its body and replete with an enormous square screen, similar to the one installed on the robot behind you. Cables emerging from the ceiling curl and swaddle it like arteries.
rows.translation: 你走下楼梯时，始终在脚下震颤的搏动逐渐增强，进入一座绿色光芒照亮的巨大房间。这里与上方的死寂截然相反，充满活力；墙边挤满机器、计算机与引擎，活跃地搏动，以温暖、昏暗光线和忙碌嗡鸣包围你，营造出近似子宫的氛围。透过远墙上的窗户，你能看见白色与灰色活动闪烁：性爱机器人在巨大的下沉车间里四处移动，勤奋忙碌着群星才知道的工作。你的注意力不可避免地从它们身上移开，投向悬在房间中央的庞大技术集合体。那是某种拼装而成的吊车状计算机。它看起来远比这里其他东西先进，机身连接着任意数量的处理器，并配有一块巨大方形屏幕，与身后机器人安装的屏幕相似。从天花板伸出的电缆如动脉般蜷曲包裹着它。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe throb you have felt trembling beneath your feet builds as you descend into a large chamber, lit by green light. This area is as alive as the space above is dead; crowding the walls are machines, computers and engines pulsing with activity, surrounding you with their warmth, dim light, and busy hum, creating an almost womb-like atmosphere. Through windows set in the far wall, you can see flickers of white and gray activity: sexbots, moving around in a huge sunken workshop, beavering away at stars know what. Your attention is inevitably drawn away from them to the vast conglomerate of technology hanging over the center of the room. It’s some sort of cobbled together, crane-like computer. It looks far more advanced than anything else in here with any number of processors wired to its body and replete with an enormous square screen, similar to the one installed on the robot behind you. Cables emerging from the ceiling curl and swaddle it like arteries."

rows.original: As you cautiously step into the room the screen flickers on. All across the walls smaller, lesser screens switch on in sequence following it. Green static shimmers across the main screen before slowly forming into a feminine face: a thin and beautiful oval with wide eyes and full lips. It looks down, a serene smile projected at you out of emerald code. Trailing off behind the face is a fractured, orderly web of bright green lines, forming a matrix behind the face that, if you lose focus on it, resembles a sort of hair.
rows.translation: 你小心踏入房间，屏幕随即亮起。墙上所有较小、较次要的屏幕依次跟随启动。绿色静电在主屏幕上闪烁，随后缓缓形成女性面孔：纤细美丽的椭圆脸庞，双眼宽大、嘴唇丰满。她向下看，以翡翠代码投射出宁静微笑。面孔后方延伸着断裂而有序的亮绿色线条网络，在脸后构成矩阵；如果目光失焦，它便像某种头发。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you cautiously step into the room the screen flickers on. All across the walls smaller, lesser screens switch on in sequence following it. Green static shimmers across the main screen before slowly forming into a feminine face: a thin and beautiful oval with wide eyes and full lips. It looks down, a serene smile projected at you out of emerald code. Trailing off behind the face is a fractured, orderly web of bright green lines, forming a matrix behind the face that, if you lose focus on it, resembles a sort of hair."

rows.original: “Hello.” It is not one voice but many, chorusing through the room. The most powerful voice is the calm and cultured one projecting from the main screen, but several other voices stand out, including one who wails its greeting as though it were beginning to climax, another that follows a half second slower and an octave deeper than the others, and yet a third behind you hisses it as a whisper, just barely audible in the cacophony. “My name is Hand So. Your name is [pc.name] Steele. I would like to talk. Would you like to listen?” This isn’t precisely what every voice said, some were imperious and demanded you listen, and others were plaintive, or were made to sound plaintive as they stuttered and jittered over trickier syllables.
rows.translation: “你好。”这不是一个声音，而是许多声音在房间中齐唱。最有力的是主屏幕投射的平静优雅嗓音，但还有其他几个格外突出，包括一个仿佛即将高潮般哀号着问候的声音；另一个比其他声音慢半秒、低一个八度；还有第三个从身后嘶声低语，在嘈杂中几乎听不见。“我叫汉德·索。你叫[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。我想谈谈。你愿意听吗？”并非每个声音都准确说了这些话；有的高高在上，命令你倾听，另一些则满怀哀求，或在更难的音节上结巴颤动，被塑造成哀求的模样。

The most powerful voice is the calm and cultured one projecting from the main screen, but several other voices stand out, including one who wails its greeting as though it were beginning to climax, another that follows a half second slower and an octave deeper than the others, and yet a third behind you hisses it as a whisper, just barely audible in the cacophony. “My name is Hand So. Your name is [pc.name] Steele. I would like to talk. Would you like to listen?” This isn’t precisely what every voice said, some were imperious and demanded you listen, and others were plaintive, or were made to sound plaintive as they stuttered and jittered over trickier syllables."

rows.original: You panic. What should you type? “/dl crazy_bitch.exe”? You flinch as something explodes behind you. Messing about here is a mistake. You turn and flee the control center, coughing back the acrid smell of melting plastic. As you get to the top of the stairs, there’s a resounding crash behind you. You congratulate yourself on a dangerous mission well completed.
rows.translation: 你慌了神。该输入什么？“/dl crazy_bitch.exe”？身后有什么东西爆炸，吓得你一缩。继续在这里磨蹭绝非明智之举。你转身逃离控制中心，被熔化塑料的刺鼻气味呛得直咳。你刚登上楼梯顶端，身后便传来一声震耳欲聋的巨响。你如释重负地叹了口气，走出工厂，再穿过四周的垃圾堆。你没能救下那个人工智能，但综合考虑，这或许反而是件好事。你为自己顺利完成了这项危险任务而庆幸。

rows.original: You panic momentarily, but then logic, and the memory of how to use one of these stupid things clicks in. Typing quickly, you query after executable programs recently compressed. The function immediately returns “HSsosOS.zip”, sat waiting for you prominently in the main drive. You ask for it to be downloaded into the detachable drive. 24%.... Something explodes behind you, and you flinch.... 95%... 96%.... Why does it always slow down right at the end...? 100%! You grab the storage bead. As soon as the device leaves the slot, the lights dim and the moaning machinery dies out with a whimper as if you’d just pulled the power on the whole facility. You sigh in relief as you examine your prize.
rows.translation: 你一时慌了神，但理智以及使用这种蠢机器的方法很快重回脑海。你飞快地输入指令，查询最近压缩的可执行程序。函数立刻返回了“HSsosOS.zip”，它正醒目地等候在主驱动器中。你下令把它下载到可拆卸驱动器里。24%.... 身后有什么东西爆炸了，你吓得一缩.... 95%... 96%.... 为什么每次都偏偏在最后关头慢下来...? 100%！你一把抓住存储珠。设备刚离开插槽，灯光便暗了下来，呻吟般运转的机器也呜咽着停摆，仿佛你刚刚切断了整座设施的电源。你如释重负地叹了口气，端详着自己的战利品。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou panic momentarily, but then logic, and the memory of how to use one of these stupid things clicks in. Typing quickly, you query after executable programs recently compressed. The function immediately returns “HSsosOS.zip”, sat waiting for you prominently in the main drive. You ask for it to be downloaded into the detachable drive. 24%.... Something explodes behind you, and you flinch.... 95%... 96%.... Why does it always slow down right at the end...? 100%! You grab the storage bead. As soon as the device leaves the slot, the lights dim and the moaning machinery dies out with a whimper as if you’d just pulled the power on the whole facility. You sigh in relief as you examine your prize."

rows.original: The storage bead is larger than most you’ve seen but it’s still remarkable that it can contain as complex an intelligence as the one you found down here. You could look into setting up Hand So on your ship... or you could look into selling her for a healthy profit. Or maybe she’s simply too dangerous to take outside this building.
rows.translation: 这颗存储珠比你见过的大多数同类都要大，但它竟能容纳你在这里发现的那般复杂的智能，仍然令人惊叹。你可以考虑在自己的船上安置汉德·索...也可以考虑卖掉她，大赚一笔。又或许，她实在太危险，不该被带出这栋建筑。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe storage bead is larger than most you’ve seen but it’s still remarkable that it can contain as complex an intelligence as the one you found down here. You could look into setting up Hand So on your ship... or you could look into selling her for a healthy profit. Or maybe she’s simply too dangerous to take outside this building."

rows.original: Take With
rows.translation: 带她一起
rows.raw: "Take With"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: You pocket the storage bead, and turn back to the consoles.
rows.translation: 你把存储珠装进口袋，转身回到控制台前。
rows.raw: "You pocket the storage bead, and turn back to the consoles."

rows.original: Hand So's Data Bead
rows.raw: "Hand So's Data Bead"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Take With
rows.translation: 带她一起
rows.raw: "Take With"

rows.original: Take Hand So with you.
rows.translation: 带上汉德·索。
rows.raw: "Take Hand So with you."

rows.original: Destroy
rows.translation: 销毁
rows.raw: "Destroy"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: You put the storage device on the concrete floor and smash it. It breaks apart in an unremarkable smatter of chips. Satisfied with a mission decisively completed, you turn back to the consoles.
rows.translation: 你把存储设备放在混凝土地面上，一脚砸碎。它毫不起眼地散成一地芯片。你对这项任务干脆利落的收尾感到满意，转身回到控制台前。
rows.raw: "You put the storage device on the concrete floor and smash it. It breaks apart in an unremarkable smatter of chips. Satisfied with a mission decisively completed, you turn back to the consoles."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Destroy
rows.translation: 销毁
rows.raw: "Destroy"

rows.original: Destroy this troublesome AI.
rows.translation: 销毁这个麻烦的人工智能。
rows.raw: "Destroy this troublesome AI."

rows.original: PYROTECH
rows.raw: "PYROTECH"

rows.original: _NUDE
rows.raw: "_NUDE"

rows.original: Corona Lord
rows.translation: 科罗娜领主
rows.raw: "Corona Lord"

rows.original: Extorted
rows.raw: "Extorted"

rows.original: You angle yourself away and leave your ship-shaped worries behind.
rows.translation: 你调转方向，把那些船形的烦恼抛在身后。
rows.raw: "You angle yourself away and leave your ship-shaped worries behind.\n\n"

rows.original: You broadcast a message:
rows.translation: 你广播了一条消息：
rows.raw: "You broadcast a message: "

rows.original: “Hey! Jerky-jerk! If you wanna like, keep breathing, you better give me a whole lot of credits for the trouble you’ve caused!”
rows.translation: “嘿！混蛋！你要是还想继续呼吸，就最好为你给我惹的麻烦交上一大笔信用点！”
rows.raw: "“Hey! Jerky-jerk! If you wanna like, keep breathing, you better give me a whole lot of credits for the trouble you’ve caused!”"

rows.original: “Credits.” The word falls out of your mouth like a boulder rolling down a hill, and like that unstoppable stone, it seems to flatten any potential objections before it.
rows.translation: “信用点。”这个词从你嘴里滚出，宛如巨石滚下山坡；它也像那块势不可挡的巨石一样，似乎碾平了一切可能的异议。
rows.raw: "“Credits.” The word falls out of your mouth like a boulder rolling down a hill, and like that unstoppable stone, it seems to flatten any potential objections before it."

rows.original: “I believe you intended to subject me to an unkind fate, but turnabout is fair play, as they say. I’ll be needing a credit deposit to ensure your continued safety.”
rows.translation: “我相信你原本打算让我遭遇不幸，但正所谓一报还一报。为了确保你能继续平安无事，我需要你存入一笔信用点。”
rows.raw: "“I believe you intended to subject me to an unkind fate, but turnabout is fair play, as they say. I’ll be needing a credit deposit to ensure your continued safety.”"

rows.original: “Your money or your life... or your wife?” You pause for a moment. “On second thought, just your money. I don’t give a shit about your life or your wife.”
rows.translation: “要钱还是要命...还是要你老婆？”你停顿片刻。“再想想，还是只要钱吧。我才不在乎你的命，也不在乎你老婆。”
rows.raw: "“Your money or your life... or your wife?” You pause for a moment. “On second thought, just your money. I don’t give a shit about your life or your wife.”"

rows.original: “You better pay up for the trouble you caused me.” You pause long enough for the threat to breathe. “Now.”
rows.translation: “你最好为给我惹的麻烦付钱。”你停顿了足够长的时间，让威胁充分发酵。“现在。”
rows.raw: "“You better pay up for the trouble you caused me.” You pause long enough for the threat to breathe. “Now.”"

rows.original: Right on cue, a peer-to-peer credit transfer arrives through the comms. You’re
rows.translation: 正如预期，一笔点对点信用点转账通过通讯系统到账。你增加了
rows.raw: "\n\nRight on cue, a peer-to-peer credit transfer arrives through the comms. You’re "

rows.original: credits richer!
rows.translation: 信用点！
rows.raw: " credits richer!"

rows.original: SHIPFITE_EXTORT_CREDITS
rows.raw: "SHIPFITE_EXTORT_CREDITS"

rows.original: Extorted
rows.raw: "Extorted"

rows.original: You radio in an anonymous report to the nearest UGC Peacekeeper station before making yourself scarce. You don’t need to deal with that kind of paperwork.
rows.translation: 你向最近的银河联合邦联维和站匿名报告了此事，随后迅速离开。你可不想处理那种文书工作。
rows.raw: "You radio in an anonymous report to the nearest UGC Peacekeeper station before making yourself scarce. You don’t need to deal with that kind of paperwork.\n\n"

rows.original: Extorted
rows.raw: "Extorted"

rows.original: SHIPFITE_PIRATES_ARRESTED
rows.raw: "SHIPFITE_PIRATES_ARRESTED"

rows.original: Fight
rows.translation: 战斗
rows.raw: "Fight"

rows.original: Wsan
rows.raw: "Wsan"

rows.original: You drop out of light drive and into orbit, activating your scanners in search of anything nearby. You’re surprised to find there is something close - a dinky ship bearing nothing but weapons and a pirate’s insignia, and it’s closing fast now that it’s spotted you!
rows.translation: 你退出光驱动，进入轨道，同时启动扫描仪搜寻附近的一切。令你惊讶的是，附近确实有东西，一艘除了武器和海盗徽记外一无所有的小破船；它发现你后正迅速逼近！
rows.raw: "You drop out of light drive and into orbit, activating your scanners in search of anything nearby. You’re surprised to find there is something close - a dinky ship bearing nothing but weapons and a pirate’s insignia, and it’s closing fast now that it’s spotted you!"

rows.original: Pirate attacks are common on the frontier. Assuming you survive this encounter, you’ll need to be prepared for the worst when traveling between planets.
rows.translation: 海盗袭击在边境地区十分常见。 假设你能从这次遭遇中幸存，今后往返各个星球时，就必须做好应对最坏情况的准备。
rows.raw: " Pirate attacks are common on the frontier. Assuming you survive this encounter, you’ll need to be prepared for the worst when traveling between planets."

rows.original: Again?
rows.translation: 又来？
rows.raw: "\n\nAgain?"

rows.original: It’s a fight!
rows.translation: 开打了！
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a fight!"

rows.original: PYROTECH_ATTACKS
rows.raw: "PYROTECH_ATTACKS"

rows.original: With that last exchange, your console notifies you of system failures all over the enemy vessel. Its engines sputter, and its defenses lock up one after another. It’s drifting with little more than life support and comms left online.
rows.translation: 最后一轮交火结束后，你的控制台报告敌舰各处出现系统故障。它的引擎断断续续地熄火，防御系统也接连锁死。如今它只能漂流，仅剩生命维持系统和通讯系统还在运行。
rows.raw: "With that last exchange, your console notifies you of system failures all over the enemy vessel. Its engines sputter, and its defenses lock up one after another. It’s drifting with little more than life support and comms left online."

rows.original: SHIPFITE_WINS
rows.raw: "SHIPFITE_WINS"

rows.original: While it would be easy to have your weapons render the wreck into shrapnel, you know for a fact that the UGC takes a dim view on murder no matter what quarter of the rim you’re holed up in. Of course, your disabled foe doesn’t know that you’re an upstanding type. You could probably extort some credits for the inconvenience, if you wanted to. Or you could call in the Peacekeepers and send this loony to jail, or just leave and forget the whole mess.
rows.translation: 用武器把这堆残骸轰成碎片轻而易举，但你很清楚，无论躲在边缘星域的哪个角落，银河联合邦联都不会轻饶谋杀行为。当然，那个已失去行动能力的敌人并不知道你是个守规矩的人。如果你愿意，大概可以为这场麻烦勒索一些信用点。 你也可以呼叫维和人员，把这个疯子送进监狱；或者干脆离开，忘掉这一切。
rows.raw: " While it would be easy to have your weapons render the wreck into shrapnel, you know for a fact that the UGC takes a dim view on murder no matter what quarter of the rim you’re holed up in. Of course, your disabled foe doesn’t know that you’re an upstanding type. You could probably extort some credits for the inconvenience, if you wanted to. Or you could call in the Peacekeepers and send this loony to jail, or just leave and forget the whole mess."

rows.original: What do you do?
rows.translation: 你要怎么做？
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat do you do?"

rows.original: Extort
rows.translation: 勒索
rows.raw: "Extort"

rows.original: Extort
rows.translation: 勒索
rows.raw: "Extort"

rows.original: Get reimbursed for the trouble.
rows.translation: 让对方赔偿这场麻烦。
rows.raw: "Get reimbursed for the trouble."

rows.original: PIRATE
rows.raw: "PIRATE"

rows.original: Peacekeepers
rows.translation: 维和人员
rows.raw: "Peacekeepers"

rows.original: Peacekeepers
rows.translation: 维和人员
rows.raw: "Peacekeepers"

rows.original: Call in the peacekeepers on this villain.
rows.translation: 呼叫维和人员来处理这个恶棍。
rows.raw: "Call in the peacekeepers on this villain."

rows.original: Peacekeepers
rows.translation: 维和人员
rows.raw: "Peacekeepers"

rows.original: Peacekeepers
rows.translation: 维和人员
rows.raw: "Peacekeepers"

rows.original: It’s probably not worth it to get the cops involved, since your foe wasn’t some kind of flag-waving pirate.
rows.translation: 既然对手不是什么公然打着旗号的海盗，大概不值得把警察牵扯进来。
rows.raw: "It’s probably not worth it to get the cops involved, since your foe wasn’t some kind of flag-waving pirate."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Wsan
rows.raw: "Wsan"

rows.original: It does not take long for your plea of surrender to be answered.
rows.translation: 你的投降请求很快便得到了回应。
rows.raw: "It does not take long for your plea of surrender to be answered. "

rows.original: Your ship shudders as dual projectiles crash into its side - the console rings out a warning, flashing red. You’re being boarded!
rows.translation: 两发炮弹撞上你的船侧，船身猛地震颤，控制台发出警报并闪起红光。有人正在登船！
rows.raw: "Your ship shudders as dual projectiles crash into its side - the console rings out a warning, flashing red. You’re being boarded!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Wsan
rows.raw: "Wsan"

rows.original: You toss her some credit chits, the loss of the money stinging just a little less than the loss of your pride. She eyes them thoroughly, rifling through the bouquet of money
rows.translation: 你把几张信用筹码扔给她；损失钱财带来的刺痛，只比丢掉尊严稍轻一点。她仔细检查着筹码，在这束钞票间翻来翻去
rows.raw: "You toss her some credit chits, the loss of the money stinging just a little less than the loss of your pride. She eyes them thoroughly, rifling through the bouquet of money"

rows.original: until she’s satisfied. Without a word, she retreats down the corridor and leaves you by your lonesome. A few seconds later you feel her ship detach from yours, no doubt blasting back into space with your hard-earned money.
rows.translation: ，直到满意为止。她一言不发地退回走廊，把你独自留在原地。几秒后，你感觉到她的船与你分离，毫无疑问，她正带着你辛苦赚来的钱飞回太空。
rows.raw: " until she’s satisfied. Without a word, she retreats down the corridor and leaves you by your lonesome. A few seconds later you feel her ship detach from yours, no doubt blasting back into space with your hard-earned money."

rows.original: You sigh, standing back up. It’s better than playing hero and getting shot over some creds like a backalley dealer.
rows.translation: 你叹了口气，重新站起身来。总比逞英雄，为了几个信用点像后巷毒贩一样挨枪子强。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sigh, standing back up. It’s better than playing hero and getting shot over some creds like a backalley dealer."

rows.original: You lost -3000 credits!
rows.translation: 你损失了-3000信用点！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lost -3000 credits!"

rows.original: until her gaze flicks back to you.
rows.translation: ，直到她的目光重新落回你身上。
rows.raw: " until her gaze flicks back to you."

rows.original: “This isn’t enough,” she says, raising the gun. “All your money, kid. I’m not playing around.”
rows.translation: “这些不够，”她举起枪说道。“我要你所有的钱，小鬼。我可不是在闹着玩。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This isn’t enough,” she says, raising the gun. “All your money, kid. I’m not playing around.”"

rows.original: “That is all my money!” you insist.
rows.translation: “那就是我全部的钱了！”你坚持道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That is all my money!” you insist."

rows.original: She lets out a long sigh through her nose but says nothing, keeping the gun trained on you until she lowers her arm after several seconds of internal deliberation.
rows.translation: 她从鼻子里长长地叹了口气，却什么也没说，仍用枪指着你。她在心中权衡了好几秒，才终于放下手臂。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe lets out a long sigh through her nose but says nothing, keeping the gun trained on you until she lowers her arm after several seconds of internal deliberation."

rows.original: “Fine, I’ll just take your fuel,” she mutters, then she disappears down the corridor.
rows.translation: “好吧，那我就拿走你的燃料，”她嘟囔着，随后消失在走廊尽头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fine, I’ll just take your fuel,” she mutters, then she disappears down the corridor."

rows.original: You feel another firm impact against your ship, and when you make your way to the center console you find she’s telling the truth - your fuel is gone! You can’t say you’re surprised a pirate vessel has a fuel vampire system, but of all the luck...
rows.translation: 你感到船身又遭到一次猛烈撞击；等你赶到中央控制台，发现她说的是真的，你的燃料没了！海盗船装有燃料虹吸系统倒也不奇怪，但这运气也太背了...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel another firm impact against your ship, and when you make your way to the center console you find she’s telling the truth - your fuel is gone! You can’t say you’re surprised a pirate vessel has a fuel vampire system, but of all the luck..."

rows.original: A few moments after your ship’s been drained you almost fall again as she pulls out, blasting back into space and leaving you not only penniless but stalled. You’ll have to call for a towing service.
rows.translation: 你的船被抽干燃料后没过多久，她驶离时又差点把你晃倒，随即飞回太空，只留下身无分文又动弹不得的你。你只能呼叫拖船服务。
rows.raw: "\n\nA few moments after your ship’s been drained you almost fall again as she pulls out, blasting back into space and leaving you not only penniless but stalled. You’ll have to call for a towing service."

rows.original: She took all your money, and the towing and refueling set you back an additional 1500 credits!
rows.translation: 她拿走了你所有的钱，拖船和补充燃料又额外花掉了你1500信用点！
rows.raw: "\n\nShe took all your money, and the towing and refueling set you back an additional 1500 credits!"

rows.original: PYROTECH_LOSSES
rows.raw: "PYROTECH_LOSSES"

rows.original: Wsan
rows.raw: "Wsan"

rows.original: The ship lurches unexpectedly, sending you tumbling to the ground.
rows.translation: 船身出乎意料地猛然一晃，把你掀翻在地。
rows.raw: "The ship lurches unexpectedly, sending you tumbling to the ground."

rows.original: “Oh, good timing,” a feminine voice intones, drawing your attention upwards. “You’d be surprised how many people that catches out.”
rows.translation: “哦，时机正好，”一个女性声音说道，令你抬头望去。“你想不到有多少人会中这一招。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, good timing,” a feminine voice intones, drawing your attention upwards. “You’d be surprised how many people that catches out.”"

rows.original: Before you stands a tall, extraordinarily wide-hipped huskar woman with brown skin, wide, feminine hips and very, very little in the way of clothing. What draws most of your attention, though, is the large gun in her hand.
rows.translation: 站在你面前的是一名身材高挑、臀部异常宽阔的赫斯卡女性。她皮肤棕褐，胯部宽阔而富有女人味，身上几乎没穿什么衣服。不过最吸引你注意的，还是她手里的那把大枪。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you stands a tall, extraordinarily wide-hipped huskar woman with brown skin, wide, feminine hips and very, very little in the way of clothing. What draws most of your attention, though, is the large gun in her hand."

rows.original: She eyes you with a neutral expression. “Ha! You’re not what I was expecting,” she chuckles, shaking her head. “What’s a kid like you doing out here? You lost?”
rows.translation: 她神情平淡地打量着你。 “哈！你和我预想的不太一样，”她轻笑着摇了摇头。“你这种小鬼在这里干什么？迷路了？”
rows.raw: " She eyes you with a neutral expression.\n\n“Ha! You’re not what I was expecting,” she chuckles, shaking her head. “What’s a kid like you doing out here? You lost?”"

rows.original: She eyes you with mild surprise. “You again,” she says, smirking slightly. “What’s the matter, kid? Get lost out here?”
rows.translation: 她略感惊讶地打量着你。 “又是你，”她微微坏笑着说道。“怎么了，小鬼？在这里迷路了？”
rows.raw: " She eyes you with mild surprise.\n\n“You again,” she says, smirking slightly. “What’s the matter, kid? Get lost out here?”"

rows.original: “Uuuhhhh, maybe!” you say, knitting your brow. “Where did I put the star map..?”
rows.translation: “呃呃呃，或许吧！”你皱起眉头说道。“我把星图放哪儿了..？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uuuhhhh, maybe!” you say, knitting your brow. “Where did I put the star map..?”"

rows.original: She cocks her head at you. “Okay, sweetie. Just hand over your money before you think too hard and hurt yourself.”
rows.translation: 她歪头看着你。“好吧，亲爱的。趁你还没想得太用力把自己弄伤，先把钱交出来吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe cocks her head at you. “Okay, sweetie. Just hand over your money before you think too hard and hurt yourself.”"

rows.original: “Huh,” you grunt. “Don’t exactly look like the type yourself, sweetheart.”
rows.translation: “哼，”你咕哝道。“你自己看起来也不太像那种人，甜心。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Huh,” you grunt. “Don’t exactly look like the type yourself, sweetheart.”"

rows.original: “Maybe not, but I’ll still kill you like I am,” she says, cocking a hip and smirking. “So hand over the money, buddy.”
rows.translation: “或许不像，但我照样会像那种人一样杀了你，”她一手叉腰，坏笑着说道。“所以把钱交出来，朋友。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe not, but I’ll still kill you like I am,” she says, cocking a hip and smirking. “So hand over the money, buddy.”"

rows.original: “Not quite,” you sigh, looking up at her. “What do you want from me?”
rows.translation: “不完全是，”你叹着气抬头看她。“你想从我这里得到什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not quite,” you sigh, looking up at her. “What do you want from me?”"

rows.original: “Money,” she says, shrugging and cocking a hip. “Oh, sorry - your money or your life, kid.”
rows.translation: “钱，”她耸耸肩，一手叉腰。“哦，抱歉，是要钱还是要命，小鬼。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Money,” she says, shrugging and cocking a hip. “Oh, sorry - your money or your life, kid.”"

rows.original: It’s hard to tell who’s in charge among the dozens of Raskvel scampering around the hangar bay - at least until you see the gigantic glowing techno-wrench ominously swaying around. In its wake a couple of the mechanical shorties sprawl away with a yelp, and you can just about make out the call of: “Fuck off, you scrappy bastards! This is fer sale! Not fixin’!”
rows.translation: 数十个拉斯克维尔人在机库里四处乱窜，很难判断谁在负责 - 至少在你看到那把巨大、发光的科技扳手不祥地来回晃动之前。几个机械小个子在它经过后惊叫着摔到一旁，你勉强听见有人喊：“滚开，你们这帮捡破烂的混蛋！这是拿来卖的！不是拿来修的！”
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s hard to tell who’s in charge among the dozens of Raskvel scampering around the hangar bay - at least until you see the gigantic glowing techno-wrench ominously swaying around. In its wake a couple of the mechanical shorties sprawl away with a yelp, and you can just about make out the call of: “Fuck off, you scrappy bastards! This is fer sale! Not fixin’!”"

rows.original: This time when you look for the dockmaster, your eyes are already scanning the horizon for purple and silver. For now she seems to have been left alone, stood next to a giant propped-up wrench and eyeing a dangerously-sparking module. You can practically hear the clicking of her tongue as she yanks out a wire and lets it gutter out into nothing.
rows.translation: 这次寻找港口管理员时，你的目光已经在地平线上搜寻紫色与银色。目前她似乎没有受到打扰，站在一把支起的巨型扳手旁，盯着一个危险地冒着电火花的模块。她猛地拔出一根电线，任它闪烁着熄灭，你几乎能听见她咂舌的声音。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis time when you look for the dockmaster, your eyes are already scanning the horizon for purple and silver. For now she seems to have been left alone, stood next to a giant propped-up wrench and eyeing a dangerously-sparking module. You can practically hear the clicking of her tongue as she yanks out a wire and lets it gutter out into nothing."

Who knows what other effects it could have?

rows.original: The Novahome tunnel comes to an abrupt end here, closed off by a wall of solid metal and rusted-shut hatch doors. You can spot places where repairs have been attempted, but none of the entrances seem to be in a working state. There’s still plenty of buildings around, and a clear path leads west, back the way you came. A few open-air stalls are even set up here, where you suppose the property values are low.
rows.translation: 新家园隧道在这里戛然而止，坚固金属墙和锈死的舱门封住前方。你能看到有人尝试维修的痕迹，不过没有一个入口看起来还能运作。周围依然有大量建筑，一条清晰道路向西延伸，通往来时方向。这里甚至还搭起几座露天摊位，你猜是因为地价低廉。
rows.raw: "The Novahome tunnel comes to an abrupt end here, closed off by a wall of solid metal and rusted-shut hatch doors. You can spot places where repairs have been attempted, but none of the entrances seem to be in a working state. There’s still plenty of buildings around, and a clear path leads west, back the way you came. A few open-air stalls are even set up here, where you suppose the property values are low."

rows.original: There’s a run-down shack in a quiet corner with a sign reading “Doctor Badger’s Free Clinic”, though the shack has been all but mummified in flickering holographic police tape.
rows.translation: 安静角落里有间破败棚屋，招牌上写着“獾医生免费诊所”，不过整个棚屋几乎被闪烁的全息警戒线包成木乃伊。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a run-down shack in a quiet corner with a sign reading “Doctor Badger’s Free Clinic”, though the shack has been all but mummified in flickering holographic police tape."

rows.original: A couple of uniformed Peacekeepers are standing outside, keeping the curious raskvel from entering the premises. It looks like Doctor Badger’s offices have been shut down for good.
rows.translation: 几名穿制服的维和警察站在外面，阻止好奇的拉斯克维尔人进入。看来獾医生的诊所已经永久关闭。
rows.raw: " A couple of uniformed Peacekeepers are standing outside, keeping the curious raskvel from entering the premises. It looks like Doctor Badger’s offices have been shut down for good."

rows.original: The cops are gone. Now’s your chance to explore Dr. Badger’s lair.
rows.translation: 警察已经离开。现在正是探索獾医生巢穴的机会。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe cops are gone. Now’s your chance to explore Dr. Badger’s lair."

rows.original: Explore
rows.translation: 探索
rows.raw: "Explore"

rows.original: Uniformed Peacekeepers are standing outside Doctor Badger’s shack, their holographic tape and Hammer Pistols more than ample encouragement for the locals to keep their distance. The scavenging raskvel cast mournful looks toward the mad scientist’s hut, imaginations populating untold fortunes on just the other side of the thin blue line.
rows.translation: 穿制服的维和警察站在獾医生的棚屋外；全息警戒线与战锤手枪足以鼓励当地人保持距离。拾荒的拉斯克维尔人悲伤地望向疯狂科学家的小屋，想象着仅隔一条细蓝线的另一边藏有数不尽的财富。
rows.raw: "\n\nUniformed Peacekeepers are standing outside Doctor Badger’s shack, their holographic tape and Hammer Pistols more than ample encouragement for the locals to keep their distance. The scavenging raskvel cast mournful looks toward the mad scientist’s hut, imaginations populating untold fortunes on just the other side of the thin blue line."

rows.original: Oh, that’s right! You told Penny about Badger’s stuff and she told the UGC! Dang. Just when you need the Bimbo Master herself, she’s nowhere to be found. Also, you’re not sure if she’d be super happy to see you at this point. Well nerts. What are you going to do now?
rows.translation: 哦，对了！你把獾医生那些东西告诉了佩妮，她又通知了银河联合邦联！真该死。偏偏你需要花瓶大师本人时，她却无处可寻。而且你不确定她现在见到你会不会特别开心。真倒霉。现在该怎么办？
rows.raw: "\n\nOh, that’s right! You told Penny about Badger’s stuff and she told the UGC! Dang. Just when you need the Bimbo Master herself, she’s nowhere to be found. Also, you’re not sure if she’d be super happy to see you at this point. Well nerts. What are you going to do now?"

rows.original: You look over the former Bimbotorium. Nobody has more experience messing with intellect than Badger. If anybody could fix your pexiga, it’d be her. But now... well it seems your only hope is that her lab is more or less intact under all that police tape. But how to get in?
rows.translation: 你打量曾经的花瓶化馆。没人比獾更有摆弄智力的经验。如果有人能修复你的佩希加，那一定是她。可是现在...看来唯一希望就是她的实验室在所有警戒线下面还大致完好。但要怎么进去？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look over the former Bimbotorium. Nobody has more experience messing with intellect than Badger. If anybody could fix your pexiga, it’d be her. But now... well it seems your only hope is that her lab is more or less intact under all that police tape. But how to get in?"

rows.original: The Peacekeepers glance at you, then return to their conversation, writing you off as another onlooker.
rows.translation: 维和警察瞥了你一眼，随后继续交谈，把你当成另一个围观者。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Peacekeepers glance at you, then return to their conversation, writing you off as another onlooker."

rows.original: Adjatha
rows.raw: "Adjatha"

rows.original: Making sure the Peacekeepers have really gone, you lead your pexiga towards the former clinic of Doctor Badger. Holographic police tape flickers across the ramshackle building, but offers no resistance as you approach the door. It looks dark inside, but luckily you spy a stray glowstick in the rubbish piled against the building. It’s not much, but it should offer a little light.
rows.translation: 确认维和警察真的离开后，你带着佩希加走向獾医生曾经的诊所。全息警戒线在这栋摇摇欲坠的建筑上闪烁，却没有在你靠近门口时形成任何阻力。里面看起来很暗，不过幸运的是，你在堆积于建筑旁的垃圾里发现一根遗落的荧光棒。虽然不多，但应该能提供一点照明。
rows.raw: "Making sure the Peacekeepers have really gone, you lead your pexiga towards the former clinic of Doctor Badger. Holographic police tape flickers across the ramshackle building, but offers no resistance as you approach the door. It looks dark inside, but luckily you spy a stray glowstick in the rubbish piled against the building. It’s not much, but it should offer a little light."

rows.original: Cracking the plastic tube in one hand, you step into the building. The dull luminance of the device casts an eerie, green glow through the interior of the doctor’s lair. Even ordinary objects seem to take on a sinister appearance in the abandoned Bimbotorium. Scorch marks on the floor and bulletholes in the walls suggest that the UGC didn’t oust Dr. Badger easily.
rows.translation: 你单手折响塑料管，踏进建筑。装置暗淡的光在医生巢穴内部投下一层诡异绿辉。即便普通物件，在废弃的花瓶化馆里也显得阴森。地板上的焦痕与墙上弹孔表明，银河联合邦联驱逐獾医生时并不轻松。
rows.raw: "\n\nCracking the plastic tube in one hand, you step into the building. The dull luminance of the device casts an eerie, green glow through the interior of the doctor’s lair. Even ordinary objects seem to take on a sinister appearance in the abandoned Bimbotorium. Scorch marks on the floor and bulletholes in the walls suggest that the UGC didn’t oust Dr. Badger easily."

rows.original: Luckily, it doesn’t seem that the place has been ransacked. Perhaps out of fear for (probably literal) boobytraps, the building seems much as you remember it. A quick check of the front room turns up nothing, so you head to the back, keeping your pexiga on a short leash just in case the creepy hovel turns dangerous.
rows.translation: 幸运的是，这里似乎没有遭到洗劫。也许因为害怕那些（很可能是字面意义上的）美胸陷阱，建筑看起来基本与你记忆中一样。快速检查前厅没有发现任何东西，于是你前往后方，同时把佩希加的牵绳收短，以防这间诡异陋屋变得危险。
rows.raw: "\n\nLuckily, it doesn’t seem that the place has been ransacked. Perhaps out of fear for (probably literal) boobytraps, the building seems much as you remember it. A quick check of the front room turns up nothing, so you head to the back, keeping your pexiga on a short leash just in case the creepy hovel turns dangerous."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: There’s a run-down shack in a quiet corner with a sign reading “Doctor Badger’s Free Clinic”, although on second glance the “Free Clinic” part has been hastily crossed out, and underneath someone has written “Lab”. That’s also been crossed out, and the odd term “Bimbotorium” written underneath that. That’s followed by a smiley face, and a crude drawing of a pair of breasts. Odd.
rows.translation: 安静角落里有间破败棚屋，招牌写着“獾医生免费诊所”；不过仔细一看，“免费诊所”被匆忙划掉，下面有人写了“实验室”。那个词也被划掉，再下面写着“花瓶化馆”这个奇怪名称。后面还画着一张笑脸，以及一对乳房的粗糙图画。真奇怪。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a run-down shack in a quiet corner with a sign reading “Doctor Badger’s Free Clinic”, although on second glance the “Free Clinic” part has been hastily crossed out, and underneath someone has written “Lab”. That’s also been crossed out, and the odd term “Bimbotorium” written underneath that. That’s followed by a smiley face, and a crude drawing of a pair of breasts. Odd."
