rows.original: A blush on your face and warm excitement bubbling in your tummy, you bashfully explain the blue girl you’ve got in your ship. Badger makes dismissive affirmations as she slides up beside you. “Mmhrm? Oh? Very interesting,” she mumbles as her clawed hands reach across your [pc.upperGarment] to play across your [pc.chest]. You squirm in her grasp, tempted to just jump her bone, but somehow you find the strength to press on. You explain how it’s, like, totally not fair that the pexiga can’t enjoy herself and since Badger’s so good at making people dumb, maybe she could make a super dumb person just regular dumb?
rows.translation: 你脸上泛起红晕，腹中涌动着温暖的兴奋，羞涩地向她讲起船上的那个蓝皮姑娘。獾医生敷衍地应和着，同时滑到你身旁。“嗯哼？哦？真有意思，”她喃喃说道，一双利爪越过你的[pc.upperGarment]，在[pc.chest]上游走。你在她手中扭动，忍不住想直接扑上去和她交媾，却不知怎么找到了继续说下去的力量。你解释说，佩克西加无法享受快乐实在太不公平；既然獾医生那么擅长把人变笨，或许她能把一个超级笨的人变成普通笨蛋？
rows.raw: "A blush on your face and warm excitement bubbling in your tummy, you bashfully explain the blue girl you’ve got in your ship. Badger makes dismissive affirmations as she slides up beside you. “Mmhrm? Oh? Very interesting,” she mumbles as her clawed hands reach across your [pc.upperGarment] to play across your [pc.chest]. You squirm in her grasp, tempted to just jump her bone, but somehow you find the strength to press on. You explain how it’s, like, totally not fair that the pexiga can’t enjoy herself and since Badger’s so good at making people dumb, maybe she could make a super dumb person just regular dumb?"

rows.original: No sense beating around the bush. You lay out your request very plainly and watch the dangerous woman to see how she’ll react. She listens as you explain the pexiga’s biological off-switch, her eyes narrowing as you reach the compassionate conclusion of your petition. Her hand twitches, fingers reaching for something and you tense up, equally motivated to run for safety as to lunge at the scientist before she can ready her weapon. Drawn in both directions, you’re momentarily paralyzed and the indecision allows the strained moment to pass without event.
rows.translation: 没必要拐弯抹角。你直截了当地提出请求，观察这个危险女人会作何反应。你解释了佩克西加生理上的关闭开关；她听着，直到你满怀同情地总结请求时，双眼才眯了起来。她的手微微一动，手指伸向某样东西；你立刻绷紧身体，既想逃向安全处，又想在科学家备好武器前扑向她。两种冲动拉扯着你，让你一时僵在原地；这份犹豫反而让紧张时刻平安过去。
rows.raw: "No sense beating around the bush. You lay out your request very plainly and watch the dangerous woman to see how she’ll react. She listens as you explain the pexiga’s biological off-switch, her eyes narrowing as you reach the compassionate conclusion of your petition. Her hand twitches, fingers reaching for something and you tense up, equally motivated to run for safety as to lunge at the scientist before she can ready her weapon. Drawn in both directions, you’re momentarily paralyzed and the indecision allows the strained moment to pass without event."

rows.original: Doctor Badger takes a step back and produces a hard, pink ball of gum. Popping it into her mouth, she studies you with clinical scrutiny. “You want me to make somebody... smarter? Feels a bit like going against the grain, to be honest,” she remarks, gnashing and smacking her gum loudly. “What’s the fun in building somebody up when you could be tearing them down?”
rows.translation: 獾医生后退一步，拿出一颗坚硬的粉红口香糖球。她把它丢进嘴里，用临床般审视的目光研究你。“你想让我把某个人变得...更聪明？老实说，感觉有点逆势而行，”她大声咀嚼、咂着口香糖评论道。“明明可以把人摧毁，为什么还要把人塑造得更好？”
rows.raw: "\n\nDoctor Badger takes a step back and produces a hard, pink ball of gum. Popping it into her mouth, she studies you with clinical scrutiny. “You want me to make somebody... smarter? Feels a bit like going against the grain, to be honest,” she remarks, gnashing and smacking her gum loudly. “What’s the fun in building somebody up when you could be tearing them down?”"

rows.original: Your eyes widen with surprise. “Ooooh. I understand,” you confirm with a sagely nod. “You can’t do it. Like, that’s okay. I couldn’t think of any way to help her either.” You shrug. You reach over and pull another gumball out of her pocket, chewing and smacking it in sympathy for the villain.
rows.translation: 你惊讶地睁大双眼。“哦。我明白了，”你像个贤者般点头确认。“你办不到。那个，没关系。我也没想到任何帮助她的方法。”你耸耸肩，从她口袋里又拿出一颗口香糖球，为了同情这个恶棍而跟着咀嚼咂嘴。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour eyes widen with surprise. “Ooooh. I understand,” you confirm with a sagely nod. “You can’t do it. Like, that’s okay. I couldn’t think of any way to help her either.” You shrug. You reach over and pull another gumball out of her pocket, chewing and smacking it in sympathy for the villain."

rows.original: Appealing to her better nature was a long shot, to be honest. Looks like you’ll have to go after her ego if you want to get anywhere. You explain that the pexiga wasn’t reduced to what she is now by some brilliant scheme or technological triumph, but by nature taking its course. And since when is nature more powerful than science?
rows.translation: 老实说，诉诸她善良的一面本来就希望渺茫。看来想取得进展，你只能刺激她的自尊。你解释道，佩克西加变成如今这样并不是什么绝妙计划或科技胜利的成果，只不过是自然规律使然。可自然什么时候比科学更强大了？
rows.raw: "\n\nAppealing to her better nature was a long shot, to be honest. Looks like you’ll have to go after her ego if you want to get anywhere. You explain that the pexiga wasn’t reduced to what she is now by some brilliant scheme or technological triumph, but by nature taking its course. And since when is nature more powerful than science?"

rows.original: Doctor Badger looks offended. She scowls and snaps her pink-tinted goggles over her eyes. Bracing her fists on her curvaceous hips, she spits out her gum. “Woah now. That’s quite a little assumption you’re making. I didn’t say I COULDN’T do it. I can make anything into a bimbo. Give me a little time and I’ll make a rock into a total slut.”
rows.translation: 獾医生露出被冒犯的神情。她怒目而视，把粉色护目镜扣到眼前。双拳撑在曲线优美的胯部，她吐掉口香糖。“喂，等等。你这小家伙的假设可真大胆。我没说自己办不到。我能把任何东西变成花瓶女。给我一点时间，我连石头都能变成彻头彻尾的荡妇。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDoctor Badger looks offended. She scowls and snaps her pink-tinted goggles over her eyes. Bracing her fists on her curvaceous hips, she spits out her gum. “Woah now. That’s quite a little assumption you’re making. I didn’t say I COULDN’T do it. I can make anything into a bimbo. Give me a little time and I’ll make a rock into a total slut.”"

rows.original: You clap excitedly. “Oooo! Do it, do it, do it! Make the blue girl into the smartest bimbo ever! We’ll be best friends and, like, be sooooooooooo appreci- apprec- like we’ll be so thankful!” Badger eyes your [pc.hips] and [pc.ass] with an intensity that leaves your [pc.skinFurScales] feeling well-used. You bounce up and down in delight. “You can do it! I believe in Badger!”
rows.translation: 你兴奋地拍手。“哦哦哦！做吧，做吧，快做吧！把蓝皮姑娘变成史上最聪明的花瓶女！我们会成为最好的朋友，还会，那个，感激感激感，反正我们会超级感谢你的！”獾医生紧盯着你的[pc.hips]和[pc.ass]，那份强烈的目光让你的[pc.skinFurScales]感觉像被狠狠使用过。你开心地上下蹦跳。“你能做到！我相信獾医生！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou clap excitedly. “Oooo! Do it, do it, do it! Make the blue girl into the smartest bimbo ever! We’ll be best friends and, like, be sooooooooooo appreci- apprec- like we’ll be so thankful!” Badger eyes your [pc.hips] and [pc.ass] with an intensity that leaves your [pc.skinFurScales] feeling well-used. You bounce up and down in delight. “You can do it! I believe in Badger!”"

rows.original: It seems she’s getting quite riled up. Time to close the deal. You marvel at the theoretical accomplishment. To overcome biological programming and turn a vicious beast into a thinking person? Does she really have the technology to do such a thing? Can she, dare you say it, play god?
rows.translation: 看来她越来越激动了。该促成交易了。你对这项理论上的成就赞叹不已。克服生物编程，把一头凶猛野兽变成拥有思想的人？她真的拥有完成这种事的技术吗？她是否敢于，容你这么说，扮演神明？
rows.raw: "\n\nIt seems she’s getting quite riled up. Time to close the deal. You marvel at the theoretical accomplishment. To overcome biological programming and turn a vicious beast into a thinking person? Does she really have the technology to do such a thing? Can she, dare you say it, play god?"

rows.original: “You’re damned right I can!” she responds with a suitably self-satisfied grin on her face. Her whole body trembles, with what you hope is excitement. “Go get your little friend and by the time you get back, I should have something ready for the two of you,” she grins, her pink-tinted goggles casting a distorted reflection back at you.
rows.translation: “我当然能！”她回答，脸上挂着恰如其分的自满笑容。她全身都在颤抖，希望那是因为兴奋。“去把你的小朋友带来，等你回来时，我应该已经为你们俩准备好东西了，”她咧嘴一笑，粉色护目镜将扭曲的倒影投回你眼中。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re damned right I can!” she responds with a suitably self-satisfied grin on her face. Her whole body trembles, with what you hope is excitement. “Go get your little friend and by the time you get back, I should have something ready for the two of you,” she grins, her pink-tinted goggles casting a distorted reflection back at you."

rows.original: Are you really going to trust Dr. Badger to do what’s right?
rows.translation: 你真的要相信獾医生会做正确的事吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nAre you really going to trust Dr. Badger to do what’s right?"

rows.original: Get Pexiga
rows.translation: 带来佩克西加
rows.raw: "Get Pexiga"

rows.original: Just Leave
rows.translation: 直接离开
rows.raw: "Just Leave"

rows.original: Adjatha
rows.raw: "Adjatha"

rows.original: Doctor Badger is so funny sometimes. She seemed really excited about that thing she was going to do. You place your finger to your [pc.lipsChaste] and stand still in thought. Now what was it she wanted you to do? Oh pooh. You’ve forgotten it. Oh well! You’ll remember eventually!
rows.translation: 獾医生有时真有趣。她似乎对自己要做的那件事非常兴奋。你把手指抵在[pc.lipsChaste]上，站着沉思。她刚才要你做什么来着？哦，讨厌。你忘记了。算了！你迟早会想起来的！
rows.raw: "Doctor Badger is so funny sometimes. She seemed really excited about that thing she was going to do. You place your finger to your [pc.lipsChaste] and stand still in thought. Now what was it she wanted you to do? Oh pooh. You’ve forgotten it. Oh well! You’ll remember eventually!"

rows.original: You step out and release a breath you didn’t realize you’d been holding. Maybe Yammi was right. Dealing with people like Badger just isn’t worth the risk. Maybe somebody else in the galaxy can help the pexiga. You’ll just have to keep looking.
rows.translation: 你走出去，呼出一口自己都没意识到一直憋着的气。或许雅米说得对。和獾医生这样的人打交道，根本不值得冒险。也许银河里还有其他人能帮助佩克西加。你只能继续寻找。
rows.raw: "You step out and release a breath you didn’t realize you’d been holding. Maybe Yammi was right. Dealing with people like Badger just isn’t worth the risk. Maybe somebody else in the galaxy can help the pexiga. You’ll just have to keep looking."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Pexiga Help
rows.translation: 帮助佩克西加
rows.raw: "Pexiga Help"

rows.original: Ask for help with the Pexiga’s situation.
rows.translation: 请她帮忙解决佩克西加的困境。
rows.raw: "Ask for help with the Pexiga’s situation."

rows.original: Fix DollM.
rows.translation: 修复人偶师
rows.raw: "Fix DollM."

rows.original: Fix Doll Maker
rows.translation: 修复人偶师
rows.raw: "Fix Doll Maker"

rows.original: Doctor Badger does not have enough smarts to do this.
rows.translation: 獾医生没有足够的智慧完成这件事。
rows.raw: "Doctor Badger does not have enough smarts to do this."

rows.original: Fix DollM.
rows.translation: 修复人偶师
rows.raw: "Fix DollM."

rows.original: Fix Doll Maker
rows.translation: 修复人偶师
rows.raw: "Fix Doll Maker"

rows.original: Check with Doctor Badger on the progress of repairing the Doll Maker.
rows.translation: 询问獾医生修复人偶师的进度。
rows.raw: "Check with Doctor Badger on the progress of repairing the Doll Maker."

rows.original: Fix DollM.?
rows.translation: 修复人偶师？
rows.raw: "Fix DollM.?"

rows.original: Fix Doll Maker?
rows.translation: 修复人偶师？
rows.raw: "Fix Doll Maker?"

rows.original: Ask Doctor Badger about repairing the Doll Maker.
rows.translation: 询问獾医生修复人偶师的事。
rows.raw: "Ask Doctor Badger about repairing the Doll Maker."

rows.original: The small shred of goodness in you
rows.translation: 你心中残存的一小点善意
rows.raw: "The small shred of goodness in you"

rows.original: The good samaritan in you
rows.translation: 你心中的好心人
rows.raw: "The good samaritan in you"

rows.original: tells you to fix Badger’s toy that you broke (but then again, you were only defending yourself), even if they’re going to be used for... probably something that a normal person would question. The only other thing that crosses your mind is: ‘let’s just get this over with’.
rows.translation: 告诉你应该修好被自己打坏的獾医生玩具（不过话说回来，你当时也只是在自卫），即便它们之后会被用来做...大概是正常人都会质疑的事情。你脑中唯一掠过的另一个念头是：‘赶紧把这事做完吧’。
rows.raw: " tells you to fix Badger’s toy that you broke (but then again, you were only defending yourself), even if they’re going to be used for... probably something that a normal person would question. The only other thing that crosses your mind is: ‘let’s just get this over with’."

rows.original: You speak up to catch the doctor’s attention. “Hey, Badger. I noticed the Doll Maker is still broken down there. Did you want it fixed?” You ask neutrally. This is a pretty morally ambiguous situation, you feel it’s a better idea not to show emotion here.
rows.translation: 你开口引起医生的注意。“嘿，獾。我注意到人偶师还坏在下面。你想把它修好吗？”你语气平淡地问。这种情况在道德上相当暧昧，你觉得最好别在这里流露情绪。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou speak up to catch the doctor’s attention. “Hey, Badger. I noticed the Doll Maker is still broken down there. Did you want it fixed?” You ask neutrally. This is a pretty morally ambiguous situation, you feel it’s a better idea not to show emotion here."

rows.original: “Actually, yes, [pc.name]. Would you be a doll and fix it?” Badger jokes, before turning a little more serious. “I can fix most of it by myself, but didn’t you take some of the important parts when you were done with it?”
rows.translation: “其实，是的，[pc.name]。你愿意当个听话的人偶，替我修好它吗？”獾开玩笑道，随后稍微认真起来。“大部分东西我自己能修，但你解决它以后，不是拿走了一些重要零件吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Actually, yes, [pc.name]. Would you be a doll and fix it?” Badger jokes, before turning a little more serious. “I can fix most of it by myself, but didn’t you take some of the important parts when you were done with it?”"

rows.original: “Nope. Everything should be there,” you reply. “Even if they are broken.”
rows.translation: “没有。所有东西应该都在那里，”你回答。“就算它们已经坏了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nope. Everything should be there,” you reply. “Even if they are broken.”"

rows.original: “Yes. I might still have something laying around. That, or I sold it.”
rows.translation: “对。我手边可能还留着某样东西。要不然就是已经卖掉了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes. I might still have something laying around. That, or I sold it.”"

rows.original: “Regardless, I need to get back there and fix the other parts that you broke. Thanks for that, by the way.” Badger says, turning to you from the pile of junk. “Eh, let’s just head back now and have a look. Then we’ll see what errands you can do for me.”
rows.translation: “不管怎样，我得回到那里，修好被你弄坏的其他部件。顺便谢谢你啊。”獾从垃圾堆旁转向你说道。“唉，咱们现在就回去看看吧。之后再看看你能替我跑哪些腿。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Regardless, I need to get back there and fix the other parts that you broke. Thanks for that, by the way.” Badger says, turning to you from the pile of junk. “Eh, let’s just head back now and have a look. Then we’ll see what errands you can do for me.”"

rows.original: BIMBOTORIUM LAB
rows.raw: "BIMBOTORIUM LAB"

rows.original: You reluctantly head to the back of the lab with Badger. You pass by a shelf of increasingly big dildos (the largest one being bigger than a bazooka), before approaching the spindly collection of limbs. Badger looks at the components of the device.
rows.translation: 你不情愿地和獾一起走向实验室后方。你经过一排尺寸越来越大的假阳具（最大的一根甚至比火箭筒还大），随后来到那堆细长肢体前。獾检查着装置的各个组件。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reluctantly head to the back of the lab with Badger. You pass by a shelf of increasingly big dildos (the largest one being bigger than a bazooka), before approaching the spindly collection of limbs. Badger looks at the components of the device."

rows.original: “Well, first things first, the whole thing is damaged. Even with the few lost pieces, I’m going to need to fix some of the core parts. Let’s see what’s missing, though.” Badger starts to pull down pieces of the machine to look at them.
rows.translation: “好吧，首先，整套东西都坏了。即使不算那几个丢失的零件，我也得修复一些核心部件。不过先看看缺了什么。”獾开始拆下机器的部件逐一检查。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, first things first, the whole thing is damaged. Even with the few lost pieces, I’m going to need to fix some of the core parts. Let’s see what’s missing, though.” Badger starts to pull down pieces of the machine to look at them."

rows.original: “The IQ-B-GONE is... well, gone,” Badger says, looking at a spot where a syringe would clearly fit.
rows.translation: “智商清除剂...嗯，确实被清除了，”獾望着一个明显能装下注射器的位置说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The IQ-B-GONE is... well, gone,” Badger says, looking at a spot where a syringe would clearly fit."

rows.original: “Huh, looks like the lamp is missing,” Badger states, holding a flat piece where the Brainmelt lamp goes.
rows.translation: “嗯，看起来灯不见了，”獾拿着原本安装脑融灯的扁平部件说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Huh, looks like the lamp is missing,” Badger states, holding a flat piece where the Brainmelt lamp goes."

rows.original: “Damn. The Bimboleum emitter isn’t here,” Badger states, holding the broken limb.
rows.translation: “该死。花瓶素发射器不在这里，”獾握着断裂的机械臂说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn. The Bimboleum emitter isn’t here,” Badger states, holding the broken limb."

rows.original: “The Mindwash visor disappeared, unfortunately,” she says, looking at the bland, hanging piece.
rows.translation: “可惜，洗脑面罩也不见了，”她望着那块毫无特色的悬挂部件说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The Mindwash visor disappeared, unfortunately,” she says, looking at the bland, hanging piece."

rows.original: “Looks like everything is here. Nice. Now it just needs some basic repairs, and it’ll be up and running.” Badger smiles deviously.
rows.translation: “看来东西都在。很好。现在只需要做些基本修理，它就能重新运转。”獾不怀好意地笑了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Looks like everything is here. Nice. Now it just needs some basic repairs, and it’ll be up and running.” Badger smiles deviously."

rows.original: “Hm, and it looks like everything else is here... but needs some basic repairs before it’ll be up and running again.” Badger grins mischievously.
rows.translation: “嗯，其他东西似乎都在...不过需要做些基本修理，才能重新运转。”獾狡黠地咧嘴一笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hm, and it looks like everything else is here... but needs some basic repairs before it’ll be up and running again.” Badger grins mischievously."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Well, now we know what we need before I can get this bad boy going again. It’s been fun exploring other methods to... help out my patients, but there are other projects that require my full attention,” Badger explains before leading you back to the front of her lab. You get a clue where she is going with this.
rows.translation: “好吧，现在我们知道需要什么，才能让这个坏小子重新动起来了。探索其他方法来...帮助我的患者确实很有趣，但还有些项目需要我全神贯注，”獾解释道，随后带你回到实验室前方。你大概猜到她想说什么。
rows.raw: "“Well, now we know what we need before I can get this bad boy going again. It’s been fun exploring other methods to... help out my patients, but there are other projects that require my full attention,” Badger explains before leading you back to the front of her lab. You get a clue where she is going with this."

rows.original: “So I just need to find the missing parts?” you ask.
rows.translation: “所以我只需要找到丢失的零件？”你问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So I just need to find the missing parts?” you ask."

rows.original: “Yes. But you can’t exactly buy them anywhere. However, maybe if you ask nicely, I’ll tell you what I need to rebuild them.”
rows.translation: “对。不过那些东西可不是随处都能买到的。当然，也许你肯好声好气地问，我就会告诉你重造它们需要什么。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes. But you can’t exactly buy them anywhere. However, maybe if you ask nicely, I’ll tell you what I need to rebuild them.”"

rows.original: “Anything else?” Badger asks, an eyebrow cocked behind her goggles and a grin forming across her face.
rows.translation: “还有别的事吗？”獾问道，护目镜后的一边眉毛挑起，脸上渐渐露出笑容。
rows.raw: "“Anything else?” Badger asks, an eyebrow cocked behind her goggles and a grin forming across her face."

rows.original: “Luckily for you, I have plenty of this stuff already. Give it to the police and I’ll torture you. I’ll skip the bimbofication part and just hurt you.” Badger explains with a frightening coldness. You take a step back before she starts talking again. “Nah, I’m just fucking with you. But I would definitely turn you into the dumbest bimbo ever. Don’t. Get. Involved. With. The. Police.”
rows.translation: “你运气不错，我已经有很多这种东西了。要是把它交给警察，我就折磨你。我会跳过花瓶化，直接伤害你。”獾以令人胆寒的冷漠语气解释。你后退一步，她才再次开口。“没有啦，我只是逗你玩。不过我绝对会把你变成史上最蠢的花瓶女。别。去。招惹。警。察。”

rows.original: “Hey Badger, how would this work as a part for the Brainmelt lamp?” you ask, pulling out an electrogun, bought from Aurora. Though it’s not exactly amazing, you assume it’ll do the trick. Badger quickly pulls the gun from your hand, looking at it with a determined expression before setting it on her desk. She disassembles it with speed, before putting on a rubber glove and pulling out the electric core. She holds it up, the make-shift lamp glowing with sinister intensity in front of both of you.
rows.translation: “嘿，獾，这东西拿来当脑融灯的零件怎么样？”你一边问，一边拿出从奥萝拉那里买来的电击枪。虽然它并不算出色，但你觉得应该够用。獾迅速从你手中夺过枪，神情坚定地看了一眼，随后将它放到桌上。她飞快地拆开枪，戴上橡胶手套，取出电力核心。她将它举起，临时拼成的灯在你们面前散发出邪恶而强烈的光芒。
rows.raw: "“Hey Badger, how would this work as a part for the Brainmelt lamp?” you ask, pulling out an electrogun, bought from Aurora. Though it’s not exactly amazing, you assume it’ll do the trick. Badger quickly pulls the gun from your hand, looking at it with a determined expression before setting it on her desk. She disassembles it with speed, before putting on a rubber glove and pulling out the electric core. She holds it up, the make-shift lamp glowing with sinister intensity in front of both of you."

rows.original: “Hmm. I’d say it could work, though I’ll have to make some adjustments so it doesn’t break. Consider the Brainmelt lamp fixed,” Badger says. She grins before setting the core in a small jar and removing her glove. “I’m going down to put something together. Don’t do anything stupid while I’m gone.”
rows.translation: “嗯。我觉得可行，不过得做些调整，免得它损坏。脑融灯就算修好了，”獾说道。她咧嘴一笑，把核心放进一个小罐子，再脱下手套。“我要下去组装些东西。我不在的时候别干蠢事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm. I’d say it could work, though I’ll have to make some adjustments so it doesn’t break. Consider the Brainmelt lamp fixed,” Badger says. She grins before setting the core in a small jar and removing her glove. “I’m going down to put something together. Don’t do anything stupid while I’m gone.”"

rows.original: You find a place to sit for the time being until she proudly comes back. “The bad boy is closer and closer to being done every day. Can’t wait to use it again.”
rows.translation: 你暂时找了个地方坐下，直到她一脸骄傲地回来。“这个坏小子一天比一天更接近完工了。真等不及再次使用它。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou find a place to sit for the time being until she proudly comes back. “The bad boy is closer and closer to being done every day. Can’t wait to use it again.”"

rows.original: What’s a sinkhole in your accounts, right? You agree to pay Badger’s criminally insane price. She quickly swipes a credits scanner across your Codex and it confirms the payment with a beep.
rows.translation: 反正你的账户里不缺这一个无底洞，对吧？你同意支付獾那高得丧心病狂的价格。她迅速用信用点扫描器划过你的百科终端，终端发出一声提示音，确认付款。
rows.raw: "What’s a sinkhole in your accounts, right? You agree to pay Badger’s criminally insane price. She quickly swipes a credits scanner across your Codex and it confirms the payment with a beep."

rows.original: “Thanks. Pleasure doing business with you.” Doctor Badger grins, fingers tapping rhythmically along her desk top and drawing your attention to some spare mechanical parts, already spread out in full display, next to a carefully dismantled electrogun. It becomes painfully obvious to you that the money wasn’t necessary to order the parts, but more for her own personal amusement...
rows.translation: “谢谢。合作愉快。”獾医生咧嘴一笑，手指有节奏地敲击桌面，把你的注意力引向一些备用机械零件；那些零件已经明晃晃地摊开，旁边还摆着一把被仔细拆解的电击枪。你痛苦地意识到，那笔钱根本不是用来订购零件的，更像是为了满足她自己的恶趣味...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thanks. Pleasure doing business with you.” Doctor Badger grins, fingers tapping rhythmically along her desk top and drawing your attention to some spare mechanical parts, already spread out in full display, next to a carefully dismantled electrogun. It becomes painfully obvious to you that the money wasn’t necessary to order the parts, but more for her own personal amusement..."

rows.original: “Well, let’s start with the basics. To make some more Bimboleum, I’ll have to get a dose of Tittyblossom and Semen’s Friend. Both are somewhat common, you could probably get them at a gene mod store. Not too expensive either,” Badger explains.
rows.translation: “嗯，先从基本材料开始。要再制作一些花瓶素，我得弄到一剂乳房绽放剂和精液之友。这两样都比较常见，你大概能在基因改造商店买到。价格也不算贵，”獾解释道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, let’s start with the basics. To make some more Bimboleum, I’ll have to get a dose of Tittyblossom and Semen’s Friend. Both are somewhat common, you could probably get them at a gene mod store. Not too expensive either,” Badger explains."

rows.original: “Like, only two things? I’ll have that in no time!” you shout with glee.
rows.translation: “比如说，只要两样东西？我马上就能弄到！”你欢呼道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like, only two things? I’ll have that in no time!” you shout with glee."

rows.original: “Only two things that you need to worry about, anyway. Just get them, come back, and maybe have fun with some locals on the way. Enjoy yourself out there,” Badger suggests with a bit of enthusiasm. She’s so cool.
rows.translation: “反正只有两样需要你操心。把它们弄来再回来，路上也可以和当地人找点乐子。在外面好好享受吧，”獾颇为热情地建议。她真酷。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Only two things that you need to worry about, anyway. Just get them, come back, and maybe have fun with some locals on the way. Enjoy yourself out there,” Badger suggests with a bit of enthusiasm. She’s so cool."

rows.original: “Really? Only two ingredients?” you ask. “To permanently alter someone’s mind and body?”
rows.translation: “真的？只要两种原料？”你问。“就能永久改变一个人的身心？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Really? Only two ingredients?” you ask. “To permanently alter someone’s mind and body?”"

rows.original: “Good one, smartass, but there’s more ingredients I can handle myself, and I’m pretty sure you couldn’t get your hands on them even if you tried.” You roll your eyes while she continues. “And even if you could, you wouldn’t know how to sustain them.”
rows.translation: “说得好，自作聪明的混蛋。不过还有更多原料我自己能处理，而且我很确定，就算你想尽办法也弄不到。”你翻了个白眼，她则继续说道。“即便真能弄到，你也不知道该怎么保存它们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good one, smartass, but there’s more ingredients I can handle myself, and I’m pretty sure you couldn’t get your hands on them even if you tried.” You roll your eyes while she continues. “And even if you could, you wouldn’t know how to sustain them.”"

rows.original: “Fine, fine, I’ll get your damn mods. Relax.”
rows.translation: “好，好，我会把你该死的改造剂弄来。放松点。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fine, fine, I’ll get your damn mods. Relax.”"

rows.original: You quietly mutter “fucking bitch” on your way out.
rows.translation: 离开时，你低声嘟囔了一句“臭婊子”。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou quietly mutter “fucking bitch” on your way out."

rows.original: “Badger, I got the stuff,” you pipe up. “Tittyblossom and Semen’s Friend, right? I got them, right here.” You begin to ready the items, taking a cold wrapped popsicle and boxed pill from your inventory.
rows.translation: “獾，我拿到东西了，”你开口道。“乳房绽放剂和精液之友，对吧？我拿到了，就在这里。”你开始准备物品，从物品栏中取出一根有包装的冰棒和一盒药丸。
rows.raw: "“Badger, I got the stuff,” you pipe up. “Tittyblossom and Semen’s Friend, right? I got them, right here.” You begin to ready the items, taking a cold wrapped popsicle and boxed pill from your inventory."

rows.original: Badger turns her attention to you. “Oh, really? Good, because I’m ready to make another Bimboleum emitter.” You hand the transformatives to Badger, or rather, she snatches them from your hand. You dismiss the rude gesture and just watch her work. She seems to dissolve both things into a vial, before mixing several other ingredients into it. Before long, she dumps the mixture into an open gun with a satellite shaped front. She closes the gun and shakes it up some, mixing the questionable concoction within. She then aims the emitter at you.
rows.translation: 獾将注意力转向你。“哦，真的吗？很好，因为我正准备再做一把花瓶素发射器。”你把变形剂递给獾，更准确地说，是她从你手中一把抢了过去。你没有计较这粗鲁举动，只是看着她工作。她似乎把两样东西溶进一支小瓶，再往里面混入其他几种原料。没过多久，她便将混合物倒入一把敞开的枪中，枪口形似卫星。她合上枪身，摇晃几下，混合里面那种令人怀疑的调制物，随后把发射器瞄准你。
rows.raw: "\n\nBadger turns her attention to you. “Oh, really? Good, because I’m ready to make another Bimboleum emitter.” You hand the transformatives to Badger, or rather, she snatches them from your hand. You dismiss the rude gesture and just watch her work. She seems to dissolve both things into a vial, before mixing several other ingredients into it. Before long, she dumps the mixture into an open gun with a satellite shaped front. She closes the gun and shakes it up some, mixing the questionable concoction within. She then aims the emitter at you."

rows.original: “Yeah Badger, give me bigger boobies!” you shout. Badger pauses, staring at you before putting the gun down. You tilt your head and frown a little. “Aw...”
rows.translation: “好啊，獾，让我的奶子变得更大吧！”你大喊。獾停下动作，盯了你一会儿，随后把枪放下。你歪着头，略微皱眉。“唉...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah Badger, give me bigger boobies!” you shout. Badger pauses, staring at you before putting the gun down. You tilt your head and frown a little. “Aw...”"

rows.original: “It doesn’t even work without power, y’know.” She clicks the trigger on it a few times, to no effect. She simply detaches the trigger before putting the gun on her belt. “I’ll install this as soon as possible, where it WILL work... and you’ll be able to have all the fun you want with it.” Badger smiles, going back to her work.
rows.translation: “你知道吗，没有能源它根本不能用。”她扣了几次扳机，毫无反应。她直接拆下扳机，把枪挂到腰带上。“我会尽快把它安装好，到时候它就会真正生效...你也能拿它尽情享乐。”獾笑了笑，重新投入工作。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It doesn’t even work without power, y’know.” She clicks the trigger on it a few times, to no effect. She simply detaches the trigger before putting the gun on her belt. “I’ll install this as soon as possible, where it WILL work... and you’ll be able to have all the fun you want with it.” Badger smiles, going back to her work."

rows.original: “Woah, woah, easy there.” You put your arms up, defensively. Badger smiles before twirling the gun around her finger like a holo-movie gunslinger of sorts.
rows.translation: “哇，哇，放轻松。”你防御性地举起双臂。獾微笑着像全息电影里的枪手一样，让枪绕着手指转了一圈。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Woah, woah, easy there.” You put your arms up, defensively. Badger smiles before twirling the gun around her finger like a holo-movie gunslinger of sorts."

rows.original: “Calm down, scaredy cat. The power is off; I haven’t even charged the module yet.” She demonstrates by clicking the trigger a few times before just detaching it. “I’ll get this installed as soon as possible, where it WILL work.” The doctor says, smirking. She then clicks the gun onto her belt.
rows.translation: “冷静点，胆小鬼。能源关着呢，我甚至还没给模块充电。”她扣了几次扳机，展示它毫无反应，随后直接将其拆下。“我会尽快把它安装好，到时候它就会真正生效。”医生坏笑着说道，随后把枪扣在腰带上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Calm down, scaredy cat. The power is off; I haven’t even charged the module yet.” She demonstrates by clicking the trigger a few times before just detaching it. “I’ll get this installed as soon as possible, where it WILL work.” The doctor says, smirking. rows.translation: “你真没意思...不过没错，它已经以最完美的状态准备好了。我会叫一台货运机器人运送它。毕竟你照我说的做了，所以...我想我也得履行交易。”她像典型反派那样搓了搓手，接着说道：“我只能想象，多出这么多质量后，你的冒险经历会有多么不同。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re no fun... but yes, it is ready in all of its glory. I’ll get a cargo bot ready to ship it. After all, you did what I said, so... I guess I have to hold up my end of the bargain too.” She rubs her palms together, like a typical villain before continuing, “I can only imagine how your adventures were a bit different with all that extra mass.”"

rows.original: You leave Badger and head towards her lab to claim your pump.
rows.translation: 你离开獾，前往她的实验室领取自己的泵。
rows.raw: "You leave Badger and head towards her lab to claim your pump."

rows.original: And really? ‘You’re no fun?’ Well, maybe it’s because you’ve been carrying a hundred fucking gallons of silicone in your body for a week, but you’re a little tilted about that.
rows.translation: 说真的？“你真没意思？”好吧，也许是因为你他妈已经在体内装着一百加仑硅胶过了一周，但这话确实让你有点恼火。
rows.raw: " And really? ‘You’re no fun?’ Well, maybe it’s because you’ve been carrying a hundred fucking gallons of silicone in your body for a week, but you’re a little tilted about that."

rows.original: Approaching the silicone tank, you notice it’s already unplugged and ready for you to take. With your [pc.breasts] obscuring your view, you realize why: of course, Badger had no intentions of removing the bio-silicone inside you... that would just be too easy wouldn’t it?
rows.translation: 走近硅胶罐时，你注意到它已经拔掉插头，随时可供你带走。由于[pc.breasts]挡住视野，你这才意识到原因：獾当然根本没打算取出你体内的生物硅胶...那样未免太轻松了，不是吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nApproaching the silicone tank, you notice it’s already unplugged and ready for you to take. With your [pc.breasts] obscuring your view, you realize why: of course, Badger had no intentions of removing the bio-silicone inside you... that would just be too easy wouldn’t it?"

rows.original: A cargo bot zooms into view and lifts the tank up with relative ease. It hovers itself, payload and all, near you using anti-grav thrusters, tractor beams and sensors. A small ‘ding’ comes from your Codex, informing you that the drone is now tethered to your device, ready for you to guide. You then activate your Codex and manipulate the cargo bot to follow. You start flying it out, walking alongside it to make sure it doesn’t get tangled in any of the exposed cords and hanging wires strewn about the room.
rows.translation: 一台货运机器人呼啸着进入视野，相当轻松地抬起罐子。它利用反重力推进器、牵引光束与传感器，连同载荷一起悬浮到你附近。你的终端发出一声轻微的“叮”，告知这架无人机现已与你的设备绑定，随时可由你引导。你随后启动终端，操纵货运机器人跟随自己。你开始让它向外飞，同时走在旁边，确保它不会缠进散落在房间里的任何裸露线缆与悬挂电线。
rows.raw: "\n\nA cargo bot zooms into view and lifts the tank up with relative ease. It hovers itself, payload and all, near you using anti-grav thrusters, tractor beams and sensors. A small ‘ding’ comes from your Codex, informing you that the drone is now tethered to your device, ready for you to guide. You then activate your Codex and manipulate the cargo bot to follow. You start flying it out, walking alongside it to make sure it doesn’t get tangled in any of the exposed cords and hanging wires strewn about the room."

rows.original: Soon enough, you pass Badger, who immediately slaps your titanic ass on the way out, producing a loud SMACK! You yelp in surprise as the impact causes a mountainous ripple effect throughout your jiggly form which results in extra wobbles to your step when you exit.
rows.translation: 很快你便经过獾身旁；出门途中，她立刻拍了一下你的巨硕臀部，发出响亮的“啪”！你惊叫一声；冲击在你晃荡的身躯上激起山崩般的波纹，令你离开时每一步都摇得更加厉害。
rows.raw: "\n\nSoon enough, you pass Badger, who immediately slaps your titanic ass on the way out, producing a loud SMACK! You yelp in surprise as the impact causes a mountainous ripple effect throughout your jiggly form which results in extra wobbles to your step when you exit."

rows.original: Controlling the bot with your Codex, you leave Badger’s lab and walk through Novahome proper with relative ease, if not for you appearing like a moving plate of gelatin. With the goods ahead of you, you work your way up to the hangar and to your ship.
rows.translation: 你用终端控制机器人，离开獾的实验室，相对轻松地穿过诺瓦霍姆城区——如果不考虑你看起来像一盘移动的明胶。货物就在前方，你一路来到机库和自己的飞船。
rows.raw: "Controlling the bot with your Codex, you leave Badger’s lab and walk through Novahome proper with relative ease, if not for you appearing like a moving plate of gelatin. With the goods ahead of you, you work your way up to the hangar and to your ship."

rows.original: You open up your ship’s airlock door and tow the tank inside, moving it to your storage and placing it in the corner. After releasing the cargo bot’s control from the tank, you lead it outside before it beeps in confirmation, disconnects from your link, and begins its return to sender. It flies back in the direction of Badger’s lab, going out of sight after a few seconds.
rows.translation: 你打开飞船气闸门，将罐子拖进去，移到储藏区并放在角落。解除货运机器人对罐子的控制后，你将它引到外面；它发出确认蜂鸣，断开与你的连接，开始原路返回。它朝獾的实验室飞去，几秒后消失在视野中。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou open up your ship’s airlock door and tow the tank inside, moving it to your storage and placing it in the corner. After releasing the cargo bot’s control from the tank, you lead it outside before it beeps in confirmation, disconnects from your link, and begins its return to sender. It flies back in the direction of Badger’s lab, going out of sight after a few seconds."

rows.original: Closing the hatch as you come back in, you head to the silicone tank to set it up. Once everything is plugged in, you try out the tube. Your light squeeze produces tiny droplets of bio-silicone to spill from the needle-tip. It’s ready.
rows.translation: 回来后，你关上舱门，走到硅胶罐旁进行设置。一切接通后，你试了试软管。轻轻一挤，针尖便渗出几滴生物硅胶。已经准备好了。
rows.raw: "\n\nClosing the hatch as you come back in, you head to the silicone tank to set it up. Once everything is plugged in, you try out the tube. Your light squeeze produces tiny droplets of bio-silicone to spill from the needle-tip. It’s ready."

rows.original: You now have a silicone tank in your storage. It can be used at any time when in your ship via the Masturbation -> Installed menu.
rows.translation: 你的储藏区现在拥有一座硅胶罐。在飞船内时，可以随时通过自慰 -> 已安装菜单使用。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou now have a silicone tank in your storage. It can be used at any time when in your ship via the Masturbation -> Installed menu."

rows.original: “Hey Badger, you still got those blueprints?” You ask, starting to get some sexbot chips from your inventory. You walk over to the desk with the bimbo doctor.
rows.translation: “嘿，獾，你还留着那些蓝图吗？”你一边问，一边从物品栏取出一些性机器人芯片。你与花瓶女博士一起走向桌子。
rows.raw: "“Hey Badger, you still got those blueprints?” You ask, starting to get some sexbot chips from your inventory. You walk over to the desk with the bimbo doctor."

rows.original: “Yup! They’re right here!” Badger says, picking up a piece of paper. It has two large, blue paw prints on it. You roll your eyes at the evidence of blue paint on Badger’s fingers. How considerate of her to make new ‘blueprints’ for you. Nevertheless, you jingle the chips around in your hand as you look through the sex toys that have been tossed along the desk. She works fast, apparently.
rows.translation: “当然！就在这里！”獾拿起一张纸说道。纸上印着两个巨大的蓝色爪印。看到獾手指上残留的蓝色颜料，你翻了个白眼。她还真体贴，专门给你制作了新的“蓝图”。不过，你还是一边在手里摇响芯片，一边翻看被扔得到处都是的性爱玩具。显然，她动作很快。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yup! They’re right here!” Badger says, picking up a piece of paper. It has two large, blue paw prints on it. You roll your eyes at the evidence of blue paint on Badger’s fingers. How considerate of her to make new ‘blueprints’ for you. Nevertheless, you jingle the chips around in your hand as you look through the sex toys that have been tossed along the desk. She works fast, apparently."

rows.original: You toss the toys to the side, revealing Nym-Foe’s blue prints, now with a couple drops of Badger’s jizz on it. You avert your focus to the small section about the VI chip.
rows.translation: 你把玩具扔到一旁，露出尼姆-福伊的蓝图，上面现在沾着几滴獾的精液。你将注意力转向有关虚拟智能芯片的一小部分。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou toss the toys to the side, revealing Nym-Foe’s blue prints, now with a couple drops of Badger’s jizz on it. You avert your focus to the small section about the VI chip."

rows.original: After a fair bit of tinkering around with the sexbot chips and small pieces from electric sex toys, you finally finish the last piece of the VI chip, holding it up. Badger looks at the pink, octagonal chip with glee, like it’s some sort of prize.
rows.translation: 你用性机器人芯片和电子性爱玩具上的小零件折腾了好一阵，终于完成虚拟智能芯片的最后部分，将它举起来。獾欣喜地看着这枚粉色八边形芯片，仿佛它是什么奖品。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a fair bit of tinkering around with the sexbot chips and small pieces from electric sex toys, you finally finish the last piece of the VI chip, holding it up. Badger looks at the pink, octagonal chip with glee, like it’s some sort of prize."

rows.original: “You did it, Steele! Yay!” Badger exclaims happily, then pausing for a moment with a dumbfounded expression. “Wait. What was it for again?”
rows.translation: “你成功了，斯蒂尔！好耶！”獾开心地大喊，随后带着茫然表情停顿片刻。“等等。这又是拿来干什么的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You did it, Steele! Yay!” Badger exclaims happily, then pausing for a moment with a dumbfounded expression. “Wait. What was it for again?”"

rows.original: “Nym-Foe. We’re fixing her, remember?” You answer.
rows.translation: “尼姆-福伊。我们要修好她，记得吗？”你回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nym-Foe. We’re fixing her, remember?” You answer."

rows.original: “Oh yeah! Right! So... just go down there and pop it in. She’ll be so happy, and I’ll be so happy and she’ll make you happy! It’s wonderful!”
rows.translation: “哦对！没错！所以...只要下去把它塞进去。她会特别开心，我也会特别开心，然后她还会让你开心！太棒了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh yeah! Right! So... just go down there and pop it in. She’ll be so happy, and I’ll be so happy and she’ll make you happy! It’s wonderful!”"

rows.original: Welp, as Badger just said, you can go and fix Nym-Foe now.
rows.translation: 好吧，正如獾刚才所说，你现在可以去修复尼姆-福伊了。
rows.raw: "\n\nWelp, as Badger just said, you can go and fix Nym-Foe now."

rows.original: You access your inventory before pulling out six chips that you salvaged from sexbots, offering them up to Badger. She looks to your [pc.hand], observing the small pieces before lifting her goggles. She picks them up from your hands, one by one, looking at them closely before finally switching her attention back to you.
rows.translation: 你打开物品栏，取出六枚从性机器人身上回收的芯片，递给獾。她看向你的[pc.hand]，观察着那些小零件，然后抬起护目镜。她从你手中一枚枚拿走芯片，仔细察看，最后才把注意力重新转向你。
rows.raw: "You access your inventory before pulling out six chips that you salvaged from sexbots, offering them up to Badger. She looks to your [pc.hand], observing the small pieces before lifting her goggles. She picks them up from your hands, one by one, looking at them closely before finally switching her attention back to you."

rows.original: “Well, well, is someone eager to spend time with Nym-Foe?” Badger asks, bringing the chips over to a desk, clearing it quickly before dropping the pieces down.
rows.translation: “哎呀，哎呀，有人急着和尼姆-福伊共度时光吗？”獾问道，同时把芯片拿到桌边，迅速清理出空间，然后放下零件。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, well, is someone eager to spend time with Nym-Foe?” Badger asks, bringing the chips over to a desk, clearing it quickly before dropping the pieces down."

rows.original: “Regardless, just sit tight and I’ll cook something up in a jiffy. Then you can head down and pop it in.” You find the nearest flat surface that isn’t crowded by sex toys, and plant your [pc.ass] down onto it. You sit around for a few minutes, boredly twiddling your thumbs while Badger does her thing.
rows.translation: “总之，安心坐着，我马上就能做出点东西。然后你就可以下去把它塞进去。”你找到最近一块没有堆满性爱玩具的平面，将[pc.ass]坐到上面。你坐着等了几分钟，无聊地摆弄手指，任由獾忙活。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Regardless, just sit tight and I’ll cook something up in a jiffy. Then you can head down and pop it in.” You find the nearest flat surface that isn’t crowded by sex toys, and plant your [pc.ass] down onto it. You sit around for a few minutes, boredly twiddling your thumbs while Badger does her thing."

rows.original: “And that oughta do it!” she says. You pop up at her success, standing and heading toward her. She holds up a chip, colored light pink and octagonal in shape, unlike the blue and squared sexbot chips. You’re about to take it, but she places a furred palm against your forehead, stopping you clean. “Now, don’t break her this time, y’hear? She’s a nice girl who only thinks everyone deserves a free gift.”
rows.translation: “这样应该就行了！”她说道。见她成功，你一下站起身朝她走去。她举起一枚浅粉色的八角形芯片，与蓝色方形的性爱机器人芯片截然不同。你正要伸手接过，她却把毛茸茸的手掌抵在你额头上，干脆地拦住你。“这次别再把她弄坏了，听见没？她是个好姑娘，只不过觉得人人都该得到免费礼物。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And that oughta do it!” she says. You pop up at her success, standing and heading toward her. She holds up a chip, colored light pink and octagonal in shape, unlike the blue and squared sexbot chips. You’re about to take it, but she places a furred palm against your forehead, stopping you clean. “Now, don’t break her this time, y’hear? She’s a nice girl who only thinks everyone deserves a free gift.”"

rows.original: You slowly pull your head back before nodding gently.
rows.translation: 你缓缓把头向后缩，随后轻轻点头。
rows.raw: " You slowly pull your head back before nodding gently."

rows.original: You take her forearm and push it away.
rows.translation: 你抓住她的前臂，将其推开。
rows.raw: " You take her forearm and push it away."

rows.original: You pull your head back, looking at her for a few seconds with a ‘really’ expression on your face.
rows.translation: 你把头向后缩，用一副“你认真的？”表情看了她几秒。
rows.raw: " You pull your head back, looking at her for a few seconds with a ‘really’ expression on your face."

rows.original: She looks at you for another few seconds before suddenly tossing the chip up in the air, in your general direction.
rows.translation: 她也看了你几秒，随后突然把芯片朝你所在的大致方向抛到空中。
rows.raw: " She looks at you for another few seconds before suddenly tossing the chip up in the air, in your general direction."

rows.original: You catch it easily.
rows.translation: 你轻松接住了它。
rows.raw: "You catch it easily."

rows.original: It plops onto the floor before you can catch it, making you shamefully bend down to pick it up. You wouldn’t be surprised if Badger did it just to look at your ass.
rows.translation: 你没来得及接住，它啪嗒一声落在地上，害得你难堪地弯腰去捡。就算獾是故意这么做，只为看你的屁股，你也不会意外。
rows.raw: "It plops onto the floor before you can catch it, making you shamefully bend down to pick it up. You wouldn’t be surprised if Badger did it just to look at your ass."

rows.original: You approach the totally bimbofied doctor with a question. “Hey, Badger. You know about your robots? The ones I had to go through when we fixed the pexiga?”
rows.translation: 你带着问题走近这位彻底花瓶化的博士。“嘿，獾。你知道自己的那些机器人吧？就是我们修理佩克西加时，我不得不穿过的那些？”
rows.raw: "You approach the totally bimbofied doctor with a question. “Hey, Badger. You know about your robots? The ones I had to go through when we fixed the pexiga?”"

rows.original: “We FIXED the pexiga? I thought we were just making her smarter!” Badger exclaims, reeling back and cringing slightly. “What’s she going to do now?”
rows.translation: “我们把佩克西加修理好了？我还以为只是让她变聪明了！”獾惊叫着向后踉跄，微微缩起身子。“她现在要怎么办？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We FIXED the pexiga? I thought we were just making her smarter!” Badger exclaims, reeling back and cringing slightly. “What’s she going to do now?”"

rows.original: “No Badger, not that kind of fix. We did make her smarter. Forget about her anyway, and tell me about your robots,” you change the subject quickly before Badger gets too off topic. “How would you fix Nym-Foe?”
rows.translation: “不，獾，不是那种‘修理’。我们的确让她变聪明了。总之先别管她，告诉我你的机器人吧，”你赶在獾彻底跑题前迅速转移话题。“你会怎么修复尼姆-福伊？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No Badger, not that kind of fix. We did make her smarter. Forget about her anyway, and tell me about your robots,” you change the subject quickly before Badger gets too off topic. “How would you fix Nym-Foe?”"

rows.original: Badger puts a finger on her lower lip and looks up. “Nym-Foe is the one with the big boobs and silicone right?” You nod. “In that case... I dunno!”
rows.translation: 獾把一根手指抵在下唇，抬头思索。“尼姆-福伊就是那个胸很大、身体里都是硅胶的，对吧？”你点点头。“既然这样...我不知道！”
rows.raw: "\n\nBadger puts a finger on her lower lip and looks up. “Nym-Foe is the one with the big boobs and silicone right?” You nod. “In that case... I dunno!”"

rows.original: What a helpful answer, you think. “Maybe I could see her schematics? Do you have blueprints of her?” You ask. “If you can’t fix her, maybe I can.”
rows.translation: 真是个有用的回答，你心想。“也许我能看看她的结构图？你有她的蓝图吗？”你问。“如果你修不好她，也许我可以。”
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat a helpful answer, you think. “Maybe I could see her schematics? Do you have blueprints of her?” You ask. “If you can’t fix her, maybe I can.”"

rows.original: Badger nods and looks through the desk she’s standing at. You wait for her to pull out a big, blue piece of paper, but it doesn’t happen. Just sex toys fall out of the drawers. “I dunno where it went. Wait, what were we looking for again?”

rows.original: After looking through some boring and questionable items, you find it. A blue piece of paper, rolled up with a rubber band around it. You pull it out; it’s crumpled from its former position. You bring it to Badger and place it on her desk, rolling it out and flattening any creases with your forearm. The bimbo doctor watches you curiously while you observe the royal blue paper. The entire thing has Badger’s handwriting on it, and a computer printed image of Nym-Foe from the front and side. Let’s see... silicone storage, pleasure centers, blah blah blah, memory unit and VI chip. You look over the small section about what her VI chip is made of. Hey, these parts aren’t that uncommon; you could probably get crafty with some sexbot chips and make a special one for Nym-Foe.
rows.translation: 翻过一些无聊又可疑的物品后，你终于找到了。一张蓝纸卷成筒状，外面套着橡皮筋；你将它抽出来，它已经被原先存放的位置压得皱巴巴。你把它拿给獾，放到她桌上摊开，再用前臂压平褶皱。这位花瓶女博士好奇地看着你，而你则观察着深蓝色纸张。整张纸上都是獾的笔迹，还有一张由电脑打印的尼姆-福伊正面与侧面图。让我看看...硅胶储存、快感中枢，诸如此类，记忆单元和VI芯片。你仔细查看了介绍VI芯片构成的小段内容。嘿，这些部件并不罕见；你大概可以拿几枚性爱机器人芯片动手改造，给尼姆-福伊制作一枚特制芯片。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter looking through some boring and questionable items, you find it. A blue piece of paper, rolled up with a rubber band around it. You pull it out; it’s crumpled from its former position. You bring it to Badger and place it on her desk, rolling it out and flattening any creases with your forearm. The bimbo doctor watches you curiously while you observe the royal blue paper. The entire thing has Badger’s handwriting on it, and a computer printed image of Nym-Foe from the front and side. Let’s see... silicone storage, pleasure centers, blah blah blah, memory unit and VI chip. You look over the small section about what her VI chip is made of. Hey, these parts aren’t that uncommon; you could probably get crafty with some sexbot chips and make a special one for Nym-Foe."

rows.original: You come up with an estimate: you’ll need about six sexbot chips to make a custom VI chip for Nym-Foe.
rows.translation: 你作出估算：需要大约六枚性爱机器人芯片，才能为尼姆-福伊制造一枚定制VI芯片。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou come up with an estimate: you’ll need about six sexbot chips to make a custom VI chip for Nym-Foe."

rows.original: “Well, Badger, sit tight and I’ll be back later. Please don’t lose those blue prints,” you say, a little exasperated. You head out.

rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, Badger, sit tight and I’ll be back later. Please don’t lose those blue prints,” you say, a little exasperated. You head out."

rows.raw: "\n\n“I suppose,” you start again, “I, hum... wanted to see if it would be possible to fix one of them. The one that thinks I should be full of silicone, Nym-Foe, to be precise,” you admit. “The thing is, she needs a new VI chip to work.”"

rows.original: Badger turns her attention to you, away from what looks like a pile of never-ending junk. “Oh, you want to help me? You see, I don’t have stuff to make another chip at the moment. Say, if you’ve got some free time, you could take apart some of those sexbots and get their chips. I’m not sure how many I need to make a custom one for Nym-Foe. Probably... six or so.”
rows.translation: 獾将注意力从那堆似乎永远翻不完的破烂转到你身上。“哦，你想帮我？你看，我目前没有材料再造一枚芯片。这样吧，如果你有空，可以拆掉一些性爱机器人，取出它们的芯片。我不确定为尼姆-福伊定制一枚芯片需要多少。大概...六枚左右。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBadger turns her attention to you, away from what looks like a pile of never-ending junk. “Oh, you want to help me? You see, I don’t have stuff to make another chip at the moment. Say, if you’ve got some free time, you could take apart some of those sexbots and get their chips. I’m not sure how many I need to make a custom one for Nym-Foe. Probably... six or so.”"

rows.original: “Six? Can’t you just use one and reprogram it?” you ask.
rows.translation: “六枚？你就不能只用一枚，再重新编程吗？”你问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Six? Can’t you just use one and reprogram it?” you ask."

rows.original: “I only need a part of each chip. Nym-Foe’s a... special case. Made with love. And lots of silicone.” She smiles and shrugs. “Anyway, I don’t exactly NEED her fixed at the moment, but I’d be happy to have her up and running again. Now shoo. Go get those chips.”
rows.translation: “我只需要每枚芯片中的一个部件。尼姆-福伊是个...特殊案例。她是用爱，以及大量硅胶制造的。”她笑着耸耸肩。“总之，我目前并不是非得把她修好，不过能让她重新运转，我会很高兴。好了，快走吧。去把那些芯片拿来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I only need a part of each chip. Nym-Foe’s a... special case. Made with love. And lots of silicone.” She smiles and shrugs. “Anyway, I don’t exactly NEED her fixed at the moment, but I’d be happy to have her up and running again. Now shoo. Go get those chips.”"

rows.original: A small, prefab structure nestles in amongst the raskvel’s rickety shanties, so stark and clean that seems to exist in sheer willful defiance of the disarray surrounding it. The door is marked with a glowing, “No Entry” sign.
rows.translation: 一座小型预制建筑坐落在拉斯克维尔人摇摇欲坠的棚屋之间。它如此整洁醒目，仿佛仅凭顽强意志便在公然抗拒周遭的杂乱。门上标有一块发光的“禁止入内”告示。
rows.raw: "\n\nA small, prefab structure nestles in amongst the raskvel’s rickety shanties, so stark and clean that seems to exist in sheer willful defiance of the disarray surrounding it. The door is marked with a glowing, “No Entry” sign."

rows.original: The automatic door retracts and closes with the telltale, snake-like hiss of reliably constructed hydraulic propulsion. Inside, bright lights that would be more at home in a hospital than a backwater colony illuminate dozens of terminals, microsurgeon synthesizers, and nutrient baths holding organs from extraterrestrial races you’d be hard-pressed to identify. A glass-enclosed operating table is propped up in the back with its robotic, surgery-assisting arms cradled around it like the legs of a long-dead spider.
rows.translation: 自动门缩回后又合拢，发出制作精良的液压推进装置特有的蛇嘶声。室内的明亮灯光本应更适合医院，而非这处偏远殖民地；它们照亮了数十台终端、显微外科合成器，以及盛放着外星种族器官的营养液槽，那些器官让你很难辨认出所属种族。后方支着一张封在玻璃罩内的手术台，机器人辅助手术臂环抱其四周，犹如一只死去已久的蜘蛛伸出的腿。
rows.raw: "The automatic door retracts and closes with the telltale, snake-like hiss of reliably constructed hydraulic propulsion. Inside, bright lights that would be more at home in a hospital than a backwater colony illuminate dozens of terminals, microsurgeon synthesizers, and nutrient baths holding organs from extraterrestrial races you’d be hard-pressed to identify. A glass-enclosed operating table is propped up in the back with its robotic, surgery-assisting arms cradled around it like the legs of a long-dead spider."

rows.original: A bald creature half-hidden behind a blinking cabinet whips around at the sound of your arrival, barking, “Who’s there? Get out!”
rows.translation: 一个半藏在闪烁机柜后的秃头生物听到你到来的动静，猛地转过身吼道：“谁在那里？滚出去！”
rows.raw: "\n\nA bald creature half-hidden behind a blinking cabinet whips around at the sound of your arrival, barking, “Who’s there? Get out!”"

rows.original: As you consider your reply, you make a quick appraisal of the figure. It’s clearly a scientist, judging by the lab coat, but also inhuman - a dead giveaway thanks to the six sets of sleeves that dangle from the eggshell garment. Even without them, it couldn’t pass for a human. Pale gray skin and a flat, almost nonexistent nose make sure of that. Glowing goggles protrude from above its narrow nostrils, hiding the shape of the creature’s eyes behind a veil of shining crimson.
rows.translation: 思考如何回答时，你迅速打量了一番那个身影。从白大褂来看，它显然是个科学家，但也明显不是人类——那件蛋壳色衣服上垂着六组袖子，已经把这一点暴露无遗。即使没有这些袖子，它也无法冒充人类。苍白灰暗的皮肤和几乎不存在的扁平鼻子足以证明这一点。发光护目镜从它狭窄的鼻孔上方突起，将其双眼的形状藏在一层闪耀的猩红光芒之后。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you consider your reply, you make a quick appraisal of the figure. It’s clearly a scientist, judging by the lab coat, but also inhuman - a dead giveaway thanks to the six sets of sleeves that dangle from the eggshell garment. Even without them, it couldn’t pass for a human. Pale gray skin and a flat, almost nonexistent nose make sure of that. Glowing goggles protrude from above its narrow nostrils, hiding the shape of the creature’s eyes behind a veil of shining crimson."

rows.original: You fumble for a response. <i>“
rows.translation: 你支吾着回应：<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nYou fumble for a response. <i>“"

rows.original: Sorry! I was just looking around the town. No harm intended.
rows.translation: 抱歉！我只是想在镇上四处看看，绝无恶意。
rows.raw: "Sorry! I was just looking around the town. No harm intended."

rows.original: I was just takin’ a look around. No need to get your half-dozen hackles up.
rows.translation: 我只是四处看看。没必要让你六条胳膊上的寒毛全竖起来。
rows.raw: "I was just takin’ a look around. No need to get your half-dozen hackles up."

rows.original: The six-armed alien scowls and withdraws a half-dozen glowing plasma weapons from his sleeves. “As the neural impulses from the brain cease, the muscle tissue can become quite ‘loose’ before rigor mortis sets in. I suppose you’ll manage to make a mess of my lab once, should you persist down this route, but it will be a mistake you’ll be comically incapable of duplicating.” Sickly green light lends the room’s ambience a disturbing tint. “Now, are you going to make a mess of my lab?”
rows.translation: 六臂外星人怒目而视，从袖中抽出六把发光的等离子武器。“大脑的神经冲动停止后，肌肉组织会在尸僵出现前变得相当‘松弛’。我想，如果你坚持这么做，确实能把我的实验室弄乱一次，但这会成为一个你再也没有能力重复的错误，滑稽至极。”病态的绿光为房间染上一层令人不安的色调。“现在，你打算把我的实验室弄得一团糟吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe six-armed alien scowls and withdraws a half-dozen glowing plasma weapons from his sleeves. “As the neural impulses from the brain cease, the muscle tissue can become quite ‘loose’ before rigor mortis sets in. I suppose you’ll manage to make a mess of my lab once, should you persist down this route, but it will be a mistake you’ll be comically incapable of duplicating.” Sickly green light lends the room’s ambience a disturbing tint. “Now, are you going to make a mess of my lab?”"

rows.translation: 他停了下来。先前他背对你自言自语，现在却转过身，又用好奇的目光盯着你。“她有没有碰巧说过这件武器有什么作用？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe stops. He’d been facing away from you and talking to himself, but now he turns back and fixes you with another curious stare. “Did she say what this weapon did, by any chance?”"

rows.original: “Yep!” you answer happily. “She said it’ll turn someone into a nice slutty bimbo, like me!”
rows.translation: “说过！”你开心地回答。“她说它会把人变成像我一样乖巧淫荡的花瓶女！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yep!” you answer happily. “She said it’ll turn someone into a nice slutty bimbo, like me!”"

rows.original: “Hmm, I was afraid of that.” Doctor Lash is silent for a few moments, rubbing his chin and, like, clearly thinking really hard. “I wouldn’t expect anything less from someone like her. But the question is - dare I lower myself to that level? Can I bring myself to make someone a hypersexual ‘bimbo’” - he puts air quotes around that word with two of his spare hands, for some reason - “even if it’s to save many others from the same, or worse?”
rows.translation: “嗯，我就怕这个。”拉什医生沉默片刻，摩挲下巴，显然在非常认真地思考。“对她那种人，我也不会期待别的。但问题是——我敢不敢把自己降到那个层次？我能否狠下心把某人变成性欲过度的‘花瓶女’”——不知为何，他用两只空闲的手给这个词打上引号——“即使这样能拯救许多人免遭相同，乃至更糟的命运？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm, I was afraid of that.” Doctor Lash is silent for a few moments, rubbing his chin and, like, clearly thinking really hard. “I wouldn’t expect anything less from someone like her. But the question is - dare I lower myself to that level? Can I bring myself to make someone a hypersexual ‘bimbo’” - he puts air quotes around that word with two of his spare hands, for some reason - “even if it’s to save many others from the same, or worse?”"

rows.original: He stops and thinks, for like, a real long time. Is he maybe stuck? Does he need help? “Uh, yes?” you say eventually. “Beats not doing it, right?”
rows.translation: 他停下来思考了超级久。他是不是卡住了？需要帮忙吗？“呃，当然？”你终于说道，“总比什么都不做强，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe stops and thinks, for like, a real long time. Is he maybe stuck? Does he need help? “Uh, yes?” you say eventually. “Beats not doing it, right?”"

rows.original: “Huh,” he answers. “Out of the mouths of babes, I suppose...”
rows.translation: “嗯，”他回答，“真理出自孩童之口，我想...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Huh,” he answers. “Out of the mouths of babes, I suppose...”"

rows.original: Did he just call you a babe? “Thanks!”
rows.translation: 他刚才是不是夸你是宝贝？“谢谢！”
rows.raw: "\n\nDid he just call you a babe? “Thanks!”"

rows.original: “That’s... that wasn’t a compliment,” he says slowly.
rows.translation: “那是...那不是称赞。”他缓缓说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s... that wasn’t a compliment,” he says slowly."

rows.original: You giggle. “It is where I come from!”
rows.translation: 你咯咯一笑。“在我的家乡就是！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou giggle. “It is where I come from!”"

rows.original: “Anyway...” he says firmly, wiping his face with his hands, “I’ll do it. Let’s take a look at that raygun, shall we?”
rows.translation: “总之...”他坚定说道，用手擦了擦脸，“我会做的。让我们看看那把射线枪吧，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway...” he says firmly, wiping his face with his hands, “I’ll do it. Let’s take a look at that raygun, shall we?”"

rows.original: You hand it over, and he goes into the back of the lab. You sit down and stare forwards, zoning out a little as you wait for him, but then all of a sudden he’s back.
rows.translation: 你把枪递给他，他走进实验室后方。你坐下来望着前方，等待期间有些走神，但他突然就回来了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hand it over, and he goes into the back of the lab. You sit down and stare forwards, zoning out a little as you wait for him, but then all of a sudden he’s back."

rows.original: “A trivial procedure,” he says smugly. “I’ve adjusted its targeting parameters to function on Dr. Badger. It will be less powerful than it would have been on its original target - there were all sorts of quantum entanglements set up for that poor character that I have neither the time nor the inclination to replicate against Dr. Badger - but it will still be more than enough to put a stop to her perverted research and allow me to legitimately advance science in peace.”
rows.translation: “微不足道的程序，”他自鸣得意地说，“我已经调整瞄准参数，使其能对獾医生生效。威力会弱于作用在原定目标身上——那个可怜家伙身上设有各种量子纠缠，我既没时间也没兴趣在獾医生身上复制——但仍远远足以阻止她的变态研究，让我能够安心地正当推进科学。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A trivial procedure,” he says smugly. “I’ve adjusted its targeting parameters to function on Dr. Badger. It will be less powerful than it would have been on its original target - there were all sorts of quantum entanglements set up for that poor character that I have neither the time nor the inclination to replicate against Dr. Badger - but it will still be more than enough to put a stop to her perverted research and allow me to legitimately advance science in peace.”"

rows.original: He gives the gun back to you. “Now, if you would kindly go over and use it on her, both I and the universe at large would be very much obliged. Oh, one final note - and I cannot stress this enough - never, ever tell me how you experience the results.” He shudders, for some weird reason.
rows.translation: 他把枪还给你。“现在，如果你愿意过去把它用在她身上，我和整个宇宙都会非常感激。哦，最后提醒一句——这一点再怎么强调都不为过——永远、永远不要告诉我你是如何体验结果的。”不知为何，他打了个寒战。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe gives the gun back to you. “Now, if you would kindly go over and use it on her, both I and the universe at large would be very much obliged. Oh, one final note - and I cannot stress this enough - never, ever tell me how you experience the results.” He shudders, for some weird reason."

rows.original: You have no idea what most of the things he just said were, but you know enough to know that now all you need to do is go visit Dr. Badger again and zap her, then you can finally spread the bimbo fun!
rows.translation: 他刚才说的那些话，你绝大多数都完全听不懂；不过你懂得足够多，知道现在只需再次拜访獾医生，然后射她一下，你终于就能传播花瓶女的乐趣了！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have no idea what most of the things he just said were, but you know enough to know that now all you need to do is go visit Dr. Badger again and zap her, then you can finally spread the bimbo fun!"

rows.original: “So, uh”, you say hesitantly, aware that this will probably not be an enjoyable topic for him, “you know that doctor who’s set up just across from you?”
rows.translation: “所以，呃，”你迟疑地说道，知道这话题对他大概不会愉快，“你知道就在你对面开店的那位医生吧？”
rows.raw: "“So, uh”, you say hesitantly, aware that this will probably not be an enjoyable topic for him, “you know that doctor who’s set up just across from you?”"

rows.original: “Doctor!” he answers, and you get the impression he’d have spat that word with distaste if that didn’t seem like too much of a waste of perfectly functional saliva. “Calling someone a ‘doctor’ implies they add something to the universe - that they use their intelligence to improve technology or at least people’s health. And not, as ‘Doctor’ Badger does, actively try to reduce the intelligence of the population, all the while increasing their damnable licentiousness!”
rows.translation: “医生！”他回答；你觉得，如果吐口水不会浪费功能完好的唾液，他一定会厌恶地把这个词啐出来。“称某人为‘医生’，意味着对方为宇宙作出贡献——运用智慧改善技术，或者至少改善人们的健康。而不是像‘医生’獾那样，积极尝试降低民众智力，同时提升他们那该死的淫荡程度！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Doctor!” he answers, and you get the impression he’d have spat that word with distaste if that didn’t seem like too much of a waste of perfectly functional saliva. “Calling someone a ‘doctor’ implies they add something to the universe - that they use their intelligence to improve technology or at least people’s health. And not, as ‘Doctor’ Badger does, actively try to reduce the intelligence of the population, all the while increasing their damnable licentiousness!”"

rows.original: That definitely answers for what he thinks of her, you think. Out loud, you say, “Well, what if I told you I’ve got a way we can take care of her?”
rows.translation: 你想，这无疑回答了他对她的看法。你开口说道：“好吧，如果我说自己有办法解决她呢？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThat definitely answers for what he thinks of her, you think. Out loud, you say, “Well, what if I told you I’ve got a way we can take care of her?”"

rows.original: Doctor Lash gives a short, sharp rasp of a laugh. “Please. I’ve tried to... encourage her to move on myself in the past, but between her strength implants and the variety of mechanical traps she’s got set up in her... shack, all of our previous encounters have been little better than stalemates.” He leans forwards, the light from his goggles dimming slightly as though he was narrowing his eyes at you. “And what makes you think you could succeed where I failed?”
rows.translation: 拉什医生发出短促尖锐的嘶笑。“得了吧。我以前也试过...鼓励她搬走，但她有力量植入体，还有在那间...棚屋里设置的各种机械陷阱，我们先前所有交锋不过是僵局。”他向前俯身，护目镜的光芒稍稍变暗，仿佛眯眼打量你。“你凭什么认为自己能在我失败的地方成功？”
rows.raw: "\n\nDoctor Lash gives a short, sharp rasp of a laugh. “Please. I’ve tried to... encourage her to move on myself in the past, but between her strength implants and the variety of mechanical traps she’s got set up in her... shack, all of our previous encounters have been little better than stalemates.” He leans forwards, the light from his goggles dimming slightly as though he was narrowing his eyes at you. “And what makes you think you could succeed where I failed?”"

rows.original: He’s clearly trying to be intimidating, but you’ve seen worse by now than some six-armed scientist. Standing your ground, you shrug nonchalantly. “Well, she gave me this raygun to use on someone she wanted taken out of the way,” you say, taking out the gun and showing it to him. “And I was thinking - wouldn’t it be a shame if I just happened to zap Dr. Badger herself with it instead?”
rows.translation: 他显然想吓唬你，但如今你见过的东西比六臂科学家可怕多了。你守住立场，若无其事地耸肩。“她给了我这把射线枪，让我用来解决一个碍事的人，”你取出枪展示给他，“而我在想——要是我碰巧用它射中獾医生本人，那可真遗憾，不是吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe’s clearly trying to be intimidating, but you’ve seen worse by now than some six-armed scientist. Standing your ground, you shrug nonchalantly. “Well, she gave me this raygun to use on someone she wanted taken out of the way,” you say, taking out the gun and showing it to him. “And I was thinking - wouldn’t it be a shame if I just happened to zap Dr. Badger herself with it instead?”"

rows.original: There’s a pause as Doctor Lash regards the weapon in your hands, and then suddenly the lights of his goggles go wide. “Of course! It’s so simple, why didn’t I think of it?” He starts speaking quickly, one of his hands cradling his chin while the others gesture wildly. “She’s protected from physical assault, and any sort of electrical incapacitation too no doubt, but she wouldn’t make herself immune to her own technology, or else she couldn’t keep making herself so... ridiculously sexual. So if we turn her own weapon against her, then we’ll be able to... hm.”

rows.original: He seems genuinely conflicted by this, so you try to help him out. “Uh, yeah? The needs of the many outweigh the needs of the few, right?”
rows.translation: 他似乎对此真的很矛盾，于是你试着帮忙。“呃，当然？多数人的需要比少数人的需要更重要，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe seems genuinely conflicted by this, so you try to help him out. “Uh, yeah? The needs of the many outweigh the needs of the few, right?”"

rows.original: “Ah, excellent point!” he responds, nodding slowly. “Some actions, while distasteful, are necessary for the greater progress. And if we confront Dr. Badger now with her own designs, we’ll only be stopping her from inflicting them upon the galaxy at large. Now then!” He looks at you, his mouth twisting upwards in the closest approximation of a smile you’ve seen him adopt. “Let’s take a look at that raygun, shall we?”
rows.translation: “啊，精彩的观点！”他缓缓点头回应。“有些行动即使令人反感，也是推动更大进步所必需的。如果我们现在用獾医生自己的设计对付她，就只是阻止她把这些东西施加于整个银河。好了！”他望向你，嘴角向上扭曲，露出你见过他最接近微笑的表情。“让我们看看那把射线枪吧，好吗？”

rows.original: Stowing the weapon away again, you nod. Looks like you’re ready to turn the tables on Dr. Badger!
rows.translation: 你再次收好武器，点点头。看来你已经准备好扭转局势，对付獾医生了！
rows.raw: "\n\nStowing the weapon away again, you nod. Looks like you’re ready to turn the tables on Dr. Badger!"

rows.original: Quest item gained: Reprogrammed Bimbo Raygun!
rows.translation: 获得任务物品：重新编程的花瓶射线枪！
rows.raw: "\n\nQuest item gained: Reprogrammed Bimbo Raygun!"

rows.translation: 与拉什医生谈谈獾医生交给你、原本用来对付佩妮的射线枪，看看他能否帮你把它改成对獾医生生效

rows.original: The deranged doctor seems all too happy to discuss the fall of his rival across the way. “Oh, of course, it had been a minor conceit of mine that the miserable ‘Doctor’ Badger would be undone through my own machinations, but in truth it was a trivial thing. The expediency of her removal is all that matters. One less distraction from my visionary work.”
rows.translation: 这位疯狂医生似乎非常乐于讨论对面那位宿敌的倒台。“哦，当然，我曾有个小小的自负念头，希望那个可悲的‘医生’獾会毁在我的计谋之下，不过事实上，那无足轻重。迅速除掉她才是最重要的。我的远见工作从此少了一项干扰。”
rows.raw: "The deranged doctor seems all too happy to discuss the fall of his rival across the way. “Oh, of course, it had been a minor conceit of mine that the miserable ‘Doctor’ Badger would be undone through my own machinations, but in truth it was a trivial thing. The expediency of her removal is all that matters. One less distraction from my visionary work.”"

rows.original: Lashy seems a bit out of it. He’s normally so distant, but you think you can hear a little emotion leaking out here and there. You snap your fingers in realization: he probably misses Ms. Badger! He likes to complain, but it’s hard to stay mad at somebody as sexy as the Doc. He glances up in annoyance at your snap. Nodding emphatically, you offer your take on things: “You should invite the Police over for a chat! Maybe they know where Badger went off to, and you could go visit her just like old times!”
rows.translation: 小拉什似乎有些心不在焉。他通常如此疏离，但你觉得偶尔能听出一丝情绪流露。你恍然大悟地打个响指：他大概很想獾女士！他虽然爱抱怨，但面对医生这么性感的人，很难一直生气。他因你的响指而恼火地抬眼。你用力点头，说出自己的看法：“你该邀请警察过来聊聊！也许他们知道獾去了哪里，你就能像以前一样去看她了！”
rows.raw: "\n\nLashy seems a bit out of it. He’s normally so distant, but you think you can hear a little emotion leaking out here and there. You snap your fingers in realization: he probably misses Ms. Badger! He likes to complain, but it’s hard to stay mad at somebody as sexy as the Doc. He glances up in annoyance at your snap. Nodding emphatically, you offer your take on things: “You should invite the Police over for a chat! Maybe they know where Badger went off to, and you could go visit her just like old times!”"

rows.original: Lash seems a little less collected than usual. Perhaps he’s actually a bit nervous about having UGC agents so close to his sanctuary. After all, the immaculately clean building sticks out like a sore thumb amid the greasy, patchwork menagerie of the rest of Novahome. Carefully, you broach the topic of the Peacekeepers themselves. Rather than waiting around and hoping they don’t notice him, why not take the initiative. After all, he doesn’t want to end up like Badger: on the run or in custody.
rows.translation: 拉什似乎不像平时那样镇定。银河联合邦联探员离他的避难所这么近，也许确实让他有些紧张。毕竟，在新星家园其他区域那片油腻、拼凑而成的百态杂烩中，这栋一尘不染的建筑显眼得要命。你谨慎提起维和警察。与其干等着，祈祷他们别注意到他，何不主动出击。毕竟，他可不想落得獾那样的下场：逃亡或被拘押。
rows.raw: "\n\nLash seems a little less collected than usual. Perhaps he’s actually a bit nervous about having UGC agents so close to his sanctuary. After all, the immaculately clean building sticks out like a sore thumb amid the greasy, patchwork menagerie of the rest of Novahome. Carefully, you broach the topic of the Peacekeepers themselves. Rather than waiting around and hoping they don’t notice him, why not take the initiative. After all, he doesn’t want to end up like Badger: on the run or in custody."

rows.original: Dr. Lash’s glowing red goggles dim as he regard you critically. “Ordinarily, I would reject such an idiotic proposition out of hand. However, the thought that these men of the law may take an interest above their paygrade had occurred to me prior to this conversation.”
rows.translation: 拉什医生发红光的护目镜变暗，挑剔地打量你。“通常，我会立刻拒绝如此愚蠢的提议。不过，在这次谈话之前，我确实已经想到，这些执法人员或许会关注超出他们薪资等级的事情。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDr. Lash’s glowing red goggles dim as he regard you critically. “Ordinarily, I would reject such an idiotic proposition out of hand. However, the thought that these men of the law may take an interest above their paygrade had occurred to me prior to this conversation.”"

rows.original: You ask if that means he’ll meet them himself.
rows.translation: 你问这是否意味着他会亲自去见他们。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask if that means he’ll meet them himself."

rows.original: The neuter turns a withering gaze on you. “Just as I had hoped a small glimmer of insight had wormed its way into the sex-addled mucus of your brain... No, of course I will not accost these bureaucratic puppets myself. Like a smart man, I will be using a machine to redirect their attention. Observe.” Dr. Lash produces a small, slim controller from a pocket and presses a button.
rows.translation: 这个无性人以鄙夷目光望着你。“我还以为，一小丝洞察力终于钻进了你被性欲浸透的大脑黏液里...不，我当然不会亲自去招惹这些官僚傀儡。像聪明人一样，我会用机器转移他们的注意。看好了。”拉什医生从口袋里取出一只纤薄的小控制器，按下按钮。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe neuter turns a withering gaze on you. “Just as I had hoped a small glimmer of insight had wormed its way into the sex-addled mucus of your brain... No, of course I will not accost these bureaucratic puppets myself. Like a smart man, I will be using a machine to redirect their attention. Observe.” Dr. Lash produces a small, slim controller from a pocket and presses a button."

rows.original: A tremendous shock cracks through Novahome, the walls around you shuddering as the vessel-turned-city shakes under the muffled percussion of a distant bomb being detonated. Your eyes widen and you turn to ask him what that was, but the sinister figure predicts your question before you can even open your mouth.
rows.translation: 一声猛烈震响撕裂新星家园；由飞船改造的城市在远方炸弹爆炸的沉闷冲击下摇晃，周围墙壁不断颤抖。你瞪大眼睛，转身想问那是什么，可这个阴险人物在你开口前便预料到问题。
rows.raw: "\n\nA tremendous shock cracks through Novahome, the walls around you shuddering as the vessel-turned-city shakes under the muffled percussion of a distant bomb being detonated. Your eyes widen and you turn to ask him what that was, but the sinister figure predicts your question before you can even open your mouth."

rows.original: “A small bomb I planted in the western end of the city. Nothing world-shattering, of course.” His thin lips twist in a mild smile. “Just something I had left over from my attempts to dispose of that wretched Badger creature. Alas, she never rose to my bait and remained firmly ensconced in her lair until UGC intervention. Ah well...” He sighs at the missed opportunity for murder.
rows.translation: “我在城市西端埋了一枚小炸弹。当然，不是什么毁天灭地的东西。”他薄薄的嘴唇扭出淡淡微笑。“只是我先前试图除掉那个可恨獾生物时留下的东西。可惜，她一直没上钩，始终牢牢躲在巢穴里，直到银河联合邦联介入。唉...”他为错失谋杀机会而叹气。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A small bomb I planted in the western end of the city. Nothing world-shattering, of course.” His thin lips twist in a mild smile. “Just something I had left over from my attempts to dispose of that wretched Badger creature. Alas, she never rose to my bait and remained firmly ensconced in her lair until UGC intervention. Ah well...” He sighs at the missed opportunity for murder."

rows.original: “For my purposes now,” Lash continues, as if lecturing a particularly dim pupil, “the blast will be just large enough to incite a panic and redirect UGC attention. In all likelihood, they will determine it to be a further plot by those insipid pirates.
rows.translation: “至于我现在的目的，”拉什继续说道，语气像在教导一个格外愚钝的学生，“爆炸规模刚好足以引发恐慌，转移银河联合邦联的注意。他们极有可能认定，这是那些乏味海盗的又一场阴谋。
rows.raw: "\n\n“For my purposes now,” Lash continues, as if lecturing a particularly dim pupil, “the blast will be just large enough to incite a panic and redirect UGC attention. In all likelihood, they will determine it to be a further plot by those insipid pirates."

rows.original: Or perhaps a parting gift.
rows.translation: 或许是份临别礼物。
rows.raw: " Or perhaps a parting gift."

rows.original: In any event, the necessity for their lackies to remain near my residence will be found wanting.”
rows.translation: 无论如何，他们那些走狗都没有必要继续留在我的住所附近了。”
rows.raw: " In any event, the necessity for their lackies to remain near my residence will be found wanting.”"

rows.original: Dr. Lash turns his full attention to you and you can just about feel the severity of his mad fervor like a weight on your chest. “I presume you had some errand to focus on in that cordoned shack. You may go and tend to your affairs now. Be forewarned, however: this was not a favor. I redirected the Peacekeepers for my personal advantage alone. I will not be tapped for trivial errands, and those who presume to do so may find themselves on the operative end of the next detonation.” He turns back to his work, dismissing you with an absent wave of his hand.
rows.translation: 莱什博士将全部注意力转向你；你几乎能感到他那疯狂热忱的沉重压迫，如同压在胸口一般。“我想，你到那间被封锁的小屋里应当是有什么差事要办。现在你可以去处理自己的事务了。不过我警告你：这可不是什么人情。我调走治安官纯粹是为了我个人的利益。我不会任人差遣去办鸡毛蒜皮的小事，而胆敢如此妄想的人，或许会发现自己正站在下一次爆炸的作用端。”他转身继续工作，心不在焉地挥挥手，示意你离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nDr. Lash turns his full attention to you and you can just about feel the severity of his mad fervor like a weight on your chest. “I presume you had some errand to focus on in that cordoned shack. You may go and tend to your affairs now. Be forewarned, however: this was not a favor. I redirected the Peacekeepers for my personal advantage alone. I will not be tapped for trivial errands, and those who presume to do so may find themselves on the operative end of the next detonation.” He turns back to his work, dismissing you with an absent wave of his hand."

rows.original: Whew, what a relief. All this thinking and talking was starting to make you feel dizzy. Lashy just is not as much fun as Doc Badger. Not by a long shot!
rows.translation: 呼，真让人松了口气。想了这么多、说了这么久，你都开始觉得头晕了。小莱什可远不如獾医生有趣。差得远呢！

rows.original: You’re not sure if you should thank him or draw your weapon. The man’s barking mad, that much is obvious. rows.original: Doctor Lash waves dismissively. “You release one genitalia-eradicating virus into a planet’s stratosphere, and somehow you become a wanted criminal. It’s not my fault they didn’t have microsurgeon-boosted immune systems, or that they weren’t up to date enough to handle my specially-engineered bypasses. Honestly, I merely provided them with the motivation to pursue a more erudite method of procreation. How was I to know that the cessation of sex tourism would put their economy into the tank?”
rows.translation: 莱什博士不屑地挥挥手。“不过是向一颗星球的平流层投放了一种根除生殖器的病毒，不知怎么就成了通缉犯。他们没有经过微型外科机器人强化的免疫系统，不是我的错；他们的技术不够先进，无法应付我特别设计的绕过机制，也不是我的错。老实说，我只是给了他们动力，去追求一种更有学识的繁殖方式。我怎么会知道，性旅游业的终结会让他们的经济一落千丈？”

It’s not my fault they didn’t have microsurgeon-boosted immune systems, or that they weren’t up to date enough to handle my specially-engineered bypasses. Honestly, I merely provided them with the motivation to pursue a more erudite method of procreation. How was I to know that the cessation of sex tourism would put their economy into the tank?”"
