rows.original: “Don’t be silly, [pc.name]. That would be terribly evil. I only sterilized the planet’s dominant sapient life form. Everything else could be handled after their culture caught up to their bodies, assuming the UGC hadn’t sent their Peacekeeper dogs after me.” Doctor Lash’s body quivers like a guitar string pulled too tight. “The ausar bitches couldn’t see the beauty in what I was doing, so I had to run here, away from galactic law enforcement. It’ll take me the better part of a terran century to replicate the research I lost, but it’ll be worth it. You’ll see. You’ll all see!”
rows.translation: “别犯傻了，[pc.name]。那样未免太邪恶了。我只让这颗星球占主导地位的智慧生命绝育。等他们的文化追上身体的变化，其他一切自然都能处理，前提是联合银河邦联没有派治安官走狗追捕我。”莱什博士的身体像绷得过紧的吉他弦一样颤动。“那些奥萨母狗看不出我的事业有多美好，所以我只得逃到这里，躲开银河执法机构。我要花掉一个地球世纪的大半时间，才能重建失去的研究，但这一切都会值得。你会看到的。你们都会看到的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t be silly, [pc.name]. That would be terribly evil. I only sterilized the planet’s dominant sapient life form. Everything else could be handled after their culture caught up to their bodies, assuming the UGC hadn’t sent their Peacekeeper dogs after me.” Doctor Lash’s body quivers like a guitar string pulled too tight. “The ausar bitches couldn’t see the beauty in what I was doing, so I had to run here, away from galactic law enforcement. It’ll take me the better part of a terran century to replicate the research I lost, but it’ll be worth it. You’ll see. You’ll all see!”"

rows.raw: "“Why do this? Why focus on the removal of sexual urges, desires, and organs?”"

rows.original: Doctor Lash rubs his chin thoughtfully. “That... is a surprisingly astute question, [pc.name]. ‘Why’ is the great question, after all. It is perhaps the root question, the one that fascinates even the youngest of the younglings. Why indeed.” He leans against the cold metal of a table and thinks. “The answer may be more simple than you think. Often the most complicated issues spring forth from the most simple of drives.”
rows.translation: 莱什博士若有所思地摩挲着下巴。“这个...问题敏锐得出人意料，[pc.name]。毕竟，‘为什么’才是终极问题。它或许是最根本的问题，就连最年幼的孩童也会为之着迷。究竟为什么呢。”他靠在一张冰冷的金属桌上思考起来。“答案也许比你想象得更简单。最复杂的问题，往往源于最简单的冲动。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDoctor Lash rubs his chin thoughtfully. “That... is a surprisingly astute question, [pc.name]. ‘Why’ is the great question, after all. It is perhaps the root question, the one that fascinates even the youngest of the younglings. Why indeed.” He leans against the cold metal of a table and thinks. “The answer may be more simple than you think. Often the most complicated issues spring forth from the most simple of drives.”"

rows.original: You look at him, still awaiting an answer.
rows.translation: 你看着他，仍在等待答案。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look at him, still awaiting an answer."

rows.original: He meets your gaze with his mechanical, crimson eyes and smiles in a way that sends shivers down your spine. “Simple experimentation. I worked for a company that delighted in all things sexual. You might have heard of them - TamaniCorp. They make a significant profit with the volume of business they’re dealing, all based on the back of reproduction-driven perversions. I decided the best way to deepen my understanding of the relevant tissues was to experiment on my own, starting with a thorough, microsurgeon-assisted deconstruction.”
rows.translation: 他用那双机械的猩红眼睛与你对视，露出令你脊背发寒的笑容。“单纯的实验。我曾效力于一家沉迷于一切性事的公司。你或许听说过，塔玛妮集团。他们靠以繁殖为动力的种种癖好大发其财，生意规模相当可观。我决定，若要加深自己对相关组织的理解，最好的方法就是拿自己做实验，从借助微型外科机器人进行彻底拆解开始。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe meets your gaze with his mechanical, crimson eyes and smiles in a way that sends shivers down your spine. “Simple experimentation. I worked for a company that delighted in all things sexual. You might have heard of them - TamaniCorp. I decided the best way to deepen my understanding of the relevant tissues was to experiment on my own, starting with a thorough, microsurgeon-assisted deconstruction.”"

rows.original: Looking intently at your reaction, Doctor Lash asks, “Do you know what I found?”
rows.translation: 莱什博士专注地观察着你的反应，问道：“你知道我发现了什么吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nLooking intently at your reaction, Doctor Lash asks, “Do you know what I found?”"

rows.original: You answer with a brief, negative shake of your head.

rows.raw: "\n\nYou answer with a brief, negative shake of your head."

rows.original: “I found clarity. I found peace.” He straightens the folds of his labcoat and straightens his posture. “I found solace from the pernicious, throbbing desires of my loins. I could focus on my work without my body’s base needs constantly threatening to derail my train of thought. I knew immediately that I could never go back to the way I was. There was no point in it. If anything, others had to join me. As you can imagine, I self-terminated my employment not long after.”
rows.translation: “我找到了清明。我找到了平静。”他理平白大褂的褶皱，挺直身子。“我从下体那有害而悸动的欲望中得到了解脱。我终于能专心工作，不必再让身体的低级需求时时威胁着打断思路。我立刻明白，自己再也不能回到从前的状态。那毫无意义。若一定要说，其他人也必须加入我。你可以想象，没过多久我就主动终止了雇佣关系。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I found clarity. I found peace.” He straightens the folds of his labcoat and straightens his posture. “I found solace from the pernicious, throbbing desires of my loins. If anything, others had to join me. As you can imagine, I self-terminated my employment not long after.”"

rows.raw: "\n\nThe six-armed alien scowls and withdraws a half-dozen glowing plasma weapons from his sleeves. “I had hoped you would rise against such impulses. Desist, or I will ensure that you are incapable of ever distracting me again.”"

rows.original: The gray-skinned doctor keeps his eerie, crimson goggles trained on you as you explain the pexiga’s situation to him. “Ah hah,” he replies once you’re done. “There we have it. The very essence of my thesis in one, succinct allegory. A dynamic creature, robbed of volition by its base, procreational instinct. Lobotomized by nature and enslaved by commerce. How dreadfully amusing. I will have to keep that story in mind the next time I have a U.G.C. bounty hunter in my tender mercies.” His tight mouth curls up in the faintest ghost of a smile that leaves chills in your spine.
rows.translation: 灰皮肤的博士用那副诡异的猩红护目镜始终盯着你；你向他解释了佩克西加的处境。听完后，他答道：“啊哈。”“这下就有了。一个简洁的寓言，概括了我论点的精髓。一个充满活力的生物，却被低级的繁殖本能夺去了意志。遭自然切除前额叶，又受商业奴役。多么可悲又可笑。下次有联合银河邦联的赏金猎人落入我温柔的掌握时，我一定得记住这个故事。”他紧绷的嘴角勾起一丝若有若无的微笑，令你脊背发寒。
rows.raw: "The gray-skinned doctor keeps his eerie, crimson goggles trained on you as you explain the pexiga’s situation to him. “Ah hah,” he replies once you’re done. “There we have it. The very essence of my thesis in one, succinct allegory. A dynamic creature, robbed of volition by its base, procreational instinct. Lobotomized by nature and enslaved by commerce. How dreadfully amusing. I will have to keep that story in mind the next time I have a U.G.C. bounty hunter in my tender mercies.” His tight mouth curls up in the faintest ghost of a smile that leaves chills in your spine."

rows.original: You blink. Were those even words? Lashy is always so confusing. “So, like, you mean you... CAN’T do it?” Better to be sure, just in case.
rows.translation: 你眨眨眼。那些真的是人话吗？小莱什总是这么让人摸不着头脑。“所以，你的意思是...你做不到？”保险起见，还是问清楚比较好。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou blink. Were those even words? Lashy is always so confusing. “So, like, you mean you... CAN’T do it?” Better to be sure, just in case."

rows.original: What about the pexiga, you urge. Couldn’t a scientist of his caliber do something to fix what nature broke?
rows.translation: 你催促他谈谈佩克西加的事。像他这种水平的科学家，难道不能修复自然造成的缺陷吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat about the pexiga, you urge. Couldn’t a scientist of his caliber do something to fix what nature broke?"

rows.original: “Allow me to assure you, the reach of my research exceeds imagination in every sense. Ameliorating cognitive impairment is a trifle. By all means, bring me your beast. I will remove its sexual attributes and restore it to its former state.”
rows.translation: “我可以向你保证，我的研究成果在各方面都超越了想象。改善认知障碍不过是小事。尽管把你的野兽带来。我会移除它的性征，让它恢复原状。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Allow me to assure you, the reach of my research exceeds imagination in every sense. Ameliorating cognitive impairment is a trifle. By all means, bring me your beast. I will remove its sexual attributes and restore it to its former state.”"

rows.original: “Oh, that’s no good! Without sexy bits, how is she supposed to enjoy herself? Plus, aren’t normal pexiga, like, super dangerous?”
rows.translation: “哦，那可不行！没有性感部位，她还怎么享受？而且，正常的佩克西加不是超级危险吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, that’s no good! Without sexy bits, how is she supposed to enjoy herself? Plus, aren’t normal pexiga, like, super dangerous?”"

rows.original: That wasn’t exactly what you had in mind. You were more hoping for intelligence. Pexiga are incredibly aggressive carnivores in their natural state.
rows.translation: 这和你的想法不太一样。你更希望她获得智慧。佩克西加在自然状态下是极具攻击性的食肉动物。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat wasn’t exactly what you had in mind. You were more hoping for intelligence. Pexiga are incredibly aggressive carnivores in their natural state."

rows.original: “And?” Lash replies curtly. “Is it not enough to unmake the chemical shackles of licentiousness? Besides, even with a passable intellect, your creature must invariably revert to instinctive drives.”
rows.translation: “所以呢？”莱什简短地答道。“解除淫欲的化学枷锁还不够吗？况且，即便有了勉强过得去的智力，你的生物也必然会重新受本能驱使。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And?” Lash replies curtly. “Is it not enough to unmake the chemical shackles of licentiousness? Besides, even with a passable intellect, your creature must invariably revert to instinctive drives.”"

rows.raw: "\n\nHow can somebody so smart be so dumb? "

rows.original: “It is of no particular interest to me what you do with the wretched thing,” Lash replies, dismissively. “Get a particularly thick chain and use it as a guard dog, perhaps.” He returns to his research, apparently unwilling to devote even a moment longer to your humanitarian request.
rows.translation: “你要怎么处置那可悲的东西，我一点也不关心。”莱什不屑地答道。“也许可以找条特别粗的链子，把它当看门狗用。”他重新投入研究，显然不愿再为你的人道请求多花哪怕片刻时间。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It is of no particular interest to me what you do with the wretched thing,” Lash replies, dismissively. “Get a particularly thick chain and use it as a guard dog, perhaps.” He returns to his research, apparently unwilling to devote even a moment longer to your humanitarian request."

rows.original: What a bummer! Lashy could fix her but only by making her into some kinda monster. What a tease! Like how he has all those arms but he never offers to hug you or grope you or nothing. Guess you’ll have to keep lookin’ for some geni-thingies. Smarty pantses. Who else has a big brain?

Guess you’ll have to keep lookin’ for some geni-thingies. Smarty pantses. Who else has a big brain?"

rows.original: Lash’s mouth curls into an unkind sneer. “Please. Don’t pretend your motives equate to my own.” He waves two of his arms dismissively. “It does not take a genius to see which arguments might appeal to me. Nonetheless, you display at least a token of problem-solving ability, and more importantly, your claim has some merit.” Doctor Lash pauses for effect, then pauses some more. Once the air is suitably uncomfortable, he explains, “There are many diseases which render the infected more... amenable to sexual contact - and reproduction. Both are enemies of the reasoning mind. And it is true that many species have little regard for consent.”
rows.translation: 莱什的嘴角扭成一个不怀好意的冷笑。“拜托。别假装你的动机和我的一样。”他不屑地挥动两条手臂。“看出什么论点能打动我，并不需要天才头脑。尽管如此，你至少表现出了些许解决问题的能力；更重要的是，你的说法确有几分道理。”莱什博士故意停顿了一下，又停顿了更久。等气氛变得足够难受，他才解释道：“有许多疾病会让感染者更...容易接受性接触，乃至繁殖。两者都是理性思维的敌人。许多物种确实也不怎么尊重同意。”

The leithan takes another swig of his beer, landing the mug on the table with a loud thud, then closes his eyes for a moment. You can’t help noticing a bitter look on his face. When he finally opens his eyes, he looks straight into yours. Edan is clearly trying to convey his sincerity through eye contact, but the emotion you see above all is... pity. You can’t tell how much of it’s real, and how much is just a projection of your own self-loathing. “Look, Steele, you’re [pc.isAss |the greatest asshole I know |a great person ], for real, and I’m honored you feel this way about me. But, like I said, I just can’t reciprocate,” he says with more consideration that you would expect from the otherwise brusque leithan. A part of you is happy that he cares enough about you to even change the way he speaks, but that doesn’t take the sting out of it. “I think we should put a stop to our drunken fun,” he adds, delivering another blow. “Why?” you ask, trying to keep the misery from showing[pc.nmh | on your face, though you’re sure you’re doing a poor job of concealing it |, but you’re not sure your poker face is that good | on your face. Gotta be strong, you tell yourself ]. “Because I don’t want to lead you on. I don’t want to nurture false hopes and then crush them later,” Edan explains, letting out a heavy sigh. “You can call me a superficial jerk if you want, but my heart likes what it likes. Trust me, I’ve tried before, and it didn’t go well.” If he’s gone that far, there’s really nothing left for you to say. rows.original: “Have you ever heard of the Black Void, Steele? They’re a pirate group that operate outside of the U.G.C.’s jurisdiction. Roving slavers, mostly targeting the fringe worlds,” he says, waving a hand around. “I was out there once when I was younger and dumber, thinking bounty or mercenary work would be plentiful in the less secure territories. Well, I was right, and for a while it went great. Lots of money to be made in protecting U.G.C.-funded colonists, but you really earn the money.

rows.original: At some point I was taking a break in an inn. Laughing, drinking, talking to pretty girls. Well, all of that came to a crashing halt when the Void guys showed up. See, living on the fringe worlds, everyone knows who the Black Void are and what they do. You just live in a kind of perpetual hope that they won’t show up on your world, in your town. So there was a lot of screaming and running. Surprisingly little gunfire, but only if you don’t know their MO. They don’t slaughter people wholesale, they just take them alive and sell them. From what I’m told, you’d be better off if they did just kill you.”

rows.original: “Does this look like a pharmacy to you?” snaps the gabilani. “We don’t give medical attention to our clients in 90% of non-lethal circs, so why do you think we’d give it to just any scruff-bag traveler who decided to stroll in? If you’re looking for a hand-out you’re talking to the wrong bloody people, so kindly push off.”
rows.translation: “这里看起来像药店吗？”加比拉尼人厉声道。“我们在九成不致命的状况下都不给客户提供医疗救助，你凭什么觉得我们会给任何一个决定随便逛进来的邋遢旅行者治疗？要是想讨施舍，你找错人了，所以麻烦你滚开。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Does this look like a pharmacy to you?” snaps the gabilani. “We don’t give medical attention to our clients in 90% of non-lethal circs, so why do you think we’d give it to just any scruff-bag traveler who decided to stroll in? If you’re looking for a hand-out you’re talking to the wrong bloody people, so kindly push off.”"

rows.original: “What is this place, exactly?” you ask.

rows.original: “Arbetz. Travel. Agency,” says the short, turquoise-skinned woman slowly, as if talking to an infant. “What do you think it - ” she stops, and massages her temples with closed eyes for a couple of moments. “Sorry. It’s not your fault I’m the one stuck down here, explaining this over and over. I’ll give you the spiel, shall I?” She pats her bunned-up black hair and straightens her back before going on.
rows.translation: “阿贝茨。旅行。社。”那个矮小的青绿色皮肤女人缓慢地说道，仿佛在和婴儿说话。“你以为这里 - ”她停下来，闭眼揉了片刻太阳穴。“抱歉。被困在这里一遍又一遍解释的人是我，这不是你的错。我给你讲一遍标准介绍，好吗？”她拍了拍盘起的黑发，挺直后背才继续。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Arbetz. Travel. Agency,” says the short, turquoise-skinned woman slowly, as if talking to an infant. “What do you think it - ” she stops, and massages her temples with closed eyes for a couple of moments. “Sorry. It’s not your fault I’m the one stuck down here, explaining this over and over. I’ll give you the spiel, shall I?” She pats her bunned-up black hair and straightens her back before going on."

rows.original: “I am A.T.A.’s shore-side rep, Baroness Doridia Aachen’Dedz Una Condinted. You may call me Una. We handle the logistics of gabilani mandated by the Hale and Heart Decree to travel to Tarkus, and those who simply wish to spend time drinking in the rugged beauty of our homeland.” Her tone fairly cascades sarcasm.
rows.translation: “我是阿贝茨旅行社的岸上代表，多里迪娅·亚琛德兹·乌娜·康廷德男爵夫人。你可以叫我乌娜。我们负责安排依据‘健康与心灵法令’奉命前往塔卡斯的加比拉尼人，以及那些只想来饱览故乡粗犷美景之人的后勤事务。”她的语气中满溢着讽刺。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I am A.T.A.’s shore-side rep, Baroness Doridia Aachen’Dedz Una Condinted. You may call me Una. We handle the logistics of gabilani mandated by the Hale and Heart Decree to travel to Tarkus, and those who simply wish to spend time drinking in the rugged beauty of our homeland.” Her tone fairly cascades sarcasm."

rows.original: “We offer sightseeing tours, leisure cruises, safaris and hunting expeditions for the more adventurous in the Arbetz region, all carefully catered to meet each customer’s needs and budget. Clear now? Good!” She returns to her computer without waiting for your response. “So unless you’ve got official business with us, or want to go on an oil-boat cruise with a gaggle of elderly gabilani rubberneckers, go away.”
rows.translation: “我们在阿贝茨地区提供观光游、休闲巡航、狩猎之旅，以及为更有冒险精神的人准备的狩猎远征；一切都经过精心安排，以满足每位顾客的需求和预算。现在清楚了吗？很好！”她不等你回答便回到电脑前。“所以，除非你有公务要和我们谈，或者想和一群上了年纪、爱东张西望的加比拉尼人一起乘油船巡航，否则就走开。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We offer sightseeing tours, leisure cruises, safaris and hunting expeditions for the more adventurous in the Arbetz region, all carefully catered to meet each customer’s needs and budget. Clear now? Good!” She returns to her computer without waiting for your response. “So unless you’ve got official business with us, or want to go on an oil-boat cruise with a gaggle of elderly gabilani rubberneckers, go away.”"

rows.original: Gurgling faintly to the west, a sea of sludge, filth, and corruption laps against a oily beach. Here, the pollution is not quite so bad, but it’s still thick enough to make the flaky “sand” clump together around your [pc.feet]. You can go west or south if you want to experience the pollution firsthand. Otherwise, the Nova’s fore is visible a few minutes to the east, dangling reddish stalactites off its chin.
rows.translation: 西边隐约传来汩汩声，一片由淤泥、污秽和腐败物组成的海洋拍打着油腻的海滩。这里的污染没有那么严重，但依旧浓稠得足以让片状“沙粒”在[pc.feet]周围结块。如果想亲身体验污染，你可以向西或向南走。否则，往东几分钟便能看见新星号的船艏，红色钟乳石从其下巴垂落。
rows.raw: "Gurgling faintly to the west, a sea of sludge, filth, and corruption laps against a oily beach. Here, the pollution is not quite so bad, but it’s still thick enough to make the flaky “sand” clump together around your [pc.feet]. You can go west or south if you want to experience the pollution firsthand. Otherwise, the Nova’s fore is visible a few minutes to the east, dangling reddish stalactites off its chin."

rows.original: To the north, up a rise and looking across the oil sea is a large, white stone building, surrounded by lush, green, well-manicured plants and a high wall. There is script above its bronze gate, but it’s in an alien tongue and you have no idea what it says.
rows.translation: 北边高地上有一栋俯瞰油海的大型白石建筑，四周环绕着葱郁翠绿、修剪整齐的植物和高墙。青铜大门上方写着文字，但那是一种外星语言，你完全看不懂。
rows.raw: "\n\nTo the north, up a rise and looking across the oil sea is a large, white stone building, surrounded by lush, green, well-manicured plants and a high wall. There is script above its bronze gate, but it’s in an alien tongue and you have no idea what it says."

rows.original: The air here feels pleasantly damp and temperate in comparison to the harsh winds that sandpapers your [pc.skin] elsewhere. All in all, it’s a remarkable sight in this dead, dry wasteland.
rows.translation: 与别处磨蚀[pc.skin]的凛冽狂风相比，这里的空气湿润宜人，温度适中。总而言之，这在死寂干燥的荒原上是一番非凡景象。
rows.raw: " The air here feels pleasantly damp and temperate in comparison to the harsh winds that sandpapers your [pc.skin] elsewhere. All in all, it’s a remarkable sight in this dead, dry wasteland."

rows.translation: 你走近青铜大门，发现门并未上锁。你注意到几台枪灰色球形监控摄像头如藤壶般附着在墙上，严密监视着你，但没有任何东西阻止你打开大门，沿卵石小径前行并真正走进建筑。

rows.original: The airy, summery, lounge-like room you find yourself in is largely unoccupied. Behind a desk in front of you, a curvy, turquoise-skinned female gabilani is talking into a clunky-looking interface device whilst stabbing her fingers irritably into an antique keyboard.
rows.translation: 你走进一间通风、充满夏日气息、如休息室般的房间，里面基本空无一人。前方柜台后，一个身材曲线玲珑、青绿色皮肤的加比拉尼女人正对着一台外观笨重的界面设备说话，同时烦躁地用手指猛戳一块老式键盘。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe airy, summery, lounge-like room you find yourself in is largely unoccupied. Behind a desk in front of you, a curvy, turquoise-skinned female gabilani is talking into a clunky-looking interface device whilst stabbing her fingers irritably into an antique keyboard."

rows.original: “ - telling you that no such clause exists! If your son was stupid enough to ride an open-air bi-walker into a sydian enclave - yes, I will take that tone with you - ”
rows.translation: “ - 我告诉你，根本没有这种条款！要是你儿子蠢到骑着露天双足步行机闯进锡迪安人的聚居地 - 对，我就要用这种语气和你说话 - ”
rows.raw: "\n\n“ - telling you that no such clause exists! If your son was stupid enough to ride an open-air bi-walker into a sydian enclave - yes, I will take that tone with you - ”"

rows.original: There’s a human lad operating a similar computer next to her in a distinctly more laid-back fashion. Beyond the desk you can see out into the back of the estate, which is as green as the front and has a swimming pool, alongside of which a male kaithrit is lounging. The two boys are lithe, bronzed and unashamedly dressed only in tight shorts. They, along with the warm, fresh air, give the place the atmosphere of an out-of-season holiday resort.
rows.translation: 她旁边有个人类小伙子正以明显悠闲得多的方式操作一台类似电脑。越过柜台，你能看见庄园后方，那里和前面一样翠绿，还有一座游泳池，池边躺着一名凯斯里特男性。两个男孩身材纤细、皮肤晒成古铜色，都毫不羞怯地只穿着紧身短裤。他们和温暖清新的空气一起，让这里洋溢着淡季度假村的氛围。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a human lad operating a similar computer next to her in a distinctly more laid-back fashion. Beyond the desk you can see out into the back of the estate, which is as green as the front and has a swimming pool, alongside of which a male kaithrit is lounging. The two boys are lithe, bronzed and unashamedly dressed only in tight shorts. They, along with the warm, fresh air, give the place the atmosphere of an out-of-season holiday resort."

rows.original: “Fine! Absolutely! Take it to High Command! They’ll tell you exactly the same thing! Have a good day! You stupid cow,” adds the gabilani, after she’s flung the headset down. Her over-stuffed bust quivers slightly. She snaps a finger at you. “You! Welcome to Arbetz Travel Agency! What do you want?”
rows.translation: “好！当然！拿去最高司令部申诉吧！他们会告诉你完全相同的答案！祝你愉快！你这头蠢母牛。”加比拉尼人摔下耳机后补充道。她塞得鼓鼓囊囊的胸部微微颤动。她朝你打了个响指。“你！欢迎来到阿贝茨旅行社！你想要什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fine! Absolutely! Take it to High Command! They’ll tell you exactly the same thing! Have a good day! You stupid cow,” adds the gabilani, after she’s flung the headset down. Her over-stuffed bust quivers slightly. She snaps a finger at you. “You! Welcome to Arbetz Travel Agency! What do you want?”"

rows.original: The agency’s foyer is absolutely thronged with gabilani and their luggage. A high, unpleasant petro-chemical scent is in the air, and through the patio doors you can see a clunky, metal module looming beyond the swimming pool, undoubtedly used to transport these green-skinned tourists down to Tarkus’s surface. They are talking excitedly amongst themselves, showing off their cybernetic enhancements and traveling gear to one another; a couple take the opportunity of your entrance to take a picture of you. Una is stood on top of the front desk gesticulating angrily, her querulous tones piercing the hubbub as she attempts to organize her kindred into different parties, with little obvious success.
rows.translation: 旅行社的门厅里挤满了加比拉尼人和他们的行李。空气中弥漫着浓重刺鼻的石油化工气味；透过露台门，你能看见一个笨重的金属舱体矗立在游泳池另一边，无疑是用来把这些绿皮游客送到塔卡斯地表的。他们兴奋地彼此交谈，互相炫耀义体强化和旅行装备；有两人还趁你进门时给你拍了张照片。乌娜站在前台上愤怒地比画，尖刻的声音穿透喧嚣，试图将同族分成不同队伍，显然收效甚微。

They are talking excitedly amongst themselves, showing off their cybernetic enhancements and traveling gear to one another; a couple take the opportunity of your entrance to take a picture of you. Una is stood on top of the front desk gesticulating angrily, her querulous tones piercing the hubbub as she attempts to organize her kindred into different parties, with little obvious success."

rows.original: “What is it? Oh it’s you again.” Una slaps down her pen, but she’s smirking, and there’s a fair bit of sly affection in her showily exasperated tone. “Here to waste even more of our valuable time, are we?”

rows.original: Baroness Doridia Aachen’Dedz Una Condinted is a three foot four inch tall gabilani, with clear turquoise skin and black hair, done up in a prim top bun. She has thick, expressive lips and arching eyebrows painted and styled to match her hair, proud features whose default setting seems to be “disbelieving sneer”. Her round face is framed by just the faintest touch of pudge, yet despite this and being beyond the bloom of youth, if there is the slightest line or sag about her it has been scrupulously tucked away.
rows.translation: 多里迪娅·亚琛德兹·乌娜·康廷德男爵夫人是一名身高三英尺四英寸的加比拉尼人，皮肤呈清澈的青绿色，黑发一丝不苟地盘成顶髻。她有着丰厚而富于表情的双唇，弯曲的眉毛也经过描画造型，与头发相配；那副高傲面容的默认神情似乎就是“不敢置信的冷笑”。她圆润的脸庞仅带一丝微胖；尽管如此，而且青春年华早已过去，她身上哪怕有一丝皱纹或松弛，也都被严谨地藏了起来。
rows.raw: "Baroness Doridia Aachen’Dedz Una Condinted is a three foot four inch tall gabilani, with clear turquoise skin and black hair, done up in a prim top bun. She has thick, expressive lips and arching eyebrows painted and styled to match her hair, proud features whose default setting seems to be “disbelieving sneer”. Her round face is framed by just the faintest touch of pudge, yet despite this and being beyond the bloom of youth, if there is the slightest line or sag about her it has been scrupulously tucked away."

rows.original: Una’s physique embodies the female gabilani stereotype and then some: thick, round hips carrying a pear shaped rump and ample, pendulous boobs. In keeping with the rest of her, this is all very carefully marshaled within a gray skirted business suit, stretched tightly over the succulent swells of her curves. She creaks slightly when she walks. Everything about her speaks of a repressively controlled, ravenous carnality.
rows.translation: 乌娜的体型不仅体现了人们对加比拉尼女性的刻板印象，甚至有过之而无不及：浑圆厚实的臀胯托着梨形屁股，还有一对硕大下垂的乳房。和她身上其他一切一样，这些曲线全被一套带灰色裙装的商务套装精心约束，紧绷绷地裹着丰腴隆起。她走路时衣料会微微作响。她身上的一切都透露着受压抑控制却又饥渴难耐的肉欲。
rows.raw: "\n\nUna’s physique embodies the female gabilani stereotype and then some: thick, round hips carrying a pear shaped rump and ample, pendulous boobs. In keeping with the rest of her, this is all very carefully marshaled within a gray skirted business suit, stretched tightly over the succulent swells of her curves. She creaks slightly when she walks. Everything about her speaks of a repressively controlled, ravenous carnality."

rows.original: As for her two male staff, they seem so alike it’s difficult to believe they are different species - brown, sleek, otter-like bodies, unruly curly hair, each about five foot eleven. You guess the kaithrit, recognizable by his dusty orange ears and tails, is a very masculine example of his race to match up so well to the human, with his flat, Germanic cheekbones. They are both dressed only in tight-fitting swim shorts, their slim, supple butts and seemly bulges clear to see, and they both carry the clumsy, defiantly prideful demeanor of young men who know they are being ruthlessly objectified.
rows.translation: 至于她的两名男性员工，他们如此相像，令人难以相信竟属不同物种 - 都有着棕色光滑、如水獭般的身体和一头凌乱卷发，身高都约五英尺十一英寸。那名凯斯里特人可凭尘橙色耳朵和尾巴辨认；你猜他一定是族中非常阳刚的典型，才能与那个人类如此相配，后者有着扁平的日耳曼式颧骨。两人都只穿紧身泳裤，纤细柔韧的屁股和匀称隆起一览无余；他们身上都有年轻男子那种笨拙而倔强自豪的气质，明知自己正被毫不留情地物化。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs for her two male staff, they seem so alike it’s difficult to believe they are different species - brown, sleek, otter-like bodies, unruly curly hair, each about five foot eleven. You guess the kaithrit, recognizable by his dusty orange ears and tails, is a very masculine example of his race to match up so well to the human, with his flat, Germanic cheekbones. They are both dressed only in tight-fitting swim shorts, their slim, supple butts and seemly bulges clear to see, and they both carry the clumsy, defiantly prideful demeanor of young men who know they are being ruthlessly objectified."

The place’d be overrun in a matter of hours. rows.original: “Gotten all frisky in the warm weather, have we?” smirks Una. She leans back and runs her eyes up and down your body deliberately, playing with a stray coil of black hair as she does.
rows.translation: “天气暖和，就变得这么饥渴了，是吗？”乌娜坏笑道。她向后靠去，刻意用目光上下扫视你的身体，同时把玩一绺散落的黑色卷发。

rows.original: “Tempting for someone or other, I’m sure,” she pronounces with deliberate carelessness, opening her arms in a stretch that eventually becomes a gesture at the agency itself. Her overstuffed bodice groans softly. “But I’m perfectly content with what I’ve got, two energetic boys to keep me busy. Go find a raskvel or something to play with outside, and try not to make a mess. I’m not interested.”
rows.translation: “我相信这对某些人确实很有诱惑力，”她故作漫不经心地宣布，伸展双臂，最后将动作变成指向整间旅行社的手势。她塞得满满的紧身胸衣轻声呻吟。“但我对现状非常满意，有两个精力充沛的男孩让我忙个不停。出去找个拉斯克维尔人之类的玩，尽量别弄得一团糟。我没兴趣。”

rows.original: “Let me guess. You aren’t going to leave until you’ve been spoon-fed everything there is to be known about gabilani history, culture and physiology, are you? I told them this would happen if they didn’t set up a shore-side embassy, but noooooo...” she swings herself onto the counter with one wide arm and whistles piercingly. “Godi! Here.”
rows.translation: “让我猜猜。除非有人像拿勺子喂你一样，把有关加比拉尼历史、文化和生理的一切知识都送进嘴里，否则你不会离开，对吧？我早就告诉他们，如果不设岸上大使馆就会发生这种事，可他们偏——不——听...”她用一条粗壮手臂撑着自己荡上柜台，尖锐地吹了声口哨。“戈迪！过来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let me guess. You aren’t going to leave until you’ve been spoon-fed everything there is to be known about gabilani history, culture and physiology, are you? I told them this would happen if they didn’t set up a shore-side embassy, but noooooo...” she swings herself onto the counter with one wide arm and whistles piercingly. “Godi! Here.”"

rows.raw: " You are easily able to find one yourself; it’s quite pleasing to find furniture designed for people of your stature for a change."

rows.original: With all the furniture clearly designed for people of a smaller stature than you, you are left to awkwardly sit on a table opposite her.

rows.raw: " With all the furniture clearly designed for people of a smaller stature than you, you are left to awkwardly sit on a table opposite her."

rows.original: “Let’s have your name and what you’re doing here, first off,” she sighs. “So I know who to report once office supplies start to go missing.” Una listens with a lazy grin on her full lips as you give her a few details about yourself. Despite her histrionics you get the impression she’s rather pleased you’ve gotten her away from her duties.
rows.translation: “首先，说说你的名字和来这里做什么，”她叹道。“这样办公用品开始失踪时，我才知道该举报谁。”你简单介绍自己时，乌娜丰厚的嘴唇上挂着慵懒的笑。尽管她表现得如此夸张，你却觉得她其实很高兴你让她暂时摆脱了职责。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let’s have your name and what you’re doing here, first off,” she sighs. “So I know who to report once office supplies start to go missing.” Una listens with a lazy grin on her full lips as you give her a few details about yourself. Despite her histrionics you get the impression she’s rather pleased you’ve gotten her away from her duties."

rows.original: “Fine. Steele, space adventurer on noble quest to make a fat load of dosh, yadeeyadah,” she says. “What do you want to know?”
rows.translation: “好吧。斯蒂尔，太空冒险者，肩负赚一大笔钱的崇高使命，诸如此类，”她说道。“你想知道什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fine. Steele, space adventurer on noble quest to make a fat load of dosh, yadeeyadah,” she says. “What do you want to know?”"

rows.original: “Got time to talk?” you ask.

rows.raw: "“Got time to talk?” you ask."

rows.original: “No,” Una replies bluntly. You wait patiently as she goes through the pantomime of returning to her work, realizing you haven’t moved, throwing her arms up in silent exasperation and finally clambering out from behind the desk to lead you into the dining area. She flings herself into her armchair moodily.
rows.translation: “没有，”乌娜直截了当地回答。她装模作样地重新开始工作，发现你还没离开，又无声地恼火举起双臂，最后终于从柜台后爬出来，领你走进用餐区。她闷闷不乐地把自己摔进扶手椅。

She flings herself into her armchair moodily."

rows.original: alien, really pulled me away from my job to ask me that?” snorts Una. She leans forward, opens her eyes wide, and adopts a mocking school-teacher tone. “Well, you see [pc.name], we have these things called sa-ta-lites that fly waaaaaaay up in the sky, so high you can’t even see them. Some of these sa-ta-lites have super special equipment on them. They do big word things like ‘modulate air pressure’ and ‘disperse ice nuclei’. All you need to know is: there’s one that flies over us every day and makes it always summer here, just like a holiday resort should be. Hurray!”
rows.translation: 外星人，竟然真的把我从工作中叫走，就为了问这个？”乌娜哼了一声。她身体前倾，瞪大双眼，摆出嘲弄的小学老师口吻。“这个嘛，[pc.name]，我们有一种叫作‘卫——星’的东西，会飞到天————上，高到你根本看不见。有些‘卫——星’上装着超级特别的设备。它们会做一些用大词称呼的事情，比如‘调节气压’和‘散布冰核’。你只需要知道：每天都有一颗从我们上方飞过，让这里永远是夏天，就像度假村本该有的样子。万岁！”

rows.original: “If the gabilani have cracked changing the weather, how come the rest of the planet is the way it is? And why is it so localized? Your agency isn’t a mile away from Novahome. Why isn’t it sunny there, too?”
rows.translation: “如果加比拉尼人已经掌握了改变天气的技术，为什么星球其他地方还是这副模样？又为什么范围这么局部？你们旅行社离新星家园不到一英里。那里为什么也不是晴天？”
rows.raw: "“If the gabilani have cracked changing the weather, how come the rest of the planet is the way it is? And why is it so localized? Your agency isn’t a mile away from Novahome. Why isn’t it sunny there, too?”"

rows.original: “Because it takes up a huge amount of energy, obviously,” replies Una. “Maybe if the High Command negotiations with your own stuffed shirts get anywhere, we might be able to properly terraform Tarkus, stop living in space. But I don’t think it honestly would take up that much more fuel to include the raskvel heap in the sunbeam, since you ask.”
rows.translation: “因为这显然会消耗巨量能源，”乌娜回答。“要是最高司令部和你们那些衣冠楚楚的家伙谈判有进展，也许我们就能妥善改造塔卡斯，不再生活在太空。不过既然你问了，我真不觉得把拉斯克维尔垃圾堆也纳入阳光照射范围会多消耗多少燃料。”

But I don’t think it honestly would take up that much more fuel to include the raskvel heap in the sunbeam, since you ask.”"

rows.original: “So why...”

“Because if we did,” the plump shortstack says, brushing the arm of her chair fastidiously, “the raskvel would want to know why we couldn’t extend the weather spot to include the surrounding area too, so they could grow better food? Then there would be a massive ruck as all the raskvel for miles around tried to pile into that one square of land. Then they’d probably storm this place and trample it into the ground in the chaos. Then the seven foot cockroaches would get involved, and things would get really nasty.”
rows.translation: “因为要是我们这么做，”丰满的矮胖女人一丝不苟地掸着椅子扶手说道，“拉斯克维尔人会想知道，为什么我们不能把天气区扩展到周边，让他们种出更好的食物？然后方圆数英里的拉斯克维尔人都会试图挤进那一小块土地，引发一场大混战。接着他们很可能会冲进这里，在混乱中把这里踩平。之后那些七英尺高的蟑螂也会卷进来，事情就会变得非常难看。”

rows.original: “Let me guess,” Una replies, picking at a loose thread on her armchair in irritation. “Some nonsense about one planet being the gabilani homeworld, and the other the raskvel’s? They love that line. I’m told you aliens are bright,” she goes on, gesturing at you imperiously. “How many solar systems have you heard of which have two naturally inhabitable planets in them?”
rows.translation: “让我猜猜，”乌娜烦躁地扯着扶手椅上一根松线回答。“某些胡说八道，称一颗星球是加比拉尼人的母星，另一颗是拉斯克维尔人的？他们很喜欢这套说法。听说你们外星人很聪明，”她继续说道，盛气凌人地朝你比画。“你听说过多少个拥有两颗天然宜居行星的恒星系？”

They love that line. I’m told you aliens are bright,” she goes on, gesturing at you imperiously. “How many solar systems have you heard of which have two naturally inhabitable planets in them?”"

rows.original: “It was our leaders’ great solution.” Una smiles with an uncharacteristic bleakness. “When things really started to turn bad, 500 years or so ago now. We’ve still got the vids, if you fancy treating yourself to a few nightmares. Even in the places that weren’t deserts or tundra we were practically living on top of each other, the oceans turned to poison from all the run-off, and then so did the land. Gabilani and raskvel fought wars, would kill each other in the tens of thousands for ownership of a single ground-well. Why not? Dozens of lives were worth so much less than one drop of clean water. They blame us for the pollution, but they just wouldn’t stop breeding...”
rows.translation: “那是我们领袖提出的伟大解决方案。”乌娜露出一种反常的阴郁笑容。“大约五百年前，情况真正开始恶化时。那些录像我们还留着，要是你想犒劳自己做几场噩梦的话。即使在并非沙漠或冻原的地方，我们也几乎叠着彼此生活；海洋被所有径流污染成毒液，接着陆地也一样。加比拉尼人和拉斯克维尔人发动战争，为争夺一口地下水井就会杀死数万人。为什么不呢？数十条生命远远不如一滴净水值钱。他们把污染归咎于我们，可他们就是不肯停止繁殖...”

Gabilani and raskvel fought wars, would kill each other in the tens of thousands for ownership of a single ground-well. Why not? Dozens of lives were worth so much less than one drop of clean water. They blame us for the pollution, but they just wouldn’t stop breeding...”"

rows.original: “Anyways. The solution. It appealed to us all, because it combined everything the gabilani love: a massive invention, a huge event, something we could all talk about being part of for centuries after. The world attractor! Daerinoys, the next planet out in our solar system, couldn’t sustain life but it was solid, similar size and had plenty of heavy metal and frozen water in its crust. Our scientists reckoned if we could bring it into the habitable zone, it wouldn’t require all that much terraforming. We could settle there, have our own planet, leave the raskvel to it.”
rows.translation: “总之，说回解决方案。它吸引了我们所有人，因为它结合了加比拉尼人热爱的一切：一项宏伟发明、一场巨大事件，以及某件我们数百年后仍能谈论自己曾参与其中的事情。世界牵引器！戴里诺伊斯是我们恒星系中轨道更外侧的下一颗行星；它无法维持生命，但质地坚实，大小相仿，地壳中还有大量重金属和冻结水。我们的科学家估计，只要将它拉进宜居带，就不需要进行多少地球化改造。我们可以在那里定居，拥有自己的星球，把这里留给拉斯克维尔人。”

It appealed to us all, because it combined everything the gabilani love: a massive invention, a huge event, something we could all talk about being part of for centuries after. The world attractor! Our scientists reckoned if we could bring it into the habitable zone, it wouldn’t require all that much terraforming. We could settle there, have our own planet, leave the raskvel to it.”"

rows.original: “You say you polluted the planet,” you say. “And you were going to take the fresh one?”
rows.translation: “你说是你们污染了这颗星球，”你说道。“然后你们还打算拿走那颗崭新的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You say you polluted the planet,” you say. “And you were going to take the fresh one?”"

rows.original: “Who came up with the world attractor?” snaps Una. “If you can’t be bothered looking this shit up yourself, don’t try and lay blame on the person telling you about it! And the raskvel helped to operate the damn thing, so they take just as much of the rap for what happened.”
rows.translation: “世界牵引器是谁发明的？”乌娜厉声道。“要是你自己懒得查这些破事，就别想把责任推到给你讲述的人身上！而且拉斯克维尔人也协助操作了那鬼东西，所以他们对发生的事情同样负有责任。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Who came up with the world attractor?” snaps Una. “If you can’t be bothered looking this shit up yourself, don’t try and lay blame on the person telling you about it! And the raskvel helped to operate the damn thing, so they take just as much of the rap for what happened.”"

rows.original: “It didn’t work?”
rows.translation: “它没成功？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It didn’t work?”"

rows.original: “You’ve seen what this hole looks like from the sky, haven’t you? Of course it worked! Oh, it worked alright! Worked great right up until the point someone realised Daerinoys didn’t have a fucking brake on it!”
rows.translation: “你从空中看过这个鬼地方是什么样，对吧？当然成功了！哦，确实成功了！一直运转得非常棒，直到有人发现戴里诺伊斯他妈的没有刹车！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’ve seen what this hole looks like from the sky, haven’t you? Of course it worked! Oh, it worked alright! Worked great right up until the point someone realised Daerinoys didn’t have a fucking brake on it!”"

rows.original: “Uh,” you say after a short pause, inadequately. “What happened after that?”
rows.translation: “呃，”短暂沉默后，你很不充分地说道。“之后发生了什么？”
rows.raw: "“Uh,” you say after a short pause, inadequately. “What happened after that?”"

rows.original: “What did the 20% of the planet that survived do, you mean? Some gabilani managed to evacuate. Fastest space program in the history of the galaxy, I imagine. They came back awhile later and constructed the planetary tie; it was the only way to stop the two planets from slowly tearing each other apart. As for the raskvel, well, you’ve seen them, they’re still here. They’re thriving, in their own weird way; the hostility of Tarkus now actually suits their idiotic libidos. The sydians too, although who gives a stuff about them.”
rows.translation: “你是问这颗星球上幸存的那20%做了什么？一些加比拉尼人成功撤离。大概是银河史上最快的太空计划。他们过了一阵子回来，建造了行星系绳；这是阻止两颗行星缓慢撕裂彼此的唯一办法。至于拉斯克维尔人，嗯，你见过他们，他们还在这里。他们以自己古怪的方式繁荣发展；如今塔卡斯的恶劣环境实际上很适合他们愚蠢的性欲。锡迪安人也是，不过谁在乎他们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What did the 20% of the planet that survived do, you mean? Some gabilani managed to evacuate. Fastest space program in the history of the galaxy, I imagine. They came back awhile later and constructed the planetary tie; it was the only way to stop the two planets from slowly tearing each other apart. As for the raskvel, well, you’ve seen them, they’re still here. They’re thriving, in their own weird way; the hostility of Tarkus now actually suits their idiotic libidos. The sydians too, although who gives a stuff about them.”"

rows.original: “And your people didn’t settle Daerinoys?”
rows.translation: “而你们的人没有在戴里诺伊斯定居？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And your people didn’t settle Daerinoys?”"

rows.original: “A few did,” Una sighs, rubbing her brows. She looks drained. “But most of the equipment that we were going to use to terraform it was destroyed in the collision, and we had to use what resources remained to make the space stations liveable and build that massive chain. Also, Daerinoys came off worse in the collision. It’s even less habitable than Tarkus is now, if you can believe that. Don’t worry, the irony is not lost on us.” She glares at you resentfully. “You got enough? Or perhaps you’d like to browbeat me over how irresponsible my great great great great great grandparents were some more.”
rows.translation: “有少数人去了，”乌娜揉着眉头叹道。她显得精疲力竭。“但原本用于改造环境的大部分设备都在碰撞中被摧毁了，我们不得不用剩余资源让空间站变得宜居，并建造那条巨链。而且戴里诺伊斯在碰撞中受损更严重。即使你难以置信，它现在比塔卡斯更不宜居。别担心，我们也明白其中的讽刺。”她怨恨地瞪着你。“听够了吗？还是想继续训斥我那些高高高高高祖父母有多不负责任？”

rows.original: “Tell me about your people,” you say. “Do you all live in those space stations I saw coming in?”
rows.translation: “讲讲你们的族人吧，”你说道。“你们都住在我来时看见的那些空间站里吗？”
rows.raw: "“Tell me about your people,” you say. “Do you all live in those space stations I saw coming in?”"

rows.original: “Mostly,” shrugs Una. “Couple of weirdoes live down here still, but doing that means being disconnected from gabilani society. We’re... you need to stay in touch if you’re one of us, if you want to stay part of the words. Being seen when something big happens, being able to say you experienced it, that’s incredibly important for the gabilani.”
rows.translation: “大部分吧，”乌娜耸肩道。“还有几个怪人仍住在地面，但那意味着与加比拉尼社会脱节。我们...如果你是我们的一员，又想继续成为话语的一部分，就必须保持联系。大事发生时能被人看见，能说自己亲身经历过，对加比拉尼人无比重要。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mostly,” shrugs Una. “Couple of weirdoes live down here still, but doing that means being disconnected from gabilani society. We’re... you need to stay in touch if you’re one of us, if you want to stay part of the words. Being seen when something big happens, being able to say you experienced it, that’s incredibly important for the gabilani.”"

rows.original: “Apparently the stereotype we’ve gotten is that we’re big inventors, and that’s true to a certain extent, but being able to say you were there when something was invented, that’s at least as important. Our leaders are always the ones who are able to talk about the most crazy shit they’ve seen, and once they can’t say that they have anymore, they get ousted. Oftentimes I think our engineers and philososploders come up with stuff not because it’s actually needed, but just to shake things up a bit. So if you’re down here, not able to talk or be included, then you’re either a bit strange... or you’re serving some form of punishment.” She glares over at the desk venomously.
rows.translation: “显然，外界对我们的刻板印象是大发明家；这在一定程度上没错，但能够说自己在某项发明诞生时亲临现场，至少同样重要。我们的领袖总是那些能讲述自己见过的最疯狂事情的人；一旦再也说不出这种话，就会被赶下台。我常觉得工程师和哲思爆破家发明东西并非真有需要，而只是为了搅动局面。所以待在地面，无法交谈或参与其中，要么说明你有些古怪...要么就是正在服某种刑罚。”她恶狠狠地瞪向柜台。

So if you’re down here, not able to talk or be included, then you’re either a bit strange... or you’re serving some form of punishment.” She glares over at the desk venomously."

rows.original: “The words,” you prompt. “What does that mean, exactly?”
rows.translation: “话语，”你提示道。“那究竟是什么意思？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The words,” you prompt. “What does that mean, exactly?”"

rows.original: “You know, the words.” She rolls her eyes and slaps her chair’s arms in exasperation when you continue to look at her nonplussed. “The words! The story! I don’t get why none of you aliens understand this. Look, life is a story, right? One you know the beginning to, you’re in the middle of, and one day will end. But no matter how long or interesting your story is, it doesn’t count for anything if it isn’t well-written and nobody reads it. So you got to make sure the words are good and in the right place.”
rows.translation: “你知道的，话语。”你仍一脸茫然，她翻着白眼，恼火地拍打椅子扶手。“话语！故事！我不明白为什么你们外星人全都不懂。听着，生命就是一个故事，对吧？你知道它的开端，正身处其中，总有一天它会结束。但无论你的故事多长、多有趣，如果写得不好而且无人阅读，就毫无意义。所以必须确保话语精彩，而且放在正确的位置。”

But no matter how long or interesting your story is, it doesn’t count for anything if it isn’t well-written and nobody reads it. So you got to make sure the words are good and in the right place.”"

rows.original: “Why don’t aliens’ words for things change?” she goes on heatedly, getting into the topic. “Your species have been calling yourselves the same thing for how long? How can you keep using that term when clearly you aren’t what you were tens of thousands of years ago? It’s so weirdly primitive for races with such advanced tech.”
rows.translation: “为什么外星人用来称呼事物的话语不会变化？”她越说越激动。“你们的物种用同一个名字称呼自己多久了？你们显然早已不是数万年前的模样，怎么还能继续使用那个称呼？拥有如此先进技术的种族竟这么原始，实在古怪。”

Now we are the gabilani, Children of the Outer Sky. I’ll let you work that one out yourself. We call the raskvel the herliani, Children of the Soil. Although they don’t, ah...” Una escorts a smirk off her face with a brush of the hand. “I wouldn’t use that term to their faces, is what I’m saying.”
rows.translation: “当然不是！起初我们有许多不同的名字；统一战争后，我们大多成了海恩德拉，意为‘一体之民’。第一艘飞艇升空在历史中极为重要，于是我们成了比拉尼，即天空之子，因为我们如今能前往那里，也从那里汲取灵感，懂吗？现在我们是加比拉尼，外层天空之子。这个就留给你自己琢磨。我们称拉斯克维尔人为赫里亚尼，土壤之子。虽然他们不，呃...”乌娜挥手抹去脸上的坏笑。“我的意思是，别当着他们的面用这个称呼。”

In the meantime, we’ve got the Hale and Heart decree. Every gabilani has to be spend at least two weeks in a year shore-side, give their bodies time to recuperate. There’s supposed to be a cultural thingy involved too. See where we come from, reflect on our history.” Una flicks a hand sneeringly. “Rubbish really, for most it’s just a lark.”

rows.original: And so you do it. What, are you going to gainsay Lady Una? Those quivering hams and that sardonic, domineering tone? No, of course you’re not. You’re going to obediently scrub and clean for her, flexing your taut, young body in the sunlight so that she’s surrounded at all times by delectable, lean male bodies hard at work, seemly bulges on display; just the way she likes it, just the way she deserves. Within a few minutes you’ve completely forgotten why you even came here. Petr and Godi give you slightly strange looks at first, but are pretty accepting. You’re a regular feature around here after all. Through them you learn the best way to approach any task given to you by Una is to do what she wants but get it slightly wrong; this gives her the opportunity to lose her temper and get worked up, which make her delectable nipples swell beneath her shirt when she yells about how bloody incompetent you all are and why can’t she leave you unsupervised for just one hour? “Petr! Get your dumbfuck buns in there,” she snaps, pointing at the closet. “You two - make a start on the finances.” You sit down and try and make headway with the travel agency’s sprawling thicket of admin while, with increasingly urgent groans, something soft and dense is rhythmically rammed into the wall behind you. [var0|This is your area of expertise and despite the antiquity of the interface you’re quickly able to make progress with it, much to Godi’s admiration.|[var1| Pass High Intelligence check: The interface might be incredibly antiquated and the spreadsheets messy, but you have the brains to navigate through it and begin cleaning it up, much to Godi’s admiration. About ten minutes later Una reemerges, patting her hair and looking supremely composed. “See, this is why I keep you around,” she says when she clambers onto her seat to see how you’re doing. “So long as you’re kept on task, there’s actually a brain there for someone to make use of.” You feel a glow of giddy glee. A compliment from Lady Una! Sort of! It almost distracts you from reviewing the monthly outgoings. A significant amount of the agency’s earnings are going from ‘assorted expenses’ straight into an off-planet account. |It’s gabilani tech you’re working with, cramped and complicated and practically steampowered, and it’s a real struggle for you to get up to speed with it. When Una reemerges ten minutes later, patting her hair and looking supremely composed, she tsks in irritation when she sees how you’re doing. “No, idiot. You use the clork to bring those across, and then bogi-log the rest! It’s so simple. Just make sure that that...” - She gestures at the output for the agency’s ‘assorted expenses’ - “...goes there.” She gestures to an input to what looks very much like a paying in function to an off-planet account. You pause. Is she - doing what it appears she’s doing?]] “Yes?” She looks at you, utterly unmoved, when you pause. “I’m getting off this rock, darling, back into the Words with a bang, and I’m gonna need money to do it. All I need you to do is...” She puts her warm hand over yours on the pointing device. You find yourself unresisting as she pushes it across to the ‘as above’ option and presses your finger down. “There!” She lets go to pat your face briskly. “And now you’re an abettor to a crime. Isn’t that nice?” “I’m taking all three of you with me when I go, don’t think I’m not!” She radiates her gaze over you all with a wide smile, as prideful and possessive as an empress. “I’m gonna go right to the top of High Command, show that cow of a sister of mine what’s what... and I’m gonna need three boys, three good, obedient boys, to take care of all the things that need taking care of.” She waves airily. “Don’t worry about treats and whatnot, I’ll have all that flown in... If you need any further incentive: imagine how good the shagging will be once this - ” She pats her sizeable posterior. “ - is sat down on 1.5 billion people.” She raps the desk sharply with her stylus. “Now get back to work!” You exchange goofy, shamefaced grins with Petr and Godi. None of you really believe her - but that’s part of the gabilani’s undeniable mystique. She’s a disingenuous, conniving bitch. And that’s why it feels so good, so hot, to do exactly what she says.

rows.original: “I’ll fix the mistakes you imbeciles made a bit later,” Una says, a couple hours of tending to a couple gabilani tourist groups later. “Right now....” She taps a button below her desk, and the front door locks. “I need some RnR.” A short while later she emerges from her bedroom in sunglasses and a black swimsuit, a V-shaped affair with wide straps that arrow down over her breasts and converge around her groin. You can’t help but become engorged as you watch her sashay out of the veranda in that thing, lay herself on a sunlounger in all her wobbly glory; just so much going on in such a small amount of space. Your [pc.cocks] thrum[s|s] with frustrated heat. She snaps her fingers at you. “Go make me a quivering quasar. Oh, and fetch the lotion while you’re at it. You two... go wrestle over there.” She gestures at a grassy space on the other side of the pool. “You need your exercise.” In the cool inside, mixing from the lounge’s drink cabinet, you find yourself again wondering what you’re doing here. You’re on some sort of mission, aren’t you? Yes, that’s right... making the lady the best damn cocktail she’s ever had. And when you bring it out to her on a steel platter, when she takes a dainty sip and gives just the faintest smirk of approval, that feels just as good as the sunshine on your skin. “Attend to me, [pc.boyGirl],” she coos, preening as she lies there with one short leg in the air, watching the two scantily-clad lads struggle and sweat across the way.

rows.original: “ - and, as it appears Bright Water have put your contract out to tender - you don’t have a leg left to stand on, dear Vestrah.” From her position lounging on her purple, preposterously well-upholstered sedan, Una reaches out and taps at one of her floating haptic devices. “Aaaand there we go. Condinted Corp now own you in perpetuity. Take her down to the training suites, will you dears?” The gabilani snuggles herself further into her cushions. “Sign her up for a re-education seminar.” You gesture sharply, and two skimpily dressed manservants grab the shivering zaika stood before Lady Una. “Wait, no!” she wails as she’s dragged off. “This is ridiculous! You can’t do this to me! I’m a peer and you’re a, a - ” Whatever word she was going to summon to describe Una is lost behind the quiet click of the far door. “She really thought she was going to bait and switch me with those genemod IPs. That’s what’s ridiculous.” Una examines her nails and is silent for a moment as she swallows the baklava one of her short-shorted attendants just fed her. “I admire the ambition though. Maybe I’ll pop her brain out, put into a nice pert robo boi body. One of the ones with remote controls. What do you think darling?” “I’ll see if there’s one available in the engineering bay, milady.” You allow yourself a smirk as you continue working through the morning’s admin at your own station. Your cousin has enjoyed sending you messages inquiring how much you’re enjoying being a goblin’s bitch while [rival.heShe] acquires the family business. [rival.HeShe]’ll be laughing on the other side of [rival.hisHer] face once you’re done poaching E. Lessau, A. Dorna and a couple of the better connected execs off [rival.himHer]. Steele Tech has been in shaky shape since [rival.name] took over, and it’s time to strip what assets you can and cut ties. You sigh as you read the next message. “Tarkus High Command are trying to extradite you again. Seems they’ve got hold of a Terran and a Dhaal based law firm to do it this time.” “Arseholes.” Una’s face darkens with rage, and you feel a familiar stirring. You watch her nipples harden beneath her barely-adequate gray-and-white business gown. “This’ll be Maven’s doing, you mark my words! Our case was watertight last time! What has she been feeding them? We have to get out in front of this.” She rises and, after a couple of grunting attempts, manages to get off the sedan. She snaps her fingers at you. “Come!” You lock the door behind you as you follow her into her private sanctum. Water chatters into pools either side of the marble dias at the far end, from which a big sapphire-colored bed soundlessly rises out of as Una waddles towards it. Beyond that, a huge window, through which the crepuscular beauty of Dhaal’s eternal sky gazes inwards. Una murmurs as she discards the gown, falling or bursting away from her depending on where the fastening is. You watch her in all her wobbly, turquoise glory clamber onto the bed and lie on it belly down, gazing out of the window. After a moment she taps a button on the nearby interface, and a whole host of holograms are projected out in front of her - stock exchanges, industry reports, insider memos, interspersed with footage of former assassins and saboteurs now hard at work in CC’s exec leisure suites. There’s the zaika who used a drone to gain remote access to the secure data core VI, and almost made it all the way back to her waiting hovercab before you intercepted her. Now she’s got her bubbly, heftily augmented, CC-tattooed rear in the air, eyes rolling as she gets it vigorously rogered by a rotund, cigar-puffing gabilani. “Mmm.” Una stares into the panopticon of her small but growing empire. “Somewhere in there is our next step, [pc.name]. rows.original: The next couple of months are a whirl. Una has you hand the registration of [pc_ship.theName] over to her, then fires the crew. This is only reasonable - the mission you brought them on board for is over and it’s not fair to expect them to hang on while you evade Tarkus High Command and the various bounty hunters they put on your trail. Una schemes and schemes while you ferry her around the sketchier corners of the frontier. She’s going to become a pirate - but no, piracy is a mug’s game, and dirty besides. She’s going to become a smuggler - but no, too dangerous. She’s going to forge a new identity - but no, that cow Oreol will only sniff her out again. rows.original: You closely examine the hard-earned nursedroid chip. It’s slightly run-down, but at first glance the damage seems mainly limited to the surface. A quick scan with your codex reveals it’s still functional and contains a vast amount of data and a V.I.

rows.original: You poke [gooarmor.name] a couple of times with your index finger and she reacts, squirming, reshaping and finally forming her usual face. She pops-up with a neutral expression and her eyes closed, still unaware of why she’s been summoned.
rows.translation: 你用食指戳了[gooarmor.name]几下，她随之反应，扭动、重塑，最终形成平常的脸。她突然冒出来，神情平静、双眼紧闭，仍不知道自己为何被召唤。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou poke [gooarmor.name] a couple of times with your index finger and she reacts, squirming, reshaping and finally forming her usual face. She pops-up with a neutral expression and her eyes closed, still unaware of why she’s been summoned."

rows.original: She opens her eyes and looks at you a bit startled. “wha...? I’m awake, I’m awake! What happened? Got anything for me? Or is this a booty call?” She looks at you with curiosity. Her head slightly tilted, but there is a hint of mischievousness in her expression. You’re pretty sure, deep down she expects this to be the latter.
rows.translation: 她睁开眼，略受惊吓地望着你。“什...？我醒了，我醒了！发生什么了？有东西给我？还是想找我约炮？”她好奇地看着你，头微微倾斜，表情中却带着一丝恶作剧意味。你很确定，她内心深处期待的是后者。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe opens her eyes and looks at you a bit startled. “wha...? I’m awake, I’m awake! What happened? Got anything for me? Or is this a booty call?” She looks at you with curiosity. Her head slightly tilted, but there is a hint of mischievousness in her expression. You’re pretty sure, deep down she expects this to be the latter."

rows.original: Unfortunately for her, you’re not looking for some under-the-bedsheets fun right now. You show her your prize, the small metallic chip containing the V.I. of a nursedroid. You ask her if she could use it somehow and maybe extract the information contained inside. Perhaps even assimilate it to enhance her own programming.
rows.translation: 可惜你现在不想在床单下找乐子。你向她展示战利品：一枚装有护士机器人虚拟智能的小型金属芯片。你问她能否以某种方式利用它，也许能提取其中信息，甚至将其同化以增强自身程序。
rows.raw: "\n\nUnfortunately for her, you’re not looking for some under-the-bedsheets fun right now. You show her your prize, the small metallic chip containing the V.I. of a nursedroid. You ask her if she could use it somehow and maybe extract the information contained inside. Perhaps even assimilate it to enhance her own programming."

rows.original: Having a doctor on demand during your adventures could prove very useful. If she could just learn at least a fraction of the knowledge and medical procedures stored inside the small chip, she could become an extremely valuable crew member. Not only on the field, but having a doctor on board could make the difference in a life or death situation.
rows.translation: 冒险期间随时能有医生可用，会非常实用。只要她能学会小芯片所储存知识和医疗程序的一小部分，就能成为极有价值的船员。不只是在野外；船上有名医生，可能会在生死关头带来天壤之别。
rows.raw: "\n\nHaving a doctor on demand during your adventures could prove very useful. If she could just learn at least a fraction of the knowledge and medical procedures stored inside the small chip, she could become an extremely valuable crew member. Not only on the field, but having a doctor on board could make the difference in a life or death situation."

rows.original: She smiles and nods repeatedly. “Yeah, I wanna be a doctor, save lives and stuff. Sounds fun and... uh, important too. I mean, I don’t want anything bad to happen to you or your friends, but if something goes wrong, I wanna be able to help. Uh... May I have the shiny?”
rows.translation: 她微笑着反复点头。“对，我想当医生，救人什么的。听起来很好玩，而且...呃，也很重要。我是说，我不希望你或朋友出什么事，但如果出了问题，我想有能力帮忙。呃...可以把闪亮亮给我吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smiles and nods repeatedly. “Yeah, I wanna be a doctor, save lives and stuff. Sounds fun and... uh, important too. I mean, I don’t want anything bad to happen to you or your friends, but if something goes wrong, I wanna be able to help. Uh... May I have the shiny?”"

rows.original: You nod and move your hand closer. “Gimmie!” She exclaims while yanking the chip from your hand with a gooey tendril. She keeps scrutinizing it, looking at it from every angle. She then flicks it up in the air and catches it with her mouth, swallowing and absorbing it.
rows.translation: 你点头，将手移近。“给我！”她叫喊着用一条凝胶触须从你手中夺走芯片，不断细看，从每个角度端详。随后她把它弹向空中，用嘴接住，吞下并吸收。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod and move your hand closer. “Gimmie!” She exclaims while yanking the chip from your hand with a gooey tendril. She keeps scrutinizing it, looking at it from every angle. She then flicks it up in the air and catches it with her mouth, swallowing and absorbing it."

rows.original: Sensing your approach, [gooarmor.name] quickly morphs into a shapeless blob and scoots a couple steps away from you. She suddenly reforms with her back turned to you, appearing in a slightly different guise than her normal self. Her hair is not in the loose, wavy fashion it normally is, but instead, it is tied in a low ponytail. The silvery companion doesn’t turn around, so you can’t tell if something is wrong.

She suddenly reforms with her back turned to you, appearing in a slightly different guise than her normal self. rows.translation: 她的双腿融合成中央凝胶团，随后团块迅速一分为二，形成匀称双腿，
rows.raw: " Her legs merge into one central blob, then the mass quickly splits into two, forming shapely legs that"

rows.original: make room for the bottom half of her bikini to squeeze into. Her bikini bottom then divides and extends to merge with the strings of her top, converting her swimsuit into an extra-lewd slingkini.
rows.translation: 为比基尼下装挤入腾出空间。随后，比基尼下装分开延伸，与上衣的绳带融合，将泳装变成格外淫荡的吊带比基尼。
rows.raw: " make room for the bottom half of her bikini to squeeze into. Her bikini bottom then divides and extends to merge with the strings of her top, converting her swimsuit into an extra-lewd slingkini."

rows.original: “So, how do you like it?” She twirls. “I think it’s quite sexy!” You give her outfit a once-over. ‘Sexy’ is an understatement--if she wore anything skimpier, she’d be a full-blown exhibitionist!
rows.translation: “所以，你觉得怎么样？”她转了一圈。“我觉得相当性感！”你上下打量她的衣装。“性感”都算轻描淡写--要是穿得再少一点，她就是个彻头彻尾的暴露狂！
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, how do you like it?” She twirls. “I think it’s quite sexy!” You give her outfit a once-over. ‘Sexy’ is an understatement--if she wore anything skimpier, she’d be a full-blown exhibitionist!"

rows.original: You are not sure that term would really apply to goos who can just form into anything they want though. Technically, she is always naked...
rows.translation: 不过，你不确定这个词是否真的适用于能随意变成任何形状的凝胶。严格来说，她始终都是裸体...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou are not sure that term would really apply to goos who can just form into anything they want though. Technically, she is always naked..."

rows.original: You take a moment to test the water from the pool’s edge and proceed to walk right in until you are submerged up to the top of your chest. You turn around and invite [gooarmor.name] in.
rows.translation: 你在泳池边花了片刻试水，随后径直走入，直到水面淹至胸口顶端。你转身邀请[gooarmor.name]下水。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a moment to test the water from the pool’s edge and proceed to walk right in until you are submerged up to the top of your chest. You turn around and invite [gooarmor.name] in."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: swimsuit 0
rows.raw: "swimsuit 0"

rows.original: Spotting you with head gear, [gooarmor.name] gets incredibly curious. “Ooo, neat. What’s this do?” she asks, poking it with a gooey finger.
rows.translation: [gooarmor.name]看到你戴着头部装备，顿时好奇万分。“哦，好酷。这有什么用？”她用凝胶手指戳着它问道。
rows.raw: "Spotting you with head gear, [gooarmor.name] gets incredibly curious. “Ooo, neat. What’s this do?” she asks, poking it with a gooey finger."

rows.original: You tell her it’s a helmet that protects you from inhaling dangerous gasses and protects against other fluids as well. You also add that it may also help in breathing underwater if the rest of the suit is fully sealed, pressurized, and hooked up to a rebreather.
rows.translation: 你告诉她，这是一顶头盔，能防止吸入危险气体，也能防护其他液体。你还补充说，如果整套服装完全密封、加压并连接循环呼吸器，它也许还能帮助水下呼吸。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her it’s a helmet that protects you from inhaling dangerous gasses and protects against other fluids as well. You also add that it may also help in breathing underwater if the rest of the suit is fully sealed, pressurized, and hooked up to a rebreather."

rows.original: “Awesome! You think I can make something like that?” She presses her face against the front, obscuring your view with her flattened face.
rows.translation: “太棒了！你觉得我也能做出那种东西吗？”她把脸压到正面，压扁的脸遮住你的视野。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Awesome! You think I can make something like that?” She presses her face against the front, obscuring your view with her flattened face."

joinAfter.expression:
pc.isBimbo()
                    ? "Yeah, you should, like, totally go for it!"
                    : "Hm... Sure, why not?"

rows.original: Yeah, you should, like, totally go for it!
rows.translation: 对，你应该，那个，绝对试试看！
rows.raw: "Yeah, you should, like, totally go for it!"

rows.original: Hm... Sure, why not?
rows.raw: "Hm... Sure, why not?"

rows.original: ” you say, finding this as an ideal opportunity for her to learn.
rows.translation: ”你说道，认为这是让她学习的理想机会。
rows.raw: "” you say, finding this as an ideal opportunity for her to learn."

rows.original: “Yay!” The gray goo girl leaps up at you to rest herself on your shoulders. The majority of her mass is wrapped around your dome, making you wobble a bit as your vision is masked in complete darkness. After a minute or two, there is a muffled “Okay, I think I’ve got it!” and then she launches herself off you, making you stagger back.
rows.translation: “好耶！”灰色凝胶女孩跃到你身上，将自己搁在你肩膀上。她的大部分质量裹住你的脑袋，令你略微摇晃，视野也陷入彻底黑暗。一两分钟后，里面传来闷闷的“好了，我觉得自己学会了！”随后她从你身上猛地弹开，令你踉跄后退。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yay!” The gray goo girl leaps up at you to rest herself on your shoulders. The majority of her mass is wrapped around your dome, making you wobble a bit as your vision is masked in complete darkness. After a minute or two, there is a muffled “Okay, I think I’ve got it!” and then she launches herself off you, making you stagger back."

rows.original: When your vision returns, you find [gooarmor.name] in a half-kneeling pose on the floor, her arms bent and hands balled in a determined fashion, her face in deep concentration. As you [pc.move] towards her, her head is suddenly engulfed in a shapeless silvery blob. The blob then inflates into a more orb-like shape. [gooarmor.name] then stands up to face you.
rows.translation: 视野恢复时，你发现[gooarmor.name]半跪在地板上，双臂弯曲、双手握拳，摆出坚定姿势，脸上全神贯注。你向她[pc.move]时，她的头突然被一团无定形银色凝胶吞没。凝胶团随后膨胀成更接近球体的形状。[gooarmor.name]接着站起来面对你。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen your vision returns, you find [gooarmor.name] in a half-kneeling pose on the floor, her arms bent and hands balled in a determined fashion, her face in deep concentration. As you [pc.move] towards her, her head is suddenly engulfed in a shapeless silvery blob. The blob then inflates into a more orb-like shape. [gooarmor.name] then stands up to face you."

rows.original: “H-How can you see through this thing?” But just as she says that, her microbots get to work in adjusting their composition to make the surface of the new ‘helmet’ optically transparent in the visible light spectrum. The silver-gray color then gradually dissolves, leaving behind a very solid but clear window. “Oh, there we go--I mean, I meant to do that!” She says in response, her bubbly face now completely visible behind the simulated glass.
rows.translation: “你、你怎么透过这东西看见外面？”话音刚落，她的微型机器人便开始调整组成，让新“头盔”的表面在可见光谱中变得光学透明。银灰色随后逐渐消退，留下一扇极其坚固却透明的窗口。“哦，好了--我是说，我本来就是要这么做！”她随即说道，活泼的脸如今在模拟玻璃后完全可见。
rows.raw: "\n\n“H-How can you see through this thing?” But just as she says that, her microbots get to work in adjusting their composition to make the surface of the new ‘helmet’ optically transparent in the visible light spectrum. The silver-gray color then gradually dissolves, leaving behind a very solid but clear window. “Oh, there we go--I mean, I meant to do that!” She says in response, her bubbly face now completely visible behind the simulated glass."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: helmet 0
rows.raw: "helmet 0"

rows.original: [gooarmor.name] seems restless, constantly squirming around; it’s a bit distracting. There must be something on her mind. You call her and she quickly reshapes to form a face, it shows an expression full of eagerness and curiosity.
rows.translation: [gooarmor.name]似乎焦躁不安，不停扭动；有些让人分心。她心里肯定有事。你叫了她一声，她迅速重塑出一张脸，上面满是热切与好奇。
rows.raw: "[gooarmor.name] seems restless, constantly squirming around; it’s a bit distracting. There must be something on her mind. You call her and she quickly reshapes to form a face, it shows an expression full of eagerness and curiosity."

rows.original: “Tell me, tell me. Whatcha have there? I wanna know. Lemme touch it.”
rows.translation: “告诉我，告诉我。你那里有什么？我想知道。让我摸摸。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Tell me, tell me. Whatcha have there? I wanna know. Lemme touch it.”"

rows.original: Wait, what? What’s she talking about? You ask her what she means.
rows.translation: 等等，什么？她在说什么？你问她是什么意思。
rows.raw: "\n\nWait, what? What’s she talking about? You ask her what she means."

rows.original: “Your thingy, the hot one. Lemme see. I wanna touch it!” She looks so determined right now, looking at you with puppy eyes, her eagerness unchanged.
rows.translation: “你那个东西，热乎乎的那个。让我看看。我想摸！”她此刻坚定无比，用小狗般的眼神看着你，热切丝毫未减。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Your thingy, the hot one. Lemme see. I wanna touch it!” She looks so determined right now, looking at you with puppy eyes, her eagerness unchanged."

rows.original: You’re not in the mood for sex right now. Is she always thinking about that?
rows.translation: 你现在没心情做爱。她是不是满脑子都在想那种事？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not in the mood for sex right now. Is she always thinking about that?"

rows.original: “Aw...” She seems a little disappointed, then she looks at you again. “But that’s not what I mean. I wanna see that warm tech you have. What’s it for?”
rows.translation: “噢...”她显得有点失望，随后再次看向你。“但我不是那个意思。我想看看你那件温热的科技装备。它是做什么的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aw...” She seems a little disappointed, then she looks at you again. “But that’s not what I mean. I wanna see that warm tech you have. What’s it for?”"

rows.original: Oh! She means
rows.translation: 哦！她指的是
rows.raw: "\n\nOh! She means "

rows.raw: "the thermal pack"

rows.raw: "your cold protection gear"

rows.translation: 。你拿出

rows.raw: "thermal pack out"
