rows.raw: "item off"

rows.original: and show it to her. [gooarmor.name] keeps looking at it completely mesmerized, with wide saucer-like eyes. almost like it’s a flame and she’s a moth.
rows.translation: 并向她展示。[gooarmor.name]完全入迷地盯着它，碟子般的大眼睛睁得圆圆的，活像扑向火焰的飞蛾。
rows.raw: " and show it to her. [gooarmor.name] keeps looking at it completely mesmerized, with wide saucer-like eyes. almost like it’s a flame and she’s a moth."

rows.original: She slowly extends a gooey tendril, and with a sudden move, yanks the item from your hands. “Yoink!” Hey! That’s not nice. You frown and scold her. “Aw! Don’t be mean. Bestest friends share. I’ll give it back later, pinkie promise.”
rows.translation: 她缓缓伸出一条黏胶触须，突然一动，把物品从你手里抢走。“拿到啦！”嘿！这样可不好。你皱起眉头训斥她。“啊！别这么小气嘛。最最好的朋友要分享。我晚点就还你，拉钩保证。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe slowly extends a gooey tendril, and with a sudden move, yanks the item from your hands. “Yoink!” Hey! That’s not nice. You frown and scold her. “Aw! Don’t be mean. Bestest friends share. I’ll give it back later, pinkie promise.”"

rows.original: The cheeky gray-goo scrutinizes the piece of tech for a few moments then pushes it against her pillowy chest and absorbs it.
rows.translation: 顽皮的灰色黏胶仔细端详那件科技产品片刻，随后把它压在柔软的胸口上，吸收进体内。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe cheeky gray-goo scrutinizes the piece of tech for a few moments then pushes it against her pillowy chest and absorbs it."

rows.original: “He, he! It tickles, so fuzzy, so... warm? Oh! Oh! Now I get it. That’s why you want it, innit? Warmth! But you don’t need it. You have me. Your bestest friend gotcha covered.” Her expression changes completely, she looks like she’s trying very hard to concentrate.
rows.translation: “嘿，嘿！痒痒的，好模糊，好...暖和？哦！哦！我现在明白了。你就是因为这个才想要它，对吧？温暖！可你用不着它。你有我呀。你最最好的朋友会罩着你。”她的表情彻底改变，看起来正非常努力地集中精神。
rows.raw: "\n\n“He, he! It tickles, so fuzzy, so... warm? Oh! Oh! Now I get it. That’s why you want it, innit? Warmth! But you don’t need it. You have me. Your bestest friend gotcha covered.” Her expression changes completely, she looks like she’s trying very hard to concentrate."

rows.original: Suddenly, you feel the temperature around you change completely. It feels like a warm cocoon, a sheath of fixed temperature formed around you, fitting almost like a glove.
rows.translation: 突然间，你感觉周围的温度完全变了。那感觉就像温暖的茧，一层恒温护套在你周围形成，几乎像手套般贴合身体。
rows.raw: "\n\nSuddenly, you feel the temperature around you change completely. It feels like a warm cocoon, a sheath of fixed temperature formed around you, fitting almost like a glove."

rows.original: “See? It’s simple. You just have to oscillate an asynchronous double-layered EM field to retain the IR around you while the secondary layer creates a turbulence gap between the first layer and the colder environment. The sheer kinetic energy output involved pre-heats incoming gases and can be modulated to filter out any hazardous particles. The result is a constant bubble of portable, sterilized, climate-controlled environment around the user. Too easy!”
rows.translation: “看吧？很简单。只要让异步双层电磁场振荡，把红外辐射留在你身边，同时让第二层在第一层与较冷环境之间制造湍流间隙。产生的巨大动能会预热进入的气体，还可以调节，以滤除所有有害颗粒。最终就能在使用者周围形成恒定、便携、无菌而且气候受控的环境气泡。太简单了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“See? It’s simple. You just have to oscillate an asynchronous double-layered EM field to retain the IR around you while the secondary layer creates a turbulence gap between the first layer and the colder environment. The sheer kinetic energy output involved pre-heats incoming gases and can be modulated to filter out any hazardous particles. The result is a constant bubble of portable, sterilized, climate-controlled environment around the user. Too easy!”"

rows.original: [gooarmor.name] sounds ecstatic and is speaking so fast you have trouble keeping up, let alone understand what she just said. In any case, it’s impressive. She’s smarter than she looks at first glance.
rows.translation: [gooarmor.name]听起来兴高采烈，说得又快，你连跟上她都很困难，更别说理解她刚才讲了什么。不管怎样，这确实令人印象深刻。她比乍看之下聪明得多。
rows.raw: "\n\n[gooarmor.name] sounds ecstatic and is speaking so fast you have trouble keeping up, let alone understand what she just said. In any case, it’s impressive. She’s smarter than she looks at first glance."

rows.original: [gooarmor.name] can now protect you against cold hazards.
rows.translation: [gooarmor.name]现在能够保护你抵御严寒危害。
rows.raw: "\n\n[gooarmor.name] can now protect you against cold hazards."

rows.original: You approach [gooarmor.name] for a chat, but find her face suddenly blanche (that is, if she wasn’t already a full coat of solid silver-gray).
rows.translation: 你走向[gooarmor.name]想聊聊天，却发现她的脸突然煞白（当然，前提是她原本还没有从头到脚都是纯银灰色）。
rows.raw: "You approach [gooarmor.name] for a chat, but find her face suddenly blanche (that is, if she wasn’t already a full coat of solid silver-gray)."

rows.original: Hey girl
rows.raw: "Hey girl"

rows.original: Oh, [gooarmor.name]
rows.raw: "Oh, [gooarmor.name]"

rows.original: , something wrong?” You ask, noticing her ill expression.
rows.translation: ，出什么事了吗？”你注意到她难受的表情，问道。
rows.raw: ", something wrong?” You ask, noticing her ill expression."

rows.original: She responds, with an unnatural heaving noise. Then the sound of bubbling and gurgling rumbles through her tummy. “Umm... I don’t feel so good...” She finally exhales, clutching her midsection.
rows.translation: 她发出不自然的干呕声作为回应，紧接着，肚子里传出冒泡与咕噜的轰鸣。“呃...我感觉不太舒服...”她终于吐出一口气，捂着腹部。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe responds, with an unnatural heaving noise. Then the sound of bubbling and gurgling rumbles through her tummy. “Umm... I don’t feel so good...” She finally exhales, clutching her midsection."

rows.original: “Wh-what happened?”
rows.translation: “发，发生什么了？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wh-what happened?”"

rows.original: “Please don’t get mad at me, [pc.name]...” She begs a caveat.
rows.translation: “请别生我的气，[pc.name]...”她先央求你答应这个条件。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Please don’t get mad at me, [pc.name]...” She begs a caveat."

joinAfter.expression: pc.isAss() ? "You swing your arms in the air. “C’mon out with it already! What happened?”" : "You nod and assure her you won’t, whatever it is."

rows.original: You swing your arms in the air. “C’mon out with it already! What happened?”
rows.translation: 你在空中挥动双臂。“别磨蹭了，快说！到底发生什么了？”
rows.raw: "You swing your arms in the air. “C’mon out with it already! What happened?”"

rows.original: You nod and assure her you won’t, whatever it is.
rows.translation: 你点头保证，无论发生了什么，自己都不会生气。
rows.raw: "You nod and assure her you won’t, whatever it is."

rows.original: You just want to know what’s wrong with her.
rows.translation: 你只是想知道她哪里不舒服。
rows.raw: " You just want to know what’s wrong with her."

rows.original: Gurgle. “W-well... like...” Bubble. “...you know those energy drinks you keep in your pack?”
rows.translation: 咕噜。“这，这个...就是...”冒泡。“...你知道自己背包里那些能量饮料吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nGurgle. “W-well... like...” Bubble. “...you know those energy drinks you keep in your pack?”"

rows.original: Energy drinks? What energy drinks?
rows.translation: 能量饮料？什么能量饮料？
rows.raw: "\n\nEnergy drinks? What energy drinks?"

rows.original: “I-I wanted to taste them... and they were too yummy... and... and I drank a whole, whole bunch! I couldn’t help myself! I’m SOOOO sorry!” She blurts, hands now covering her mouth. The gurgling seems to have instantly stopped after the climax of her confession. “Hm?”
rows.translation: “我，我想尝尝它们...而且实在太好喝了...然后...然后我就喝了好多好多！我忍不住嘛！真的非——常对不起！”她脱口而出，双手捂住嘴巴。坦白达到高潮后，咕噜声似乎瞬间停止了。“嗯？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-I wanted to taste them... and they were too yummy... and... and I drank a whole, whole bunch! I couldn’t help myself! I’m SOOOO sorry!” She blurts, hands now covering her mouth. The gurgling seems to have instantly stopped after the climax of her confession. “Hm?”"

rows.original: You double-check your inventory and notice it being a bit lighter than you remember. Open and mostly-empty canisters roll out, one by one, and fall to the hard floor. You squat down to investigate. Hm. It seems [gooarmor.name] has been drinking - or in her case, assimilating - the gray microbots you’ve been holding in your inventory... You stand up to let [gooarmor.name] know exactly what she drank, but as you turn to her, an unnoticed puddle of gray microbots forces you to slip and lose your balance. You go head first toward a nearby wall and your vision goes black.
rows.translation: 你再次检查物品栏，发现它比记忆中轻了一些。打开且几乎喝空的罐子一个接一个滚出来，掉在坚硬地面上。你蹲下调查。嗯。看来[gooarmor.name]一直在饮用，或者对她来说是在同化，你物品栏中存放的灰色微型机器人...你站起身，准备告诉[gooarmor.name]她到底喝了什么，可转向她时，一滩未被注意到的灰色微型机器人让你脚下一滑，失去平衡。你一头撞向附近的墙壁，眼前随即一黑。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou double-check your inventory and notice it being a bit lighter than you remember. Open and mostly-empty canisters roll out, one by one, and fall to the hard floor. You squat down to investigate. Hm. It seems [gooarmor.name] has been drinking - or in her case, assimilating - the gray microbots you’ve been holding in your inventory... You stand up to let [gooarmor.name] know exactly what she drank, but as you turn to her, an unnoticed puddle of gray microbots forces you to slip and lose your balance. You go head first toward a nearby wall and your vision goes black."

rows.raw: " canister, her head tilting side to side as she hums. She is looking down at a spare data slate, periodically swiping the screen, flipping through different pages of what looks to be a fashion magazine. You call out to the goo girl and she instantly perks up and turns to you, the drinking tube dropping from her mouth."

rows.original: “Oh, heya, [pc.name]! What’s up?” Her smile gleams as bright as ever. You ask if she wants to chat and she nods excitedly, forming her lower body into a blob and extending herself towards you. As she swirls herself around you, she continues, “Sure, what do ya--...” Her orbit slows down as she examines you deeper. Expression furrowing, she pouts in concentration. “Hey...”
rows.translation: “哦，嗨呀，[pc.name]！怎么啦？”她的笑容一如既往地灿烂。你问她想不想聊聊，她兴奋地点头，把下半身变成一团，朝你伸展过来。她环绕着你旋转，继续说道：“当然，怎么——...”她更仔细地观察你，旋转速度逐渐放慢。她皱起表情，专注地嘟着嘴。“嘿...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, heya, [pc.name]! What’s up?” Her smile gleams as bright as ever. You ask if she wants to chat and she nods excitedly, forming her lower body into a blob and extending herself towards you. As she swirls herself around you, she continues, “Sure, what do ya--...” Her orbit slows down as she examines you deeper. Expression furrowing, she pouts in concentration. “Hey...”"

rows.original: You don’t blame her, their language is tricky to foreigners if their tongue isn’t trained for it.

rows.original: a previous public debate in U.G.C. politics.
rows.translation: 银河联合邦联政坛此前的一场公开辩论。
rows.raw: " a previous public debate in U.G.C. politics."

rows.original: “...and I don’t know much about that foreign gobbly-gook she keeps talking about, but she looks like a total bitch! I mean, have you heard her laugh?” she comments.
rows.translation: “...而且她一直讲的那些外国鬼话，我也不太懂，不过她看起来就是个彻头彻尾的婊子！我是说，你听过她的笑声吗？”她评论道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...and I don’t know much about that foreign gobbly-gook she keeps talking about, but she looks like a total bitch! I mean, have you heard her laugh?” she comments."

rows.original: “Oh, totally, that senator has the most bitchiest bitch-face ever, ugh!” you agree, remembering that almost-demonic laugh during the debate.
rows.translation: “哦，没错，那个参议员长着史上最欠揍的婊子脸，呃！”你赞同道，回想起她在辩论中那近乎恶魔般的笑声。
rows.raw: "“Oh, totally, that senator has the most bitchiest bitch-face ever, ugh!” you agree, remembering that almost-demonic laugh during the debate."

rows.original: While the senator’s politics don’t really mesh with yours, you can agree with [gooarmor.name] on one thing: that senator needs some mods to fix her face for sure--and her voice. Lady laughs like a banshee.
rows.translation: 尽管那名参议员的政治立场与你不太相合，但有一点你可以认同[gooarmor.name]：那个参议员绝对需要做些改造来修整她的脸--还有她的声音。那女人笑起来像个报丧女妖。
rows.raw: "While the senator’s politics don’t really mesh with yours, you can agree with [gooarmor.name] on one thing: that senator needs some mods to fix her face for sure--and her voice. Lady laughs like a banshee."

rows.original: a recent charity to help fund research for a remedy to some rare SSTD.
rows.translation: 最近为某种罕见性传播转化疾病的疗法研究筹集资金的一项慈善活动。
rows.raw: " a recent charity to help fund research for a remedy to some rare SSTD."

rows.original: “...and yeah, I would totally help if I could earn the credits. You think I can give blowjobs for donations?” she ponders.
rows.translation: “...对呀，如果我能赚到信用点，我肯定愿意帮忙。你觉得我可以靠口交募集捐款吗？”她思索道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...and yeah, I would totally help if I could earn the credits. You think I can give blowjobs for donations?” she ponders."

rows.original: “Oh, that would be, like, the best fundraiser ever--I’ll even join you! Double the effort, double the earnings!” you agree, letting the thought linger a little more while you two hatch a hypothetical plan....
rows.translation: “哦，那简直会是史上最棒的募捐活动--我也要加入！双倍努力，双倍收入！”你赞同道。你们一边构想假想计划，一边让这个念头在脑中多停留了一会儿....
rows.raw: "“Oh, that would be, like, the best fundraiser ever--I’ll even join you! Double the effort, double the earnings!” you agree, letting the thought linger a little more while you two hatch a hypothetical plan...."

rows.original: Hypothetically indulging her silly idea, if given the right circumstances, you could probably send her to a red-light district to shake her money maker and then send the proceeds to the fundraiser....
rows.translation: 假设条件合适，你顺着她那个傻乎乎的主意想了下去：也许可以把她送到红灯区卖弄姿色，再把收入捐给募款活动....
rows.raw: "Hypothetically indulging her silly idea, if given the right circumstances, you could probably send her to a red-light district to shake her money maker and then send the proceeds to the fundraiser...."

rows.original: a questionable mod being advertised on the holo-boards.

rows.raw: " a questionable mod being advertised on the holo-boards."

rows.original: “...and I dunno, changing yourself into that might not be a good idea, right?” she asks.

rows.raw: "\n\n“...and I dunno, changing yourself into that might not be a good idea, right?” she asks."

rows.original: You think about it, but you can’t make an opinion one way or the other. You guess it’s just up to the user to decide!
rows.translation: 你想了想，却无法认定哪一边更合理。你猜，这终究得由使用者自己决定！
rows.raw: "You think about it, but you can’t make an opinion one way or the other. You guess it’s just up to the user to decide!"

rows.original: She’s probably right, but you find it humorous that she is concerned about change when she’s a goo-girl who changes form constantly.
rows.translation: 她大概说得对，不过身为一个总在不断变形的黏胶女孩，她居然会担心变化，还是让你觉得颇为好笑。

rows.original: Looking at your reaction, [gooarmor.name] suppresses a soft giggle with one hand to maintain her modesty. “I’m sorry, I’m afraid you are mistaken. Who is this ‘[gooarmor.name]’? A stowaway, perhaps?” Her eyes scan yours. “I can try helping you look for her--we take lost persons cases quite seriously on the NOVA.”
rows.translation: 看见你的反应，[gooarmor.name]用一只手掩住轻笑，以维持端庄。“很抱歉，恐怕你认错人了。这位‘[gooarmor.name]’是谁？也许是个偷渡客？”她的眼睛审视着你。“我可以试着帮你找她——我们在新星号上非常认真地处理失踪人口案件。”

rows.original: ...” You reconsider your answer. Clearly she is role playing with you, so you might as well play along...
rows.translation: ...”你重新考虑自己的回答。她显然在与你角色扮演，所以你不妨陪她演下去...
rows.raw: "...” You reconsider your answer. Clearly she is role playing with you, so you might as well play along..."

rows.original: “Oh yaaah, that’s right. My B.F.F. has, like, totally disappeared on me. We were supposed to go get ice cream, catch a movie, and have the bestest girls’-night-out ever... But I can’t find her anywhere! I was going to surprise her with something super-duper sexy afterwards, but I guess I gotta, like, hold off on it and stuff...”
rows.translation: “哦呀呀，没错。我的闺蜜突然彻底消失了。我们本来要去吃冰淇淋、看电影，度过史上最棒的女生之夜...可我哪儿都找不到她！之后我本来还想给她一个超级无敌性感的惊喜，但现在看来，我只能先把它推迟什么的...”
rows.raw: " “Oh yaaah, that’s right. My B.F.F. has, like, totally disappeared on me. We were supposed to go get ice cream, catch a movie, and have the bestest girls’-night-out ever... But I can’t find her anywhere! I was going to surprise her with something super-duper sexy afterwards, but I guess I gotta, like, hold off on it and stuff...”"

rows.original: “You’re damn right, woman--There’s a stowaway on board and we need to kick her out before she starts a mutiny up in here. Perhaps you’ve seen her. She has a big perky face, huuuge tits - as big as her head! - and a butt that won’t stop jiggling. Oh, and she’s some kind of meta-morphing, shape-shifting mutant, so she could be anyone... I bet she could even control minds!”
rows.translation: “你他妈说得没错，女人——船上有个偷渡客，我们必须在她发动兵变前把她踢出去。也许你见过她。她有一张饱满活泼的脸，胸部大得惊人——跟她脑袋一样大！——还有一个晃个不停的屁股。哦，而且她还是某种能改变形态、变换外表的突变体，所以她可能是任何人...我敢说她甚至能控制心智！”
rows.raw: " “You’re damn right, woman--There’s a stowaway on board and we need to kick her out before she starts a mutiny up in here. Perhaps you’ve seen her. She has a big perky face, huuuge tits - as big as her head! - and a butt that won’t stop jiggling. Oh, and she’s some kind of meta-morphing, shape-shifting mutant, so she could be anyone... I bet she could even control minds!”"

rows.original: “Captain Morrow, thank goodness I found you! My... my friend, she’s gone missing and I don’t know where to find her!” You wipe the imaginary sweat from your forehead. “One moment, she was with me; the next moment, gone. I think the snatchers might have gotten to her. I mean, I know it’s probably just an urban legend, but I’m worried. What if... what if snatchers are real? I need to find her before it’s too late!”
rows.translation: “莫罗上尉，谢天谢地，我终于找到你了！我的...我的朋友失踪了，我不知道该去哪里找她！”你擦了擦额头上并不存在的汗水。“前一刻她还和我在一起，下一刻就消失了。我觉得可能是夺身者抓走了她。我知道那也许只是都市传说，但我很担心。如果...如果夺身者真的存在呢？我必须在一切太迟之前找到她！”
rows.raw: " “Captain Morrow, thank goodness I found you! My... my friend, she’s gone missing and I don’t know where to find her!” You wipe the imaginary sweat from your forehead. “One moment, she was with me; the next moment, gone. I think the snatchers might have gotten to her. I mean, I know it’s probably just an urban legend, but I’m worried. What if... what if snatchers are real? I need to find her before it’s too late!”"

rows.original: “Oh my...” ‘Captain Morrow’ gasps, her eyes wide and brows tilted in deep concern. “We must find her quick!”
rows.translation: “哦天啊...”“莫罗上尉”倒吸一口气，双眼睁大，眉毛因深切担忧而倾斜。“我们必须赶快找到她！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh my...” ‘Captain Morrow’ gasps, her eyes wide and brows tilted in deep concern. “We must find her quick!”"

rows.original: The two of you spend a small moment opening compartments, looking under shelves, and flipping through security cam channels but can’t ‘find’ signs of [gooarmor.name] anywhere.
rows.translation: 你们俩花了一小会儿打开舱柜、查看架子下方，还翻阅监控频道，却始终“找”不到[gooarmor.name]的任何踪迹。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you spend a small moment opening compartments, looking under shelves, and flipping through security cam channels but can’t ‘find’ signs of [gooarmor.name] anywhere."

rows.original: After exhausting all methods of search, Morrow drops to her knees.
rows.translation: 穷尽所有搜索方式后，莫罗双膝跪地。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter exhausting all methods of search, Morrow drops to her knees."

rows.original: “Oh no... She’s totally going to miss out.” You scrunch your face and pout your lips, acting as if you are about to cry.
rows.translation: “哦不...她绝对要错过了。”你皱起脸、噘起嘴，装作马上就要哭出来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh no... She’s totally going to miss out.” You scrunch your face and pout your lips, acting as if you are about to cry."

rows.original: “She’s probably got to them. All of them. This ship’s been compromised!” Your face turns into an angry scowl of defeat, exaggerated to make sure she can read it.
rows.translation: “她大概已经把他们控制了。所有人。这艘船已经沦陷了！”你的脸变成挫败的愤怒阴沉表情，并刻意夸张，确保她能够看懂。
rows.raw: "\n\n“She’s probably got to them. All of them. This ship’s been compromised!” Your face turns into an angry scowl of defeat, exaggerated to make sure she can read it."

rows.original: “She’s... she’s gone.” You cover your face with your hands, preparing to go into full sobbing mode with an imaginary waterfall of tears.
rows.translation: “她...她不在了。”你用双手捂住脸，准备进入彻底痛哭模式，流下一道并不存在的泪水瀑布。
rows.raw: "\n\n“She’s... she’s gone.” You cover your face with your hands, preparing to go into full sobbing mode with an imaginary waterfall of tears."

rows.original: Morrow’s silvery face begins to break character and she is convinced so much by you that she really believes what you’re saying. Suddenly, she springs onto you with a gooey hug, practically squeezing the life out of you, her legs melting and pooling around your body to add to the embrace.
rows.translation: 莫罗的银色面孔开始脱离角色，而你的表演如此有说服力，令她真的相信了你的话。突然，她扑上来给了你一个凝胶拥抱，几乎把你的生命都挤出来；双腿融化，在你身体周围汇聚，令拥抱更加紧密。
rows.raw: "\n\nMorrow’s silvery face begins to break character and she is convinced so much by you that she really believes what you’re saying. Suddenly, she springs onto you with a gooey hug, practically squeezing the life out of you, her legs melting and pooling around your body to add to the embrace."

rows.original: “Here I am! Look! See?” Easing her glomp attack, she lifts her head and looks honestly into your eyes. Her face quickly contorts and smoothly shifts back to her [gooarmor.name]-face. “It’s me!”
rows.translation: “我在这里！看！看见了吗？”她放松飞扑拥抱，抬起头，真诚地望进你的双眼。她的脸迅速扭曲，平滑地恢复成[gooarmor.name]的面孔。“是我！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Here I am! Look! See?” Easing her glomp attack, she lifts her head and looks honestly into your eyes. Her face quickly contorts and smoothly shifts back to her [gooarmor.name]-face. “It’s me!”"

rows.original: . Her morphing herself like that gives you an idea. Curious, you ask about her ability to hold different shapes and if she would be willing to change into anything you ask.
rows.translation: 。她那样变形让你产生了一个想法。出于好奇，你询问她保持不同形态的能力，以及她是否愿意变成你要求的任何东西。
rows.raw: ". Her morphing herself like that gives you an idea. Curious, you ask about her ability to hold different shapes and if she would be willing to change into anything you ask."

rows.original: “Sure thing, [pc.name]!” she exclaims as she swirls off your body to face you standing. “Buuut, I might have trouble remembering different forms if you ask for too much. I think Captain Morrow is super pretty, but I really like how I look right now!” She gives you a wink. “And I don’t mind if you ask me to change, okay?”
rows.translation: “当然可以，[pc.name]！”她惊呼着从你身上旋转离开，站在面前。“不过呢，如果你要求太多，我可能很难记住不同形态。我觉得莫罗上尉超级漂亮，但我真的很喜欢自己现在的样子！”她朝你眨眨眼。“而且你尽管叫我改变，我不介意的，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure thing, [pc.name]!” she exclaims as she swirls off your body to face you standing. “Buuut, I might have trouble remembering different forms if you ask for too much. I think Captain Morrow is super pretty, but I really like how I look right now!” She gives you a wink. “And I don’t mind if you ask me to change, okay?”"

rows.original: You nod, then ask her if she can do the same when you are wearing her.
rows.translation: 你点点头，随后问她穿在你身上时能否做同样的事。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, then ask her if she can do the same when you are wearing her."

rows.original: “Mmm... that’s a bit harder, but I can try!” she says pondering. “When you wear me, I just kinda cover everything to make sure I stay on and stuff. I’m afraid, if I change into something else for a long period of time, I might fall off and get lost!”
rows.translation: “嗯...那就有点难了，不过我可以试试！”她思考着说道。“你穿着我时，我只是把一切都覆盖起来，确保自己不会脱落什么的。我担心如果长时间变成其他东西，自己可能会掉下来，然后走丢！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmm... that’s a bit harder, but I can try!” she says pondering. “When you wear me, I just kinda cover everything to make sure I stay on and stuff. I’m afraid, if I change into something else for a long period of time, I might fall off and get lost!”"

rows.original: You take a moment to think, then ask: if you brought her an outfit, if she would be willing to duplicate its shape like she did Victoria’s shape.
rows.translation: 你思考片刻，随后问道：如果你给她带来一件服装，她是否愿意像复制维多利亚的外形一样复制那件衣服的形状。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a moment to think, then ask: if you brought her an outfit, if she would be willing to duplicate its shape like she did Victoria’s shape."

rows.original: “Ooo... I see. Then, if you really want something specific, like a covering for your face or an opening for your butt, gimme something that fits you and I’ll try to copy it!”
rows.translation: “哦哦...我懂了。那如果你真的想要某种特定样式，比如遮住脸或者在屁股上留个开口，就给我一件合身的东西，我会试着复制它！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ooo... I see. Then, if you really want something specific, like a covering for your face or an opening for your butt, gimme something that fits you and I’ll try to copy it!”"

rows.original: The goo-girl dips the tip of her toe into the water and quickly retracts back. “Oooh, cold!” The sensitivity in her temperature sensors must be turned up, you note. When she sees you enjoying the water, she huffs her worries away. Not wanting to be left out, she takes a few steps back... then makes a dash towards the pool and jumps straight into the air. “CANNONBALL!”
rows.translation: 凝胶姑娘把脚趾尖伸进水中，又迅速缩了回来。“哦哦，好冷！”你心想，她温度传感器的灵敏度一定调得很高。看见你享受着水，她气呼呼地赶走忧虑。不想被落下，她后退几步...随后冲向泳池，笔直跃入空中。“炸弹跳水！”
rows.raw: "The goo-girl dips the tip of her toe into the water and quickly retracts back. “Oooh, cold!” The sensitivity in her temperature sensors must be turned up, you note. When she sees you enjoying the water, she huffs her worries away. Not wanting to be left out, she takes a few steps back... then makes a dash towards the pool and jumps straight into the air. “CANNONBALL!”"

rows.raw: "\n\nShe morphs herself into an actual ball shape and shifts her mass to crash right down into the water. Though she safely lands a few feet away from you, the magnitude of the splash is so great, it lifts you up off your [pc.feet]. When you"

rows.original: touch the pool bottom again, your silver friend surfaces next to you, remorphed back into her bikini-clad self.
rows.translation: 再次碰到池底时，银色朋友在你身旁浮出水面，已经重新变成身穿比基尼的模样。
rows.raw: " touch the pool bottom again, your silver friend surfaces next to you, remorphed back into her bikini-clad self."

rows.original: “Ahhh... This really is nice, isn’t it, [pc.name]?” she coos. When she turns to you she finds you completely soaked... and you haven’t even started swimming yet! “Oops! I totally over-did it, didn’t I?”
rows.translation: “啊啊...这里真的很舒服，对吧，[pc.name]？”她柔声说道。当她转向你时，却发现你浑身湿透...而你甚至还没开始游泳！“哎呀！我完全做过头了，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ahhh... This really is nice, isn’t it, [pc.name]?” she coos. When she turns to you she finds you completely soaked... and you haven’t even started swimming yet! “Oops! I totally over-did it, didn’t I?”"

rows.original: You answer her question by sweeping your arms from behind you and letting loose two handfuls of cool water right at her face, payback for the drenching she gave you.
rows.translation: 你从身后挥动双臂，把两捧凉水直接泼到她脸上，以此回答她的问题，报复她刚才把你浇透。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou answer her question by sweeping your arms from behind you and letting loose two handfuls of cool water right at her face, payback for the drenching she gave you."

rows.original: “Ack!” she squeaks, then lets out a joyful giggle and splashes back.
rows.translation: “呀！”她尖叫一声，随后开心地咯咯笑着，反手泼水回来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ack!” she squeaks, then lets out a joyful giggle and splashes back."

rows.original: The two of you splash-fight for a bit, which eventually leads to some friendly, competitive swimming. When you are all swimmed out, you take some time to relax with [gooarmor.name] and chat a little. She talks about all the different swimsuits she’s seen so far and the ones she likes the most. She also offers to be your swimsuit if you ever need one. That definitely would come in handy, you think.
rows.translation: 你们俩打了一会儿水仗，最终演变成友好而激烈的游泳竞赛。游到筋疲力尽后，你花了些时间与[gooarmor.name]一起放松、聊聊天。她谈起自己迄今见过的各种泳装，以及最喜欢的款式。她还表示，如果你需要，自己可以变成你的泳装。你觉得那肯定会很方便。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you splash-fight for a bit, which eventually leads to some friendly, competitive swimming. When you are all swimmed out, you take some time to relax with [gooarmor.name] and chat a little. She talks about all the different swimsuits she’s seen so far and the ones she likes the most. She also offers to be your swimsuit if you ever need one. That definitely would come in handy, you think."

rows.original: Stepping out of the pool, you approach the shower to rinse yourself off. However, all [gooarmor.name] does is shake like a wet ausar and she is instantly dry, also having reshaped back to her previous form. Before you can get to your gear and dry yourself, you feel two big smacks, one on each of your [pc.butts]. Arching your back in surprise, you turn around to find [gooarmor.name], her hands behind her, looking at you and smiling innocently. She’s so naughty!
rows.translation: 你走出泳池，来到淋浴处冲洗身体。然而，[gooarmor.name]只是像湿透的澳萨人一样抖了抖，便立刻完全干燥，同时也恢复了先前的形态。你还没来得及去拿装备擦干身体，便感觉两记响亮的拍打分别落在你的[pc.butts]上。你惊讶地弓起背，转身发现[gooarmor.name]双手藏在身后，正一脸无辜地朝你微笑。她真调皮！
rows.raw: "\n\nStepping out of the pool, you approach the shower to rinse yourself off. However, all [gooarmor.name] does is shake like a wet ausar and she is instantly dry, also having reshaped back to her previous form. Before you can get to your gear and dry yourself, you feel two big smacks, one on each of your [pc.butts]. Arching your back in surprise, you turn around to find [gooarmor.name], her hands behind her, looking at you and smiling innocently. She’s so naughty!"

rows.original: Apparently she is putting on an act again, since you know - as a gray goo - she doesn’t need air to survive. But to humor her, you play along and shout: “[gooarmor.name]! Take it off! Take it off!”

rows.original: One by one, lines draw hexagonal tiles on certain parts of your suit, giving it a very modern flavor.
rows.translation: 一道道线条依次在战衣特定部位勾勒出六边形拼块，赋予其极具现代感的风格。
rows.raw: " One by one, lines draw hexagonal tiles on certain parts of your suit, giving it a very modern flavor."

rows.original: Like a marker, polished silver trim is drawn along the edges of your suit, giving it an elegant yet simple look.
rows.translation: 如同记号笔绘制一般，抛光银色饰边沿战衣边缘延伸，带来优雅而简洁的外观。
rows.raw: " Like a marker, polished silver trim is drawn along the edges of your suit, giving it an elegant yet simple look."

rows.original: Lines of silver are drawn on your suit, bending in angles and ending either off the edge or capped with a dot or circle shape. This circuit board pattern makes your suit look very tech-oriented.
rows.translation: 银色线条绘制在战衣上，弯折成角；末端有的延伸至边缘外，有的则以圆点或圆形封口。这种电路板图案让战衣显得科技感十足。
rows.raw: " Lines of silver are drawn on your suit, bending in angles and ending either off the edge or capped with a dot or circle shape. This circuit board pattern makes your suit look very tech-oriented."

rows.original: L
Emanating from the collar, l
rows.raw: "Emanating from the collar, l"

rows.original: ines are drawn downward and across certain anatomical seams along your suit, segmenting it into major portions yet still retaining the one-piece look.
rows.translation: 线条沿战衣的特定解剖接缝向下、横向延伸，将其分成几个主要部分，同时仍保留连体外观。
rows.raw: "ines are drawn downward and across certain anatomical seams along your suit, segmenting it into major portions yet still retaining the one-piece look."

rows.original: Gradually, the new pattern you requested emerges on the surface of the suit until your suit is covered in the new design.
rows.translation: 你要求的新图案逐渐浮现在战衣表面，直到整件战衣都被新设计覆盖。
rows.raw: " Gradually, the new pattern you requested emerges on the surface of the suit until your suit is covered in the new design."

rows.original: [gooarmor.name] quickly engulfs your head with her gooey matter. Your vision is eclipsed in black for a few seconds before the microbots blocking your eyes begin to clear up, creating a transparent layer and allowing you to see your reflection in the mirror.
rows.translation: [gooarmor.name]迅速用凝胶物质吞没你的头部。视野陷入黑暗数秒，随后挡住双眼的微型机器人开始散开，形成透明层，让你能看见镜中的倒影。
rows.raw: " [gooarmor.name] quickly engulfs your head with her gooey matter. Your vision is eclipsed in black for a few seconds before the microbots blocking your eyes begin to clear up, creating a transparent layer and allowing you to see your reflection in the mirror."

rows.original: The helmet on your head quickly opens opens up and rapidly dissolves, melding back into the suit from which it came. After making some final aesthetic adjustments, [gooarmor.name] squeals in approval. “Now just remember to be careful out there!”
rows.translation: 头盔迅速打开并溶解，重新融回它诞生的战衣。进行最后几项美观调整后，[gooarmor.name]赞许地尖叫。“在外面一定要小心哦！”
rows.raw: " The helmet on your head quickly opens opens up and rapidly dissolves, melding back into the suit from which it came. After making some final aesthetic adjustments, [gooarmor.name] squeals in approval. “Now just remember to be careful out there!”"

rows.original: The surface of your new head gear becomes more defined until it changes into something similar to a sports speeder’s helmet, but with some noticeable accents. Something tells you that if [gooarmor.name] wasn’t completely silver-gray, the surface would be colored bright pink and decked with heart-shaped stickers.
rows.translation: 新头部装备的表面变得更加清晰，最终化作类似运动飞车头盔的造型，但带有几处醒目装饰。某种直觉告诉你，要是[gooarmor.name]并非通体银灰，表面肯定会涂成亮粉色，再贴满心形贴纸。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe surface of your new head gear becomes more defined until it changes into something similar to a sports speeder’s helmet, but with some noticeable accents. Something tells you that if [gooarmor.name] wasn’t completely silver-gray, the surface would be colored bright pink and decked with heart-shaped stickers."

rows.original: “How do you like that? Nice and stylish!”
rows.translation: “喜欢吗？又漂亮又时髦！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“How do you like that? Nice and stylish!”"

rows.original: The helmet’s form twists and shifts, with edges and sharp points appearing across its surface. The viewable area narrows until your reflection shows that it has become a linear slit masking your eyes. The helmet itself is flush with the shape of your head, allowing it to move in sync without wobbling. In the right lighting, at the right angle, you can almost see a piercing glow emanating from your eye slit.
rows.translation: 头盔形态扭曲变换，表面浮现棱边与尖角。可视区域逐渐收窄，直到倒影显示它化为一道遮住双眼的横向狭缝。头盔本身与头部轮廓严丝合缝，能同步移动而不会晃动。在合适的光线与角度下，你几乎能看见眼部狭缝中透出刺目光芒。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe helmet’s form twists and shifts, with edges and sharp points appearing across its surface. The viewable area narrows until your reflection shows that it has become a linear slit masking your eyes. The helmet itself is flush with the shape of your head, allowing it to move in sync without wobbling. In the right lighting, at the right angle, you can almost see a piercing glow emanating from your eye slit."

rows.original: “Ooh, yeah. Now you look super scary!”
rows.translation: “哦耶。现在你看起来超级吓人！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ooh, yeah. Now you look super scary!”"

rows.original: The entire dome inflates into a spherical shape, forming a very distinctive bubble that steadily continues to grow larger. When it reaches the appropriate size for you, the rest of the orb’s silvery gray tint dissolves away, leaving behind a glass-like surface. You experimentally tap it a few times and determine that it sounds very much like glass too--and hopefully a lot more durable!
rows.translation: 整个圆顶膨胀成球形，形成极具辨识度的泡泡，并继续稳定变大。达到适合你的尺寸时，球体其余部分的银灰色逐渐褪去，只留下一层玻璃般的表面。你试着敲了几下，判断它听起来也很像玻璃——但愿结实得多！
rows.raw: "\n\nThe entire dome inflates into a spherical shape, forming a very distinctive bubble that steadily continues to grow larger. When it reaches the appropriate size for you, the rest of the orb’s silvery gray tint dissolves away, leaving behind a glass-like surface. You experimentally tap it a few times and determine that it sounds very much like glass too--and hopefully a lot more durable!"

rows.original: “Is this how ancient spacers looked? I like it!”
rows.translation: “古代太空人就是这副模样吗？我喜欢！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is this how ancient spacers looked? I like it!”"

rows.original: The helmet’s surface smoothes out and warps to match the dimensions of your head, then the transparency re-shades itself in a silver, reflexive film - painting the entire front to form a smooth, featureless mask. No one can see your face even though you can see through it just fine. This definitely gives you a very anonymous appearance.
rows.translation: 头盔表面变得光滑，并扭曲到贴合头部尺寸；随后透明层重新染上一层银色反光薄膜——将整个正面涂成光滑无特征的面罩。虽然你能透过它正常看清外界，但别人完全看不到你的脸。这无疑赋予你非常匿名的外观。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe helmet’s surface smoothes out and warps to match the dimensions of your head, then the transparency re-shades itself in a silver, reflexive film - painting the entire front to form a smooth, featureless mask. No one can see your face even though you can see through it just fine. This definitely gives you a very anonymous appearance."

rows.original: “Ooo, mysterious!”
rows.translation: “哦哦，好神秘！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ooo, mysterious!”"

rows.original: The headgear’s surface molds into a shape that looks very similar to a round hoverbike helmet, complete with its own flip visor, and fits snugly with your head. At the top, two blobs protrude from the surface. They reshape to form a pair of large, triangular animal ears, like those belonging to a cat or fennec-like creature.
rows.translation: 头部装备的表面塑成与圆形悬浮摩托头盔极其相似的造型，自带可翻式面罩，并紧贴头部。顶部有两团物质从表面凸起，重塑为一对巨大的三角形兽耳，如同猫或耳廓狐一类生物的耳朵。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe headgear’s surface molds into a shape that looks very similar to a round hoverbike helmet, complete with its own flip visor, and fits snugly with your head. At the top, two blobs protrude from the surface. They reshape to form a pair of large, triangular animal ears, like those belonging to a cat or fennec-like creature."

rows.original: “Aw, that makes you look like such a cutie!”
rows.translation: “啊，这让你看起来好可爱！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aw, that makes you look like such a cutie!”"

rows.original: The mass around the helmet reshapes itself into a more blocky shape, yet retaining some familiar curvature. A tough-looking visor and an obvious mouthguard form in the front while a slight cap tops the frame and thick ear shells cover the sides, making the headgear appear in line with standard military wear. After a few adjustments, the final design looks like it can take a good beating but remain intact.
rows.translation: 头盔周围的物质重塑成更加方正的形状，同时保留几分熟悉的曲线。正面形成一块坚固面罩和明显的护嘴，框架顶部覆有微微突出的帽檐，两侧则被厚实耳罩覆盖，使头部装备符合标准军用装束。经过几次调整，最终设计看起来即使挨上一顿狠揍也能保持完好。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe mass around the helmet reshapes itself into a more blocky shape, yet retaining some familiar curvature. A tough-looking visor and an obvious mouthguard form in the front while a slight cap tops the frame and thick ear shells cover the sides, making the headgear appear in line with standard military wear. After a few adjustments, the final design looks like it can take a good beating but remain intact."

rows.original: “Like, do you wanna live forever?! Ooh-rah!”
rows.translation: “那个，你想永生吗？！哦啦！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like, do you wanna live forever?! Ooh-rah!”"

rows.original: The silvery blob splits and forms into two pointed pieces, one below your lower jaw and the other above your head, looking very much like a shark or bird maw--and, like the mouth of a beast, the “jaw” closes around your head, flattening and reshaping as it goes, the corners polarized at three distinct points. When finished, the helmet gives off the illusion that you are wearing a tricorn hat, closed off by a large collar under your chin.
rows.translation: 银色团块裂开，形成上下两块尖锐部件，一块位于下颚下方，另一块位于头顶，看起来很像鲨鱼或鸟类的巨口——如同野兽的嘴，那副“颚”环绕你的头部闭合，同时逐渐压平重塑，边角在三个明显点位形成尖峰。完成后，头盔营造出你戴着三角帽的错觉，并由下巴下方的巨大衣领封闭。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe silvery blob splits and forms into two pointed pieces, one below your lower jaw and the other above your head, looking very much like a shark or bird maw--and, like the mouth of a beast, the “jaw” closes around your head, flattening and reshaping as it goes, the corners polarized at three distinct points. When finished, the helmet gives off the illusion that you are wearing a tricorn hat, closed off by a large collar under your chin."

rows.original: “Cool, you look kinda like a pirate now!”
rows.translation: “酷，你现在看起来有点像海盗！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Cool, you look kinda like a pirate now!”"

rows.original: The silver surface of the new helmet begins to split and form separate plates of armor. The plates move and position themselves around your head, creating a regal, crown-like shape at the top and leaving a “Y”-shaped gap as a primary slit for your eyes.
rows.translation: 新头盔的银色表面开始分裂，形成一块块独立装甲板。甲片自行移动并环绕头部排列，在顶部构成高贵的王冠造型，同时留下“Y”形缺口作为主要眼部狭缝。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe silver surface of the new helmet begins to split and form separate plates of armor. The plates move and position themselves around your head, creating a regal, crown-like shape at the top and leaving a “Y”-shaped gap as a primary slit for your eyes."

rows.original: “I hereby dub thee, Knight of Steele!”
rows.translation: “我在此册封你为斯蒂尔骑士！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I hereby dub thee, Knight of Steele!”"

rows.original: The helmet then forms a cloth-shaped piece that extends in front of you, draping over your head, falling to the sides, and resting atop your shoulders, resulting in a very rogue-like hood. The inside of the helmet is covered in shadow when you are in the right light.
rows.translation: 随后，头盔形成一块向前延展的布状部件，垂覆头顶、落向两侧并搭在肩膀上，最终化作颇具游荡者风格的兜帽。在合适光线下，头盔内部会被阴影覆盖。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe helmet then forms a cloth-shaped piece that extends in front of you, draping over your head, falling to the sides, and resting atop your shoulders, resulting in a very rogue-like hood. The inside of the helmet is covered in shadow when you are in the right light."

rows.original: “Hoodies like this are in style, right?”
rows.translation: “这种连帽衫很流行，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hoodies like this are in style, right?”"

rows.original: The helmet’s surface divides and splits into several straps, wrapping around certain areas across your face. Some of the straps then flatten out, creating a mask for your mouth, a blindfold for your eyes, and finally a sheath to cover the entirety of your head. Across the surface, the straps imitate stitching, fasteners, zippers and even spikes. Ultimately, your new helmet appears very much at home on top of a bondage suit.
rows.translation: 头盔表面分裂成数条束带，缠绕脸部特定区域。部分束带随后压平，分别形成遮嘴面罩、蒙眼布，最终是覆盖整个头部的头套。束带表面模拟出缝线、扣件、拉链乃至尖刺。最终，你的新头盔看起来与束缚服无比相配。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe helmet’s surface divides and splits into several straps, wrapping around certain areas across your face. Some of the straps then flatten out, creating a mask for your mouth, a blindfold for your eyes, and finally a sheath to cover the entirety of your head. Across the surface, the straps imitate stitching, fasteners, zippers and even spikes. Ultimately, your new helmet appears very much at home on top of a bondage suit."

rows.original: “Ooo, kinky!”
rows.translation: “哦哦，好变态！”

rows.original: “Oh, the... Yeah that would be easy. Just a little prick.” She forms a very thin and pointy gooey tendril, almost like a needle. It stings you in the wrist and quickly finds its way into the nearest vein. It doesn’t really hurt, just a small prick at first.

rows.original: “Your microsurgeons are clueless. So, I’m gonna send my boys to teach them how it’s done. Buckle up!” Mere moments later you begin to feel a bit queasy and you notice your body temperature rising sharply. You’re feeling unwell all over. This is the opposite of a cure!
rows.translation: “你的显微外科机器人根本不懂。所以我要派我的小伙子教他们怎么做。坐稳了！”片刻后，你开始有些恶心，并注意到体温急剧上升。全身都很不舒服。这完全是治疗的反面！
rows.raw: "\n\n“Your microsurgeons are clueless. So, I’m gonna send my boys to teach them how it’s done. Buckle up!” Mere moments later you begin to feel a bit queasy and you notice your body temperature rising sharply. You’re feeling unwell all over. This is the opposite of a cure!"

rows.original: “Dontcha worry! Everything’s ok. Just a minor side-effect. It’s a battlefield in there. Good news! We’re winning. Those viral bastards don’t stand a chance.” Considering how queasy and flustered you’re feeling, it’s hard to agree with her, but you trust she’d never do anything that could harm you.
rows.translation: “别担心！一切正常。只是轻微副作用。里面正在打仗。好消息！我们在赢。那些病毒混蛋毫无胜算。”考虑到你有多恶心、燥热，很难赞同她，但你相信她绝不会做出伤害你的事。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Dontcha worry! Everything’s ok. Just a minor side-effect. It’s a battlefield in there. Good news! We’re winning. Those viral bastards don’t stand a chance.” Considering how queasy and flustered you’re feeling, it’s hard to agree with her, but you trust she’d never do anything that could harm you."

rows.original: “Aaaaaand... done! You’re clean now. It was a rough fight. I think a tumor or two got caught in the crossfire, but you’re officially 100% SSTD free.” She retracts her tendril from your arm then looks at you.
rows.translation: “好————了...完成！你现在干净了。战斗很艰苦。我想有一两个肿瘤被流弹误伤，不过你现在正式百分之百没有特殊性传播疾病了。”她从你手臂收回触须，然后看着你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aaaaaand... done! You’re clean now. It was a rough fight. I think a tumor or two got caught in the crossfire, but you’re officially 100% SSTD free.” She retracts her tendril from your arm then looks at you."

rows.raw: "\n\nYou shake your head. The symptoms you’ve been experiencing gradually disappear until you’re good as new."

rows.original: “Yah know... None of my business as to which thingy end up in which hole but... take care. Those bugs are nasty. The database has a few pamphlets on safe sex I can send to your codex if you need ‘em.”
rows.translation: “你知道...哪个东西进哪个洞不关我的事，不过...要小心。那些病菌很讨厌。数据库里有几本安全性爱小册子，需要的话我可以传到你的个人终端。”

rows.original: [gooarmor.name] circles around you, like a predator, waiting for the moment to strike. Your personal gray-goo doctor is scrutinizing you or more precisely, she has her eyes fixed on your parasite, her target. She pauses for a moment, leaning forwards.
rows.translation: [gooarmor.name]像捕食者般绕着你转，等待出手时机。你的私人灰色凝胶医生正在仔细观察你；更准确地说，她的目光锁定了寄生虫，也就是她的目标。她停顿片刻，身体前倾。
rows.raw: "\n\n[gooarmor.name] circles around you, like a predator, waiting for the moment to strike. Your personal gray-goo doctor is scrutinizing you or more precisely, she has her eyes fixed on your parasite, her target. She pauses for a moment, leaning forwards."

rows.original: “Gotcha!” She suddenly turns into a formless mass of gray goo and leaps forwards, crashing against the infested area like a silvery wave and nearly makes you lose your footing.
rows.translation: “抓到你了！”她突然化作无定形灰色凝胶团向前扑去，如银色浪潮般撞上感染部位，差点让你失去平衡。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Gotcha!” She suddenly turns into a formless mass of gray goo and leaps forwards, crashing against the infested area like a silvery wave and nearly makes you lose your footing."

rows.original: A couple of seconds later you feel the pain she was talking about, like intense heat. It’s followed by a series of shrieks. You’re unsure if that’s [gooarmor.name], the parasite or the result of the fight between the two of them, but it is bone chilling.
rows.translation: 几秒后，你感觉到她所说的疼痛，如同灼热，紧接着是一连串尖叫。你不知道那是[gooarmor.name]、寄生虫，还是两者搏斗造成的声音，但实在令人毛骨悚然。
rows.raw: "\n\nA couple of seconds later you feel the pain she was talking about, like intense heat. It’s followed by a series of shrieks. You’re unsure if that’s [gooarmor.name], the parasite or the result of the fight between the two of them, but it is bone chilling."

rows.original: Moments later, the loud noises stop and [gooarmor.name] jumps off you, reshaping again into her humanoid form.
rows.translation: 片刻后，巨响停止，[gooarmor.name]从你身上跳下，再次重塑成人形。
rows.raw: "\n\nMoments later, the loud noises stop and [gooarmor.name] jumps off you, reshaping again into her humanoid form."

rows.original: “Oh, you want me to fix that boo-boo? It’s just a flesh wound! Your microsurgeons should have that fixed in a few moments. Just take a nap. It’d be like one of those videogames.” [gooarmor.name] crosses her arms and looks at you with an unfazed expression. You frown, stating your disappointment.
rows.translation: “哦，你想让我修好这个小伤口？只是皮肉伤！你的显微外科机器人几分钟就能修好。睡一觉就行，就像某种电子游戏。”[gooarmor.name]交叉双臂，不为所动地看着你。你皱眉，表示失望。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, you want me to fix that boo-boo? It’s just a flesh wound! Your microsurgeons should have that fixed in a few moments. Just take a nap. It’d be like one of those videogames.” [gooarmor.name] crosses her arms and looks at you with an unfazed expression. You frown, stating your disappointment."

rows.original: “Fine, fine. I can fix it if you’re in a hurry. It’s just a matter of overloading and commanding your microsurgeons. I’ll send a few of my boys too for good measure.”
rows.translation: “好吧，好吧。要是你很急，我可以修好。只需让你的显微外科机器人超载并对其发号施令。我也会派几个小伙子过去，以防万一。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fine, fine. I can fix it if you’re in a hurry. It’s just a matter of overloading and commanding your microsurgeons. I’ll send a few of my boys too for good measure.”"

rows.original: She begins to form several gooey tendrils from her back, which quickly reach for any injury you might have and cover it with her microbots. The cold sensation calms you and soothes your pain.
rows.translation: 她从背后形成数条凝胶触须，迅速伸向你可能有的伤口，用微型机器人覆盖。冰凉的感觉使你平静下来，缓解疼痛。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe begins to form several gooey tendrils from her back, which quickly reach for any injury you might have and cover it with her microbots. The cold sensation calms you and soothes your pain."

rows.original: A few seconds later, you feel the temperature rising and the area around your injuries flustering red with rushing blood. It’s a bit uncomfortable but it only lasts for a minute or so. The gray goo then simply oozes off of you and splatters into the ground, where it slithers its way back towards [gooarmor.name].
rows.translation: 几秒后，你感觉温度升高，伤口周围因血液涌入而泛红发热。有些不舒服，但只持续约一分钟。随后灰色凝胶直接从你身上流下，溅落地面，再蜿蜒爬回[gooarmor.name]身边。
rows.raw: "\n\nA few seconds later, you feel the temperature rising and the area around your injuries flustering red with rushing blood. It’s a bit uncomfortable but it only lasts for a minute or so. The gray goo then simply oozes off of you and splatters into the ground, where it slithers its way back towards [gooarmor.name]."

rows.translation: “能劳驾你把巴雷尼亚牡丹递给我吗？”阿兹拉转向[gooarmor.name]，随后俯身查看一排准备接收新标本的新花盆。“就是那个...”忙碌的海妖转身准备说明，却发现自己要的植物已经被笑容满面的[gooarmor.name]用双手轻轻捧着。阿兹拉愣了一下，随后接过递来的植物。 “太棒了！可你怎么会...”她疑惑道。“我从没告诉过你是哪一株。”苏拉人不解地盯着她，挑起一边眉毛。 “我看了你的笔记！希望你不介意。你聪明得不得了。”[gooarmor.name]为自己感到骄傲，自信地微笑着。 “谢谢。”阿兹拉的双颊明显染上落日般的红色。“你真体贴。我非常有信心，我们迟早会把你培养成出色的异星生物学家。啊！船长！”海妖转向你。“是什么风把你吹到飞船上属于我的这片小小天地来了？”她问道，脸上闪耀着温暖的笑容。 你告诉她，自己只是礼貌性地来看看，仅此而已；不过眼前这一幕倒是出乎意料。你看向[gooarmor.name]，她一边咯咯笑着，一边热情地向你挥手。 “我在做科学研究！”灰色凝胶宣布道。 “没错，她确实在做，而且做得非常出色。”阿兹拉匆忙背过身去，把注意力转向花盆。“请原谅我的失礼，但这株标本等不得；它离开土壤已经太久了。”阿兹拉忙着工作，仍礼貌地向你浅浅鞠了一躬；随后她身体前倾，继续缓慢而细致地为牡丹挖出一个新洞。 “我能帮忙！”[gooarmor.name]欣喜若狂地宣布。“生根激素！生根激素！它需要一大份。”[gooarmor.name]急忙取来一瓶透明液体，把它递给全神贯注的异星生物学家；后者已经看得入迷，正确保每一条根都得到悉心照料，被妥善埋进肥沃的泥炭土里。她过了几秒才伸手接过瓶子，滴上几滴，随后转身向[gooarmor.name]道谢。 “好极了！堪称典范。这正是我需要的东西。你学得很快，[gooarmor.name]小姐。”阿兹拉幸福地叹息，满足的笑容在脸上闪耀。“这个小淘气会茁壮成长，很快就会开花。” [gooarmor.name]高兴地拍手庆祝。“耶！我们成功了！你看到了吗，[pc.name]？”她凝视着你。 “看到了。”你还不知道她对植物学如此感兴趣。 “我发现她正盯着我的安塔里亚西番莲。”阿兹拉插嘴道。“老实说，我本以为她要把花吃掉，不过后来才发现，她只是不小心逛了进来。” “它们太漂亮了。”[gooarmor.name]打断道。“我想多了解一点，那位漂亮的大姐姐就说会给我看更多东西。”阿兹拉红了脸。 “嗯，的确如此。弄清她没有恶意、只是好奇之后，我就让[gooarmor.name]小姐在周围帮忙。我现在有点忙。要分析的样本很多，要编目的植物也很多，而这里这位优秀的女士是个出色又勤奋的学生。[gooarmor.name]小姐有钻研植物学的态度，而且聪明得令人佩服。我怀疑她可能是这个房间里最聪明的人。”阿兹拉顽皮地咧嘴一笑，斜眼看向[gooarmor.name]，又眨了眨眼。后者随即发出欣喜的咕噜声，回以灿烂温暖的微笑。 你轻声笑了起来。是啊，[gooarmor.name]总能带来惊喜。
rows.raw: "“Would you kindly hand me the Barenian Peony?” Azra turns to [gooarmor.name] before leaning over a row of fresh planters ready to receive new specimens. “That would be the...” As the busy siren turns to clarify, her gaze meets with the requested plant, held gently between the hands of a beaming [gooarmor.name]. Azra flinches for a second, then accepts the offered plant. “Superb! But how did you...” she wonders. “I’ve never told you which one it was.” The suula stares quizzically, raising an eyebrow. “I read your notes! I hope yah didn’t mind. You’re hella smart.” [gooarmor.name]’s proud of herself, smiling with confidence. “Thank you.” Azra’s cheeks visibly blush the color of a sunset. “Very kind of you. I am quite confident we’ll make a splendid xenobiologist of you, yet. Ah! Captain!” The siren turns to you. “What brings you to my humble little pocket of your ship?” she inquires with a warm smile shining on her face. You inform her this is a courtesy visit, that’s all, but this, you weren’t expecting. You glance at [gooarmor.name], who effusively waves at you, giggling. “I’m doing science!” The gray-goo announces. “That’s right, she is, and an amazing job, at that.” Azra hastily turns her back at you, and her attention toward the planters. “My apologies for the rudeness, but this specimen can’t wait; it’s been uprooted for far too long.” Busy at work, Azra gives you a small courtesy bow and leans forward, carrying on slowly and delicately digging a new hole for her peony. “I can help!” [gooarmor.name] announces ecstatically. “Rooting Hormone! Rooting hormone! It needs a big helping of it.” [gooarmor.name] rushes to procure a bottle full of clear liquid, handling it to the focused xenobiologist, who’s far too mesmerized, making sure each individual root is carefully tended to and properly dug in the rich, peaty soil. It takes her a few seconds, but eventually, Azra reaches for the bottle and applies a few drops, before tuning to thank [gooarmor.name]. “Bravo! Exemplary work. That was precisely what I needed. You are a quick study, miss [gooarmor.name].” Azra sighs happily, a contented smile glistening on her face. “The little scamp will grow strong and blossom soon enough.” [gooarmor.name] joyously claps her hands in celebration. “Yay! We did it! Did you see [pc.name]?” She stares at you. “Aye.” You didn’t know she was so interested in botany. “I found her staring at my Antarian Passion Flowers,” Azra chimes in. “Truth be told, I thought she was about to eat them, but as it turned out she merely wandered in.” “They are so pretty,” [gooarmor.name] interrupts. “I wanted to know more about ‘em, and the big, pretty lady said she’d show me more.” Azra blushes. “Well, that is correct. After figuring out she was harmless and merely curious, I let miss [gooarmor.name] aid me around. I am slightly busy right now. There are many samples to analyze, plants to catalog, and this fine lady here is a splendid and diligent pupil. Miss [gooarmor.name]’s got the attitude for botany and is impressively smart. I suspect she might be the smartest one in the room.” Azra grin coyly, giving [gooarmor.name] a sideways glance and a wink. She, in turn, coos, and responds with a wide warm smile. You chuckle. Yeah, [gooarmor.name] can be full of surprises."

rows.original: “Miss Azra, I finished analyzing the molecular structure of the enzyme from earlier. Plants of the phyranineae suborder all possess a rich amount of a complementary protein capable of interlocking with it, and they aren’t even from the same solar system!” Both of you stare blankly into [gooarmor.name] before bursting into laughter. Right on cue. Azra pats [gooarmor.name]’s head. “Thank you, that would be very helpful.” She turns to you. “Believe it or not, it would have taken a whole day for my portable workstation to analyze the enzyme and find any matching substrates. The naturally occurring one isn’t easy to synthesize.” You nod. Then, it’s good luck she found herself a talented aide. “Right. Miss [gooarmor.name], I believe you’ve earned that snack I’ve promised.” You flinch, confused, and cock an eyebrow. “Yay! Can we have it right now? I wanna have it now.” [gooarmor.name] is gleefully ecstatic, almost bouncing in place and ready to claim her prize. “Of course! Let’s head to the kitchen and-” You cough dryly, interrupting Azra. She’s most definitely misunderstood [gooarmor.name]’s liberal use of the word “snack”. It would be best if you clarify. Azra flinches and blushes. “Oh. Oh, no, we can’t do that. I’m sorry, miss [gooarmor.name].” [gooarmor.name]’s clearly distraught, and whines in disappointment. “Awwww.” “But!” Azra exclaims. “I can show you one special plant you’re gonna love; It exudes a deliciously sweet sap that can fulfill your needs. Plus, I have to dispose of the excess sap every day. What’s that human expression?” Azra ponders, scratching her chin. “Ausars are man’s best fuckbuddies!” [gooarmor.name] guesses. Azra chuckles and smiles. “Two birds with one stone. You’re welcome to pay a visit any day you want.” [gooarmor.name]’s face illuminates once more as her smile makes a comeback. “Yes, please!” “Let’s go, then.” That would be your cue to make a discreet retreat and let the two ladies carry on with their duties. You can always come back later.
rows.translation: “阿兹拉小姐，我已经分析完先前那种酶的分子结构。非拉宁亚亚目植物全都含有大量能够与之互锁的互补蛋白质，而它们甚至不属于同一个恒星系！” 你和阿兹拉都茫然地盯着[gooarmor.name]，随后一起笑了起来。果然不出所料。 阿兹拉拍了拍[gooarmor.name]的头。“谢谢，这会非常有帮助。”她转向你。“不管你信不信，我的便携工作站原本得花整整一天才能分析这种酶，找到任何与之匹配的底物。天然存在的那种并不容易合成。” 你点点头。那么，她能找到一位才华横溢的助手，确实走运。 “好了。[gooarmor.name]小姐，我想你已经赢得了我答应给你的那份点心。”你困惑地一愣，挑起眉毛。 “耶！我们现在就能吃吗？我现在就想吃。”[gooarmor.name]欣喜若狂，几乎兴奋得原地跳起来，已经准备领取奖品。 “当然！我们去厨房，然后-” 你干巴巴地咳了一声，打断了阿兹拉。她肯定误解了[gooarmor.name]对“点心”一词的宽泛用法。你最好解释清楚。 阿兹拉一惊，红了脸。“哦。哦，不行，我们不能那样做。对不起，[gooarmor.name]小姐。” [gooarmor.name]显然伤心极了，失望地哀号。“啊啊啊。” “不过！”阿兹拉喊道。“我可以给你看一种你肯定会喜欢的特殊植物；它会分泌香甜可口、能够满足你需求的树液。而且我每天都得处理多余的树液。人类的那句俗语怎么说来着？”阿兹拉挠着下巴思考起来。 “奥萨是人类最好的炮友！”[gooarmor.name]猜道。 阿兹拉轻笑着露出笑容。“一石二鸟。你随时想来都欢迎。” [gooarmor.name]的脸再度焕发光彩，笑容也重新回到脸上。“好呀，拜托了！” “那我们走吧。” 这正是你悄悄退场，让两位女士继续履行职责的信号。反正你随时可以稍后再来。

rows.raw: "\n\nYou explain to her that everything’s fine. You’re as fit as a fiddle and the reason you’re here has nothing to do with your health. You’re just curious if she could interface with the droid and learn from her medical database or maybe even get a copy of her O.S."

rows.original: She looks back at you and raises an eyebrow, then smiles and nods. “Sounds like fun. She looks like a total cutie. I guess it wouldn’t hurt to try. Alright, here goes [gooarmor.name]!”
rows.translation: 她回头看你，扬起眉毛，随后微笑点头。“听起来很好玩。她看起来超级可爱。我想试试也没坏处。好啦，[gooarmor.name]要上了！”

rows.original: She jumps off of you and assumes her normal humanoid form. She then walks slowly, pretending to tip-toe, towards the unreactive nursedroid. It seems the robotic doctor doesn’t know what to make of [gooarmor.name]. After all, she’s programmed to recognize and treat organics.
rows.translation: 她从你身上跳下，恢复普通人形。随后她假装踮起脚尖，缓缓走向毫无反应的护理机器人。这位机器人医生似乎不知道该如何看待[gooarmor.name]；毕竟，她的程序只负责识别并治疗有机体。

rows.original: [gooarmor.name] circles around the nursedroid, grinning, like a predator, examining every angle, scrutinizing her prey. The nursebot follows [gooarmor.name] with her gaze, but otherwise doesn’t move or comment at all. Finally, [gooarmor.name] stops, standing a couple of feet behind the nursedroid, and with a sudden pouncing move, she places both her hands on the droid’s head.
rows.translation: [gooarmor.name]如同捕食者般咧嘴绕着护理机器人转圈，从各个角度审视自己的猎物。护理机器人目光跟随[gooarmor.name]，但除此之外既不移动也不评论。最终，[gooarmor.name]停在护理机器人身后几英尺处，突然猛扑上前，双手按住机器人的脑袋。

The nursebot follows [gooarmor.name] with her gaze, but otherwise doesn’t move or comment at all. rows.original:
On your way to your cheeky tanuki’s quarters, your [pc.ears] pick up a peculiar commotion, which, the closer you get to your destination, the louder it raises, almost like an orchestra in the middle of a crescendo, building up to the climax. You chuckle, it’s obvious now, all loud and clear - a stray moan here, and a loud wet slap there - that’d the unmistakable cacophony you’ve know to associate with sex - raw and wild, judging by the intensity of it.

	The situation begs the question, Kiro’s a given, but who’s the other part of their naughty dance? After all, it takes two to tango... well, two at the very least; one can’t rule out the possibility of a fuck-party when it comes to Kiro.

	Perhaps you should come back at a later time when it’s more convenient. Although, that little pervert inside you also suggests voyeurism might be a fun activity. What shall you do?

	或许你应该在更方便的时候再回来。不过，内心那个小变态也觉得偷窥可能很有趣。你要怎么办？

rows.original: As you approach the door of Azra’s quarters, a low-key murmur reaches you. You can’t make head or tails from this far away and through the bulkhead, but the distinct coherence points to a conversation, indecipherable as it is from where you’re standing. Not to intrude in what could be a private moment, you lean in closer and pay attention in order to figure out if you should go right in - right after knocking, of course - or come back later. It’s not as if you’re eavesdropping, you try to convince yourself as you stick your [pc.ear] to the metal door. The murmuring becomes clearer. There’s Azra, that one’s a given, and the other actor in this dialog would be... giggles? Oh! It’s [gooarmor.name]! That’s unexpected, but you’d recognized her trademark laughter anywhere. Recoiling first, you knock on the door, requesting permission to enter the stance. “Come on in!” Azra exclaims, raising her voice a little. “It’s open.” Well then, you let yourself in, only to be met with one peculiar scene. [gooarmor.name] is donning an unbuttoned lab-coat made out of her own microbots and chasing Azra around like a lost puppy looking for an adoptive mother; an unusually large - if gracious - one. The portentously sizable suula strides along in a hurry, carrying test tubes, samples, and flasks full of who knows what, moving back and forth between her indoor garden and her portable workstation. With [gooarmor.name] in tow, imprinted like a little duckling, Azra stumbles as she walks, more than once, attempting not to collide with your gray-goo comrade. “Ah, pardon me!” Azra excuses herself, juggling a batch of soil samples as she raises her left leg and tail to avoid bumping into [gooarmor.name], but in turn, bumps against her table’s corner. Fortunately, Azra’s armor readily absorbs the impact to the point the mighty suula simply shrugs it off as if it has never happened. For a moment, the chaotic dance between the two women makes you wonder if they are rehearsing for a comic role. Nevertheless, both look highly focused, and [gooarmor.name] in particular is acting really serious, endeavoring to assist Azra to the best of her abilities, providing the siren with whatever item she necessitates or fulfilling every task she requires. Truth be told, you feel like an intruder, interrupting important research.
rows.translation: 当你走近阿兹拉住处的门时，一阵低沉私语传入耳中。隔着这么远又有舱壁阻挡，你听不清内容，但清晰连贯的节奏说明那是一场对话，只是站在这里无法辨认。为了不闯入可能的私人时刻，你靠近专心倾听，想判断是该直接进去——当然先敲门——还是稍后再来。 这又不算偷听；你把[pc.ear]贴上金属门，同时试图说服自己。 私语逐渐清晰。其中有阿兹拉，这一点毋庸置疑，而对话的另一位参与者是...咯咯笑声？哦！是[gooarmor.name]！真没想到，但她那标志性的笑声，你在任何地方都能认出来。 你先向后退开，再敲门请求进入。 “进来吧！”阿兹拉稍稍提高音量喊道。“门没锁。” 既然如此，你自行进门，却看到一幕奇特景象。[gooarmor.name]穿着一件由自身微型机器人组成、没有扣纽扣的实验服，像寻找养母的迷路小狗般追着阿兹拉；只不过这位候选母亲异常高大——却也颇为优雅。 这位体型惊人的苏拉大步匆忙穿行，手里拿着试管、样本与装满不明物质的烧瓶，在室内花园与便携工作站之间来回移动。[gooarmor.name]如小鸭般紧随其后，阿兹拉走路时不止一次踉跄，努力避免撞上灰色凝胶同伴。 “啊，抱歉！”阿兹拉一边道歉，一边腾挪一批土壤样本；她抬起左腿与尾巴躲避[gooarmor.name]，却反而撞到桌角。幸好阿兹拉的装甲轻易吸收冲击，强壮的苏拉只是耸耸肩，仿佛什么都没发生。 两名女性这场混乱舞蹈一度令你怀疑，她们是否在排练喜剧角色。不过，两人看起来都高度专注；尤其是[gooarmor.name]表现得无比严肃，竭尽所能协助阿兹拉，为这位海妖提供所需物品，完成她要求的每项任务。 说实话，你感觉自己像个打断重要研究的闯入者。

rows.original: “Watch the swirling lights,” [lane.heShe] says, and it’s hard not to. Everything in your vision is moving and swimming: from the tattoos on [lane.hisHer] body to the lights in [lane.hisHer] eyes. The familiar sensation of being immersed in [lane.himHer], engrossed by [lane.himHer], overcomes you. “You trust Lane. You can listen to Lane. Lane wants you to watch the swirling lights.”
rows.translation: “看着旋转的光芒，”[lane.heShe]说道，而你很难不去看。视野里的一切都在移动、游动：从[lane.hisHer]身上的纹身，到[lane.hisHer]眼中的光芒。那种熟悉的感觉再次征服你，你沉浸在[lane.himHer]之中，全神贯注于[lane.himHer]。“你信任莱恩。你可以听从莱恩。莱恩希望你看着旋转的光芒。”

rows.original: Any resistance you thought you once had evaporates as you’re introduced to the bliss that is Lane’s hypnotism. “This is all so familiar to you. You remember being where you are before.” [lane.HeShe]’s right, and in more ways than one: although you never remember the sessions, you remember the sensations subconsciously. “Familiarity is good; familiarity is safe. Lane is familiar to you. You are safe with Lane. You want to stay with Lane, because Lane is safe.”
rows.translation: 当你再次接触莱恩催眠带来的极乐，曾以为自己拥有的任何抵抗都烟消云散。“这一切对你而言如此熟悉。你记得自己以前曾处在相同的位置。”[lane.HeShe]说得没错，而且不止一个层面：虽然你从来不记得催眠过程，潜意识却记得那些感受。“熟悉的事物是好的；熟悉的事物是安全的。莱恩对你而言很熟悉。和莱恩在一起，你很安全。你想留在莱恩身边，因为莱恩很安全。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAny resistance you thought you once had evaporates as you’re introduced to the bliss that is Lane’s hypnotism. “This is all so familiar to you. You remember being where you are before.” [lane.HeShe]’s right, and in more ways than one: although you never remember the sessions, you remember the sensations subconsciously. “Familiarity is good; familiarity is safe. Lane is familiar to you. You are safe with Lane. You want to stay with Lane, because Lane is safe.”"

rows.original: How did you never think of it that way before? Like a warm house, or a cozy bed, you’ve never felt more at-ease than with Lane. You want to nod your head, but you don’t really have the strength or the drive. You’d much rather just keep watching and listening. “You don’t ever want to leave Lane again. You don’t mind giving up your life to be with Lane. The universe is unfamiliar to you; you want to stay with Lane, where it’s safe.”
rows.translation: 你以前怎么从没这样想过？就像温暖的房屋或舒适的床铺，你在莱恩身边感受到的安心无可比拟。你想点头，可实在没有那份力量或动力。你更愿意继续观看、继续聆听。“你再也不想离开莱恩。你不介意放弃自己的人生，与莱恩永远相伴。宇宙对你而言很陌生；你想留在莱恩身边，这里很安全。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHow did you never think of it that way before? Like a warm house, or a cozy bed, you’ve never felt more at-ease than with Lane. You want to nod your head, but you don’t really have the strength or the drive. You’d much rather just keep watching and listening. “You don’t ever want to leave Lane again. You don’t mind giving up your life to be with Lane. The universe is unfamiliar to you; you want to stay with Lane, where it’s safe.”"

rows.original: You have to admit, that’s a good point. In your journey to claim your inheritance, you’ve been to different planets, met unfamiliar and dangerous plants and animals, and traveled the lonely stars. Why should you pursue such recklessness, when you could stay with Lane all your life?
rows.translation: 你不得不承认，这很有道理。为了领取遗产，你去过不同星球，遇见陌生而危险的动植物，也曾穿行于孤寂群星。既然能够一生留在莱恩身边，为什么还要追求这种鲁莽生活？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have to admit, that’s a good point. In your journey to claim your inheritance, you’ve been to different planets, met unfamiliar and dangerous plants and animals, and traveled the lonely stars. Why should you pursue such recklessness, when you could stay with Lane all your life?"

rows.original: “You’ve forgotten your birthplanet.” Well, that’s silly. You were born on... on... huh. “But wherever it was, it is too different now. You love the planet Venar much more.” You do enjoy the warmth of the desert sands and the contrasting coolness of its caves...
rows.translation: “你已经忘记了自己的出生星球。”这太可笑了。你出生在...在...咦。“但无论那里曾是什么样子，现在都已经变得太过陌生。你更加热爱维纳尔星。”你确实喜欢沙漠暖热的沙地，以及洞穴与之形成对比的凉爽...
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’ve forgotten your birthplanet.” Well, that’s silly. You were born on... on... huh. “But wherever it was, it is too different now. You love the planet Venar much more.” You do enjoy the warmth of the desert sands and the contrasting coolness of its caves..."

rows.original: “You’ve forgotten your spaceship.” It was a hunk of junk anyway. “Its metal hide was too unforgiving compared to the concrete of Lane’s hut. You prefer Lane’s home to your spaceship.” You have been here enough times to know just about every little thing about it.

rows.original: “Excuse me, sir?” you call out, hoping you’ve made the right decision. rows.translation: 你的双眼不由自主地睁得更大，将[lane.himHer]的一切尽收眼底。[lane.hisHer]颈瓣内侧遍布着许多黑色刺青，其图案盘旋交错，近似部落纹样；[lane.hisHer]的瓣膜皮肤上则到处镶着浅色的玻璃质穿刺饰品。当[lane.hisHer]的血液在[lane.himHer]体内搏动时，光芒与刺青交融，又在[lane.hisHer]穿刺饰品的玻璃中四处折射：这些光芒扰乱了你的注意力，每当你的目光在它们之间移动，[lane.himHer]身上的刺青便会在你的视野边缘彼此旋动。你的双眼每移动一次，奔流的血液、刺入莱恩肌肤的明亮饰物以及游动的刺青，都会将你更深、更深地拖入恍惚之中——拖入[lane.himHer]之中。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour eyes open wider of their own accord as you absorb [lane.himHer]. Adorned across the inside of [lane.hisHer] tassels are a number of black tattoos with swirling, almost tribal designs on them, and all throughout the skin of [lane.hisHer] membranes are light, glassy piercings. As [lane.hisHer] blood beats through [lane.himHer], they mingle with the tattoos and their light bounces all throughout the glass of [lane.hisHer] piercings: the lights distract your focus, and every time you move your eyes between them, the tattoos on [lane.himHer] begin to swirl with each other in the corners of your eyes. With every movement your eyes make, the coursing blood, the bright trinkets pierced to Lane’s skin, and the moving tattoos draw you deeper and deeper into a trance – into [lane.himHer]."

rows.original: “Watch the swirling lights,” [lane.heShe] says, but you barely need the instruction. Lane begins to say a lot of other things, but you’ve lost your attention. Your senses begin to overcome your consciousness: your nostrils begin to pick out every individual smell with every breath, and your eyes soon start seeing new shapes and motions that hadn’t existed before. Your mind is completely on autopilot: you’re aware of every sight, every smell, and every vague command Lane tells you, but you barely register them as thoughts. Soon, even your thoughts are leaving you, and you become nothing but a blank slab of a person for Lane to mold and shape as [lane.heShe] likes. [lane.HeShe] tells you that’s okay, and that becomes your thought, your decision.
rows.translation: “看着那些旋转的光，”[lane.heShe]说道，可你几乎已经不需要这道指示。莱恩开始说起许多其他事情，但你早已无法集中注意。你的感官逐渐压倒意识：每一次呼吸，鼻腔都开始辨认出每一种独立的气味；不久之后，双眼也开始看见此前根本不存在的形状与运动。你的意识彻底进入自动运转：你知晓眼前的每一幕、嗅到的每一种气味，也知晓莱恩对你下达的每一道模糊指令，却几乎不会将它们当作思绪加以理解。很快，就连你的思绪也离你而去，你变成一块空白的人形坯料，任由莱恩按照[lane.heShe]的喜好塑造。[lane.HeShe]告诉你这样没关系，于是这便成了你的想法、你的决定。

Your mind is completely on autopilot: you’re aware of every sight, every smell, and every vague command Lane tells you, but you barely register them as thoughts. Soon, even your thoughts are leaving you, and you become nothing but a blank slab of a person for Lane to mold and shape as [lane.heShe] likes. [lane.HeShe] tells you that’s okay, and that becomes your thought, your decision."

rows.original: You’re left hanging limp in Lane’s control. [lane.HeShe] says some other things to you, and they become your thoughts for only a moment before they’re lost in the ether that is your blank consciousness. [lane.HisHer] words become your own, and that’s okay. Your eyes hurt, and you remember to blink – no, Lane reminds you to blink – no, you remember to blink.
rows.translation: 你软绵绵地悬在莱恩的掌控之中。[lane.HeShe]又对你说了些话，它们只短暂地成为你的思绪，随后便消失在你空白意识的虚无里。[lane.HisHer]的话语成了你自己的话，而这样没关系。你的眼睛发疼，你想起该眨眼了——不，是莱恩提醒你眨眼——不，是你想起了该眨眼。

[lane.HisHer] words become your own, and that’s okay. Your eyes hurt, and you remember to blink – no, Lane reminds you to blink – no, you remember to blink."

rows.original: Lane watches you, completely enthralled and under [lane.hisHer] spell. Your mouth is dry, and you swallow – no, Lane tells you to swallow – no, you swallow, it was a thought you had. [lane.HeShe] takes a deep breath, remaining calm in [lane.hisHer] seat. Confident that you’re deep enough under [lane.hisHer] spell, [lane.heShe] begins the work you paid [lane.himHer] to do.
rows.translation: 莱恩注视着完全沉迷、彻底落入[lane.hisHer]魔掌的你。你口干舌燥，于是咽了口唾沫——不，是莱恩叫你吞咽——不，是你自己咽了下去，这是你自己的想法。[lane.HeShe]深吸一口气，平静地坐在[lane.hisHer]座位上。确信你已经深陷于[lane.hisHer]的控制后，[lane.heShe]便开始进行你付钱请[lane.himHer]做的工作。

rows.original: “You feel strength like you’ve never known before course through you,” [lane.heShe] says smoothly. “What was your limit yesterday is your warm-up today. You have the stability to lift any weight; the endurance to run any distance; the strength to defeat any foe. You are as physically capable as you have ever been. You are a fountain, a geyser, of strength: when you think you can not, you will try, and you will.”
rows.translation: “你感到一股前所未有的力量流遍全身，”[lane.heShe]流畅地说道。“昨天的极限，只是你今天的热身。你拥有举起任何重量的稳定性、跑过任何距离的耐力，以及击败任何敌人的力量。你的身体能力已经达到了有生以来的巅峰。你是一口喷泉，一道力量的间歇泉：当你认为自己做不到时，你仍会尝试，而且你一定会做到。”

rows.original: “Your mind is clear as a crystal,” [lane.heShe] instructs. “What your eyes see, your mind can react to. Your weapon is as much an extension of you as your arm holding it. Hitting your target is as natural as blinking and breathing. You can account for motion; velocity; acceleration; wind resistance; distance. There is nothing between you and your target. If your weapon is drawn and your target is not struck, it is because that is what you choose.”
rows.translation: “你的头脑如水晶般清澈，”[lane.heShe]指示道。“双眼所见之物，你的意识都能作出反应。你的武器与你握住它的手臂一样，都是你身体的延伸。命中目标就像眨眼与呼吸一样自然。你能够将运动、速度、加速度、风阻与距离全都计算在内。你与目标之间再无任何阻碍。只要你已经拔出武器，目标却没有中招，那就只会是因为你选择了不去命中。”

If your weapon is drawn and your target is not struck, it is because that is what you choose.”"

rows.original: “You have no forgotten memory,” [lane.heShe] tells you. “Every lesson is recalled. Every tidbit is remembered. Every trivia is retained. You remember every plant you were taught to avoid. You remember how to combat every species. Every mistake is recollected and learned from. You are knowledgeable with every scenario, every possibility, because you have learned from them before. Yet, your focus is linear. You do not consider anything that does not need considering.”
rows.translation: “你没有任何被遗忘的记忆，”[lane.heShe]告诉你。“每一堂课都能回想起来。每一则细节都被牢记。每一条琐闻都被保留。你记得曾有人教你避开的每一种植物。你记得如何对付每一个种族。每一次错误都能回想起来，并从中汲取教训。你熟知每一种情境、每一种可能，因为你从前便已经从中学习过。然而，你的思路始终笔直。你不会考虑任何不必考虑的事情。”

rows.original: “You are as rigid as a stone,” [lane.heShe] says sternly. “As rooted as a tree. You will not sway. You will not bend. Yours is your will alone. Nobody else will impose theirs upon you. You will not compromise. You will not fall for petty tricks; you cannot be deceived. You will not let any action you take, any course you choose, be altered by someone else’s hand. You will take what you want, and you will not give what is not anyone else’s to take.”
rows.translation: “你像岩石一样坚定，”[lane.heShe]严厉地说道。“像树木一样根深蒂固。你不会动摇。你不会屈服。你的意志只属于你自己。任何人都无法将他们的意志强加给你。你不会妥协。你不会落入卑劣的把戏；你不可能受到欺骗。你不会让自己的任何行动、任何选择的道路，因他人的操弄而改变。你会夺取自己想要的东西，也不会交出任何不该任由他人夺走的东西。”

rows.original: “You will forget all of my previous instructions after twenty-four Terran hours,” [lane.heShe] says, wrapping up [lane.hisHer] session with you. “It will be as though we had never had this session. You will know to return to me, but you will do it at your leisure; you will not feel you must. When I close my tassels, [pc.name], we will return to my desk in the front room, and you will awaken.” [lane.HeShe] reinforces those statements for another minute.
rows.translation: “二十四个泰伦小时之后，你会忘掉我此前的所有指令，”[lane.heShe]说道，开始结束[lane.hisHer]与你的这次疗程。“到时就像我们从未进行过这次疗程一样。你会知道该回来找我，但会依照自己的闲暇安排；你不会觉得非来不可。当我合上颈瓣时，[pc.name]，我们会回到前厅的书桌旁，而你将会醒来。”[lane.HeShe]又花了一分钟强化这些话。

[lane.HeShe] learned how to control people, and [lane.heShe] made it a legitimate business... because of a power fantasy? “I know what you’re thinking,” [lane.heShe] says smoothly, trying to calm your nerves. “If I put a person ‘under’, then I could, theoretically, control what the person feels and thinks and does until they pull out of it. Believe it or not, the UGC thought so too – and they made me swear that I wouldn’t use my skills ‘to the detriment of the peoples that trust my judgment’. Sort of like the Hippocratic Oath for doctors.” You narrow your eyes and chew your bottom lip. You could trust a surgeon, but a hypnotist...?
rows.translation: 你不自在地轻笑，转动肩膀。[lane.HeShe]学会控制他人，而[lane.heShe]又把它变成合法生意...竟然只是出于权力幻想？“我知道你在想什么，”[lane.heShe]平静地说道，试图安抚你的不安。“如果我让一个人‘进入状态’，理论上，我可以控制对方的感受、思想和行为，直到那人脱离催眠。信不信由你，UGC也考虑过这一点——他们要求我发誓，不会利用自己的技巧‘损害那些信任我判断之人的利益’。有点像医生的希波克拉底誓言。”你眯起双眼，咬住下唇。外科医生或许值得信任，可催眠师...？

You decide to broach a rather delicate and personal question, and you preface it by telling Lane that she doesn’t need to answer if she doesn’t want to. If you’re not mistaken, Daynarians are cold-blooded – which she confirms – and that Daynarians lay eggs – which she confirms. So, why does she have breasts?
rows.translation: 你决定提出一个相当敏感而私人的问题，并事先告诉莱恩，如果她不愿意，可以不回答。如果你没记错，戴纳尔是冷血动物——她予以确认——而且戴纳尔会产卵——她也予以确认。那么，她为什么会有乳房？

rows.original: She leans back and stretches her arms, shamelessly showing off her doubly-dangerous jugs to you. “I’m glad you noticed,” she says slyly and without a hint of reserve. “Daynarians were a very sexual species as we transitioned from a lowlier species to one of higher thought. The females don’t have breasts, you’re correct, but, as we discovered the more... carnal pleasures of life, we recognized their appeal and why they’re sexually desirable. Today, breasts on a female Daynarian means she has the means to acquire them in the first place, so they’re something of a status symbol. They don’t serve any purpose other than to be shown off – and,” she says, massaging them right in front of you, “I gotta say, they’re pretty fun.”
rows.translation: 她向后靠去，伸展双臂，毫不羞涩地向你展示那对危险加倍的巨乳。“很高兴你注意到了，”她狡黠地说道，毫无避讳。“戴纳尔从低等物种向高等智慧种族转变期间，是个性欲十分旺盛的种族。你说得对，雌性原本没有乳房；但随着我们发现生活中更多...肉欲的乐趣，我们也认识到乳房的魅力，以及它为什么在性方面令人向往。如今，雌性戴纳尔拥有乳房，意味着她首先有能力买得起它们，所以乳房算是一种身份象征。除了拿来炫耀，它们没有任何用途——而且，”她当着你的面揉弄起来，“不得不说，还挺好玩的。”

rows.original: If they’re considered a status symbol among the Daynarians, does that mean male Daynarians can get them too? You chuckle as you imagine it, but she only smiles. “It’s not unusual.” That silences you in a hurry. “But it is uncommon. It’s something of a clash between Daynarian culture and that of the rest of the universe’s: to us, boobs on anybody means they’re well off and financially stable, but not a lot of other cultures see it that way. So, don’t be surprised if you see a male Daynarian with a set bigger than mine, but try not to be repulsed, either.”
rows.translation: 既然乳房在戴纳尔中被视为身份象征，那雄性戴纳尔也能装上一对吗？你想象着那幅画面轻笑起来，她却只是微笑。“并不罕见。”这句话立刻让你安静下来。“但确实不常见。这算是戴纳尔文化和宇宙其他文化之间的冲突：对我们而言，任何人长着胸部都表示其生活富裕、财务稳定；但许多其他文化并不这么看。所以，如果你看到雄性戴纳尔的胸部比我的还大，不必惊讶，也尽量别觉得恶心。”

rows.original: You ask Lane about [lane.hisHer] service, and you mention that you’re interested. “Of course!” [lane.heShe] says, giddy that [lane.heShe] has some business. “I specialize in hypnosis. A lot of problems that a lot of people have are all in their head – if there’s something about yourself that you don’t like, but you’re not comfortable with using drugs or biotech to change your body, I can give you the boost you need. Or maybe you’re struggling with something more cerebral: I’ve had writers come to me before asking me to help with their writer’s block. Whatever the case, there’s no psychological barrier I can’t help you breach.”
rows.translation: 你向莱恩询问[lane.hisHer]服务，并提到自己很感兴趣。“当然！”[lane.heShe]因为因为[lane.heShe]有生意上门而兴奋不已。“我专精于催眠。许多人遇到的许多问题都只存在于脑海中——如果你不喜欢自己的某个方面，却不愿用药物或生物科技改变身体，我可以给你需要的推动。或者，也许你在应对更偏心智的问题：以前有作家来找我，请我帮忙克服创作瓶颈。无论情况如何，没有哪道心理屏障是我无法帮你突破的。”

rows.original: You ask [lane.himHer] to elaborate. “Well, in your case, you don’t really seem like the desk-jockey sort. You’re more of a doer, a shaker; you’re out there, exploring new planets and conquering new terrains, or your name isn’t [pc.name] Steele. Am I right?” You confirm. You never were one for desk jobs, and, without telling [lane.himHer] why, you’ve been exploring the planets rather extensively lately.
rows.translation: 你请[lane.himHer]详细说明。“嗯，就你而言，你看起来不太像整天坐办公室的人。你更像行动派、弄潮儿；你在外面探索新行星、征服新地域，不然你就不叫[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。我说得对吗？”你予以确认。你从来不适合案头工作，而且——尽管没有向[lane.himHer]解释原因——最近确实广泛探索了许多行星。

rows.original: “So, and I don’t want to be presumptuous here, but let’s say you’re in the jungles of Mhen’ga and you see some Naleen in the bushes. You reach for your gun – but it’s faster! It lunges at you, and you point and shoot, but your aim goes wide and now that cat-snake has got you in its coils! You struggle and you struggle, but you don’t have the strength to break free! If only your reflexes were a little better!”
rows.translation: “所以，我无意妄加揣测，但假设你身处门加丛林，在灌木里看见一只纳林。你伸手去拿枪——但它更快！它朝你猛扑过来；你举枪射击，却打偏了，现在那只猫蛇已经用身体缠住你！你拼命挣扎，却没有足够的力量脱身！要是反应能再快一点就好了！”

I can hypnotize your senses to be more acute, more in-tune with your surroundings and atmosphere. With my help, the next time you’re in those jungles, you’ll be able to turn the surprise around on the Naleen before it could even blink.”
