[lane.HeShe] can really make your reflexes that good? “Not only your reflexes!” [lane.heShe] insists. “Have you ever been in a fight, and you wished you were stronger than you were? I can help with that, too! You often hear stories about people performing extraordinary feats of strength, when they look as wiry as a straw, yes? If only a person can harness that sort of strength and call on it whenever they wish. I can help with that! Whatever it is you need – anything at all – I can make you better just by making you believe that you are.”

rows.original: And who’s getting those samples? Why, you, of course. You should have seen that one coming. Still, if it’s for Amber, you’re willing to go that extra mile. At any rate, how exactly does Lumi propose you get those highly specific samples?

rows.original: With a bit of trepidation, you take off your gear, take a seat, and lower the thin plates of the Mindwash machine to either side of your head. The curved hardlight screen flickers across your field of vision before engulfing your senses. A small host of error messages scroll across the screen before the pink light fades to a soft blue. Your body seizes up, muscles straining and the hot wash of panic surging up your gullet. You force yourself to relax, and the tension melts away. It seems your body can have only one master at a time and the visor is in control for now.

rows.translation: 既然已经安全回到你的飞船上，你可以检查一下从芭比化馆得到的洗脑器眼罩了。这个装置非常小巧，不过是两块塑料圆盘由一面弯曲的硬光屏连接在一起。尽管它发出轻微的嗡鸣，一侧还是有个插口，必须接到你飞船的供电系统上。看来这个小玩意非常耗电。
rows.raw: "Now that you’re safe aboard your vessel, you can take a look at the Mindwash Visor you got from the Bimbotorium. The device is quite small, little more than a pair of plastic discs connected by a curving screen of hardlight. Despite the light hum it lets off, there is a socket on one side that’ll have to be hooked into your ship’s power supply. It seems the little toy is quite an energy hog."

rows.original: You plug it in next to a large, comfortable seat somewhere not too conspicuous and examine Badger’s visor. With the power on, its normally passive holoscreen is blinking with an inviting pink glow. One last check-through reveals an “intensity” gage on the side. It seems to go from “Fuck Me Up” all the way to “Tabula Rasa” so you go ahead and dial that down to the lowest setting. No sense in taking undue risks when dealing with Badger Tech.
rows.translation: 你把它插在某个不太显眼的地方，旁边摆着一把宽大舒适的座椅，然后检查贝德格的眼罩。通电后，原本静止的全息屏闪烁着诱人的粉色光芒。最后一次检查发现，侧面有一个“强度”仪表。它似乎从“狠狠操我”一直调到“心灵白板”，于是你果断把强度降到最低。对付贝德格科技时，没必要承担多余的风险。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou plug it in next to a large, comfortable seat somewhere not too conspicuous and examine Badger’s visor. With the power on, its normally passive holoscreen is blinking with an inviting pink glow. One last check-through reveals an “intensity” gage on the side. It seems to go from “Fuck Me Up” all the way to “Tabula Rasa” so you go ahead and dial that down to the lowest setting. No sense in taking undue risks when dealing with Badger Tech."

rows.original: Now that you’ve got it, though, do you really want to use it?
rows.translation: 不过，既然你已经得到它了，你真的想用吗？

rows.original: You’re still feeling lightheaded when you stumble out of the booth. Luca shuffles to your side and offers her arm to help you from tumbling over. “Well? Is my baby okay?” she asks with motherly worry.

rows.original: “Well, at least it doesn’t seem to be outright dangerous, but I certainly can’t just open it up to the public. People with less mental fortitude might walk away still believing they’re the characters from the simulation! I’ll have to think on what to do with my poor, damaged visor.”
rows.translation: “唉，至少它似乎没有明显的危险，但我肯定不能就这样对公众开放。精神意志较弱的人走出来后，也许还会相信自己就是模拟程序里的角色！我得好好想想，该怎么处理我这台可怜又损坏的眼罩。”

People with less mental fortitude might walk away still believing they’re the characters from the simulation! I’ll have to think on what to do with my poor, damaged visor.”"

rows.original: [flags.PAULETTE_MET |[paulette.isCrew |You send a quick message to your local cyborg and leyak, asking them if they have some time to spend with you. A moment later, a simple, smiling face appears on the console, inviting you to join them. The road to their new lair is rather safe compared to what it was. No exposed cables, toxic fumes, or serrated metal shards to threaten your integrity. The heavily chromed up zaika welcomes you in her quarters with a kind smile you wouldn’t expect to see on such a war machine of a lady. She made her own pillow fort here and kept a great amount of stuff she gathered on Tarkus. The little leyak snoozes softly under comfy linens, unencumbered by the disguise he otherwise uses to blend in the crowd. Speaking of attires, Paulette wears the same colorful tunic and runic paints as she did in her lair, either she’s fond of them or she found her style. The blend of primitive rags and high-tech augments looks surprisingly good on her, she’s a bit of a techno-barbarian from the old, pre-UGC stories. “Howdy [pc.name], why don’t you rest your [pc.legs] a moment, there’s enough space on the bed for three,” she says, inviting you on the cushions reserved for her guests. You take Paulette’s metallic hand in yours and let guide and install you in her warm nest, leaving just enough room for the two of you to be close but not too close yet. “So, is there anything I can do for you?” |Remembering the path towards [flags.PAULETTE_TLK_HERSELF |Paulette |the purple bitch ]’s lair, you cross the sinister corridors of The Gloaming, avoiding live wires weakly sparking with power and ragged metal ridges across the way. Refreshing air coming from the hydroponic room and the water storage provide you with enough courage to go down the sharp, dolomite ledge leading to the ship’s plasma core repurposed into a makeshift living room. [flags.PAULETTE_COMPLY |You are greeted by a surprise, swooping hug from [flags.PAULETTE_TLK_HERSELF |Paulette |the bionic alien ], lifting you for a few seconds before landing you softly on her blanketed nest. “Howdy [pc.name]. I’m glad you found the time to see us again,” she says with her melodic voice. She isn’t combat-ready right now, but you know that her rifle-cannon and wicked claws could turn you into [silly |a very rare T-bone |scorched meat ] in a couple of seconds. The purple amazon’s cheerful smile deletes this dire outcome as she leans closer to you. “So, what can a strong girl like me do for a charming [pc.race] like you?” |A ball of plasma greets you from the ceiling, searing the ground a few steps in front of you. Unimpressed by her threat, you draw your [pc.weapon] towards the looming creature. “Citizen [pc.name] Steele, drop your weapon or face my wrath. You now have fifteen seconds to comply,” she commands, her cannon preparing another deadly load. ] ] |Mustering your courage, you head inside the obscured guts of the freighter, avoiding the exposed, sparking wires and fuming vents. The wreckage’s corridors are barely lighted with flickering neons trying their best to stay active despite the intermittent power surges. Along the way, you come across what used to be a meeting room fitted with broken tables and papers spread all around the dust-filled place. Large containers full of water and local plants take up a large corner of the room near neatly stored rations and biscuits. There’s no doubt somebody lives here, somebody strong enough to push sydians, raskvels, and sex-crazed VIs away. You continue on through the obscured tunnels until you reach the abandoned ship’s helm. A few consoles flicker to life when they detect your presence, allowing you to search for leftover data in the ship’s mainframe. A quick survey through the manifest indicates you are aboard what used to be The Gloaming, a pirate transport ship traveling between freshly discovered rush worlds with smuggled goods. Data indicates it was shot down by the Black Void in Tarkus’s orbit months ago, killing most of the crew — except for a couple of weird creatures labeled as Haywire Alien Cyborg and Toxic Jellyfish. Despite all your efforts, you can’t find any further data on these aliens before the power runs out, stopping your electronic adventures. Dim noises come from below, where the ship’s reactor ought to be. With your [pc.weapon] in hand, you follow a makeshift dolomite ledge replacing the melted stairs towards the ominously glowing room housing what you expect to be a broken core. To your surprise, the plasma engine’s still active and fueled with a cell connected to an array of solar panels and an improvised water purifier. Weak lights draw your attention towards a big nest of cushions and blankets. The imposing [silly |pillow fort |lair ] is inhabited by a snoring blue alien with three closed eyes. A loud gasp crosses your lips when you realize that the ship’s inhabitant is actually a [var0|Leyak|disembodied head with lash-like tentacles] resting peacefully in the plush paradise. Your muffled sound of surprise manages to wake the creature. The teal floating head’s trio of eyes look at you with a mix of terror and surprise whilst a red targeting laser climbs your [pc.legs] up to your [pc.chest] before setting on your forehead. “Galactic citizen [pc.name] Steele, drop your weapon and move away from my friend! You have fifteen seconds to comply,” a loud, feminine voice altered by bionic amplifiers orders. Your [pc.eyes] spot a powerful, cybernetic frame of an imposing creature. The slowly charging Pyrexxx Annihilator serving as her right arm is locked on your face, ready to turn you into a charred pile of ashes. The bionic alien glances at her terrified friend then at you again. Maybe peacefully following her orders will save you some trouble, but in the end, it’s up to you to decide if you want to live or if you want to fight. ]
rows.translation: [flags.PAULETTE_MET |[paulette.isCrew |你给当地的赛博格与莱雅克发了条简讯，问他们是否有时间陪你。片刻后，控制台上出现一张简单的微笑脸孔，邀请你去见他们。与从前相比，通往他们新巢穴的道路相当安全。没有裸露电缆、有毒烟雾或锯齿状金属碎片会威胁你的身体。这位全身镀上厚重铬层的赛卡在自己的房间里以亲切的微笑迎接你，这可不像如此一位女性战争机器会露出的表情。她在这里搭了自己的枕头堡垒，还保留着许多从塔库斯收集来的东西。 那只小莱雅克在舒适的床单下轻声酣睡，没有穿戴平日为了混入人群而使用的伪装。说到服装，波莱特穿着与她在巢穴时相同的彩色束腰衣，身上也画着同样的符文；要么她很喜欢这一身，要么她已经找到了自己的风格。原始破布与高科技增强体的融合意外地适合她，她有些像古早UGC故事中的科技野蛮人。 “你好啊，[pc.name]，为什么不让你的[pc.legs]歇一会儿？床上足够容下三个人，”她说，邀请你坐到为客人准备的软垫上。你将波莱特的金属手握在手中，任由她引导你在温暖的巢穴里安顿下来，留出恰好足以让你们靠近、却还不至于过分亲密的空间。“那么，有什么是我能为你做的吗？” |回想起通往[flags.PAULETTE_TLK_HERSELF |波莱特 |那个紫色婊子 ]巢穴的路线，你穿过薄暮号阴森的走廊，避开仍在微弱迸出电火花的带电线缆和沿途崎岖的金属棱脊。水培室和储水处飘来的清新空气给了你足够的勇气，让你沿尖锐的白云石崖壁向下，走到被改造成临时起居室的飞船等离子核心。[flags.PAULETTE_COMPLY |一个突如其来的俯冲拥抱迎接了你，[flags.PAULETTE_TLK_HERSELF |波莱特 |那名仿生外星人 ]将你抱离地面数秒，然后轻轻把你放到她铺着毯子的巢穴上。 “你好，[pc.name]。我很高兴你又抽出时间来看我们，”她用悦耳的声音说道。她现在并未做好战斗准备，但你知道，她的步枪炮和凶恶利爪只要几秒就能把你变成[silly |一块非常罕见的T骨牛排 |烤焦的肉 ]。紫色亚马逊女战士欢快的微笑令这个可怕的结局烟消云散，她向你靠近。 “那么，像我这样的强壮女孩能为你这样迷人的[pc.race]做什么？” |一团等离子从天花板上向你飞来，烧焦了你前方几步的地面。你对她的威胁无动于衷，将你的[pc.weapon]指向那个逼近的生物。 “公民[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，放下武器，否则面对我的怒火。你现在有十五秒时间服从，”她命令道，她的大炮正在准备另一发致命攻击。 ] ] |你鼓起勇气，走进这艘货船黑暗的内部，避开裸露冒火花的电线和喷着热气的通风口。残骸的走廊里几乎没有光线，只有闪烁的霓虹灯在断断续续的电流涌动中努力保持运作。沿途，你来到一间曾经的会议室，里面摆着破损的桌子，纸张散落在布满灰尘的房间各处。装满水和当地植物的大容器占据着房间的一大角，旁边整齐储存着口粮和饼干。毫无疑问，有人住在这里，而且那人足够强壮，能够赶走西迪安人、拉斯克维尔人和性欲疯狂的VI。 你继续穿过黑暗的通道，直到抵达废弃飞船的驾驶台。几台控制台在检测到你时闪烁着恢复运作，让你得以在飞船主机中搜索遗留数据。快速查看货物清单后，你发现自己登上的是曾经的薄暮号，一艘携带走私货物、往返于新发现的淘金星球之间的海盗运输船。数据显示，它在几个月前于塔库斯轨道上被黑色虚空击落，大部分船员因此丧生——只有一对被标记为失控外星赛博格和有毒水母的奇怪生物例外。尽管你已经竭尽所能，在电力耗尽并终止你的电子冒险之前，你仍找不到有关这些外星生物的更多数据。 下方传来微弱的声音，那里应该是飞船反应堆的位置。你手持[pc.weapon]，沿着代替已融化楼梯的临时白云石崖梯向下，走向那间发着不祥光芒的房间，里面正是你以为已经损坏的核心。令你惊讶的是，等离子引擎仍在运作，一枚连接着太阳能板阵列和临时净水器的电池为它提供燃料。微弱的灯光将你的注意力引向一个由软垫和毯子堆成的大巢穴。那座壮观的[silly |枕头堡垒 |巢穴 ]里住着一个发出鼾声、三只眼睛全都闭着的蓝色外星生物。当你意识到飞船的居住者其实是一只正安详躚在这片柔软天堂中的[var0|莱雅克|长着鞭状触手的离体头颅]时，一声惊呼从你唇间逸出。 你压低的惊呼还是成功惊醒了这个生物。这颗青绿色漂浮头颅的三只眼睛带着恐惧与惊讶看向你，与此同时，一道红色瞄准激光沿你的[pc.legs]一路爬上[pc.chest]，最终停在你的额头上。 “银河公民[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，放下武器，远离我的朋友！你有十五秒时间服从，”一个经仿生扩音器改造的响亮女声命令道。你的[pc.eyes]看到一个强大生物威严的赛博格躯体。充当她右臂的派雷克斯湮灭者正缓慢充能，锁定着你的脸，随时准备将你化为一堆焦黑的灰烬。这位仿生外星人看了一眼惊恐的朋友，然后又看向你。也许和平地服从她的命令会为你免去一些麻烦，但最终，是想活还是想战斗，取决于你。 ]

With your [pc.weapon] in hand, you follow a makeshift dolomite ledge replacing the melted stairs towards the ominously glowing room housing what you expect to be a broken core. To your surprise, the plasma engine’s still active and fueled with a cell connected to an array of solar panels and an improvised water purifier. Weak lights draw your attention towards a big nest of cushions and blankets. The imposing [silly |pillow fort |lair ] is inhabited by a snoring blue alien with three closed eyes. A loud gasp crosses your lips when you realize that the ship’s inhabitant is actually a [var0|Leyak|disembodied head with lash-like tentacles] resting peacefully in the plush paradise. Your muffled sound of surprise manages to wake the creature. The teal floating head’s trio of eyes look at you with a mix of terror and surprise whilst a red targeting laser climbs your [pc.legs] up to your [pc.chest] before setting on your forehead. “Galactic citizen [pc.name] Steele, drop your weapon and move away from my friend! You have fifteen seconds to comply,” a loud, feminine voice altered by bionic amplifiers orders. Your [pc.eyes] spot a powerful, cybernetic frame of an imposing creature. The slowly charging Pyrexxx Annihilator serving as her right arm is locked on your face, ready to turn you into a charred pile of ashes. The bionic alien glances at her terrified friend then at you again. Maybe peacefully following her orders will save you some trouble, but in the end, it’s up to you to decide if you want to live or if you want to fight. ] "

rows.original: Feeling her defeat at hand, the draconic cyborg lets out a mighty roar before shooting a harmless flare towards you. The distraction isn’t enough to blind or stun you but it grants her enough time to flee through a hole in the ceiling. Now that the threat is gone, you can take a closer look at the nest. There’s nothing valuable here except a shard of picardine lying near the plasma core. With your acquisition in hand, you quickly leave the room and head to the wreckage’s exit. The blue, jellyfish-like alien and the draconic cyborg are nowhere to be seen. They might have fled this lair for another or looked for another shelter inside the ruins, but following them now wouldn’t be cost efficient. You take a couple of minutes to leave the entrails of The Gloaming, surfacing back near the coasts of Tarkus’s Oil Sea. Maybe you should try a more peaceful approach next time.

rows.original: Unable to withstand more of her relentless assaults, your [pc.legs] drop you face first on the cold, hard floor. A moment later, the cyborg[silly | dabs on you before taking a firm hold on your shoulder with her strong, clawed feet |’s strong clawed feet take a firm hold over your shoulder ]. The chromed up alien carries you to her lair with powerful flaps of hardlight wings and unceremoniously drops you in her nest of warm blankets and plush cushions. Her pinning claws deactivate and she swaps her cannon for a powerful hand that strips you out of your [pc.gear] in a matter of seconds, leaving you naked on her bed. “[flags.PAULETTE_DEFEAT |Too bad [pc.name], now I get to have my way with your sublime body |My name’s Paulette and today, you’ll be my plaything, [pc.name] ],” she smirks before removing her helmet, revealing her freckled face and mesmerizing eyes.
rows.translation: 你无法再承受她无情的连番攻击，[pc.legs]一软，让你脸朝下摔在冰冷坚硬的地板上。片刻后，赛博格[silly |对你做了个挥臂庆祝动作，然后用强壮的利爪双足牢牢扣住你的肩膀 |强壮的利爪双足牢牢扣住你的肩膀 ]。这位镀铬外星人用硬光翼强劲挥动，把你带回她的巢穴，然后毫不客气地将你扔在铺满温暖毯子和绒软垫子的窝里。她用来压制你的爪子关闭，又将大炮换成一只强有力的手，只用几秒就脱掉你的[pc.gear]，让你赤裸地留在她的床上。 “[flags.PAULETTE_DEFEAT |太糟了，[pc.name]，现在我可以随心所欲地玩弄你迷人的身体了 |我叫波莱特，今天你将成为我的玩物，[pc.name] ]，”她坏笑着脱下头盔，露出带着雀斑的脸庞和迷人的双眼。

rows.original: Reluctantly, you sheathe your [pc.weapon] and raise your opened hands, hoping it’ll appease the armored cyborg. The energy running through her arm cannon fades away a second before the laser sight shuts down. The robotic creature then unfolds her draconic wings, slowly glides around the room and lands softly between the cozy nest and you. Now that she isn’t obscured anymore, you can fully see how massive and powerful she’s with her orange, chromed limbs and toned, purple frame. Her slender, powerful legs and left arm sport wicked, hardlight claws; these dangerous limbs combined with her large, reptilian wings and her long, bulb-tipped tail make her look like a giant saurian from the Leithan homeworld. Her right arm seems to be a modified Pyrexxx Annihilator-class rifle that she covers with a module resembling a welcoming hand while her hardlight claws deactivate, greatly reducing her body’s destructive potential. A hiss of pressurized air as she takes off her helmet reveals soft features distorted by a strict, dominant gaze that meets your eyes through a pair of glasses she discretely perches on the bridge of her nose. A long, blonde ponytail frames her face with an intimidating look. Her smooth, tapered ears twitch gently as her electric blue eyes explore your body very carefully. “Thank you for your cooperation, citizen Steele. Please, seat yourself comfortably on the mattress and disclose your intentions.” Reassured a bit for your safety’s sake, you let the amazonian creature lead you to her [silly |Dragon’s |linen-covered ] lair and place you on a soft, fluffy pillow. She takes her place close to you, joined a moment later by [var0|the reassured Leyak|her alien friend]. The blue creature settles on her lap with a sublime grace and wraps its venom-dripping tentacles around the cyborg’s waist in what must pass for a hug for it. A slight shiver runs through the chromed lady’s body and her chest inflates a bit under the mixed sensation provided by the intoxicating embrace. “Who are you and how do you know my name?” The cyborg brings a chromed hand to her helmet. “My name is Paulette, this wonderful place’s owner,” she says. “As for your name, my sensors tried and failed to get into your Codex’s systems when you penetrated my lair; I could only identify your name out of all the encrypted data. I then looked it up on the Extranet — or rather what little we have access to with my dhaalian computers. So... what brings the heir of a multi-trillionaire playboy to this pastoral paradise?” she inquires through a mischievous smile.
rows.translation: 你不情愿地收起[pc.weapon]，举起张开的双手，希望能安抚这名装甲赛博格。流经她臂炮的能量逐渐消退，一秒后，激光瞄准器也关闭了。随后，这个机械生物展开龙翼，缓缓滑翔着绕过房间，轻轻落在舒适的巢穴与你之间。 如今她不再隐于暗处，你可以完整看清她有多么高大强壮：她拥有橙色镀铬的四肢与紧实的紫色身躯。她修长有力的双腿和左臂上长着凶恶的硬光利爪；这些危险的肢体配合巨大的爬行类翅膀和末端圆球状的长尾巴，使她看起来像来自莱坦母星的巨型蜥蜴。她的右臂似乎是改装过的派雷克斯湮灭者级步枪，她用一个形似友善手掌的模块将它覆盖，同时关闭硬光利爪，大幅降低了身体的破坏力。 她脱下头盔时，压缩空气发出一声嘶响，露出柔和的五官。一道严厉而强势的目光扭曲了这份柔和，隔着一副被她悄悄架在鼻梁上的眼镜，与你四目相对。一条金色长马尾为她的脸庞增添了令人畏惧的气势。她光滑细长的耳朵轻轻抽动，同时电蓝色的双眼极其仔细地打量着你的身体。 “感谢你的合作，斯蒂尔公民。请在床垫上舒适地就座，并说明你的意图。”为了自己的安全，你稍稍放下心来，任由这位亚马逊般的生物把你带到她的[silly |龙巢 |铺着床单的 ]巢穴，并把你安置在一只柔软蓬松的枕头上。她在你身边坐下，片刻后，[var0|安下心来的莱雅克|她的外星朋友]也加入了你们。那个蓝色生物优雅无比地落在她腿上，将滴着毒液的触手缠住赛博格的腰部，这想必就是它的拥抱方式。这令人陶醉的拥抱所带来的复杂感受令镀铬女士的身体微微颤抖，胸部也稍稍膨胀。 “你是谁，又怎么知道我的名字？” 赛博格将一只镀铬手掌放到头盔上。“我叫波莱特，是这个美妙地方的主人，”她说。“至于你的名字，当你闯入我的巢穴时，我的传感器尝试侵入你的法典系统，但失败了；在所有加密数据里，我只能识别出你的名字。然后我在外网上搜索了它——或者更准确地说，是用我的达尔计算机搜索了我们能够访问的那一小部分网络。所以...一位身价数万亿的花花公子的继承人，是什么把你带到了这座田园天堂？”她带着狡黠的笑容问道。

所以他们最后也算迎来了快乐结局？她满意现在的自己吗？你的问题令她轻笑，并摆出英雄姿势。 “以达尔炽热的炼狱起誓，我当然爱现在的生活！这些Pyrexxx肢体，还有我游荡废土时找到的那支[silly |母牛针 |亚马逊改造医疗笔 ]，把我变成了幼年时梦想成为的生物。”她夸耀道。“还有这撮可爱毛发，是我潜入诺瓦家园时吃下采集来的变形糖果后，从产卵口上方长出来的。”她脸颊微红地补充。 她的双颊颜色更深，胸部突然开始膨胀。“然后是拆掉所有肢体，把改造过的产卵口塞满，就像一个豪华自慰洞。我的身体经过处理，产道不仅像最可爱的利坦育母一样欢迎来客、湿润无比，还拥有豪华狸猫挤奶器的功能。”她坏笑道。“我也喜欢无套肛交。凭我的身体结构，甚至可以用尾巴塞进伴侣的屁股。”她用撩人的声音和淘气笑容说道。 “最后，扮演肮脏的龙婊会让我的心疯狂跳动，剩余的某些Pyrexxx肢体还能把我变成塔库斯最可爱的宠物。”她坦白道，羞得满脸通红，在你的[pc.eyes]前藏起脸，显然已经快承受不住。看来这位前XO有些极其独特的癖好，尤其对她这样高大强壮的姑娘而言。 “听着，我、我控制不了隐藏的欲望，但面对最下流的幻想时，我能够、也一定会享受贬低自己。” 她空洞的虚张声势令你轻轻[pc.mf |笑出声 |咯咯笑 ]，蓝色朋友用触手戳刺、恶劣挠痒替她消除尴尬，帮助她恢复镇定。“那么，你还想聊些什么，或者做些什么吗？”
rows.raw: " [paulette.isCrew |If it doesn’t bother her too much, you’d like to hear her story again. |You’ve been wondering since you arrived in this peculiar lair of hers, what a girl like her is doing here? It would be nice if she could provide you some context. ] The purple girl’s features sadden for a handful of seconds before going back to a more relaxed facade. “Well, it’s not a very happy tale, but it’s worth listening to I guess,” she mutters, [silly |snuggling herself into a large, blanket fort |taking a more comfy position on her soft cushions ]. “My name is Paulette and I’m a zaika[var0 |. I guess I’m not the first of my kin you met, |, ]” she says, placing a lithe, chromed hand on her chest. “I was born among the populace of our tidally-locked homeworld, Dhaal. I was raised from hatchling to a full grown [silly |space drow |lady ] with a dozen other sisters by Kemmie, a very gentle and kind [silly |rental mommy |adoptive mother ].” She stops her story a moment to clear her misty eyes and takes a couple of deep breaths before speaking again. “[silly |Architect |Stars ] above, I miss her so much. A few weeks after I reached maturity, I had to leave her home to move to the roaring factories, else she would have lost her mysterious benefactor’s funds.” Wait, can’t she try to find a way to go back there now? The violet lady sadly nods before setting her gaze back on you. “She died a couple of years later and I had to quit my job to be able to go to her funeral. My sisters were here too and followed in her footsteps, helping the poorest of us the best they could. I sold my body to a Peer a couple of days later out of desperation; it was just too hard to go on.” A lone tear trickles down her cheeks before her hovering friend gives her what passes for a reassuring, tentacle-filled hug and snuggles against her tight. Wait, she means indentured servitude, right? Right? “No. I was on the streets with nowhere to go, so I took the first opportunity I could find to stay alive. I answered an ad looking for strong and resilient girls for Paragon Inc.’s new project. Since they promised they would cover all my expenses, I eagerly responded without reading the fine prints and ended up as a new type of XO enforcer.” Her voice trails off a little and her eyes slowly drift to her chromed up limbs. “Since we were new prototypes for a potential upgrade of the XO corp, we were equipped with features such as magnetic, modular limbs that could turn law enforcers into sex-relief units or caretakers on demand,” she whispers. “However, we were too expensive to mass-produce and were thus sold to the wealthiest zaika Peers as their personal bodyguards and sexual-relief units.” You talked about a Peer that owned you? How was she? “A terrible monster of a Paragon high up. She used me to intimidate and repress those she despised. Her favorite thing to do was to make me pin a poor gal on the ground and stuff her to the point she would be forced to cough my seed out. She had complete control over me and the new generation of mind-controlling chips they fitted us with let us see and feel everything,” she sighs. “The worst moments were when she used me in her suite; there’s no word to describe the state in which she left my poor body when she was mad. She even altered my seminal fluids to bear Paragon’s colors and my egg-laying canal to make it more fuckable for crying out loud!” Ouch, it’s a very sensible subject, it’d be better to change the topic at hand. So, how did she end up here? A warm smile erases her despair as she brings the blue floating head in an almost motherly hug. “It’s thanks to my friend Dabebbieth. Could you tell this little guy over here’s a skilled poet?” The sentient head jellyfish’s cheeks take a darker coloration a second before unintelligible words escape his [silly |dickpillows |lips ]. “Isn’t he the cutest leyak around? It’s just a shame he’s so shy because [silly |I’m not fluent in bottom |he barely speaks with his beautiful voice ].” The alien’s blue face turns three shades darker following his friend’s compliment and flustered words cross his large lips. Long tentacles fail to hide his face from your gaze as the melodic mumbles spirit your [pc.ears] to a comfy paradise. Ethereal sounds and tunes soothe your mind with colorful feelings, as if the chant is tying your senses together into a sweet fantasy. Paulette stops the leyak’s melody with a few headpats a minute later, gently ending the mind-flaring experience. “I see you enjoyed this little show. I always feel better and well-rested when he hums next to me. He was my owner’s most prized pet. The awful bitch kept him underfed to annihilate his complex thought processes, dooming him to a fancy jellyfish’s life. Unfortunately for her, one of her rivals hired pirates to abduct him. So she did the only thing she knew to solve her problems and sent me against an entire freighter of pirates and slavers.” Did you manage to take them all down? A small shake of her head reports the outcome. “Hundreds of heavily trained and armed thugs against a lone war machine of a zaika? Come on! Life isn’t a fairy tale. They captured me in the armory thanks to an EMP grenade that incapacitated my limbs and fried my control chip. I did manage to turn at least sixty percent of the crew into broken messes beforehand,” she says in a somewhat proud roar. “They were shot down by a rival gang over Tarkus a few hours later while they were destroying my right robotic arm,” she says with a melancholic gaze toward her reversible hand cannon. “I took advantage of the crash to escape with Dabebbieth and a new set of deadly limbs I retrieved from their stolen supplies.” So they had a kind of happy ending in the end? Is she happy with how she is now? Your question makes her chuckle softly as she takes a heroic posture. “By Dhaal’s torrid inferno, of course I love my new life! These Pyrexxx limbs and that [silly |cow jab |Amazon Treatment medipen ] I found while roaming the Wastes turned me into the creature lil’ hatchling me dreamt to be,” she boasts. “There’s also this cute tuft of hair that sprouted over my egg-chute after I ate some transformative candies I gathered when I snuck into Novahome,” she adds with a slight blush on her cheeks. Hold on a minute, how are her breasts working? You’ve heard zaika stored their genetic material in their chest, so how does her new biology work? The purple alien wink and gives you her most charming smile. “A quick scan provided by my cybernetics revealed to me that my [silly |chestpillows |tits ] hold two kinds of very similar blue liquid; the only difference being that the type coming out of my nipples is more fluid and free from genetic material. The transformative split them in two chambers: one on the front that contains a milk-like nectar and the other, closer to my chest, is filled with a spicier payload. When I’m aroused, both cavities inflate to tremendous levels, so the hornier I am, the milkier I become. [paulette.isCrew |Now that I’m here, I’m having no problem anymore with my body’s excessive fluid production, Dabebbieth still takes the lion’s share, but here I have all I need to empty my bloated bosom, |There’s days I wish I had another roommate with me to help me dry my bloated bosom. Dabebbieth helps a lot but sometimes there’s too much of it for just him, ]” she adds, playing with her leyak companion’s numbing tentacles with sharp yet delicate fingers. They are rather cute together; it’s reassuring to see that there’s room for some kindness and friendship[paulette.isCrew | | in a tough place like this ]. “[paulette.isCrew |Your ship offers us |We might be stranded here but it’s ] a better life than most of my folks could dream of and it’s a perfect place for my shy [silly |guy |friend ]. This calm, peaceful setting provides him all that he needs for his artistic mind to shine. His last poem was an absolute banger on the Extranet. Everyone wants to read more of his beautiful words,” she says before dragging the flustered leyak in for a merciless salvo of kisses. Hum, it might be a bit personal, but does she have specific... ‘things’ that rock her boat? A deep, magenta blush rises to her cheeks as she lets her mind dance with her carnal desires. “Well, that’s indeed a bit personal, but I don’t really mind answering,” she mumbles, starting to enumerate her kinks on her clawed fingers. “I’m a zaika, so I really love [silly |Mommy Milkies |milk ]; it makes my mind go all lovey dovey. Then there’s nursing stuff... my seed has become really sweet and nutritious and the treatment gave me nipples, so I can be a very gentle mommy.” Her cheeks take a deeper coloration as her chest starts to grow all of a sudden. “Then there’s having my modified egg-chute stuffed with all my limbs removed, just like if I were a deluxe onahole. It seems the former XO has some very peculiar tastes, especially for a big, strong girl like her. “Listen, I c-can’t control my hidden desires, but I can and will appreciate debasing myself when it comes to my vilest fantasies.” Her empty bravado makes you [pc.mf |chuckle |giggle ] a little while she restores her composure with the help of her blue friend’s tentacled pokes, soothing her embarrassment away, thanks to his vicious tickles. “So, is there anything else you’d want to talk about, or do?” "

rows.original: You’ve been wondering, what do they do to pass the time around here? A charming smile invites itself on Paulette’s face. “It depends on the amount of food, supplies, power, and water we have left. This life might be better than anything I could have had on Dhaal with my upbringing but it’s not an easy one either.” She extends her orange prosthetics to reach for her leyak companion, resting him on her lap and gently petting his gelatinous body. “First comes the food. My little poet over here has a high protein diet and can’t stop himself from waking me at dawn with a drug-laced blowjob,” she says, punctuating each word with a hint of anger. “Stars, I wish I could sleep a tad later. Most of my food comes from the improvised hydroponic farms I’ve set all around the wreckage. I downloaded some data from the Extranet on how to create and maintain a controlled biome with the remains of the ship’s systems.” That’s quite impressive; it must have been a real pain to settle it. “You wouldn’t believe how hard it was for me to find good crops around this rock. Fortunately, I borrowed some stuff from a sydian dominatrix’s stocks. She wasn’t pleased but her boytoys weren’t very eager to fight a strong gal like me, even with their greater numbers. In dire cases, we still have some leftover biscuits and combat rations I’ve found around the ship or abandoned near the Oil Sea,” she says in a disgusted voice. She might not be a fan of dehydrated or diamond-hard food. “For water, it was quite easy to repair the water filtering system and to alter the ship’s plumbing to gather enough liquid for the farm and for our personal usage. The amount of salvageable systems on the wreckage made it simple, but there’s always a damn nut or screw whose model was discontinued, forcing me to do some [silly |calibrations |improvised plasma welding ].” The chromed up amazon points at a few armored, bubbling tanks near the core. “The hardest part of the job was finding replacement filters for the fuel cell. It needs pure water to create hydrogen and there’s not many high quality filters around, so one night I acquired some from an abandoned deck of the Nova.” That doesn’t sound quite legal. Ironic that someone who’d been turned into a ruthless [silly |robocop |cybernetic cop ] would break the law. The violet lady rolls her eyes, slightly annoyed by the remark. “XOs aren’t cops; they are judges, jury, and executioners. And for my defense, I took this stuff from a dusty supply room, nobody went there for centuries and none of the stuff was connected to the machinery, so my actions didn’t threaten anyone.” Paulette then gently taps her bed and points at the small collection of books near her nest. “The best and most interesting quests are for finding stuff like linens, books, holodiscs, baubles... All the nice things that aren’t necessary to live but incredibly valuable all the same. I think I spotted a [rand |set of flowery cushions |flamethrower guitar |collection of Reaper Armaments plasma blades |collection of kui-tan yaois ] yesterday but I was already packed with liquid oxygen and hydrogen,” she sighs. It seems that her situation forces her to make some tough choices. “Yeah, I try my best to keep the core running first and foremost. The containment shell can resist a nuclear warhead, but it would require a small one to reignite it if it ever runs dry, so I’m always on the lookout for hydrogen to feed it. It’s running at the lowest functioning point, around five percent of its capacity, and it requires quite a lot of fuel to keep it up.” Why doesn’t she look for another kind of engine to maintain her farm and water purifiers? “I tried to, but most of the good engines were already salvaged or required exotic components to run. Sure, I could get an old diesel engine to run the filtering system, but the Oil Sea’s purity is low. It would require more power to refine the oil and maintain the refinery than taping some solar panels and wind turbines together to run a humidity gatherer and pump some liquid from a water table to process the fuel cell feeding the core.” Her life here’s indeed quite busy, doesn’t she need help or trade with others? “Well look at me. I don’t really have the shape of a friend, and besides I can do the heavy lifting and tech savvy stuff. But to be fair, I would gladly have some more company,” she muses, giving a friendly kiss to what passes for Dabebbieth’s forehead. “Don’t get me wrong, I appreciate that you showed us kindness and respect but I — no, we could use a lot more friendly contacts. When this place finally has more settlers... or when the locals start approaching us with peaceful intentions rather than trying to steal our tech... then maybe we will be able to socialize again. Until then, I will be the Ghod’Mluss’ipn for them. I think it means Underworld Beast or Manticore in their language. I’ve left quite an impression on them with this little outfit of mine,” she snickers. If she had to take a more ‘civilized’ job, what would she do? The modular XO takes a long minute to think about her skills and desires, slowly pondering her eventual career change. “The obvious answer would be a Peacekeeper. I’ve got the body for it... but it might awaken some of my past’s worst memories. I could be a caretaker like mom used to be, but my leyak friend will struggle with kids and my altered biology might put a stop to my ambitions. Welder, engineer or farmer could be fine jobs if I had no other choices, but my dream job would be a florist.” That’s... a very peculiar choice; you didn’t take her for a creative soul. “I know right? When I was a kid, I wanted to work in the agrarian districts. Their conditions were dire but they were the only ones outside the Peers and the food industry workers that could see real crops and natural beauty, untouched by the Gyre’s polluted hellscape. I saw some on a holopict when I was a factory worker. It was a picture of a sublime bouquet composed for one of Dhaal’s Mavens — the acting commanders and rulers of our planet. The mix of colors and textures were wonderful and the few droplets of dew added an ethereal look to the floral harmony.” Well, Tarkus could use a few more colors to highlight its hidden beauty, but it’ll be a herculean task. “Do I look like a quitter, [pc.name]? And like I said, it’d be a dream job,” she whispers, a palpable envy laced through her words. “I already have ideas about how to adapt some species to this planet’s peculiar biome and I discovered some interesting endemic fauna to play with. It’ll take time but this little project of mine might come to fruition,” she muses. She sets her electric blue eyes back on yours, almost analyzing you with them. “I think that’s all I have to say about our activities here. Anything else you’d want to do?”
rows.translation: 你一直很好奇，他们平时在这里怎样打发时间？ 波莱特脸上浮现迷人笑容。“这取决于我们还剩多少食物、补给、电力和水。以我的出身来看，这种生活或许比在达尔能拥有的一切都好，但也绝不轻松。”她伸出橙色义肢，把莱亚克伙伴抱到腿上，温柔抚摸他胶质的身体。 “首先是食物。这里的小诗人需要高蛋白饮食，还总忍不住在黎明用带药的口交叫醒我。”她说道，每个词都带着一丝怒意。“星辰在上，我真希望能多睡一会儿。大多数食物来自我在残骸各处搭建的简易水培农场。我从外网下载了资料，学习怎样利用飞船残余系统建立并维护受控生态群落。” 相当了不起；建起来一定非常麻烦。 “你想象不到，我在这块破石头上寻找优质作物有多困难。幸好我从一个西迪安女支配者的库存里借了些东西。她很不高兴，不过即使人数占优，她的男宠也不太愿意和我这种强壮姑娘打架。情况危急时，我们还有一些我在飞船各处或油海附近废弃物中找到的剩余饼干和战斗口粮。”她语带嫌恶，看来不喜欢脱水或硬得像钻石的食物。 “水方面倒很简单：修好过滤系统，再改造飞船管道，就能为农场和日常使用收集足够液体。残骸里可回收的系统很多，所以并不困难，但总有该死的螺母或螺丝已经停产，逼我做些[silly |校准 |临时等离子焊接 ]。” 这个镀铬亚马逊指向核心附近几座冒泡的装甲罐。“最困难的是为燃料电池寻找替换滤芯。它需要纯水制氢，而附近没有多少高品质滤芯，所以某晚我从诺瓦号一处废弃甲板上取得了一些。” 听起来不太合法。一个曾被改造成冷酷[silly |机器警察 |义体警察 ]的人居然违法，真够讽刺。紫色女士翻了个白眼，对这番话略感恼火。 “XO不是警察；他们集法官、陪审团和刽子手于一身。而且我要为自己辩护：那些东西来自积灰的储藏室，几百年都没人去，也没有任何部件连接设备，所以我的行为没有威胁任何人。” 波莱特随后轻敲床铺，指向巢穴旁收藏的几本书。“最好、最有趣的探索，是寻找床单、书籍、全息光盘、小饰品之类...都是生存并非必需，却同样极其珍贵的好东西。昨天我好像发现了[rand |一套花卉图案靠垫 |一把喷火吉他 |一套死神军工等离子刀 |一套狸猫耽美漫画 ]，但当时身上已经装满液氧和氢。”她叹息道。 看来她的处境迫使她作出一些艰难选择。 “是啊，我首先会尽力让核心保持运转。约束外壳可以抵挡核弹头，但如果核心耗尽，就需要一枚小型核弹才能重新点燃，所以我总在寻找氢来喂养它。现在它以最低可运行状态工作，大约只有容量的百分之五，却仍需要大量燃料维持。” 她为什么不找另一种发动机维护农场和净水器？ “我试过，但好用的发动机大都已经被回收，或者需要稀有部件才能运转。当然，我可以用老柴油机驱动过滤系统，可油海纯度太低。精炼石油并维护炼油设施所需电力，会超过拼起太阳能板和风力涡轮、驱动湿度收集器，再从地下水层抽取液体处理燃料电池并为核心供能的消耗。” 她在这里的生活确实忙碌，不需要帮助，或与别人交易吗？ “看看我吧。我实在不像个友善的人，而且重活和技术工作自己都能做。不过说实话，我很乐意多点陪伴。”她沉思着，在勉强算作达贝比埃斯额头的部位友善一吻。 “别误会，我很感激你向我们表达善意和尊重，但我——不，是我们确实需要更多友好联系。等这个地方终于有更多定居者...或当地人开始怀着和平意图接近，而不是试图偷走我们的技术...或许那时我们才能重新社交。在此之前，我会继续当他们的Ghod’Mluss’ipn。我想在他们语言里，这意为冥界之兽或蝎狮。这身小衣装给他们留下了深刻印象。”她窃笑。 如果必须从事更‘文明’的工作，她会选择什么？ 模块化XO花了很长一分钟思考技能与愿望，缓缓斟酌未来可能的职业转变。“最显而易见的是维和者。我有适合的身体...但这可能唤醒过去最糟糕的回忆。我可以像妈妈一样当照护者，可莱亚克朋友难以适应孩子，改变后的生理结构也可能阻碍理想。如果别无选择，焊工、工程师或农民都不错，但梦想职业是花艺师。” 这...是个非常特别的选择；你没想到她还有创造力。 “对吧？小时候我想在农业区工作。那里条件很糟，却是除了对等者和食品业工人之外，唯一能看见真正作物和自然美景、不受环流污染地狱侵蚀的人。我当工厂工人时在全息照片里看过一些。那是一束为达尔某位导师——我们行星的代理指挥官和统治者——制作的华美花束。色彩与质感的组合美妙绝伦，少许露珠更为花卉和声增添了空灵气质。” 嗯，塔库斯确实需要更多色彩来凸显隐藏的美丽，不过这将是一项艰巨任务。 “我看起来像会放弃的人吗，[pc.name]？而且我说过，那是梦想职业。”她低声说，话语中带着明显向往。“我已经想好怎样让一些物种适应这颗行星独特的生态群落，还发现了些有趣的本土动物可以尝试。虽然需要时间，但这个小项目或许会开花结果。”她若有所思。 她重新用电蓝色双眼望向你，仿佛几乎在分析你。“我想关于我们在这里的活动，就只有这些可说了。你还想做什么吗？”
rows.raw: " You’ve been wondering, what do they do to pass the time around here? A charming smile invites itself on Paulette’s face. “It depends on the amount of food, supplies, power, and water we have left. This life might be better than anything I could have had on Dhaal with my upbringing but it’s not an easy one either.” She extends her orange prosthetics to reach for her leyak companion, resting him on her lap and gently petting his gelatinous body. “First comes the food. My little poet over here has a high protein diet and can’t stop himself from waking me at dawn with a drug-laced blowjob,” she says, punctuating each word with a hint of anger. “Stars, I wish I could sleep a tad later. Most of my food comes from the improvised hydroponic farms I’ve set all around the wreckage. I downloaded some data from the Extranet on how to create and maintain a controlled biome with the remains of the ship’s systems.” That’s quite impressive; it must have been a real pain to settle it. “You wouldn’t believe how hard it was for me to find good crops around this rock. Fortunately, I borrowed some stuff from a sydian dominatrix’s stocks. She wasn’t pleased but her boytoys weren’t very eager to fight a strong gal like me, even with their greater numbers. In dire cases, we still have some leftover biscuits and combat rations I’ve found around the ship or abandoned near the Oil Sea,” she says in a disgusted voice. She might not be a fan of dehydrated or diamond-hard food. “For water, it was quite easy to repair the water filtering system and to alter the ship’s plumbing to gather enough liquid for the farm and for our personal usage. The amount of salvageable systems on the wreckage made it simple, but there’s always a damn nut or screw whose model was discontinued, forcing me to do some [silly |calibrations |improvised plasma welding ].” The chromed up amazon points at a few armored, bubbling tanks near the core. “The hardest part of the job was finding replacement filters for the fuel cell. It needs pure water to create hydrogen and there’s not many high quality filters around, so one night I acquired some from an abandoned deck of the Nova.” That doesn’t sound quite legal. Ironic that someone who’d been turned into a ruthless [silly |robocop |cybernetic cop ] would break the law. The violet lady rolls her eyes, slightly annoyed by the remark. “XOs aren’t cops; they are judges, jury, and executioners. And for my defense, I took this stuff from a dusty supply room, nobody went there for centuries and none of the stuff was connected to the machinery, so my actions didn’t threaten anyone.” Paulette then gently taps her bed and points at the small collection of books near her nest. “The best and most interesting quests are for finding stuff like linens, books, holodiscs, baubles... All the nice things that aren’t necessary to live but incredibly valuable all the same. I think I spotted a [rand |set of flowery cushions |flamethrower guitar |collection of Reaper Armaments plasma blades |collection of kui-tan yaois ] yesterday but I was already packed with liquid oxygen and hydrogen,” she sighs. It seems that her situation forces her to make some tough choices. “Yeah, I try my best to keep the core running first and foremost. The containment shell can resist a nuclear warhead, but it would require a small one to reignite it if it ever runs dry, so I’m always on the lookout for hydrogen to feed it. It’s running at the lowest functioning point, around five percent of its capacity, and it requires quite a lot of fuel to keep it up.” Why doesn’t she look for another kind of engine to maintain her farm and water purifiers? “I tried to, but most of the good engines were already salvaged or required exotic components to run. Sure, I could get an old diesel engine to run the filtering system, but the Oil Sea’s purity is low. It would require more power to refine the oil and maintain the refinery than taping some solar panels and wind turbines together to run a humidity gatherer and pump some liquid from a water table to process the fuel cell feeding the core.” Her life here’s indeed quite busy, doesn’t she need help or trade with others? “Well look at me. I don’t really have the shape of a friend, and besides I can do the heavy lifting and tech savvy stuff. But to be fair, I would gladly have some more company,” she muses, giving a friendly kiss to what passes for Dabebbieth’s forehead. “Don’t get me wrong, I appreciate that you showed us kindness and respect but I — no, we could use a lot more friendly contacts. When this place finally has more settlers... or when the locals start approaching us with peaceful intentions rather than trying to steal our tech... then maybe we will be able to socialize again. Until then, I will be the Ghod’Mluss’ipn for them. I think it means Underworld Beast or Manticore in their language. I’ve left quite an impression on them with this little outfit of mine,” she snickers. If she had to take a more ‘civilized’ job, what would she do? The modular XO takes a long minute to think about her skills and desires, slowly pondering her eventual career change. “The obvious answer would be a Peacekeeper. I’ve got the body for it... but it might awaken some of my past’s worst memories. I could be a caretaker like mom used to be, but my leyak friend will struggle with kids and my altered biology might put a stop to my ambitions. Welder, engineer or farmer could be fine jobs if I had no other choices, but my dream job would be a florist.” That’s... a very peculiar choice; you didn’t take her for a creative soul. “I know right? When I was a kid, I wanted to work in the agrarian districts. Their conditions were dire but they were the only ones outside the Peers and the food industry workers that could see real crops and natural beauty, untouched by the Gyre’s polluted hellscape. I saw some on a holopict when I was a factory worker. It was a picture of a sublime bouquet composed for one of Dhaal’s Mavens — the acting commanders and rulers of our planet. The mix of colors and textures were wonderful and the few droplets of dew added an ethereal look to the floral harmony.” Well, Tarkus could use a few more colors to highlight its hidden beauty, but it’ll be a herculean task. “Do I look like a quitter, [pc.name]? And like I said, it’d be a dream job,” she whispers, a palpable envy laced through her words. “I already have ideas about how to adapt some species to this planet’s peculiar biome and I discovered some interesting endemic fauna to play with. It’ll take time but this little project of mine might come to fruition,” she muses. She sets her electric blue eyes back on yours, almost analyzing you with them. “I think that’s all I have to say about our activities here. Anything else you’d want to do?” "

rows.original: Paulette frowns. “Are you sure? I mean... I’m not against a good forepl- sparring session to get all pumped up and sweaty, but I tend to take things pretty seriously. I don’t wanna hurt you with my sharp claws and energy weapons.” You’ve been through tougher challenges. A scratch or two doesn’t sound too bad. The chromed alien cocks an eyebrow. Your confidence spiked her interest. “Assuming we do find a safe spot to spar, I tend to go overboard pretty quickly. When I’m in the heat of battle, I quickly lose all restraint and give everything I’ve got. I can limit some of my force multipliers and reduce my power output if you wanna play it fun and safe, or we can fight for our lives in a [silly |duel of the fates |deadly gauntlet ]. And one last thing — I fuck harder than I fight, a lot harder, especially after a fun fight, so choose when you wanna use your second wind carefully,” she impishly teases. Will you fight her and if so, how tough do you want her to be?
rows.translation: 波莱特皱起眉头。“你确定吗？我是说...我并不反对来场痛快的前、对练，让大家都热血沸腾、汗流浃背，不过我打起来往往相当认真。我可不想用利爪和能量武器伤到你。” 你经历过更加严酷的挑战，一两道抓伤听起来没什么大不了。 这个镀铬异星人挑起一边眉毛。你的自信激起了她的兴趣。“假设我们真能找到安全的地方对练，我通常很快就会玩过头。战意一上来，我马上就会失去克制，拿出全部本事。你想玩得轻松安全些，我可以限制部分力量增幅并降低功率输出；不然，我们也可以在一场[silly |命运对决 |致命试炼 ]里赌上性命。最后还有一点，我操人时比打架凶猛得多，凶猛得多，尤其是在一场痛快的战斗之后。所以什么时候使用第二口气，可要仔细选择。”她坏笑着挑逗道。 你要和她战斗吗？如果要，又希望她拿出多少实力？

rows.original: A predatory light sparks in Paulette’s blue eyes, as if you activated some deeply buried instincts. “I see: you want to test who’s the toughest predator around, don’t you? Beware though, the winner takes all!” As soon as her words leave her mouth, an irresistible force drags you across the room, squeezed in her tight, vicious grip. You try to squirm out of her grasp but her powerful claws hold you firmly in her grasp. [var0 |You hit the ground after a quick swooping motion, allowing you to draw your [pc.weapon] whilst the XO’s wicked hardlight claws and Pyrexxx Annihilator come to life with an ominous glow. |[paulette.isCrew |The former XO quickly deploys her wings and swoops through the ship before soaring high above the [var1 |arid wastes. She hoists you into the air for a handful of seconds before diving down toward a rocky plateau near the landing site! |other vessels. She hoists you in the air for a handful of seconds before diving toward an abandoned storehouse at the edge of the landing site! ] You hit the ground after a quick swooping motion, allowing you to draw your [pc.weapon] whilst the XO’s wicked hardlight claws and Pyrexxx Annihilator come to life with an ominous glow, scaring a stray nuka salvager. |The former XO tugs you across the nursery, crossing confused nurses and a very concerned Briget on your way to a training room. “What are you up to this time?” “A little test of strength between [pc.name] and I,” Paulette casually says. “Don’t worry, I won’t hurt [pc.himHer] — much.” “You better play nice if you wanna keep your cookie privileges.” Paulette nods. “I will. Did you check the first aid kits near training room two? Better safe than sorry.” Briget squints. “No disintegrations.” “As you wish,” the former XO playfully replies before tugging you to the reinforced room. Once inside, she finally releases her grasp on you. She flies to the center of the small arena, allowing you to take a fighting stance as the doors close in a hiss of magnetic circuitry. Her wicked claws and Pyrexxx Annihilator ominously glow with power, ready to tear you to shreds! ] ] “Alright [pc.name]. Let’s dance!”

rows.translation: 能陪她待上一阵很不错，但你还有地方要去，还有遗产要争取。你恋恋不舍地离开镀铬女士的柔软巢穴，告诉她自己现在要上路了。她蓝色眼眸中闪过一丝悲伤，随后[paulette.isCrew |像出现时一样迅速消失 |隐没在嘶鸣的头盔之下 ]。 “好吧，[paulette.isCrew |你知道去哪里找我们。”她说着在你脸颊轻轻一吻，随后把你送到房间入口。你刚走出住处，这位紫色亚马逊便紧紧拥抱你，珍惜着你的存在、香气与温暖，仿佛你即将离开数年。“在外面要小心：宇宙是个寒冷无情的地方，它太常摧毁甜美的灵魂。”她贴着你的[pc.ears]低语。 “别担心，波莱特，要是我觉得太冷，就去你床上陪你。”你说道，惹得她深深脸红，双颊变成暗紫水晶色，乳房也胀大了一个罩杯。 慌乱的扎伊卡缓缓退回房间，而你逐渐远去；她透过低调的眼镜，以混合着欲望与爱慕的目光盯着你迷人的曲线 |让我带你到飞船外面。我可不想让这里的破烂零件电到或割伤你。”她说着张开金属双臂，作出邀请。你花几秒钟鼓起面对接下来一切的勇气，靠近这位机械亚马逊。她紧紧抱住你的[pc.arms]与[pc.chest]后，强有力地扇动双翼，把你们一同托起，以极快速度穿过破败走廊。龙族义体人在残骸深处穿行，追随一束刺入危险废船的微弱光芒；阵阵寒风令你的视野模糊。 没过多久，塔库斯荒凉的土地重新出现在眼前：布满残骸废物的尘土海岸，受到一片焦油般深邃海洋的威胁。波莱特轻柔地将你放在崎岖地面，曾是薄暮号左侧装甲板的残骸为你们遮挡视线。当你的[pc.feet]触及地面时，她突然抱得更紧，在放手前与你分享最后一个拥抱。 “我们的道路暂时分开了，但希望还能再见，[pc.name]。”你回答说，这是你的荣幸。几秒后，她挥手告别，骇人双翼将她送回薄暮号锈迹斑斑的船体 ]。
rows.raw: " It was nice to spend some time with her, but you still have places to be and an inheritance to claim. Reluctantly, you leave the chromed lady’s soft nest and announce to her you’ll be on your way now. A slight spark of sadness lights her blue eyes before disappearing [paulette.isCrew |as quickly as it appeared |under her hissing helmet ]. “Alright then, [paulette.isCrew |you know where to find us,” she says, dropping a small peck on your cheek before escorting you to her room’s entrance. As soon as you step out of her place, the purple amazon hugs you tight, enjoying your presence, perfume, and warmth as if you were about to leave for years. “Be safe out there: the universe is a cold, merciless place that breaks sweet souls way too often,” she whispers in your [pc.ears]. “Don’t worry Paulette, if I ever feel too cold, I’ll join you in your bed,” you say, making her blush deep enough to turn her cheeks a dark amethyst and grow her breasts a cup bigger. The flustered zaika slowly returns to her room as you walk away, staring at your alluring curves through her discrete glasses with a mix of desire and adoration |let me lead you outside the ship. I wouldn’t want you to get shocked or cut by this place’s broken bits,” she says, opening her metallic arms invitingly. You take a few seconds to gather your courage for what’s to come and close in with the mechanical amazon. Once she hugs your [pc.arms] and [pc.chest] tight, she lifts you both with powerful flaps of her wings, propelling herself through the ragged corridors with extreme alacrity. Cold blasts of wind blur your vision as the draconic cyborg travels through the wreck’s depths, following a dim ray of light piercing the dangerous derelict. Before long, Tarkus’s desolate land reappears in front of your eyes, a dusty shore covered in debris and wastes threatened by a deep, tar-like ocean. Paulette gently lands you on the rough ground, sheltered from sight by what used to be The Gloaming’s left armor plate. Her grip over you tightens suddenly as your [pc.feet] touch the ground, sharing a last hug with you before letting you go. “Our paths split for now, but I hope we’ll meet again, [pc.name].” The pleasure was all yours, you retort. A few seconds later, she gives you a parting wave as her menacing wings propel her back towards The Gloaming’s rusted frame ]. "

rows.original: So... is there a reason why she stays here instead of traveling this world — or better, joining a spaceship’s crew and seeing the confederacy’s worlds spread across the stars? Paulette sighs. “I’d like to, but there’s something anchoring me down here. Come, I’ll show you,” she says, gliding off her mattress and offering a clawed hand to you. Intrigued by her troubled face and mysterious answer, you take her hand and let her guide you to the crackling plasma core’s base. It takes her a long minute to open the synthetic star’s control panel, revealing dozens of digital gauges and displays. [pc.cl engineer |Even for a seasoned scholar in technological fields like you, these readings look correct. There’s power spikes here and there but nothing to worry about |You might not be versed in the field of mechatronics and engineering, but you fail to see any problem in any of the measures in front of you ]. “Look carefully at the fluctuations of the containment field, you’ll understand.” Still unsure about her worries’ legitimacy, you turn your [pc.eyes] toward the periodic curves monitoring the core’s stability. Everything seems to be fine, the signal’s a bit jagged but it looks just like any other big ship’s engine — unless... “You saw it, didn’t you? Remove the periodic contribution of the reactor and see what’s the remaining feedback.”
rows.translation: 所以...她为什么一直留在这里，而不去周游这个世界——或者更好一些，加入某艘飞船的船员，游览邦联散布在群星之间的世界？ 波莱特叹了口气。“我很想，但有件东西把我拴在这里。来，我带你看看。”她说着滑下床垫，向你伸出一只带爪的手。她忧虑的神色和神秘回答勾起你的兴趣，于是你牵住她的手，任她领你前往噼啪作响的等离子核心底部。她花了足足一分钟才打开这颗人造恒星的控制面板，露出数十个数字仪表与显示屏。[pc.cl engineer |即便对于你这样精通技术领域的资深学者，这些读数看起来也完全正常。这里那里有几次功率尖峰，但没什么好担心的 |你或许并不精通机电一体化与工程学，但眼前的各项测量值也看不出有什么问题 ]。 “仔细看约束场的波动，你会明白的。” 你依然不确定她的担忧是否有根据，便将[pc.eyes]转向监测核心稳定性的周期曲线。一切似乎都很正常，信号有些参差不齐，但看起来就像其他大型飞船的引擎——除非... “你看到了，对吧？去掉反应堆的周期分量，看看剩余反馈是什么。”

rows.original: can do: a mundane checkup of the engine to be sure it won’t explode mid-flight. If the reactor is fine, only a tiny electronic noise should be on the display, else the machine might be defective. As soon as you input the last command, a chaotic mess appears on the screen, leaving you gawking in confusion.
rows.translation: 都能做到：对引擎进行一次普通检查，确保它不会在飞行途中爆炸。如果反应堆正常，显示器上应该只会有微小电子噪声，否则机器可能存在故障。你刚输入最后一条命令，屏幕上便出现一团混乱，让你困惑得目瞪口呆。

rows.original: “The poor quality of the hydrogen I’m feeding it is postponing potential disaster, but if I leave it alone for one or two days, there’s going to be a lot less living in the Nova’s immediate area, and an inch or two less hull plating on the big bitch herself. I looked for a way to fix it, but I couldn’t get my hands on an Ultra Dense Degenerate Matter Turbine. The Nova had a few, from what I could find out, skulking around. One’s still running and can’t be taken out without risking to trigger an even bigger catastrophe. Another’s been broke when she crashed, and the last, redundant one was stolen by an eccentric raskvel mechanic some time ago. I could try to recover it from him... but what he calls his workshop is in the middle of a Sydian-heavy territory — going there will be a sure way for me to lose all my limbs and end up as their deluxe, helpless fucktoy.”
rows.translation: “我喂给它的氢气质量很差，这延后了潜在灾难；但要是我把它单独放上一两天，诺瓦号附近的活物会少上一大截，那个大家伙自己的船体装甲也会少上一两英寸。我找过修复方法，可一直弄不到超高密简并物质涡轮机。据我查到的情况，诺瓦号里本来有几台，分散藏在各处。一台还在运转，不能拆，否则可能触发更大的灾难。另一台在坠毁时摔坏了；最后那台冗余设备则在一段时间前被一个古怪的拉斯克维尔机械师偷走。我可以试着从他那里取回来...但他所谓的工坊位于西迪安人大量出没的地盘中央——我去那里肯定会失去所有肢体，最后变成他们豪华而无助的泄欲玩具。”

rows.original: Slowly, you turn to face Paulette’s electric blue eyes. “I can try to bargain for it, then we can get you out of this place.”
rows.translation: 你缓缓转身，望向波莱特那双电蓝色眼睛。“我可以试着和他谈条件，然后我们就能带你离开这里。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSlowly, you turn to face Paulette’s electric blue eyes. “I can try to bargain for it, then we can get you out of this place.”"

rows.original: The zaika blushes, a rather cute display corrupted by her growing chest. “I’ll forever be in your debt if you did. With this part, we can fix the plasma reactor in about thirty minutes, and then, we’ll be free to go where we please,” she whispers, reaching for the leyak’s venomous tentacle. The floating alien nods before disappearing between the cyborg’s breasts, babbling a couple of words muffled by the pillowy mass of purple flesh smothering him.
rows.translation: 扎伊卡红了脸，这幅相当可爱的景象却被她不断膨胀的胸部破坏。“如果你真这么做，我会永远欠你一份人情。有了这个零件，我们大约三十分钟就能修好等离子反应堆，然后便可以自由前往任何想去的地方。”她低声说着，伸手摸向莱亚克有毒的触手。漂浮外星人点了点头，随后钻进义体人的乳房之间；枕头般的紫色乳肉将他埋住，令他含混地咕哝了几句话。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zaika blushes, a rather cute display corrupted by her growing chest. “I’ll forever be in your debt if you did. With this part, we can fix the plasma reactor in about thirty minutes, and then, we’ll be free to go where we please,” she whispers, reaching for the leyak’s venomous tentacle. The floating alien nods before disappearing between the cyborg’s breasts, babbling a couple of words muffled by the pillowy mass of purple flesh smothering him."

rows.original: “Dhaal’s infernal hemisphere, you’re right. [pc.name], I’ll also need a couple of cargobots to pack our belongings with. We can’t leave this place without them,” she says, reaching for a big, red shard of picardine from a box filled with replacement parts, surely a makeshift focus lens. “Please take this, it should be enough to cover for the fees and to buy some EMP grenades in case the eccentric raskvel isn’t in the mood for haggling. The pink, infertile merchant — Shekka if my memory’s correct — should have some robots to spare. She’ll certainly be friendlier to you than to me. I’ve got a rather bad reputation with the locals because of my sharp physique and territorial behavior,” she confesses.
rows.translation: “达尔的地狱半球啊，你说得对。[pc.name]，我还需要几台货运机器人来打包我们的物品。没有它们，我们不能离开这里。”她说着从装满替换零件的箱子里拿出一大块红色皮卡丁晶石碎片，显然是个临时聚焦透镜。“请收下这个，应该足够支付费用，再买些EMP手榴弹，以防那个古怪的拉斯克维尔人没心情讨价还价。那个粉色的不孕商人——如果我没记错，叫谢卡——应该有些机器人可以腾出来。她肯定会对你比对我友善。因为尖锐的外形和领地意识，我在当地人中的名声相当差。”她坦白道。

I’ve got a rather bad reputation with the locals because of my sharp physique and territorial behavior,” she confesses."

rows.original: through the ragged guts of The Gloaming, avoiding the exposed cables and fuming cracks spread across the derelict. You surface from it after following a dim source of light, rising about a hundred feet over the Oil Sea’s shore before gliding down to a rather unencumbered spot near the broken ship’s entrance. “Be careful out there [pc.name]. I fear that you won’t avoid a gruesome confrontation with the eccentric mechanic. You’ll find his home to the east-north-east of here, under the Nova’s shadow,” she says, looking at a green-lit amalgamation of mismatched metals.
rows.translation: 穿过薄暮号破败的内部，避开遍布废船的裸露电缆和冒烟裂缝。你们循着一处昏暗光源离开船体，升到油海岸边约一百英尺的高空，随后滑翔降落在破船入口附近一处较为空旷的地点。“在外面要小心，[pc.name]。我担心你免不了要与那个古怪的机械师展开一场惨烈对决。你会在这里的东北偏东方向，诺瓦号的阴影下找到他的住所，”她望着一团亮着绿光、由不相配的金属拼凑而成的物体说道。

rows.original: “I’ll be back,” you retort, dropping a quick kiss on her violet cheek before leaving the flustered cyborg to her devices. Let’s hope Shekka has what you need and that the turbine’s still in good shape and in this engineer’s hands.
rows.translation: “我会回来的，”你回道，在她紫色的脸颊上匆匆一吻，随后把不知所措的改造人留在原地忙自己的事。希望谢卡那里有你需要的东西，也希望涡轮机仍完好无损，并且就在这名工程师手中。
rows.raw: " “I’ll be back,” you retort, dropping a quick kiss on her violet cheek before leaving the flustered cyborg to her devices. Let’s hope Shekka has what you need and that the turbine’s still in good shape and in this engineer’s hands. "

rows.original: [var0 |“Here’s the cargobots you needed. Ready to go on an adventure?” The zaika XO tries her best to contain her glee, but there’s no way she can entirely hide the body language of her unrestrainable joy. On the other hand, her leyak friend looks more flustered and dubious about this new change of pace. “Come on you jellyball, everything will be fine. You can’t spend your entire life stranded on this oversized junkyard of a planet; think about your inspiration and fans!” The shy alien tries his best not to have a breakdown, collecting his thoughts the best he can before sighing a lone “Fine” in a crystalline voice. You take a moment to realize that you finally heard him talk, an event that manages to stun Paulette as well. “D-Dabbebieth, it’s the first time you talked to somebody that isn’t me, I’m so proud of you!” The leyak blushes so deeply his cheeks become cobalt, a peculiar sight that makes you [pc.mf |chuckle |giggle ] with your zaika friend as she begins packing her pillows, blankets, additional limbs, and books. It’s an herculean task to fit all of her scavenged stuff into the two cargobot’s guts, but with some clever management from your part and her logistics skills, you gradually store more and more of their stuff into the carriers’ bins. Once her gear and comforts bloat the load-bearing robots, she covers them with her blankets and ties them all up with her luminous, draining whip. “Alright, everything’s secured and ready to go. [pc.hasWings |How about flying together to the Nova?” S |[pc.name], would you kindly come closer and hold me tight? I’ll fly us to the Nova,” s ]he says as Dabbebieth wraps his tentacles around her neck. In the span of a minute, you emerge from the downed ship’s corpse and head toward the colonial carrier’s reinforced walls, appreciating the ramshackled planet’s raw beauty for long, pleasant minutes while a cool, invigorating breeze makes the trip all the more magical. Instead of stepping through the Nova’s innards, Paulette decides to enter it by the landing deck, causing some gabilani and raskvels to flee in fear while others end up paralyzed by the sheer shock of seeing the Ghod’Mluss’ipn up close. “I-It’s her.. the creatur-” “Hush y’all, I’m not gonna eat you! Fortunately, none of them seem brave or reckless enough to do anything stupid, be it when you cross the long hangar or when you wait for the bulkhead to open. I-I’m Paulette by the way, and here’s my friend, Dabbebieth.” Your [silly |slutpuppy |scientist ] crewmate smiles. “Nice to meet you, I’m Doctor Anno Dorna. I hope we’ll spend a lot of time together, especially if [pc.name] is involved,” she teases. “Anyway, I’ll let you claim your room and catch your breath before getting to know each other a bit more intimately.” You give Anno a gentle wave before resuming your short trip to empty quarters just waiting for the zaika’s touch | The trip to an empty part of the ship just waiting for Paulette’s touch is rather uneventful, except for the cargobots bumping a few times against the ceiling ]. Without uttering a word, you open the modular chamber’s door and invite your guests inside — instantly lighting stars in the XO’s eyes. rows.translation: [var0 |“这就是你需要的货运机器人。准备好去冒险了吗？” 这位扎伊卡大副拼命压抑自己的欣喜，却根本无法完全掩饰那份无法自制的喜悦所流露出的肢体语言。另一方面，她的莱雅克朋友对这种突如其来的生活变化显得更加局促和怀疑。“来吧，你这果冻球，一切都会好好的。你不能一辈子都被困在这颗巨大的废品场行星上；想想你的灵感和粉丝们！” 这名害羞的异星人竭尽全力不让自己崩溃，尽可能整理好思绪，最后用水晶般的声音孤零零地叹出一句“好吧”。你过了一会才意识到，自己终于听到他开口说话了，这件事同样震惊了波莱特。 “达-达贝比埃斯，这是你第一次和我以外的人说话，我真为你骄傲！” 这名莱雅克害羞得满脸深红，两颊甚至变成了钴蓝色。这幅奇特的景象让你和扎伊卡朋友一起[pc.mf |轻笑 |咯咯笑 ]了起来，而她已开始收拾自己的枕头、毛毯、额外肢体和书籍。要把她拾荒得来的全部家当塞进两台货运机器人的肚子，堪称一项赫克里士般的艰巨任务；但凭借你巧妙的统筹和她的物流才能，你们逐渐将越来越多的家当装进了运输箱。当她的装备和舒适用品将负重机器人塞得膨胀起来后，她用毛毯将它们盖住，再用那根发光的吸能鞭将所有东西牢牢捆好。 “好了，一切都已经固定好，可以出发了。[pc.hasWings |我们一起飞去诺瓦号怎么样？”她 |[pc.name]，能请你靠近一点，紧紧抱住我吗？我会带我们飞去诺瓦号，”她 ]说道，同时达贝比埃斯用触手缠住她的脖子。 你不再多言，[pc.hasWings |展开[pc.wings]，拍打着飞到离地几英尺的高度，等待朋友们出发 |用[pc.arms]环住她的腰，为即将开始的旅程做好准备 ]。紫色赛博格片刻后也展开硬光双翼，以惊人的速度推进自己，迫使你在滑翔穿过薄暮号的内脏时[pc.hasWings |加速才能跟上她 |将她抱得更紧 ]。短短一分钟内，你们就从坠毁飞船的尸骸中冲了出来，朝殖民运输舰加固过的舱壁飞去。凉爽而振奋人心的微风让这趟旅程更加如梦似幻，你也因而在悦意的漫长数分钟里，尽情欣赏这颗七拼八凑的行星那份原始的美丽。 波莱特并没有踏进诺瓦号的内部，而是决定由着陆甲板进入，这令一些加比拉尼和拉斯克维尔人惊恐逃窜，另一些则因亲眼近距离看到Ghod’Mluss’ipn而彻底震惊到僵在原地。 “是-是她..那个怪物-” “都安静，我不会吃了你们！所以告诉我，[pc.name]，你的飞船在哪里？” 你不发一言地领她走向[pc_ship.short]那熟悉的轮廓，一只手搭在[pc.weapon]上，以防当地人试图对你的朋友不利。幸好，无论是在你们穿过漫长的机库，还是等待隔舱门打开时，都没有人勇敢或鲁莽到敢做什么蠢事。三人终于踏进你家中的走廊时，都如释重负地叹了口气 — 事情比你预想的顺利多了。[anno.isCrew | “你好，老板，很高兴见到你喽喽-这位新客人是谁？我觉得自己以前见过你，但想不起来是在哪了。” [anno.isHuskar |胡斯卡 |奥萨 ]的数据板传来一声轻微的提示音，将对话打断了几秒。安诺看了眼快速弹出的消息，再将蓝眸望向前大副发光的目光。 “你就是那个害羞、热衷赛博宠物扮演的KittyKutie，对吧？” “也-也许吧。这又不是什么我会在公开场合拿来吹嘘的事，”她承认道，“我以前可能发过几张自己可爱私处的照片，还分享了出去。对-对了，我叫波莱特，这位是我的朋友达贝比埃斯。” 你那位[silly |荡狗 |科学家 ]船员微微一笑。“很高兴认识你，我是安诺·多尔纳医生。希望我们以后能经常在一起，尤其是[pc.name]也在场时，”她挑逗道。“总之，我先让你占下自己的房间，缓口气，然后我们再更亲密地了解彼此。” 你向安诺轻轻挥手，随后继续走完这段短短的路程，前往那间正等待扎伊卡亲手点缀的空舱室 |前往那片正等待波莱特亲手点缀的空舱室的旅程没有发生什么意外，只是货运机器人有几次撞上了天花板 ]。你沉默地打开模块化舱室的门，邀请客人进去 — 这立刻点亮了大副眼中的繁星。她的面罩闪烁了几下，肯定是因情绪骤然高涨而拍下了这个地方的照片。 “群星在上，这里又大又干净。我本来以为会是间小屋，这里却更像贵宾酒店套房，或者一名对等体的衣帽间！甚至还有只属于我们的独立浴室！非常感谢你，[pc.name]，谢谢你所做的一切，”她说着将你抱得极紧，竟然没有弄伤你简直是个奇迹。 紫色扎伊卡和她的莱雅克伙伴迅速收集所有家当，装进货运机器人，然后一起振展硬光双翼飞向你的飞船。无论你们一起旅行多少次，你都永远无法习惯凉风柔滑的爱抚，也永远看不腻从高空俯瞰时这颗行星的壮丽景象。 这一次，当波莱特降落在你的飞船旁边时，当地人没有陷入恐慌 — 尽管有些人仍害怕得发抖，或避免看向她，仿佛只要看一眼就会被变成石头。你缓缓打开隔舱门，邀请客人进来，带他们穿过金属走廊，一直来到你的大副伴侣原来的舱室。 她第一个踏进一尘不染的房间，虽不像第一次那么震惊，却仍满溢着喜悦。“我已经又有回家的感觉了，而且不只是我，”她说着，看了眼达贝比埃斯欢快的蹦跳。“我很高兴能回到你身边，希望我们会一起留下一些回忆。” rows.original: The Mad Raskvel’s Land Railer stands in front of you. It’s a horrible amalgamation of an oversized tank engine on huge treads, salvaged plates from the Nova, industrial tools, and a flurry of different weapons all ready to tear you to pieces. It’s so big it wouldn’t surprise you if it were the crazy engineer’s entire lab stitched together into a chariot of death and destruction, an unstoppable battletank of fire and fury. You can spot three weak, exposed spots: the fuming V69 powering it, a large array of targeting sensors, and the many tank treads lining this parody of a train. “I DON’T CARE WHO YOU ARE, FEEL THE MIGHT OF THE LAND RAILER!”
rows.translation: 疯狂拉斯克维尔的陆行碾压者矗立在你面前。那是一台可怕的混合怪物：装在巨型履带上的超大坦克发动机、从诺瓦号回收的装甲板、工业工具，以及一大堆随时准备把你撕成碎片的各式武器。它庞大得惊人，就算有人告诉你，这是那个疯狂工程师把整座实验室缝合成了一辆散播死亡与毁灭的战车，一台势不可挡、裹挟烈火与怒涛的主战坦克，你也不会感到意外。你能看到三个脆弱而暴露的部位：为它提供动力、不断冒烟的V69发动机，一大片瞄准传感器，以及排列在这列火车仿制品上的众多坦克履带。 “我不管你是谁，感受陆行碾压者的威力吧！”

rows.original: The roaring battle tank’s engine starts leaking fuel and acrid smoke after your last hit, a concerning signal as the machine’s pistons, timing belts, and camshafts go haywire. Strident hisses fill Tarkus’s hills while the searchlights and laser sights flicker in the wake of the hellish machine’s last breaths. “EVERYTHING’S IN THE RED! THAT’S NOT GOOD!” The mad engineer shouts through the loudspeakers a second before the metallic plates turn from red to yellow-orange to painfully-bright white. It’s about to explode! Scouring your surroundings, you notice a piece of the Nova half-buried in the sands; the tungsten alloy should be dense enough to withstand the piping hot shards and the explosion’s blast. You barely have the time to [pc.isNaga |slither |run ] behind the broken shielding and to duck under its hardest spot before a deafening wail and burning gusts turn the world into an infernal trap. Your entire body rumbles with the ground and the warm, ablative shell covering you the best it can. The firestorm lasts for long seconds that feel like hours to you; hours of demonic screams and unsustainable heat you have no other choice than to withstand or die. Once the wildfire stops, you notice just how close one of the blasted saws was to cutting you in half — if you stood but a few more steps to your right, the broken tool would have split you in two after piercing one of your cover’s weak spots. Still on your guard, you leave your shelter and contemplate the devastation.

rows.original: The huge, towering tank engine’s a melted mess of twisted metal, its weapons ravaged by the explosion and its treads in no state to roll ever again. The cursed machine’s driver is nowhere to be seen, a bit like most of the war machine’s parts. Fortunately, a quick scan of what remains of the V69’s guts with your codex confirms to you that the Ultra Dense Degenerate Matter Turbine survived the cataclysm — the only problem will be moving it out of the smoldering wreckage. It takes you a couple minutes of investigation to find a surviving toolbox and a powerless antigrav-loader; they might not be perfect but it’s your best chance to recover what you were looking for. [pc.cl engineer |Even with your advanced skills |Handling big machines isn’t your cup of tea ], it takes you an hour to repair the load-bearer and remove the bolts securing the turbine to the broken train. The transporter yields a bit under the sheer weight of the stabilizing device, but it holds on against all odds and asks for your input to know where it must deliver the payload. You enter the coordinates of Paulette’s lair and the automated machine surges on hardlight legs towards the south-west, antigrav motors humming with power. Your XO friend’s going to have a pleasant surprise. (Key Item Distributed to Paulette: Ultra Dense Degenerate Matter Turbine)

rows.original: [var0 |You load the program and smile as you are shuffled to an artificial reality on a current of perfectly programmed electrons. You find yourself back in time, on your way to recover the device to fix the Gloaming’s unstable reactor. ]An eccentric mass of ramshackled plates, automated weapons, searchlights, and sensor suites rolls under the great ship’s shadow. This is it: the mad mechanic’s lab (tank?) and housing for the Ultra Dense Degenerate Matter Turbine. Even from hundreds of feet away, it looms high and imposing. Green lights scour the terrain under the Nova’s shadow while roars of machinery become louder and louder the closer you get to it — and not just because of the proximity. Step by step you approach the humongous lab, going from a pile of scraps to another in the hope to sneak in and avoid the worst of the automated defense systems. The building seems to shake and rumble from afar, as if a powerful, ill-secured motor rocks its frame from the inside. To make things worse, you notice lots of oil tanks lining it, but you don’t spot any generator that’d use it — why would someone gather so many resources here without exploiting them? Something’s stirring inside this mess, something bad. Before you can get closer, a strident, draconic hiss fills the plains and dozens of hidden exhausts spew dark, fiery fumes followed by an earth-quaking force rumbling everything around you. Large, heavy treads and a huge engine surface from under the ground, swallowing the building in a towering mix of a mega engine and a battle tank lined with circular saws, flamethrowers, guns, energy weapons, missile pods, and even an industrial grinder in front of this gruesome abomination of smoldering metal. An oversized, snarling imitation of a raskvel’s head looms over you: a burlesque figurehead that reinforces the war machine’s macabre look even further. Before you can process what’s going on, the loud, booming wail of loudspeakers assault your [pc.ears] with a mad laughter that leaves no doubt about the sanity of its owner. “GYYAAAAAHAHA! THEY TOLD ME I WOULD NEVER MAKE MY V69 ENGINE WORK! WHO’S THE MAD, DELUSIONAL RASKVEL NOW?!” You consider retreating to get a better chance against this spiked mastodon but the green searchlights find you way too soon for that. “WHAT HAVE WE HERE?! AN INTERLOPER? A NE’ER-DO-WELL?! OR WORST, AN ALIEN?! Oh wait, my flan’s ready.” The loudspeakers shut off for some time as the booming engine roars and a dozen of targeting sights lock on you. “Yeeees, it’s so [silly |finger-licking |fucking ] good. Anyway, what was I doing again? Oh yeah I remember. YOU KNOW WHAT I CAN’T STAND? ANYTHING THAT ISN’T A RASKVEL! YOU NASTY, [pc.hasFur |FURRY GOONS |[pc.hasScales |SCALY TRAITORS |MANIACS ] ] HAVE HAD ENOUGH FUN! YOU’LL SUBMIT OR BE CHAINED FOREVER TO MY MACHINE’S DEGENERATE REACTOR, SENTENCED TO FUEL MY LAND RAILER WITH YOUR ORGASMIC POWER! GYYAAAAAAAHAHA!” The mad lad’s machine wails as its treads come to life and autoloaders feed ammunition to the many deadly weapons lining the growling behemoth. The V69 engine screams like a thousand ancient tank engines as it powers the hundreds of motors and turbines fueling this gargantuan war machine’s “legs”, “ears”, and “eyes”, vicious organs all set to rid the galaxy of your presence — or alternatively, break you into nothing but a moaning piston in this mastodon of madness. Nothing’s gonna stop it; he’s too far gone to be reasoned with and clearly not in the mood for parley. If you want to live, you must take him and his hellish machine down by any means necessary.
rows.translation: [var0 |你载入程序，微笑着任由完美编程的电子洪流将你送入人造现实。你发现自己又回到了过去，正在前往取回用于修复薄暮号不稳定反应堆的设备。 ]一团由东拼西凑的装甲板、自动武器、探照灯和传感器阵列构成的怪异庞然大物，正在巨舰的阴影下滚动。就是这里：那个疯狂机械师的实验室（坦克？），也是超高密度简并态物质涡轮机的容身之所。即使相隔数百英尺，它依然高高耸立，威势骇人。绿色灯光扫过新星号阴影下的地面，而随着你逐渐靠近，机械的轰鸣声也越来越大——而且并不只是因为距离缩短。你一步步逼近那座巨大实验室，从一堆废料转移到另一堆，希望能潜入其中，避开自动防御系统最猛烈的火力。 远远看去，这座建筑似乎正在颤抖轰鸣，仿佛一台功率强大却固定不牢的马达，正从内部摇晃着它的框架。更糟的是，你注意到建筑周围排列着许多油罐，却找不到任何会使用它们的发电机——为什么会有人把这么多资源堆积在这里，却不加以利用？这团乱七八糟的东西里有什么正在蠢蠢欲动，而且绝非善类。 你还没来得及继续靠近，一声尖锐的龙吼便响彻平原，数十个隐藏的排气口喷出漆黑燃烧的烟雾，紧接着一股震天撼地的力量将你周围的一切震得轰鸣不止。宽大沉重的履带和一台巨型引擎从地底升起，吞没整座建筑，将它变成一座摩天巨型引擎与战斗坦克的混合体。这具燃烧金属构成的骇人怪物，周身装满圆锯、喷火器、枪械、能量武器和导弹舱，前方甚至还有一台工业粉碎机。一颗巨大得过分、龇牙咧嘴的拉斯克维尔仿制头颅高悬在你上方：这个滑稽的船首像，让这台战争机器显得更加阴森恐怖。你还未理清眼前究竟发生了什么，扩音器震耳欲聋的咆哮就带着疯狂笑声轰击你的[pc.ears]，丝毫不给你怀疑它主人精神状态的余地。 “呀啊啊啊哈哈！他们都说我永远不可能让V69引擎正常工作！现在到底谁才是那个疯狂妄想的拉斯克维尔？！” 你想先撤退，为对付这头长满尖刺的乳齿象寻找更好的机会，但绿色探照灯太快就发现了你。 “这是什么东西？！入侵者？恶棍？！还是更糟，外星人？！哦，等等，我的布丁好了。” 扩音器沉默了一阵，只剩巨型引擎轰鸣咆哮，以及十几道瞄准线锁定你。“对对对，它真是好吃到[silly |让人舔手指 |他妈的 ]。话说回来，我刚才在干什么？哦对，我想起来了。知道我最无法忍受什么吗？任何不是拉斯克维尔的东西！你们这些恶心的[pc.hasFur |毛茸茸的恶棍 |[pc.hasScales |长鳞的叛徒 |疯子 ] ]已经玩得够久了！你要么屈服，要么就永远被锁在我这台机器的简并态反应堆上，判处用你高潮的力量为我的陆行碾压者提供能量！呀啊啊啊啊哈哈！” 那个疯子的机器尖声长啸，履带开始转动，自动装弹机将弹药送入排列在这头咆哮巨兽周身的众多致命武器。V69引擎像一千台古老坦克引擎那样尖啸，驱动着为这台巨型战争机器的“双腿”、“耳朵”和“眼睛”提供动力的数百台马达与涡轮机。这些凶残的器官全部准备就绪，要把你从银河系中彻底抹除——或者换一个选择，把你摧残成这头疯狂乳齿象中一根只会呻吟的活塞。什么都阻止不了它；他已经疯得无法讲理，而且显然也没有谈判的心情。如果你想活下去，就必须不惜一切代价干掉他和那台地狱般的机器。
rows.raw: " [var0 |You load the program and smile as you are shuffled to an artificial reality on a current of perfectly programmed electrons. You find yourself back in time, on your way to recover the device to fix the Gloaming’s unstable reactor. ]An eccentric mass of ramshackled plates, automated weapons, searchlights, and sensor suites rolls under the great ship’s shadow. This is it: the mad mechanic’s lab (tank?) and housing for the Ultra Dense Degenerate Matter Turbine. Even from hundreds of feet away, it looms high and imposing. Green lights scour the terrain under the Nova’s shadow while roars of machinery become louder and louder the closer you get to it — and not just because of the proximity. Step by step you approach the humongous lab, going from a pile of scraps to another in the hope to sneak in and avoid the worst of the automated defense systems. The building seems to shake and rumble from afar, as if a powerful, ill-secured motor rocks its frame from the inside. To make things worse, you notice lots of oil tanks lining it, but you don’t spot any generator that’d use it — why would someone gather so many resources here without exploiting them? Something’s stirring inside this mess, something bad. Before you can get closer, a strident, draconic hiss fills the plains and dozens of hidden exhausts spew dark, fiery fumes followed by an earth-quaking force rumbling everything around you. Large, heavy treads and a huge engine surface from under the ground, swallowing the building in a towering mix of a mega engine and a battle tank lined with circular saws, flamethrowers, guns, energy weapons, missile pods, and even an industrial grinder in front of this gruesome abomination of smoldering metal. An oversized, snarling imitation of a raskvel’s head looms over you: a burlesque figurehead that reinforces the war machine’s macabre look even further. Before you can process what’s going on, the loud, booming wail of loudspeakers assault your [pc.ears] with a mad laughter that leaves no doubt about the sanity of its owner. “GYYAAAAAHAHA! THEY TOLD ME I WOULD NEVER MAKE MY V69 ENGINE WORK! WHO’S THE MAD, DELUSIONAL RASKVEL NOW?!” You consider retreating to get a better chance against this spiked mastodon but the green searchlights find you way too soon for that. “WHAT HAVE WE HERE?! AN INTERLOPER? A NE’ER-DO-WELL?! OR WORST, AN ALIEN?! Oh wait, my flan’s ready.” The loudspeakers shut off for some time as the booming engine roars and a dozen of targeting sights lock on you. “Yeeees, it’s so [silly |finger-licking |fucking ] good. Anyway, what was I doing again? Oh yeah I remember. YOU KNOW WHAT I CAN’T STAND? ANYTHING THAT ISN’T A RASKVEL! YOU NASTY, [pc.hasFur |FURRY GOONS |[pc.hasScales |SCALY TRAITORS |MANIACS ] ] HAVE HAD ENOUGH FUN! YOU’LL SUBMIT OR BE CHAINED FOREVER TO MY MACHINE’S DEGENERATE REACTOR, SENTENCED TO FUEL MY LAND RAILER WITH YOUR ORGASMIC POWER! GYYAAAAAAAHAHA!” The mad lad’s machine wails as its treads come to life and autoloaders feed ammunition to the many deadly weapons lining the growling behemoth. The V69 engine screams like a thousand ancient tank engines as it powers the hundreds of motors and turbines fueling this gargantuan war machine’s “legs”, “ears”, and “eyes”, vicious organs all set to rid the galaxy of your presence — or alternatively, break you into nothing but a moaning piston in this mastodon of madness. Nothing’s gonna stop it; he’s too far gone to be reasoned with and clearly not in the mood for parley. If you want to live, you must take him and his hellish machine down by any means necessary. "

rows.original: You decide to check on your XO friend. The trek to her lair’s louder than usual: dozens of mechanical clinks resonate through the ship’s steel guts as you approach the plasma core’s room: certainly Paulette fitting the Ultra Dense Degenerate Matter Turbine onto it. A loud, hissing groan of systems powering up assaults your [pc.ears] just before you can reach the room’s entrance. You barely have the time to rush toward the oil-stained XO before the ghostly whine stops, followed by a bright flash coming from the huge, plasma ball dancing behind the reactor’s containment shell. “Thank the stars you’re here. I didn’t see you arrive with the power loader and the turbine so I expected the worst,” the cyborg confesses, trapping you in a tight hug. You can’t fail to notice the tears running down her glowing eyes; she was sincerely worried for your sake — or maybe she’s got something in her eyes, that’s what the strong ones say to keep a stern facade. “[pc.kmhbb |The raskvel engineer was a tough one, but in the end he didn’t stand a chance against me |I tried to swap his turbine for a toaster, but the raskvel mechanic saw my charade. rows.original: By this point, you come back to this location not by chance but because you recognize the features of the land. Despite that... small mistake, the suits you found were clearly made with impressive skill. While probably – likely – definitely mad, you can’t deny he’s also a genius. So it’s no surprise that curiosity brought you here once more, to see if you can find any new inventions he left for you. What could he possibly have created since? Disappointingly, the familiar crater seems to be empty. You are quite certain this is the same area you found the two suits in, the one that had been smoking and full of strange half-finished inventions, then swiftly got scavenged until nothing was left. You look around, but all you can spot are a few rusted shards of metals here, some new-looking ones there... New? Hold on now, how could there be anything new here when even now the locals seem to be giving the area a wide berth? You approach that shine you spotted and find your earlier observation was correct. You’d say this was the result of someone dragging a broken, jagged piece of metal – if this wasn’t clearly intentional. This could not have been more obviously a crumb trail left out to guide you. You follow carefully, walking along the wilds of Tarkus until you reach a small cave. Well, cave may be a generous term, it’s mostly a big hole at the bottom of a small mound. rows.original: You’re greeted by a sudden chorus of cheers. You recoil, until you see that you’re surrounded by Sgt. Decker’s S.W.A.T. team, all clustering around you. The sergeant himself steps forward, chomping on his cigar over a great big grin. “We just got the word from Command: they saw everything. Great work, kid!”
rows.translation: 突然爆发的欢呼声迎接了你。你下意识后退，随后才发现自己已被德克尔中士的特警队包围，所有人都簇拥在你身边。中士本人走上前来，咬着雪茄露出灿烂笑容。“我们刚收到指挥部消息：他们看见了一切。干得漂亮，孩子！”
