The sergeant himself steps forward, chomping on his cigar over a great big grin. “We just got the word from Command: they saw everything. Great work, kid!”"

rows.original: Several officers shake your hand or clap you on the back as you try and make your way out of the lift. As they do, several of them peel off from the main group, heading into the personnel lift to go and make the official arrests on the pirates you defeated. Speaking of which: just ahead, you can see the crazed cat-girl, Tam, being led out of the ground-side station in cuffs, struggling against a pair of burly officers and crying out for her wolf drone.
rows.translation: 你试图离开升降机时，几名警官同你握手或拍打你的后背。与此同时，其中一些人脱离大队，进入人员升降机，准备正式逮捕被你击败的海盗。说到这里：就在前方，你看见那个疯狂猫女塔姆戴着手铐被押出地面站。她奋力反抗两名魁梧警官，高喊自己那台狼形无人机。
rows.raw: "\n\nSeveral officers shake your hand or clap you on the back as you try and make your way out of the lift. As they do, several of them peel off from the main group, heading into the personnel lift to go and make the official arrests on the pirates you defeated. Speaking of which: just ahead, you can see the crazed cat-girl, Tam, being led out of the ground-side station in cuffs, struggling against a pair of burly officers and crying out for her wolf drone."

rows.original: As you make your way out of the gathering of officers, Sgt. Decker falls in beside you, billowing smoke like a chimney. “You did good, kid. Your old man would have been proud. Listen, you go back to the Nova, rest up. We’ll handle things from here, make sure the place is secured. With luck, whatever passes for a government here will be looking to the U.G.C. for help, now. Might even be willing to join the ConFed now. That’ll make the brass hard as diamonds. Wish I had a way to reward you, kid. Though I bet you found something worthwhile down there, huh?”
rows.translation: 你离开聚集的警官时，德克尔中士走到你身旁，像烟囱般吞云吐雾。“干得不错，孩子。你老爸会为你骄傲的。听着，回到诺瓦号上休息吧。接下来交给我们，确保这里安全。运气好的话，这里那个勉强算政府的组织如今会向U.G.C.求援，说不定还愿意加入邦联。那些大人物肯定会兴奋得硬如钻石。真希望我有办法奖励你，孩子。不过我猜你在下面找到了值得带走的东西，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you make your way out of the gathering of officers, Sgt. Decker falls in beside you, billowing smoke like a chimney. “You did good, kid. Your old man would have been proud. rows.original: “Look, kid, see that station up ahead?” he says, pointing to Tether station. “There’s a shitload of pirates in there threatening to crack the planet back in half, finish what the goblins and kobo- er, gabilani and raskvel started ages ago. Why don’t you head back to Nova and get the hell out of here before you get sucked into space with the rest of us, huh?”
rows.translation: “听着，孩子，看见前面那座站点了吗？”他指向系留站说道。“里面有一大群海盗，威胁要把这颗星球再次劈成两半，完成哥布林和狗头——呃，加比拉尼人与拉斯克维尔人在很久以前开始的事。你何不回到诺瓦号上，赶紧离开这里，免得和我们一起被吸进太空，嗯？”

Why don’t you head back to Nova and get the hell out of here before you get sucked into space with the rest of us, huh?”"

Several of the troops standing around give you respectful nods as you step into one of the APCs. At a touch from the sergeant, a holo-map of the facility and the Chasm appear between you.
rows.translation: 德克尔中士有力地与你握手，那股力量几乎捏碎你的手。年纪这么大还真强壮！你走进一辆装甲运兵车时，周围几名士兵尊敬地点头。中士轻触一下，设施与裂谷的全息地图便浮现在你们之间。
rows.raw: "\n\nSgt. Decker gives you a firm handshake, his grip just about crushing your hand. Strong in his old age! Several of the troops standing around give you respectful nods as you step into one of the APCs. At a touch from the sergeant, a holo-map of the facility and the Chasm appear between you."

rows.original: “Here’s the situation: a group of pirates, a splinter group from the Black Void near as we can tell, have taken up residence inside the Tether station here. I don’t know what their game is -- they haven’t made any demands, except that we keep clear. What they DO have is a bomb, and a big one: Command’s got radiological alarms going off like you wouldn’t believe. Worse, they’ve locked down the cargo lift that goes down to the station at the planetary core, and are threatening to blow the place if we try and go down. I’ve got twenty good SWAT troopers out here sitting on their asses, and there’s not a lot we can do about it. We’ve got orders to sit tight, straight from the top.”
rows.translation: “情况是这样：一群海盗——据我们所知，是黑色虚空的分裂派系——占据了这里的系留站。我不知道他们图什么；除了要求我们离远点，他们什么条件都没提。但他们确实有一枚炸弹，而且非常大：指挥部的放射警报响得你难以想象。更糟的是，他们封锁了通往行星核心站的货运升降机，并威胁我们若试图下去，就把那里炸掉。我手下二十名优秀特警只能坐在这里干等，我们对此无能为力。上头直接下令，要求我们按兵不动。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Here’s the situation: a group of pirates, a splinter group from the Black Void near as we can tell, have taken up residence inside the Tether station here. I don’t know what their game is -- they haven’t made any demands, except that we keep clear. What they DO have is a bomb, and a big one: Command’s got radiological alarms going off like you wouldn’t believe. Worse, they’ve locked down the cargo lift that goes down to the station at the planetary core, and are threatening to blow the place if we try and go down. I’ve got twenty good SWAT troopers out here sitting on their asses, and there’s not a lot we can do about it. We’ve got orders to sit tight, straight from the top.”"

rows.original: “A lone operator, though... well, I don’t think me or my troops here would say anything if Steele Jr. here wandered up to the lift control station, here on the rift edge,” he says, pointing toward the building ahead. “There’s a pirate in there keeping watch. Bunch of gun turrets and drones set up inside, like she repurposed the station’s auto-defenses against us. Fight or sneak your way to the control center, override the lift controls, and you’ve got a straight shot into the core. Pirates’ll never know what hit ‘em.”
rows.translation: “不过，要是有个单独行动的人...嗯，如果小斯蒂尔碰巧走到裂谷边缘的升降机控制站，我和手下大概都不会说什么，”他指着前方建筑说道。“那里有个海盗负责监视。她在里面布置了一堆炮塔和无人机，似乎把站点自动防御系统改造成了对付我们的武器。一路打进去或潜行到控制中心，解除升降机控制，你就能直达核心。海盗绝不会知道是谁袭击了他们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A lone operator, though... well, I don’t think me or my troops here would say anything if Steele Jr. here wandered up to the lift control station, here on the rift edge,” he says, pointing toward the building ahead. “There’s a pirate in there keeping watch. Bunch of gun turrets and drones set up inside, like she repurposed the station’s auto-defenses against us. Fight or sneak your way to the control center, override the lift controls, and you’ve got a straight shot into the core. Pirates’ll never know what hit ‘em.”"

rows.original: Before you can say a word, the remaining turrets -- what few are left -- open up, forcing you to dive into cover as the cat-girl retreats into the back room, dragging her attack drone and cursing up a storm at you. A few well-placed swings take out the last of the turrets, leaving you standing in the room amid a decimated army of drones and gun-turrets and a sea of shell casings. Your ears are ringing, but at least you’re alive....
rows.translation: 你还没来得及开口，剩余炮塔——仅存的那几座——便同时开火，迫使你扑进掩体。猫女拖着攻击无人机退入后室，一路对你破口大骂。几次精准挥击摧毁最后的炮塔，留下你站在房间里，周围尽是被摧毁的无人机与枪炮塔大军，还有满地弹壳。你的耳朵嗡嗡作响，但至少还活着....

rows.original: Tam grins, and from her backpack, draws a leash and collar -- clearly meant for Tam-wolf, now yours. She slips it around your neck and, satisfied you’re under her dominion, holsters her pistol. Wrapping the leash firmly around her hand, she gives you a simple, “Come on!” and starts walking toward the door, clearly content to let her turrets do the defending for the moment. You gulp but, with Tam-wolf at your heels growling, submit to your new mistress’s will. What awaits you among the pirates...?
rows.translation: 塔姆咧嘴一笑，从背包里拿出一副牵绳和项圈——显然原本是给塔姆狼准备的，现在却归你了。她把项圈套上你的脖子，确认你已受她支配后，便收起手枪。她把牵绳牢牢缠在手上，只说了一句“走吧！”便朝门口走去，显然眼下很乐意让炮塔负责防卫。你咽了口唾沫，可塔姆狼跟在脚后低吼，你只得屈从新女主人的意志。海盗群中又有什么在等着你呢...?

rows.original: Today is special -- you have a present coming for you, Mistress said. Goody! You try to focus on that, rather than how hungry you are... the smell of your warm meal getting cold in the bowl in Mistress’s hands as she takes the big red plastic “COLLECTION” back to her quarters for breakfast. The scent of your creamy meal is heavenly, nearly driving you wild with anticipation as you follow Mistress into her quarters, and hear the comforting pneumatic hiss of her door sealing shut. You pad up to Mistress, putting one of your stumpy “limbs” up on her leg in a motion of begging, making a little whimper sound -- you’re so hungry, and breakfast smells so good!
rows.translation: 今天很特别——女主人说，你会收到一份礼物。太棒了！你努力想着这件事，好忽略腹中的饥饿...女主人手里那碗温热食物逐渐变凉的气味，伴随她把红色大塑料“收集桶”带回住处当早餐。浓稠餐点的香味宛如天堂，期待几乎令你发狂。你跟着女主人进入住处，听见房门气动密封时令人安心的嘶响。你用脚掌爬到女主人面前，把一根短粗的“肢体”搭在她腿上，摆出乞求姿势，发出细小的呜咽——你好饿，早餐闻起来又是那么香！

rows.raw: " Taking Tam-wolf would let you replace your shock-slinging default drone with a bitey attack drone by equipping it as an accessory."

rows.original: If only you had the expertise and experience to work with drones, you could probably get Tam-wolf up to peak form -- as is, he’s still pretty damaged, and might be unreliable.
rows.translation: 要是你具备操作无人机的专业知识与经验，或许能让塔姆狼恢复到最佳状态——可照现在这样，它仍损坏严重，可能并不可靠。
rows.raw: " If only you had the expertise and experience to work with drones, you could probably get Tam-wolf up to peak form -- as is, he’s still pretty damaged, and might be unreliable."

rows.original: Take him?
rows.translation: 带走它吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nTake him?"

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Tam-wolf
rows.translation: 塔姆狼
rows.raw: "Tam-wolf"

rows.original: Nah. You’d hate to deprive the crazy cat-girl of her pet pooch, anyway. She’d be heartbroken!
rows.translation: 算了。反正你也不想让那个疯狂猫女失去自己的宠物狗。她会伤心欲绝的！
rows.raw: "Nah. You’d hate to deprive the crazy cat-girl of her pet pooch, anyway. She’d be heartbroken!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: Pass up the chance to take this fascinating accessory. Tamtam seems to care about it quite a lot.
rows.translation: 放弃带走这件迷人饰品的机会。塔姆塔姆似乎非常在乎它。
rows.raw: "Pass up the chance to take this fascinating accessory. Tamtam seems to care about it quite a lot."

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Tam-wolf
rows.translation: 塔姆狼
rows.raw: "Tam-wolf"

rows.original: Attack Drone
rows.raw: "Attack Drone"

rows.original: You pull a cord from your codex to the datajack in the back of Tam-wolf canid head and upload a basic clear and reformat program. Then it’s a simple matter of uploading your normal drone’s command and control programs to Tam-wolf and fixing that borked leg of his: just a few minutes’ work, really, now that you can concentrate. Pretty soon, he’s good as new! You pick up the hefty cyber-doberman and set it on the ground before flicking the on button hidden under his hind leg. With a synthesized bark, the attack drone comes to life.
rows.translation: 你从法典接出一根线，连上塔姆狼犬形脑袋后方的数据插口，上传基础清除与格式化程序。接下来只要把普通无人机的指挥控制程序上传进塔姆狼，再修好它那条坏腿即可：现在你能专心工作，真的只需几分钟。没过多久，它便焕然一新！你抱起沉重的赛博杜宾犬放到地上，拨动藏在后腿下方的开关。伴随着一声合成犬吠，这台攻击无人机苏醒过来。
rows.raw: "You pull a cord from your codex to the datajack in the back of Tam-wolf canid head and upload a basic clear and reformat program. Then it’s a simple matter of uploading your normal drone’s command and control programs to Tam-wolf and fixing that borked leg of his: just a few minutes’ work, really, now that you can concentrate. Pretty soon, he’s good as new! You pick up the hefty cyber-doberman and set it on the ground before flicking the on button hidden under his hind leg. With a synthesized bark, the attack drone comes to life."

rows.original: The wolf-drone shudders, then its tail starts wagging rhythmically as it turns to face you. Its booming, synthesized voice announces, <i>“Grrrreetings
rows.translation: 狼形无人机颤动了一下，随后尾巴开始有节奏地摇摆，转身面对你。它用洪亮的合成音宣布：<i>“您——好，
rows.raw: "\n\nThe wolf-drone shudders, then its tail starts wagging rhythmically as it turns to face you. Its booming, synthesized voice announces, <i>“Grrrreetings "

rows.original: Master
rows.translation: 主人
rows.raw: "Master"

rows.original: Mistress
rows.translation: 女主人
rows.raw: "Mistress"

rows.original: . This unit is programmed to be your faithful protector. What is your command?”
rows.translation: 。本机的程序设定是成为您忠实的保护者。请下达命令？”
rows.raw: ". This unit is programmed to be your faithful protector. What is your command?”"

rows.original: “Uh... sit?” Tam-wolf sits obediently, tail still wagging.
rows.translation: “呃...坐下？” 塔姆狼顺从地坐下，尾巴仍在摇摆。
rows.raw: " “Uh... sit?” Tam-wolf sits obediently, tail still wagging."

rows.original: “Uh... who’s a good robo-attack-drone?” Tam-wolf ponders the question a moment. “I am?” “Good boy! Yes you are!” Tam-wolf barks appreciatively.
rows.translation: “呃...谁是最棒的机器攻击无人机？” 塔姆狼思考片刻。“是我？” “好孩子！没错，就是你！” 塔姆狼高兴地叫了一声。
rows.raw: " “Uh... who’s a good robo-attack-drone?” Tam-wolf ponders the question a moment. “I am?” “Good boy! Yes you are!” Tam-wolf barks appreciatively."

rows.original: “Uh... play dead!” Tam-wolf obediently rolls onto his back and is completely still.
rows.translation: “呃...装死！” 塔姆狼顺从地翻身仰躺，纹丝不动。
rows.raw: " “Uh... play dead!” Tam-wolf obediently rolls onto his back and is completely still."

rows.original: “Alright, come on, boy!” You say, stepping back from the work bench -- quickly followed by your loyal new friend.
rows.translation: “好了，跟上，孩子！”你一边说一边从工作台旁退开——忠诚的新朋友立刻紧随在后。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, come on, boy!” You say, stepping back from the work bench -- quickly followed by your loyal new friend."

rows.original: Well, you’re not a drone expert, but... how hard could it be? You pull a cord from your codex to an exposed datajack on the back of Tam-wolf’s canid cranium, and quickly find your screen flooded with seemingly random messages and diagnostics.
rows.translation: 好吧，你不是无人机专家，不过...这能有多难？你从法典接出一根线，连上塔姆狼犬科头颅后方裸露的数据插口，屏幕很快便被看似随机的消息与诊断信息淹没。
rows.raw: "Well, you’re not a drone expert, but... how hard could it be? You pull a cord from your codex to an exposed datajack on the back of Tam-wolf’s canid cranium, and quickly find your screen flooded with seemingly random messages and diagnostics."

rows.original: Shit. You can’t make heads or tails of this! With a frustrated grunt, you yank the cord out of the useless canine drone and step back from the bench.
rows.translation: 该死。这些东西你完全看不懂！你懊恼地哼了一声，从这台没用的犬形无人机上拔掉连线，退离工作台。
rows.raw: "\n\nShit. You can’t make heads or tails of this! With a frustrated grunt, you yank the cord out of the useless canine drone and step back from the bench."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Eventually, with quite a bit of effort, you’re able to clear out the various diagnostics and find your way to what looks like a Factory Reset button, which should clear out all of the cat-girl’s modifications... and make the drone not attack you, hopefully. You key it, and pull your codex out once it’s completed. With that done, you search around for an “on” button. You find... something switch-like between the robo-mutt’s legs, flip it, and plant the drone on the ground.
rows.translation: 经过一番颇费力气的操作，你终于清除了各种诊断信息，找到一个看似恢复出厂设置的按钮；它应该会清除猫女所做的一切改装...并让无人机别再攻击你，希望如此。你按下按钮，等操作完成后拔出法典。接着你四处寻找“开机”按钮，在机器狗双腿之间找到了...某个像开关的东西，将其拨动后把无人机放在地上。
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually, with quite a bit of effort, you’re able to clear out the various diagnostics and find your way to what looks like a Factory Reset button, which should clear out all of the cat-girl’s modifications... and make the drone not attack you, hopefully. You key it, and pull your codex out once it’s completed. With that done, you search around for an “on” button. You find... something switch-like between the robo-mutt’s legs, flip it, and plant the drone on the ground."

rows.original: It shudders to life, nearly falling over on its damaged leg. With some effort, the drone turns around to face you, its synthetic voice booming, “Grrrrreetings, [pc.Master]. This-this-this unit is programmed to be-be-be your faithful prooooooooooooootector. What is your c-c-command?”
rows.translation: 它颤抖着启动了，受伤的腿让它险些摔倒。无人机费力转身面对你，用洪亮的合成音说道：“您——您——您好，[pc.Master]。本——本——本机的程序设定是成——成——成为您忠诚的保————————护者。请下——下——下达命令？”
rows.raw: "\n\nIt shudders to life, nearly falling over on its damaged leg. With some effort, the drone turns around to face you, its synthetic voice booming, “Grrrrreetings, [pc.Master]. This-this-this unit is programmed to be-be-be your faithful prooooooooooooootector. What is your c-c-command?”"

rows.original: Uh oh, looks like that damage was worse than you thought. You try and think up a command to give it, just to test:
rows.translation: 糟糕，看来损坏比你预想的更严重。你想了条命令来测试它：
rows.raw: "\n\nUh oh, looks like that damage was worse than you thought. You try and think up a command to give it, just to test:"

rows.original: Tam-wolf rolls over onto his side and barks.
rows.translation: 塔姆狼翻倒在一侧，叫了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nTam-wolf rolls over onto his side and barks."

rows.original: “Arth! Arth Arth!”
rows.raw: " “Arth! Arth Arth!”"

rows.original: Close enough.
rows.translation: 差不多吧。
rows.raw: " Close enough."

rows.original: “Uh... who’s a good robo-attack-drone?” Tam-wolf ponders the question a moment. “I am?” “Good boy! Yes you are!” Tam-wolf barks appreciatively.
rows.translation: “呃...谁是最棒的机器攻击无人机？” 塔姆狼思考片刻。“是我？” “好孩子！没错，就是你！” 塔姆狼高兴地叫了一声。
rows.raw: " “Uh... who’s a good robo-attack-drone?” Tam-wolf ponders the question a moment. “I am?” “Good boy! Yes you are!” Tam-wolf barks appreciatively."

rows.original: “Uh... play dead!” That doesn’t take much effort. Tam-wolf’s bum leg slides out from under him, and he promptly collapses in a heap.
rows.translation: “呃...装死！” 这根本不费什么力。塔姆狼的坏腿从身下滑开，它立刻瘫成一团。
rows.raw: " “Uh... play dead!” That doesn’t take much effort. Tam-wolf’s bum leg slides out from under him, and he promptly collapses in a heap."

rows.original: “Alright, come on, boy!” You say, stepping back from the work bench -- eventually followed by your loyal, if barely-functional, new friend.
rows.translation: “好了，跟上，孩子！”你一边说一边从工作台旁退开——过了一会儿，忠诚却几乎无法正常运作的新朋友才跟了上来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, come on, boy!” You say, stepping back from the work bench -- eventually followed by your loyal, if barely-functional, new friend."

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: Take the fascinating canine accessory for yourself.
rows.translation: 把这件迷人的犬形饰品据为己有。
rows.raw: "Take the fascinating canine accessory for yourself."

rows.original: INGNAM.TARKUS TETHER.354
rows.raw: "INGNAM.TARKUS TETHER.354"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: ROCKET_PODS
rows.raw: "ROCKET_PODS"

rows.original: Rocket Pods
rows.translation: 火箭发射舱
rows.raw: "Rocket Pods"

rows.original: Stepping out of what remains of the lift
rows.translation: 走出升降机仅存的残骸
rows.raw: "Stepping out of what remains of the lift"

rows.original: , you come to face a long, narrow walkway perched precariously between the rocky outcropping at the base of the lift and the titanic tether station hanging between the two halves of the planet. Ahead, between you and the station, you catch a glimpse of several turrets set up along the walkway and the roof of the station, all aimed at you.
rows.translation: ，你来到一条狭长通道前；它危险地架在升降机底部的岩石突起与悬于行星两半之间的巨大系留站之间。前方，在你和站点之间，通道沿线及站点屋顶上设置着好几座炮塔，全都瞄准了你。
rows.raw: ", you come to face a long, narrow walkway perched precariously between the rocky outcropping at the base of the lift and the titanic tether station hanging between the two halves of the planet. Ahead, between you and the station, you catch a glimpse of several turrets set up along the walkway and the roof of the station, all aimed at you."

rows.original: Oh, shit.
rows.translation: 哦，操。
rows.raw: "\n\nOh, shit."

rows.original: You scramble behind
rows.translation: 你急忙躲到
rows.raw: "\n\nYou scramble behind"

rows.original: a convenient nearby chest high wall
rows.translation: 附近一堵恰好齐胸高的墙后
rows.raw: " a convenient nearby chest high wall"

rows.original: some crates stacked nearby
rows.translation: 附近堆放的一些箱子后
rows.raw: " some crates stacked nearby"

rows.original: before they can target you. Unlike the crazy cat-girl’s turrets topside, these are sleek and heavy looking, probably part of the installation’s normal security. And if those barrels are anything to go by, they’re probably loaded with micro-rockets rather than bullets - powerful enough to chew through a dropship or a freighter. You’ll need to take these bastards down fast if you want any hope of fighting forward.
rows.translation: ，赶在它们锁定你之前藏好。与上方那个疯狂猫女的炮塔不同，这些炮塔线条流畅、看起来十分沉重，可能本就是设施正常安保系统的一部分。从那些炮管判断，它们装的大概是微型火箭而非子弹——威力足以撕碎登陆艇或货船。若想继续向前战斗，你必须迅速干掉这些混蛋。
rows.raw: " before they can target you. Unlike the crazy cat-girl’s turrets topside, these are sleek and heavy looking, probably part of the installation’s normal security. And if those barrels are anything to go by, they’re probably loaded with micro-rockets rather than bullets - powerful enough to chew through a dropship or a freighter. You’ll need to take these bastards down fast if you want any hope of fighting forward."

rows.original: This situation reminds you of the time you snuck by the guards on Antaris VII. Zero-G environs do open up some unconventional paths....
rows.translation: 眼前的情况让你想起自己曾在安塔里斯七号偷偷绕过守卫的经历。零重力环境确实能开辟一些非常规路线....
rows.raw: "\n\nThis situation reminds you of the time you snuck by the guards on Antaris VII. Zero-G environs do open up some unconventional paths...."

rows.original: Sneak
rows.translation: 潜行
rows.raw: "Sneak"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: ROCKET_PODS
rows.raw: "ROCKET_PODS"

rows.original: Rocket Pods
rows.translation: 火箭发射舱
rows.raw: "Rocket Pods"

rows.original: “Discretion is the better part of valor,” Dad always said. You roll your shoulders, wipe the sweat from your palms, and pull yourself over the guard rail. You tumble weightlessly, grabbing the bottom of the bridge, leaving yourself hanging over the void.
rows.translation: “谨慎才是勇气的上策，”父亲总是这么说。你活动肩膀，擦去手心的汗，翻过护栏。你在失重中翻滚，抓住桥梁底部，让自己悬在虚空之上。
rows.raw: "“Discretion is the better part of valor,” Dad always said. You roll your shoulders, wipe the sweat from your palms, and pull yourself over the guard rail. You tumble weightlessly, grabbing the bottom of the bridge, leaving yourself hanging over the void."

rows.original: OHGODTHAT’SALONGWAYDOWN! Up?! Whatever....
rows.translation: 哦天啊下面也太远了！上面？！随便了....
rows.raw: "\n\nOHGODTHAT’SALONGWAYDOWN! Up?! Whatever...."

rows.original: You try not to stare, even as your [pc.feet] dangle
rows.translation: 你努力不去看，哪怕[pc.feet]正沉重地悬荡
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try not to stare, even as your [pc.feet] dangle"

rows.original: s

down ponderously below you, swaying over the blackness of space. You gulp, and swing them up, grinning widely when they snap into place thanks to the electromagnetic gear girding them. The experience is dizzying, but at least the turrets aren’t targeting you. Whoever programmed them didn’t take into account the new paths that zero G would offer.
rows.translation: 在你下方，于太空的漆黑中摇摆。你咽了口唾沫，将它们甩向上方；电磁装备使其牢牢吸附到位，你顿时咧嘴一笑。这种体验令人头晕目眩，但至少炮塔没有瞄准你。编写它们程序的人没有考虑零重力会提供的新路线。
rows.raw: " down ponderously below you, swaying over the blackness of space. You gulp, and swing them up, grinning widely when they snap into place thanks to the electromagnetic gear girding them. The experience is dizzying, but at least the turrets aren’t targeting you. Whoever programmed them didn’t take into account the new paths that zero G would offer."

rows.original: After a few moments’ of stepping carefully, constantly worried the turrets will turn on you, you step over to a nearby console conveniently labeled “defense turrets” and flip the switch. No more of that.
rows.translation: 你小心翼翼地走了片刻，始终担心炮塔会突然向你开火，终于来到附近一台方便地标着“防御炮塔”的控制台前，拨下开关。麻烦解决了。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a few moments’ of stepping carefully, constantly worried the turrets will turn on you, you step over to a nearby console conveniently labeled “defense turrets” and flip the switch. No more of that."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Sneak
rows.translation: 潜行
rows.raw: "Sneak"

rows.original: Sneak
rows.translation: 潜行
rows.raw: "Sneak"

rows.original: Smugglers can probably find a way to avoid this fight entirely....
rows.translation: 走私者大概能找到完全避开这场战斗的方法....
rows.raw: "Smugglers can probably find a way to avoid this fight entirely...."

rows.original: Hack Turrets
rows.translation: 入侵炮塔
rows.raw: "Hack Turrets"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: ROCKET_PODS
rows.raw: "ROCKET_PODS"

rows.original: Rocket Pods
rows.translation: 火箭发射舱
rows.raw: "Rocket Pods"

rows.original: “Fight smart, not hard,” Dad always said. You reach into your pack and pull out your Codex, bringing up the network selection, and quickly slicing into the station’s wireless.
rows.translation: “要斗智，别斗力，”父亲总是这么说。你从背包中取出法典，打开网络选择界面，很快切入站点的无线网络。
rows.raw: "“Fight smart, not hard,” Dad always said. You reach into your pack and pull out your Codex, bringing up the network selection, and quickly slicing into the station’s wireless."

rows.original: You spend a few minutes tapping around in the security system, but someone’s clearly been ramping up the anti-intruder countermeasures. You grit your teeth with effort, trying to pierce the security, but finding no backdoors or weak points to exploit. With a grunt of frustration, you toss your Codex back in your pack. Looks like it’s the hard way.
rows.translation: 你花了几分钟在安保系统中操作，但显然有人强化了防入侵措施。你用力咬牙，试图突破防线，却找不到任何后门或弱点可供利用。你懊恼地哼了一声，把法典扔回背包。看来只能硬来了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou spend a few minutes tapping around in the security system, but someone’s clearly been ramping up the anti-intruder countermeasures. You grit your teeth with effort, trying to pierce the security, but finding no backdoors or weak points to exploit. With a grunt of frustration, you toss your Codex back in your pack. Looks like it’s the hard way."

rows.original: Clearly Tam was already in here fiddling around, and the security she put back up isn’t really the best, easily falling prey to your trained skill. A few minutes later, you hear a tell-tale “BEEP” from the turrets ahead as they reset to their default parameters. Another few strokes, and you slice yourself into their Friend/Foe ID system, and tag yourself as friendly. Pirates, not so much.
rows.translation: 塔姆显然已经来这里折腾过，而她重新设下的安保并不高明，轻易便败给你训练有素的技巧。几分钟后，前方炮塔发出标志性的“哔”声，恢复默认参数。又操作几下，你便切入它们的敌我识别系统，将自己标记为友军。至于海盗，可就不是了。
rows.raw: "\n\nClearly Tam was already in here fiddling around, and the security she put back up isn’t really the best, easily falling prey to your trained skill. A few minutes later, you hear a tell-tale “BEEP” from the turrets ahead as they reset to their default parameters. Another few strokes, and you slice yourself into their Friend/Foe ID system, and tag yourself as friendly. Pirates, not so much."

rows.original: Stepping out from behind cover, you nervously approach the turrets. Their many rocket launchers swivel around to regard you, laser targeters taking a bead... before the nearest one makes a happy-sounding chirp, and the battery disengages. Whew.
rows.translation: 你从掩体后走出，紧张地靠近炮塔。数个火箭发射器转向你，激光瞄准器锁定目标...接着最近的一座发出听起来很愉快的鸣叫，发射组件随之解除。呼。
rows.raw: "\n\nStepping out from behind cover, you nervously approach the turrets. Their many rocket launchers swivel around to regard you, laser targeters taking a bead... before the nearest one makes a happy-sounding chirp, and the battery disengages. Whew."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.translation: 入侵炮塔
rows.raw: "Hack Turrets"

rows.translation: 入侵炮塔
rows.raw: "Hack Turrets"

rows.original: A tech specialist could probably hack these things.
rows.translation: 科技专家或许能入侵这些东西。
rows.raw: "A tech specialist could probably hack these things."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: . The rocket pods are sitting at the end of the walkway, scanning for hostile targets. As you approach, they chirp a digital greeting at you, utterly harmless.
rows.translation: 。火箭发射舱坐落在通道尽头，扫描着敌对目标。你靠近时，它们发出电子问候声，完全无害。
rows.raw: ". The rocket pods are sitting at the end of the walkway, scanning for hostile targets. As you approach, they chirp a digital greeting at you, utterly harmless."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: , especially now that it’s been blasted with holes from the now defunct rocket turrets, which are sitting in a shorted-out heap at the edge of the way, rendered harmless. From here, you have an uninterrupted line of sight all the way back to the top of the lift track, as well as a commanding view of the lift station, big and bulky and ancient, sitting before you.
rows.translation: ，尤其如今它已被失效的火箭炮塔轰得千疮百孔；那些炮塔短路后堆在通道边缘，已经毫无威胁。从这里，你能毫无遮挡地一路望回升降轨道顶端，也能俯瞰眼前那座庞大、笨重而古老的升降站。

rows.original: With a mighty KABOOM, the last rocket turret explodes in a hail of shrapnel and sparks. You heave a sigh of relief as silence again reigns in the rift. You can only spare a few moments to catch your breath, though, before you have to push on: there’s a bomb that needs defusing!
rows.translation: 伴随一声震天的轰隆，最后一座火箭炮塔在弹片与火花中爆炸。裂隙重新归于寂静，你如释重负地叹了口气。但你只能花片刻喘息，随后必须继续前进：还有一枚炸弹等着拆除！
rows.raw: "With a mighty KABOOM, the last rocket turret explodes in a hail of shrapnel and sparks. You heave a sigh of relief as silence again reigns in the rift. You can only spare a few moments to catch your breath, though, before you have to push on: there’s a bomb that needs defusing!\n\n"

rows.original: Rockets pummel into the ground around you, closer and closer, blasting you off your [pc.feet], bouncing you around like a toy. You scream in pain as shrapnel tears through you, explosive force hurling you off the walkway and into the void around Tarkus’s core. Your corpse will have to rest amongst the floating strata.
rows.translation: 火箭不断砸落在你周围的地面，越来越近，将你从[pc.feet]上炸飞，像玩具一样到处弹撞。弹片撕裂身体，你痛苦尖叫；爆炸冲击把你掀下通道，抛进塔库斯核心周围的虚空。你的尸体只能与漂浮岩层为伴。
rows.raw: "Rockets pummel into the ground around you, closer and closer, blasting you off your [pc.feet], bouncing you around like a toy. You scream in pain as shrapnel tears through you, explosive force hurling you off the walkway and into the void around Tarkus’s core. Your corpse will have to rest amongst the floating strata."

rows.translation: 继续

rows.original: Turrets
rows.raw: "Turrets"

rows.original: The reinforced mining suit shudders, smoke billowing off of it as the captain struggles to keep it standing. With one final roar of outrage, she levels the mining laser at you, intending to go down with a fight... but it doesn’t fire. Indeed, it catches fire as she spins it up, quickly bursting into flames from excess heat. You bat a billow of smoke away from your face as the suit collapses to one knee, its guns melting to slag.
rows.translation: 加固采矿服剧烈震颤，浓烟滚滚冒出，船长拼命想让它保持站立。她发出最后一声愤怒咆哮，将采矿激光瞄准你，打算战斗到底...可它没有开火。事实上，她刚启动它，激光器便因过热而起火，迅速被烈焰吞没。你挥开扑向脸庞的烟雾，看着机甲单膝跪地，武器熔成炉渣。
rows.raw: "The reinforced mining suit shudders, smoke billowing off of it as the captain struggles to keep it standing. With one final roar of outrage, she levels the mining laser at you, intending to go down with a fight... but it doesn’t fire. Indeed, it catches fire as she spins it up, quickly bursting into flames from excess heat. You bat a billow of smoke away from your face as the suit collapses to one knee, its guns melting to slag."

rows.original: But she’s not done yet! The intact hand of the suit reaches out, grabbing you before you have time to react. You gasp, fighting for breath as the suit’s powerful grip threatens to crush you... before hurling you into the platform behind it. You go tumbling, back slamming into a sheer rock face -- though it’s strangely smooth, cold to the touch. Rubbing your head, you look up to see a thick vein of platinum running up through the crust.
rows.translation: 但她还没完！机甲完好的手伸来，在你来得及反应前一把抓住你。强大握力几乎将你捏碎，你喘不过气、拼命挣扎...随后它把你掷向后方平台。你翻滚着撞上陡峭岩壁——那表面却异常平滑，触感冰冷。你揉着脑袋抬头，看见一道粗大的铂矿脉贯穿地壳。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut she’s not done yet! The intact hand of the suit reaches out, grabbing you before you have time to react. You gasp, fighting for breath as the suit’s powerful grip threatens to crush you... before hurling you into the platform behind it. You go tumbling, back slamming into a sheer rock face -- though it’s strangely smooth, cold to the touch. Rubbing your head, you look up to see a thick vein of platinum running up through the crust."

rows.original: With a pneumatic hiss, the mech suit’s cockpit flings open, and the captain rolls out. You momentarily think she means to surrender, until you see the hilt of a sword in her hand. With a flick of her wrist, the hilt erupts in a blade of sheer force, glowing a brilliant blue in the dim light of the sundered core.
rows.translation: 伴随气压嘶鸣，机甲驾驶舱猛然弹开，船长翻身滚出。你一度以为她打算投降，直到看见她手中握着一截剑柄。她手腕一甩，剑柄中迸发出纯粹力场构成的剑刃，在破碎核心的昏暗光线里闪耀着明亮蓝光。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a pneumatic hiss, the mech suit’s cockpit flings open, and the captain rolls out. You momentarily think she means to surrender, until you see the hilt of a sword in her hand. With a flick of her wrist, the hilt erupts in a blade of sheer force, glowing a brilliant blue in the dim light of the sundered core."

But you... now you’ve ruined everything. Probably killed half my crew, haven’t you? And now my suit! My beautiful suit!”
rows.translation: ，”船长冷笑着挺直身体——至少足有七英尺高，令人印象深刻。她迈步向前，紧身胸衣勉强束住起伏的胸脯，将力场弯刀摆成经典决斗姿势。“你和那些该死的维和人员只要再退开几小时就好...根本没人需要受伤。但你...现在你毁了一切。大概还杀了我一半船员，对吧？现在连我的机甲也毁了！我漂亮的机甲！”

rows.translation: 她向你突刺时，你只来得及举起[pc.meleeWeapon]，勉强格开这一击。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have just enough time to ready your [pc.meleeWeapon] when she lunges at you, only barely parrying the thrust."

rows.original: She circles, breathing hard. “You’re strong, I’ll give you that. That suit should have been able to mow through a whole squad of soldiers, but you...”
rows.translation: 她绕着你踱步，呼吸粗重。“你很强，这点我承认。那套机甲本该能碾过整队士兵，可你...”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe circles, breathing hard. “You’re strong, I’ll give you that. That suit should have been able to mow through a whole squad of soldiers, but you...”"

rows.original: Khorgan sighs, a slight grin crossing her lips. She charges, swinging low. You parry, leaping back as you see the feint for what it is, only just dodging a left hook that would have had you on your ass. She follows up with a few swings which you alternatively dodge or parry before countering with your own attack, pushing her back -- and giving you some room to breathe.
rows.translation: 霍根叹了口气，唇角浮现一丝笑意。她冲上来，挥剑横扫下盘。你架开攻击，看穿佯招后向后一跃，险险避过足以把你打翻在地的左勾拳。她紧接着连续挥砍，你或闪避或招架，随后以自己的攻击反击，将她逼退——也为自己争取到喘息空间。
rows.raw: "\n\nKhorgan sighs, a slight grin crossing her lips. She charges, swinging low. You parry, leaping back as you see the feint for what it is, only just dodging a left hook that would have had you on your ass. She follows up with a few swings which you alternatively dodge or parry before countering with your own attack, pushing her back -- and giving you some room to breathe."

rows.original: “Good!” the captain grins, the fury in her voice fading to what you might venture to call mirth. “You’re good, Steele. Maybe even good enough...”
rows.translation: “很好！”船长咧嘴笑道，声音里的愤怒逐渐变成你或许会称作愉悦的情绪。“你很不错，斯蒂尔。甚至可能足够优秀...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good!” the captain grins, the fury in her voice fading to what you might venture to call mirth. “You’re good, Steele. Maybe even good enough...”"

rows.original: You just catch the dangerous glint in her eye before she rushes you. Your weapons clash, but she’s strong, strong enough to lock blades with you and start twisting your weapon aside. You strain against her, trying to keep yourself centered, but to no avail -- she pushes you aside just enough to smash her head into yours, sending you staggering back. Rather than follow-up, though, she roars in triumph, head and arms thrown back in a primal display. Her tricorn flutters aside, revealing a shock of brilliant orange hair against her green skin, a flowing braid dancing behind her as she starts to circle again, force cutlass readied.
rows.translation: 你刚捕捉到她眼中危险的光芒，她便冲了过来。武器相撞，可她力气极大，强到能与你锁住兵刃并开始将你的武器扭向一旁。你用力抵抗，试图稳住重心，却毫无作用——她把你推偏了些许，随即用脑袋狠狠撞向你，让你踉跄后退。然而她没有追击，而是仰头高举双臂，以原始姿态发出胜利咆哮。三角帽飘落一旁，露出绿色皮肤上那一头亮橙色头发；一条长辫在身后舞动，她再次绕着你移动，力场弯刀严阵以待。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou just catch the dangerous glint in her eye before she rushes you. Your weapons clash, but she’s strong, strong enough to lock blades with you and start twisting your weapon aside. You strain against her, trying to keep yourself centered, but to no avail -- she pushes you aside just enough to smash her head into yours, sending you staggering back. Rather than follow-up, though, she roars in triumph, head and arms thrown back in a primal display. Her tricorn flutters aside, revealing a shock of brilliant orange hair against her green skin, a flowing braid dancing behind her as she starts to circle again, force cutlass readied."

rows.original: “Why did you come here, Steele?” she sneers, “Are you some kind of hero -- thought you could save the planet from the big, bad pirates?”
rows.translation: “你为什么来这里，斯蒂尔？”她讥笑道，“你是什么英雄吗——以为自己能从邪恶的大海盗手中拯救这颗星球？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Why did you come here, Steele?” she sneers, “Are you some kind of hero -- thought you could save the planet from the big, bad pirates?”"

rows.original: You move next, charging in with a pair of wild swings, enough to batter down her guard before you fully commit, leaping into an overhand blow. She dodges at the last moment, pulling back hard -- your weapon sheers through air and fabric, tearing into the front of her corset. When she recovers, she’s grinning maniacally, her big breasts barely restrained by the remaining strings of her outfit, threatening to burst free at any moment as tatters of fabric fall away.
rows.translation: 这次你率先行动，冲上前连续胡乱挥出两击，足以击溃她的防守，随后彻底发力，跃起使出一记下劈。她在最后一刻猛然后撤闪开——你的武器划过空气与布料，撕开她紧身胸衣的前襟。恢复姿态时，她正疯狂地咧嘴大笑；硕大乳房只被衣服残余的系带勉强束缚，随时可能迸出，破碎布片纷纷掉落。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou move next, charging in with a pair of wild swings, enough to batter down her guard before you fully commit, leaping into an overhand blow. When she recovers, she’s grinning maniacally, her big breasts barely restrained by the remaining strings of her outfit, threatening to burst free at any moment as tatters of fabric fall away."

Why don’t you put the weapon down, Steele. You’re wasting your time, you know that? The bomb was never meant to go off. It was just insurance, to keep the Peacekeepers away. rows.original: From her pocket, she pulls a small remote, and glances at it. “Not much time left, Steele. Maybe you ought to start running... you might make it back to your ship, if you’re lucky. Or maybe you’d rather get a ride out with me, hmm? Submit to me, and I guarantee you’ll live. You might even like being my personal bitch....”
rows.translation: 她从口袋里取出一只小遥控器，看了一眼。“剩余时间不多了，斯蒂尔。也许你该开始逃跑...如果够幸运，或许还能赶回飞船。又或者，你更愿意搭我的船离开，嗯？向我臣服，我保证你能活下来。你甚至可能会喜欢做我的私人母狗....”

rows.original: You’re losing ground. Even ignoring the sensual assault assailing your senses, the captain’s still an amazing swordsman, and you’re banged up after that fight against her mech. It’s hard to keep standing, much less fighting. You can barely feel your hand by the time she easily bats your weapon from your hand... right before giving you a nasty right hook that plants you on the ground. With a smirk, the captain plants one of her boot on your chest, utterly asserting her dominance.
rows.translation: 你正在节节败退。即便不管不断冲击感官的情欲攻势，船长依然是位出色剑士，而你与她的机甲大战后已经伤痕累累。连站立都很困难，更别说战斗了。等她轻松从你手中拍落武器时，你几乎已感觉不到自己的手...紧接着，她一记凶狠右勾拳将你放倒在地。船长冷笑着把一只靴子踩在你胸膛上，彻底彰显她的支配地位。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re losing ground. Even ignoring the sensual assault assailing your senses, the captain’s still an amazing swordsman, and you’re banged up after that fight against her mech. It’s hard to keep standing, much less fighting. You can barely feel your hand by the time she easily bats your weapon from your hand... right before giving you a nasty right hook that plants you on the ground. With a smirk, the captain plants one of her boot on your chest, utterly asserting her dominance."

rows.original: Laser bolts and rockets explode around you, hammering into your defenses, tearing through the steel platform around you. Suddenly, another bolt tears into your [pc.rangedWeapon], shredding your weapon and throwing you to the ground. You cough and struggle, trying to get on your [pc.feet], only to suddenly feel a crushing weight bearing down on your chest as the captain’s mech suit lumbers up, pinning you down. The captain exits the suit, stepping out the cockpit amidst pneumatic hisses, and replaces her suit’s great, heavy foot with her own.
rows.translation: 激光束与火箭在周围爆炸，猛烈轰击你的防御，将身边钢铁平台撕裂。突然，又一道光束击中[pc.rangedWeapon]，把武器撕碎并将你掀翻在地。你咳嗽着挣扎，想重新站上[pc.feet]，胸口却突然承受一股可怕重压；船长的机甲轰隆隆走来，将你牢牢压住。船长在气压嘶鸣中离开驾驶舱，用自己的脚替换机甲沉重的巨足，继续踩着你。
rows.raw: "Laser bolts and rockets explode around you, hammering into your defenses, tearing through the steel platform around you. Suddenly, another bolt tears into your [pc.rangedWeapon], shredding your weapon and throwing you to the ground. You cough and struggle, trying to get on your [pc.feet], only to suddenly feel a crushing weight bearing down on your chest as the captain’s mech suit lumbers up, pinning you down. The captain exits the suit, stepping out the cockpit amidst pneumatic hisses, and replaces her suit’s great, heavy foot with her own."

rows.original: Grinning fiercely, the captain says, “You’re brave, Steele. Brave and strong. Not enough to defeat ME, of course, but still, those are admirable qualities among the thraggen. It would be such a waste to kill you... maybe I could make some use out of you, then. What do you say, Steele? Do you want to live?”
rows.translation: 船长凶狠地咧嘴笑道：“你很勇敢，斯蒂尔。勇敢又强壮。当然，还不足以击败我，但这些在萨根人之中仍是值得赞赏的品质。杀掉你未免太浪费...那么，也许我可以好好利用你。怎么样，斯蒂尔？你想活下去吗？”

rows.translation: 一股突如其来的冲击扫过整个房间，紧接着便是震耳欲聋的轰鸣。你很快意识到，继续留在这里绝对没有好下场，于是决定直奔主甲板。
rows.raw: "A sudden shock courses through the entire room followed by a loud roar. Quickly realizing that the situation does not bode well for you if you stay here, you decide to head straight to the main deck."

rows.original: Careful not to
rows.translation: 你小心着别
rows.raw: "\n\nCareful not to"

rows.original: lunge into any obstacles, you fly
rows.translation: 一头撞上什么障碍物，飞快地冲
rows.raw: " lunge into any obstacles, you fly"

rows.original: trip over yourself, you make a dash
rows.translation: 绊倒自己，朝前狂奔
rows.raw: " trip over yourself, you make a dash"

rows.original: stumble over yourself, you hastily move your body
rows.translation: 跌跌撞撞，慌忙挪动身体
rows.raw: " stumble over yourself, you hastily move your body"

rows.original: towards the elevator and punch the call button. Excess debris starts to fall as the haunting sounds of creaking and crunching metal echo around you. Like a sign from the heavens, the bell dings and the doors open.
rows.translation: 向电梯，一拳砸在呼叫按钮上。多余的碎片开始掉落，金属令人毛骨悚然的嘎吱与碎裂声在四周回荡。如同天降神迹，铃声响起，电梯门随之敞开。
rows.raw: " towards the elevator and punch the call button. Excess debris starts to fall as the haunting sounds of creaking and crunching metal echo around you. Like a sign from the heavens, the bell dings and the doors open."

rows.original: “Boss!” Your ausar companion yells as she does a tactical somersault into the elevator shaft. You quickly follow behind her
rows.translation: “老板！”你的奥萨伙伴大喊着，一个战术翻滚跃入电梯井。你紧跟在她身后
rows.raw: "\n\n“Boss!” Your ausar companion yells as she does a tactical somersault into the elevator shaft. You quickly follow behind her"

rows.original: You quickly jump into the elevator shaft
rows.translation: 你迅速跳进电梯井
rows.raw: "\n\nYou quickly jump into the elevator shaft"

rows.original: and hit the button on the control panel. The doors jam, refusing to close, but the elevator hums and the lift makes its ascent.
rows.translation: 并按下控制面板上的按钮。电梯门卡住了，怎么也关不上，但机械低鸣一声，开始向上爬升。
rows.raw: " and hit the button on the control panel. The doors jam, refusing to close, but the elevator hums and the lift makes its ascent."

rows.original: As it moves up, you peer out the opening
rows.translation: 电梯上升时，你从敞开的门口向外窥视
rows.raw: "\n\nAs it moves up, you peer out the opening"

rows.original: only to find the shaft below being crushed and mangled, lit only by small sparks... and then huge flames. You have to get out of here quick!
rows.translation: ，只见下方电梯井正被挤压扭曲，只有细小火花照亮四周...随后更是烈焰冲天。你必须赶快离开这里！
rows.raw: " only to find the shaft below being crushed and mangled, lit only by small sparks... and then huge flames. You have to get out of here quick!"

rows.original: seeing visible tremors and more debris - though luckily, the shaft remains intact. Turning on the shields must have done the trick or you could have been a trapped sardine!
rows.translation: ，看见清晰可见的震颤与更多碎片——幸好，电梯井依然完好。开启护盾肯定起了作用，否则你已经成了被封在罐头里的沙丁鱼！
rows.raw: " seeing visible tremors and more debris - though luckily, the shaft remains intact. Turning on the shields must have done the trick or you could have been a trapped sardine!"

rows.original: The bell dings again and
rows.translation: 铃声再次响起，然后
rows.raw: "\n\nThe bell dings again and"

rows.original: Anno pulls you to help you get out of the
rows.translation: 安诺拉着你，帮你离开这台
rows.raw: " Anno pulls you to help you get out of the"

rows.original: you finally crawl out of the
rows.translation: 你终于爬出了这台
rows.raw: " you finally crawl out of the"

rows.original: death trap and get on your [pc.feet], the doors now closing - then completely sealing - behind you
rows.translation: 死亡陷阱，重新用[pc.feet]站稳身体，身后的门立刻关闭——然后彻底封死
rows.raw: " death trap and get on your [pc.feet], the doors now closing - then completely sealing - behind you"

rows.original: shaky elevator cab and get on your [pc.feet]
rows.translation: 摇摇晃晃的电梯轿厢，重新用[pc.feet]站稳身体
rows.raw: " shaky elevator cab and get on your [pc.feet]"

rows.original: , only to be greeted with more chaos on the main floor...
rows.translation: ，然而迎接你的却是主层更加混乱的景象...
rows.raw: ", only to be greeted with more chaos on the main floor..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SHEKKA
rows.raw: "SHEKKA"

rows.original: Anno & Shekka
rows.translation: 安诺与谢卡
rows.raw: "Anno & Shekka"

rows.original: Novahome groans like a wounded animal and shifts at least a foot to the left, dumping you to the deck. Alarms sound while you’re climbing back to your [pc.feet]. When did the raskvel get those working? Screams of alarm fill the corridors, and you’re nearly swept along on a tide of scaly panic. The ship lurches a few more times. You’re lucky enough to grab hold of a hand hold this time, and you make your way to the ship’s exit ramp.
rows.translation: 诺瓦之家像受伤的野兽一样哀鸣，向左猛移了至少一英尺，把你摔在甲板上。你爬回[pc.feet]站稳时，警报声已经响彻四周。拉斯克维尔是什么时候把这些修好的？惊恐尖叫充斥走廊，你几乎被鳞片人潮裹挟而去。飞船又剧烈倾斜了几次。这次你幸运地抓住了扶手，然后向飞船出口斜坡挪去。
rows.raw: "Novahome groans like a wounded animal and shifts at least a foot to the left, dumping you to the deck. Alarms sound while you’re climbing back to your [pc.feet]. When did the raskvel get those working? Screams of alarm fill the corridors, and you’re nearly swept along on a tide of scaly panic. The ship lurches a few more times. You’re lucky enough to grab hold of a hand hold this time, and you make your way to the ship’s exit ramp."

rows.original: The ramp itself is gone. There’s an open air gap in its place and no sign of those who might have been walking on it. The Nova bucks like a nautical vessel of old trapped in the gale-force winds of a hurricane. Your belly turns, and you watch the ground fall away a second before Tarkus’s surface shatters like a piece of glass. Chunks of ore go hurtling by. Raskvel, gabilani, and rushers alike are sucked out of the hull, screaming in terror. You barely manage to keep your grip as you watch the bomb tear apart the planet you could’ve saved.
rows.translation: 斜坡本身不见了。原地只剩一道通往外界的缺口，那些当时可能正走在上面的人也不见踪影。诺瓦号像是陷入飓风的古老海船一般剧烈颠簸。你胃里一阵翻腾，眼看地面在脚下远去，紧接着塔卡斯地表便如玻璃般破碎。矿石碎块呼啸着从旁边飞过。拉斯克维尔、加比拉尼与冲锋者纷纷被吸出船体，惊恐尖叫。你拼尽全力才没松手，同时眼睁睁看着炸弹把本可由你拯救的星球撕碎。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe ramp itself is gone. There’s an open air gap in its place and no sign of those who might have been walking on it. The Nova bucks like a nautical vessel of old trapped in the gale-force winds of a hurricane. Your belly turns, and you watch the ground fall away a second before Tarkus’s surface shatters like a piece of glass. Chunks of ore go hurtling by. Raskvel, gabilani, and rushers alike are sucked out of the hull, screaming in terror. You barely manage to keep your grip as you watch the bomb tear apart the planet you could’ve saved."

rows.original: Dry winds scream like banshees, propelled by geological forces beyond comprehension.
rows.translation: 干燥狂风像女妖般尖啸，被超乎想象的地质力量推动着。
rows.raw: "\n\nDry winds scream like banshees, propelled by geological forces beyond comprehension. "

rows.original: Anno
rows.translation: 安诺
rows.raw: "Anno"

rows.original: A white-haired ausar
rows.translation: 一名白发奥萨少女
rows.raw: "A white-haired ausar"

rows.original: seems to be one of the only ones not panicking. As a matter of fact, you see her pulling herself on handholds towards the sucking hole in the side of the hull. Opposite,
rows.translation: 似乎是仅有的几个没有陷入恐慌的人之一。事实上，你看见她抓着扶手，朝船体侧面那个吸风的缺口挪去。对面，
rows.raw: " seems to be one of the only ones not panicking. As a matter of fact, you see her pulling herself on handholds towards the sucking hole in the side of the hull. Opposite, "

rows.original: Shekka
rows.translation: 谢卡
rows.raw: "Shekka"

rows.original: a pink-haired raskvel in a gleaming white jumpsuit
rows.translation: 一名粉发拉斯克维尔，身穿闪亮白色连身服
rows.raw: "a pink-haired raskvel in a gleaming white jumpsuit"

rows.original: is wearing a pair of glowing boots, stomping along the deck towards a lever.
rows.translation: 正穿着一双发光长靴，踩着甲板朝一根拉杆走去。
rows.raw: " is wearing a pair of glowing boots, stomping along the deck towards a lever. "

rows.original: Anno
rows.translation: 安诺
rows.raw: "Anno"

rows.original: The ausar
rows.translation: 那名奥萨女子
rows.raw: "The ausar"

rows.original: is almost at a matching one on the other side. They reach them at the same time, and recessed doors slide out of the walls, trailing a curtain of rust particles, and slam shut.
rows.translation: 已经快要抵达另一侧与之匹配的拉杆。她们同时抓住拉杆，嵌在墙壁中的舱门随即滑出，带起一道锈屑帘幕，然后轰然合拢。
rows.raw: " is almost at a matching one on the other side. They reach them at the same time, and recessed doors slide out of the walls, trailing a curtain of rust particles, and slam shut."

rows.original: While the horrible sounds from outside may have died out, the ship is still spinning and shaking like wild gark. A tinny, raskvel voice comes over the speaker, “Tarkus is breaking up! Get the shields-” It cuts off with a burst of static. The lights dim, and the din of crying aliens reaches a whole new crescendo. Staggering, you make your way towards the hangar. Maybe you can save yourself.
rows.translation: 外面的恐怖声响虽然停止了，但飞船依旧像发疯的加克一样旋转震荡。扬声器里传来拉斯克维尔尖细的声音：“塔卡斯正在解体！快开护盾——”声音被一阵静电噪音截断。灯光暗下，周围异星人的哭喊声猛然拔高到全新的程度。你踉踉跄跄地朝机库走去。也许你还能救自己一命。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile the horrible sounds from outside may have died out, the ship is still spinning and shaking like wild gark. A tinny, raskvel voice comes over the speaker, “Tarkus is breaking up! Get the shields-” It cuts off with a burst of static. The lights dim, and the din of crying aliens reaches a whole new crescendo. Staggering, you make your way towards the hangar. Maybe you can save yourself."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: The hangar’s blast doors are sealed. You didn’t even know the hangar HAD blast doors, but they’ve closed all the same. Your ship and a half dozen others are piled together on the far side of the chamber, damaged but unbroken. You’re lucky no one brought any larger ships here before the planets came apart. Your ride could’ve gotten smashed.
rows.translation: 机库的防爆门已经封闭。你甚至不知道机库还有防爆门，但它们确实已经关上了。你的飞船和另外半打飞船堆在舱室另一端，虽然受损，却都没有解体。幸好行星碎裂前没有人把更大的飞船开到这里。否则你的座驾可能已经被压扁了。
rows.raw: "The hangar’s blast doors are sealed. You didn’t even know the hangar HAD blast doors, but they’ve closed all the same. Your ship and a half dozen others are piled together on the far side of the chamber, damaged but unbroken. You’re lucky no one brought any larger ships here before the planets came apart. Your ride could’ve gotten smashed."

rows.original: Still bumping and bouncing, you wonder if you’re going to die like this - trapped in a metal coffin with a bunch of space-
rows.translation: 飞船依然磕磕绊绊、上下颠簸，你开始怀疑自己是不是就会这样死去——和一群太空
rows.raw: "\n\nStill bumping and bouncing, you wonder if you’re going to die like this - trapped in a metal coffin with a bunch of space-"

rows.original: kobolds
rows.translation: 狗头人
rows.raw: "kobolds"

rows.original: rats
rows.translation: 老鼠
rows.raw: "rats"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: Somehow, you didn’t die, and neither did the raskvel - at least not the ones onboard Novahome. With no other option save extinction, the scrappy little aliens managed to get the engines and life support on this old boat running.
rows.translation: 不知怎的，你没死，拉斯克维尔们也没死——至少诺瓦之家上的这些没死。除了灭绝之外别无选择时，这些顽强的小家伙竟然让这艘老船的引擎与生命维持系统运转了起来。
rows.raw: "Somehow, you didn’t die, and neither did the raskvel - at least not the ones onboard Novahome. With no other option save extinction, the scrappy little aliens managed to get the engines and life support on this old boat running. "

rows.original: A dark-skinned girl
rows.translation: 一名深肤色少女
rows.raw: "A dark-skinned girl"

rows.original: Del
rows.translation: 黛尔
rows.raw: "Del"

rows.original: spearheaded options to keep the refugees fed
rows.translation: 带头组织起了供养难民的办法
rows.raw: " spearheaded options to keep the refugees fed"

rows.original: and suitably serviced
rows.translation: 并确保她们得到妥善服务
rows.raw: " and suitably serviced"

rows.original: while the hangar was cleared. You helped out where you could, anything to see the hangar and your ship operational again. An escape vector is always nice.
rows.translation: ，直到机库被清理干净。你也在力所能及的地方帮了忙，只要能让机库和你的飞船重新运作，做什么都行。能有一条逃生路线总是好事。
rows.raw: " while the hangar was cleared. You helped out where you could, anything to see the hangar and your ship operational again. An escape vector is always nice."

rows.original: A day later, life calmed down enough for things to get back to something approaching normal on Novahome. While deciding what to do next, you catch wind that [rival.name] is in
rows.translation: 一天后，诺瓦之家上的生活总算平静到可以恢复某种程度的正常。你正在考虑下一步该做什么，忽然听说[rival.name]正在
rows.raw: "\n\nA day later, life calmed down enough for things to get back to something approaching normal on Novahome. While deciding what to do next, you catch wind that [rival.name] is in "

rows.original: Shekka’s shop
rows.translation: 谢卡的店里
rows.raw: "Shekka’s shop"

rows.original: a nearby shop
rows.translation: 附近的一家店里
rows.raw: "a nearby shop"

rows.original: . A pity they didn’t get sucked out the airlock.
rows.translation: 。真可惜，那家伙没被吸出气闸。
rows.raw: ". A pity they didn’t get sucked out the airlock."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: , doomed by your own incompetence. The overhead lights flicked and die, plunging you into darkness. The Nova rings like a gong when something slams into it, forcing you to clap your hands to your [pc.ears]. You’re going to die. It’s finished, then. There’s no way out.
rows.translation: ，注定要为你自己的无能陪葬。头顶灯光闪烁几下后熄灭，把你抛入黑暗。某个东西猛撞诺瓦号，船体像铜锣一样震响，逼得你用双手捂住[pc.ears]。你要死了。这就是结局。已经无路可逃。
rows.raw: ", doomed by your own incompetence. The overhead lights flicked and die, plunging you into darkness. The Nova rings like a gong when something slams into it, forcing you to clap your hands to your [pc.ears]. You’re going to die. It’s finished, then. There’s no way out."

rows.original: The lights come on, bringing with it the tiny voice of whatever raskvel sits at the helm. “Shields are up! Shields are up! Get me engines! Fucking gabilani must have wrecked their own planet. Someone should’ve told them it would take more than that to wipe us out!” A cheer goes through the huddled masses around you. Maybe you’ll live after all?
rows.translation: 灯光再次亮起，同时传来掌舵的某个拉斯克维尔细小的声音。“护盾升起来了！护盾升起来了！快给我引擎！肯定是那些该死的加比拉尼毁了他们自己的星球。应该有人告诉他们，这点程度还不足以消灭我们！”你周围蜂拥成团的人群爆发出欢呼。也许你终究还能活下来？
rows.raw: "\n\nThe lights come on, bringing with it the tiny voice of whatever raskvel sits at the helm. “Shields are up! Shields are up! Get me engines! Fucking gabilani must have wrecked their own planet. Someone should’ve told them it would take more than that to wipe us out!” A cheer goes through the huddled masses around you. Maybe you’ll live after all?"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You receive a notification on your codex that Tarkus was destroyed by the bomb you failed to disarm. The news feeds make a big deal of playing up the survival of a group of raskvel onboard Novahome, and some mention is made of a gabilani space station being intact as well. Maybe you should check up on Novahome and see how the raskvel are doing?
rows.translation: 你的法典收到一条通知，塔卡斯已被你未能拆除的炸弹毁灭。新闻频道大肆渲染了一群拉斯克维尔在诺瓦之家上幸存的消息，还提到一座加比拉尼太空站似乎也安然无恙。也许你应该去诺瓦之家看看，瞧瞧那些拉斯克维尔过得怎么样？
rows.raw: "You receive a notification on your codex that Tarkus was destroyed by the bomb you failed to disarm. The news feeds make a big deal of playing up the survival of a group of raskvel onboard Novahome, and some mention is made of a gabilani space station being intact as well. Maybe you should check up on Novahome and see how the raskvel are doing?"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: tarkus
rows.raw: "tarkus"

rows.original: The section of deck upon which you now stand is undoubtedly the busiest place in all of Novahome, either because of its central location or the access tunnel that opens up to the south, leading out onto Tarkus’s surface. Before you can get to the windswept junkyards, you’ll have to walk across a wobbling gangplank made of hundreds of welded-together metal plates. The aliens pay it no mind. You could also go to the east or west if you wanted to explore Novahome and the people within.
rows.translation: 你现在所站的甲板区域无疑是整个诺瓦之家最繁忙的地方，或许是因为它位置居中，也或许是因为那条向南敞开、直通塔卡斯地表的通道。在抵达风沙漫天的废品场前，你得先走过一条由数百块金属板焊接而成、摇摇晃晃的跳板。异星人们丝毫不以为意。如果你想探索诺瓦之家和里面的居民，也可以向东或向西走。
rows.raw: "The section of deck upon which you now stand is undoubtedly the busiest place in all of Novahome, either because of its central location or the access tunnel that opens up to the south, leading out onto Tarkus’s surface. Before you can get to the windswept junkyards, you’ll have to walk across a wobbling gangplank made of hundreds of welded-together metal plates. The aliens pay it no mind. You could also go to the east or west if you wanted to explore Novahome and the people within."

rows.original: The section of deck upon which you now stand was undoubtedly the busiest place in all of Novahome back before the planet blew. Now, huge blast doors close off the way to the south, and while foot traffic is still high, the press of raskvel bodies is significantly abated. The massive, central corridor leads east and west from here.
rows.translation: 在星球爆炸之前，你现在所站的甲板区域无疑是整个诺瓦之家最繁忙的地方。如今，巨大防爆门封死了南面的去路；虽然人流依然很大，拉斯克维尔身体挤成的浪潮却已经缓和许多。巨大的中央走廊从这里向东西两侧延伸。
rows.raw: "The section of deck upon which you now stand was undoubtedly the busiest place in all of Novahome back before the planet blew. Now, huge blast doors close off the way to the south, and while foot traffic is still high, the press of raskvel bodies is significantly abated. The massive, central corridor leads east and west from here."

rows.original: A sign made of mismatched machine parts displays “Shekka’s Widget Warehouse” just above a cobbled-together, warehouse like building to the north.
rows.translation: 一块由各种不匹配机器零件拼成的招牌挂在北面一栋东拼西凑的仓库式建筑上方，写着“谢卡的零件仓库”。
rows.raw: " A sign made of mismatched machine parts displays “Shekka’s Widget Warehouse” just above a cobbled-together, warehouse like building to the north."

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: <b>Dane is standing outside of Shekka’s Widget Warehouse, his four arms crossed over his chest. His white-furred ears flick up in recognition.
rows.translation: <b>戴恩站在谢卡的零件仓库外，四只手臂抱在胸前。他覆着白毛的耳朵认出你后竖了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n<b>Dane is standing outside of Shekka’s Widget Warehouse, his four arms crossed over his chest. His white-furred ears flick up in recognition. "

rows.original: “The boss was mighty pleased with how I handled you last mission. I wouldn’t mind a repeat sometime when I’m off the clock.” The ausar merc chuckles. “Boss also said to let you in if you showed up. Guess [rival.he] figured you were too poor to stop him now.
rows.translation: “老板对我上次任务中处理你的表现非常满意。等我下班了，倒不介意再来一次。”奥萨佣兵笑了起来。“老板还说，要是你出现就放你进去。看来[rival.he]觉得你现在穷得已经阻止不了他了。
rows.raw: "“The boss was mighty pleased with how I handled you last mission. I wouldn’t mind a repeat sometime when I’m off the clock.” The ausar merc chuckles. “Boss also said to let you in if you showed up. Guess [rival.he] figured you were too poor to stop him now."

rows.original: “You’ve got a lot of balls showing up here,” he growls before smiling. “Boss said not to stop you, and after last time, I’m not sure I’d want to try. Just don’t start any trouble, all right?

rows.original: “No! No! Not while [pc.he]’s around!” Your cousin panics, slapping ineffectually at the gleaming metal. A seam appears next to [rival.name]’s hand and retracts, revealing a blinking, electronic screen with a set of flashing coordinates. “Damn,” [rival.he] mutters. To [rival.his] credit, your cousin recovers quickly. [rival.He] flashes you a smarmy grin. “I still beat you to two of them. I’ll be sure to send you a message when I get the keys to Uncle Vic’s fortune.” Snapping [rival.his] fingers, [rival.name] calls, “Dane, lug this hunk of metal back to the ship. We’re out of here.”
rows.translation: “不！不行！[pc.he]还在旁边的时候不行！”你的堂亲惊慌起来，无力地拍打着闪亮金属。[rival.name]手边出现一道缝隙，随即向后收缩，露出一块不断闪烁、显示着一组坐标的电子屏幕。“该死，”[rival.he]咕哝道。[rival.his]表现值得肯定，你的堂亲很快便恢复了镇定。[rival.He]向你露出讨厌的假笑。“我还是比你先拿到了两个。等我拿到维克叔叔财产的钥匙，一定会给你发消息。”[rival.name]打了个[rival.his]响指，喊道：“戴恩，把这坨金属搬回飞船。我们离开这里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No! No! Not while [pc.he]’s around!” Your cousin panics, slapping ineffectually at the gleaming metal. I’ll be sure to send you a message when I get the keys to Uncle Vic’s fortune.” Snapping [rival.his] fingers, [rival.name] calls, “Dane, lug this hunk of metal back to the ship. We’re out of here.”"

rows.original: You finalize the payment and run your hands across the pod until it chimes. The tone is brief and almost musical. You’d expect to hear similar from a lift on a luxury planet. “DNA signature detected, welcome [pc.name] Steele,” a synthesized, female voice announces. A seam appears on the face of the gleaming metal, recessing itself down before sliding out of the way and into the body of the probe. Behind it, there’s a simple screen with a set of coordinates.
rows.translation: 你完成付款，双手在舱体上抚过，直到它发出一声轻响。音调短促，几乎像一段乐声。你想象中，豪华行星的电梯也会发出类似声音。“检测到DNA签名，欢迎[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”一个合成女声宣布道。闪亮金属正面出现一道缝隙，向下凹陷后滑开，收入探测器体内。后面露出一块简单屏幕，显示着一组坐标。

You’d expect to hear similar from a lift on a luxury planet. “DNA signature detected, welcome [pc.name] Steele,” a synthesized, female voice announces. A seam appears on the face of the gleaming metal, recessing itself down before sliding out of the way and into the body of the probe. Behind it, there’s a simple screen with a set of coordinates."

rows.original: You nod while turning to your codex. The coordinates correspond to another planet linked up by the rush - the only habitable world in the system. You had better head to Myrellion if you want to claim your father’s legacy, but first, there is the matter of this spent pod. You don’t need to lug it everywhere. You could give it to Shekka, sell it to her, or sell it back to your dad’s company.
rows.translation: 你点点头，转向自己的法典。这些坐标对应着大开拓期连接的另一颗行星——也是该星系唯一的宜居世界。如果想要继承父亲的遗产，你最好赶往米瑞利恩；不过在那之前，这个已经没用的探测舱还得处理。你没必要拖着它到处走。你可以把它送给谢卡，卖给她，或卖回你父亲的公司。
