rows.translation: 你生来就是为了侍奉与取悦，宁静的脑海从未闪过其他念头。你欣然跟在赛迪安摇曳的尾巴后面。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou live to serve and give pleasure, and it never crosses your peaceful mind to do anything other. You happily follow the Sydian’s swishing tail."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: It’s your instinct now to immediately obey, and it’s a struggle not to do so.
rows.translation: 立刻服从已成为你的本能，你得拼命才能忍住。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s your instinct now to immediately obey, and it’s a struggle not to do so."

rows.original: It’s a test of your iron fortitude not to immediately obey. Is... is there perhaps some danger here you’re not seeing?
rows.translation: 你必须动用钢铁般的意志才能不立刻服从。这里...是不是藏着你没发现的危险？
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a test of your iron fortitude not to immediately obey. Is... is there perhaps some danger here you’re not seeing?"

rows.original: Smash
rows.translation: 干她
rows.raw: "Smash"

rows.original: Smash
rows.translation: 干她
rows.raw: "Smash"

rows.original: Serve your queen.
rows.translation: 侍奉你的女王。
rows.raw: "Serve your queen."

rows.original: Not Today
rows.translation: 今天免了
rows.raw: "Not Today"

rows.original: Not Today
rows.translation: 今天免了
rows.raw: "Not Today"

rows.original: Danger, Will Robinson!
rows.translation: 危险，威尔·罗宾逊！
rows.raw: "Danger, Will Robinson!"

rows.original: What was once the crew chief’s office overlooking the flight deck has been converted into a U.G.C. scout base, complete with maps and star charts hanging from the walls and a massive board map dominating the center, with landmarks and racial analysis printouts scattered over it. Behind the chief’s desk sits a female kaithrit with her bright orange hair pulled back into a long ponytail.
rows.translation: 曾经俯瞰飞行甲板的机组长办公室，如今已被改造成一座U.G.C.侦察基地。墙上挂满地图与星图，中央摆着一块巨大的沙盘，上面散落着地标与种族分析报告。机组长办公桌后坐着一名女性凯斯瑞特，亮橙色长发扎成马尾。
rows.raw: "What was once the crew chief’s office overlooking the flight deck has been converted into a U.G.C. scout base, complete with maps and star charts hanging from the walls and a massive board map dominating the center, with landmarks and racial analysis printouts scattered over it. Behind the chief’s desk sits a female kaithrit with her bright orange hair pulled back into a long ponytail."

rows.original: Scout
rows.translation: 侦察员
rows.raw: "Scout"

rows.original: Scout
rows.translation: 侦察员
rows.raw: "Scout"

rows.original: Talk to the scout about security transportation to different parts of the planet.
rows.translation: 询问侦察员前往星球不同区域的安保运输服务。
rows.raw: "Talk to the scout about security transportation to different parts of the planet."

rows.original: A forgotten comm relay is sitting here, its antennas corroded with rust. If you knocked all the crud loose, it could probably get a signal again, allowing you to call for transport.
rows.translation: 这里放着一台被遗忘的通讯中继器，天线已锈蚀。如果把污垢敲掉，它大概能重新收到信号，让你呼叫交通工具。
rows.raw: "\n\nA forgotten comm relay is sitting here, its antennas corroded with rust. If you knocked all the crud loose, it could probably get a signal again, allowing you to call for transport."

rows.original: Fix Comms
rows.translation: 修理通讯
rows.raw: "Fix Comms"

rows.original: A few well placed kinetic repairs knock the crust loose from the antennas. The screen lights up. Perfect!
rows.translation: 几下恰到好处的动能维修便敲掉了天线上的锈壳。屏幕亮了起来。完美！
rows.raw: "A few well placed kinetic repairs knock the crust loose from the antennas. The screen lights up. Perfect!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The comm relay you fixed is sitting here, holoscreen illuminated. You could use it to call for a taxi if you wanted.
rows.translation: 你修好的通讯中继器就在这里，全息屏幕亮着。需要的话，你可以用它叫出租车。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe comm relay you fixed is sitting here, holoscreen illuminated. You could use it to call for a taxi if you wanted."

rows.original: Call Taxi
rows.translation: 呼叫出租车
rows.raw: "Call Taxi"

rows.original: You jab in a few commands, and a moment later, a holographic kaithrit appears onscreen. “Need a lift?” she offers.
rows.translation: 你输入几条指令，片刻后，一名凯斯瑞特的全息影像出现在屏幕上。“要搭车吗？”她问道。
rows.raw: "You jab in a few commands, and a moment later, a holographic kaithrit appears onscreen. “Need a lift?” she offers."

rows.original: You nod.
rows.translation: 你点点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod."

rows.original: “No problem. Where do you want to go?”
rows.translation: “没问题。想去哪儿？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No problem. Where do you want to go?”"

rows.original: You walk over to the pale woman in the corner sitting alone. As you draw closer, her gaze turns to you and you see her striking red reptilian eyes. You slow a moment, a little off balance due to their stark contrast to the rest of her. The break in your step causes her to shift, suck her teeth dismissively, then avert her gaze back to her drink.
rows.translation: 你走向角落里独坐的苍白女子。靠近后，她转眼望向你，你看见她醒目的红色爬虫眼睛。那双眼与她身体其他部分形成强烈反差，使你脚步一顿，有些失衡。你的迟疑令她挪了挪身子，不屑地咂嘴，随后又把目光移回酒杯。
rows.raw: "You walk over to the pale woman in the corner sitting alone. As you draw closer, her gaze turns to you and you see her striking red reptilian eyes. You slow a moment, a little off balance due to their stark contrast to the rest of her. The break in your step causes her to shift, suck her teeth dismissively, then avert her gaze back to her drink."

rows.original: You reach her and introduce yourself. “Hey there, name’s-”
rows.translation: 你走到她面前自我介绍。“你好，我叫——”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reach her and introduce yourself. “Hey there, name’s-”"

rows.original: The white woman cuts you off. “Would you mind just walking away? I’m really not in the mood and I don’t have time for your rehearsed icebreakers.”
rows.translation: 白色女子打断你。“能请你直接走开吗？我真没心情，也没时间听你排练好的开场白。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe white woman cuts you off. “Would you mind just walking away? I’m really not in the mood and I don’t have time for your rehearsed icebreakers.”"

rows.original: You pause a moment then continue. “[pc.name]...” You shift a moment, feeling a bit of tension. “[pc.name] Steele.”
rows.translation: 你停了一会儿，随后继续。“[pc.name]...”你挪了挪身子，感到有些紧张。“[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou pause a moment then continue. “[pc.name]...” You shift a moment, feeling a bit of tension. “[pc.name] Steele.”"

rows.original: The woman tilts her head slightly, showing a minimal amount of interest. “That’s nice.” She takes a sip of her drink, still not looking at you.
rows.translation: 女子微微歪头，表现出一丁点兴趣。“真不错。”她抿了口酒，仍没看你。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman tilts her head slightly, showing a minimal amount of interest. “That’s nice.” She takes a sip of her drink, still not looking at you."

rows.original: After a long few seconds you shift a bit, feeling awkward. Doesn’t that line usually work? She takes another sip from her drink then sucks her teeth again. “Look kid. I’m sure you expect that to mean something to me. It doesn’t. So move along.”
rows.translation: 漫长的几秒后，你尴尬地动了动。那句通常不是很管用吗？她又抿了一口酒，再次咂嘴。“听着，小鬼。我猜你觉得这个名字对我该有点意义。没有。赶紧走。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a long few seconds you shift a bit, feeling awkward. Doesn’t that line usually work? She takes another sip from her drink then sucks her teeth again. “Look kid. I’m sure you expect that to mean something to me. It doesn’t. So move along.”"

rows.original: “Kid?” You repeat out loud, and take another step closer, standing better in the light above her table.
rows.translation: “小鬼？”你大声重复，又向前一步，更清楚地站在她桌上方的灯光下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Kid?” You repeat out loud, and take another step closer, standing better in the light above her table. "

rows.original: “I’m really not that young compared to you. Unless you’re older than you look.”
rows.translation: “和你相比，我真没那么年轻。除非你比看起来老。”
rows.raw: "“I’m really not that young compared to you. Unless you’re older than you look.”"

rows.original: “I’m not an expert, but if I had to guess you can’t be much older than me. In fact, I might even be older than you.”
rows.translation: “我不是专家，但要我猜，你应该不会比我大多少。其实我甚至可能比你年长。”
rows.raw: "“I’m not an expert, but if I had to guess you can’t be much older than me. In fact, I might even be older than you.”"

rows.original: “Who exactly are you calling a kid?”
rows.translation: “你到底叫谁小鬼？”
rows.raw: "“Who exactly are you calling a kid?”"

rows.original: The woman turns her head slightly, regarding you again for the first time since her initial look. Dark black slits in her red orbs shift around slowly taking you in. <i>“Ah. My mistake. I thought you were... Never mind... Just keep walking please
rows.translation: 女子微微转头，自初次一瞥后第一次重新审视你。红色眼球里的漆黑竖瞳缓缓移动，把你从头看到脚。<i>“啊，是我弄错了。我以为你是...算了...请继续走吧，斯蒂尔
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman turns her head slightly, regarding you again for the first time since her initial look. Dark black slits in her red orbs shift around slowly taking you in. <i>“Ah. My mistake. I thought you were... Never mind... Just keep walking please "

rows.original: Mr.
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "Mr."

rows.original: Ms.
rows.translation: 女士
rows.raw: "Ms."

rows.original: Steele, I’m not interested.”
rows.translation: ，我没兴趣。”
rows.raw: " Steele, I’m not interested.”"

rows.original: Sensing a marginally lighter tone after her mistake, you turn back on the Steele charm for another quick pass. Maybe she’ll be more receptive now that the ice is broken?
rows.translation: 察觉她认错后语气稍有缓和，你再次施展斯蒂尔式魅力，迅速再试一次。既然已经破冰，也许她会更愿意接受？
rows.raw: "\n\nSensing a marginally lighter tone after her mistake, you turn back on the Steele charm for another quick pass. Maybe she’ll be more receptive now that the ice is broken? "

rows.original: “Come on now, let me buy you a drink. Drinking alone isn’t fun.”
rows.translation: “别这样，让我请你喝一杯吧。一个人喝酒可没意思。”
rows.raw: "“Come on now, let me buy you a drink. Drinking alone isn’t fun.”"

rows.original: “Not interested? But you don’t know what I’m offering. It’s quite a bit of fun.”
rows.translation: “没兴趣？可你还不知道我要提供什么。那可是相当有趣。”
rows.raw: "“Not interested? But you don’t know what I’m offering. It’s quite a bit of fun.”"

rows.original: “It’s going to take a bit more than that to scare me off. I’ve seen worse bite before.”
rows.translation: “光凭这点可吓不退我。我见过咬得更狠的。”
rows.raw: "“It’s going to take a bit more than that to scare me off. I’ve seen worse bite before.”"

rows.original: The woman’s gaze narrows a bit, seemingly getting quite annoyed. You watch as her free hand slips off the table towards her hip. “Leave.” You hear the faint sound of a blaster activating under the table. Did she just draw a gun on you?!
rows.translation: 女子眯起眼睛，显然越来越恼火。你看到她空着的手从桌面滑向腰间。“滚。”你听见桌下传来爆能枪启动的轻响。她刚刚拿枪指着你了吗？！
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman’s gaze narrows a bit, seemingly getting quite annoyed. You watch as her free hand slips off the table towards her hip. “Leave.” You hear the faint sound of a blaster activating under the table. Did she just draw a gun on you?!"

rows.original: The threat is clear. You stare back at her a moment in disbelief. Is she going to shoot you for hitting on her?
rows.translation: 威胁再明显不过。你难以置信地盯了她一会儿。她要因为你搭讪就开枪吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nThe threat is clear. You stare back at her a moment in disbelief. Is she going to shoot you for hitting on her?"

rows.original: Your fingers twitch, itching to reach for your own weapon.
rows.translation: 你的手指抽动，迫不及待地想伸向自己的武器。
rows.raw: " Your fingers twitch, itching to reach for your own weapon."

rows.original: Examining her glare, you believe she would. For some reason, looking into those orbs, you know this woman is dangerous. You back away slowly, defeated. “Can I at least get your name? I’d at least know the name of the woman threatening to kill me.”
rows.translation: 观察她的怒视后，你相信她真会开枪。出于某种原因，望着那双眼睛，你知道这个女人很危险。你认输般缓缓后退。“至少能告诉我你的名字吗？这样我至少知道是谁在威胁杀我。”
rows.raw: " Examining her glare, you believe she would. For some reason, looking into those orbs, you know this woman is dangerous. You back away slowly, defeated. “Can I at least get your name? I’d at least know the name of the woman threatening to kill me.”"

rows.original: The woman frowns. <i>“It’s Tessa. Now leave
rows.translation: 女子皱眉。<i>“我叫泰莎。现在滚，斯蒂尔
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman frowns. <i>“It’s Tessa. Now leave "

rows.original: Mr.
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "Mr."

rows.original: Ms.
rows.translation: 女士
rows.raw: "Ms."

rows.original: Steele.”
rows.raw: " Steele.”"

rows.original: You nod your head slightly and move away from the table, leaving the white woman alone with her drink and gun.
rows.translation: 你微微点头，离开桌边，留下那名白色女子独自面对她的酒与枪。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod your head slightly and move away from the table, leaving the white woman alone with her drink and gun."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: You decide to try your luck with Tessa again. She spots you a few paces away from her and takes a big gulp from her drink. You also can’t help but notice her right hand drops below the table. When you reach the table she looks over at you, her red eyes boring a hole into your skull.
rows.translation: 你决定再去泰莎那里碰碰运气。她在几步外便发现你，猛灌了一大口酒。你还注意到她的右手垂到了桌下。你走到桌边，她转眼望来，红色双眼仿佛要在你的头骨上烧出一个洞。
rows.raw: "You decide to try your luck with Tessa again. She spots you a few paces away from her and takes a big gulp from her drink. You also can’t help but notice her right hand drops below the table. When you reach the table she looks over at you, her red eyes boring a hole into your skull."

rows.original: “Are you being serious right now?” Her tone is calm, with no hint of rage. “Didn’t we already go over this?”
rows.translation: “你现在是认真的吗？”她语气平静，毫无怒意。“我们不是已经说清楚了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are you being serious right now?” Her tone is calm, with no hint of rage. “Didn’t we already go over this?”"

rows.original: You shift your weight a bit, “I figured...” You cut yourself off and take a step back. “I’m sorry, I’ll leave you be.” You turn to leave, hearing Tessa mutter something under her breath as you leave earshot.
rows.translation: 你挪了挪重心。“我觉得...”你打断自己，后退一步。“抱歉，我不打扰你了。”你转身离开，走出听力范围时听见泰莎低声嘟囔了些什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shift your weight a bit, “I figured...” You cut yourself off and take a step back. “I’m sorry, I’ll leave you be.” You turn to leave, hearing Tessa mutter something under her breath as you leave earshot."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: You decide to try your luck with Tessa again. She spots you a few paces away from her and takes a big gulp from her drink. You also can’t help but notice her right hand dropped below the table. When you reach the table she looks over at you, her red eyes boring a hole into your skull.
rows.translation: 你决定再去泰莎那里碰碰运气。她在几步外便发现你，猛灌了一大口酒。你还注意到她的右手已经垂到桌下。你走到桌边，她转眼望来，红色双眼仿佛要在你的头骨上烧出一个洞。
rows.raw: "You decide to try your luck with Tessa again. She spots you a few paces away from her and takes a big gulp from her drink. You also can’t help but notice her right hand dropped below the table. When you reach the table she looks over at you, her red eyes boring a hole into your skull."

rows.original: “Are you being serious right now?” Her tone is calm, with no hint of rage. “Didn’t we already go over this?”
rows.translation: “你现在是认真的吗？”她语气平静，毫无怒意。“我们不是已经说清楚了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are you being serious right now?” Her tone is calm, with no hint of rage. “Didn’t we already go over this?”"

rows.original: You slowly raise your hands and move to the opposite side of the table. “Relax, I’m not here to hit on you.”
rows.translation: 你缓缓举起双手，走到桌子另一边。“放松，我不是来搭讪的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou slowly raise your hands and move to the opposite side of the table. “Relax, I’m not here to hit on you.”"

rows.original: You give a small wink. “This time.”
rows.translation: 你轻轻眨眼。“这次不是。”
rows.raw: " You give a small wink. “This time.”"

rows.original: You slowly take a seat and place your palms flat on the table. “I’m here on business.”
rows.translation: 你缓缓坐下，把双掌平放在桌上。“我是来谈生意的。”
rows.raw: " You slowly take a seat and place your palms flat on the table. “I’m here on business.”"

rows.original: Tessa’s gaze softens, then twists into a skeptical expression. “Business? With me?” Her tone shifts, she seems more curious now, but still on guard. She slides her drink away from her, opening up space between her and you. “What business could we have together?”
rows.translation: 泰莎的目光缓和下来，随后变得怀疑。“生意？跟我？”她的语调变了，似乎更加好奇，却仍保持戒备。她把酒杯推开，在你们之间腾出空间。“我们能有什么生意可谈？”
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa’s gaze softens, then twists into a skeptical expression. “Business? With me?” Her tone shifts, she seems more curious now, but still on guard. She slides her drink away from her, opening up space between her and you. “What business could we have together?”"

rows.original: You take a deep breath. “I want to hire you.” You watch her expression closely, trying to sense if her mood changes.
rows.translation: 你深吸一口气。“我想雇用你。”你密切观察她的表情，试图判断她的情绪是否变化。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a deep breath. “I want to hire you.” You watch her expression closely, trying to sense if her mood changes."

rows.original: Tessa scoffs slightly. “Hire me? Do you... Even know what I do?” She shifts a bit in her seat, seemingly getting comfortable.
rows.translation: 泰莎轻蔑地哼了一声。“雇用我？你...到底知不知道我是做什么的？”她在座位上动了动，似乎坐得更舒服了。
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa scoffs slightly. “Hire me? Do you... Even know what I do?” She shifts a bit in her seat, seemingly getting comfortable."

rows.original: You smile a bit, getting ready to play your hand. “You’re a Bounty Hunter.”
rows.translation: 你微微一笑，准备亮出底牌。“你是赏金猎人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou smile a bit, getting ready to play your hand. “You’re a Bounty Hunter.”"

rows.original: Tessa chuckles, seemingly amused at your declaration. “Bounty Hunter huh? And what does a go getter like you need with a Bounty Hunter?” Her red eyes examine you closely, in a way they haven’t before. For the first time she really looks at you. “No. You don’t want to hire me.” She reaches for her drink and takes a big gulp.
rows.translation: 泰莎轻笑，似乎被你的宣言逗乐了。“赏金猎人，是吗？像你这样干劲十足的人，要赏金猎人做什么？”她的红眼以前所未有的方式仔细审视你。她第一次真正看清你。“不，你并不想雇我。”她伸手拿起酒杯，猛灌一口。
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa chuckles, seemingly amused at your declaration. “Bounty Hunter huh? And what does a go getter like you need with a Bounty Hunter?” Her red eyes examine you closely, in a way they haven’t before. For the first time she really looks at you. “No. You don’t want to hire me.” She reaches for her drink and takes a big gulp."

rows.original: You raise a brow. “What? Why do you say that? Of course I want to hire you...”
rows.translation: 你挑眉。“什么？为什么这么说？我当然想雇你...”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou raise a brow. “What? Why do you say that? Of course I want to hire you...”"

rows.original: The white woman waves her hand at you, dismissing your claim. “Please. Spare me that crap. You strike me as a...” She stares at you again, those red orbs seeming to read your soul. “..Do it yourself kind of person.” She points at you with a sharp finger. “I can tell.”
rows.translation: 白色女子冲你摆手，对你的说法不屑一顾。“拜托，少来这套。你给我的感觉像是个...”她再次盯着你，那双红眼仿佛能看穿灵魂。“...凡事喜欢亲自动手的人。”她用尖细的手指指着你。“我看得出来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe white woman waves her hand at you, dismissing your claim. “Please. Spare me that crap. You strike me as a...” She stares at you again, those red orbs seeming to read your soul. “..Do it yourself kind of person.” She points at you with a sharp finger. “I can tell.”"

rows.original: You raise your hands in surrender and sigh. “Alright, you got me.” You ease back your posture a bit more, getting comfortable. All the danger seems to have vanished from her eyes. “So you admit it then?”
rows.translation: 你举手投降，叹了口气。“好吧，被你看穿了。”你稍稍放松姿势，让自己坐得舒服些。她眼中的危险似乎全消失了。“所以你承认了？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou raise your hands in surrender and sigh. “Alright, you got me.” You ease back your posture a bit more, getting comfortable. All the danger seems to have vanished from her eyes. “So you admit it then?”"

rows.original: She takes another gulp from her drink, seemingly indifferent to your presence now. “Hm? Admit what?”
rows.translation: 她又灌了一口酒，似乎已经不在乎你的存在。“嗯？承认什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe takes another gulp from her drink, seemingly indifferent to your presence now. “Hm? Admit what?”"

rows.original: You roll your eyes and can’t help but smirk a bit now. “That you’re a Bounty Hunter.”
rows.translation: 你翻了翻眼睛，忍不住露出坏笑。“承认你是赏金猎人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou roll your eyes and can’t help but smirk a bit now. “That you’re a Bounty Hunter.”"

rows.original: Tessa stares at you a moment, and for that moment you feel a tingle run up your spine as her red eyes narrow again. After a long few heartbeats she sighs and her gaze soften and looks away. “It’s not quite correct, but I suppose you could call me that.” She takes another gulp and finishes her drink. “Great I’m empty now. Dealing with you made me drink faster than I like.” She returns her gaze to you, expectantly. “Well?”
rows.translation: 泰莎盯了你一会儿；那一刻，她再次眯起红眼，令你脊背发麻。漫长的几次心跳后，她叹气，目光缓和并移向别处。“不算完全正确，不过你要这么称呼也行。”她又喝一大口，把酒喝光。“太好了，空了。应付你让我喝得比平时快。”她期待地重新望向你。“所以呢？”
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa stares at you a moment, and for that moment you feel a tingle run up your spine as her red eyes narrow again. After a long few heartbeats she sighs and her gaze soften and looks away. “It’s not quite correct, but I suppose you could call me that.” She takes another gulp and finishes her drink. “Great I’m empty now. Dealing with you made me drink faster than I like.” She returns her gaze to you, expectantly. “Well?”"

rows.original: You stare at her a moment, unsure of her intentions. She gives her empty glass a tap with her sharp nails and you immediately understand. She wants you to buy her a drink. You stand up and head over to the bar.
rows.translation: 你盯着她，不明白她的意思。她用尖锐指甲敲敲空杯，你立刻懂了。她要你请喝酒。你起身走向吧台。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stare at her a moment, unsure of her intentions. She gives her empty glass a tap with her sharp nails and you immediately understand. She wants you to buy her a drink. You stand up and head over to the bar. "

rows.original: You return a few moments later with a new glass for the pale woman.
rows.translation: 片刻后，你拿着一杯新酒回到苍白女子身边。
rows.raw: "You return a few moments later with a new glass for the pale woman."

rows.original: Realizing your broke, you take a quick look around and spot an unattended glass waiting to be sent out. After a quick look around, you grab the glass and make your way back to Tessa, trying to look casual.
rows.translation: 意识到自己身无分文，你迅速环顾四周，发现一杯无人看管、正等着送出的酒。确认没人注意后，你抓起酒杯走回泰莎身边，努力表现得若无其事。
rows.raw: "Realizing your broke, you take a quick look around and spot an unattended glass waiting to be sent out. After a quick look around, you grab the glass and make your way back to Tessa, trying to look casual."

rows.original: She takes the drink and takes a small sip. “Okay Steele, you win. I’ll let you stay until this drink is done.”
rows.translation: 她接过酒，小抿一口。“好吧，斯蒂尔，你赢了。这杯喝完前，我允许你待在这里。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe takes the drink and takes a small sip. “Okay Steele, you win. I’ll let you stay until this drink is done.”"

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.original: Engage with your new friend.
rows.translation: 和你的新朋友聊聊。
rows.raw: "Engage with your new friend."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: You spot Tessa in her normal spot in the corner of the bar. Her knife is still embedded into the table, and more than a few empty beer glasses are littered around. Taking a deep breath, you head on over.
rows.translation: 你在酒吧角落的老位置看见泰莎。她的刀仍插在桌上，周围散落着不少空啤酒杯。你深吸一口气，走了过去。
rows.raw: "You spot Tessa in her normal spot in the corner of the bar. Her knife is still embedded into the table, and more than a few empty beer glasses are littered around. Taking a deep breath, you head on over."

rows.original: You reach the table and stand behind your normal seat. Tessa is starting down into her drink and does not acknowledge you. You take a seat and sit there in silence a few moments.
rows.translation: 你走到桌边，站在惯常座位后。泰莎低头盯着酒，没有理会你。你坐下，默默待了片刻。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reach the table and stand behind your normal seat. Tessa is starting down into her drink and does not acknowledge you. You take a seat and sit there in silence a few moments."

rows.original: “I was raised a girl you know.” She speaks after a long few minutes. Her speech is slurred, she’s drunk or at least well on her way. “Not saying that was wrong, but I was. I was born female, so it made sense, right? They had me tested. Most ovir don’t have that happen to them. I was a girl and I knew it for as long as I can remember.” She went quiet again and took a big gulp of her drink.
rows.translation: “你知道吗，我是被当作女孩养大的。”漫长的几分钟后，她开口了。她口齿含糊，已经醉了，至少也快醉了。“不是说这有什么错，但确实如此。我出生时是女性，所以这样很合理，对吧？他们还给我做了检测。大多数欧维尔都不会经历这些。我是个女孩，从记事起便一直知道。”她再次沉默，猛灌了一口酒。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I was raised a girl you know.” She speaks after a long few minutes. Her speech is slurred, she’s drunk or at least well on her way. “Not saying that was wrong, but I was. I was born female, so it made sense, right? They had me tested. Most ovir don’t have that happen to them. I was a girl and I knew it for as long as I can remember.” She went quiet again and took a big gulp of her drink."

rows.original: You ask her how much she’s had to drink. You count at least ten glasses on the table, but knowing her she was likely a few deep before.
rows.translation: 你问她喝了多少。桌上至少有十只杯子，但以她的习惯，你来之前多半已经喝了几杯。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her how much she’s had to drink. You count at least ten glasses on the table, but knowing her she was likely a few deep before."

rows.original: Tessa just shakes her head. “Don’t care, lost count.” She sighs a bit and lifts her head for the first time sit you sat down. Her eyes are puffy, she’s been crying. “I thought I was over this shit, but whenever I feel like I’ve forgotten somebody comes alon-” She cuts herself off and goes quiet. She sits there a long time without saying anything. You both do.
rows.translation: 泰莎只是摇头。“不在乎，数不清了。”她轻叹一声，自你坐下后第一次抬头。双眼浮肿，她哭过。“我以为自己早就放下这破事了，可每当我觉得已经忘记，总会有人出——”她突然住口，再次沉默。她长时间一言不发，你也一样。
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa just shakes her head. “Don’t care, lost count.” She sighs a bit and lifts her head for the first time sit you sat down. Her eyes are puffy, she’s been crying. “I thought I was over this shit, but whenever I feel like I’ve forgotten somebody comes alon-” She cuts herself off and goes quiet. She sits there a long time without saying anything. You both do."

rows.original: After a few minutes she sets her glass down and reaches for her knife. With a yank she pulls it from the table and looks over the blade. “Sorry I... you know... You didn’t mean anything by it. I know that. I KNEW that. I just...” She moves the blade to the sheath on her hip and slides it in. “I’m a mess... I need to go.” She starts to stand up and wobbles a bit.
rows.translation: 几分钟后，她放下酒杯，伸手去拿刀。她猛地把刀从桌上拔出，端详刀刃。“抱歉，我...你懂的...你没有恶意，我知道。我明明知道。我只是...”她把刀送回腰间刀鞘。“我一团糟...得走了。”她开始起身，却摇晃了一下。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a few minutes she sets her glass down and reaches for her knife. With a yank she pulls it from the table and looks over the blade. “Sorry I... you know... You didn’t mean anything by it. I know that. I KNEW that. I just...” She moves the blade to the sheath on her hip and slides it in. “I’m a mess... I need to go.” She starts to stand up and wobbles a bit."

rows.original: You jolt up and grab her arm, stopping her from falling over. She yanks her arm away and scowls. “Don’t... I don’t need...” She staggers a bit, then holds onto the edge of the table for support. “Fuck... I can’t...” Her eyes start to well up again. She bites her lip, clearly frustrated.
rows.translation: 你猛地站起，抓住她的手臂，免得她摔倒。她甩开你，怒目而视。“别...我不需要...”她踉跄一下，只得扶住桌边。“操...我不行...”她眼中再次泛起泪光，咬住嘴唇，显然十分懊恼。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou jolt up and grab her arm, stopping her from falling over. She yanks her arm away and scowls. “Don’t... I don’t need...” She staggers a bit, then holds onto the edge of the table for support. “Fuck... I can’t...” Her eyes start to well up again. She bites her lip, clearly frustrated."

rows.original: You reach out again, offering to help her back to her ship or wherever she is staying.
rows.translation: 你再次伸手，表示可以送她回飞船或住处。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reach out again, offering to help her back to her ship or wherever she is staying."

rows.original: Tessa stands there a long moment, holding onto the table and looking at the floor. She thinks to herself for a few moments then raises her head. She nods.
rows.translation: 泰莎扶着桌子，低头站了很久。她思索片刻，随后抬头，点了点。
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa stands there a long moment, holding onto the table and looking at the floor. She thinks to herself for a few moments then raises her head. She nods."

rows.original: A few minutes later the two of you are walking towards the hangar, her arm over your shoulder and your arm around her waist. Her head is rolled back and is staring off in the distance, tears still in her eyes. She breaks the silence first. “I only let you help me because it’s what a woman should do. Or at least what I think I woman should do.”
rows.translation: 几分钟后，你们朝机库走去。她的手臂搭在你肩上，你搂着她的腰。她仰着头望向远方，眼中仍含着泪。她先打破沉默。“我让你帮忙，只因为女人就该这么做。至少我觉得女人该这么做。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA few minutes later the two of you are walking towards the hangar, her arm over your shoulder and your arm around her waist. Her head is rolled back and is staring off in the distance, tears still in her eyes. She breaks the silence first. “I only let you help me because it’s what a woman should do. Or at least what I think I woman should do.”"

rows.original: You frown a bit at that.
rows.translation: 你听得微微皱眉。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou frown a bit at that. "

rows.original: “It’s not just women who need help getting home you know.”
rows.translation: “需要别人帮忙回家的人又不只有女人。”
rows.raw: "“It’s not just women who need help getting home you know.”"

rows.original: “I don’t think needing help getting home after drinking your ass off is exclusive to women.”
rows.translation: “喝得烂醉后需要人送回家，可不是女人的专利。”
rows.raw: "“I don’t think needing help getting home after drinking your ass off is exclusive to women.”"

rows.original: . “You shouldn’t only ask for help because of what’s between your legs.”
rows.translation: 。“你不该只因为两腿之间有什么才求助。”
rows.raw: ". “You shouldn’t only ask for help because of what’s between your legs.”"

rows.original: She gives a loud snort at that and starts to laugh. “Yeah, you’re right about that.” She points a long white finger at a sleek black ship, the name Ebony scrawled on the hull. “That would be me.” She stops and pulls away from you, staggering a little bit. “I can make it from here.” Her eyes seem glazed over, but she shifts them to look at you. “You’re a good drinking buddy.. And I’m not just saying that because you haven’t tried to sleep with me.” She reaches out and taps your nose, smirking.
rows.translation: 她大声哼气，随后笑了起来。“嗯，你说得对。”她用白色长指指向一艘流线型黑船，船壳上潦草写着“乌木号”。“那就是我的船。”她停下脚步，从你身边挣开，微微踉跄。“从这里我能自己走。”她目光朦胧，却仍转眼看你。“你是个不错的酒友..我这么说，可不只是因为你没想跟我上床。”她伸手点了点你的鼻子，露出坏笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives a loud snort at that and starts to laugh. “Yeah, you’re right about that.” She points a long white finger at a sleek black ship, the name Ebony scrawled on the hull. “That would be me.” She stops and pulls away from you, staggering a little bit. “I can make it from here.” Her eyes seem glazed over, but she shifts them to look at you. “You’re a good drinking buddy.. And I’m not just saying that because you haven’t tried to sleep with me.” She reaches out and taps your nose, smirking."

rows.original: You sigh to yourself as you watch the drunken ovir stagger over to her ship, waving as she walks away. She shouts back at you, “let’s pretend this didn’t happen, okay?”
rows.translation: 你看着醉醺醺的欧维尔摇晃着走向飞船，叹了口气。她一边离开一边挥手，回头喊道：“我们就当这事没发生，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sigh to yourself as you watch the drunken ovir stagger over to her ship, waving as she walks away. She shouts back at you, “let’s pretend this didn’t happen, okay?”"

rows.original: You call back saying you’d like that. You’re not sure if she heard.
rows.translation: 你回喊说正合心意。你不确定她听见没有。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou call back saying you’d like that. You’re not sure if she heard."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You take your normal seat across from Tessa, the ovir woman glancing over at you and sighing. “Won’t be able to stay long Steele. I’ve got business to take care of.”
rows.translation: 你在泰莎对面的惯常位置坐下。欧维尔女子瞥你一眼，叹了口气。“不能久留，斯蒂尔。我还有事情要处理。”
rows.raw: "You take your normal seat across from Tessa, the ovir woman glancing over at you and sighing. “Won’t be able to stay long Steele. I’ve got business to take care of.”"

rows.original: You can’t help but frown at that, considering how little the white woman did on a daily basis aside from drink. “What sort of business?”
rows.translation: 想到这名白色女子每天除了喝酒几乎什么都不做，你忍不住皱眉。“什么事情？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t help but frown at that, considering how little the white woman did on a daily basis aside from drink. “What sort of business?”"

rows.original: Tessa takes a sip of her drink and sighs. “My job.”
rows.translation: 泰莎抿了口酒，叹息道：“我的工作。”
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa takes a sip of her drink and sighs. “My job.”"

rows.original: “Ah.” You sit in silence a moment. It came up so rarely you had almost forgotten your scaled friend was a professional killer. You clear your throat and shift in your seat. “So, are you... killing somebody in particular or....?”
rows.translation: “啊。”你沉默片刻。她很少提起这件事，你都快忘了这位有鳞朋友是个职业杀手。你清清嗓子，在座位上挪了挪。“那么，你是要...杀某个特定的人，还是...？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah.” You sit in silence a moment. It came up so rarely you had almost forgotten your scaled friend was a professional killer. You clear your throat and shift in your seat. “So, are you... killing somebody in particular or....?”"

rows.original: The white ovir looks at you for a long moment, her face difficult to read. “Yeah. I am. We don’t... have to talk about this, you know.” You notice Tessa’s eyes twitch a bit, she was forcing herself to look at you.
rows.translation: 白色欧维尔久久望着你，神情难以解读。“对。是的。我们...其实不用谈这件事。”你注意到泰莎眼角抽动，她在强迫自己直视你。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe white ovir looks at you for a long moment, her face difficult to read. “Yeah. I am. We don’t... have to talk about this, you know.” You notice Tessa’s eyes twitch a bit, she was forcing herself to look at you."

rows.original: You shrug. The topic wasn’t the worst in the world, and if there was ever a time to talk about it... “Tell me about your target.”
rows.translation: 你耸耸肩。这话题还不算世上最糟的；而且若真有适合谈论的时机...“说说你的目标吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shrug. The topic wasn’t the worst in the world, and if there was ever a time to talk about it... “Tell me about your target.”"

rows.original: Tessa shifts in her seat. “Nothing much to say really. Just some pirate, or ex-pirate rather. Crossed the wrong people and now... well...” Tessa takes another sip of her drink. “Let’s just say his old crew doesn’t want him talking to certain people.”
rows.translation: 泰莎在座位上动了动。“其实没什么可说的。只是个海盗，更准确地说是前海盗。他得罪了不该得罪的人，现在...嗯...”泰莎又抿了口酒。“这么说吧，他的老船员不希望他跟某些人开口。”
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa shifts in her seat. “Nothing much to say really. Just some pirate, or ex-pirate rather. Crossed the wrong people and now... well...” Tessa takes another sip of her drink. “Let’s just say his old crew doesn’t want him talking to certain people.”"

rows.original: “So he deserves to die then?” You ask the question flatly, trying not to sound judgemental. The ovir sighs and pulls out a datapad from her pocket, sliding it over to you. Taking a peek, you see a picture of a rather scruffy looking man, and a very lengthy list of his alleged crimes. “Ah.” You scroll through a few, starting to get the idea after a few of the more graphic charges. You slide the datapad back to the ovir and she repockets it.
rows.translation: “所以他该死？”你平淡地问，尽量不显得在评判。欧维尔叹气，从口袋取出数据板推给你。你瞄了一眼，看见一个颇为邋遢的男人，以及一长串据称由他犯下的罪行。“啊。”你翻过几项，看到几条更加露骨的指控后便明白了。你把数据板推回去，欧维尔重新收好。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So he deserves to die then?” You ask the question flatly, trying not to sound judgemental. The ovir sighs and pulls out a datapad from her pocket, sliding it over to you. Taking a peek, you see a picture of a rather scruffy looking man, and a very lengthy list of his alleged crimes. “Ah.” You scroll through a few, starting to get the idea after a few of the more graphic charges. You slide the datapad back to the ovir and she repockets it."

rows.original: “Yeah. Real piece of work.” Tessa sips her drink again then coughs a bit. “Subject change? Subject change. So... Sleep with anybody fun lately?” The white women smirks at you, leaning in a bit. “Don’t be shy, I know you get around.”
rows.translation: “对，彻头彻尾的混账。”泰莎又抿一口酒，轻咳几声。“换话题？换话题。所以...最近和什么有趣的人上床了吗？”白色女子冲你坏笑，稍稍靠近。“别害羞，我知道你很风流。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah. Real piece of work.” Tessa sips her drink again then coughs a bit. “Subject change? Subject change. So... Sleep with anybody fun lately?” The white women smirks at you, leaning in a bit. “Don’t be shy, I know you get around.”"

rows.original: Chuckling a bit, you start to tell Tessa about a few notable exploits of yours, but the ovir cuts you off after you drop a few tales. “Right, like I should believe that shit. Look, I believe you get some mad.... well whatever it is you get, you get it a lot.” When you insist you’re being honest, Tessa rolls her eyes. “Prove it.”
rows.translation: 你轻笑着开始讲述几段值得一提的艳遇，但欧维尔听了几则便打断你。“得了吧，我才不信这些鬼话。听着，我相信你能搞到不少疯狂的...管它是什么，反正你经常搞得到。”你坚持自己说的都是真的，泰莎翻了翻眼睛。“证明给我看。”
rows.raw: "\n\nChuckling a bit, you start to tell Tessa about a few notable exploits of yours, but the ovir cuts you off after you drop a few tales. “Right, like I should believe that shit. Look, I believe you get some mad.... well whatever it is you get, you get it a lot.” When you insist you’re being honest, Tessa rolls her eyes. “Prove it.”"

rows.original: You smirk at the woman and show her a few of the trophies you’ve gathered over your travels. Tessa looks at the pile of panties and gives them a soft sniff, then leans in close to them and sticks her long ovir tongue out. For a second you think she’s going to lick the pile, but instead she wiggles her studded tongue around your collection. “Huh.” Tessa leans back in her chair taking another sip from her drink. “All from different women. Good work.”
rows.translation: 你冲她坏笑，展示旅途中收集的一些战利品。泰莎看着那堆内裤，轻轻嗅闻，随后凑近，伸出欧维尔长舌。你一度以为她要舔上去，但她只是让带钉的舌头在收藏品周围摆动。“嗯。”泰莎靠回椅背，又抿了口酒。“来自不同女人。干得不错。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou smirk at the woman and show her a few of the trophies you’ve gathered over your travels. Tessa looks at the pile of panties and gives them a soft sniff, then leans in close to them and sticks her long ovir tongue out. For a second you think she’s going to lick the pile, but instead she wiggles her studded tongue around your collection. “Huh.” Tessa leans back in her chair taking another sip from her drink. “All from different women. Good work.”"

rows.original: You crack a small smile. “Maybe one of these days I could add something of yours to my collection.”
rows.translation: 你露出浅笑。“也许哪天能把你的东西也加入收藏。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou crack a small smile. “Maybe one of these days I could add something of yours to my collection.”"

rows.original: Tessa stares at you a moment, slight annoyance in her eyes. After a long tense pause, she sighs and rubs her face. “Steele. Do you realize I’ve never kissed you?” You think about it for a moment. Assuming she only means on the lips then she isn’t wrong. “I’m sure you’ve also realized we’ve never properly fucked either.” The ovir takes another sip from her drink, letting that sink in. “We’ve come close mind you, dangerously close in fact...” Tessa smiles a bit, her tail wagging behind her. “But nothing that would cause somebody to lose their V-card over. I always keep you back, do you know why?”
rows.translation: 泰莎盯了你片刻，眼中略有恼意。漫长而紧张的停顿后，她叹气揉脸。“斯蒂尔。你有没有意识到，我从没吻过你？”你想了想。假如她只指嘴唇，那确实没错。“你肯定也发现，我们从未真正做爱。”欧维尔又抿一口，让你消化这句话。“当然，我们很接近过，事实上危险地接近过...”泰莎微微一笑，尾巴在身后摇晃。“但没做过会让谁丢掉初夜的事。我总和你保持距离，知道为什么吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa stares at you a moment, slight annoyance in her eyes. After a long tense pause, she sighs and rubs her face. “Steele.
