rows.raw: "\n\nThe ovir frowns at you. “No shithead. I’m upset because... Look I’m not like most women. I don’t have a proper set of tits or normal cunt.” She sighs and grabs her drink, taking a long pull from it. “Cards on the table? No bullshit? I’m just a bit worried you might... Not be kind. Like I said, I value our time together. If it ended because...” She groans a bit. “I’m an ovir. Ovir aren’t born with nipples. There, that’s your biology lesson for the day. You fine with that?”"

rows.original: You nod.
rows.translation: 你点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod."

rows.original: “And my cun-...my cloaca? Your fine with that too?”
rows.translation: “还有我的骚——...我的泄殖腔？你也能接受？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And my cun-...my cloaca? Your fine with that too?”"

rows.original: You roll your eyes and nod again.
rows.translation: 你翻了翻眼睛，再次点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou roll your eyes and nod again."

rows.original: Tessa smiles at you, a weight seemingly lifted off her shoulders. “Awesome.” She finishes her beer. “Now excuse me. I’ve got to go and take a shower, gonna try to wash all this sap off me”
rows.translation: 泰莎冲你微笑，仿佛卸下了肩头重担。“太好了。”她喝完啤酒。“现在失陪。我得去洗澡，试试把身上这些汁液洗掉。”
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa smiles at you, a weight seemingly lifted off her shoulders. “Awesome.” She finishes her beer. “Now excuse me. I’ve got to go and take a shower, gonna try to wash all this sap off me”"

rows.original: Without any goodbye, Tessa rises from her seat and walks off, her tail wagging behind her.
rows.translation: 泰莎没有告别便离座走开，尾巴在身后摇晃。
rows.raw: "\n\nWithout any goodbye, Tessa rises from her seat and walks off, her tail wagging behind her."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You rise up and bid Tessa a farewell.
rows.translation: 你站起来向泰莎告别。
rows.raw: "You rise up and bid Tessa a farewell."

rows.original: She looks at you and sighs. “Thank God, all this talking is making my throat dry.” Her red eyes shift down to her drink, and she resumes her loner behavior.
rows.translation: 她看着你叹气。“谢天谢地，说这么多话弄得我嗓子都干了。”她的红眼移向酒杯，恢复独来独往的样子。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe looks at you and sighs. “Thank God, all this talking is making my throat dry.” Her red eyes shift down to her drink, and she resumes her loner behavior."

rows.original: Walking away, you hear her take a long, loud sip from her beer.
rows.translation: 你走开时，听见她大声、长长地喝了一口啤酒。
rows.raw: "\n\nWalking away, you hear her take a long, loud sip from her beer."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: A brief silence fills the air between you two. After a moment you shift in your seat and smirk. “I think I’d like to press the issue.”
rows.translation: 短暂的沉默笼罩你们。片刻后，你在座位上动了动，露出坏笑。“我想继续追问。”
rows.raw: "A brief silence fills the air between you two. After a moment you shift in your seat and smirk. “I think I’d like to press the issue.”"

rows.original: A dark smile creeps across the face of the white woman, and she stands up slowly. “Then follow me. I’ll show you.” She reaches out and offers her hand to you.
rows.translation: 白色女子脸上浮现阴暗的笑容，她缓缓起身。“那就跟我来。我会让你看看。”她伸手递向你。
rows.raw: "\n\nA dark smile creeps across the face of the white woman, and she stands up slowly. “Then follow me. I’ll show you.” She reaches out and offers her hand to you."

rows.original: Unsure of what she means, you take her hand and follow her. She leads you outside of the bar and takes you a bit of a ways away, towards the hangar you believe. Walking behind her, you can’t help but notice her tail wags lightly behind her as she walks, the tip of it brushing against you gently. Is she... Is this?
rows.translation: 你不明白她的意思，却仍握住她的手跟上。她带你离开酒吧，走出一段距离，似乎朝机库方向去。跟在身后，你忍不住注意到她走路时尾巴在身后轻摆，尾尖温柔地擦过你。她是...这难道是？
rows.raw: "\n\nUnsure of what she means, you take her hand and follow her. She leads you outside of the bar and takes you a bit of a ways away, towards the hangar you believe. Walking behind her, you can’t help but notice her tail wags lightly behind her as she walks, the tip of it brushing against you gently. Is she... Is this?"

rows.original: She comes to a stop and a small alley, gives a look around and releases your hand. “Come on in... If you want a taste....” She slips into the shadows, giving a small giggle.
rows.translation: 她在一条小巷前停下，环顾四周，松开你的手。“进来吧...如果你想尝尝...”她溜进阴影，轻声咯咯笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe comes to a stop and a small alley, gives a look around and releases your hand. “Come on in... If you want a taste....” She slips into the shadows, giving a small giggle. "

rows.original: Feeling a sudden
rows.translation: 突然感觉
rows.raw: "Feeling a sudden"

rows.original: tightness
rows.translation: 一阵紧绷
rows.raw: " tightness"

rows.original: heat
rows.translation: 热意
rows.raw: " heat"

rows.original: in your
rows.translation: 出现在你的
rows.raw: " in your "

rows.original: [pc.groin]
rows.raw: "[pc.groin]"

rows.original: [pc.lowerGarment]
rows.raw: "[pc.lowerGarment]"

rows.original: , you can’t help but follow.
rows.translation: 里，你忍不住跟上。
rows.raw: ", you can’t help but follow. "

rows.original: You turn the corner into the alley and... She’s gone. You look around but see almost no sign of her... Except her black jacket on the ground. You tread forward and bend over to examine the jacket.
rows.translation: 你转进小巷...她不见了。你四处查看，几乎找不到她的踪迹...只有黑色夹克掉在地上。你向前走，弯腰查看夹克。
rows.raw: "You turn the corner into the alley and... She’s gone. You look around but see almost no sign of her... Except her black jacket on the ground. You tread forward and bend over to examine the jacket."

rows.original: Cold steel meets your throat. While you bent down, the ovir woman somehow got behind you, her wicked knife now at your throat. Her other hand is on her blaster, which you feel prod against your back. She giggles in your ear, leaning in close. “Gotcha.”
rows.translation: 冰冷钢铁抵上你的喉咙。你弯腰时，欧维尔女子不知怎地绕到身后，邪恶刀刃此刻正贴着你的咽喉。另一只手握着爆能枪，你感觉枪口顶住后背。她贴近耳边咯咯轻笑。“抓到你了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nCold steel meets your throat. While you bent down, the ovir woman somehow got behind you, her wicked knife now at your throat. Her other hand is on her blaster, which you feel prod against your back. She giggles in your ear, leaning in close. “Gotcha.”"

rows.original: Sweat begins to build on your brow. What was this, what was she? She’s just a boozehound in a bar who made threats and sat alone. This was wrong. This wasn’t normal. She wasn’t a Bounty Hunter. Bounty Hunter’s don’t move like that. How can she get behind somebody in a narrow alley and take them from behind? In heels no less!
rows.translation: 汗水开始在额头聚集。这是什么情况，她究竟是什么人？她明明只是酒吧里的酒鬼，只会威胁人、独自坐着。这不对劲，不正常。她不是赏金猎人。赏金猎人不会那样移动。她怎么能在狭窄小巷里绕到别人身后，从背后制住对方？而且还穿着高跟鞋！
rows.raw: "\n\nSweat begins to build on your brow. What was this, what was she? She’s just a boozehound in a bar who made threats and sat alone. This was wrong. This wasn’t normal. She wasn’t a Bounty Hunter. Bounty Hunter’s don’t move like that. How can she get behind somebody in a narrow alley and take them from behind? In heels no less!"

rows.original: She moves her face close to yours and gives you a small lick on the cheek. “You thought I was just a Bounty Hunter. You’re not far off. I’m actually...” She twists the blade a bit, the razor edge pressing tight against your throat. “An Assassin.”
rows.translation: 她把脸凑近，轻轻舔了下你的脸颊。“你以为我只是赏金猎人。其实也没差太远。我实际上是...”她稍稍转动刀刃，锋利刀口紧压你的喉咙。“一名刺客。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe moves her face close to yours and gives you a small lick on the cheek. “You thought I was just a Bounty Hunter. You’re not far off. I’m actually...” She twists the blade a bit, the razor edge pressing tight against your throat. “An Assassin.”"

rows.original: Then, just as quickly as she attacked, the blade and the blaster are removed. You spin around ready to fight, but see she is gone. You dart your eyes around. How did she do that? How did she disappear? You hear a call from the end of the alley.
rows.translation: 接着，正如她发动攻击时那般迅速，刀刃与爆能枪都撤开了。你转身准备战斗，却发现她消失了。你飞快环顾四周。她怎么做到的？怎么消失的？巷子尽头传来呼喊。
rows.raw: "\n\nThen, just as quickly as she attacked, the blade and the blaster are removed. You spin around ready to fight, but see she is gone. You dart your eyes around. How did she do that? How did she disappear? You hear a call from the end of the alley."

rows.original: “I’ll be at the bar if you want to talk.” You turn the opposite direction and see her at the far end, putting her jacket back on. Your eyes fall to where it was laying and see she had somehow scooped it up. The white woman laughs and blows you a kiss, then turns to leave while you sit there dumbfounded.
rows.translation: “想聊的话，我会在酒吧。”你转向另一边，看见她正在远处重新穿上夹克。你看向夹克原先落地的位置，发现她不知怎地已经把它捡走。白色女子笑着给你一个飞吻，随后转身离开，留下你目瞪口呆地坐着。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ll be at the bar if you want to talk.” You turn the opposite direction and see her at the far end, putting her jacket back on. Your eyes fall to where it was laying and see she had somehow scooped it up. The white woman laughs and blows you a kiss, then turns to leave while you sit there dumbfounded."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: What will you ask her about?
rows.translation: 你想问她什么？
rows.raw: "What will you ask her about?"

rows.original: Herself
rows.translation: 她自己
rows.raw: "Herself"

rows.original: You decide to ask her about herself.
rows.translation: 你决定问问她自己的事。
rows.raw: "You decide to ask her about herself."

rows.original: She runs a long nail around the rim of her drink. “Me? Not much to say. Just a gal trying to make it in this twisted cruel galaxy.” She tilts her head a bit, letting silence fill the air for a moment. She gives her glass a tap then lifts it to her mouth a takes a big gulp. “Fine.”
rows.translation: 她用长指甲沿酒杯边缘划过。“我？没什么好说。只是个努力在这扭曲残酷的银河里谋生的姑娘。”她微微歪头，让沉默持续片刻。她敲敲杯子，举到嘴边猛灌一口。“好吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe runs a long nail around the rim of her drink. “Me? Not much to say. Just a gal trying to make it in this twisted cruel galaxy.” She tilts her head a bit, letting silence fill the air for a moment. She gives her glass a tap then lifts it to her mouth a takes a big gulp. “Fine.”"

rows.original: “Well, you can clearly tell I’m not human. Never was. I’m an ovir, although you might already know that....” She leans back a bit and sucks her teeth. “But as you can tell I’m not exactly your standard model. I’m an albino. While that isn’t exactly rare for my kind, there isn’t really one like me living in every community if you get my meaning.”
rows.translation: “嗯，你显然看得出我不是人类。从来都不是。我是欧维尔，不过你也许已经知道了....”她稍稍后靠，咂了咂嘴。“但你也看得出来，我不完全是标准型号。我是白化个体。这在我们种族中不算特别罕见，但也不是每个社区都能见到一个像我的人，懂我的意思吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, you can clearly tell I’m not human. Never was. I’m an ovir, although you might already know that....” She leans back a bit and sucks her teeth. “But as you can tell I’m not exactly your standard model. I’m an albino. While that isn’t exactly rare for my kind, there isn’t really one like me living in every community if you get my meaning.”"

rows.original: You nod a bit. “That must have made you lonely.”
rows.translation: 你轻轻点头。“那一定让你很孤独。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod a bit. “That must have made you lonely.”"

rows.original: She scoffs a bit. “Being alone makes you lonely. Not the color of your skin.” She shifts a bit in her seat and crosses her legs under the table. “But, if you are asking if I was lonely, then I guess I was. From time to time. Not that I mind being alone.” She gives you a knowing glare.
rows.translation: 她嗤笑一声。“独自一人才会让你孤独，不是肤色。”她在座位上动了动，在桌下交叠双腿。“不过你要问我是否孤独，我想确实有过。偶尔吧。并不是说我介意独处。”她意味深长地瞪你一眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe scoffs a bit. “Being alone makes you lonely. Not the color of your skin.” She shifts a bit in her seat and crosses her legs under the table. “But, if you are asking if I was lonely, then I guess I was. From time to time. Not that I mind being alone.” She gives you a knowing glare."

rows.original: You can’t help but smirk at that, but ask her to continue.
rows.translation: 你忍不住坏笑，却还是让她继续。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t help but smirk at that, but ask her to continue."

rows.original: “What else is there to say? I’m an albino ovir who’s been alone so much she’s gotten used to it.” She runs her hand through her thick mane of hair. “Anything else is just the past.”
rows.translation: “还有什么可说的？我是个白化欧维尔，独处太久，已经习惯了。”她用手梳过浓密长发。“其他一切都只是过去。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What else is there to say? I’m an albino ovir who’s been alone so much she’s gotten used to it.” She runs her hand through her thick mane of hair. “Anything else is just the past.”"

rows.original: You stare at her, frowning a bit at her evasiveness. “There has to be more than just that..”
rows.translation: 你盯着她，对她的回避略感不满。“肯定不止这些..”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stare at her, frowning a bit at her evasiveness. “There has to be more than just that..”"

rows.original: Tessa shrugs. “Just because we are doing...this...Doesn’t mean I’m going to tell you my life story. I’m a private person and if you don’t like that....” Her red eyes narrow in. “Then we’re done here.”
rows.translation: 泰莎耸肩。“仅仅因为我们在做...这种事...不代表我要把人生故事告诉你。我是个注重隐私的人，如果你不喜欢....”她眯起红眼。“那我们就到此为止。”
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa shrugs. “Just because we are doing...this...Doesn’t mean I’m going to tell you my life story. I’m a private person and if you don’t like that....” Her red eyes narrow in. “Then we’re done here.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Herself
rows.translation: 她自己
rows.raw: "Herself"

rows.original: Ask her about herself.
rows.translation: 询问她自己的事。
rows.raw: "Ask her about herself."

rows.original: Species
rows.translation: 种族
rows.raw: "Species"

rows.original: You ask her more about her species.
rows.translation: 你向她询问更多有关其种族的事。
rows.raw: "You ask her more about her species."

rows.original: The white woman shrugs. “You’ve got that Codex thing, don’t you? I’m sure it can tell you more about that than I can.” She gives an exaggerated smile, showing off her sharp teeth.
rows.translation: 白色女子耸肩。“你不是有那个法典吗？我相信它能告诉你的，比我更多。”她夸张地一笑，露出锋利牙齿。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe white woman shrugs. “You’ve got that Codex thing, don’t you? I’m sure it can tell you more about that than I can.” She gives an exaggerated smile, showing off her sharp teeth."

rows.original: You shrug at the truth of it. “True. But you must have something to add. What was it like growing up as an ovir?”
rows.translation: 你承认确实如此。“没错。但你肯定有自己的看法。作为欧维尔长大是什么感觉？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shrug at the truth of it. “True. But you must have something to add. What was it like growing up as an ovir?”"

rows.original: Tessa stares at you hard a moment. Her gaze isn’t threatening, but is rather certainly annoyed. “I told you I’m a private person. My childhood isn’t any of your business.”
rows.translation: 泰莎狠狠盯着你片刻。那目光不算威胁，却明显十分恼火。“我说过我是个注重隐私的人。我的童年不关你的事。”
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa stares at you hard a moment. Her gaze isn’t threatening, but is rather certainly annoyed. “I told you I’m a private person. My childhood isn’t any of your business.”"

rows.original: You apologize, trying to drop the issue. “I didn’t think that was going to be a sore spot for you.”
rows.translation: 你道歉，试图结束话题。“我没想到这是你的痛处。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou apologize, trying to drop the issue. “I didn’t think that was going to be a sore spot for you.”"

rows.original: She takes a big gulp and rubs her forehead. “If it’ll shut you up about it, I wasn’t really raised around other ovir. I didn’t meet another ovir until I was...” She pauses a moment and thinks, searching for the right word, “mature. So, I’m not like them and they are not like me, in fact-” She cuts herself off, realizing she was starting to say too much.
rows.translation: 她猛灌一口酒，揉揉额头。“如果这样能让你闭嘴，那我并不是在其他欧维尔身边长大的。我直到...”她停顿片刻，寻找合适的词。“成年后才见到另一个欧维尔。所以我不像他们，他们也不像我，事实上——”她突然住口，意识到自己开始说得太多。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe takes a big gulp and rubs her forehead. “If it’ll shut you up about it, I wasn’t really raised around other ovir. I didn’t meet another ovir until I was...” She pauses a moment and thinks, searching for the right word, “mature. So, I’m not like them and they are not like me, in fact-” She cuts herself off, realizing she was starting to say too much."

rows.original: “Sorry I brought it up. We can talk about something else if you want.”
rows.translation: “抱歉提起这事。想的话，我们可以聊别的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry I brought it up. We can talk about something else if you want.”"

rows.original: Tessa takes a sip from her drink. “This is why I like to sit alone. Fucking hell, this was just so much easier when you were just trying to hit on me.”
rows.translation: 泰莎抿了口酒。“所以我才喜欢独坐。该死，你只是来搭讪时可容易多了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa takes a sip from her drink. “This is why I like to sit alone. Fucking hell, this was just so much easier when you were just trying to hit on me.”"

rows.original: You chuckle, asking her when she thinks you stopped.
rows.translation: 你轻笑，问她觉得你是什么时候停止搭讪的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou chuckle, asking her when she thinks you stopped."

rows.original: She smirks at that. Behind her you notice her jacket shifting a bit. You point it out and the motion stops immediately. “Shit. Sorry, that’s my tail. Damn thing has a mind of its own if I don’t think about it long enough.”
rows.translation: 她听后坏笑。你注意到她身后的夹克动了动，便指了出来，那动作立刻停止。“操，抱歉，是我的尾巴。要是太久不去想，那鬼东西就会自作主张。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smirks at that. Behind her you notice her jacket shifting a bit. You point it out and the motion stops immediately. “Shit. Sorry, that’s my tail. Damn thing has a mind of its own if I don’t think about it long enough.”"

rows.original: You can’t help but laugh
rows.translation: 你忍不住笑
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t help but laugh"

rows.original: , and you give your own a bit of a wag. “Oh trust me. I know.” You smirk and wiggle it again at Tessa
rows.translation: ，并让自己的尾巴轻摆。“相信我，我懂。”你坏笑着又朝泰莎晃了晃
rows.raw: ", and you give your own a bit of a wag. “Oh trust me. I know.” You smirk and wiggle it again at Tessa"

rows.original: . “See? You did teach me something about ovir. I didn’t know they wagged their tails like Ausar when flattered.”
rows.translation: 。“看吧？你确实教了我一点欧维尔知识。我以前不知道他们受奉承时会像奥萨尔一样摇尾巴。”
rows.raw: ". “See? You did teach me something about ovir. I didn’t know they wagged their tails like Ausar when flattered.”"

rows.original: . “Well, well looks like somebody likes me after all.” You offer a lewd wink.
rows.translation: 。“哎呀呀，看来某人终究还是喜欢我。”你淫荡地眨眨眼。
rows.raw: ". “Well, well looks like somebody likes me after all.” You offer a lewd wink."

rows.original: . “Hope you can keep that thing under control when it counts there.”
rows.translation: 。“希望到了关键时候，你能管好那东西。”
rows.raw: ". “Hope you can keep that thing under control when it counts there.”"

rows.original: The death glare Tessa shoots you ends the conversation quickly.
rows.translation: 泰莎投来的死亡凝视迅速结束了话题。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe death glare Tessa shoots you ends the conversation quickly."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Species
rows.translation: 种族
rows.raw: "Species"

rows.original: Ask her about her species.
rows.translation: 询问她的种族。
rows.raw: "Ask her about her species."

rows.original: Alone?
rows.translation: 独处？
rows.raw: "Alone?"

rows.original: You ask her why she likes to drink alone.
rows.translation: 你问她为什么喜欢一个人喝酒。
rows.raw: "You ask her why she likes to drink alone."

rows.original: “I’m a private person and I like to be alone. Is that so strange?” She rhythmically taps her fingers on the table, seemingly thinking on the question more. “I just don’t like people. Well most people. You’re alright. I guess.” She looks at you with her big red eyes.
rows.translation: “我是个注重隐私的人，也喜欢独处。这很奇怪吗？”她有节奏地用手指敲桌，似乎更认真地思考起这个问题。“我只是不喜欢人。好吧，大多数人。你还凑合。大概吧。”她用大大的红眼看着你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m a private person and I like to be alone. Is that so strange?” She rhythmically taps her fingers on the table, seemingly thinking on the question more. “I just don’t like people. Well most people. You’re alright. I guess.” She looks at you with her big red eyes."

rows.original: You laugh a bit and thank her, but remind her of your not too warm meeting and the end of a blaster.
rows.translation: 你笑着道谢，却提醒她，你们初遇并不友好，而且还被爆能枪指着。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou laugh a bit and thank her, but remind her of your not too warm meeting and the end of a blaster."

rows.original: “I’m not sorry about that.” Her tone stiffens a bit and her eyes become annoyed again. Silence fills the air for a long moment. She scratches her thumb nail against her forefinger a moment then continues. “Look, I’ve had some stuff in my past that’s made me a little messed up okay? I’m not going to get into it, but all you need to know is me and people don’t mix well.” She takes a firm gulp from her drink and scowls a bit looking down into her drink.
rows.translation: “那件事我不道歉。”她语气变硬，眼中再次浮现恼意。空气长久沉默。她用拇指指甲刮了刮食指，随后继续。“听着，我过去经历过一些事，让我变得有点不正常，好吗？我不想细说，你只需知道，我和人群合不来。”她坚定地灌了一口酒，低头望着杯中，微微皱眉。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m not sorry about that.” Her tone stiffens a bit and her eyes become annoyed again. Silence fills the air for a long moment. She scratches her thumb nail against her forefinger a moment then continues. “Look, I’ve had some stuff in my past that’s made me a little messed up okay? I’m not going to get into it, but all you need to know is me and people don’t mix well.” She takes a firm gulp from her drink and scowls a bit looking down into her drink."

rows.original: You nod a bit and opt to sit in silence for a moment. The tension only lasts a short while, with her taking a few more gulps and sips. You comment she is quite good at holding her liquor.
rows.translation: 你点点头，选择沉默片刻。紧张气氛只持续了一会儿，她又喝了几大口、小口。你评论说她酒量很好。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod a bit and opt to sit in silence for a moment. The tension only lasts a short while, with her taking a few more gulps and sips. You comment she is quite good at holding her liquor."

rows.original: She chuckles a bit softly. “I usually pace myself. I make a beer like this last two hours. Been doing that since I was... God... Fourteen?” She leans back and ruffles her hair a bit. “Do that with five beers a day at least for a number of years and a tolerance builds up. Only drink beer though, everything else is too strong for me.” She looks you dead in the eye. “Beer or water. Nothing else.”
rows.translation: 她轻声笑了。“我通常慢慢喝。这样一杯啤酒能喝两小时。从我...天哪...十四岁起就是这样？”她向后靠，揉乱头发。“至少每天五杯，连续喝几年，酒量自然就练出来了。不过我只喝啤酒，其他东西对我来说太烈。”她直视你的眼睛。“啤酒或水，别的都不要。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe chuckles a bit softly. “I usually pace myself. I make a beer like this last two hours. Been doing that since I was... God... Fourteen?” She leans back and ruffles her hair a bit. “Do that with five beers a day at least for a number of years and a tolerance builds up. Only drink beer though, everything else is too strong for me.” She looks you dead in the eye. “Beer or water. Nothing else.”"

rows.original: You nod a bit and chuckle, asking how she managed to support a drinking habit so young.
rows.translation: 你点头轻笑，问她这么小怎么维持喝酒习惯。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod a bit and chuckle, asking how she managed to support a drinking habit so young."

rows.original: The pale ovir shifts a bit, clearly uncomfortable with the question. “I told you I’m a pri- Okay, you know what. Fine. You get this one.” She lifts her glass to get mouth and takes a gulp, as if asking for strength. “When I was young, even younger than fourteen, my home had a contaminant in the water. Alien something or other from who knows where. Nobody knew what it was or how to get rid of it. We could bathe fine, but drinking? That was a sure-fire way to end up sick and in a hospital bed for a week.”
rows.translation: 苍白的欧维尔动了动，显然对问题很不自在。“我说过我是个注——好吧，算了。这次告诉你。”她举杯猛灌，仿佛借酒壮胆。“我小时候，甚至还不到十四岁时，家里的水被污染了。谁也不知道从哪来的外星玩意。没人知道那是什么，也不知道怎么清除。洗澡没问题，可饮用？那肯定会让你生病，在医院躺上一周。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe pale ovir shifts a bit, clearly uncomfortable with the question. “I told you I’m a pri- Okay, you know what. Fine. You get this one.” She lifts her glass to get mouth and takes a gulp, as if asking for strength. “When I was young, even younger than fourteen, my home had a contaminant in the water. Alien something or other from who knows where. Nobody knew what it was or how to get rid of it. We could bathe fine, but drinking? That was a sure-fire way to end up sick and in a hospital bed for a week.”"

rows.original: You lean in a bit, interested that she finally decided to share. “Didn’t you have filtration? Or water reserves?”
rows.translation: 你稍稍凑近，对她终于愿意分享很感兴趣。“没有过滤设备？或者储备水？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lean in a bit, interested that she finally decided to share. “Didn’t you have filtration? Or water reserves?”"

rows.original: Tessa waves her hand a bit, dismissively. “Filtration wasn’t getting it. Not all the time at least. Whatever was in the water was persistent. All the reserves had to be used for the sick. And let me tell you, there were a lot of those.”
rows.translation: 泰莎不屑地摆手。“过滤没用，至少不是每次都有用。水里的东西很顽固。所有储备用水都得留给病人。告诉你，病人可多了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa waves her hand a bit, dismissively. “Filtration wasn’t getting it. Not all the time at least. Whatever was in the water was persistent. All the reserves had to be used for the sick. And let me tell you, there were a lot of those.”"

rows.original: You shake your head a bit in disbelief. She must have grown up somewhere pretty backwater by the sounds of it. “So, what did you drink?”
rows.translation: 你难以置信地摇头。听起来她一定在相当落后的地方长大。“那你们喝什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shake your head a bit in disbelief. She must have grown up somewhere pretty backwater by the sounds of it. “So, what did you drink?”"

rows.original: The white woman sighs and taps her glass. “Have you been paying attention? Beer. Well I did at least. I was a kid, so they gave me the lightest stuff they could. All the kids had to drink it. For some reason, the crap in the water couldn’t survive in alcohol, which I suppose makes sense.” Tessa lifts her beer up off the table and starts to swirl the liquid. “The whole thing maybe last a few months. But when you drink nothing but beer for that long, you develop a taste.”
rows.translation: 白色女子叹气，敲敲杯子。“你到底有没有听？啤酒，至少我喝的是。我还是孩子，他们就给我能找到的最淡的酒。所有孩子都得喝。不知为何，水里的脏东西无法在酒精中存活，想来也有道理。”泰莎举起啤酒，摇晃其中液体。“整件事大概持续几个月。但如果那么久只喝啤酒，自然会养成口味。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe white woman sighs and taps her glass. “Have you been paying attention? Beer. Well I did at least. I was a kid, so they gave me the lightest stuff they could. All the kids had to drink it. For some reason, the crap in the water couldn’t survive in alcohol, which I suppose makes sense.” Tessa lifts her beer up off the table and starts to swirl the liquid. “The whole thing maybe last a few months. But when you drink nothing but beer for that long, you develop a taste.”"

rows.original: She takes another sip and sets the glass down. “By the time I was fourteen I had a hookup who could get me tons for cheap. Just had to have the cash, and money was never really an issue for me.” The ovir went silent a moment and sighed again. “So there, that’s why I drink beer. End of discussion.”
rows.translation: 她又抿一口，放下杯子。“十四岁时，我已经认识能低价给我弄来一大堆酒的人。只要有钱，而钱对我从来不是问题。”欧维尔沉默片刻，再次叹气。“好了，这就是我喝啤酒的原因。讨论结束。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe takes another sip and sets the glass down. “By the time I was fourteen I had a hookup who could get me tons for cheap. Just had to have the cash, and money was never really an issue for me.” The ovir went silent a moment and sighed again. “So there, that’s why I drink beer. End of discussion.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Alone?
rows.translation: 独处？
rows.raw: "Alone?"

rows.original: Ask why she always drinks alone.
rows.translation: 问她为什么总是独自喝酒。
rows.raw: "Ask why she always drinks alone."

rows.original: Her Sex
rows.translation: 她的性别
rows.raw: "Her Sex"

rows.original: You ask decide to ask her about her sex.
rows.translation: 你决定询问她的性别。
rows.raw: "You ask decide to ask her about her sex."

rows.original: Tessa rolls her eyes and frowns a bit. “I’m pretty clearly a woman.” She stares at you a moment, her red eyes reading you. Her frown fades away and her expression goes blank. After reading you a moment, she understands now why you’re asking. “Oh. That.” Her gaze narrows and her tone becomes rather annoyed. “I’m a female. No cock.”
rows.translation: 泰莎翻眼皱眉。“我显然是个女人。”她盯了你片刻，红眼仿佛在解读你。眉头消失，表情变得空白。观察片刻后，她终于明白你为什么问。“哦，那个。”她眯起眼，语气颇为恼火。“我是女性，没有鸡巴。”
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa rolls her eyes and frowns a bit. “I’m pretty clearly a woman.” She stares at you a moment, her red eyes reading you. Her frown fades away and her expression goes blank. After reading you a moment, she understands now why you’re asking. “Oh. That.” Her gaze narrows and her tone becomes rather annoyed. “I’m a female. No cock.”"

rows.original: You lean in a bit, slightly surprised. “Oh, well you seem rather feminine for a female don’t y-”
rows.translation: 你稍稍凑近，有些惊讶。“哦，可作为女性，你看起来相当女性化，不是——”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lean in a bit, slightly surprised. “Oh, well you seem rather feminine for a female don’t y-”"

rows.original: “So you’re saying a woman can’t be feminine?” She leans back in her chair, crossing her arms over her chest.
rows.translation: “所以你是说，女人不能女性化？”她靠回椅背，双臂交叉抱胸。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So you’re saying a woman can’t be feminine?” She leans back in her chair, crossing her arms over her chest."

rows.original: You shake your head. “What? That’s not what I mean. I just thought that male ovir were the ones with large busts an-”
rows.translation: 你摇头。“什么？我不是这个意思。我只是以为雄性欧维尔才有丰满胸部而——”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shake your head. “What? That’s not what I mean. I just thought that male ovir were the ones with large busts an-”"

rows.original: “So just because I have a large chest I must be a male?” Her eyes narrow. She flexes her fingers against her arms, her sharp nails almost scratching into her jacket.
rows.translation: “所以只因为我胸大，我就一定是雄性？”她眯起眼睛，手指在手臂上绷紧，锋利指甲几乎要抓破夹克。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So just because I have a large chest I must be a male?” Her eyes narrow. She flexes her fingers against her arms, her sharp nails almost scratching into her jacket."

rows.original: You go silent a minute, unsure of what to say. An ovir’s sexual dimorphism was what it was, so why was she getting so mad?
rows.translation: 你沉默片刻，不知该说什么。欧维尔的性别二态就是如此，她为什么这么生气？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou go silent a minute, unsure of what to say. An ovir’s sexual dimorphism was what it was, so why was she getting so mad?"

rows.original: “I’m sorry if I misspoke, it’s just an ovir I met told me-”
rows.translation: “如果我说错了话，我很抱歉。只是我遇到的一个欧维尔告诉我——”
rows.raw: " “I’m sorry if I misspoke, it’s just an ovir I met told me-”"

rows.original: “Wow. Damn. Sorry. I just heard from this ovir that-”
rows.translation: “哇，见鬼。抱歉。我只是听一个欧维尔说——”
rows.raw: " “Wow. Damn. Sorry. I just heard from this ovir that-”"

rows.original: “Settle down. Damn. This ovir told me that-”
rows.translation: “冷静点。该死。那个欧维尔告诉我——”
rows.raw: " “Settle down. Damn. This ovir told me that-”"

rows.original: Tessa slams her hand on the table and stands up with a jolt, knocking her chair over with her tail as she rises. “Shut up! You don’t know anything!” Her red eyes glare hard into you, harder than when she first threatened your life. “What the fuck do you know?! I’m me, do you understand that? I’m a woman and I was born a woman and no matter how I act or look I am just as much a woman as any other human or ovir!”
rows.translation: 泰莎猛拍桌面，骤然起身，尾巴掀翻椅子。“闭嘴！你什么都不懂！”红眼恶狠狠盯着你，比初次威胁取你性命时更凶。“你他妈知道什么？！我是我自己，明白吗？我是个女人，生来就是女人，无论行为还是外表如何，我都和任何人类或欧维尔一样，是个彻彻底底的女人！”
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa slams her hand on the table and stands up with a jolt, knocking her chair over with her tail as she rises. “Shut up! You don’t know anything!” Her red eyes glare hard into you, harder than when she first threatened your life. “What the fuck do you know?! I’m me, do you understand that? I’m a woman and I was born a woman and no matter how I act or look I am just as much a woman as any other human or ovir!”"

rows.original: You raise your hands, trying to apologize. A few eyes around the bar turn to watch the small scene.
rows.translation: 你举起双手，试图道歉。酒吧里几道目光转过来，注视这场小骚动。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou raise your hands, trying to apologize. A few eyes around the bar turn to watch the small scene."

rows.original: The white woman reaches for and draws her knife, slamming it into the table, the force of which spills her beer. “You don’t get to tell me if I’m too feminine or masculine or anything like that, you got it asshole?” Her eyes were pure rage and hurt. You notice the ovir’s hand on the knife tremble, her knuckles going red. A long moment passes and she stands up straight, leaving the knife in the table. Using her tail, she scoops up her chair and set it upright then sits down, her gaze falling downward into her lap. “Leave me alone.” Her voice was calm, and low. But she wasn’t asking.
rows.translation: 白色女子拔出刀，猛插进桌面，力量震洒了啤酒。“你没资格告诉我，我是不是太女性化、太男性化，或者任何类似的话，明白吗，混蛋？”她眼里满是愤怒与伤痛。你注意到她握刀的手在颤抖，指节发红。漫长片刻后，她站直身体，把刀留在桌里。她用尾巴扶起椅子并坐下，低头望向膝间。“别烦我。”声音平静低沉，但这不是请求。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe white woman reaches for and draws her knife, slamming it into the table, the force of which spills her beer. “You don’t get to tell me if I’m too feminine or masculine or anything like that, you got it asshole?” Her eyes were pure rage and hurt. You notice the ovir’s hand on the knife tremble, her knuckles going red. A long moment passes and she stands up straight, leaving the knife in the table. Using her tail, she scoops up her chair and set it upright then sits down, her gaze falling downward into her lap. “Leave me alone.” Her voice was calm, and low. But she wasn’t asking."

rows.original: Without hesitation, you stand up and leave the trembling ovir alone.
rows.translation: 你毫不犹豫地起身，留下颤抖的欧维尔独处。
rows.raw: "\n\nWithout hesitation, you stand up and leave the trembling ovir alone."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You decide to risk bring up the Sex issue again.
rows.translation: 你决定冒险再次提起性别问题。
rows.raw: "You decide to risk bring up the Sex issue again."

rows.original: Tessa stares at you a moment, her gaze going rigid. “Do you think that’s wise?” She runs a finger along the table, brushing over the mark left behind by her knife. “Do you want to die?”
rows.translation: 泰莎盯了你片刻，目光变得僵硬。“你觉得这样明智吗？”她用手指划过桌面，扫过刀留下的痕迹。“你想死吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa stares at you a moment, her gaze going rigid. “Do you think that’s wise?” She runs a finger along the table, brushing over the mark left behind by her knife. “Do you want to die?”"

rows.original: You stare at her a moment, pondering the threat, but are waved off by the ovir shaking her head and sighing.
rows.translation: 你盯着她，思考这份威胁，却见欧维尔摇头叹气，挥手让你作罢。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stare at her a moment, pondering the threat, but are waved off by the ovir shaking her head and sighing."

rows.original: “Fine. I think I owe you a bit of an explanation. Well as I said before I am female.” She leans back, getting comfy in her seat. “I don’t know if you remember me mentioning, but I didn’t meet another ovir until I was an adult.”
rows.translation: “好吧。我想我欠你一点解释。就像以前说的，我是女性。”她向后靠，在座位上坐舒服。“不知道你还记不记得我提过，我成年前从未见过其他欧维尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fine. I think I owe you a bit of an explanation. Well as I said before I am female.” She leans back, getting comfy in her seat. “I don’t know if you remember me mentioning, but I didn’t meet another ovir until I was an adult.”"

rows.original: You nod at that, recalling that as one of the few details she let slip about her past.
rows.translation: 你点头，想起这是她少数透露的过去细节之一。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod at that, recalling that as one of the few details she let slip about her past."

rows.original: “Well when I said that... I meant it. Very literally.” She takes a strong gulp on her drink and then runs her long nails through her snowy hair. “Not even my parents. No. Stop, don’t... I don’t need sympathy for that okay.” She waves her hand at you, dismissively. “I’ve accepted that. I was abandoned as an egg. Best reckoning is my parents didn’t want...” The white woman goes silent and motions up and down at herself. “This. I guess they could tell what I was from my egg. An albino freak. I’m told most ovir don’t care about this sort of thing. But some... Well let’s just say some people in this galaxy are living a few centuries behind everybody else.”
rows.translation: “我当时说的...完全是字面意思。”她猛灌一口酒，用长指甲梳过雪白头发。“连我的父母也不是。别，停下...我不需要同情，好吗？”她不屑地摆手。“我已经接受了。我还是一颗蛋时就被遗弃。最合理的推测是父母不想要...”白色女子沉默，用手从头到脚示意自己。“这个。他们大概能从蛋看出我是什么，白化怪胎。听说大多数欧维尔不在乎这种事，但有些...这么说吧，银河里有些人还活在几个世纪以前。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well when I said that... I meant it. Very literally.” She takes a strong gulp on her drink and then runs her long nails through her snowy hair. “Not even my parents. No. Stop, don’t... I don’t need sympathy for that okay.” She waves her hand at you, dismissively. “I’ve accepted that. I was abandoned as an egg. Best reckoning is my parents didn’t want...” The white woman goes silent and motions up and down at herself. “This. I guess they could tell what I was from my egg. An albino freak. I’m told most ovir don’t care about this sort of thing. But some... Well let’s just say some people in this galaxy are living a few centuries behind everybody else.”"

rows.original: The two of you pause and let that hang in the air, thinking about it for a long a moment.
rows.translation: 你们停下来，让这些话悬在空气里，久久思考。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you pause and let that hang in the air, thinking about it for a long a moment."

rows.original: “Anyways, I was adopted by my foster parents. Humans. They are...well...my parents. I’ve never really considered them not to be....” She smiles faintly at that. “They loved kids, but for some... God, for some insane reason instead of making one of their own they adopted an egg. An egg!” Tessa chuckles a bit and takes another drink, a small sip this time. “Well, when I hatched, they didn’t know the first thing about ovir children, they couldn’t even tell if I was a boy or girl. So, they had me checked.” She sighed deeply and shook her head. “That’s not normal for ovir. Not really anyways.”
rows.translation: “总之，我被养父母收养了。他们是人类。他们...嗯...就是我的父母。我从没觉得不是....”她淡淡一笑。“他们喜欢孩子，可不知为何——天哪，不知什么疯狂原因——他们没有自己生，而是收养了一颗蛋。一颗蛋！”泰莎轻笑，又喝一口，这次只是小抿。“我孵化后，他们对欧维尔儿童一无所知，甚至分不出我是男是女。所以给我做了检查。”她深深叹气，摇摇头。“这对欧维尔并不正常。至少通常不是。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyways, I was adopted by my foster parents. Humans. They are...well...my parents. I’ve never really considered them not to be....” She smiles faintly at that. “They loved kids, but for some... God, for some insane reason instead of making one of their own they adopted an egg. An egg!” Tessa chuckles a bit and takes another drink, a small sip this time. “Well, when I hatched, they didn’t know the first thing about ovir children, they couldn’t even tell if I was a boy or girl. So, they had me checked.” She sighed deeply and shook her head. “That’s not normal for ovir. Not really anyways.”"

rows.original: You can’t help but ask how being an ovir raised by humans went.
rows.translation: 你忍不住询问，被人类养大的欧维尔生活如何。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t help but ask how being an ovir raised by humans went."

rows.original: “I was... Different. It was a human colony. Tiny really, everybody knew everybody sort of tiny. Sure, we had an ausar here and there, but I was the only ovir. My mother made all my clothes because of that.” She gives her tail a bit wiggle, then chuckles. “I was treated like a human most of the time, but not always. Some kids were... Not kind to me. But you know kids, right? They’re little assholes. Didn’t stop little ol’ me from crying myself to sleep some nights.”
rows.translation: “我...与众不同。那是个人类殖民地，真的很小，小到人人都认识彼此。当然，偶尔有奥萨尔，但我是唯一的欧维尔。为此，我母亲所有衣服都亲手给我做。”她轻摆尾巴，随后笑了。“大多数时候大家把我当人类，但并非总是如此。有些孩子...对我并不友善。不过你懂孩子，对吧？一群小混蛋。可这并没阻止小时候的我有些夜晚哭着入睡。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I was... Different. It was a human colony. Tiny really, everybody knew everybody sort of tiny. Sure, we had an ausar here and there, but I was the only ovir. My mother made all my clothes because of that.” She gives her tail a bit wiggle, then chuckles. “I was treated like a human most of the time, but not always. Some kids were... Not kind to me. But you know kids, right? They’re little assholes. Didn’t stop little ol’ me from crying myself to sleep some nights.”"

rows.original: “That must have been hard for you.” You watch the ovir’s eyes stare off into nothing, knowing she’s thinking back to those days.
rows.translation: “那一定很难熬。”你看着欧维尔的眼睛望向虚空，知道她在回忆那些日子。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That must have been hard for you.” You watch the ovir’s eyes stare off into nothing, knowing she’s thinking back to those days."

rows.original: “It was fine. It was childhood. Kids are jerks, but they grow out of it. One of the boys who was mean to me...” She pauses a moment and smirks; her tail starting to start to wag a bit. After a quick second she catches herself and her tail stops. “Never mind....” In a quick motion she downs her drink and taps on the glass. “Get me another, will ya? I’m way too sober to talk about this crap.”
rows.translation: “还好。那就是童年。孩子们很混蛋，但长大会改。曾经有个欺负我的男孩...”她停顿片刻，坏笑起来；尾巴开始摆动。片刻后她发现了，立刻停住。“算了....”她迅速喝光酒，敲敲杯子。“再给我来一杯，好吗？谈这些破事时，我清醒得过头了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was fine. It was childhood. Kids are jerks, but they grow out of it. One of the boys who was mean to me...” She pauses a moment and smirks; her tail starting to start to wag a bit. After a quick second she catches herself and her tail stops. “Never mind....” In a quick motion she downs her drink and taps on the glass. “Get me another, will ya? I’m way too sober to talk about this crap.”"

rows.original: You shake your head and
rows.translation: 你摇摇头，并
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shake your head and "

rows.original: fetch
rows.translation: 取来
rows.raw: "fetch"

rows.original: steal
rows.translation: 偷来
rows.raw: "steal"

rows.original: a fresh beer for your alabaster friend. She takes it from your hand and sighs. “I didn’t know anything about ovirs. Nothing. Aside from stuff I knew because it was happening to me. I was just a girl, a lizard girl in a sea of filthy monkey children, but a girl all the same.” She takes a sip of her new drink. “First ovir I met thought I was a guy. How you spend your whole life around ovirs and get the sexes confused is beyond me, but... Well he was... Hurtful. And not in the way the children were.”
rows.translation: 一杯新啤酒给这位雪白朋友。她从你手中接过，叹了口气。“我对欧维尔一无所知。除了因为发生在我身上而知道的事情外，什么都不知道。我只是个女孩，一个身处肮脏猴孩海洋里的蜥蜴女孩，但仍然是女孩。”她抿了口新酒。“我遇到的第一个欧维尔以为我是男人。一个人一辈子都在欧维尔身边，却会搞错性别，我真不明白。但...嗯，他...很伤人。和孩子们的方式不同。”
rows.raw: " a fresh beer for your alabaster friend. She takes it from your hand and sighs. “I didn’t know anything about ovirs. Nothing. Aside from stuff I knew because it was happening to me. I was just a girl, a lizard girl in a sea of filthy monkey children, but a girl all the same.” She takes a sip of her new drink. “First ovir I met thought I was a guy. How you spend your whole life around ovirs and get the sexes confused is beyond me, but... Well he was... Hurtful. And not in the way the children were.”"

rows.original: Sensing the story is about to get heavy, you say she can stop if she wants, but she shakes her head and sips her beer, holding it in both hands.
rows.translation: 察觉故事即将变得沉重，你说她想停下也可以，但她摇头，双手捧着啤酒抿了一口。
rows.raw: "\n\nSensing the story is about to get heavy, you say she can stop if she wants, but she shakes her head and sips her beer, holding it in both hands."

rows.original: “No. I started this crap, I might as well finish. He saw me first... And he liked what he saw... I mean can you blame him? He was charming... And sweet. I knew he was a he, or she was a he, or however the damn pronouns work... We went back to my place... I...” She gulps her beer, still with both hands. “I was curious. We stripped naked and his... was out, it had been out a good chunk of the night. It’s how I knew....” She laughs and finishes her drink in a mighty chug.
rows.translation: “不。这破事是我开头的，不如讲完。他先看到了我...也喜欢看到的东西...我是说，能怪他吗？他很迷人...也很温柔。我知道他是‘他’，或者她是‘他’，管它该死的代词怎么用...我们回了我家...我...”她双手捧杯，猛灌啤酒。“我很好奇。我们脱光了，他的...露在外面，其实那晚大半时间都露着。所以我才知道....”她笑着一口气喝光。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No. I started this crap, I might as well finish. He saw me first... And he liked what he saw... I mean can you blame him? He was charming... And sweet. I knew he was a he, or she was a he, or however the damn pronouns work... We went back to my place... I...” She gulps her beer, still with both hands. “I was curious. We stripped naked and his... was out, it had been out a good chunk of the night. It’s how I knew....” She laughs and finishes her drink in a mighty chug."

rows.original: Knowing how this normally goes, you stand and offer to get another for her, but he waves you off. “No. No. Let me finish.”
rows.translation: 知道这通常会怎么发展，你站起来表示再给她拿一杯，但她挥手拒绝。“不，不。让我讲完。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKnowing how this normally goes, you stand and offer to get another for her, but he waves you off. “No. No. Let me finish.”"

rows.original: She sighs and rubs her temples. “He asked me... Well, he asked me why I wasn’t into him. I was confused, I wanted him. Badly. I... Fucking hell. I said I was, and he asked why I hadn’t let it out... He... Well. When I told him I was a female he laughed at me...” Tessa’s red eyes shifted off into the distance. “He was a gay ovir who thought I was a dude. My white scales... Well females are not usually white. We’re supposed to be bland, dull colors... And my chest... I guess you could say I’m stacked for a girl....” She went quite a moment. “And I guess... female ovir don’t get horny... well they do, just not often. But... that’s not me... I... I’m... Never mind. I want that drink now.”
rows.translation: 她叹气揉着太阳穴。“他问我...嗯，问我为什么对他没兴趣。我很困惑，我想要他，非常想。我...操。他问我为什么还不把它放出来。他...嗯，当我告诉他我是女性，他笑了...”泰莎的红眼望向远处。“他是个男同欧维尔，以为我是男人。我的白鳞...女性通常不是白色，应该是平淡、暗淡的颜色...还有我的胸...对女孩来说，我大概算很丰满....”她沉默片刻。“而且我猜...雌性欧维尔不会发情...好吧，会，只是不常有。但...我不是那样...我...我...算了。我现在想要那杯酒。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sighs and rubs her temples. “He asked me... Well, he asked me why I wasn’t into him. I was confused, I wanted him. Badly. I... Fucking hell. I said I was, and he asked why I hadn’t let it out... He... Well. When I told him I was a female he laughed at me...” Tessa’s red eyes shifted off into the distance. “He was a gay ovir who thought I was a dude. My white scales... Well females are not usually white. We’re supposed to be bland, dull colors... And my chest... I guess you could say I’m stacked for a girl....” She went quite a moment. “And I guess... female ovir don’t get horny... well they do, just not often. But... that’s not me... I... I’m... Never mind. I want that drink now.”"

rows.original: You head back over to the bar and retrieve a fresh beer for your friend. She takes it, but stays silent. “So, he laughed and left. Said I needed to learn how to... How to act my sex... He was an asshole. I know not all ovir are like him but... All my life I was something else. Something other. Everybody around me... Not everybody accepted me at first because I was different. Most of them changed over time, but they still were not the same as me. I was a lizard in a den of mammals. So why is it the first other ovir I met treated me like I was... something else....”
rows.translation: 你回到吧台，为朋友取来新啤酒。她接过，却保持沉默。“所以他笑着离开了。说我得学会...学会按自己的性别行事...他是个混蛋。我知道不是所有欧维尔都像他，可...我一生都像别的东西，像异类。周围所有人...不是所有人一开始都能接受我的不同。多数人后来改了，可他们仍与我不同。我是哺乳动物巢穴里的蜥蜴。那么为什么我遇到的第一个欧维尔，也把我当作...别的东西....”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou head back over to the bar and retrieve a fresh beer for your friend. She takes it, but stays silent. “So, he laughed and left. Said I needed to learn how to... How to act my sex... He was an asshole. I know not all ovir are like him but... All my life I was something else. Something other. Everybody around me... Not everybody accepted me at first because I was different. Most of them changed over time, but they still were not the same as me. I was a lizard in a den of mammals. So why is it the first other ovir I met treated me like I was... something else....”"

rows.original: You reach across the table and place your hand on Tessa’s. She looks over at you, regarding you with her red orbs. She smiles. “I was raised like a human girl. I grew up with human girls... My appearance... I was a freak to the humans and then a freak to the ovir.”
rows.translation: 你越过桌面，把手放在泰莎手上。她转眼用红色眼珠注视你，随后微笑。“我是作为人类女孩被养大的，与人类女孩一起长大...我的外表...在人类眼中是怪胎，在欧维尔眼中也是怪胎。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reach across the table and place your hand on Tessa’s. She looks over at you, regarding you with her red orbs. She smiles. “I was raised like a human girl. I grew up with human girls... My appearance... I was a freak to the humans and then a freak to the ovir.”"

rows.original: “No. You’re not.” You grip her hand. “You are... You.
rows.translation: “不，你不是。”你握住她的手。“你就是...你自己。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No. You’re not.” You grip her hand. “You are... You."

rows.original: You are so much more because of it all. It helped you become an amazing person.
rows.translation: 正因经历这一切，你才比别人更加丰富，成为了不起的人。
rows.raw: " You are so much more because of it all. It helped you become an amazing person."

rows.original: You said it before, when you... well when you had your knife out.
rows.translation: 你以前说过，就在你...嗯，拔出刀时。
rows.raw: " You said it before, when you... well when you had your knife out."

rows.original: So to hell with everybody else. If they want you to change then they aren’t worth thinking about.
rows.translation: 所以让其他人见鬼去吧。若他们想让你改变，那根本不值得你放在心上。
rows.raw: " So to hell with everybody else. If they want you to change then they aren’t worth thinking about."

rows.original: The white woman can’t help but laugh at that. “You’re right. I know, it’s... it’s just me. God, I feel silly. Starting to well all emotional because the first ovir I met didn’t think I was who I should have been....” She sighs and takes another sip from her drink. “Thanks [pc.name], for listening.” She runs her thumb along the side of your hand, still placed on hers. “Now stop touching me before I cut that hand off.”
rows.translation: 白色女子忍不住笑了。“你说得对。我知道，只是...只是我自己。天哪，我感觉真傻。只因为遇到的第一个欧维尔认为我不该是现在的样子，就开始这么情绪化....”她叹气，抿了口酒。“谢谢你，[pc.name]，谢谢你听我说。”她用拇指摩挲仍覆在自己手上的你的手侧。“现在别摸了，不然我把那只手砍下来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe white woman can’t help but laugh at that. “You’re right. I know, it’s... it’s just me. God, I feel silly. Starting to well all emotional because the first ovir I met didn’t think I was who I should have been....” She sighs and takes another sip from her drink. “Thanks [pc.name], for listening.” She runs her thumb along the side of your hand, still placed on hers. “Now stop touching me before I cut that hand off.”"

rows.original: Laughing, you pull your hand away, not sure if she’s serious or not. She couldn’t be. Right?
rows.translation: 你笑着抽回手，不确定她是否认真。应该不是吧？
rows.raw: "\n\nLaughing, you pull your hand away, not sure if she’s serious or not. She couldn’t be. Right?"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Her Sex
rows.translation: 她的性别
rows.raw: "Her Sex"

rows.original: Ask her what her “deal” is.
rows.translation: 问她到底有什么“问题”。
rows.raw: "Ask her what her “deal” is."

rows.original: Profession
rows.translation: 职业
rows.raw: "Profession"

rows.original: You decide to ask about her job.
rows.translation: 你决定询问她的工作。
rows.raw: "You decide to ask about her job."

rows.original: “Bounty Hunter.” She takes a sip of her drink. “That’s what you figured out right?”
rows.translation: “赏金猎人。”她抿了口酒。“你不就是这么猜的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bounty Hunter.” She takes a sip of her drink. “That’s what you figured out right?”"

rows.original: You frown at that, reminding her she wasn’t very clear on the subject.
rows.translation: 你对此皱眉，提醒她一直说得不够清楚。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou frown at that, reminding her she wasn’t very clear on the subject."

rows.original: The ovir woman scratches her face a bit, staring at you hard. “It’s accurate enough.”
rows.translation: 欧维尔女子挠挠脸，狠狠盯着你。“已经够准确了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe ovir woman scratches her face a bit, staring at you hard. “It’s accurate enough.”"

rows.original: “I think you can do better than that.” You lean in slightly, feeling like you know the white ovir well enough to get when she isn’t being straight with you.
rows.translation: “我觉得你可以说得更好些。”你稍稍靠近，感觉自己已经足够了解这个白色欧维尔，能看出她何时没说实话。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think you can do better than that.” You lean in slightly, feeling like you know the white ovir well enough to get when she isn’t being straight with you."

rows.original: Tessa sighs deeply and pushes her drink to the side, an uncharacteristic move for her. “How did you find out about that anyways... I never did ask.”
rows.translation: 泰莎深深叹气，把酒推到一旁，这对她来说很反常。“说起来，你到底怎么知道那件事的...我一直没问。”
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa sighs deeply and pushes her drink to the side, an uncharacteristic move for her. “How did you find out about that anyways... I never did ask.”"

rows.original: You mention you observed her looking up bounties, and you hazarded a guess.
rows.translation: 你说自己看见她查询悬赏，于是大胆猜测。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou mention you observed her looking up bounties, and you hazarded a guess."

rows.original: That stops the white woman in her tracks and she glares at you. “So, you guessed?”
rows.translation: 这让白色女子动作一顿，怒视着你。“所以，你只是猜的？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThat stops the white woman in her tracks and she glares at you. “So, you guessed?”"

rows.original: All you can offer in response is a shrug.
rows.translation: 你只能耸耸肩作为回应。
rows.raw: "\n\nAll you can offer in response is a shrug."

rows.original: That brings a chuckle from the woman, and her tail making a bit of movement behind her. “Oh, that’s good. Very good. Here I am letting you into my little world based completely off of a guess. Well cheers to you!” She goes for her glass, but doesn’t take it, her hand stopping just before it.
rows.translation: 这让女人轻笑出声，身后的尾巴也稍稍动了动。“哦，很好。非常好。我居然仅凭一个猜测，就让你进入了我的小世界。好吧，敬你！”她伸手去拿杯子，却没有拿起来，手停在了杯子前。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat brings a chuckle from the woman, and her tail making a bit of movement behind her. “Oh, that’s good. Very good. Here I am letting you into my little world based completely off of a guess. Well cheers to you!” She goes for her glass, but doesn’t take it, her hand stopping just before it."

rows.original: You stare at her a moment, watching her hesitation. You’ve never known her to turn down a good sip.
rows.translation: 你盯着她看了一会儿，注意到她的迟疑。你从未见她拒绝过美酒。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stare at her a moment, watching her hesitation. You’ve never known her to turn down a good sip."

rows.original: “How much would it take to change the subject?” She says after a long moment. She stares at you hard, her eyes focused. There is no annoyance, or rage, or murderous intent in her stare. Just focus.
rows.translation: “要付出多少才能换个话题？”沉默许久后，她开口说道。她专注地紧盯着你。那目光中没有恼怒、愤恨或杀意，只有专注。
rows.raw: "\n\n“How much would it take to change the subject?” She says after a long moment. She stares at you hard, her eyes focused. There is no annoyance, or rage, or murderous intent in her stare. Just focus."

rows.original: Back Off
rows.translation: 后退
rows.raw: "Back Off"

rows.original: Back Off
rows.translation: 后退
rows.raw: "Back Off"

rows.original: Discretion is the better part of wisdom they say.
rows.translation: 人们常说，谨慎才是明智之举。
rows.raw: "Discretion is the better part of wisdom they say."

rows.original: Push the Issue
rows.translation: 追问到底
rows.raw: "Push the Issue"

rows.original: Push the issue
rows.translation: 追问到底
rows.raw: "Push the issue"

rows.original: Don’t let her off THAT easy.
rows.translation: 别让她这么轻易蒙混过去。
rows.raw: "Don’t let her off THAT easy."

rows.original: Against your better judgement, you decide to ask her about her job again.
rows.translation: 尽管理智告诉你不该这么做，你还是决定再次询问她的工作。
rows.raw: "Against your better judgement, you decide to ask her about her job again."

rows.original: Tessa chuckles. “Want to be reminded of how I almost killed you?” She smirks and sips her beer, seemingly very relaxed. “What’s there to say? I kill people for money.”
rows.translation: 泰莎轻笑一声。“想让我提醒你，我差点杀了你的事吗？”她得意一笑，喝了口啤酒，看起来十分放松。“有什么好说的？我收钱杀人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa chuckles. “Want to be reminded of how I almost killed you?” She smirks and sips her beer, seemingly very relaxed. “What’s there to say? I kill people for money.”"

rows.original: You stare at her a moment, a bit uneven about how flippant she is over it.
rows.translation: 你盯着她看了一会儿，对她如此轻描淡写的态度感到有些不自在。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stare at her a moment, a bit uneven about how flippant she is over it."

rows.original: “Oh, don’t give me that look. This is why I didn’t want to tell you. Don’t worry. I don’t kill people who don’t already have it coming.” She sets her drink down and frowns. “I don’t... do it much. There is good money to be made doing it, and I can more than sustain my lifestyle only killing a few people a year.”
rows.translation: “哦，别这样看我。这就是我不想告诉你的原因。放心，我不会杀那些罪不至死的人。”她放下酒杯，皱起眉头。“我不...常干这事。这行报酬丰厚，我一年只杀几个人，就足以维持现在的生活。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, don’t give me that look. This is why I didn’t want to tell you. Don’t worry. I don’t kill people who don’t already have it coming.” She sets her drink down and frowns. “I don’t... do it much. There is good money to be made doing it, and I can more than sustain my lifestyle only killing a few people a year.”"

rows.original: “I don’t think that makes it much better.” Your eyes move to her knife at her hip. “How do you even get into that sort of thing?”
rows.translation: “我觉得这并没有好多少。”你的目光移向她腰间的刀。“你究竟是怎么入这一行的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t think that makes it much better.” Your eyes move to her knife at her hip. “How do you even get into that sort of thing?”"

rows.original: “Oh. Well I started off as a Bounty Hunter, like you guessed. Now most bounties want you to bring in the mark alive... Well I wasn’t very good at that.” She motions up and down at herself. “You try subduing and dragging a 300-pound ausar onto your ship with a build like mine and you find out quick what you can and can’t do.”
rows.translation: “哦。好吧，我一开始确实像你猜的那样，是个赏金猎人。大多数悬赏都要求活捉目标...可我不太擅长这个。”她上下比划着自己的身体。“你用我这种体格试试制服一个三百磅重的奥萨，再把他拖上飞船，很快就会明白自己能做什么、不能做什么。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh. Well I started off as a Bounty Hunter, like you guessed. Now most bounties want you to bring in the mark alive... Well I wasn’t very good at that.” She motions up and down at herself. “You try subduing and dragging a 300-pound ausar onto your ship with a build like mine and you find out quick what you can and can’t do.”"

rows.original: You frown, “Why be a Bounty Hunter? It’s not exactly the sort of job anybody can just do.”
rows.translation: 你皱起眉头，“为什么要当赏金猎人？这可不是什么人都能随便干的工作。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou frown, “Why be a Bounty Hunter? It’s not exactly the sort of job anybody can just do.”"

rows.original: The white woman sighs deeply and takes a big swing from her drink. “I fell into it. I needed a job and it paid well. Did some easy ones and got a taste for it. It’s very exciting. rows.translation: “施虐狂？听起来像是在挑战我。”你听见泰莎从你身边后退几步，随后脚步声消失了。漫长的几次心跳之后，你听见她出现在身后。“准备好，小甜心。这会很有趣的。”接下来只剩寂静....
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sadist? Sounds like a challenge.” You hear Tessa take a few steps backwards from you, then her footsteps vanish. A few long heartbeats later, you hear her behind you. “Get ready, love muffin. This is going to be fun.” All that follows is silence...."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You listen for movement but can’t seem to find her. “Tessa?” You call out but get no reply. You shift your feet, straining your arms against the rope. Where is she? Was she sitting in the corner? You listen harder. Nothing. Your heart flutters in your chest.
rows.translation: 你侧耳寻找动静，却怎么也找不到她。“泰莎？”你出声呼唤，却没有回应。你挪动双脚，双臂拉扯着绳索。她在哪儿？坐在角落里吗？你更加用力倾听。什么也没有。你的心在胸腔里一颤。
rows.raw: "You listen for movement but can’t seem to find her. “Tessa?” You call out but get no reply. You shift your feet, straining your arms against the rope. Where is she? Was she sitting in the corner? You listen harder. Nothing. Your heart flutters in your chest."

rows.original: Suddenly you feel a sharp nail graze along your chin, a flare of sensation in your sightless world. You start to let out a sharp gasp, but are hushed by the white woman. “Shhhh. Easy there. Just be quiet and enjoy.” Tessa’s claw-like nail drags downward along your neck then vanishes off your [pc.skinFurScales].
rows.translation: 忽然，一枚尖锐指甲擦过你的下巴，在失去视觉的世界里激起一阵鲜明触感。你刚要猛吸一口气，白色女人便嘘声制止。“嘘——放轻松。安静享受就好。”泰莎利爪般的指甲沿你的脖子向下划过，随后从[pc.skinFurScales]上消失。
rows.raw: "\n\nSuddenly you feel a sharp nail graze along your chin, a flare of sensation in your sightless world. You start to let out a sharp gasp, but are hushed by the white woman. “Shhhh. Easy there. Just be quiet and enjoy.” Tessa’s claw-like nail drags downward along your neck then vanishes off your [pc.skinFurScales]."

rows.original: Tessa moves around the room, stalking you like a predator on the hunt. Every so often she makes a subtle noise, but you know it’s only because she made it on purpose. With each sound your head turns towards the cause of the break in silence, struggling to follow the ovir’s movements. A long minute passes, then one of Tessa’s nails touches the back of your neck. You can’t help but jump at her touch, the unexpected contact feeling electric against your vulnerable nape, sending your heart hammering.
rows.translation: 泰莎在房间里移动，像狩猎中的掠食者般追踪你。她偶尔发出一点细微声响，但你知道那只是她故意为之。每次声音打破寂静，你都会朝声源转头，努力追踪奥维尔的动向。漫长的一分钟过去，泰莎的一枚指甲触到你的后颈。你忍不住被她吓得一跳；这意外接触在脆弱颈后激起电流般的感觉，让你的心狂跳不止。
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa moves around the room, stalking you like a predator on the hunt. Every so often she makes a subtle noise, but you know it’s only because she made it on purpose. With each sound your head turns towards the cause of the break in silence, struggling to follow the ovir’s movements. A long minute passes, then one of Tessa’s nails touches the back of your neck. You can’t help but jump at her touch, the unexpected contact feeling electric against your vulnerable nape, sending your heart hammering."

rows.original: “So jumpy. I love it.” Tessa’s tone is low and husky in your ear. You feel a second unexpected touch on your stomach, and you can only assume it’s Tessa pressing the tip of her tail firmly against your exposed belly. You strain against the rope, trying to defend yourself against her invasive touch. Her tail drags across your body, brushing against your [pc.skinFurScales] then disappears off you, leaving your flesh tingling. Tessa’s nail starts to glide down your neck before vanishing as well off your now trembling body.
rows.translation: “真容易受惊。我喜欢。”泰莎低沉沙哑的声音贴在你耳边。你感到腹部传来第二次意外触碰，只能猜测是泰莎用尾尖用力抵住裸露的小腹。你挣扎着拉扯绳索，试图抵御她侵入性的触摸。她的尾巴拖过你的身体，擦过[pc.skinFurScales]后离开，留下阵阵麻痒。泰莎的指甲开始沿你的脖子滑下，随后也从颤抖的身体上消失。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So jumpy. I love it.” Tessa’s tone is low and husky in your ear. You feel a second unexpected touch on your stomach, and you can only assume it’s Tessa pressing the tip of her tail firmly against your exposed belly. You strain against the rope, trying to defend yourself against her invasive touch. Her tail drags across your body, brushing against your [pc.skinFurScales] then disappears off you, leaving your flesh tingling. Tessa’s nail starts to glide down your neck before vanishing as well off your now trembling body."

rows.original: Tessa speaks again, now in a different spot from where she was standing. “Having fun yet?” Despite the absurdity of the situation, you can’t help but nod. Each of her touches feels far more potent than it should, the sensation of her sharp dangerous nails against your [pc.skinFurScales] makes you more than a little excited. You feel your breath start to grow heavy and the air starts to feel warm against your exposed body. Your arms ache as you strain against the restrictive bonds on your wrists.
rows.translation: 泰莎再次开口，声音已从另一个位置传来。“玩得开心吗？”尽管情形荒唐，你仍忍不住点头。她的每一下触碰都远比理应的更加强烈；危险的尖锐指甲划过[pc.skinFurScales]，令你兴奋得不止一点。你的呼吸逐渐加重，空气贴着裸露身体时也开始显得温热。手腕被牢牢束缚，你不断拉扯，双臂隐隐作痛。
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa speaks again, now in a different spot from where she was standing. “Having fun yet?” Despite the absurdity of the situation, you can’t help but nod. Each of her touches feels far more potent than it should, the sensation of her sharp dangerous nails against your [pc.skinFurScales] makes you more than a little excited. You feel your breath start to grow heavy and the air starts to feel warm against your exposed body. Your arms ache as you strain against the restrictive bonds on your wrists."

rows.original: Two sharp nails press on the sensitive underside of your arm. You can’t help but squirm as they trail downwards, heading towards your tender armpit, your body starting to twist away from the contact on it’s own. “Easy now. Move too much and I might nick you.” You try your best to stay still, successful for the moment as you struggle against the urge to fight against the attack. Tessa’s fingers reach your armpit then shift their path along your collarbone. A third nail joins the others and their trail stops at your sternum. “Your heart is pounding, can you hear it?”
rows.translation: 两枚尖锐指甲压在你手臂敏感的内侧。它们一路向下，朝娇嫩腋窝逼近，你忍不住扭动，身体自行躲避着接触。“放轻松。动得太厉害，我可能会划伤你。”你竭力保持静止，暂时成功压下了抵抗这种袭击的冲动。泰莎的手指抵达腋窝，随后改变路线，沿锁骨划去。第三枚指甲加入另外两枚，最终停在你的胸骨上。“你的心跳得好快，听见了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nTwo sharp nails press on the sensitive underside of your arm. You can’t help but squirm as they trail downwards, heading towards your tender armpit, your body starting to twist away from the contact on it’s own. “Easy now. Move too much and I might nick you.” You try your best to stay still, successful for the moment as you struggle against the urge to fight against the attack. Tessa’s fingers reach your armpit then shift their path along your collarbone. A third nail joins the others and their trail stops at your sternum. “Your heart is pounding, can you hear it?”"

rows.original: Even if you couldn’t before, with your senses sharpened you surely can now as it thumps wildly in your chest. You feel your [pc.legs] grow weak underneath you, your body feeling more sluggish by the minute. You really are starting to enjoy this. A loud sound off to the side startles you, Tessa’s nails still pressing tight against your chest. You feel a sharp pain, suspecting she scratched you with her wicked claws. “Ow, what the hell?”
rows.translation: 即便先前听不见，感官变得敏锐后，你现在肯定能听见它在胸腔里疯狂跳动。你的[pc.legs]在身下发软，身体每分钟都变得更加迟钝。你确实开始享受这一切。侧面突然传来一声巨响，把你吓了一跳；泰莎的指甲仍紧紧压在胸口。尖锐疼痛传来，你怀疑她用邪恶利爪抓伤了你。“嗷，搞什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nEven if you couldn’t before, with your senses sharpened you surely can now as it thumps wildly in your chest. You feel your [pc.legs] grow weak underneath you, your body feeling more sluggish by the minute. You really are starting to enjoy this. A loud sound off to the side startles you, Tessa’s nails still pressing tight against your chest. You feel a sharp pain, suspecting she scratched you with her wicked claws. “Ow, what the hell?”"

rows.original: With her free hand Tessa strokes your cheek. “Awww, sorry ‘bout that.” The insincerity of her tone is thicker than honey. “Damned tail has a mind of its own. Did I hurt you?” Her hand on your chest pulls away and in its place you feel an unexpected warm wetness.
rows.translation: 泰莎用空着的手抚摸你的脸颊。“哎呀，对不起啦。”她语气中的虚伪简直比蜂蜜还浓。“该死的尾巴有自己的想法。我弄疼你了吗？”她按在你胸前的手抽开，取而代之的是出乎意料的温热湿意。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith her free hand Tessa strokes your cheek. “Awww, sorry ‘bout that.” The insincerity of her tone is thicker than honey. “Damned tail has a mind of its own. Did I hurt you?” Her hand on your chest pulls away and in its place you feel an unexpected warm wetness."

rows.original: You wince as her tongue and lips touch your scratches, but the soft and warm sensation only lasts a fleeting moment before it’s gone. Her kiss was a sloppy one, as you feel a wet spot still on your chest. The hand she has on your cheek runs along your jaw, her smooth scales tickling as they trail along your [pc.skinFurScales]. While focusing on the caress of her hand, you’re suddenly hit by something long and strong wrapping around your waist. Knowing the ovir’s anatomy, it’s quite clearly her tail.
rows.translation: 她的舌头和嘴唇碰到抓痕时，你疼得一缩，但柔软温暖的感觉转瞬即逝。她这一吻十分湿润，你仍能感觉胸前留着一块湿痕。她放在你脸颊上的手沿着下颌滑动，光滑鳞片掠过[pc.skinFurScales]，挠得你发痒。就在你专注于手掌爱抚时，某种修长有力的东西突然缠住腰间。考虑到奥维尔的身体构造，那显然是她的尾巴。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wince as her tongue and lips touch your scratches, but the soft and warm sensation only lasts a fleeting moment before it’s gone. Her kiss was a sloppy one, as you feel a wet spot still on your chest. The hand she has on your cheek runs along your jaw, her smooth scales tickling as they trail along your [pc.skinFurScales]. While focusing on the caress of her hand, you’re suddenly hit by something long and strong wrapping around your waist. Knowing the ovir’s anatomy, it’s quite clearly her tail."

rows.original: The strong appendage hugs you tightly, its scales pressing hard into your form. The tip of her tail wiggles against your [pc.hip], causing you to squirm at the touch. “Like it when I hold you close?” You feel the ovir’s warm breath tickle your neck as she talks. She leans in closer and you feel her soft lips brush against your throat lightly.
rows.translation: 强壮附肢紧紧抱住你，鳞片用力压进身体。她的尾尖在[pc.hip]上扭动，让你因触碰而不停挣扎。“喜欢我把你紧紧抱住吗？”奥维尔说话时，温热吐息挠过你的脖子。她靠得更近，柔软嘴唇轻轻擦过你的喉咙。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe strong appendage hugs you tightly, its scales pressing hard into your form. The tip of her tail wiggles against your [pc.hip], causing you to squirm at the touch. “Like it when I hold you close?” You feel the ovir’s warm breath tickle your neck as she talks. She leans in closer and you feel her soft lips brush against your throat lightly."

rows.original: Before you can reply she and her tail vanish off you, leaving you exposed and alone. A quick snap on your ass makes you yelp, Tessa’s tail delivering a strong smack to your backside, the sting radiating across your meaty flesh. You hear your play partner chuckle off to the side and you turn in her direction. “Now that was mean,” you admonish her weakly.
rows.translation: 你还未来得及回答，她和尾巴便从你身上消失，只留下赤裸而孤单的你。屁股突然挨了一记脆响，令你惊叫出声；泰莎的尾巴狠狠抽中你的后臀，刺痛扩散至厚实肉体。你听见玩伴在侧面轻笑，于是转向她。“这可太坏了，”你无力地责备道。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you can reply she and her tail vanish off you, leaving you exposed and alone. A quick snap on your ass makes you yelp, Tessa’s tail delivering a strong smack to your backside, the sting radiating across your meaty flesh. You hear your play partner chuckle off to the side and you turn in her direction. “Now that was mean,” you admonish her weakly."

rows.original: “Oh [pc.name] honey. If you thought that was bad....” You hear a metallic sliding sound. “Then you don’t have a very good imagination.” Tessa makes noticeable footsteps, positioning herself in front of you. “Trust me. Don’t move.”
rows.translation: “哦，[pc.name]亲爱的。如果你觉得刚才已经很过分....”你听见金属滑动声。“那你的想象力可不怎么样。”泰莎故意踏出明显的脚步，站到你面前。“相信我。别动。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh [pc.name] honey. If you thought that was bad....” You hear a metallic sliding sound. “Then you don’t have a very good imagination.” Tessa makes noticeable footsteps, positioning herself in front of you. “Trust me. Don’t move.”"

rows.original: Doing as you’re told, you brace yourself. Cold steel meets your neck, as Tessa’s knife presses against you. You can’t help but tug on the ropes in alarm, but remain as still as you can, quivering at the dangerous touch. Tessa rotates the knife slowly and deliberately, the flat of the blade turning over to the edge.
rows.translation: 你依言做好准备。冰冷钢铁贴上颈侧，泰莎的刀抵住了你。你惊慌地拉扯绳索，却还是尽力保持不动，在危险触感下瑟瑟发抖。泰莎缓慢而刻意地转动刀子，刀身平面逐渐翻向锋刃。
rows.raw: "\n\nDoing as you’re told, you brace yourself. Cold steel meets your neck, as Tessa’s knife presses against you. You can’t help but tug on the ropes in alarm, but remain as still as you can, quivering at the dangerous touch. Tessa rotates the knife slowly and deliberately, the flat of the blade turning over to the edge."

rows.original: “Do you have any idea how hot I get knowing I have your life in my hands?” Tessa’s tone is throaty, her breathing slightly labored. “Don’t worry. I’ll be careful not to cut you again... This time.” You feel the knife drag along your neck, moving down to your collar. The cold blade feels wickedly sharp against you, not helped by how hot you feel. The blade moves to your shoulder, where Tessa presses it against you harder, the edge just on the brink of cutting you. Then it vanishes off you, making your body sing in its absence.
rows.translation: “知道一想到你的命掌握在我手里，我会有多兴奋吗？”泰莎嗓音低沉，呼吸略显急促。“别担心。我会小心不再割伤你...至少这一次。”刀刃沿你的脖子拖过，向下移至衣领。冰凉刀锋贴着身体，显得邪恶而锋利，你浑身发热的感觉更令情况雪上加霜。刀刃移向肩膀，泰莎更用力地将它压住，刃口正处在割破皮肤的边缘。随后它突然离开，让你的身体因触感消失而嗡鸣。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do you have any idea how hot I get knowing I have your life in my hands?” Tessa’s tone is throaty, her breathing slightly labored. “Don’t worry. I’ll be careful not to cut you again... This time.” You feel the knife drag along your neck, moving down to your collar. The cold blade feels wickedly sharp against you, not helped by how hot you feel. The blade moves to your shoulder, where Tessa presses it against you harder, the edge just on the brink of cutting you. Then it vanishes off you, making your body sing in its absence."

rows.original: A long few moments pass with no touch. You call out to your silent friend but get no answer. Carefully you listen, and you quiver in anticipation. You hear her breathing on the far side of the room, faintly. You turn to her but are suddenly met with a light touch from her tail on your [pc.thigh].
rows.translation: 漫长的片刻过去，始终没有新的触碰。你呼唤沉默的朋友，却得不到回答。你仔细倾听，在期待中颤抖。房间另一端隐约传来她的呼吸声。你转向她，却突然感到尾巴轻触[pc.thigh]。
rows.raw: "\n\nA long few moments pass with no touch. You call out to your silent friend but get no answer. Carefully you listen, and you quiver in anticipation. You hear her breathing on the far side of the room, faintly. You turn to her but are suddenly met with a light touch from her tail on your [pc.thigh]."

rows.original: Her tail lightly trails upwards, brushing against your crotch and briefly visiting your [pc.genitals]. Then you feel the unmistakable sensation of teeth on your jaw, Tessa’s sharp fangs grazing you as she nibbles at your chin. You lash out a bit, causing Tessa and her touches to withdraw. You hear her laughing behind you.
rows.translation: 她的尾巴轻轻向上游移，擦过胯部并短暂造访[pc.genitals]。紧接着，你的下颌传来无可错认的牙齿触感；泰莎的尖牙啃咬着你的下巴，轻轻擦过皮肤。你猛地挣动一下，令泰莎和她的触碰退开。你听见她在身后大笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer tail lightly trails upwards, brushing against your crotch and briefly visiting your [pc.genitals]. Then you feel the unmistakable sensation of teeth on your jaw, Tessa’s sharp fangs grazing you as she nibbles at your chin. You lash out a bit, causing Tessa and her touches to withdraw. You hear her laughing behind you."

rows.original: “Oh Steele. This is going to be so much fun.”
rows.translation: “哦，斯蒂尔。这会非常有趣的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh Steele. This is going to be so much fun.”"

rows.original: Half an hour passes.
rows.translation: 半小时过去了。
rows.raw: "\n\nHalf an hour passes."

rows.original: You struggle to stand, your [pc.legs] failing you. Tessa, stalking you still, is nowhere to be heard, and you have long since stopped trying to track her. Her touches seem random and without pattern. One minute it would be her knife and the next her soft wet lips. The blind sensations are killing you, her teasing going beyond what you are used to. Suddenly, the rope holding you upright goes loose and your arms fall free, causing you to lose your balance and fall on your [pc.ass]. “What the hell?” You pull off the blindfold and see Tessa standing in front of you, having just cut the rope with her knife.
rows.translation: 你努力站稳，但[pc.legs]已经不听使唤。泰莎仍在追踪你，却听不见任何踪迹，而你早已放弃追踪她。她的触碰似乎毫无规律；前一分钟还是刀锋，下一分钟便换成柔软湿润的嘴唇。失去视觉后的种种感觉快把你逼疯，她的挑逗远超你习惯的程度。忽然，吊住你的绳索松开，双臂重获自由，你随即失去平衡，摔坐在[pc.ass]上。“搞什么？”你扯下眼罩，看见泰莎站在面前，刚用刀割断绳索。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou struggle to stand, your [pc.legs] failing you. Tessa, stalking you still, is nowhere to be heard, and you have long since stopped trying to track her. Her touches seem random and without pattern. One minute it would be her knife and the next her soft wet lips. The blind sensations are killing you, her teasing going beyond what you are used to. Suddenly, the rope holding you upright goes loose and your arms fall free, causing you to lose your balance and fall on your [pc.ass]. “What the hell?” You pull off the blindfold and see Tessa standing in front of you, having just cut the rope with her knife."

rows.original: Tessa smiles and sheathes her weapon. “That was fun Steele, but I think it’s time to call it.” Her face is flushed and her voice heavy. “Can you show yourself out? I have some stuff to take care of. And I suspect you do as well.” She gives you a knowing look.
rows.translation: 泰莎笑了笑，将武器收回鞘中。“挺好玩的，斯蒂尔，但我想该到此为止了。”她脸颊泛红，声音沉重。“你能自己出去吗？我还有些事要处理。我猜你也一样。”她心照不宣地看了你一眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa smiles and sheathes her weapon. “That was fun Steele, but I think it’s time to call it.” Her face is flushed and her voice heavy. “Can you show yourself out? I have some stuff to take care of. And I suspect you do as well.” She gives you a knowing look."

rows.original: “You mean we’re not going to-” You huff and start to undo the bindings. “Right. Got it.”
rows.translation: “你是说我们不打算—”你哼了一声，开始解开绑缚。“好吧。明白了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You mean we’re not going to-” You huff and start to undo the bindings. “Right. Got it.”"

rows.original: The white woman sighs and crouches down in front of you. “Maybe next time, Steele.” She give you a condescending pat on the head, like a child or pet. “This was just play. Never said there would be any sex involved.”
rows.translation: 白色女人叹了口气，蹲在你面前。“下次再说吧，斯蒂尔。”她像对待孩子或宠物一样，居高临下地拍了拍你的头。“这只是玩耍。我可从没说过会涉及性爱。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe white woman sighs and crouches down in front of you. “Maybe next time, Steele.” She give you a condescending pat on the head, like a child or pet. “This was just play. Never said there would be any sex involved.”"

rows.original: You gather up your stuff and start to head out, feeling more than a little pent up. That woman sure knows how to be a tease.
rows.translation: 你收拾好东西，开始往外走，感到欲火积压得厉害。那个女人真懂得怎么吊人胃口。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou gather up your stuff and start to head out, feeling more than a little pent up. That woman sure knows how to be a tease."

rows.translation: “我在想，也许我们可以试试别的。”

rows.translation: 你们抵达她的飞船黑檀号，她领你进了里面。船体不大，却不显拥挤，而且显然长期有人生活。主货舱被布置成客厅，你还注意到地上不止一个空啤酒瓶。继续环顾，你看见侧面有扇门，猜那是她的卧室，便朝那里走去。“地方不错，我该放松一点吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you arrive at her ship, the Ebony, and she leads you inside. The vessel is small, but not cramped, and you get a feeling it’s been well lived in. The main hold has been furnished like a living room, and you note more than one empty beer bottle laying around. Looking around more, you see a door off to the side which you suspect to be her bedroom and start off towards it. “Nice place, should I get comfy?”"

rows.original: Tessa removes her jacket and tosses it to the side. She turns to you and rolls her eyes. “Don’t go in there dumbass.”
rows.translation: 泰莎脱下夹克扔到一边。她转向你翻了个白眼。“别进去，蠢货。”
rows.raw: "\n\nTessa removes her jacket and tosses it to the side. She turns to you and rolls her eyes. “Don’t go in there dumbass.”"

rows.original: You stop and turn around, facing the white woman. “Ah, I thought that was the bedroom.”
rows.translation: 你停步转身，面向白色女子。“啊，我还以为那是卧室。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stop and turn around, facing the white woman. “Ah, I thought that was the bedroom.”"

rows.original: The ovir stares at you a moment. “Yeah, it is. But we’re not using it. We’re using the cargo hold.” Tessa points to the back of the ship and starts to walk over. “We’re doing this my way remember?”
rows.translation: 欧维尔盯着你看了一会儿。“对，是卧室。但我们不用那里。我们用货舱。”泰莎指向飞船后部，迈步走去。“记得吗？要按我的方式来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe ovir stares at you a moment. “Yeah, it is. But we’re not using it. We’re using the cargo hold.” Tessa points to the back of the ship and starts to walk over. “We’re doing this my way remember?”"

rows.translation: “好吧，那轮到你了。”你忍不住露出笑容，非常好奇她那身紧身衣下藏着什么。环顾房间，你不禁发现这里根本没有家具。她到底打算做什么？
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, your turn then.” You can’t help but smile, more than a little curious what’s under that catsuit of hers. Looking around the room you can’t help but notice there isn’t any furniture. What exactly does she have in mind?"

I’m pretty good at sizing a person up, so I’m usually right.” She pulls a length of rope from the box and turns back to face you.

rows.raw: "\n\nTessa laughs and shakes her head. “Yeah no. Sorry we’re not doing that today.” She turns and heads to the corner of the hold and opens a crate. “What are you like [pc.height]?
