rows.original: “Um, what are you doing?” You eyeball the rope, feeling like you might have signed up for something a bit more freaky than intended.

Without a word, she moves towards you and slips the binders over your wrists. “Um...Tessa?”
rows.translation: 你走到她所在的房间中央，按照指示举起双臂。你看着她测量并稍微调整绳子，接着她回到箱子旁，拿来两只束腕和一条眼罩。她一言不发地靠近你，将束腕套上你的手腕。“呃...泰莎？”

Taking a step back she examines her work.

rows.original: You snag one of the waitresses and ask for a menu. She nods and scurries off toward the front, vanishing into the crowd of bodies flooding through the place. They crowd around you, seemingly heedless of your personal space, noses and hands poking all over your alien form for what must be half an hour before your waitress returns with a glass of water and a menu. She scoots off before you can ask for a proper drink or an appetizer.

He nods, scribbling it down before bolting off to another table, utterly ignoring the clamoring family of raskvel around you.

You say goodbye to the raskvel family sitting around (or in their son’s case, on) you and depart. Just as you’re reaching the door, you turn back to see the first waitress coming by your former table with a basket of what looks like very stale bread.

rows.original: “Did have its perks, all things considered. Dad hooked me up with a job in a corporation that I wouldn’t have been able to get otherwise. Nepotism at its finest, I guess? But my dad didn’t control the firm, he was in a high position but not that high. There were people outside the community working there. So, I got paired up with a handsome guy. Tanned, buff, blond hair, blue eyes, and a nice dick, though I learned that later. Eventually we grew close and started dating a while and I fell in love with him. Eventually, he suggested that we should move into the same apartment.”
rows.translation: “不过仔细想想，那种生活也有好处。老爸托关系把我塞进了一家我原本根本进不去的公司。裙带关系发挥到极致了吧？不过那公司不是我爸说了算，他职位虽高，却也没高到那个份上。那里也有社区外的人工作。于是我和一个英俊男人搭档：皮肤晒得黝黑，身材健壮，一头金发，蓝眼睛，鸡巴也很漂亮——当然，这是后来才知道的。我们渐渐亲近，交往了一阵子，我也爱上了他。后来，他提议我们搬到同一间公寓住。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Did have its perks, all things considered. Dad hooked me up with a job in a corporation that I wouldn’t have been able to get otherwise. Nepotism at its finest, I guess? But my dad didn’t control the firm, he was in a high position but not that high. There were people outside the community working there. So, I got paired up with a handsome guy. Tanned, buff, blond hair, blue eyes, and a nice dick, though I learned that later. Eventually we grew close and started dating a while and I fell in love with him. Eventually, he suggested that we should move into the same apartment.”"

rows.original: “But after already having had a boyfriend before, I knew how my dad would react if he found out, so I was in a bit of a dilemma. On one hand I loved him, but on the other hand everyone I ever knew would denounce me and my parents would disown me and my dad would be looking for any excuse to fire me. But, in the end, I chose love and moved in with him and got a job in a different company. It was like a dream come true for the first few months, but then it came crashing down.”
rows.translation: “可我以前已经交过男朋友，知道老爸发现后会有什么反应，所以进退两难。一方面我爱他；另一方面，我认识的所有人都会谴责我，父母会和我断绝关系，老爸也会找尽借口开除我。但最后我还是选择了爱情，搬去和他同住，又在另一家公司找了份工作。头几个月简直美梦成真，可后来一切都垮了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But after already having had a boyfriend before, I knew how my dad would react if he found out, so I was in a bit of a dilemma. On one hand I loved him, but on the other hand everyone I ever knew would denounce me and my parents would disown me and my dad would be looking for any excuse to fire me. But, in the end, I chose love and moved in with him and got a job in a different company. It was like a dream come true for the first few months, but then it came crashing down.”"

rows.original: “After a few months, he left me, glamour apparently wore off, and since the apartment was in his name I got kicked out on my ass. So, there I was: homeless, disowned, and stuck in a dead-end job. But I managed to hunt down a small apartment in a seedy neighborhood. The apartment room was the size of a broom closet, but at least it was dry. Unfortunately, it was the kind of neighborhood where if someone knocked on your door in the middle of the night, you were better off putting a bullet through the door and then seeing who was at it.”
rows.translation: “几个月后，他甩了我。大概新鲜感没了吧。公寓写在他名下，我也被一脚赶了出去。于是我无家可归、被家人断绝关系，还困在一份毫无前途的工作里。不过我总算在一个乌烟瘴气的街区找到了间小公寓。房间跟扫帚柜一样大，但至少不漏雨。可惜那地方危险到半夜有人敲门时，最好先隔着门开一枪，再看看外面是谁。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“After a few months, he left me, glamour apparently wore off, and since the apartment was in his name I got kicked out on my ass. So, there I was: homeless, disowned, and stuck in a dead-end job. But I managed to hunt down a small apartment in a seedy neighborhood. The apartment room was the size of a broom closet, but at least it was dry. Unfortunately, it was the kind of neighborhood where if someone knocked on your door in the middle of the night, you were better off putting a bullet through the door and then seeing who was at it.”"

rows.raw: "\n\nIf the neighborhood was so crime infested, how did she manage to get out and onto Tarkus?"

rows.original: “Bought a gun and a personal shield and started looking for muggers, thieves, and other scums of society and took their ill-gotten gains for myself.”
rows.translation: “我买了把枪和个人护盾，开始专门找劫匪、小偷以及街上的其他人渣。我会抢在他们动手前收拾他们，再拿走他们身上的东西。”

rows.original: “Well it made a better life for me, and it’s not like I feel sympathy for those people. Sure, I understood that they were in a desperate situation, but that doesn’t justify preying on the innocent. But, by living on the smallest budget i could manage and with the unorthodox source of extra income, I managed to scrounge up enough credits to buy a cheap ticket off-world. But that might have been the worst decision of my life. Since it was a shitty, cheap ship, it was easy picking for pirates.”
rows.translation: “至少这让我过上了更好的日子，而且我一点也不同情那些人。我当然明白他们走投无路，可这不是他们对无辜者下手的理由。我把预算压到最低，又靠这份不太正当的额外收入，总算攒够信用点，买了张离开这颗星球的廉价船票。可那大概是我这辈子最糟的决定。那艘破船又烂又便宜，简直是送到海盗嘴边的肥肉。”

But that might have been the worst decision of my life. Since it was a shitty, cheap ship, it was easy picking for pirates.”"

Took me ages to deal with that shit; apparently seeing someone who is supposedly dead walking around isn’t convincing enough. When I got back to the book of the living, I sold the ship and the jewelry and bought a ticket to the nearest livable planet that wasn’t a total backwater shithole, this time making sure that the ship wasn’t pirate bait. It was an uneventful trip, thankfully.”
rows.translation: “等我终于回到友好空域，便去了最近的空间站，却发现她已经把痕迹全掩盖了。档案上我居然已经死了。处理这堆破事花了我好久；他们竟然觉得，一个本该死掉的人活生生站在眼前还不足以证明什么。等我终于重新列入活人名册，就卖掉飞船和珠宝，买了张前往最近宜居行星的船票——当然得不是鸟不拉屎的穷乡僻壤。这次我特意确认飞船不是海盗眼里的肥肉。幸好一路平安无事。”

rows.original: “When I made it planetside, I used the creds to buy a military-tier gun and a personal shield and looked up some work for hired muscle; no surprise that there was a lot of work for a hired gun on an untamed planet, every corporation was willing to throw credits at any two bit hack with a gun in order to try to get a leg up on the competition. After gaining a bit of a reputation for being a tough nut to crack with a death wish, my employer’s words not mine, my current company approached me with an offer: better jobs, bigger pay, but the jobs would be more dangerous. No more pushing around drunks from VIP’s, no more keeping the locals in line, instead jobs like hunting down pirates and dangerous criminals, securing important objectives, and other jobs that were fitting for an actual merc. When I realized that by working with them I could save someone from the fate I suffered, that was enough for me to sign up, well the credits certainly don’t hurt either.”
rows.translation: “到了行星上，我用那些信用点买了军用级枪械和个人护盾，又找了些打手的活。蛮荒行星上到处都有人雇枪手，毫不奇怪：每家公司都愿意向随便哪个带枪的三流货色撒信用点，好压竞争对手一头。后来我闯出了名声，成了个难对付又不怕死的硬骨头——这是雇主的原话，不是我说的——现在这家公司便找上我，开出更好的任务和更高的报酬，当然也更加危险。再也不用替贵宾赶走醉鬼，也不用镇压当地人；改成追捕海盗和危险罪犯、夺取重要目标，以及其他真正适合佣兵的工作。我意识到替他们干活，也许能让别人免遭我曾受过的苦，这就足够让我签约了。当然，信用点多也不是坏事。”

Might have been other mercs or some militia for all I know, but they were some young kids, most of them didn’t even know how to handle a gun. Doesn’t really matter, they tried to stop us, that was all that mattered.”

rows.original: “You lost your arm and eye during an operation? How did you get your cybernetics then? I doubt that the your company has an intensive health care plan,” you wonder while you look at her cybernetic arm.

rows.original: “Well, not exactly. We have a case-by-case basis where one of the commanders judges whether or not the investment’s going to be profitable. Since by that point I had been with them for long enough, they provided me with a basic cybernetic arm. Rookies almost never get cybernetics for free unless they show unprecedented talent in what they do.”
rows.translation: “也不完全是。我们会具体情况具体处理，由一名指挥官判断这笔投资是否有利可图。那时我已经为他们干了够久，所以公司给了我一条基础义肢。新人几乎不可能免费得到义体，除非他们在本行展现出前所未见的天赋。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, not exactly. We have a case-by-case basis where one of the commanders judges whether or not the investment’s going to be profitable. Since by that point I had been with them for long enough, they provided me with a basic cybernetic arm. Rookies almost never get cybernetics for free unless they show unprecedented talent in what they do.”"

rows.original: “When we were deciding the cybernetics, I chipped in with some credits since I wanted to have a sturdier cybernetic, something that I could use in close quarters.” She turns it around, showing it to you. “It doesn’t have a built-in knife, but it packs quite a punch.”
rows.translation: “决定用哪款义体时，我自己也添了些信用点，因为想要条更结实、能用于近身战斗的义肢。”她转动手臂，展示给你看。“它没有内置刀刃，但打起人来相当有劲。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“When we were deciding the cybernetics, I chipped in with some credits since I wanted to have a sturdier cybernetic, something that I could use in close quarters.” She turns it around, showing it to you. “It doesn’t have a built-in knife, but it packs quite a punch.”"

rows.original: “Now, the eye was a son of a bitch since I could still work without an eye and it didn’t hamstring me as much as the missing arm did. The company didn’t pay for a replacement, I had to save up for it myself. Could have afforded a basic one on my average pay, but I decided to get an advanced one. It’s not a supercomputer or anything, but since it’s synced to my arm it can help me aim or calculate a grenade arc.”
rows.translation: “眼睛就麻烦多了。少一只眼我照样能工作，影响又不像没手臂那么大，所以公司没替我买，我只能自己攒钱。按我的平均薪水，本来买得起基础款，可我决定换个高级的。它算不上什么超级计算机，但和手臂同步后，能辅助瞄准，也能计算手榴弹的抛物线。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now, the eye was a son of a bitch since I could still work without an eye and it didn’t hamstring me as much as the missing arm did. The company didn’t pay for a replacement, I had to save up for it myself. Could have afforded a basic one on my average pay, but I decided to get an advanced one. It’s not a supercomputer or anything, but since it’s synced to my arm it can help me aim or calculate a grenade arc.”"

rows.original: “You lost your arm and eye in combat, but what happened to your leg? A similar story to your arm?” You look at her metallic leg.

rows.raw: "\n\n“You lost your arm and eye in combat, but what happened to your leg? A similar story to your arm?” You look at her metallic leg."

rows.original: “Not exactly. Was during a mission as well, but not in combat. Some corporate assholes hired us to retrieve some sensitive data from some banged up research building. Apparently, the reason they hired us was that the data could land them in some hot water. We were ordered to fire at scavengers, scavengers that took to that place like vultures to a corpse.”
rows.translation: “不完全是。也是任务期间，但不是战斗。某群公司混蛋雇我们去一栋破旧研究楼取回敏感资料。显然那批资料可能让他们惹上大麻烦。他们命令我们向拾荒者开火——那些拾荒者像秃鹫扑向尸体一样涌进了那里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not exactly. Was during a mission as well, but not in combat. Some corporate assholes hired us to retrieve some sensitive data from some banged up research building. Apparently, the reason they hired us was that the data could land them in some hot water. We were ordered to fire at scavengers, scavengers that took to that place like vultures to a corpse.”"

rows.raw: "\n\n“The rookie thought that he could set off the charges and later come pick off anything worth selling. Where his plan failed is that our demolitionist didn’t fill the place with charges,the explosion only triggered a collapse, forcing us to retreat before we got the data.”"

rows.raw: "\n\n“During the retreat, part of the ceiling collapsed. Most of it was small rubble. But my leg got stuck under a large metal beam. We didn’t have the manpower nor the time to remove it. It was either get buried under the rubble or amputate the leg.” She pats her metallic leg. “It’s pretty obvious which one I went with.”"

rows.translation: 你尴尬得脸颊发热；就在那个外星——那个谢拉福格人猛然警觉起来，好奇地抬头望向你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou flush in embarrassment as the ali- the Xhelarfog snaps to attention, looking up at you curiously."

rows.translation: 先前因为对方姿势松垮，又没有朝向你，你还真没注意到；可现在，三只金色眼睛正一眨不眨地仰望着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hadn’t really noticed before, thanks to their slouched posture and the fact they weren’t facing in your direction, but they have three, golden eyes staring up at you, unblinking."

rows.raw: "Xhelarfog"

rows.original: There’s a few tense moments of awkward silence before you manage to get your act together, introducing yourself, and they speak up, tucking away their codex so their work doesn’t distract them.
rows.translation: 紧张而尴尬的沉默持续片刻后，你终于镇定下来作了自我介绍。对方也开口说话，同时收起终端，以免工作令人分心。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a few tense moments of awkward silence before you manage to get your act together, introducing yourself, and they speak up, tucking away their codex so their work doesn’t distract them."

rows.original: “Ah! A Steele. [pc.name] Steele, at that! The boss-to-be - or, well ...Potential boss-to-be. It’s a pleasure to make your acquaintance. I am known as Zea.”
rows.translation: “啊！一位斯蒂尔。[pc.name]·斯蒂尔本人！未来的老板——或者说，嗯 ...可能成为未来老板的人。很高兴认识你。我叫泽娅。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah! A Steele. [pc.name] Steele, at that! The boss-to-be - or, well ...Potential boss-to-be. It’s a pleasure to make your acquaintance. I am known as Zea.”"

rows.original: Zea’s speech has some... Odd affectations when it comes to titles, but they’re perfectly understandable.
rows.translation: 泽娅说起头衔时带着某些... 奇怪的腔调，但意思完全可以听懂。
rows.raw: "\n\nZea’s speech has some... Odd affectations when it comes to titles, but they’re perfectly understandable."

rows.original: You pull up a seat across from them, asking what exactly they meant by potential.
rows.translation: 你在对方面前拉开座位坐下，询问所谓的可能究竟是什么意思。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou pull up a seat across from them, asking what exactly they meant by potential."

rows.original: “I don’t know what boss-that-was - Victor - planned to make you go through before taking the company, but I’m sure it was a bad idea. You, your cousin-twins, your uncle, any half-siblings we don’t even know about? All of them are potential bosses-to-be - and that’s just relatives that have a realistic stake in the Steele collective-name.”
rows.translation: “我不知道前任老板，也就是维克托，原本打算让你经受什么考验才肯把公司交给你，但那肯定是个坏主意。你、你的双胞胎表亲、你的叔叔，还有任何连我们都不知道的同父异母或同母异父手足？他们都是潜在的未来老板，这还只是那些确实有资格染指斯蒂尔共同姓氏的亲戚。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t know what boss-that-was - Victor - planned to make you go through before taking the company, but I’m sure it was a bad idea. You, your cousin-twins, your uncle, any half-siblings we don’t even know about? All of them are potential bosses-to-be - and that’s just relatives that have a realistic stake in the Steele collective-name.”"

rows.original: They don’t look particularly concerned at that.

Yeah, no. You might have been courageous enough to try the first one, but considering the explosive mess you found it in, it’s pretty hard to just believe this mad scientist will succeed every time. 还是算了。你或许有勇气尝试第一件，但看到这件是在一片爆炸后的狼藉中找到的，实在很难相信这位疯狂科学家每次都能成功。事实上，你愈发怀疑第一件成功品也许只是侥幸。更别提你穿上这件时，他多半还会研究你！

	你摇摇头，转身把套装留在盒中，回到锈野深处。[pc.isNaga| 再说，你的蛇形身体显然也塞不进这么小的东西。][pc.isTaur| 再说，你很喜欢自己现在的多足兽身体，多谢关心。][pc.isGoo| 再说，你自己就能变形，何必需要一件套装？]

rows.original: Well, why not. Yes, in hindsight there were many reasons why you shouldn’t have tried the taur suit; but in this case, the new suit was practically created for you. Its inventor would obviously have only gotten better at making these since, and the first one already works fine. Time to try this new suit. Much like the first time you tried the taur suit, you make sure to take off your [pc.gear] to prevent it from messing with (or being messed up by) the suit. You take a deep breath and, knowing it’s best to deal with these things as soon as possible, you jump into it. Even waist-deep in the red jelly covered thing, you still aren’t sure what kind of suit it is. Are you going to grow an entire dragon body or what? At any rate, you hop in place as the way it keeps your legs together makes it hard to stay up. On second thought, you decide to just sit down on the ground instead. Better to start off low instead of making things harder on yourself later. And you know things will get, if not hard, at least weird. Taking a deep breath, you locate the belt buckle and press the button. In a very similar way to the other suit, the whole thing whirrs to life and starts tightening around you. It’s a good thing you’re sitting, because your [pc.legs] are hugged so tight by the suit and the jelly that you would definitely not be able to stand. You shiver as the jelly starts filling every nook and cranny of your downstairs region, the sensation remaining odd even after going through it before. You feel your [pc.legs] and [pc.crotch] disappear, only for those sensations to be replaced by the suit’s. And now, the moment you were waiting for. The projectors on the bottom of the suit light up, making it look like it’s growing longer. You watch in fascination – and with a degree of nauseous vertigo - as the suit, no, your body grows longer and longer, every sensation feeding directly into you as it lengthens. Once it finishes in a pointed shape and wags before your eyes, you see what it truly is. It’s a naleen suit, made to give you a long, serpentine body. The suit’s scales grow more and more opaque, more and more realistic, and more and more sensitive. And beyond that, you’re shocked when you feel the muscles below. Growing extra limbs may have been strange, but at least you had an idea of how legs worked. This legless body just operates so differently. Countless new muscles, all working in unison to allow you to twitch and slither and even stand up solidly. Well, this is going to take some getting used to... Aaand you’re good. Seriously, how does this work? You were feeling so confused and nauseated one second, and now all of a sudden everything’s fine. You stand up, making an experimental circle on the floor, and find that you’re as comfortable with this body as if you were born in it. Well, good.
rows.translation: 好吧，何乐而不为。事后看来，之前确实有很多理由不该尝试那件多足兽套装；但这一次，新套装几乎就是为你量身打造的。发明者在之后肯定只会越做越好，而第一件本来就运作正常。 该试试这件新套装了。就像第一次尝试多足兽套装时一样，你先脱下[pc.gear]，免得装备干扰套装或反过来被套装损坏。你深吸一口气，想着这种事最好尽快解决，便纵身跳了进去。 即使腰部以下已经浸进覆盖红色胶质的套装，你依然不确定这究竟是什么类型。难道会长出完整的龙身？不管怎样，套装把双腿紧紧并在一起，你很难站稳，只好原地蹦跳。转念一想，你干脆坐到地上。与其之后给自己添麻烦，还不如一开始就压低重心。你知道接下来就算不会变硬，至少也一定会变得古怪。你深吸一口气，找到腰带扣并按下按钮。 整件套装以和另一件极为相似的方式嗡鸣着启动，并开始贴紧身体。幸好你正坐着，因为套装和胶质把[pc.legs]箍得极紧，你绝对无法站立。胶质开始填满下身每一处缝隙，你不禁颤抖；即使以前经历过，这种感觉依旧古怪。你感到[pc.legs]和[pc.crotch]逐渐消失，随后那些感觉被套装传来的感官取代。 终于到了你一直期待的时刻。套装底部的投影器亮起，看上去像是整件套装正在延长。你着迷地看着它，不适的眩晕感也随之袭来；套装，不，是你的身体变得越来越长，延伸时的每一丝感受都直接传入意识。当末端最终收束成尖形并在眼前摆动时，你终于看清它是什么。这是一件纳林套装，能赋予你修长的蛇形身体。 套装的鳞片变得越来越不透明，越来越逼真，也越来越敏感。更令你震惊的是，你能感觉到下方的肌肉。长出额外肢体固然奇怪，但至少你知道双腿如何活动。这个无腿身体的运作方式却截然不同。无数崭新肌肉协调运作，让你能够抽动、蜿蜒爬行，甚至稳稳直立。看来得花些时间适应... 然后你就适应了。说真的，这到底怎么做到的？前一秒你还困惑又恶心，下一秒一切忽然都恢复正常。你站起身，在地面试着绕了一圈，发现自己使用这具身体时自在得如同天生如此。很好。
rows.raw: "Well, why not. Yes, in hindsight there were many reasons why you shouldn’t have tried the taur suit; but in this case, the new suit was practically created for you. Its inventor would obviously have only gotten better at making these since, and the first one already works fine. Time to try this new suit. Much like the first time you tried the taur suit, you make sure to take off your [pc.gear] to prevent it from messing with (or being messed up by) the suit. You take a deep breath and, knowing it’s best to deal with these things as soon as possible, you jump into it. Even waist-deep in the red jelly covered thing, you still aren’t sure what kind of suit it is. Are you going to grow an entire dragon body or what? At any rate, you hop in place as the way it keeps your legs together makes it hard to stay up. On second thought, you decide to just sit down on the ground instead. Better to start off low instead of making things harder on yourself later. And you know things will get, if not hard, at least weird. Taking a deep breath, you locate the belt buckle and press the button. In a very similar way to the other suit, the whole thing whirrs to life and starts tightening around you. It’s a good thing you’re sitting, because your [pc.legs] are hugged so tight by the suit and the jelly that you would definitely not be able to stand. You shiver as the jelly starts filling every nook and cranny of your downstairs region, the sensation remaining odd even after going through it before. You feel your [pc.legs] and [pc.crotch] disappear, only for those sensations to be replaced by the suit’s. And now, the moment you were waiting for. The projectors on the bottom of the suit light up, making it look like it’s growing longer. You watch in fascination – and with a degree of nauseous vertigo - as the suit, no, your body grows longer and longer, every sensation feeding directly into you as it lengthens. Once it finishes in a pointed shape and wags before your eyes, you see what it truly is. It’s a naleen suit, made to give you a long, serpentine body. The suit’s scales grow more and more opaque, more and more realistic, and more and more sensitive. And beyond that, you’re shocked when you feel the muscles below. Growing extra limbs may have been strange, but at least you had an idea of how legs worked. This legless body just operates so differently. Countless new muscles, all working in unison to allow you to twitch and slither and even stand up solidly. Well, this is going to take some getting used to... Aaand you’re good. Seriously, how does this work? You were feeling so confused and nauseated one second, and now all of a sudden everything’s fine. You stand up, making an experimental circle on the floor, and find that you’re as comfortable with this body as if you were born in it. Well, good. "

rows.original: And looking down you can see your [pc.crotch] recreated right where it should be, at your waist. Though technically the real thing is hidden just behind, it all feels real enough to fool even yourself.

rows.raw: "And looking down you can see your [pc.crotch] recreated right where it should be, at your waist. Though technically the real thing is hidden just behind, it all feels real enough to fool even yourself. "

rows.original: You pat your long tail, satisfied to feel both the deceptively realistic scales with your hand, and the feel of your hand with your sides. You’re a naga now! Now then, you think as you put your [pc.gear] back on. Who could you find around here to wrap yourself around?
rows.translation: 你拍了拍修长的尾巴，手掌感受到以假乱真的鳞片，身体两侧也感受到手掌的触碰，令你十分满意。 你现在是纳迦了！接着，你一边重新穿上[pc.gear]一边思索：这附近能找谁让自己缠上去呢？

rows.original: Besides, you obviously wouldn’t have been able to fit your serpentine body in this tiny little thing anyway.

rows.raw: "\n\nBesides, you obviously wouldn’t have been able to fit your serpentine body in this tiny little thing anyway."

rows.original: As you do, you inadvertently press the big button in the middle of the belt buckle, and all of a sudden both the belt and the rest of the suit spring up to action. The whole thing tightens up around you, hugging every part of you as the jelly inside seems to fill up every crevice. You feel the gel going in every crack, cradling your crotch and even going deep into your orifices - and staying there. You shiver as you feel the invasive pressure in your [pc.vagOrAss] disappear as quickly as it came, and you realize that it isn’t because the jelly retreated, but because you can’t feel your crotch and [pc.legsNoun] anymore!
rows.translation: 就在这时，你无意按下腰带扣中央的大按钮，腰带和整件套装突然同时启动。它紧紧包裹身体，内部胶质似乎填满了每一处缝隙。凝胶钻进所有裂缝，托住裆部，甚至深入你的孔洞并停留其中。你感觉[pc.vagOrAss]中的侵入压力来得快、去得也快，不由打了个冷颤；随即意识到，并不是胶质退了出去，而是你已经感觉不到裆部和[pc.legsNoun]了！
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you do, you inadvertently press the big button in the middle of the belt buckle, and all of a sudden both the belt and the rest of the suit spring up to action. The whole thing tightens up around you, hugging every part of you as the jelly inside seems to fill up every crevice. You feel the gel going in every crack, cradling your crotch and even going deep into your orifices - and staying there. You shiver as you feel the invasive pressure in your [pc.vagOrAss] disappear as quickly as it came, and you realize that it isn’t because the jelly retreated, but because you can’t feel your crotch and [pc.legsNoun] anymore!"

rows.original: Before you can begin panicking, you start feeling the air on your outer pair of legs, and the realization confuses you further. The suit numbed your lower body’s senses to replace them with its own! You can only assume the jelly is used both as an anesthetic and to connect the suit’s nerves with your own. But as you assumed earlier, that was only the beginning. The myriad projectors on your backside light up, projecting what looks unmistakably like a Leithan body. While only shimmers of light at first, the holographic taur body slowly starts to become more and more opaque and dark, adopting the same dark color as your front legs. You can almost feel the weight-
rows.translation: 还没来得及惊慌，你便开始感觉空气拂过外侧那双腿，这个发现让你更加困惑。套装麻痹了下半身的感觉，并用自己的感官取而代之！你只能猜测胶质既充当麻醉剂，又负责把套装的神经与你连接起来。但正如先前预料，这仅仅是开始。你背后无数投影器亮起，投射出一个显然属于莱萨人的身体。最初只是闪烁的微光，全息多足兽身体却渐渐变得越来越不透明、越来越暗，呈现出与前腿相同的深色。你几乎能感觉到那份重量。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you can begin panicking, you start feeling the air on your outer pair of legs, and the realization confuses you further. The suit numbed your lower body’s senses to replace them with its own! You can only assume the jelly is used both as an anesthetic and to connect the suit’s nerves with your own. But as you assumed earlier, that was only the beginning. The myriad projectors on your backside light up, projecting what looks unmistakably like a Leithan body. While only shimmers of light at first, the holographic taur body slowly starts to become more and more opaque and dark, adopting the same dark color as your front legs. You can almost feel the weight-"

rows.original: Whoa! A sudden wave of nausea catches you by surprise. You twist around to look behind you. You’re not just feeling the weight of the suit, you’re starting to feel its everything. Hardlight! You’ve heard of using hardlight providing tacticle feedback to the wearer before, being able to feel a fake cock as though it were real, but a whole body? Your brain struggles to catch on as it suddenly has to deal with having four extra limbs and a whole other abdomen. Both the confusion and the added weight makes you lose your balance and you totter on the spot, each small hop you make on your new legs to catch yourself only adding to the sensory and mental confusion.
rows.translation: 哇！突如其来的恶心感令你措手不及。你扭身回望。你感觉到的不只是套装重量，而是它的一切。硬光！你以前听说过利用硬光向穿戴者提供触觉反馈，让人能像感觉真鸡巴一样感觉假鸡巴，可一整具身体？大脑艰难适应突然多出的四条肢体和另一整个腹部。混乱与额外重量让你失去平衡，只能原地踉跄；每次用新腿小跳着稳住自己，都只会加剧感官和思维的混乱。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhoa! A sudden wave of nausea catches you by surprise. You twist around to look behind you. You’re not just feeling the weight of the suit, you’re starting to feel its everything. Hardlight! You’ve heard of using hardlight providing tacticle feedback to the wearer before, being able to feel a fake cock as though it were real, but a whole body? Your brain struggles to catch on as it suddenly has to deal with having four extra limbs and a whole other abdomen. Both the confusion and the added weight makes you lose your balance and you totter on the spot, each small hop you make on your new legs to catch yourself only adding to the sensory and mental confusion."

rows.original: Eventually you manage to remain steady on your many feet, breathing hard but no longer feeling like you’re about to throw up. If anything, now it feels... natural. As quickly as that. You look behind yourself and gasp at the sight. You now have a Leithan, tauric body with six legs! The hardlight half of your body looks so realistic, you would have believed it was real, had you not seen it come into existence just now. This is like no other hardlight device you have ever seen or heard of; this looks genuinely real. You pat your own flank and feel amazed as you feel your own hand on yourself, but no nausea comes. You shake yourself, and as you do, you feel your [pc.crotch] with a start. Not on the front as usual, mind, but back there. You can’t exactly look, but you can still feel it all as the moving air brushes against you.
rows.translation: 最终，你总算用众多脚掌稳稳站住，仍然喘得厉害，却不再觉得马上就会呕吐。真要说的话，现在感觉反而...很自然。就是这么快。你回头看去，眼前景象令你倒吸一口气。你现在拥有莱萨人的六腿多足兽身体了！身体的硬光后半部分逼真得不可思议，若不是亲眼看着它刚刚成形，你一定会相信那是真的。这与你见过或听说过的任何硬光设备都不同；它看起来确实真实。你拍了拍自己的侧腹，既能感觉手掌触碰身体，也能感觉身体被手掌触碰，却不再恶心。你抖了抖身体，忽然感觉到[pc.crotch]。当然，它不在通常的前方，而是在后面。你看不到，却仍能感觉流动空气拂过那里的每一处。
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually you manage to remain steady on your many feet, breathing hard but no longer feeling like you’re about to throw up. If anything, now it feels... natural. As quickly as that. You look behind yourself and gasp at the sight. You now have a Leithan, tauric body with six legs! The hardlight half of your body looks so realistic, you would have believed it was real, had you not seen it come into existence just now. This is like no other hardlight device you have ever seen or heard of; this looks genuinely real. You pat your own flank and feel amazed as you feel your own hand on yourself, but no nausea comes. You shake yourself, and as you do, you feel your [pc.crotch] with a start. Not on the front as usual, mind, but back there. You can’t exactly look, but you can still feel it all as the moving air brushes against you."

rows.original: Did... Did the suit recreate your genitals back there? As you can’t feel the real ones hidden within the suit at your front, it effectively feels as though they were simply moved where a Leithan’s genitals would normally be.

rows.translation: 你现在是多足兽了！接着，你一边重新穿上[pc.gear]一边想：是骑别人，还是被别人骑，这是个问题。

rows.original: You slow your ship down as you near the orbit of your next destination, Tarkus. As you scale down past a third of the speed of light, the planet begins to come into view: surrounded by a dense field of asteroids loom the two sundered halves of the gabilani world. At first glance this appears to be a lifeless system, however, as the ship’s sensor suite comes online instruments alert you to extreme electromagnetic interference emanating from the planet below, suggesting a power source in the multi-petawatt range. The planet, or perhaps more accurately the rended halves of the former planet, is blatantly chained together with a massive space tether whose every link must be the size of a Terran cruiser! Surely it must have taken the resources of the entire system to erect such a technological marvel: No wonder new pioneers are so interested in this place.
rows.translation: 你在接近下一个目的地塔库斯的轨道时放慢飞船。当速度降到光速的三分之一以下，行星开始映入眼帘：加比拉尼世界断裂成两半，耸立在稠密的小行星带中。乍看之下，这是个毫无生机的星系；然而飞船传感器组启动后，仪器便警告你，下方行星正散发极强的电磁干扰，显示那里存在数拍瓦级能源。那颗行星，或者更准确地说，那颗旧行星撕裂后的两半，显然被一条巨型太空系链拴在一起，每一节链环恐怕都有地球巡洋舰那么大！建造如此技术奇观必定耗尽了整个星系的资源。难怪新一代拓荒者会对这里如此感兴趣。
rows.raw: "You slow your ship down as you near the orbit of your next destination, Tarkus. As you scale down past a third of the speed of light, the planet begins to come into view: surrounded by a dense field of asteroids loom the two sundered halves of the gabilani world. At first glance this appears to be a lifeless system, however, as the ship’s sensor suite comes online instruments alert you to extreme electromagnetic interference emanating from the planet below, suggesting a power source in the multi-petawatt range. The planet, or perhaps more accurately the rended halves of the former planet, is blatantly chained together with a massive space tether whose every link must be the size of a Terran cruiser! Surely it must have taken the resources of the entire system to erect such a technological marvel: No wonder new pioneers are so interested in this place."

rows.original: Slowly but surely, the ship picks through shards of rock that must have once been part of the planet’s core and mantle. Further in however the field seems to largely consist of orbital debris rather than planetary ejecta: hulls of space ships and ruined clumps of satellites mashed together over centuries of disuse flit past you at thousands of kilometers per hour, making your approach difficult. More than once unidentified high velocity particles are intercepted by your shields, a grim reminder your ship is barely equipped to survive this landing. Finally you’re through. The console to your front chirps as heat shields engage and you enter the upper atmosphere.
rows.translation: 飞船缓慢而谨慎地穿过岩石碎片，它们想必曾属于行星的核心与地幔。然而继续深入后，这片区域似乎主要由轨道残骸而非行星喷出物构成：废弃数百年的飞船船体和破碎卫星团挤成一团，以每小时数千公里的速度从你身旁掠过，让接近过程十分困难。不止一次，护盾拦下身份不明的高速粒子，冷酷提醒你，这艘飞船的配置几乎不足以撑过本次降落。终于，你穿了过去。前方控制台发出提示音，隔热护盾启动，你进入高层大气。
rows.raw: "\n\nSlowly but surely, the ship picks through shards of rock that must have once been part of the planet’s core and mantle. Further in however the field seems to largely consist of orbital debris rather than planetary ejecta: hulls of space ships and ruined clumps of satellites mashed together over centuries of disuse flit past you at thousands of kilometers per hour, making your approach difficult. More than once unidentified high velocity particles are intercepted by your shields, a grim reminder your ship is barely equipped to survive this landing. Finally you’re through. The console to your front chirps as heat shields engage and you enter the upper atmosphere."

rows.original: For several minutes all you can hear is the hum of the shield generator as it works to deflect and absorb much of the heat created by drag and atmospheric compression as you descend.
rows.translation: 接下来几分钟里，你只能听见护盾发生器的嗡鸣；下降过程中，它不断偏转并吸收阻力与大气压缩产生的大量热量。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor several minutes all you can hear is the hum of the shield generator as it works to deflect and absorb much of the heat created by drag and atmospheric compression as you descend."

rows.original: Finally the vibration subsides and your view is restored as the heat shields slide open, just in time for you to see yourself punch through a thick cloud layer that leaves a mask of water droplets at the edges of your cockpit window. Although still high above the planet, you make out the surface below as mostly red speckled with flecks of silver and gray. The sea resembles acrylic paints that have undergone mixing at the hands of an overzealous toddler; hideous black and green hues garishly reflect the harsh light of Tarkus’s star, KP0384128J.
rows.translation: 震动终于平息，隔热护盾滑开，视野随之恢复；正好让你看见飞船冲破厚重云层，在驾驶舱窗边留下水滴凝成的边框。尽管仍高悬在行星上空，你已能辨认下方地表主要呈红色，其中点缀着银灰斑点。海洋像被过分热心的幼童胡乱搅拌过的丙烯颜料；难看的黑色与绿色刺眼地反射着塔库斯恒星KP0384128J的强光。
rows.raw: "\n\nFinally the vibration subsides and your view is restored as the heat shields slide open, just in time for you to see yourself punch through a thick cloud layer that leaves a mask of water droplets at the edges of your cockpit window. Although still high above the planet, you make out the surface below as mostly red speckled with flecks of silver and gray. The sea resembles acrylic paints that have undergone mixing at the hands of an overzealous toddler; hideous black and green hues garishly reflect the harsh light of Tarkus’s star, KP0384128J."

rows.original: Entry process winks green and your altitude control system switches to local ref. 300 kilometers out from the beacon you slow to a polite mach one in towards the impact site of the ancient and disintegrating capital ship you saw from orbit. The ship is surrounded by mechanical detritus from all sides and powdered with red dusts from a wasteland which stretches as far as your eye can see to the east. It rests on the shore of the strange shimmering black sea. The land here is little more than a junkyard, one more world ravished by the march of progress until it was little more than a skeleton. The dead land sends a chill down your spine while you wait for permission to land. As you vector to one of the dimly lit hangars you fly past an ancient QR code dating from the brief but colorful Information Age of Man that reads simply; NOVA. “Goddamn the ship is prehistoric!” you think as [pc_ship.theName] eases into your appointed docking bay - a hastily spray-painted square on the deck, surrounded by other explorers’ ships.
rows.translation: 进入程序亮起绿灯，高度控制系统切换到本地参考。距离信标三百公里时，你礼貌地减速至一马赫，驶向从轨道上看到的古老解体主力舰坠毁地点。飞船四周堆满机械残骸，东边一望无际的荒原扬起红尘，将其蒙上一层粉末。它停在那片诡异闪烁的黑海岸边。这里的陆地不过是一座垃圾场，又一个被进步步伐蹂躏到只剩骨架的世界。等待着陆许可时，死寂大地令你背脊发凉。你调整航向飞往一座灯光昏暗的机库，途中掠过一个古老二维码，那是短暂却多彩的人类信息时代遗物，只写着：诺瓦。“该死，这艘船简直是史前古董！”你想着，[pc_ship.theName]缓缓驶入指定泊位，也就是甲板上仓促喷出的一个方框，周围停着其他探险者的飞船。
rows.raw: "\n\nEntry process winks green and your altitude control system switches to local ref. 300 kilometers out from the beacon you slow to a polite mach one in towards the impact site of the ancient and disintegrating capital ship you saw from orbit. The ship is surrounded by mechanical detritus from all sides and powdered with red dusts from a wasteland which stretches as far as your eye can see to the east. It rests on the shore of the strange shimmering black sea. The land here is little more than a junkyard, one more world ravished by the march of progress until it was little more than a skeleton. The dead land sends a chill down your spine while you wait for permission to land. As you vector to one of the dimly lit hangars you fly past an ancient QR code dating from the brief but colorful Information Age of Man that reads simply; NOVA. “Goddamn the ship is prehistoric!” you think as [pc_ship.theName] eases into your appointed docking bay - a hastily spray-painted square on the deck, surrounded by other explorers’ ships."

rows.original: The fore of Novahome is still smouldering from Dr. Lash’s explosion. The rusted walls and narrow passages are scorched and the lighting here flickers irregularly. It doesn’t seem like anyone was hurt in the blast, but the bomb almost certainly set the raskvel back on their plans to one day get this junker working again.
rows.translation: 诺瓦之家前部仍因拉什博士的爆炸冒着烟。锈蚀墙壁与狭窄通道被熏得焦黑，这里的灯光不规则闪烁。爆炸似乎没有伤到任何人，但那枚炸弹几乎肯定让拉斯克维尔有朝一日重新启动这艘破船的计划倒退了不少。
rows.raw: "The fore of Novahome is still smouldering from Dr. Lash’s explosion. The rusted walls and narrow passages are scorched and the lighting here flickers irregularly. It doesn’t seem like anyone was hurt in the blast, but the bomb almost certainly set the raskvel back on their plans to one day get this junker working again."

rows.original: You step down out of your ship and into a crowd of tiny, scaly folk: only a few feet tall, they’re all sporting lithe frames and ridiculously long ears that nearly drag around on the ground behind them, most bearing a variety of piercings and tattoos. As you leave your ship behind, you’re quickly swarmed by several of these curious creatures, which your Codex helpfully identifies as the raskvel, the planet’s native species (or one of them, anyway). They shower you with questions about name, sex, species, et cetera as one or two in very scruffy uniforms try to hand you some paperwork. You hurriedly scribble down your signature before pushing off some of the more outgoing raskvel climbing up your [pc.leg]. Eventually, another starship lands, leaving you in peace for a moment as they scurry off to see the next new and interesting thing.
rows.translation: 你走下飞船，踏入一群矮小鳞族之中：他们只有几英尺高，全都身形轻盈，耳朵长得夸张，几乎拖在身后地面上，多数人还戴着各式穿孔饰物并纹有刺青。你刚离开飞船，便迅速被几名好奇生物围住；法典贴心地将他们识别为拉斯克维尔，也就是这颗行星的原生种族，至少是其中之一。他们连珠炮般询问你的姓名、性别、种族等等，还有一两个穿着极其破旧制服的人试图递给你表格。你匆忙签下名字，再把几名正往[pc.leg]上爬的外向拉斯克维尔推开。最终，另一艘星舰降落，他们立刻跑去围观下一个新鲜有趣的东西，让你暂时得以清静。
rows.raw: "You step down out of your ship and into a crowd of tiny, scaly folk: only a few feet tall, they’re all sporting lithe frames and ridiculously long ears that nearly drag around on the ground behind them, most bearing a variety of piercings and tattoos. As you leave your ship behind, you’re quickly swarmed by several of these curious creatures, which your Codex helpfully identifies as the raskvel, the planet’s native species (or one of them, anyway). They shower you with questions about name, sex, species, et cetera as one or two in very scruffy uniforms try to hand you some paperwork. You hurriedly scribble down your signature before pushing off some of the more outgoing raskvel climbing up your [pc.leg]. Eventually, another starship lands, leaving you in peace for a moment as they scurry off to see the next new and interesting thing."

rows.raw: "\n\nYou are on the starship Nova, now known as the raskvel’s city, Novahome."

rows.original: The cargo elevator seems to be working down here - its doors sit open to the north, awaiting a passenger. Now if only the raskvel could get it to go to the hangar, you could save yourself a lot of walking.
rows.translation: 货运电梯在这里似乎仍能运行，它的门朝北敞开，等待乘客。要是拉斯克维尔能让它通往机库，你就能少走很多路。

rows.original: Note: Chance of encountering “sand worms” in the wild may be significant. These creatures house parasitic bugs that can latch onto the body via the anal cavity. Once infected, the victim may be subject to various involuntary, rectum-related events. Such events may not be palatable. Take caution and be careful!
rows.translation: 注意：在野外遭遇“沙虫”的概率可能很高。这些生物体内寄居着寄生虫，会通过肛腔附着到身体上。一旦感染，受害者可能会经历各种非自愿的直肠相关事件。这类事件可能令人难以接受。务必警惕，小心行事！

Once infected, the victim may be subject to various involuntary, rectum-related events. Such events may not be palatable. Take caution and be careful!"

rows.original: Your trek through the wilds of Tarkus is interrupted when you spot an odd trail of smoke nearby. Though faint, it still grabs your attention and you make your way towards its source, carefully surveying the surroundings as you go.
rows.translation: 你在塔库斯荒野中的跋涉被附近一道奇怪烟迹打断。烟虽淡薄，却仍吸引了你的注意；你一边小心观察四周，一边朝源头走去。
rows.raw: "Your trek through the wilds of Tarkus is interrupted when you spot an odd trail of smoke nearby. Though faint, it still grabs your attention and you make your way towards its source, carefully surveying the surroundings as you go."

rows.original: As you approach you find a large crater, still faintly smoldering, though evidently whatever exploded here had done so a while ago. You spot shards of steel here and there, a lot of which look like they had been parts of a wall once upon a time. You look at the crater, and while not exactly large, you suppose there could have been a building standing there before... something happened. There are a few walls left standing, all bent in a way that confirms that whatever exploded, it came from the inside. Still, based on the size, it barely looks large enough for one person to live in. Maybe some sort of research station for a solitary scientist, come to study the local fauna?
rows.translation: 走近后，你发现一个仍在微微冒烟的大坑，尽管这里发生爆炸显然已有一段时间。四处散落着钢铁碎片，其中许多看起来曾经属于墙壁。你打量着弹坑；它虽不算很大，但你猜这里先前或许立着一栋建筑，后来...发生了什么。还有几面墙尚未倒下，却全都以一种足以证明爆炸源自内部的方式弯曲着。不过，从规模来看，这里勉强只够一个人居住。也许是某位孤身科学家为了研究当地动物而建的研究站？

You spot shards of steel here and there, a lot of which look like they had been parts of a wall once upon a time. You look at the crater, and while not exactly large, you suppose there could have been a building standing there before... something happened. There are a few walls left standing, all bent in a way that confirms that whatever exploded, it came from the inside. Still, based on the size, it barely looks large enough for one person to live in. Maybe some sort of research station for a solitary scientist, come to study the local fauna?"

rows.original: Looking around, it seems clear that whatever happened here, the locals are giving the area a wide berth. Though that should probably be a sign that this area is dangerous, you feel far too excited to take heed of it, and start looking around the rubble for loot.
rows.translation: 环顾四周后，可以明显看出，无论这里发生过什么，当地人都对这片区域敬而远之。这本该是此地危险的警告，可你兴奋得根本顾不上，开始在废墟里搜寻战利品。
rows.raw: "\n\nLooking around, it seems clear that whatever happened here, the locals are giving the area a wide berth. Though that should probably be a sign that this area is dangerous, you feel far too excited to take heed of it, and start looking around the rubble for loot."

rows.original: Nothing could have prepared you for what you find. A sort of massive spring with tennis balls on each end, which gives you a nasty shock when you touch it; a series of broken flasks stained with remains of bright and shiny liquids, which makes your codex blare Taint warnings; a half-torn plushie of some nondescript species that feels awfully moist at the touch; and a mysteriously levitating cube that blasts into the sky at your touch, never to return.
rows.translation: 你完全没料到自己会找到这些东西。一根两端各装着网球般巨球的巨大弹簧，碰一下便会狠狠电你；一排破碎烧瓶，上面沾着明亮闪耀的液体残迹，令法典大声发出腐化警告；一只物种特征不明、被撕掉一半的毛绒玩具，摸起来湿得吓人；还有一个神秘悬浮的方块，你一碰，它便直冲天际，再也没有回来。
rows.raw: "\n\nNothing could have prepared you for what you find. A sort of massive spring with tennis balls on each end, which gives you a nasty shock when you touch it; a series of broken flasks stained with remains of bright and shiny liquids, which makes your codex blare Taint warnings; a half-torn plushie of some nondescript species that feels awfully moist at the touch; and a mysteriously levitating cube that blasts into the sky at your touch, never to return."

rows.original: It seems clear that this wasn’t just a small research station: it was a mad scientist’s base. Probably a lab they built away from prying eyes while they lived in Novahome, if you had to guess. Still, you wonder where they are now. If they’re alive, at any rate.
rows.translation: 很明显，这里不只是一座小型研究站，而是某个疯狂科学家的基地。要你猜的话，大概是对方住在诺瓦之家时，为躲避窥探而建在外面的实验室。不过，你还是想知道那人如今身在何处——前提是还活着。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt seems clear that this wasn’t just a small research station: it was a mad scientist’s base. Probably a lab they built away from prying eyes while they lived in Novahome, if you had to guess. Still, you wonder where they are now. If they’re alive, at any rate."

rows.raw: "\n\nYour eyes land on one box that looks relatively untouched by whatever failed experiment undoubtedly blew this place sky-high. You open it carefully, though the lack of warning labels does reassure you to some extent. And you find... "

rows.original: A Leithan costume? Not even that, just the front half. You immediately think of those stupid horse suits meant for two people to wear, one standing at the front as the head and front legs while the other has to bend down to be the torso and the back legs. Though on closer inspection, it turns out this one only has the front legs. So, just pants to make you look like you have two Leithan legs? Even then, it looks odd. The fake chitin looks oddly realistic, and there’s a fairly stupid looking belt at the waist with a number of buttons on the buckle, not to mention what appears to be some kind of projectors on the backside?
rows.translation: 一套莱萨人服装？甚至还算不上完整服装，只有前半身。你立刻想到那种供两个人穿的蠢笨马戏服：一个人站在前面充当头和前腿，另一个则必须弯腰充当躯干与后腿。但仔细一看，这套衣服确实只有前腿。所以，它只是一条让你看起来拥有两条莱萨人腿的裤子？即便如此，它看上去依然古怪。假甲壳逼真得异常，腰间则系着一条颇为滑稽的腰带，带扣上有好几个按钮，更别提后侧似乎还装着某种投影器？
rows.raw: "\n\nA Leithan costume? Not even that, just the front half. You immediately think of those stupid horse suits meant for two people to wear, one standing at the front as the head and front legs while the other has to bend down to be the torso and the back legs. Though on closer inspection, it turns out this one only has the front legs. So, just pants to make you look like you have two Leithan legs? Even then, it looks odd. The fake chitin looks oddly realistic, and there’s a fairly stupid looking belt at the waist with a number of buttons on the buckle, not to mention what appears to be some kind of projectors on the backside?"

rows.original: Perhaps it really is a Leithan costume, made to shoot a hologram of the rest of the body when you put it on. Though when you look inside, you’re startled to find the sides covered in some sort of red jelly, moist at the touch but solid enough that your finger doesn’t go in when you tentatively poke at it. You truly can’t be sure what this is.
rows.translation: 也许它确实是一套莱萨人服装，穿上后会投射出其余身体的全息影像。不过朝里面看时，你惊讶地发现内壁覆盖着某种红色胶质；摸起来湿润，却又足够结实，试探着戳下去时手指并不会陷进去。你实在无法确定这是什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nPerhaps it really is a Leithan costume, made to shoot a hologram of the rest of the body when you put it on. Though when you look inside, you’re startled to find the sides covered in some sort of red jelly, moist at the touch but solid enough that your finger doesn’t go in when you tentatively poke at it. You truly can’t be sure what this is."

rows.raw: "\n\nYou could try the suit on and find out. It may sound foolhardy to try on a mad scientist’s pet project, but you feel like it’s harmless enough. Worse case, you could probably undo whatever it does to you."

rows.original: But then again, it might be an incredibly stupid decision. You could just leave it where you found it and hope the raskvel will deal with this mess once they get the courage to go near.

rows.original: As you trek through the wilds of Tarkus, you can’t help but feel like you’ve been here before. The crater over there seems awfully familiar, and your mind recalls there being smoke and... Right, this is where you found that strange taur suit! The remains of the blown-up lab have been completely scrapped away, evidently the scavengers that crawl all over this palace have finally got over their initial fear of the disaster site. Once the smoke cleared and nothing else exploded, they must have assumed it was safe and came to get everything they could. You can barely find a few fragments of steel here and there, probably left from what walls were left standing. That and... A box. It looks exactly like the box which contained the taur suit, and it’s just... sitting there, hidden behind a few rocks. If you hadn’t known this place had once been more than another featureless piece of wasteland, you’d have never explored this much to find it. And there seems to be a note attached? Carefully, you grab the note attached to the box. Hello hello! It appears you have found my little gift. I assume you are the one who found and made good use of my Hardlight Taur Suit (copyright pending), and came here for more? Yes, yes, I just had to thank you for this; the data I got from your little experiment session alone was priceless! And so, if you were interested, well, this is just more of that. Another suit for your collection! I do hope you will enjoy it as much as the first. Cordially, Relly. Huh. So now you know who made that suit. And wait, he’s been monitoring you? One, that means the hardlight taur suit has been sending data of whatever you did with it to some mad scientist? That’s...
rows.translation: 在塔库斯荒野跋涉时，你忍不住觉得自己以前来过这里。那边的弹坑熟悉得吓人，你想起这里曾有烟，还有... 对了，你就是在这里找到那套古怪多足兽套装的！爆炸实验室的残骸已被拆得一干二净；显然，在这片宫殿般废墟上到处爬行的拾荒者终于克服了对灾难现场最初的恐惧。烟散尽后再没发生爆炸，他们一定认定这里已经安全，便来拿走了所有能拿的东西。你只能在四处勉强找到几片钢铁残骸，或许是尚未倒塌的墙壁留下的。除此之外还有... 一个箱子。 它看起来与装着多足兽套装的箱子一模一样，就这么...藏在几块岩石后面。若非知道这里曾经不只是另一片毫无特色的荒地，你绝不会探索得这么仔细，也就找不到它。上面似乎还贴着一张纸条？ 你小心地拿起箱子上的纸条。 你好你好！看来你发现了我的小礼物。我猜你就是那个找到并充分利用我的硬光多足兽套装（版权申请中）的人，而且还回来找更多东西了？是的，是的，我必须为此感谢你；单凭你那场小小实验提供的数据，就已价值连城！所以，如果你有兴趣，嗯，这只是更多同类产品。又一套可供收藏的服装！衷心希望你能像喜欢第一套那样喜欢它。 谨致问候，雷莉。 啊。现在你知道是谁制作了那套服装。等等，对方一直在监视你？首先，这意味着硬光多足兽套装一直在把你使用它时所做的一切传给某个疯狂科学家？这真是...
rows.raw: "As you trek through the wilds of Tarkus, you can’t help but feel like you’ve been here before. The crater over there seems awfully familiar, and your mind recalls there being smoke and... Right, this is where you found that strange taur suit! The remains of the blown-up lab have been completely scrapped away, evidently the scavengers that crawl all over this palace have finally got over their initial fear of the disaster site. Once the smoke cleared and nothing else exploded, they must have assumed it was safe and came to get everything they could. Carefully, you grab the note attached to the box. Hello hello! It appears you have found my little gift. I assume you are the one who found and made good use of my Hardlight Taur Suit (copyright pending), and came here for more? Yes, yes, I just had to thank you for this; the data I got from your little experiment session alone was priceless! And so, if you were interested, well, this is just more of that. Another suit for your collection! I do hope you will enjoy it as much as the first. Cordially, Relly. Huh. So now you know who made that suit. And wait, he’s been monitoring you? One, that means the hardlight taur suit has been sending data of whatever you did with it to some mad scientist? That’s... "

rows.original: Well, at least the tone of the message was cordial enough that you feel safe to pull the box out of its stony nook and open it. Carefully, mind. And as expected, inside you find a suit. Though this one is... what? It just looks like a tube. You take it out of the box, and confirm that it is basically a cylinder covered with artificial scales on the outside and that weird red jelly on the inside. Well, it has a bottom so, more like a bag maybe? And much like the hardlight taur suit, this one has a weird belt with a familiar switch. Once again, you could try this suit and see what happens. Assuming this mad scientist is at least consistent, it should be safe enough that whatever happens is at least temporary. Or you could do the sane thing and not trust a mad - albeit friendly - scientist.
rows.translation: 好吧，至少留言的语气足够客气，让你可以放心把箱子从岩石缝中拉出来打开。当然，依然得小心。 不出所料，里面是一套服装。但这一套是...什么？看上去只像一根管子。你将它从箱中取出，确认它基本就是个圆筒：外侧覆盖人造鳞片，内侧则是那种古怪的红色胶质。嗯，它有个底，所以或许更像袋子？与硬光多足兽套装一样，这一套也有条古怪腰带，上面装着熟悉的开关。 你又一次可以试穿这套服装，看看会发生什么。假设这位疯狂科学家至少做事一贯，那么它应该足够安全，而且无论发生什么，至少都是暂时的。 或者你也可以做个理智的人，别相信一个疯狂——尽管友善——的科学家。

rows.original:
This huge, open air hangar could easily hold whole squadrons of fighters or a dozen much larger ships. It’s obvious that the craft that once called this place home have long-since departed, either scrapped or looted ages ago. In their place are ships of every shape and size, many obviously owned by planet-rushers, but there are a few cobbled-together junk-heaps standing on rusted landing struts that must belong to locals. Further to the west, you can make out the distinctive outline of your own ship. Most of the foot traffic is going east into an access tunnel; the nearby cargo elevator’s doors sit askew in their frame, obviously nonfunctional.

The U.G.C. scouts have set up an office to the north. They might be able to give you a lift to some of the more remote destinations on planet.
rows.translation:
这座巨大的露天机库足以容纳整支战斗机中队，或是十几艘体型大得多的飞船。显然，曾以此为家的飞船早已离去，不是在很久以前被拆成废料，就是遭人洗劫。如今取而代之的是各式各样、大小不一的飞船，其中许多显然属于星球淘金者，也有几艘用破烂拼凑而成、由锈蚀起落架支撑的飞船，想必属于本地人。更西边，你能辨认出自己飞船独特的轮廓。大部分人流都向东涌进一条通道；附近货运电梯的门歪斜地卡在门框里，显然已经无法使用。

联合银河邦联的侦察兵在北边设立了一间办事处。他们或许能载你前往这颗星球上一些更偏远的地点。
rows.raw: "This huge, open air hangar could easily hold whole squadrons of fighters or a dozen much larger ships. It’s obvious that the craft that once called this place home have long-since departed, either scrapped or looted ages ago. In their place are ships of every shape and size, many obviously owned by planet-rushers, but there are a few cobbled-together junk-heaps standing on rusted landing struts that must belong to locals. Further to the west, you can make out the distinctive outline of your own ship. Most of the foot traffic is going east into an access tunnel; the nearby cargo elevator’s doors sit askew in their frame, obviously nonfunctional.\n\nThe U.G.C. scouts have set up an office to the north. They might be able to give you a lift to some of the more remote destinations on planet."

rows.original: You’re standing inside a wide corridor labeled as “Starewell” in painted script. The writing is as crude as it is misspelled. It isn’t even accurate to this location; the corridor is a corkscrew-shaped ramp that twists down into the belly of the ship. There’s no stairs anywhere that you can see. In spite of the terrible labeling, large numbers of the diminutive raskvel are scurrying up and down the passage, bearing all kinds of cargo. There are even some robots carrying tanks of fuel or driving small carts on their way. You can go down into the ship or west out into the hangar.
rows.translation: 你正站在一条宽阔的走廊里，墙上用油漆潦草写着“星梯间”。这字不仅粗糙，还拼错了，甚至与此处的实际结构毫不相符；走廊其实是一道螺旋形坡道，盘旋着通往飞船腹部，视野所及之处根本没有楼梯。尽管标识糟糕，大批矮小的拉斯克维尔仍扛着各种货物，在通道里来回奔忙。甚至还有机器人驮着燃料罐，或开着小推车经过。你可以沿坡道下到飞船内部，也可以向西前往机库。

In spite of the terrible labeling, large numbers of the diminutive raskvel are scurrying up and down the passage, bearing all kinds of cargo. There are even some robots carrying tanks of fuel or driving small carts on their way. You can go down into the ship or west out into the hangar."

rows.original: There’s a crudely written sign hanging above a spiralling ramp. It reads, “Stairwill.” You’re pretty sure that whoever wrote it meant to write “Stairwell,” but even so, there isn’t a stair to be seen. The smooth metal deckplates arc up around a central column in a huge ramp, leading to the Nova’s middle decks where the hangar is located. An access corridor stretches away to the east. Faded texts indicate that it was once used for maintenance, but nowadays, it seems to be the main route between Novahome and the ship’s hangar-turned-landing-pad.
rows.translation: 一道盘旋坡道上方挂着块字迹潦草的牌子，上面写着“楼梯井儿”。你敢肯定写牌子的人本想写“楼梯间”，可即便如此，这里也连一级楼梯都看不见。光滑的金属甲板围绕中央立柱向上盘旋成巨大的坡道，通往诺瓦号中层甲板的机库。一条通道向东延伸。褪色的文字表明这里曾是维修通道，但如今似乎已成为诺瓦家园与那座由机库改造而成的着陆坪之间的主要路线。

Faded texts indicate that it was once used for maintenance, but nowadays, it seems to be the main route between Novahome and the ship’s hangar-turned-landing-pad."

rows.original: You’re in the middle of a bend in a massive, maintenance access corridor. Once, long ago, it was used by work robots to move between various sections of the ship unseen. Now, with much of the ship in disrepair, it’s the main thoroughfare between Novahome’s central corridor and the hangar. The raskvel streaming by you seem excited to have all the offworlders around, stopping them to jabber questions almost nonstop. You narrowly escape the same fate as you go on your way. A ramp is visible to the west, and a corridor stretches south towards Novahome proper, glowing faintly.
rows.translation: 你正处在一条巨大维修通道的转弯处。很久以前，工作机器人会借此在飞船各区域之间悄然穿行。如今飞船大部分已年久失修，这里反倒成了诺瓦家园中央走廊与机库之间的主干道。川流不息的拉斯克维尔似乎因大批外星来客的到来而兴奋不已，几乎不停地拦住他们叽叽喳喳地提问。你险险避开同样的命运，继续赶路。西边能看见一道坡道，南边则有一条散发微光的走廊通往诺瓦家园内部。

rows.original: The power in this section of the ship is working, amazingly. Flicking incandescence bathes the ancient metal in amber-tinged light as busy little aliens trundle by, many carrying wrenches or multi-tools in one hand. North of here, the tunnel bends west. From the excited babble around you, you pick up that the hangar lies in that direction. The glowing corridor opens up into a huge east-west tunnel a little further south, the main thoroughfare of Novahome.
rows.translation: 令人惊讶的是，飞船这一区域的电力仍在运转。闪烁的白炽灯为古老金属镀上一层琥珀色光芒，忙碌的小个子异星人在一旁来来往往，许多人单手拎着扳手或多功能工具。北边的通道转而向西。从周围兴奋的喧闹声中，你听出机库就在那个方向。再向南不远，这条发光的走廊便汇入一条东西走向的巨大隧道——诺瓦家园的主干道。

The glowing corridor opens up into a huge east-west tunnel a little further south, the main thoroughfare of Novahome."

rows.original: Novahome
rows.raw: "Novahome"

rows.original: Here in the central tunnel of the Nova, the ceiling is at least forty feet tall, and the walls are wide enough to handle a football field. This vessel could easily match the biggest dreadnaughts in the terran navy pound for pound, but it’s obvious from its unique internal structure that it was not a ship meant for war. Whatever its original purpose, the raskvel have turned it into their home. Metallic structures have sprung up on all sides, though the central part of the tunnel remains clear, leading east and west from here. A maintenance corridor to the north leads back toward the hangar.
rows.translation: 这里是诺瓦号的中央隧道，天花板至少有四十英尺高，两侧宽得足以容下一座橄榄球场。单论体量，这艘飞船足以与地球海军最大的无畏舰匹敌，但它独特的内部结构显然表明这并非为战争而造的舰船。不论最初用途是什么，拉斯克维尔都已将其变成自己的家。金属建筑在四周拔地而起，不过隧道中央仍保持畅通，从此处向东、西延伸。北边的一条维修通道通往机库。

This vessel could easily match the biggest dreadnaughts in the terran navy pound for pound, but it’s obvious from its unique internal structure that it was not a ship meant for war. Whatever its original purpose, the raskvel have turned it into their home. Metallic structures have sprung up on all sides, though the central part of the tunnel remains clear, leading east and west from here. A maintenance corridor to the north leads back toward the hangar."

rows.raw: "Novahome"

rows.original: You are in the central tunnel of Novahome. Once a gigantic tunnel in the core of an ancient ship, it’s now packed with houses and shops of all styles and sizes. On one side, there’s a shack made from stapled-together, rusted plates, while on the north lies a structure of all hard, angled starship parts. You can continue east or west from here, though a huge wall looms in the former direction before long.
rows.translation: 你身处诺瓦家园的中央隧道。这里曾是古老飞船核心的一条巨型隧道，如今却挤满了各式各样、大小不一的住宅和店铺。一边是用锈蚀金属板钉合而成的棚屋，北边则矗立着一栋完全以棱角分明的飞船零件拼成的建筑。你可以继续向东或向西，不过东边不远处就耸立着一面巨墙。

On one side, there’s a shack made from stapled-together, rusted plates, while on the north lies a structure of all hard, angled starship parts. You can continue east or west from here, though a huge wall looms in the former direction before long."

rows.original: To the south is what appears to be the nest of an ancient air control tower, poking partially out of a rent in the side of the vast starship. Above its dark windows the faded white top of the octagonal structure bristles with satellites of all shapes and sizes, some of them squeaking rustily as they slowly turn. Someone has painted “COLENSO’S JUNK” on the outside in rough, red lettering. It almost looks like an afterthought.
rows.translation: 南边看起来是一座古老空管塔的塔楼，半截从巨型飞船侧面的裂口中探出。八角形建筑褪色的白色顶部位于漆黑窗户上方，密布着大小形状各异的卫星，其中一些转动时发出锈涩的吱呀声。有人用粗糙的红色字迹在外墙写下“科伦索的破烂”。看上去简直像临时补写的。

Above its dark windows the faded white top of the octagonal structure bristles with satellites of all shapes and sizes, some of them squeaking rustily as they slowly turn. Someone has painted “COLENSO’S JUNK” on the outside in rough, red lettering. It almost looks like an afterthought."

rows.original: The sound of old satellites and radio masts groaning in the breeze is all you need to know you’re standing outside Colenso’s again. You could go inside and do some trading with the strange goblin.
rows.translation: 老旧卫星和无线电桅杆在风中呻吟的声音，足以让你知道自己又站在科伦索的店外。你可以进去同那个古怪的哥布林做些交易。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe sound of old satellites and radio masts groaning in the breeze is all you need to know you’re standing outside Colenso’s again. You could go inside and do some trading with the strange goblin."

rows.raw: "East Novahome"

rows.raw: "NOVA MAIN DECK ELEVATOR"

rows.original: You’re almost smack in the middle of the tremendous passageway that runs through the center of this starship-turned-town. It would take at least fifteen minutes of walking to reach either end, and there’s plenty of lateral room as well. Such a huge, central void would make this ship poorly suited for combat, but perhaps it served some other purpose back in its day. Now, it’s being used as a place of residence and business, filled with raskvel of every color and variety.
rows.translation: 你几乎正站在这座由星舰改造成的城镇中央，那条巨型通道的正中间。步行抵达任意一端都至少需要十五分钟，横向空间同样宽阔。如此巨大的中央空腔会让这艘船很不适合战斗，不过它当年或许另有用途。如今这里被用作居住和经商之地，挤满了各种颜色、各个种类的拉斯克维尔。
rows.raw: "You’re almost smack in the middle of the tremendous passageway that runs through the center of this starship-turned-town. It would take at least fifteen minutes of walking to reach either end, and there’s plenty of lateral room as well. Such a huge, central void would make this ship poorly suited for combat, but perhaps it served some other purpose back in its day. Now, it’s being used as a place of residence and business, filled with raskvel of every color and variety."
