rows.raw: "Novahome"

rows.original: You’re definitely in the third of the ship closest to the fore. The tunnel is narrowing a little bit with every step to the west and broadening to the east. There’s still plenty of room, though. Where you’re standing, the immense chamber is at least eighty yards across and thirty-five feet tall - plenty of room for the short aliens to populate the area with a half-dozen buildings. A steady stream of raskvel are coming and going from inside a cavernous chamber to the north, clearly marked “MESS” in large, white letters. A pair of large windows on either side of the door are currently obstructed thanks to a pair of gigantic sandwich boards set up with some crudely-drawn caricatures of soups, sandwiches, and steaks beside prices in the local currency.
rows.translation: 你显然位于飞船最靠近舰艏的三分之一区域。隧道每向西一步就稍微收窄，向东则逐渐变宽，不过空间依然绰绰有余。你所站的巨大舱室至少有八十码宽、三十五英尺高，足够这些矮小的异星人在此建起半打建筑。拉斯克维尔正源源不断地进出北边一间洞穴般宽阔的舱室，入口上方用白色大字清楚标着“食堂”。门两侧各有一扇大窗，此刻却被两块巨大的立牌挡住；牌上粗糙地画着汤、三明治和牛排的漫画图案，旁边标注着以本地货币计算的价格。
rows.raw: "You’re definitely in the third of the ship closest to the fore. The tunnel is narrowing a little bit with every step to the west and broadening to the east. There’s still plenty of room, though. Where you’re standing, the immense chamber is at least eighty yards across and thirty-five feet tall - plenty of room for the short aliens to populate the area with a half-dozen buildings. A steady stream of raskvel are coming and going from inside a cavernous chamber to the north, clearly marked “MESS” in large, white letters. A pair of large windows on either side of the door are currently obstructed thanks to a pair of gigantic sandwich boards set up with some crudely-drawn caricatures of soups, sandwiches, and steaks beside prices in the local currency."

rows.original: Novahome
rows.raw: "Novahome"

rows.original: The Nova’s internal lighting flickers gently with its own asynchronous rhythm. To the east, the illumination is brighter and more steady. You estimate the ship’s powerplants are located in the aft of the ship, near its engines, and the power conduits are in less than pristine condition. Further west, where the corridor ends, it’s even dimmer, oddly reminiscent of just minutes after sunset.
rows.translation: 诺瓦号的内部照明以各自不同步的节奏轻轻闪烁。东边的灯光更加明亮稳定。你估计飞船的动力装置位于舰艉、靠近引擎的位置，而输电线路的状况远称不上完好。再往西、走廊尽头处，光线甚至更加昏暗，奇异地让人想起日落后不久的天色。
rows.raw: "The Nova’s internal lighting flickers gently with its own asynchronous rhythm. To the east, the illumination is brighter and more steady. You estimate the ship’s powerplants are located in the aft of the ship, near its engines, and the power conduits are in less than pristine condition. Further west, where the corridor ends, it’s even dimmer, oddly reminiscent of just minutes after sunset."

rows.original: West Novahome
rows.raw: "West Novahome"

rows.original: West Novahome is located near the fore of the ship, where the power is weak and the lighting dim. You can see that the tunnel is narrower here than to the east as well. Even the western wall is in disrepair; it’s covered in years of rust despite recent attempts to repair it. Even now, raskvel mechanics are toiling away alongside a nonfunctional hatch. Maybe someday they’ll actually get this junker working again. The rest of Novahome stretches away to the east.
rows.translation: 西诺瓦家园位于舰艏附近，这里的电力微弱、灯光昏暗。你也看得出此处隧道比东边狭窄。就连西墙也已年久失修，尽管近期有人尝试维修，墙面仍覆着多年积下的锈迹。直到此刻，拉斯克维尔技工仍在一扇失灵的舱门旁辛苦劳作。也许总有一天，他们真能让这堆破烂重新运转。诺瓦家园的其余部分向东延伸。
rows.raw: "West Novahome is located near the fore of the ship, where the power is weak and the lighting dim. You can see that the tunnel is narrower here than to the east as well. Even the western wall is in disrepair; it’s covered in years of rust despite recent attempts to repair it. Even now, raskvel mechanics are toiling away alongside a nonfunctional hatch. Maybe someday they’ll actually get this junker working again. The rest of Novahome stretches away to the east."

rows.original: Makeshift Gangplank
rows.raw: "Makeshift Gangplank"

rows.original: With every step you take out onto this gangplank, you hear the telltale groans of metal straining. You can feel it flexing from the combined foot traffic of dozens of raskvel scavengers, droids, and other rushers as they move along the improvised structure. You’d be more worried if it wasn’t so thick and the welds didn’t look so solid. All you have to do is stay away from the edges and keep your balance. If you follow it up to the north, you’ll find yourself back inside the Nova, now Novahome. Continuing south will deposit you on the surface of Tarkus.
rows.translation: 每当你在这条舷梯上迈出一步，都能听见金属承受压力时特有的呻吟。数十名拉斯克维尔拾荒者、机器人和其他淘金者一同在这座临时结构上行走，你能感觉到它随之微微弯曲。若不是它足够厚实、焊缝看起来也很牢固，你大概会更加担心。你只需远离边缘并保持平衡。沿舷梯向北走，你会回到如今已成为诺瓦家园的诺瓦号内部；继续向南则会抵达塔库斯地表。
rows.raw: "With every step you take out onto this gangplank, you hear the telltale groans of metal straining. You can feel it flexing from the combined foot traffic of dozens of raskvel scavengers, droids, and other rushers as they move along the improvised structure. You’d be more worried if it wasn’t so thick and the welds didn’t look so solid. All you have to do is stay away from the edges and keep your balance. If you follow it up to the north, you’ll find yourself back inside the Nova, now Novahome. Continuing south will deposit you on the surface of Tarkus."

rows.original: Rust Fields
rows.raw: "Rust Fields"

rows.original: You’re standing in the middle of the Tarkus’s famed rust fields, so called thanks to the endless tracks of discarded, rusting machinery. Reddish flakes blow by your [pc.feet] on arid, metallic-tasting breezes, and the unmistakable tang of ancient pollution clings to your tongue with every breath. The place is a ruin of wasted potential and shattered dreams with the only visible sign of civilization rising up to the north: Novahome, a starship-turned native city.
rows.translation: 你正站在塔库斯著名的锈蚀原野中央。这里因无边无际的废弃锈蚀机械带而得名。泛红的锈片乘着干燥、带有金属味的风掠过你的[pc.feet]，每一次呼吸，远古污染那鲜明的辛涩味都会黏上舌头。这里是浪费的潜力与破碎梦想的废墟，唯一可见的文明迹象耸立在北方：由星舰改造成的本地城市——诺瓦家园。
rows.raw: "You’re standing in the middle of the Tarkus’s famed rust fields, so called thanks to the endless tracks of discarded, rusting machinery. Reddish flakes blow by your [pc.feet] on arid, metallic-tasting breezes, and the unmistakable tang of ancient pollution clings to your tongue with every breath. The place is a ruin of wasted potential and shattered dreams with the only visible sign of civilization rising up to the north: Novahome, a starship-turned native city."

rows.original: Rust Fields
rows.raw: "Rust Fields"

rows.original: Mounds of rusted machinery, ancient hulks, and plastics pile up around you into trackless dunes to the east, south, and west. Your every movement is chased by the soft crunching of metal flakes breaking
rows.translation: 锈蚀机械、古老残骸和塑料堆积在你四周，形成向东、南、西延伸的无路沙丘。每当你移动，都会听见金属碎屑在
rows.raw: "Mounds of rusted machinery, ancient hulks, and plastics pile up around you into trackless dunes to the east, south, and west. Your every movement is chased by the soft crunching of metal flakes breaking "

rows.original: , and you’re constantly spotting new oddities in the mess. They’re all too damaged, rotten, or rusted to be useful. Here in the shadow of the Nova, it’s likely the area has been picked clean of valuables.
rows.translation: 碎裂的轻微咔嚓声，你也不断在这堆垃圾里发现新的怪东西。它们不是损坏得太严重，就是已经腐烂或锈透，毫无用处。这里位于诺瓦号的阴影下，值钱的东西很可能早已被搜刮一空。
rows.raw: ", and you’re constantly spotting new oddities in the mess. They’re all too damaged, rotten, or rusted to be useful. Here in the shadow of the Nova, it’s likely the area has been picked clean of valuables."

rows.original: underfoot
rows.translation: 脚下
rows.raw: "underfoot"

rows.original: under your [pc.feet]
rows.translation: 你的[pc.feet]下
rows.raw: "under your [pc.feet]"

rows.original: Rust Fields
rows.raw: "Rust Fields"

rows.original: This close to the nova, you can’t help but be impressed by its sheer size and durability. Even though the hull is heavily scaled with rust, the metal appears sound underneath the crusty, red-flecked layer. This is clearly a ship that was meant to last a very, very long time, and it has. All around, small, uneven dunes of dirt, dust, and rust rise up, hiding half-buried garbage from a variety of different races. You can walk across them to the east, west, and south. The Nova blocks passage to the north.
rows.translation: 如此靠近诺瓦号，你不得不为它惊人的体量和耐久性赞叹。尽管船体覆着厚厚的鳞片状锈层，下面的金属看起来仍然坚固。这显然是一艘为了长久服役而建造的飞船，而且它的确做到了。四周隆起一座座低矮不平的尘土与铁锈丘，掩埋着来自许多不同种族的垃圾。你可以越过它们向东、西或南行进。诺瓦号挡住了北边的去路。
rows.raw: "This close to the nova, you can’t help but be impressed by its sheer size and durability. Even though the hull is heavily scaled with rust, the metal appears sound underneath the crusty, red-flecked layer. This is clearly a ship that was meant to last a very, very long time, and it has. All around, small, uneven dunes of dirt, dust, and rust rise up, hiding half-buried garbage from a variety of different races. You can walk across them to the east, west, and south. The Nova blocks passage to the north."

rows.original: Rust Fields
rows.raw: "Rust Fields"

rows.original: An unstable pile of rusted ships and gutted battle tanks has been built up to the southwest, perhaps stacked there by natives sorting through the junk for still-usable treasures. Regardless, the massive mound is too sheer and rusted to climb. If you tried, you’d either tip it over onto yourself or just cut yourself on erosion-sharpened metal. You can traverse around it by going west or south, or you could head east in the shadow of the Nova.
rows.translation: 西南边堆起了一座由锈蚀飞船和被掏空的战车构成的不稳定废料山，也许是本地人在筛选仍可利用的宝物时堆出来的。无论如何，这座巨大的废料堆既陡峭又锈蚀，根本无法攀爬。若勉强尝试，不是会让它倾倒下来压住自己，就是会被侵蚀后锋利如刃的金属割伤。你可以向西或向南绕开它，也可以向东、沿诺瓦号的阴影前行。
rows.raw: "An unstable pile of rusted ships and gutted battle tanks has been built up to the southwest, perhaps stacked there by natives sorting through the junk for still-usable treasures. Regardless, the massive mound is too sheer and rusted to climb. If you tried, you’d either tip it over onto yourself or just cut yourself on erosion-sharpened metal. You can traverse around it by going west or south, or you could head east in the shadow of the Nova."

rows.original: Rust Canyon
rows.raw: "Rust Canyon"

rows.original: You’re standing in the shadow of two different mounds of metal. To the northeast, the Nova towers above you. To the south and west, a huge pile of busted machinery has been stacked at least thirty feet into the air. Well-trod paths have been worn through the metallic dust between the two obstacles, leading north between the monolithic wreckages. You can also travel east to get out of this narrow, ferrous valley and out into the rust fields.
rows.translation: 你正站在两座不同金属山投下的阴影中。东北边，诺瓦号高高耸立；南边和西边，一大堆损坏的机械被垒到至少三十英尺高。两处障碍之间的金属尘埃上，被踩出了一条条清晰的小径，向北通往两座巨型残骸之间。你也可以向东走出这条狭窄的铁质山谷，进入锈蚀原野。
rows.raw: "You’re standing in the shadow of two different mounds of metal. To the northeast, the Nova towers above you. To the south and west, a huge pile of busted machinery has been stacked at least thirty feet into the air. Well-trod paths have been worn through the metallic dust between the two obstacles, leading north between the monolithic wreckages. You can also travel east to get out of this narrow, ferrous valley and out into the rust fields."

rows.original: Rust Canyon
rows.raw: "Rust Canyon"

rows.original: The path between the Nova and the piled detritus is almost punishingly narrow here. You have to duck and weave to navigate around the angled prow of the colossal starship. The air is stagnant and thick with dust. There isn’t even that much light down here; the piled metal hulks above are leaning against the much larger hull of the Nova, keeping this area perpetually dark. You can squeeze south or west from here. Both directions are far more open and well lit.
rows.translation: 诺瓦号与成堆废料之间的小路狭窄得几乎令人难以忍受。你不得不时而低头、时而侧身，才能绕过这艘巨型星舰倾斜的舰艏。空气沉滞，满是尘埃。这里甚至没有多少光线；上方堆叠的金属残骸斜靠在诺瓦号更为巨大的船体上，使这片区域永远笼罩在黑暗中。你可以从这里挤向南边或西边，两个方向都要开阔明亮得多。
rows.raw: "The path between the Nova and the piled detritus is almost punishingly narrow here. You have to duck and weave to navigate around the angled prow of the colossal starship. The air is stagnant and thick with dust. There isn’t even that much light down here; the piled metal hulks above are leaning against the much larger hull of the Nova, keeping this area perpetually dark. You can squeeze south or west from here. Both directions are far more open and well lit."

rows.original: Next To A Junk Pile
rows.raw: "Next To A Junk Pile"

rows.original: The air here smells vaguely of molten metal and pollution, stronger than many other places on Tarkus. The flakes of iron and other ferrous-based materials that make up the dusty soil are fine, so small you could almost mistake it for reddish-brown dirt if you didn’t look too closely. You could head north around the prow of the Nova, east alongside a towering pile of junk, or west to the other side of the heap.
rows.translation: 这里的空气隐约散发着熔融金属与污染物的气味，比塔库斯许多其他地方都更加浓烈。构成尘土地面的铁屑及其他含铁物质细得惊人，若不仔细看，几乎会被误认为红褐色泥土。你可以向北绕过诺瓦号舰艏，向东沿着高耸的垃圾山前进，或向西抵达废料堆另一侧。
rows.raw: "The air here smells vaguely of molten metal and pollution, stronger than many other places on Tarkus. The flakes of iron and other ferrous-based materials that make up the dusty soil are fine, so small you could almost mistake it for reddish-brown dirt if you didn’t look too closely. You could head north around the prow of the Nova, east alongside a towering pile of junk, or west to the other side of the heap."

rows.original: Nova Point
rows.raw: "Nova Point"

rows.original: You’re standing directly under the nose of the Nova. Around you hang stalactites of ancient, corroded metal, testaments to corrosive forces that have seen fit to grace the ship with a beard worthy of father time. In spite of that, the hull looks thick enough to remain spaceworthy. It was obviously built to withstand an obscene amount of punishment. The ground here is relatively flat. Why, there’s barely even any junk sticking up out of the “soil!” You can amble around similar terrain to the north and west. Heading south would put you on a path alongside a mound of twisted wreckage.
rows.translation: 你正站在诺瓦号舰艏的正下方。四周垂挂着由古老腐蚀金属形成的钟乳石，见证了腐蚀之力为飞船添上的一把足以媲美时间老人之须的胡子。即便如此，船体看起来仍厚得足以继续航行于太空。它显然是为了承受骇人的摧残而造。这里的地面相对平坦，甚至几乎没有垃圾从所谓的“土壤”中冒出来！你可以在北边和西边相似的地形中闲逛；向南则会踏上一条沿扭曲残骸山延伸的小路。
rows.raw: "You’re standing directly under the nose of the Nova. Around you hang stalactites of ancient, corroded metal, testaments to corrosive forces that have seen fit to grace the ship with a beard worthy of father time. In spite of that, the hull looks thick enough to remain spaceworthy. It was obviously built to withstand an obscene amount of punishment. The ground here is relatively flat. Why, there’s barely even any junk sticking up out of the “soil!” You can amble around similar terrain to the north and west. Heading south would put you on a path alongside a mound of twisted wreckage."

rows.original: Shipside Field
rows.raw: "Shipside Field"

rows.original: The surrounding expanse of flat, dusty fields is about as desolate as it gets, but even that hasn’t stopped life, at least not yet. There’s a few silvery plant stalks capped with iridescent blue leaves waving gently in the polluted breezes, somehow still here in spite of all this place has gone through. Stepping gingerly, you could go south or west from here. The Nova blocks passage to the east, and gray cliffs stretch up towards a cloudless sky to the north.
rows.translation: 四周平坦的尘土荒原可谓荒凉到了极点，可即便如此，生命至少暂时仍未绝迹。几株银色植物茎秆顶着虹彩蓝叶，在受污染的微风中轻轻摇曳；尽管这里历经了这一切，它们不知为何仍顽强存活。你可以小心翼翼地向南或向西行进。诺瓦号挡住了东边的道路，北边则有灰色峭壁向无云的天空延伸。
rows.raw: "The surrounding expanse of flat, dusty fields is about as desolate as it gets, but even that hasn’t stopped life, at least not yet. There’s a few silvery plant stalks capped with iridescent blue leaves waving gently in the polluted breezes, somehow still here in spite of all this place has gone through. Stepping gingerly, you could go south or west from here. The Nova blocks passage to the east, and gray cliffs stretch up towards a cloudless sky to the north."

rows.original: Here on the beach of the Oil Sea, you can’t help but be aware of its stunning, unnatural beauty, a property lent to it by the glossy, metallic materials that comprise its slowly rolling waves. The smell is obscenely clingy. You can practically feel the tainted air sticking to the roof of your mouth, lending credence to the worrying thoughts that are assailing your mind, wondering how quickly this place is poisoning you. You can travel along the beach to the south, or you could head east away from the liquid’s edge. A sheer cliff face blocks travel north, and you don’t even want to think about trying to swim through the sludge to the west.
rows.translation: 站在油海岸边，你很难忽视它那惊人而反常的美感。这种美来自组成缓缓翻滚波浪的光亮金属物质。那股气味黏人得令人作呕。你几乎能感觉受污染的空气黏在上颚，也让脑中不断袭来的忧虑显得越发可信：这里究竟正以多快的速度毒害你？你可以沿海滩向南行进，也可以向东远离液体边缘。陡直的崖壁阻断了北边的道路，而你甚至不愿设想游过西边的黏稠污泥。
rows.raw: "Here on the beach of the Oil Sea, you can’t help but be aware of its stunning, unnatural beauty, a property lent to it by the glossy, metallic materials that comprise its slowly rolling waves. The smell is obscenely clingy. You can practically feel the tainted air sticking to the roof of your mouth, lending credence to the worrying thoughts that are assailing your mind, wondering how quickly this place is poisoning you. You can travel along the beach to the south, or you could head east away from the liquid’s edge. A sheer cliff face blocks travel north, and you don’t even want to think about trying to swim through the sludge to the west."

rows.original: Oil Sea Beach
rows.raw: "Oil Sea Beach"

rows.original: The silver-black surface of the Oil Sea rolls with slow, almost malevolent purpose just to the south and west. Some exotic material inside those murky swells must be much thicker than water; they never crest or foam like seawater does, and the frequency and amplitude of their motions seems subtly wrong to you. You can follow the beach north or east from here.
rows.translation: 油海银黑色的表面就在南边和西边，以缓慢而近乎恶意的节奏翻滚。浑浊浪涛中某种奇异物质必定比水黏稠得多；它们从不像海水那样卷起浪峰或泡沫，运动的频率和幅度也让你隐约觉得不对劲。你可以沿海滩向北或向东行进。
rows.raw: "The silver-black surface of the Oil Sea rolls with slow, almost malevolent purpose just to the south and west. Some exotic material inside those murky swells must be much thicker than water; they never crest or foam like seawater does, and the frequency and amplitude of their motions seems subtly wrong to you. You can follow the beach north or east from here."

rows.original: Oil Sea Beach
rows.raw: "Oil Sea Beach"

rows.original: Here, at the tip of a small, oily inlet, the beach is even more blackened than elsewhere, perhaps due to collecting sludge and sediment carried on the waves. You can actually spot pools of tar alongside silvery swirls and reddish quagmires, each of them as beautiful as they are deadly. It’s hard not to feel like this whole planet is a spectacle of pollution and rot heaped upon itself until it’s gained its own sense of obscene beauty. Surely there’s something of value left on this planet - perhaps half-buried in the beach to the south or west. Maybe you could find something to the east, near the nose of the Nova or to the north under the cliffs.
rows.translation: 这里位于一处小型油腻海湾的尽头，海滩甚至比别处更黑，或许是因为浪潮带来的污泥和沉积物都汇集于此。银色涡流与泛红泥沼之间，甚至可见一汪汪焦油；每一处都美丽得与致命程度不相上下。你很难不觉得整颗星球都是污染与腐烂层层堆积而成的奇观，最终竟孕育出属于自己的亵渎美感。这颗星球上肯定还留着什么有价值的东西——也许半埋在南边或西边的海滩中。你也可以去东边诺瓦号舰艏附近找找，或前往北边的峭壁下方。
rows.raw: "Here, at the tip of a small, oily inlet, the beach is even more blackened than elsewhere, perhaps due to collecting sludge and sediment carried on the waves. You can actually spot pools of tar alongside silvery swirls and reddish quagmires, each of them as beautiful as they are deadly. It’s hard not to feel like this whole planet is a spectacle of pollution and rot heaped upon itself until it’s gained its own sense of obscene beauty. Surely there’s something of value left on this planet - perhaps half-buried in the beach to the south or west. Maybe you could find something to the east, near the nose of the Nova or to the north under the cliffs."

rows.original: Oil Sea Beach
rows.raw: "Oil Sea Beach"

rows.original: You have to stop to yank your [pc.foot] out of the muck at least once in order to continue on. Like brackish swamp water, mercurial deposits of tar and filth have gathered in every depression on the crimson tinged beach. You tread carefully as you navigate the unearthly landscape, keeping a wary eye on the slow waves of pollution that lap at the rusted shores. The beach leads north and south. To the east, you can spot a trail around a twisted mountain of wrecked machinery.
rows.translation: 为了继续前进，你至少有一次不得不停下，把[pc.foot]从烂泥里拔出来。猩红海滩上的每处凹地，都像半咸水沼泽般积满变幻不定的焦油与污物。你小心穿行在这片异世景观中，警惕地注视着缓慢拍打锈蚀岸边的污染浪涛。海滩向北、南延伸。东边可见一条绕过扭曲机械残骸山的小径。
rows.raw: "You have to stop to yank your [pc.foot] out of the muck at least once in order to continue on. Like brackish swamp water, mercurial deposits of tar and filth have gathered in every depression on the crimson tinged beach. You tread carefully as you navigate the unearthly landscape, keeping a wary eye on the slow waves of pollution that lap at the rusted shores. The beach leads north and south. To the east, you can spot a trail around a twisted mountain of wrecked machinery."

rows.original: Oil Sea Beach
rows.raw: "Oil Sea Beach"

rows.original: This narrow strip of beach is made all the more precarious by a looming pile of wasted hulks and gutted spaceships. Someone went through all the trouble of scrounging them for useful parts and stacking the corroded leftovers into a pile, and whoever it was didn’t even have the foresight to make it a little further away from the beach. You’ll be forced to squeeze between the metal and the viscous waves numerous times if you want to go north or south, the only passable directions.
rows.translation: 废弃残骸和被掏空的飞船堆高高压在一旁，让这条狭窄海滩变得更加险恶。有人费尽心思搜刮了其中有用的零件，再将腐蚀的残余堆成一座山，却连把它堆得离海滩稍远些的先见之明都没有。若想向北或向南这两个唯一可通行的方向前进，你将不得不反复从金属与黏稠浪潮之间挤过。
rows.raw: "This narrow strip of beach is made all the more precarious by a looming pile of wasted hulks and gutted spaceships. Someone went through all the trouble of scrounging them for useful parts and stacking the corroded leftovers into a pile, and whoever it was didn’t even have the foresight to make it a little further away from the beach. You’ll be forced to squeeze between the metal and the viscous waves numerous times if you want to go north or south, the only passable directions."

rows.original: Oil Sea Beach
rows.raw: "Oil Sea Beach"

rows.original: A slurping sound announces the languid connection of a minor waterway to the beach. The sluggish water pours an irregular stream into the contaminated water, creating a chunky froth. Fat-like chunks of scum litter the sand, looking like greasy, gray-black stones, already blistering in the elements. The smell of baked crude oil saturates the air, making it hard to breathe. You pick your way carefully through the deposits, holding your breath as one crumbles with your passing, filling the air with visible fumes. The wall stacked junkers blocking off the northeast doesn’t help either. You can follow the beach to the north and east.
rows.translation: 一阵啜吸般的声响宣告一条小水道缓缓汇入海滩。迟滞的水流断断续续注入受污染的水域，泛起块状泡沫。沙滩上散落着一团团脂肪般的浮垢，看似油腻的灰黑石块，已经在恶劣环境中起泡。烘烤原油的气味充斥空气，令人难以呼吸。你屏住呼吸，小心绕过沉积物；其中一块在你经过时碎裂，向空气中喷出肉眼可见的烟气。东北边那堵由报废飞船堆成的墙也毫无帮助。你可以沿海滩向北或向东行进。
rows.raw: "A slurping sound announces the languid connection of a minor waterway to the beach. The sluggish water pours an irregular stream into the contaminated water, creating a chunky froth. Fat-like chunks of scum litter the sand, looking like greasy, gray-black stones, already blistering in the elements. The smell of baked crude oil saturates the air, making it hard to breathe. You pick your way carefully through the deposits, holding your breath as one crumbles with your passing, filling the air with visible fumes. The wall stacked junkers blocking off the northeast doesn’t help either. You can follow the beach to the north and east."

rows.original: Oil Sea Beach
rows.raw: "Oil Sea Beach"

rows.original: The world around you gradually turns red. You rub your eyes, blaming fatigue for the sudden crimson shift. After blinking several times, you realize, no, the world has actually gone red. The sands are an unhealthy red-black, silicates tossed with metal particulates, and the entire stretch of water here looks uncomfortably like blood. Something massive is corroding off shore on this beach. You can see the mirror stillness of the “water” several yards out from where you stand, and try to shake off the impression of some oceanic titan bleeding to death. The beach curves around to the south and west while twisting, creaking mass of forgotten wrecks have been stacked to the north and east, blocking your way.
rows.translation: 周围的世界逐渐变红。你揉了揉眼睛，把这突如其来的猩红变化归咎于疲劳。眨了几次眼后，你才意识到不，世界真的变红了。沙地呈病态的红黑色，硅酸盐中混杂着金属微粒，整片水域看起来也令人不安地像鲜血。海滩外有什么庞然大物正在腐蚀。你能看到离岸数码处“水面”镜子般的死寂，并努力摆脱某个海洋巨人正在失血而死的错觉。海滩向南和西弯曲，北边与东边则堆满了扭曲吱呀、早已被遗忘的残骸，阻住去路。
rows.raw: "The world around you gradually turns red. You rub your eyes, blaming fatigue for the sudden crimson shift. After blinking several times, you realize, no, the world has actually gone red. The sands are an unhealthy red-black, silicates tossed with metal particulates, and the entire stretch of water here looks uncomfortably like blood. Something massive is corroding off shore on this beach. You can see the mirror stillness of the “water” several yards out from where you stand, and try to shake off the impression of some oceanic titan bleeding to death. The beach curves around to the south and west while twisting, creaking mass of forgotten wrecks have been stacked to the north and east, blocking your way."

rows.original: Oil Sea Beach
rows.raw: "Oil Sea Beach"

rows.original: While your first and second step onto the sand here are stable enough, your third nearly pitches you forward. The sand beneath your [pc.feet] crumbles away, leaving a black, fluid-filled depression a foot deep. Fumes rising from the pool make you think of cheap, chemical batteries. You notice a black underlayer to the water here and realize that the beach is slowly dissolving. It’s safe enough for now, but from this point on, you carefully test each step before committing your weight to it. Towering over you, a picked-through collection of ancient battle tanks twists in the breeze. Someone took the time to cut out all the valuable components and pile the gutted remains together. You can follow the beach north and east.
rows.translation: 踏上此处沙地的第一步和第二步还算稳固，第三步却险些让你向前栽倒。[pc.feet]下的沙土骤然崩塌，留下一个一英尺深、灌满黑色液体的凹坑。池中升起的烟气令你想起廉价化学电池。你注意到水下有一层黑色物质，意识到海滩正在缓慢溶解。眼下还算安全，但从现在起，你每一步都会先试探稳固程度，再把体重压上去。一堆被翻捡过的古老战车高耸在你头顶，随风微微扭动。有人特意切走所有值钱部件，再把掏空的残骸堆在一起。你可以沿海滩向北或向东行进。
rows.raw: "While your first and second step onto the sand here are stable enough, your third nearly pitches you forward. The sand beneath your [pc.feet] crumbles away, leaving a black, fluid-filled depression a foot deep. Fumes rising from the pool make you think of cheap, chemical batteries. You notice a black underlayer to the water here and realize that the beach is slowly dissolving. It’s safe enough for now, but from this point on, you carefully test each step before committing your weight to it. Towering over you, a picked-through collection of ancient battle tanks twists in the breeze. Someone took the time to cut out all the valuable components and pile the gutted remains together. You can follow the beach north and east."

rows.original: Oil Sea Beach
rows.raw: "Oil Sea Beach"

rows.original: The silence of your walk is interrupted by a chattering of high pitched tones. You glance around quickly, looking for the source of the ringing notes. You see nothing but the yellow-tinged fluid of the sea and this area’s glittering sand. It is not until you begin walking that you hear the tinkling notes once more. You take a few more experimental steps forward, then look down, feeling awed and foolish at the same time. Chemical reactions here have crystallized the sand into minuscule, interlocking crystals. Each step snaps hundreds of them, resulting in the sound of scattered bells. The waterside twists away to the south and west, but you could head east into the rust fields if you wanted.
rows.translation: 步行时的寂静被一串尖细音调打破。你迅速环顾四周，寻找铃音来源，却只看见泛黄的海水和这片区域闪闪发亮的沙地。直到重新迈步，那叮当声才再次响起。你试探着又向前走了几步，随即低头，既惊叹又觉得自己愚蠢。此处的化学反应已令沙子结晶成微小且相互咬合的晶体，每一步都会踩断数百颗，于是发出零落钟铃般的声响。水岸向南和西蜿蜒而去，不过你若愿意，也可以向东进入锈蚀原野。
rows.raw: "The silence of your walk is interrupted by a chattering of high pitched tones. You glance around quickly, looking for the source of the ringing notes. You see nothing but the yellow-tinged fluid of the sea and this area’s glittering sand. It is not until you begin walking that you hear the tinkling notes once more. You take a few more experimental steps forward, then look down, feeling awed and foolish at the same time. Chemical reactions here have crystallized the sand into minuscule, interlocking crystals. Each step snaps hundreds of them, resulting in the sound of scattered bells. The waterside twists away to the south and west, but you could head east into the rust fields if you wanted."

rows.original: Rust Path
rows.raw: "Rust Path"

rows.original: Sandwiched between two different, tall mounds of junk, is a single, winding path. Ominous creaks of strained, failing metal slip out of the rusted ships and machinery stacked to the west with every errant gust of bone-dry breeze. Across the way, arms, legs, and treads spread akimbo, sticking out of a mass of rusted torsos, dead eyes, and forgotten power plants. Someone took the time to gather them all together, perhaps so that they could dig through the rust elsewhere. Heading north will take you between the piles. You could also travel south alongside the eerie, robotic graveyard or west beside the ancient, stripped starships.
rows.translation: 两座不同的高大垃圾山之间，夹着一条蜿蜒小径。每当干得刺骨的微风偶然吹过，西边堆叠的锈蚀飞船与机械中便传出金属不堪重负、即将垮塌的不祥吱嘎声。道路另一侧，手臂、双腿与履带四散伸展，从一大团锈蚀躯干、死寂眼睛和被遗忘的动力装置中探出。有人花时间把它们全都收集起来，也许是为了方便在别处翻找铁锈。向北会带你穿过两堆废料之间；你也可以向南沿诡异的机器人墓场前进，或向西经过那些古老且被拆空的星舰。
rows.raw: "Sandwiched between two different, tall mounds of junk, is a single, winding path. Ominous creaks of strained, failing metal slip out of the rusted ships and machinery stacked to the west with every errant gust of bone-dry breeze. Across the way, arms, legs, and treads spread akimbo, sticking out of a mass of rusted torsos, dead eyes, and forgotten power plants. Someone took the time to gather them all together, perhaps so that they could dig through the rust elsewhere. Heading north will take you between the piles. You could also travel south alongside the eerie, robotic graveyard or west beside the ancient, stripped starships."

rows.original: Rust Path
rows.raw: "Rust Path"

rows.original: It is hard not to feel a little claustrophobic when you’re standing in the shadows of two giants. It’s even harder when those giants are two rusted skeletons of torn-up, corroded machinery. To the west is a pile of stripped-down tanks and the occasional ship or crane. To the east, the mound is comprised of thousands upon thousands of broken-down robots and androids, their valuable components removed, their bodies left to rot. You could follow the path south between them, north alongside the larger ship pile, or east beside those poor robots.
rows.translation: 站在两个巨人的阴影下，很难不感到些许幽闭恐惧；而当这两个巨人其实是遭撕裂、腐蚀的机械锈骨架时，感觉就更加强烈。西边堆着被拆空的战车，间或夹杂飞船或起重机；东边则由成千上万台损坏的机器人与仿生人堆成，它们值钱的部件已被取走，躯体任其腐烂。你可以沿两堆废料间的小路向南，沿更大的飞船堆向北，或贴着那些可怜的机器人向东行进。
rows.raw: "It is hard not to feel a little claustrophobic when you’re standing in the shadows of two giants. It’s even harder when those giants are two rusted skeletons of torn-up, corroded machinery. To the west is a pile of stripped-down tanks and the occasional ship or crane. To the east, the mound is comprised of thousands upon thousands of broken-down robots and androids, their valuable components removed, their bodies left to rot. You could follow the path south between them, north alongside the larger ship pile, or east beside those poor robots."

rows.original: Next To A Junk Pile
rows.raw: "Next To A Junk Pile"

rows.original: The massive hulk a few yards away is the mass grave of robots. Metallic arms reach up from the mound, frozen in mid-grasp, entreating the scorched sky. The shadows they cast fall on your path, striping the road ahead with skeletal shadows. As you walk past, you catch a flicker of movement. You whip your head around, glaring at the still mound of shattered bots. Your eyes are playing tricks on you - it almost looks like the arms are reaching for you as soon as your back is turned. You can head east or west and stay beside the forgotten automatons, or you could go north into the rust fields beside the Nova.
rows.translation: 几码外的庞大残骸是机器人的万人坑。金属手臂从废料山中向上伸出，定格在抓握动作中，仿佛向焦灼的天空哀求。它们投下的阴影落在小路上，以骨骼般的条纹切割前方道路。经过时，你瞥见一丝动静，猛然扭头瞪向那堆静止的破碎机器人。是眼睛在捉弄你——那些手臂看起来几乎会在你转身时伸向你。你可以向东或向西，继续沿被遗忘的自动机械前进；也可以向北进入诺瓦号旁的锈蚀原野。
rows.raw: "The massive hulk a few yards away is the mass grave of robots. Metallic arms reach up from the mound, frozen in mid-grasp, entreating the scorched sky. The shadows they cast fall on your path, striping the road ahead with skeletal shadows. As you walk past, you catch a flicker of movement. You whip your head around, glaring at the still mound of shattered bots. Your eyes are playing tricks on you - it almost looks like the arms are reaching for you as soon as your back is turned. You can head east or west and stay beside the forgotten automatons, or you could go north into the rust fields beside the Nova."

rows.original: Next To A Junk Pile
rows.raw: "Next To A Junk Pile"

rows.original: A blast of wind carries a storm of rusted flakes off the jumble of broken robots. You shield your eyes just in time as a it throws a bucket’s worth of rust over you. You taste blood and spit repeatedly, trying to get the oxidized metal out of your mouth. The wind rocks a precarious steel skeleton atop the pile, making it lurch forward repeatedly, almost as if it were silently laughing at your misfortune. You flip a rude gesture at the inanimate robot, then, feeling a bit silly, continue on your way. The automaton pile arcs away to the south and west. You can also head north into the rust fields near the Nova or east towards a different, smaller crashed ship.
rows.translation: 一阵狂风从杂乱的破机器人堆上卷起暴雨般的锈片。你及时护住眼睛，而风仿佛把整桶铁锈泼到了身上。你尝到血味，连连吐唾沫，想把氧化金属清出口腔。狂风摇动废料堆顶一具摇摇欲坠的钢铁骨架，让它不断向前猛晃，仿佛正无声嘲笑你的不幸。你朝这台死物比了个粗鲁手势，随后觉得有些傻，继续赶路。自动机械堆向南和西弯曲。你也可以向北进入诺瓦号附近的锈蚀原野，或向东前往另一艘较小的坠毁飞船。
rows.raw: "A blast of wind carries a storm of rusted flakes off the jumble of broken robots. You shield your eyes just in time as a it throws a bucket’s worth of rust over you. You taste blood and spit repeatedly, trying to get the oxidized metal out of your mouth. The wind rocks a precarious steel skeleton atop the pile, making it lurch forward repeatedly, almost as if it were silently laughing at your misfortune. You flip a rude gesture at the inanimate robot, then, feeling a bit silly, continue on your way. The automaton pile arcs away to the south and west. You can also head north into the rust fields near the Nova or east towards a different, smaller crashed ship."

rows.original: Next To A Crashed Ship
rows.raw: "Next To A Crashed Ship"

rows.original: Like a giant, orange egg, a rust-covered, ancient craft of alien design sits half-buried in Tarkus’s iron-scaled surface. It seems that even alien metals are no match for the corrosive properties of this planet’s atmosphere. What few hatches you can see are either sealed shut or only cracked open enough to let the elements into the interior, their hinges or mechanisms long since seized into immobility. You could circle around it to the north or south. Alternatively, you could travel west towards a pile of shattered robots.
rows.translation: 一艘覆盖铁锈、造型如巨型橙色蛋的古老异星飞船，半埋在塔库斯覆满铁鳞的地表。看来就连异星金属也敌不过这颗星球大气的腐蚀性。你能看见的少数舱门不是紧紧封死，就是只裂开足以让风雨侵入内部的缝隙；它们的铰链或机械结构早已锈死不动。你可以向北或向南绕行，也可以向西前往一堆破碎机器人。
rows.raw: "Like a giant, orange egg, a rust-covered, ancient craft of alien design sits half-buried in Tarkus’s iron-scaled surface. It seems that even alien metals are no match for the corrosive properties of this planet’s atmosphere. What few hatches you can see are either sealed shut or only cracked open enough to let the elements into the interior, their hinges or mechanisms long since seized into immobility. You could circle around it to the north or south. Alternatively, you could travel west towards a pile of shattered robots."

rows.original: Next To A Crashed Ship
rows.raw: "Next To A Crashed Ship"

rows.original: Flakes of corroded metal break off the egg-shaped hull of a crashed, alien ship in the slow, dry breezes that occasionally gust by, scratching at you as they travel by. You brush a few off your shoulder as you regard the ancient machinery. It is clear that the ship has been here so long that it’s never going to be spaceworthy again. Some of the hatches are hanging open, frozen by rust, while others are staunchly sealed shut, virtually welded in place by time. You can head north or east around the ship, or you could head west toward a pile of discarded robots. To the south, there’s an open area of the rust fields.
rows.translation: 偶尔掠过的缓慢干风，会从一艘坠毁异星飞船的蛋形船体上剥落腐蚀金属片；锈片飞过时刮擦着你。你拂去肩上几片碎屑，打量这台古老机械。显然，飞船已在这里躺了太久，再也不可能重返太空。有些舱门敞开垂挂，被铁锈定住；另一些则顽固地紧闭，几乎被岁月焊死。你可以向北或向东绕过飞船，也可以向西前往一堆废弃机器人。南边是一片开阔的锈蚀原野。
rows.raw: "Flakes of corroded metal break off the egg-shaped hull of a crashed, alien ship in the slow, dry breezes that occasionally gust by, scratching at you as they travel by. You brush a few off your shoulder as you regard the ancient machinery. It is clear that the ship has been here so long that it’s never going to be spaceworthy again. Some of the hatches are hanging open, frozen by rust, while others are staunchly sealed shut, virtually welded in place by time. You can head north or east around the ship, or you could head west toward a pile of discarded robots. To the south, there’s an open area of the rust fields."

rows.original: Next To A Junk Pile
rows.raw: "Next To A Junk Pile"

rows.original: A skeletal-looking arm with titanium-composite bones covered in caked-on hydraulic fluid nearly whacks you in the head as you walk alongside a stockpile of forgotten, looted automatons. You look closer until you spot a pair of dead eyes looking back at you, and suitably unnerved, you decide it’d be best not to look too close. If you walk a little ways to the east, you could come up alongside a crusty-looking ship. You could also go north or south if you wanted to stay next to the creepy-looking junkpile.
rows.translation: 你沿被遗忘、遭洗劫的自动机械仓库行走时，一条骨架般的手臂险些砸中脑袋；其钛合金骨骼上结满液压油污垢。你凑近查看，直到发现一双死寂的眼睛正回望自己。被吓得恰到好处后，你决定最好别再看得太仔细。向东走一小段，便能来到一艘外壳斑驳的飞船旁；若想继续沿这座诡异垃圾山走，也可以向北或向南。

rows.original: A load of batteries has calcified this portion of the robot pile. One of the android’s power cells, likely a cheap chemical battery of some kind, has leaked down from the top of the heap. The burst chest plate of this hulking android is a flower of torn metal, and the gout of calcification creates the impression of a mouth frozen mid-vomit. The corrosion has seared and blistered the metal of the robots below it, creating a frozen waterfall of white, corroded metal. Bars of bone-white residue pour cage-like rivulets down the cybernetic hecatomb. You give the silent cascade a sideways look as you hurry on your way.
rows.translation: 大量电池让机器人堆的这一部分结满了硬垢。某个仿生人的动力电池——可能是某种廉价化学电池——从废料堆顶泄漏下来。这台巨型仿生人爆裂的胸甲如一朵撕裂金属构成的花，而喷涌的钙化沉积让它看起来像一张凝固在呕吐瞬间的嘴。腐蚀灼伤并剥裂了下方机器人的金属，形成一道白色腐蚀金属凝固而成的瀑布。骨白色残渣化作笼栏般的细流，从这座机械祭尸堆上倾泻而下。你斜眼看着这道无声瀑布，加快脚步离开。

rows.original: You gape at this section of the robot pile. Different parts have been loosely arranged into different heaps. You’re aware that it was likely someone sorting through the scrap, but the end result is extremely unnerving. A tangle of limbs, rusted pistons, snapped and bent bars, makes up the largest pile, a thicket of malformed pincers and robotic hands. Next to them is a heap of chassis of varying colors, smeared with the fungal encroach of rust and verdigris. Most unnerving, though, is the pile of heads next to the path. You know it to be the act of a scrapper, but you just can’t shake the vaguely threatening feel of a stack of two dozen severed, metal heads pointed at you. The gathered robots continue to loom above you to the east and west. Distantly to the south, you can see huge, metal blades sticking up out of the metal-flaked earth.
rows.translation: 你目瞪口呆地看着机器人堆的这一部分。不同零件被松散地分成一堆堆。你知道这大概只是有人在整理废料，但最终景象仍极其瘆人。最大的一堆由纠缠的肢体、锈蚀活塞、折断弯曲的金属杆构成，俨然一片畸形钳爪与机械手组成的灌木丛。旁边是一堆颜色各异的躯壳，表面涂满铁锈和铜绿如真菌侵染般的痕迹。不过最令人不安的还是路边那堆头颅。你明知这是拾荒者所为，却怎么也摆脱不了两打被切下的金属头颅齐齐对准自己的隐约威胁感。聚集的机器人仍在东、西两边高高压着你。遥远的南边，巨大的金属刃从布满金属碎屑的大地上刺出。

rows.original: Skeletal robots lay sprawled across the heap, interlocked in a still, rusted orgy. Most are stripped of their chassis, their interiors bare to the elements. What heads remain stare blankly at the corrosion-streaked sky, silent observers of the slow death of the planet. You know that they were simply piled here, but you can’t help but imagine some accidental meaning to the coiling of coolant tubes, the criss-crossing of arms, and the gape of silent jaw joints. Despite no real change in temperature, you shiver, resolving to walk faster past this section of the pile. If you head north or east, you’ll stay alongside this artificial graveyard. You can also go west from here, towards a polluted beach, or south, towards a monolithic, metal blade that sticks up out of the ground like a shiny, gigantic rib.
rows.translation: 骨架般的机器人摊倒在废料堆上，彼此交缠成一场静止而锈蚀的群交。大多数已被剥去外壳，内部结构完全暴露在环境中。残存的头颅茫然仰望被腐蚀染出条纹的天空，默默见证这颗星球缓慢死亡。你知道它们只是被堆在这里，却仍忍不住为盘绕的冷却管、交错的手臂和无声张开的颌部关节想象出某种无意间形成的意义。气温明明毫无变化，你却打了个寒颤，决意加快脚步通过这一段。向北或向东会继续沿着这座人造墓场行进；你也可以向西前往受污染的海滩，或向南走向一片如闪亮巨肋般刺出地面的庞大金属刃。

rows.original: Oil Sea Beach
rows.raw: "Oil Sea Beach"

rows.original: Are those... sharks? Standing on the oxidized sand, you squint at the oily-yellow sea. Several dark, triangular “fins” cut through the surface just offshore. It takes you a few moments of squinting and holding up your thumb to realize that they’re not moving, and the space of several yards to see that they’re simply shards of metal standing upright in the sea. The irregular pulse of the tide had made them seem as if they were moving. You scold yourself for the flight of fancy. Sharks in the water! What’s next? Mistaking that twist of wire for a pair of glasses?
rows.translation: 那些是...鲨鱼吗？你站在氧化的沙地上，眯眼望向油黄色海面。几片黑色三角形“鳍”划过近岸水面。你眯眼看了好一会儿，又举起拇指比量，才发现它们根本没动；再走近数码，才看清那只是直立海中的金属碎片。潮汐不规律的脉动让它们看起来像在游动。你责备自己胡思乱想。水里有鲨鱼！接下来呢？把那截弯铁丝错认成一副眼镜？

It takes you a few moments of squinting and holding up your thumb to realize that they’re not moving, and the space of several yards to see that they’re simply shards of metal standing upright in the sea. The irregular pulse of the tide had made them seem as if they were moving. You scold yourself for the flight of fancy. Sharks in the water! What’s next? Mistaking that twist of wire for a pair of glasses?"

rows.original: Oil Sea Beach
rows.raw: "Oil Sea Beach"

rows.original: An acrid cloud announces this stretch of beach before you really see it. The stuttered pulse of tidal actions slap a watery, greenish fluid against the ashy-white sand. With every half-formed push of the sea, the corrosive fluid pushes against the sand, burning away handfuls at a time, creating a noxious curtain of fumes at the sea’s edge. It smells like some ungodly blend of citrus, diesel, and urine. You nearly gag before you think to hold your breath. The beach runs north and south from here, but you can journey east into the rust fields as well.
rows.translation: 还没真正看清这段海滩，一团刺鼻云雾便先宣告了它的存在。潮汐断续的脉动把水样绿色液体拍向灰白沙滩。海水每一次不完整的推进，都令腐蚀性液体冲刷沙地，一把把将其烧蚀，并在海边形成有毒烟幕。那味道像某种亵渎神明的柑橘、柴油与尿液混合物。你差点干呕，才想到应该屏住呼吸。海滩从这里向北、南延伸，你也可以向东进入锈蚀原野。

It smells like some ungodly blend of citrus, diesel, and urine. You nearly gag before you think to hold your breath. The beach runs north and south from here, but you can journey east into the rust fields as well."

rows.original: Oil Sea Beach
rows.raw: "Oil Sea Beach"

rows.original: You are momentarily puzzled by the sound of a church bell. Could some alien culture have actually built a place of worship on this planet? And why in whoever’s name would they put it on this beach? A step around another battered hull exposes the mystery, but does nothing to dispel the oddity. As you watch, a cylindrical section of a ship, likely a spent fuel tank, rolls down a slope of metallic sand into the sea of chemicals. Rhythmically, the idiot tide shoves it back. The thick, syrupy waves push it up the slope far enough to clang the house-sized tank against a half-buried engine core, lodged in the shore. You wonder, in passing, how long this accidental bell has pealed, summoning its nonexistent flock. A blade of metal the size of a small skyscraper blocks travel to the south and east, leaving north the only passable direction.
rows.translation: 教堂钟声令你困惑了片刻。难道某种异星文化真在这颗星球上建了礼拜场所？而且他们究竟为何要以不管谁的名义把它建在这片海滩？绕过另一具破损船体后，谜底显露出来，怪异感却丝毫未减。你注视着一段圆柱形船体——很可能是用尽的燃料罐——沿金属沙坡滚入化学物质之海，愚钝的潮水又有节奏地把它推回来。浓稠糖浆般的波浪将其沿斜坡推得足够高，让这只房屋大小的罐体撞上半埋在岸边的引擎核心，发出铛铛巨响。你随意想着，这口意外形成的钟究竟已敲响多久，召唤着根本不存在的信众。一片小型摩天楼般巨大的金属刃挡住南边和东边，只剩北边可以通行。
rows.raw: "You are momentarily puzzled by the sound of a church bell. Could some alien culture have actually built a place of worship on this planet? And why in whoever’s name would they put it on this beach? A step around another battered hull exposes the mystery, but does nothing to dispel the oddity. As you watch, a cylindrical section of a ship, likely a spent fuel tank, rolls down a slope of metallic sand into the sea of chemicals. Rhythmically, the idiot tide shoves it back. A blade of metal the size of a small skyscraper blocks travel to the south and east, leaving north the only passable direction."

rows.original: Iron Ridges
rows.raw: "Iron Ridges"

rows.original: From here, you can see two gigantic metal plates in the distance: one to the southeast and the other to the southwest. The former is at least a dozen feet taller than the latter, but they’re both easily hundreds of feet tall, big enough to have come from a capital ship or ocean-going vessel. There’s enough of a gap for you to squeeze south between them. You could also head east or west along the ridges. Due north, into the rust plains, is an option as well, but a heap of piled robots will block your travels before you go too far.
rows.translation: 从这里能看见远处两块巨型金属板：一块在东南，另一块在西南。前者至少比后者高出十二英尺，但两块都轻易达到数百英尺高，庞大得足以来自主力舰或远洋船只。它们之间的空隙足够让你向南挤过去。你也可以沿山脊向东或向西。正北方的锈蚀平原同样可走，不过还没走多远，一堆机器人就会挡住去路。

There’s enough of a gap for you to squeeze south between them. You could also head east or west along the ridges. rows.raw: "Iron Valley"

rows.original: The light is dim but still sufficient for you to navigate against some of the smaller protrusions in the area. Rough orange walls pen you in to the east and west, curved in enough to remind you of bloodied waves frozen in time. You battle down the fleeting claustrophobia that rears its ugly head and consider your options. There’s too many chunks of metal to the south to allow you any further into this metallic ravine. North is the only passable direction.
rows.translation: 光线昏暗，却仍足以让你避开这片区域一些较小的突起。粗糙的橙色墙壁从东、西两边将你围住，它们向内弯曲的形状令人想起凝固在时间中的血色浪涛。你压下转瞬冒头的丑陋幽闭恐惧，考虑接下来的选择。南边金属碎块太多，无法继续深入这条金属峡谷，只有北边可以通行。

rows.original: Iron Ridges
rows.raw: "Iron Ridges"

rows.original: The iron ridges provide a fascinating, if unnatural, landscape. Thousands of metallic plates of all sizes and descriptions comprise them, all aligned in the same north-south orientation. Here there’s a bit of iron, flaking away into dust. There you can see a teal hunk of corroded bronze. Blue flakes fall like snow off alien pieces of metal you don’t even recognize, but you know enough to realize that any value it once had flaked away with its structural integrity. The hunks of metal are too thick to the south to move in that direction, but travel east and west alongside the ridges is free and clear. To the north lie the rust plains and a distant pile of abandoned automatons.
rows.translation: 铁脊构成了一片迷人却反常的景观。成千上万块大小与形制各异的金属板构成山脊，而且全都沿同一个南北方向排列。这边有块铁正剥落成尘；那边则能看见一大块被腐蚀成蓝绿色的青铜。你甚至认不出某些异星金属，蓝色碎屑如雪般从上面落下；但你至少知道，它曾有的价值已和结构完整性一同剥落。南边金属块密得无法通行，不过可以自由向东或向西沿山脊前进。北边是锈蚀平原和远处一堆被遗弃的自动机械。

Here there’s a bit of iron, flaking away into dust. There you can see a teal hunk of corroded bronze. Blue flakes fall like snow off alien pieces of metal you don’t even recognize, but you know enough to realize that any value it once had flaked away with its structural integrity. The hunks of metal are too thick to the south to move in that direction, but travel east and west alongside the ridges is free and clear. To the north lie the rust plains and a distant pile of abandoned automatons."

rows.original: Iron Ridges
rows.raw: "Iron Ridges"

rows.original: A gust of biting wind lances by your cheek, opening a narrow cut in your flesh when you get unlucky enough to catch a rust flake just wrong. The stacked panels to the south have channeled Tarkus’s natural breezes into a dangerous wind tunnel here. It’d be best to move on before too long. The edges of the iron ridges can be followed to the east and west, or you can journey north into the rust plains.
rows.translation: 一阵刺骨狂风从脸颊旁穿刺而过，你倒霉地被一片角度刁钻的锈片划出一道细口。南边堆叠的金属板把塔库斯的天然微风汇聚成了危险风洞。最好别在这里停留太久。你可以沿铁脊边缘向东或向西，也可以向北进入锈蚀平原。
