The stacked panels to the south have channeled Tarkus’s natural breezes into a dangerous wind tunnel here. It’d be best to move on before too long. The edges of the iron ridges can be followed to the east and west, or you can journey north into the rust plains."

rows.original: Rust Plains
rows.raw: "Rust Plains"

rows.original: In an empty patch of the rust plains, Tarkus’s ruined state is laid bare. There isn’t a single living creature that you can see. The air smells like acid and ancient batteries. Worse still, fetid brown clouds roll across the sky, occasionally turning a sunny walk into a dreary slog. The ground isn’t doing much to help either. It’s covered in drifts of crumbled rust that hide razor-sharp bits of machinery and corrosive puddles. East and south of here, you can approach the iron ridges - groups of metal slabs of all shapes and sizes that have been gathered together for some unknown purpose. Some ancient ship wreckage lies a few minutes walk to the north, and robotic carcasses have been piled up a ways to the west.
rows.translation: 在锈蚀平原的一片空地上，塔库斯的残破状态暴露无遗。视野中没有任何活物。空气闻起来像酸液与老旧电池。更糟的是，恶臭的棕色云团横越天空，偶尔把阳光下的漫步变成阴沉跋涉。地面也没好到哪里去；一层层碎锈掩盖着锋利如剃刀的机械碎片与腐蚀性水洼。此处东边和南边可以接近铁脊——为了某种未知目的聚集起来、形状大小各异的金属板群。北边步行几分钟处有古老飞船残骸，西边稍远处则堆着机器人尸骸。
rows.raw: "In an empty patch of the rust plains, Tarkus’s ruined state is laid bare. There isn’t a single living creature that you can see. The air smells like acid and ancient batteries. Worse still, fetid brown clouds roll across the sky, occasionally turning a sunny walk into a dreary slog. The ground isn’t doing much to help either. It’s covered in drifts of crumbled rust that hide razor-sharp bits of machinery and corrosive puddles. East and south of here, you can approach the iron ridges - groups of metal slabs of all shapes and sizes that have been gathered together for some unknown purpose. Some ancient ship wreckage lies a few minutes walk to the north, and robotic carcasses have been piled up a ways to the west."

rows.original: Iron Ridges
rows.raw: "Iron Ridges"

rows.original: A slab of ancient metal covered in enough scaled material to hide a house juts out of the iron ridges like the prow of an ancient sailing vessel. Drifts of detritus have gathered up around its leading edge like corroded waves, and the relatively smooth, unbroken length completes the illusion as it disappears southward into a virtual sea of similar plates. You can go south next to its western edge, east along the ends of similar ridges, north into the wastes towards a forgotten ship, or west into the empty, rusted plains.
rows.translation: 一块覆满鳞状物、足以藏住整栋房子的古老金属板从铁脊中探出，仿佛古代帆船的船艏。腐蚀的废料如浪涛般堆积在其前缘，平滑而相对完整的修长板面向南没入一片由相似板材构成的虚拟海洋，令这幅错觉越发完整。你可以沿其西侧边缘向南，沿相似山脊的尽头向东，向北穿过荒原前往一艘被遗忘的飞船，或向西进入空旷的锈蚀平原。
rows.raw: "A slab of ancient metal covered in enough scaled material to hide a house juts out of the iron ridges like the prow of an ancient sailing vessel. Drifts of detritus have gathered up around its leading edge like corroded waves, and the relatively smooth, unbroken length completes the illusion as it disappears southward into a virtual sea of similar plates. You can go south next to its western edge, east along the ends of similar ridges, north into the wastes towards a forgotten ship, or west into the empty, rusted plains."

rows.original: Iron Ridges
rows.raw: "Iron Ridges"

rows.original: Bits of rust - iron oxide, your old chemistry teacher would say - are falling like snow from the top of football field-sized sheet of metal to the east. Unlike a winter flurry, this precipitation grates on your [pc.skinFurScales] in a most irritating way. You brush a few off your shoulder and look around. There’s enough room between the discarded metals to squeeze south into a metallic valley. You can always head west and north along the iron ridges as well.
rows.translation: 东边那块橄榄球场大小的金属板顶部，铁锈碎屑——你的老化学老师会称之为氧化铁——正如雪般飘落。与冬日小雪不同，这种降水以极其恼人的方式刮擦着你的[pc.skinFurScales]。你拂去肩上的几片碎屑，环顾四周。废弃金属之间留有足够空间，可以挤向南边的金属山谷；你也随时可以沿铁脊向西或向北。
rows.raw: "Bits of rust - iron oxide, your old chemistry teacher would say - are falling like snow from the top of football field-sized sheet of metal to the east. Unlike a winter flurry, this precipitation grates on your [pc.skinFurScales] in a most irritating way. You brush a few off your shoulder and look around. There’s enough room between the discarded metals to squeeze south into a metallic valley. You can always head west and north along the iron ridges as well."

rows.original: Iron Valley
rows.raw: "Iron Valley"

rows.original: Sun glitters on the few places that these plates haven’t been obscured by rust and corrosion, occasionally forcing you to squint your eyes. The further south you go, the narrower the space between the ridges grows. In the space of a few hundred steps, the walls of metal have all but closed together. They end not far ahead, but the gap between them is filled with dozens of smaller, erosion-sharpened slabs. There’s little reason to brave such a dangerous path without some foreknowledge as to what lies beyond....
rows.translation: 阳光在这些金属板少数未被铁锈与腐蚀遮蔽的部位闪烁，偶尔逼得你眯起双眼。越向南走，山脊之间的空间就越狭窄。短短数百步内，金属墙几乎已合拢。它们在不远处便会结束，但其间缝隙塞满了数十块被侵蚀磨利的小型板材。在预先知道另一边有什么之前，实在没理由冒险穿过如此危险的道路....
rows.raw: "Sun glitters on the few places that these plates haven’t been obscured by rust and corrosion, occasionally forcing you to squint your eyes. The further south you go, the narrower the space between the ridges grows. In the space of a few hundred steps, the walls of metal have all but closed together. They end not far ahead, but the gap between them is filled with dozens of smaller, erosion-sharpened slabs. There’s little reason to brave such a dangerous path without some foreknowledge as to what lies beyond...."

rows.original: Iron Ridges
rows.raw: "Iron Ridges"

rows.original: Here at the iron ridges, it’s obvious how they got their name. Ancient decks and armor plates have been stacked upright in the filth, some big enough that they resemble narrow mountains. Some of the smaller ones look less stable than their big brothers; you’ll have to step carefully if you don’t want to get slabbed. They’re so so densely packed to the south that there’s no stepping between them. You’ll have to search east and west of here for another way. Alternatively, you could step north into the rust plains, towards a wrecked ship.
rows.translation: 站在铁脊之间，很容易看出它们为何得名。古老甲板与装甲板直立堆在污物中，有些庞大得犹如狭长山峰。较小的板材看起来不如那些大家伙稳定；若不想被金属板拍扁，你就得小心落脚。南边板材密集得根本没有空隙可走，只能去东边或西边寻找其他道路。你也可以向北踏入锈蚀平原，前往一艘失事飞船。
rows.raw: "Here at the iron ridges, it’s obvious how they got their name. Ancient decks and armor plates have been stacked upright in the filth, some big enough that they resemble narrow mountains. Some of the smaller ones look less stable than their big brothers; you’ll have to step carefully if you don’t want to get slabbed. They’re so so densely packed to the south that there’s no stepping between them. You’ll have to search east and west of here for another way. Alternatively, you could step north into the rust plains, towards a wrecked ship."

rows.original: Iron Ridges
rows.raw: "Iron Ridges"

rows.original: Blade-like pieces of metal, some as big as buildings, are embedded in the sand-like expanse of rusty flakes to the south. In between them, hundreds of smaller pieces litter the landscape, almost as if they were stacked that way. The only other explanation would be a ship deconstructing itself in the upper atmosphere above a particularly strong magnetic field. Shrugging, you consider your options. You can travel east and west along these impassible ridges. You can also go north into the rust plains.
rows.translation: 刀刃般的金属碎片嵌在南边沙地般铺展的锈屑中，其中一些大如建筑。数百块较小碎片散落其间，看起来几乎像被人特意如此堆放。唯一的另一种解释，就是某艘飞船在上方大气层中、恰好位于异常强大的磁场上空自行解体。你耸耸肩，考虑可选路线。你可以沿这些无法穿越的山脊向东或向西，也可以向北进入锈蚀平原。
rows.raw: "Blade-like pieces of metal, some as big as buildings, are embedded in the sand-like expanse of rusty flakes to the south. In between them, hundreds of smaller pieces litter the landscape, almost as if they were stacked that way. The only other explanation would be a ship deconstructing itself in the upper atmosphere above a particularly strong magnetic field. Shrugging, you consider your options. You can travel east and west along these impassible ridges. You can also go north into the rust plains."

rows.original: Rust Plains
rows.raw: "Rust Plains"

rows.original: This is one of the single most desolate, empty places you’ve yet come across on the planet of Tarkus. Rolling dunes of scale and metallic crust are your only company in every direction, shifting under your [pc.feet] to undermine your steps and concealing untold dangers. Distantly, you can make out huge metallic ridges to the south. A wrecked ship is visible in the western distance, and eastwards you can see light glittering off something silvery; are those trees? Much further north lies the wrecked Nova, now Novahome, its engines glowing dully under the raskvels’ ministrations.
rows.translation: 这里是你至今在塔库斯遇见的最荒凉空旷之地之一。各个方向都只有鳞屑与金属硬壳组成的起伏沙丘作伴；它们在[pc.feet]下滑动，令脚步不稳，还掩藏着不知多少危险。远处南边能辨认出巨大的金属山脊，西方可见一艘失事飞船，东边则有某种银色物体反射着亮光——那是树吗？更遥远的北边是失事的诺瓦号，如今的诺瓦家园；在拉斯克维尔的照料下，它的引擎散发着暗淡光芒。
rows.raw: "This is one of the single most desolate, empty places you’ve yet come across on the planet of Tarkus. Rolling dunes of scale and metallic crust are your only company in every direction, shifting under your [pc.feet] to undermine your steps and concealing untold dangers. Distantly, you can make out huge metallic ridges to the south. A wrecked ship is visible in the western distance, and eastwards you can see light glittering off something silvery; are those trees? Much further north lies the wrecked Nova, now Novahome, its engines glowing dully under the raskvels’ ministrations."

rows.original: Rust Plains
rows.raw: "Rust Plains"

rows.original: It’s hard not to feel depressed when taking in views like this one. The nova, crashed long ago, lies half-buried in the red-flecked sand. Another ship in even worse condition lies west. Rolling plains interrupted by small piles of parts and assorted junk are the only landmarks here to keep you company. In a way, this place feels like a technological graveyard, only the planet’s inhabitants obviously haven’t left anything to rest. The rust plains stretch away in all directions.
rows.translation: 看到这样的景色，很难不感到压抑。很久以前坠毁的诺瓦号半埋在点缀红屑的沙地中，西边还有一艘状况更加糟糕的飞船。除了偶尔出现的小型零件堆与各式垃圾，起伏平原上再无其他地标陪伴你。某种意义上，这里像一座科技墓场，只不过这颗星球的居民显然不肯让任何东西安息。锈蚀平原向四面八方延伸。
rows.raw: "It’s hard not to feel depressed when taking in views like this one. The nova, crashed long ago, lies half-buried in the red-flecked sand. Another ship in even worse condition lies west. Rolling plains interrupted by small piles of parts and assorted junk are the only landmarks here to keep you company. In a way, this place feels like a technological graveyard, only the planet’s inhabitants obviously haven’t left anything to rest. The rust plains stretch away in all directions."

rows.original: Next To A Crashed Ship
rows.raw: "Next To A Crashed Ship"

rows.original: A half-buried ship sticks up out of the corroded soil like a long-forgotten, iron-rich boulder, its surface pitted and scarred from long-forgotten battles with ancient foes. One of the engines has managed to evade a burial in the shifting, metallic dunes to sit there, staring at you accusingly. The machinery that gave it life long ago rotted out long after its batteries failed a century back. All that remains is the emptied, battered husk of what once was a proud vessel.
rows.translation: 一艘半埋的飞船从腐蚀土壤中突出，犹如被遗忘已久、富含铁质的巨石。表面布满凹坑和伤疤，来自早被遗忘的古老战斗。某具引擎侥幸没有被流动的金属沙丘掩埋，就那样坐在那里，仿佛责备般盯着你。早在一个世纪前电池失效后，曾赋予它生命的机械也逐渐腐朽。如今只剩这具曾经骄傲的船舰那空洞而伤痕累累的躯壳。
rows.raw: "A half-buried ship sticks up out of the corroded soil like a long-forgotten, iron-rich boulder, its surface pitted and scarred from long-forgotten battles with ancient foes. One of the engines has managed to evade a burial in the shifting, metallic dunes to sit there, staring at you accusingly. The machinery that gave it life long ago rotted out long after its batteries failed a century back. All that remains is the emptied, battered husk of what once was a proud vessel."

rows.original: Rust Fields
rows.raw: "Rust Fields"

rows.original: Crusty collections of oxidized granules crunch underneath your every motion as you walk around, vaguely reminding you of the soft crackle of autumn leaves. That illusion is swiftly shattered by the feeling of a bone-dry breeze against your cheek, carried along the length of the Nova by weather systems you don’t have time to study. That once-great capital ship’s hull prevents any movement to the north, and an unsteady drift of dust amidst poorly-stacked machinery stops travel east.
rows.translation: 你四处行走时，结壳的氧化颗粒随每个动作在脚下咔嚓作响，隐约令人想起秋叶轻柔的碎裂声。脸颊感受到干燥至极的微风后，这种错觉立刻破灭；风沿诺瓦号船身吹来，由你没时间研究的天气系统推动。那艘昔日宏伟主力舰的船体阻止你向北，东边则有堆放不善的机械间积起一片不稳定尘丘，同样无法通行。
rows.raw: "Crusty collections of oxidized granules crunch underneath your every motion as you walk around, vaguely reminding you of the soft crackle of autumn leaves. That illusion is swiftly shattered by the feeling of a bone-dry breeze against your cheek, carried along the length of the Nova by weather systems you don’t have time to study. That once-great capital ship’s hull prevents any movement to the north, and an unsteady drift of dust amidst poorly-stacked machinery stops travel east."

rows.original: Next To Crashed Ships
rows.raw: "Next To Crashed Ships"

rows.original: This shaded area is markedly cooler than the surrounding spaces thanks to the two nearby starships. The Nova’s shadow is far larger, but the other ship, the one to the south, helps keep away any glare at times when the Nova’s is angled in the other direction. The only problem is the omnipresent breeze from the west, channeled between the two ancient hulks. It carries enough flecks of tiny metal to grate irritatingly against you. You can travel south alongside the smaller ship’s hull, west into the wall of wind, or east next to the Nova.
rows.translation: 由于附近两艘星舰遮挡，这片阴影区域明显比周围凉爽。诺瓦号投下的阴影大得多，但南边另一艘飞船也会在诺瓦号阴影转向别处时帮忙遮住刺眼阳光。唯一的问题是无处不在的西风，被引导着穿过两具古老船骸之间。风中携带着许多细小金属屑，恼人地刮擦身体。你可以沿较小飞船的船体向南，顶着风墙向西，或贴着诺瓦号向东行进。
rows.raw: "This shaded area is markedly cooler than the surrounding spaces thanks to the two nearby starships. The Nova’s shadow is far larger, but the other ship, the one to the south, helps keep away any glare at times when the Nova’s is angled in the other direction. The only problem is the omnipresent breeze from the west, channeled between the two ancient hulks. It carries enough flecks of tiny metal to grate irritatingly against you. You can travel south alongside the smaller ship’s hull, west into the wall of wind, or east next to the Nova."

rows.original: Next To Crashed Ships
rows.raw: "Next To Crashed Ships"

rows.original: Wind whips by your face as you traverse the area. The rust-red wall of the nova to the north works with the curved orange hulk of another wrecked ship to the south to channel idle gusts into blistering, scything wind. It bears little bits of metal and grit with irritating force, forcing you to shield your eyes just to look around. The only passable directions are east and west.
rows.translation: 穿越此地时，风从脸旁呼啸而过。北边诺瓦号锈红的墙体与南边另一艘失事飞船弯曲的橙色残骸共同将游荡的阵风汇聚成灼人如镰刃般的狂风。风带着细小金属片与砂砾猛烈袭来，逼得你必须遮住双眼才能环顾四周。只有东边和西边可以通行。
rows.raw: "Wind whips by your face as you traverse the area. The rust-red wall of the nova to the north works with the curved orange hulk of another wrecked ship to the south to channel idle gusts into blistering, scything wind. It bears little bits of metal and grit with irritating force, forcing you to shield your eyes just to look around. The only passable directions are east and west."

rows.original: Rust Fields
rows.raw: "Rust Fields"

rows.original: The rust fields come to and end here, bordering on the edge of the scything glades. You can see how the glades get their name - the area is filled with silvery, tree-like plants, only the branches are tipped with sharp blades. As you watch, the wind carries a plastic bag into the side of one. It’s impaled in a half-dozen places in seconds. The “trees” are too thick to risk travel to the east, and a mound of detritus to the north prevents movement that way.
rows.translation: 锈原在此处抵达尽头，与镰刃林地的边缘相接。你一眼便能看出这片林地为何得名：整个区域长满银色树状植物，只不过枝梢都带着锋利刀刃。你注视间，风把一个塑料袋吹向其中一棵，几秒内便有六处遭到刺穿。这些“树木”过于密集，无法冒险向东穿行；北面则有一堆废料挡住去路。
rows.raw: "The rust fields come to and end here, bordering on the edge of the scything glades. You can see how the glades get their name - the area is filled with silvery, tree-like plants, only the branches are tipped with sharp blades. As you watch, the wind carries a plastic bag into the side of one. It’s impaled in a half-dozen places in seconds. The “trees” are too thick to risk travel to the east, and a mound of detritus to the north prevents movement that way."

rows.original: Hardlight Suit Cooldown
rows.raw: "Hardlight Suit Cooldown"

rows.original: Relly
rows.translation: 雷利
rows.raw: "Relly"

rows.original: Relly
rows.translation: 雷利
rows.raw: "Relly"

rows.original: This is where Relly the hardlight mad scientist had built his lab. You could always accidentally fall for his trap and be used as a guinea pig if you wanted.
rows.translation: 这里曾是硬光疯狂科学家雷利建造实验室的地方。愿意的话，你随时可以不小心落入他的陷阱，被当作实验品。
rows.raw: "This is where Relly the hardlight mad scientist had built his lab. You could always accidentally fall for his trap and be used as a guinea pig if you wanted."

rows.original: TAUR
rows.raw: "TAUR"

rows.original: NAGA
rows.raw: "NAGA"

rows.original: HL_
rows.raw: "HL_"

rows.original: SUIT_FOUND
rows.raw: "SUIT_FOUND"

rows.original: HL_
rows.raw: "HL_"

rows.original: SUIT_EVER_EQUIPPED
rows.raw: "SUIT_EVER_EQUIPPED"

rows.original: Rust Fields
rows.raw: "Rust Fields"

rows.original: Here among the flat, featureless dunes of the rust fields, the sight of the silvery trees to the east comes as something of a relief. Of course, you dare not tread among them; it’s quite clear their branches are tipped with deadly blades, and they seem to swing them around with predatory intent whenever something moves nearby. You can go north and south along the border or west deeper into the rust fields.
rows.translation: 在平坦而毫无特色的锈原沙丘中，东面的银色树木着实令人稍感宽慰。当然，你不敢走入其中；显然，它们枝梢长着致命刀刃，每当附近有什么东西移动，便会带着捕食意图挥舞枝条。你可以沿边界向北或向南，也可以向西深入锈原。
rows.raw: "Here among the flat, featureless dunes of the rust fields, the sight of the silvery trees to the east comes as something of a relief. Of course, you dare not tread among them; it’s quite clear their branches are tipped with deadly blades, and they seem to swing them around with predatory intent whenever something moves nearby. You can go north and south along the border or west deeper into the rust fields."

rows.original: Rust Fields
rows.raw: "Rust Fields"

rows.original: You stand on a crossroads of sorts. Though you’re technically in the rust fields, the iron ridges aren’t far to the south, and the scything glade begins a few steps to the east. Luckily, there’s a large enough gap between bladed trees for you to pass quite comfortably. You can spot at least one corroded stump in the middle of the open area - someone has gone through great pains to try and open a path through the deadly foliage.
rows.translation: 你站在一处类似十字路口的地方。严格说来，你仍位于锈原，但铁脊就在南面不远处，向东走几步便是镰刃林地。幸运的是，刀刃树之间留有足够大的空隙，让你能相当轻松地通过。你至少能看见空地中央有一截腐蚀的树桩——显然有人费尽力气，试图在这片致命枝叶间开辟道路。
rows.raw: "You stand on a crossroads of sorts. Though you’re technically in the rust fields, the iron ridges aren’t far to the south, and the scything glade begins a few steps to the east. Luckily, there’s a large enough gap between bladed trees for you to pass quite comfortably. You can spot at least one corroded stump in the middle of the open area - someone has gone through great pains to try and open a path through the deadly foliage."

rows.original: Metal Ravine
rows.raw: "Metal Ravine"

rows.original: This deep, dark crevice between two house-sized plates is about the quietest, most shadowy place you’ve found on planet. The air is markedly still, and drifts of fine dust have accumulated against the giant sheets of metal into small mounds. There’s nowhere to travel but north from here.
rows.translation: 两块房屋大小的金属板之间有一道幽深昏暗的裂隙，这里大概是你在这颗行星上找到的最安静、最阴暗之处。空气明显静止不动，细尘飘落并堆积在巨型金属板边缘，形成一座座小土丘。从这里除了向北，哪儿也去不了。
rows.raw: "This deep, dark crevice between two house-sized plates is about the quietest, most shadowy place you’ve found on planet. The air is markedly still, and drifts of fine dust have accumulated against the giant sheets of metal into small mounds. There’s nowhere to travel but north from here."

rows.original: KIMBER_QUEST
rows.raw: "KIMBER_QUEST"

rows.original: Scything Glade
rows.raw: "Scything Glade"

rows.original: From somewhere nearby comes a pained scream that’s silenced almost as soon as it’s begun. You can only assume that the local fauna ran afoul of the glittering flora. In fact, after looking around, you spot the source of distress: a small, quadrupedal creature dead in the shadow of one of the great steel sentinels, its body punctured in a dozen places. Narrow streams of blood gather in pools beneath it, just above the roots of the predatory plant that killed it. You had best keep your distance.
rows.translation: 附近某处传来一声痛苦尖叫，却几乎刚响起便戛然而止。你只能推测，当地动物不慎招惹了这些闪闪发亮的植物。事实上，环顾一圈后，你发现了惨叫来源：一只小型四足生物死在一棵巨大钢铁哨兵的阴影下，身体十几处遭到刺穿。细细血流在尸体下方汇成血泊，恰好位于杀死它的捕食植物根系上方。你最好离远一点。
rows.raw: "From somewhere nearby comes a pained scream that’s silenced almost as soon as it’s begun. You can only assume that the local fauna ran afoul of the glittering flora. In fact, after looking around, you spot the source of distress: a small, quadrupedal creature dead in the shadow of one of the great steel sentinels, its body punctured in a dozen places. Narrow streams of blood gather in pools beneath it, just above the roots of the predatory plant that killed it. You had best keep your distance."

rows.original: Scything Glade
rows.raw: "Scything Glade"

rows.original: The “trees” of the scything glade are relatively sparse and widespread here, allowing you a number of avenues of travel. If you head west, they briefly thicken, but you can spot the rolling vistas of the rust fields just beyond. Alternatively, you could follow the gaps between the scything trees to the north or the south. There doesn’t seem to be any difference between the two paths besides direction.
rows.translation: 此处镰刃林地的“树木”相对稀疏，彼此间隔也很大，为你提供了好几条路线。向西时，它们会短暂变得茂密，但你能看见再往外便是锈原起伏的辽阔景色。你也可以沿镰刃树之间的空隙向北或向南。两条路除了方向外，似乎没有任何区别。
rows.raw: "The “trees” of the scything glade are relatively sparse and widespread here, allowing you a number of avenues of travel. If you head west, they briefly thicken, but you can spot the rolling vistas of the rust fields just beyond. Alternatively, you could follow the gaps between the scything trees to the north or the south. There doesn’t seem to be any difference between the two paths besides direction."

rows.original: Scything Glade
rows.raw: "Scything Glade"

rows.original: You’re struck by how red the soil of Tarkus is inside the glade; it’s so dark that it’s nearly purple in places, broken only by the glittering silver roots of the trees that hem your path. The gaps between them trail north and east from here, wide enough for you to be safe from the deadly blades so long as you mind your position.
rows.translation: 你惊讶地发现，林地中的塔库斯土壤竟如此鲜红；有些地方颜色深得近乎紫色，唯有夹住道路的树木闪亮银根打破这片色泽。根系间的空隙从这里分别通向北面与东面，只要留意自己的位置，道路便足够宽阔，能让你避开致命刀刃。
rows.raw: "You’re struck by how red the soil of Tarkus is inside the glade; it’s so dark that it’s nearly purple in places, broken only by the glittering silver roots of the trees that hem your path. The gaps between them trail north and east from here, wide enough for you to be safe from the deadly blades so long as you mind your position."

rows.original: Scything Glade
rows.raw: "Scything Glade"

rows.original: The gaps between the deadly, bladed trees fork into a ‘T’ intersection, offering unrestricted movement to the north, south, and west. The silver blades on either side rattle menacingly in the breeze, and more than once, you catch yourself stepping back at the unexpected sound. You’re glad for the good-sized gap in which you now stand. Those things don’t look like the type to discriminate when it comes to targets.
rows.translation: 致命刀刃树之间的空隙分岔成一个“T”字路口，可以畅通无阻地向北、向南或向西移动。两侧银刃在微风中发出威胁般的哗啦声，不止一次，你都因这突如其来的响动而下意识后退。幸好此刻所站的空隙相当宽敞。那些东西看起来可不会挑选目标。
rows.raw: "The gaps between the deadly, bladed trees fork into a ‘T’ intersection, offering unrestricted movement to the north, south, and west. The silver blades on either side rattle menacingly in the breeze, and more than once, you catch yourself stepping back at the unexpected sound. You’re glad for the good-sized gap in which you now stand. Those things don’t look like the type to discriminate when it comes to targets."

rows.original: Scything Glade
rows.raw: "Scything Glade"

rows.original: Web-like shadows shade the path, cast by the looming, metal behemoths on either side. There’s a certain menace in the air, like this place itself is filled with potential violence just waiting to burst out and claim its latest victim, but that may simply be your imagination acting up in this eerie location. Clear openings lead north and east, the only safe directions. Moving any other way would surely result in you being cut to ribbons.
rows.translation: 两侧高耸的金属巨物在道路上投下蛛网般的阴影。空气中弥漫着某种威胁感，仿佛这地方本身充满蓄势待发的暴力，只等着冲出来夺走最新受害者；不过，也可能只是在这诡异地点里，你的想象力开始作怪。清晰的缺口分别通向北面和东面，也是仅有的安全方向。若往其他方向移动，你肯定会被切成碎片。
rows.raw: "Web-like shadows shade the path, cast by the looming, metal behemoths on either side. There’s a certain menace in the air, like this place itself is filled with potential violence just waiting to burst out and claim its latest victim, but that may simply be your imagination acting up in this eerie location. Clear openings lead north and east, the only safe directions. Moving any other way would surely result in you being cut to ribbons."

rows.original: Scything Glade
rows.raw: "Scything Glade"

rows.original: The air blows through the trees to produce a warbling, keening wail that you can feel all the way in your bones. It pitches up and down with the changing wind speed, always seeming to adopt a shivering, uncomfortable tone. You briefly consider the idea that the haunting sound could be an intentional product of the way these things grow. Perhaps a scientist will be able to tell you someday.
rows.translation: 空气穿过树木，发出颤抖哀鸣般的呜咽，直透骨髓。声调随风速变化而起伏，却始终带着一种令人战栗不适的音色。你短暂思考过，这种幽灵般的声音会不会是这些东西特意以这种方式生长而产生的。也许有朝一日，某位科学家能告诉你答案。
rows.raw: "The air blows through the trees to produce a warbling, keening wail that you can feel all the way in your bones. It pitches up and down with the changing wind speed, always seeming to adopt a shivering, uncomfortable tone. You briefly consider the idea that the haunting sound could be an intentional product of the way these things grow. Perhaps a scientist will be able to tell you someday."

rows.original: Scything Glade
rows.raw: "Scything Glade"

rows.original: The light catches on the curves of the countless, scythe-like blades above, shining so brightly that you have to raise a hand to shield your eyes with alarming regularity. The gap between them bends to the south and west from here, uneven but suitably broad. You’re pretty sure that you can make out the edge of a cliff a good way to the east.
rows.translation: 光线照在头顶无数镰刀般弯曲的刀刃上，反射得如此耀眼，以至于你时常不得不抬手遮住眼睛。它们之间的空隙从此处弯向南方与西方，虽不平整，却足够宽阔。你几乎可以肯定，东面颇远处就是一片悬崖边缘。
rows.raw: "The light catches on the curves of the countless, scythe-like blades above, shining so brightly that you have to raise a hand to shield your eyes with alarming regularity. The gap between them bends to the south and west from here, uneven but suitably broad. You’re pretty sure that you can make out the edge of a cliff a good way to the east."

rows.original: Scything Glade
rows.raw: "Scything Glade"

rows.original: This winding path is almost maze-like. If it weren’t for the readings from your codex, you’d risk getting lost in here, turned around until you got desperate enough to brave the bladed limbs. Instead, you’re lucky enough to be able to chart your path. The path between the scythes twists east towards the face of a sheer cliff or canyon. You can’t make out anything past the lip. The trail through the glade also goes back north.
rows.translation: 这条蜿蜒小径几乎像座迷宫。若不是法典读数，你很可能会在这里迷路，不断绕圈，直至绝望得只能冒险闯过那些刀刃枝桠。幸运的是，你可以借此标记路线。镰刃之间的道路朝东蜿蜒，通往一面陡峭悬崖或峡谷的边缘。你看不清崖口外有什么。穿过林地的小径也会向北折返。
rows.raw: "This winding path is almost maze-like. If it weren’t for the readings from your codex, you’d risk getting lost in here, turned around until you got desperate enough to brave the bladed limbs. Instead, you’re lucky enough to be able to chart your path. The path between the scythes twists east towards the face of a sheer cliff or canyon. You can’t make out anything past the lip. The trail through the glade also goes back north."

rows.original: Planet Divide
rows.raw: "Planet Divide"

rows.original: Standing on the edge of this tremendous cliff, you can’t help but be overwhelmed by a sense of vertigo so powerful that you nearly topple off the edge. This is unlike any stone face you’ve ever seen before. Tarkus’s metallic rocks protrude jaggedly out from the edge, yet they are short enough to allow you an unobstructed view towards the core of the planet, the reddish haze of the atmosphere the only thing that stops you from seeing through to the other side. Perhaps the native goblins or raskvel used ships to mine off the more prominent, valuable protrusions.
rows.translation: 站在这道巨大悬崖边缘，你不由被一股强烈眩晕感淹没，险些从边上跌落。你从未见过这样的岩壁。塔库斯的金属岩石从边缘参差伸出，却又足够短，不会妨碍你望向行星核心；只有大气中的红色烟霭阻止你透过裂隙看到另一边。也许当地哥布林或拉斯克维尔曾驾驶飞船，开采掉那些更突出、更有价值的矿石。
rows.raw: "Standing on the edge of this tremendous cliff, you can’t help but be overwhelmed by a sense of vertigo so powerful that you nearly topple off the edge. This is unlike any stone face you’ve ever seen before. Tarkus’s metallic rocks protrude jaggedly out from the edge, yet they are short enough to allow you an unobstructed view towards the core of the planet, the reddish haze of the atmosphere the only thing that stops you from seeing through to the other side. Perhaps the native goblins or raskvel used ships to mine off the more prominent, valuable protrusions."

rows.original: Scything Glade
rows.raw: "Scything Glade"

rows.original: The dangerous flora of the scything glade is thinner here than in other places - you suppose due to the impending cliff to the east. More interestingly, an artificial platform starts just to the east, leading over the edge of the cliff to some kind of mechanical facility. From here, it’s difficult to tell its purpose; you’ll have to get closer for that.
rows.translation: 此处镰刃林地的危险植物比其他地方稀疏一些——你猜是因为东面紧邻悬崖。更有趣的是，一座人工平台从东面不远处开始，越过悬崖边缘，通往某种机械设施。站在这里很难判断它的用途；你必须走近才能看清。
rows.raw: "The dangerous flora of the scything glade is thinner here than in other places - you suppose due to the impending cliff to the east. More interestingly, an artificial platform starts just to the east, leading over the edge of the cliff to some kind of mechanical facility. From here, it’s difficult to tell its purpose; you’ll have to get closer for that."

rows.original: Artificial Platform
rows.raw: "Artificial Platform"

rows.original: You’re standing on the west end of a metal platform. Its surface gleams in the light from Tarkus’s sun in spite of the many scratches and scars that it bears. Somehow, it has yet to corrode in the harsh conditions. Whoever made this place built it to last, that much is clear. Barricades have been set up to the east around it.
rows.translation: 你站在一座金属平台的西端。尽管表面留下许多刮痕与伤疤，它仍在塔库斯太阳的光芒下熠熠生辉。即使环境如此恶劣，它不知为何依然没有腐蚀。无论是谁建造了这里，显然都打算让它长久存在。东面周围架设着路障。
rows.raw: "You’re standing on the west end of a metal platform. Its surface gleams in the light from Tarkus’s sun in spite of the many scratches and scars that it bears. Somehow, it has yet to corrode in the harsh conditions. Whoever made this place built it to last, that much is clear. Barricades have been set up to the east around it."

rows.original: Scything Glade
rows.raw: "Scything Glade"

rows.original: The scything trees that loom over you from nearly every angle split in three directions here: north, south, and west. A copse of reflective trunks prevents travel and sight to the east. You try not to think about what would happen to you if you were to stray into the murderous plants by accident and focus on keeping your eyes peeled for more mobile dangers.
rows.translation: 几乎从四面八方笼罩着你的镰刃树在此处分出三个方向：北、南、西。东面一片反光树干组成的小树林挡住道路与视线。你努力不去想万一意外闯入这些杀人植物会遭遇什么，转而集中精神，警惕更能移动的危险。
rows.raw: "The scything trees that loom over you from nearly every angle split in three directions here: north, south, and west. A copse of reflective trunks prevents travel and sight to the east. You try not to think about what would happen to you if you were to stray into the murderous plants by accident and focus on keeping your eyes peeled for more mobile dangers."

rows.original: Scything Glade
rows.raw: "Scything Glade"

rows.original: Two predatory plants have grown in too close to each other to the north. Their trunks have twisted around each other in a twisted, unhealthy-looking shape, and their many blades hang like sickly drapes around them, grinding audibly with every arid breeze. The air itself smells vaguely of blood, and the ground seems almost stained with it as well. You can’t really tell if the earth is truly saturated given how red with rust everything is, nor do you want to find out.
rows.translation: 北面有两株捕食植物长得过于靠近。它们的树干以一种扭曲病态的形状纠缠在一起，众多刀刃则像病恹恹的帷幔般垂落四周，每逢干燥微风吹过，便发出清晰可闻的摩擦声。空气本身隐约带着血腥味，地面似乎也染上了鲜血。四周一切都被铁锈染得通红，你实在无法判断土壤是否真已被血浸透，也不想查个究竟。
rows.raw: "Two predatory plants have grown in too close to each other to the north. Their trunks have twisted around each other in a twisted, unhealthy-looking shape, and their many blades hang like sickly drapes around them, grinding audibly with every arid breeze. The air itself smells vaguely of blood, and the ground seems almost stained with it as well. You can’t really tell if the earth is truly saturated given how red with rust everything is, nor do you want to find out."

rows.original: Scything Glade
rows.raw: "Scything Glade"

rows.original: A gnarled, argent root has emerged from the granular soil like the back of some great sandworm. If it did not catch the light so beautifully, you might have wound up tripping over it. As it is, you’re able to move carefully over its thickness. The thing’s “bark,” if it can be called that, is smooth to the touch, almost slickened with a kind of oil. Perhaps that secretion is what keeps it from corroding away. The path twists east and south from here.
rows.translation: 一条扭曲的银色树根从颗粒状土壤中隆起，仿佛某条巨型沙虫的脊背。若非它反射光线的模样如此美丽，你说不定已经被绊倒。现在，你得以小心越过这条粗大根系。它的“树皮”——如果真能这么称呼——摸起来十分光滑，几乎像涂了一层油。也许正是这种分泌物使它免遭腐蚀。道路从这里分别弯向东面与南面。
rows.raw: "A gnarled, argent root has emerged from the granular soil like the back of some great sandworm. If it did not catch the light so beautifully, you might have wound up tripping over it. As it is, you’re able to move carefully over its thickness. The thing’s “bark,” if it can be called that, is smooth to the touch, almost slickened with a kind of oil. Perhaps that secretion is what keeps it from corroding away. The path twists east and south from here."

rows.original: Scything Glade
rows.raw: "Scything Glade"

rows.original: This close to Tarkus’s great chasm, the air can go from placid warmth to gusting currents of chemical-tinted coolness that whip the flakey dust into an all-natural sand-blaster in an instant. Such gusts end almost as soon as they begin, long before they can cause much in the way of damage, but it is quite the irritant. You can walk east out onto the edge or north along the edges of the scything glade.
rows.translation: 靠近塔库斯大裂谷后，空气可能在顷刻间从平静温暖变成带有化学气味的凉风；强风卷起片片尘土，化作纯天然喷砂机。这种阵风几乎来得快去得也快，远在造成太大伤害之前便会结束，却依旧烦人得很。你可以向东走到边缘，也可以沿镰刃林地边界向北。
rows.raw: "This close to Tarkus’s great chasm, the air can go from placid warmth to gusting currents of chemical-tinted coolness that whip the flakey dust into an all-natural sand-blaster in an instant. Such gusts end almost as soon as they begin, long before they can cause much in the way of damage, but it is quite the irritant. You can walk east out onto the edge or north along the edges of the scything glade."

rows.original: Planet Divide
rows.raw: "Planet Divide"

rows.original: Whoah. The view from here is outstanding. Firstly, there’s the awe-inspiring chasm before you, but that’s just the start of it. The walls of the seemingly bottomless pit are covered with rusty stalactites, gleaming gems, and veins of the most beautiful amethyst. Perhaps a mile away, you can make out the opposite side of the chasm. By the stars above, this thing is huge, and it runs around the entire circumference of the planet! The hazy, polluted atmosphere stops you from seeing the whole way down whatever is holding this wreck together. The only viable direction is to the west.
rows.translation: 哇。这里的景色无与伦比。首先映入眼帘的是面前令人敬畏的裂谷，但那还只是开始。仿佛无底深坑的岩壁上布满锈色钟乳石、闪耀宝石以及最美丽的紫水晶矿脉。大概一英里外，你可以辨认出裂谷另一侧。天上的群星啊，这东西实在太大了，而且竟环绕整颗行星一圈！浑浊受污染的大气阻止你看清究竟是什么在下方维系着这片残骸。唯一可行的方向是西面。
rows.raw: "Whoah. The view from here is outstanding. Firstly, there’s the awe-inspiring chasm before you, but that’s just the start of it. The walls of the seemingly bottomless pit are covered with rusty stalactites, gleaming gems, and veins of the most beautiful amethyst. Perhaps a mile away, you can make out the opposite side of the chasm. By the stars above, this thing is huge, and it runs around the entire circumference of the planet! The hazy, polluted atmosphere stops you from seeing the whole way down whatever is holding this wreck together. The only viable direction is to the west."

rows.original: Planet Divide
rows.raw: "Planet Divide"

rows.original: The edge of the planet’s immense, bisecting chasm rears its ugly to the east, its shattered surface as irregular as the mineral-dense formations that line its walls. So far away that you can barely make it out, you can see the other half of the planet, or more accurately, the other half-planet that’s leashed to make up greater Tarkus. From here, it looks just about as trashed, though the wall on that side is a different shade of orange. You can continue south or west from here, though going west will take you back into the scything glade.
rows.translation: 行星上将其一分为二的巨大裂谷在东面露出丑陋面貌，破碎表面与岩壁上富含矿物的结构一样参差不齐。远处几乎难以辨认的位置，你能看见行星另一半；更准确地说，是被拴在一起、组成大塔库斯的另一颗半行星。从这里看去，那一边同样破烂不堪，只是那侧岩壁呈现另一种橙色。你可以从这里继续向南或向西，不过向西会把你带回镰刃林地。
rows.raw: "The edge of the planet’s immense, bisecting chasm rears its ugly to the east, its shattered surface as irregular as the mineral-dense formations that line its walls. So far away that you can barely make it out, you can see the other half of the planet, or more accurately, the other half-planet that’s leashed to make up greater Tarkus. From here, it looks just about as trashed, though the wall on that side is a different shade of orange. You can continue south or west from here, though going west will take you back into the scything glade."

rows.original: Scything Glade
rows.raw: "Scything Glade"

rows.original: LANESHOP
rows.raw: "LANESHOP"

rows.original: The sharp-bladed trees are a little farther back from the path here than elsewhere, perhaps due to the sizes of the few that do grow nearby. They’re easily twice as big as those around them. This could be a prime location for catching prey. You can definitely spot more than one skeleton half-buried in the rust-flaked earth around them.
rows.translation: 此处的利刃树比其他地方离道路稍远，也许是因为附近仅有的几棵都格外巨大。它们轻易就有周围同类的两倍大。这里可能是捕捉猎物的绝佳地点；你清楚看见周围布满锈片的土地里半埋着不止一具骸骨。
rows.raw: "The sharp-bladed trees are a little farther back from the path here than elsewhere, perhaps due to the sizes of the few that do grow nearby. They’re easily twice as big as those around them. This could be a prime location for catching prey. You can definitely spot more than one skeleton half-buried in the rust-flaked earth around them."

rows.original: There’s a little hut built between some of the trees to the north; if you squint just right, you can barely make out a sign above the doorway- “Lane’s Plane: Unlocking the New You”.
rows.translation: 北面几棵树之间建着一间小屋；若眯起眼睛仔细看，勉强能辨认门上方的招牌——“莱恩位面：解锁崭新的你”。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a little hut built between some of the trees to the north; if you squint just right, you can barely make out a sign above the doorway- “Lane’s Plane: Unlocking the New You”."

rows.original: Lane’s shop is tucked between some of the trees to the north.
rows.translation: 莱恩的商店藏在北面的树木之间。
rows.raw: "\n\nLane’s shop is tucked between some of the trees to the north."

rows.original: Safe paths lead to the east and west from here.
rows.translation: 安全道路从这里分别通向东面和西面。
rows.raw: " Safe paths lead to the east and west from here."

rows.original: LANESHOP
rows.raw: "LANESHOP"

rows.original: Lane’s Plane
rows.raw: "Lane’s Plane"

rows.original: You’re inside of a reasonably well constructed hut. The interior is dressed from top to bottom with fine, lacy fabrics and thin streamers blowing in the calm breeze, making it look quite inviting and standoffish, compared to the harshness of the surrounding area. The hut looks to have three rooms, and is only one story tall.
rows.translation: 你身处一间结构还算不错的小屋。室内从上到下装饰着精致蕾丝织物，纤细彩带在平缓微风中飘动；与周围环境的严酷相比，这里显得既亲切诱人，又有些矜持疏离。小屋似乎共有三个房间，而且只有一层。
rows.raw: "You’re inside of a reasonably well constructed hut. The interior is dressed from top to bottom with fine, lacy fabrics and thin streamers blowing in the calm breeze, making it look quite inviting and standoffish, compared to the harshness of the surrounding area. The hut looks to have three rooms, and is only one story tall."

rows.original: Scything Glade
rows.raw: "Scything Glade"

rows.original: The air in this part of the scything glade is unusually quiet, so much more than in the surrounding forest. Every single movement seems to grind the rust-flecked dust louder than an industrial sander. It practically echoes! You move as carefully as you can through the open areas, careful not to get too close to any of the trees, lest you wind up impaled on one of their menacing talon-branches.
rows.translation: 镰刃林地这一带的空气异常安静，远比周围森林更为寂静。每一个动作碾过夹杂锈屑的尘土时，声音都比工业砂磨机还响，几乎会产生回声！你尽可能小心地穿过空地，避免离任何树木太近，以免最终被它们那些威胁十足的利爪枝条刺穿。
rows.raw: "The air in this part of the scything glade is unusually quiet, so much more than in the surrounding forest. Every single movement seems to grind the rust-flecked dust louder than an industrial sander. It practically echoes! You move as carefully as you can through the open areas, careful not to get too close to any of the trees, lest you wind up impaled on one of their menacing talon-branches."

rows.original: Scything Glade
rows.raw: "Scything Glade"

rows.original: Webs of small, argent roots cross the open area between the trees here, exposed by eroding soil. The way they twist and entwine makes it impossible to distinguish one tree’s roots from the next. It wouldn’t surprise you to learn that they were all part of one giant root network, sharing nutrients from any tree lucky enough to catch a snack. You step carefully; there’s no point in getting turned into fertilizer before you’ve claimed your legacy. The gap between the scythe-bearing branches twists north and west from here.
rows.translation: 细小的银色根须如网般横跨林间空地，被不断侵蚀的土壤暴露出来。它们彼此扭曲缠绕，让人根本分不清哪条根属于哪棵树。就算得知它们其实同属一张巨大的根系网络，共享任何一棵幸运捕获食物的树木所吸收的养分，你也不会惊讶。你小心落脚；在拿到遗产之前就变成肥料，实在毫无意义。长着镰刀状枝条的树林缝隙从此处蜿蜒向北和向西延伸。
rows.raw: "Webs of small, argent roots cross the open area between the trees here, exposed by eroding soil. The way they twist and entwine makes it impossible to distinguish one tree’s roots from the next. It wouldn’t surprise you to learn that they were all part of one giant root network, sharing nutrients from any tree lucky enough to catch a snack. You step carefully; there’s no point in getting turned into fertilizer before you’ve claimed your legacy. The gap between the scythe-bearing branches twists north and west from here."

rows.original: Not far to the northwest, one of the trees looks to be suffering from the planet’s mildly corrosive atmosphere. You look a little closer and discover, much to your disdain, that it isn’t rust but dried-on blood. The ground around it is stained a dull crimson. There’s no visible corpse, but you are very, very sure that you don’t want to get any closer to these deadly plants. The gap between the dangerous flora bends east and south.
rows.translation: 西北方不远处，有棵树似乎正遭受这颗行星轻度腐蚀性大气的侵害。你凑近看了看，却厌恶地发现，那不是锈迹，而是已经干涸的血。周围地面也染成了暗红色。虽然看不到尸体，但你非常、非常确定，自己绝不想再靠近这些致命植物。危险植被间的缝隙向东和向南弯去。

rows.original: A forgotten ship that looks almost as old as the rest of the planet crashed here so long ago that the junk mounds have consumed at least half of its bulk. A fanciful musing that this is just the tip of a much larger craft comes to mind. What if this rounded, orange tip is just the capstone of a city-sized colony vessel? It would explain the wide variety of sapient natives. It’s likely no more than idle thought. You can head east, south, and west of here.
rows.translation: 一艘几乎和这颗行星其他事物一样古老的废弃飞船，很久以前坠毁在此，以至于垃圾堆已吞没至少一半船体。你忽发奇想：眼前的或许只是某艘更庞大飞船的尖端。假如这段圆润的橙色船头，其实是一艘城市大小的殖民舰露在外面的顶盖呢？这倒能解释当地智慧种族为何如此多样。不过多半只是胡思乱想。你可以从这里向东、南或西前进。

rows.original: To the south between the slabs and sickly vegetation, you can make out a large, squat, brick building, blackened with age and moldy with ancient Raskvel graffiti. An iron radio tower looms over it. It looks wholly unpromising, but the GPS data you compiled tells you that the sexbots originate from this area, and that building is the only significant structure in the area. It’s going to be a complete pain in the ass approaching it – the wreckage and briars which surround it are thick and hostile-looking. Looking through the detritus at the dark, blocky shape you feel a profound sense of foreboding. You’d best be as prepared as possible before confronting whatever is inside, if that is your intention.
rows.translation: 透过南边的残骸板块和病恹恹的植被，你能看见一座又大又矮的砖砌建筑。它因岁月而发黑，墙上布满古老的拉斯克维尔涂鸦和霉斑。一座铁制无线电塔耸立其上。那里看起来毫无希望，但你整理的GPS资料表明，性爱机器人的源头就在这片区域，而那栋建筑又是附近唯一显眼的结构。想靠近它肯定麻烦透顶——四周残骸与荆棘密集交错，看上去充满敌意。透过垃圾望着那栋黑暗方正的建筑，一股强烈的不祥预感涌上心头。如果你打算面对里面的东西，最好做好万全准备。

rows.original:
The Mess sure lives up to its name. Once the ship’s mess hall, a vessel of this size would have had a large cafeteria, and this place doesn’t disappoint. Easily large enough to seat several hundred raskvel (and it currently is), the Mess is dimly lit and smoky, thanks to a combination of tall, hookah-like devices set up on several tables as well as a pillar of woodsmoke coming from the kitchen, which is exposed to the mess hall thanks to a busted-in bulkhead. Several raskvel chefs in cute white aprons are running around trying to tend to dozens of orders at once. The wait-staff are hurrying about, trying to deliver their goods as fast as they can. Strangely, most of the waiters and waitresses are human, each bearing the emblem of the Carver Catering Company - three C’s across the breast and back of their sheer black uniforms.

On the far side of the Mess, there’s another room sealed off from the restaurant by a pair of heavy doors and glass windows. By its dark interior and the off-worlders coming and going, you reckon that’s the way to the local tavern.
rows.translation:
“食堂”果然名副其实。这里曾是飞船餐厅，而如此巨大的舰船理应配备大型用餐区，此地也确实没有令人失望。它轻松容得下几百名拉斯克维尔人——眼下也确实坐了这么多——室内昏暗而烟雾弥漫，一部分来自几张桌上高耸的水烟壶状装置，另一部分则是厨房升起的木烟。厨房与大厅之间的舱壁已经破损，因此完全暴露在餐厅中。几名身穿可爱白围裙的拉斯克维尔厨师跑来跑去，同时应付几十份订单；服务员也匆忙穿梭，竭力尽快把餐点送到客人手中。奇怪的是，大多数男女侍者都是人类，每人都佩戴着卡弗餐饮公司的标志——透明黑色制服的前胸和后背各印着三个C。

食堂远端还有一个房间，用一对厚重舱门和玻璃窗与餐厅隔开。看看里面昏暗的环境和进进出出的外星人，你推测那就是通往本地酒馆的入口。

By its dark interior and the off-worlders coming and going, you reckon that’s the way to the local tavern."

rows.original: You’re in the Mess’ attached bar, thankfully separated from the deafening din of the open hall by a sturdy wall and thick windows. Though still smoky, the bar has a much calmer, friendlier atmosphere, and you’re quickly able to find a seat thanks to a hostess at the door, wearing a strikingly skimpy version of the Carver uniform: a simple black vest, a thong, and fishnets to cover most of her body. The rest of the staff seems to be just as scantily clad, if not more so: a stage has been erected on one wall, where a topless ausar girl in nothing but her fishnets and a pair of pasties is currently singing to the accompaniment of an old-earth jazz band made up of raskvel in little tuxedos. The bar here is clearly catering to a higher-class clientele, and most of the people lounging around are fellow spacers and pioneers coming in for the Planet Rush, while others have the air of off-duty U.G.C. scouts and engineers. Almost everyone has a drink or a half-nude server in their lap, maybe both. This place is a weird mesh of retro earth and sensuality, that’s for sure.
rows.translation: 你身处食堂附设的酒吧。幸好这里有坚固的墙壁和厚实的窗户，将开放大厅震耳欲聋的喧嚣隔绝在外。酒吧虽仍烟雾缭绕，气氛却平静友善得多。门口的女招待很快替你找到了座位；她穿着格外暴露的卡弗制服：一件简单的黑背心、一条丁字裤，以及包裹身体大部分区域的渔网袜。其余员工似乎穿得同样少，甚至更少：一面墙前搭着舞台，一名奥萨女孩赤裸上身，只穿渔网袜并贴着乳贴，正在演唱；为她伴奏的是一支由穿小礼服的拉斯克维尔人组成的旧地球爵士乐队。这里显然面向更高档的客群，休息区里大多是为星球大开发而来的太空客和开拓者，也有些看起来像休假的U.G.C.侦察员和工程师。几乎每个人手里都有酒，腿上坐着半裸侍者，或者两者兼有。这里无疑是复古地球风情与色情氛围的奇妙混合体。

rows.original: Before you is the Chasmfall, a chasm through the heart of the planet where Tarkus was stitched together centuries if not millennia ago from the shattered remains of two disparate worlds. Here is the border between this half of the world and another, separated by a gap nearly a mile wide. At the edge of the rift, you can see a towering steel structure: the monitor station, one of the few structures on Tarkus you’ve seen that actually looks well-cared-for. Beyond it, you can see a massive cargo elevator and shaft have been built into the side of the chasm, surrounded by hundreds of the great tethers bolted between the halves of the planet, desperately straining to hold Tarkus together. Each of them seems attached to that building, each carefully checked and monitored constantly for any sign of trouble.
rows.translation: 眼前便是“裂谷瀑布”：一道贯穿行星核心的深渊。几个世纪、甚至几千年前，塔克斯正是在此由两个截然不同世界的碎裂残骸缝合而成。这里是世界这一半与另一半的边界，两者之间隔着近一英里宽的鸿沟。裂隙边缘耸立着一座钢铁建筑：监控站，也是你在塔克斯见过少数显然维护良好的设施之一。它后方，一座巨大的货运电梯及其井道嵌入深渊侧壁；周围有数百条巨型系索固定在行星两半之间，拼命承受张力，维持塔克斯的完整。每条系索似乎都连着那座建筑，并持续接受细致检查与监控，以防任何异常。

Each of them seems attached to that building, each carefully checked and monitored constantly for any sign of trouble."

rows.original: The lift station’s foyer is a large, semi-circular waiting room, dominated by a big desk facing outward, laden with security monitors and data outputs, showing the status of the rift and tethers at a glance. The pirates have, wisely, jacked internal camera feeds from the core station below, preventing you from getting a head’s-up on their positions.
rows.translation: 升降站大厅是一间宽阔的半圆形候车室，正面摆着一张占据视觉中心的大桌子，上面堆满安保监视器和数据终端，能让人一眼掌握裂谷与系索的状态。海盗很明智地劫持了下方核心站的内部摄像信号，让你无法提前掌握他们的位置。

rows.original:
Just beyond the control station is the huge cargo elevator leading down into the chasm between worlds. Large enough for a couple of cargo freighters to ride down side by side together, the cargo lift is currently stacked with crates and heavy equipment, doubtless intended for the tether station at the core. Stepping forward, you can see the elevator tracks leading down almost beyond sight, deep into the planetary heart.

Beside the cargo lift, though, is a much smaller personnel elevator: a glass-encased car on a straight rail down to the station below, just big enough for a dozen workers or so to cram into. That’s your ticket down.
rows.translation:
控制站后方就是通往两个世界之间裂谷的巨型货运电梯。它大到足以让两艘货船并排下降，眼下堆满箱子和重型设备，无疑是要送往核心的系索站。走上前去，你能看见电梯轨道一路向下，几乎消失在视野尽头，深入行星心脏。

不过货梯旁还有一座小得多的人员电梯：一节玻璃包裹的轿厢，沿直轨通往下方站点，最多只够十来名工人挤进去。那就是你下去的途径。

rows.translation: 控制站后方就是通往两个世界之间裂谷的巨型货运电梯。它大到足以让两艘货船并排下降，眼下堆满箱子和重型设备，无疑是要送往核心的系索站。走上前去，你能看见电梯轨道一路向下，几乎消失在视野尽头，深入行星心脏。\n\n不过货梯旁还有一座小得多的人员电梯：一节玻璃包裹的轿厢，沿直轨通往下方站点，最多只够十来名工人挤进去。那就是你下去的途径。
rows.raw: "Just beyond the control station is the huge cargo elevator leading down into the chasm between worlds. Large enough for a couple of cargo freighters to ride down side by side together, the cargo lift is currently stacked with crates and heavy equipment, doubtless intended for the tether station at the core. Stepping forward, you can see the elevator tracks leading down almost beyond sight, deep into the planetary heart.\\n\\nBeside the cargo lift, though, is a much smaller personnel elevator: a glass-encased car on a straight rail down to the station below, just big enough for a dozen workers or so to cram into. That’s your ticket down."

rows.original: The walkway connecting the lift and the tether control station is a long, thin passageway overlooking the great planetary rift through the heart of Tarkus. With every step, it shifts precariously on its supports

rows.original: Suspended between two planets with nothing but void above and below, this walkway cuts a dangerous path to the facility in the center of it all. Signs of conflict cover the structure - scorch marks here, dents there, even a railing sliced clean through by some kind of energy blade. The facility lies east and the elevator out west.
rows.translation: 这条步道悬在两颗行星之间，上下皆是虚空，沿着危险路线通向中心设施。结构上到处留有交战痕迹——这里是焦痕，那里有凹坑，甚至有一段栏杆被某种能量刃整齐斩断。设施位于东方，电梯则在西边。
rows.raw: "Suspended between two planets with nothing but void above and below, this walkway cuts a dangerous path to the facility in the center of it all. Signs of conflict cover the structure - scorch marks here, dents there, even a railing sliced clean through by some kind of energy blade. The facility lies east and the elevator out west."

rows.original: This platform circles around a massive, ancient machine of alien design. It’s roughly cylindrical and extends at least a few hundred feet in all directions. Metal gratings provide a solid anchor for your [pc.feet] thanks to the electromagnetic gear you picked up in the elevator.
rows.translation: 这座平台环绕着一台巨大而古老的外星机器。它大致呈圆柱形，向各个方向至少延伸数百英尺。多亏你在电梯里拿到的电磁装备，金属格栅为你的[pc.feet]提供了牢靠的立足点。
rows.raw: "This platform circles around a massive, ancient machine of alien design. It’s roughly cylindrical and extends at least a few hundred feet in all directions. Metal gratings provide a solid anchor for your [pc.feet] thanks to the electromagnetic gear you picked up in the elevator."

rows.original: The metal supports that ring the central structure have been supplanted by a series of floating platforms to the north, piled with crates and other equipment. The primary platforms bend south and east from here, shaded in places by metal beams and shafts of pure energy that radiate into the half-planets on either side.
rows.translation: 环绕中央结构的金属支架，在北方被一系列堆满箱子及其他设备的浮空平台取代。主平台从这里分别向南、向东弯曲，部分区域笼罩在金属梁架与纯能量柱的阴影下；这些能量向两侧半颗行星辐射而去。
rows.raw: "The metal supports that ring the central structure have been supplanted by a series of floating platforms to the north, piled with crates and other equipment. The primary platforms bend south and east from here, shaded in places by metal beams and shafts of pure energy that radiate into the half-planets on either side."

rows.original: Beams of energy and corded metal alike radiate from the central column, connecting to the planet on all sides. To the north, or at least what your codex’s instruments report as north, are a series of floating platforms laden with all manner of crates and equipment. They do not appear to be a permanent installation; perhaps the pirates brought them with them?
rows.translation: 能量束与绞合金属索同样从中央立柱向四周辐射，与行星各侧相连。北方——至少你的法典仪器报告那里是北方——漂浮着一系列装满各种箱子和设备的平台。它们不像永久设施；或许是海盗带来的？
rows.raw: "Beams of energy and corded metal alike radiate from the central column, connecting to the planet on all sides. rows.original: The permanent walkway around the stellar tether curves south and west around the central facility here, well-anchored and relatively safe to travel upon. The hastily deployed floating platforms to the north are objectively secure, barely anchored in place as they are. Placed there by the pirates, these temporary structures are covered in crates of all sizes and descriptions.
rows.translation: 恒星系索周围的永久步道从这里向南、向西绕过中央设施，锚定牢固，行走相对安全。北方匆忙部署的浮空平台却显然不够稳固，几乎没怎么固定。海盗搭设的这些临时结构上堆满了各种尺寸、各种类型的箱子。

The rest of the platform is stable and secure at least - no chance of you randomly tumbling into the zero-grav expanse around Tarkus’s conjoined core. You can follow the pathway around the impressive alien structure to the east and west.
rows.translation: 南侧栏杆已经消失，被爆炸装置从固定座上炸飞。至少平台其余部分依然稳固安全——你不至于无缘无故跌入塔克斯拼合核心周围的零重力空间。你可以沿着道路向东或向西，绕过这座宏伟的外星结构。

You can follow the pathway around the impressive alien structure to the east and west."

rows.original:
Diagnostic tools float around you in seemingly random directions. Now and again you have to duck your head to avoid a tumbling spanner. The bottom half of a bullet and laser-riddled crate clings stubbornly to the metal grates while the rest of its splintery mass bursts into popping flames on contact with the myriad energy beams that hold the planet together.

You can follow the platform north and east.
rows.translation:
诊断工具看似毫无规律地向各个方向漂浮。你不时得低头躲开翻滚而来的扳手。一只遭子弹和激光打穿的箱子，其下半截仍顽固地卡在金属格栅上；其余碎裂部分一接触维系行星完整的无数能量束，便爆成噼啪作响的火焰。

你可以沿平台向北或向东前进。

The bottom half of a bullet and laser-riddled crate clings stubbornly to the metal grates while the rest of its splintery mass bursts into popping flames on contact with the myriad energy beams that hold the planet together.\n\nYou can follow the platform north and east."

The remains of the errant security droids are scattered around the barricade, still crackling with electricity. To the north is a huge steel blast door. To the west, an elevator shaft. To the east, what looks like some kind of armory, if the cute picture of a gun on the side of the door is any indication.
rows.translation: 这条走廊被改造成了某种路障，几只箱子和设备堵塞通道，只容一人单列通过。失控安保机器人的残骸散落在路障周围，仍噼啪冒着电火花。北面是一扇巨大的钢制防爆门，西边是电梯井，东边似乎是某种军械库——至少门上那幅可爱的枪械图案是这样暗示的。

rows.original: The secondary reactor bay is a huge room, easily taking up half the deck with thrumming power converters and a glowing fusion reactor dominating the center of the expansive room. Several wires lead directly from the reactor to dozens of computer banks, servers, and hard drives scattered all through the room, like half the computers aboard the ship were all pulled and clustered around the reactor.
rows.translation: 副反应堆舱是一间巨大的房间，几乎占据半层甲板。嗡鸣的能量转换器遍布其中，发光的聚变反应堆则占据宽阔房间的中心。数条电线从反应堆直接连向散布各处的几十组计算机阵列、服务器和硬盘，就像有人把船上一半的电脑都拆下来，堆到了反应堆周围。

Several wires lead directly from the reactor to dozens of computer banks, servers, and hard drives scattered all through the room, like half the computers aboard the ship were all pulled and clustered around the reactor."

rows.original: Tessa pulls herself up, lifting her chest away from your face. She gives your [pc.hips] a squeeze with her thighs, reminding you of how powerful they are. She looks down at you and smiles. “As you desire.”
